text.使用后将二品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.2 Tripod in Forge.

text.使用后将七品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.7 Tripod in Forge.

text.以水属性灵液炼制而成，柔若无物，可自由变换形体。: Being made with the essence fluid of water element, it is extremely flexible and can change it's form freely.

text.使用后将五品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.5 Tripod in Forge.

text.使用空冥玄铁炼制而成，注入灵力之后剑身会巨大化，威力惊人。: Being forged with the Desolation steel, the sword will grow in size when being infused with mana, holding incredible power.
text.使用后将六品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.6 Tripod in Forge.

text.使用后将一品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.1 Tripod in Forge.

text.离火木雕刻而成，上面印有火焰纹路，常见的低阶法器。: Carved from Inferno Wood, it has a fire pattern on it, a commonly seen craft.
text.炼制时加持了低阶风灵阵，能够略微提升行动力。: Augmented with a low grade wind array during making, sightly increases the wearer's mobility.
text.使用火云沙炼制，御寒效果极佳，但防御效果不甚出众。: Made with Fire Cloud Sand, it is very effective to resist cold, but doesn't provide much defense.
text.鬼修常用的法宝，其内封印着万千魂魄，需要时可驱使御敌。: A commonly used trump by the Ghostly Path, it contains thousands of soul within it, able to use it to attack enemy when needed.
text.由大神通修士炼制，内含须弥结界，可将一片天地封印其中。: Made by a powerful practitioner, it contains huge space inside, able to seal the world within it.
text.样式华丽的头冠，其上有玉龙盘绕，像是世俗之物。: A gorgeous crown surrounded by jade dragon, seems like an otherworldly item.
text.传闻某位仙界大能，将整个大陆连同其内生灵炼化成此宝。: It was said that once a powerful individual made this treasure from a continent, including all the living being inside.
text.使用真灵玄武的皮炼制而成，并封印了玄武的一缕魂魄，防御力极佳。: Made from the skin of Black Tortoise and sealing a part of it's soul inside, it provides extreme defensive capabilities.
text.万年寒玉打造，触之冰冷刺骨，只适合修习水属性功法的修士穿戴。: Made with Millennial Jade, wearing it would feel chills to the bone, only suitable for practitioner who practices water technique.
text.炼制时加入了少量雷劫石，使得其威力较寻常飞剑有很大提升。: A small amount of Thunder Tribulation stone were added during it's forging process, giving it superior power compare to average flying sword.
text.辅助型的法宝，可窥视万里之内的任何一处景象。: A supportive trump, able to have a peek of any scene within a wide range.
text.由玄冥铁吸纳大量煞气，再经冥火锻造而成，充满杀戮血腥气息。: Made from the Nether Steel that absorbed a huge amount of kill intent and forged with Nether Flame, it is filled with a slaughtering aura.

text.使用青山石打造，因表面刻有青龙而得名。: Made from green mountain stone, it got his name from the Azure Dragon engraved on the surface.
text.剑身嵌有七颗星璇石，暗含北斗七星之势，可施展七星剑阵。: Embedded with 7 star gem, it contains the power of the stars, able to perform the seven star array.
text.蕴含雷霆之力，驱动后在周身形成雷电屏障，攻守兼备。: Contains the power of thunder, it forms a lightning barrier around the owner when activated, providing both offense and defense.
text.使用万年雪晶炼制，蕴含冰雪之力，可将河川化为冰川。: Made with a ice crystal that is million years old, it contains the power of ice, able to freeze any river.
text.使用多种水属性材料炼制，对水系法术有不错的抵抗力。: Made with all kinds of water element material, it has good resist towards water spell.
text.由上古真灵“天睛兽”的独目炼制而成，可看破世间幻象，乃世间异宝。: Made with the single eye of the ancient spirit "Heavenly Shine Beast", it is able to see through every illusion, an exotic treasure.
text.使用灵蚕丝炼制的法袍，质地柔软，能够抵消部分五行法术伤害。: A robe made with spirit silk, it is soft and able to neutralize most of the 5-Element spell's damage.

text.因炼制时掺入了大量秘银，使得剑身银光闪耀，故而得名。: Fused with huge amount of Mithril during forging, it made the sword shines brightly, thus the name was given.
text.加持了神风法阵，催动之后如御风而行，堪比飞行法宝。: Augmented with Godwind array, the owner could walk on wind after activation, a flying trump.

text.炼制时掺入了天蚕丝，能够变化成罗天巨网困住敌人。: Fused with heavenly silk during making, able to form a huge web to trap enemy.

text.妙音门炼制的法宝，专门用于破除幻阵，以及修士的幻化伪装。: A trump made by Miaoyin Clan, specialize in breaking illusion and camouflage.
text.加持了由八卦阵衍生出来的坎离阵，威力较寻常法器有所提升。: Augmented with Kun Li array of the Eight Diagram, it has more power compare to average craft.
text.定魂玉雕琢而成，有少许温养神识的作用。: Carved from Soulfix Jade, it can calm your mental.
text.将万灵石置于炎阳精火中煅烧万余载，方可得此异宝。: This treasure can only be obtained by burning the Million Spirit Stone within the Refined Sun Fire for million years.
text.使用青魂矿打造，并且参入了少量秘银，能够有效抵御法术攻击。: Forged with Green Soul Ore and fused with a small amount of Mithril, it is able to resist spell attack effectively.
text.由寒魄冰晶炼制，催动之后，方圆万里皆化为冰雪之地。: Made with Cryosoul Crystal, activating it will freeze all of your surroundings.

text.防御力不佳，但是可以遮掩自身气息，隐匿踪迹。: It has poor defense but is able to hide the wearer's aura.
text.造型古朴，紫气缭绕，穿戴之后颇有仙家气范。: With a classic look and surrounded by auspicious aura, wearing it makes you feel like a deity.

text.元始仙尊早年曾用此剑灭杀过域外魔神，后将其赏赐给门下弟子。: Primeval Lord once used this sword to kill the outer devils, and gave it to his disciple.

text.为感谢你又为仙界引渡了一位杰出的修仙之士，小小心意，不成敬意，还望笑纳。: To thank you for guiding another outstanding practitioner to the deity world, here is a little gift for you.
text.拥有一座灵兽院，可以用来饲养灵兽。: Having a Pet Hall could use it to raise pet.

text.这个锦盒在灵宝阁也有售，没了就去那买吧。: This brocade box are being sold at the Treasure Chamber too, buy it there when runs out.
text.宗门弟子需每隔一段时间去坊市采购日常物资。: Sect disciple require to purchase dairies at the market from time to time.
text.在门派周围的山峰上布置法阵，互相呼应，防止外敌入侵。: Set up array on the peak of mountain around the guild, to prevent invader.
text.引动灵泉之水，灌溉后山药田。: Guide the water of Spirit Fountain to water the Yam Field.
text.在藏经阁里整理一些经年日久落满灰尘的书籍。: Sorting some old books in the scripture hall.
text.去接待前来拜访的各门各派的道友，参观我宗门气象。: Go and welcome our visitors from other clan and faction to have a look at our sect.
text.通过空间节点进入异界，探索并带回异界的信息。: Enter the other world through space node, explore and bring back information.
text.运送灵果至后山灵兽山庄。: Transport the fruit to the village behind the mountain.
text.带领门人弟子守护空间节点，抵御异界凶灵的侵袭。: Lead the disciple to guard the space node from the wraith of other world.
text.清扫大殿前的落叶，是一项非常简易的门派任务。: Cleaning the fallen leaf in front of the hall is an easy guild quest.
text.虫谷的瘴气即将爆发在即，师尊命你前往消除扩散的瘴气。: Miasma of the Worm Valley is bursting soon, master orders you to go and clear the miasma.
text.前往其他宗门，获取有用情报，监视对方宗门动向。: Proceed to other sect in order to obtain useful information while monitor their movement.
text.带领门人弟子前往神魔谷，铲除盘踞于此的妖魔鬼怪。: Lead the disciple to the Shaytan Valley and remove the devil there.
text.代表门派下山历练，通过游历各地和增长见闻磨练自己的心志。: Go out to travel representing your guild and train yourself.
text.门中灵兽稀少，急需一批新的灵兽补充。: Clan beast is running low, require a new batch of beast.
text.藏书阁三长老需要一名弟子代为抄录典籍。: The 3rd elder of Book Store needs a disciple to copy books.
text.将自己的成仙感悟传道于万物生灵，指点它们修行。: Spread your thoughts of ascension to other living being, helping them in their practice.
text.在门派山门外进行巡逻，警惕一些外来人士进入。: Patrol the outside of the guild gate, prevent the invasion of outsider.
text.为新入门的弟子讲解初级功法，指导他们进行修行。: Explain the primary technique to new disciple, helping them out in practice.
text.照顾门派灵田，清理灵田内杂草。: Take care of the clan field, clean out the weeds.
text.考核刚刚入门弟子的修为，了解一下他们的修炼境界。: Test the attainment of new disciple, and understand their state of practice.
text.你刚来到深渊的底层，尚未有所行动，便有大批魔物向你围过来。: You just reached the bottom of the abyss, and a huge swarm of monster surrounds you.
text.你一直走到洞窟尽头，正欲返回，身后突然传出了沉闷的呼吸声。: You've reached the end of the cave, just when you want to head back, a depressed breath came from behind.
text.山脚下有一条小河，你在河畔发现一间草屋，呼喊了几声，无人应答。: There is a small river under the mountain, you found a shack beside the river, but no one seems to be around.
text.你走到岔道尽头，发现一具修士遗骸躺在地上，看样子已死去多年。: You walked to the end of the road and found a practitioner skeleton on the ground.It seems that he has been dead for many years.
text.莫名闯进了一座废弃的修士洞府。正准备探索，一个眼露杀机的修士拦住了去路。: Inexplicably broke into an abandoned practitioner abode.Being ready to explore, a practitioner stopped your way.
text.前方一片区域遍布着蜘蛛网，你还看到了一些小蜘蛛在爬来爬去。: The area infront is filled with spider web, and some spiderlings crawling around.
text.你从死去的邪修身上找到了一副地图，看起来是他存放宝物的秘密洞府。: You found a treasure map from the corpse of the evil practitioner, it seems like the map shows where he hid his treasure.
text.击败了蒙面修士，你一路上到石塔的顶层，看到几个檀木盒子散落在地上。: Defeating the masked practitioner, you walked to the top of stone tower, and saw a few wooden boxes lying on the floor.
text.你在一片空旷之地发现了几栋建筑废墟，思索着要不要探查一番。: You found a few building ruins in the plains, thinking if you want to explore it.
text.你在密林间发现了血迹，追寻过去，看到一个受伤的修士正在疗伤。: You found blood track in the jungle, following it, you saw a wounded practitioner is healing himself.
text.你看到远处树林里有一个被触发的陷阱，应该是山里的猎户布置的。: You saw a triggered trap in the forest, seems like a hunter from the mountain set it up.
text.你在赶路时意外发现了一个灵物，灵物旁边有一个强大的妖兽在看守。: You found a spiritual being while on a hurry, and a strong devil beast is guarding the being.
text.你听到附近传来了奇怪声响，循声望去，看到石壁上有条巨大的石缝。: You heard a weird sound coming from nearby, looking over, you saw a huge crack on the stone wall.
text.你在一片密林之中看到一个水池，池中逸散出浓郁的灵气。: You saw a pool within the jungle that is filled with essence.
text.你偶然发现了一个洞天福地，只可惜这里已经被妖兽占据了。: You found a cave paradise accidentally, too bad that it is occupied by devil beast.
text.进门之后是个石室，里面布满了灰尘，似乎很久都没人来过了。: Within it is a stone room filled with dusts, seems like no one came here for a long time.
text.你尾随一个气息诡异的修士，来到了座山神庙，里面有一股股魔气在涌动。: You stalked a mysterious practitioner to a temple that is filled with evil aura.
text.你颇费了一番手段，才击败了栖居于此的妖兽，准备探查一番。: After a hard fight, you defeated the demon beast, and decide to explore the place.
text.在一处僻静之地，你发现了一个深不见底的地穴，散发出阴冷的气息。: In a silent place, you found a hole with an endless depth, giving out a chilling sense.
text.正思索的时候，旁边的树枝突然缠向你，树干之上浮现出一张人脸。: In your thoughts, the vine suddenly tangles you, and a human face appears from the tree trunk.
text.进到山洞内，突然一股猩风从背后袭来，你险险躲过。一个不知名野兽进入视野。: After entering the cave, you felt a fierce wind from your back, and you dodged it.An unknown wild beast enters your sight.
text.你发现了一个乱石堆，石堆中有灵气溢出，可能会有什么灵物。: You found a stone pile with flowing essence, something might be inside.
text.你发现一颗数十人环抱的巨型灵木，其底部有一个树洞，似乎能通到树顶。: You found a enormous tree with a huge hole at it's roots, seems like it could lead to the top of the tree.
text.你查阅了地图，发现附近有个小型坊市，过去看一下可能会有所收获。: You checked the map and discovered a small market, taking a look might give unexpected rewards.
text.你正在追逐一只妖兽，突然周围景色大变，似乎是闯进了一个幻阵。: You were chasing a demon beast, suddenly the scenery changes, it seems like you've broke into a illusion array.
text.山腰处耸立着一座破败的石塔，还没进入其中，一个蒙面修士便冲了出来。: A ruined stone tower is on the hill, just when you were going in, a masked practitioner rushed out from it.
text.你追寻妖兽来到了一个破败的寺庙，却不想这里正站着一个相貌怪异的修士。: You followed the devil beast to a broken temple, and saw a weird looking practitioner standing there.
text.当你找到了遗留的宝物时，同行修士却突然翻脸，威胁你交出宝物。: When you found the treasure, the other practitioner suddenly betrays you and threatens to gain possession of the treasure.
text.刚下到坑底，就看到一群马蜂向你飞来，每一只都有拳头大小。: Once you've reached the end of the pit, you saw a bunch of hornet flying towards you, each at the size of a punch.
text.你发现了一个黝黑的洞窟，里面有一丝丝血腥味散发出来。: You found a dark cave that emits a bloody scent.
text.行走间，前方突然出现一个打扮怪异的修士，身上散发出邪恶的气息。: While you were walking, a weirdly dressed practitioner appeared in front of you, emitting an evil aura.
text.前方出现了一片建筑废墟，还残留有少量阵法波动，似乎刚废弃不久。: A building ruin appeared in front, with some array wave still left in it, seems like it has just been abandoned.
text.进入洞穴之后，发现里面的灵气非常浓郁，这种地方往往存在天地灵物。: After entering the cave, you could feel that the cave is filled with essence, only heavenly being lives in places like this.
text.你在山谷里发现一个小型湖泊，湖泊中传出了婴儿哭泣般的声音。: You found a small lake within the valley, within it comes the crying voice of a baby.
text.山顶处一个石亭里聚集着几个修士，他们邀请你参加他们的小型交易会。: Few practitioner gathered at the stone hut located at the top of the mountain, they invited you to join their small trading session.
text.你路过一个修士洞府，考虑着要不要进去结识一番，交流下修炼心得。: You passed by a practitioner cave, wondering if you should go in to acquaint with the practitioner and have a talk about practicing.
text.你沿着树洞向上攀爬，发现树顶处有一只丑陋的独眼巨鸟正目光不善地盯着你。: You climbed upwards following the hole, and found an ugly, one-eyed huge bird looking at you in a bad way.
text.山腰处有一个妖兽的巢穴，里面散落着一些兽类残骸，还有些血迹。: There is a devil beast's cave on the hill, within it is some remains of other beasts and some blood track.
text.翻过一个山坡，一片郁郁葱葱的竹林映入眼帘，似乎是人为种植的。: After walking over a hill, you saw a huge field of bamboo forest, seems to be artificially.
text.前方出现了一个小宗门的遗址，还能察觉到微弱的阵法波动。: A ruins of a small sect appeared in front, you still can feel a weak array wave.
text.进入到密林深处，你发现这里灵气充沛，非常适合修行。: After entering to the depth of the jungle, you feel that it is filled with essence, a place very suitable to practice.
text.击败了守护妖兽之后，你终于进入了秘境，可以好好探索一番了。: After defeating the guardian beast, you can finally enter the realm and explore it.
text.你探查一番后准备离开，突然之间，一个巨大的身影挡在了出口前面。: You were prepared to leave after exploring, but a huge shadows blocked the exit in a sudden.
text.正当你走进废墟中心探查时，废墟四周闪现出几个修士，将你包围起来。: As you walk into the center of the ruins, several practitioner came out from around and surround you.
text.进入石缝后是个密室，正要探查，头顶一个黑影向你扑来。: It is a secret room behind the crack.About to explore, and a black shadow on top pounce on you.
text.打败了修士之后，你来到地宫二层。入眼的大厅中间摆放着一个大箱子。: After defeating the practitioner, you came to the second floor of the underground palace.In the center of the hall is a huge chest.
text.你发现了一株灵草，正欲采摘，突然有个修士驱使法宝向你攻来。: You found a grass, just about to pick, and suddenly a practitioner attack you by using trump.
text.你无意中触发了一个阵法，一个个妖兽从阵法中出现。: You accidentally triggered an array, causing monsters to swarm out from it.
text.远处传来了一声嚎叫，你循声过去，看到了一个妖兽的巢穴。: You head a howl coming from afar, as you went over, you saw a demon's lair.
text.你在坊市中偶然结识一位修士，他邀请你去探索一个古修士遗留的洞府。: You accidentally met a practitioner in the city, and he invited you to explore the Abode left by an ancient practitioner.
text.你发现了一个上古封印，好不容易将其破除，却放出了一个上古妖灵。: You found an ancient seal, breaking it after great effort, you released an ancient devil spirit.
text.你按照地图指引找到了一个秘境，但是入口处盘踞着强大的妖兽。: You found a hidden realm according to the map, but a strong demon lies at the entrance.
text.你刚刚猎杀了一个妖兽，尚未来得及休息，身后突然传出法宝攻击的波动。: You have killed a devil beast.Before able to rest, there is a sudden wave of Trump attacks.
text.你触碰了一个神秘石碑，被传送到一个未知地方，出口似乎就在不远处。: You touched a mysterious tablet, it teleported you to an unknown place, but the exit seems to be not far away.
text.你在一片灵气浓郁之地发现一块废弃灵田，似乎有人曾经在这里种植灵草。: You found a piece of abandoned land that is rich in essence.Someone seems to have planted spirit herbs here.
text.你感受到天地灵气正在向某个地方汇聚，难道是有异宝出世？: You feel that the essence of heaven and earth is gathering in a certain place, could it be a rare treasure about to appear?
text.当你走进一个幽深的洞穴时，看到洞穴深处有一双猩红的眼睛。: When you walked into a deep and dark cave, you saw a pair of crimson eyes looking at you from within.
text.前方石壁上有个门，旁边伫立着两个石像，当你走过去时，石像动了。: There is a door at the stone wall, beside it is 2 statue, when you walked over, the statue moved.
text.你走进了一个岔道，没走多远，发现前面盘踞着一条巨蟒。: After walking awhile after passing a crossroad, you saw a giant anaconda laying in front.
text.当你经过一条狭长的小道时，前方出现了几个匪寇，拦住了你的去路。: While you are crossing the long road, few bandits appeared and blocked your way.
text.前方雾气笼罩，依稀可见一片沼泽。雾气中沼泽妖鳄的双眼闪着阴森的绿光。: A swamp can be seen within the foG.The eyes of the devil swamp crocodile is giving out a creepy green light within the mist.
text.前方隐约可见一个洞窟，里面传出了阵阵阴气，还伴随着野兽的嚎叫。: A cave could be seen in front, within the cave you could hear the growling of unknown beast.
text.沼泽深处有一座洞府。似乎已荒废了很久的样子，不知道洞府内会不会有些灵宝。: There is a cavern deep within the swamp.Seemed unexplored for years, who knows there might be treasures.
text.前方出现了一个深渊，阵阵魔气涌出，深渊底部似乎有魔物活动。: An abyss has appeared right infront, with demonic aura surging out, seems like there is demon laying at the bottom of the abyss.
text.远处有水声传来，是一条千丈瀑布，瀑布后面隐约可见一个山洞。: You could heard water flowing from afar, after checking it, it is a waterfall, and a cave could be seen behind the waterfall.
text.行走间，你闻到一股香气，香气来自一个洞穴，有只妖兽正伏在洞口。: While you were walking, you could smell a fragrant scent coming out from a cave, and a devil beast is laying infront of the cave entrance.
text.前方出现了一个黑色水池，你靠近了之后，池水中突然跃出一条怪鱼。: A black pool appears in front, after getting closer, a strange fish leaps out from the pool.
text.你走进了一片寂静的密林，尚未走多远，身后突然涌现出一股强大的气息。: You walked into a silent jungle, but just within a few steps, you felt a strong presence behind you.
text.你走进了一片树林，树林里非常寂静，看不到一只鸟兽。: You walked into a forest, it is very quiet, and no animal could be seen.
text.山北面有一个天坑，深不见底，你犹豫着要不要下去。: There is a heavenly pit located at the north side of the mountain, it is so deep you could not see the end of it, you wonder if you should go down.
text.玃如其状如鹿而白尾，马足人手而四角。: A legendary ape that has deer look with white tail.
text.“天地五行，万物相生。火灵是也！”: "5-Elements, all living things engender one another. It's Fire Spirit!"
text.“天地五行，万物相生。金灵是也！”: "5-Elements, all living things engender one another. It's Metal Spirit!"
text.毕方，其状如鹤，一旦鸣叫，便会引发火灾。: Bifang, it shape resembles a crane, but whenever it tweets, it would trigger a fire disaster.
text.据闻三十年前数十名修真人士讨伐穷奇，最后无一生还。: It was said that many practitioner has tried to exterminate Qiongqi, but none has survived.
text.“遇到我只能怪你自己命不好。杀了你之后，我会好好的对待你的灵宝。”: "Blame your bad luck on facing me.I will treat your treasure well after killing you."
text.“吾乃地坤真君，负责镇守两仪大阵。”: "I am the Earth Immortal, responsible for guarding the Duality Array."
text.泽更之水出焉，而南流注于滂水，水有兽焉，名曰蛊雕，其状如雕而有角，其音如婴儿之，: At a small river besides the swamp,there is one beast named Gudiao, it has the shape of a crane but has horns, it sounds is like a baby, but is harmful to human.
text.“看你在这里兜兜转转，定是找不到出处。既然来了，那干脆就别走了。”: "You have been wandering around here, seems like you could not find the exit.Since you are here, just stay here."
text.“此乃星宫管辖之地，擅闯者死！”: "This place is under the rule of Star Palace, those who enters without permission shall face death!"
text.“你的血肉闻起来很香，看来是一盘不错的食物。”: "You smell nice, you must be delicious."
text.“你的血肉闻起来很香，看来是一盘不错的食物！”: "You smell nice, you must be delicious!"
text.“蝼蚁！面对仙人还不跪下，是嫌自己活得太久了吗？”: "Ants! Kneel down, or you want to die?
text.“道友请留步，乖乖交出你的灵器法宝，我或许可以考虑让你死个痛快！”: "Hey, hand over your Spirit Trump, I may consider to kill you instantly!"
text.“大胆！你竟敢擅闯我的洞府，定叫你魂飞魄散。”: "How dare you! How dare you enter my abode! I'll make you pay."
text.“大胆凡人！竟敢闯我百莽山，定叫你魂飞魄散。”: "Puny mortal! How dare you to invade my mountain, I will make you pay."
text.“你这小小蝼蚁，竟然敢打扰本王，不知死活！”: "Puny humans, how dare you to disturb me, you shall have your death!"
text.“本座开阳子，奉元始仙尊谕令，镇守七星大阵。”: "My name is Kaiyuan Zi, guarding the 7-Star Array under the order of Primeval Lord."
text.“能击败我的手下，看来有两把刷子，不过也就到此为止了。”: "You seems capable by defeating my underlings, but this is how far you will go."
text.其状如马而白首，其文如虎而赤尾，其音如谣，其名曰鹿蜀，佩之宜子孙。: It has the shape of a horse, the stripe of a tiger but with a white head and red tail, it cries is like reciting a poem, it's name is Lushu, a gentle beast.
text.“你我并无深仇大恨，咱们分出胜负即可，不必拼个你死我活。”: "We have no grudge, just a normal spar will do."
text.传说西王母十分贪婪，如今更是要霸占这镜天之景。: It was said that the Western Mother Queen is very greedy, now she evens wants to single-handedly owns this beautiful scenery.
text.“咦！居然是个人族修士，都说人族修士随身携带大量天材地宝。不知道你如何？”: "Oh! They say that human practitioner always carries all kinds of treasure on them.How about you?"
text.“又来一个不怕死的……来来来，就让我赏你痛快一死！”: "Another fearless guy……Come forth, I shall grant you your death!"
text.“这位道友，遇到我只能怪你自己命不好。杀了你之后，我会好好的对待你的灵宝。”: "Blame your bad luck on facing me.I will treat your treasure well after killing you."
text.有蛇焉，名曰肥遗，六足四翼，见则天下大旱。: There is a type of snake that is called Feiyi, it has 6 legs and 4 wings, it's appearance means drought to the world.
text.“凡人！面对龙族你居然敢动杀意，我要将你轰成碎渣。”: "Mortal! How dare you to have the intent to kill a dragon, I will blast you to smithereens."
text.有兽焉，其状如彘而有角，其音如号，名曰蠪蚳，食人肉。: There is one beast that takes the shape of a horned pig, it's name is like it's cries, which is called Longchi, it feasts on human meat.
text.“有兽焉，其状如禺而四耳，其名长右，其音如吟，见则郡县大水。: "There is one beast that takes the shape of a 4-eared ape, it's name is Changyou, it's appearance would cause flooding to the world.
text.应龙处南极，杀蚩尤与夸父，不得复上，故下数旱，旱而为应龙之状，乃得大雨: Yinglong lives at the South pole, as it killed Chiyou and Kuafu, the heaven punished it and the world with a massive drought.
text.“愚蠢的人类，你以为能奈何得了我吗？”: "Stupid humans, you think you can do anything?"
text.“站住！百莽山禁止人族修士通行！否则，杀无赦！”: "Hold up! No human practitioner is allowed to traverse Mt.Baimang! get out, or die!"
text.“闯入者，这里不欢迎任何人族修士。否则，杀无赦。”: "Invaders, human practitioner are not welcomed here." get out, or die."

text.每一滴汗水，都不会白流。每一次冥思，都会增加你的修为。: Every drop of sweat will not be wasted.Every meditation will increase your attainment.
text.修炼如逆水行舟，不进则退。: If the cultivation is like a boat against the water, just retreat.
text.今日小弟我有恙在身，不便见客。: I'm not feeling well today, hence I'm inconvenient to meet guests.
text.此番小比结果着实糟糕，也难怪掌门师兄如此生气。: The result this time is really bad, no wonder the Leader is so angry.
text.察俗世芸芸众生之奔波，如苍蝇竞血，蝼蚁争食。: Look at the movements of all living beings, such as flies competing for blood, and ants fighting for food.
text.万里江海通，九州天地宽。: The whole world can be gone through.
text.宗门已经很久没有出现像我一样的修真奇才了。: The sect has not seen the magical talents like me for a long time.
text.黄庭内人服锦衣，紫华飞裙云气罗，丹青绿条翠灵柯，七蕤玉龠闭两扉。: Courtiers of the Dantian clothed in brocade, purple robe woven in the Qi cloud, red and green seams are numinous boughs of the spirit, jade wedge with seven flowers secure the two-wing door.
text.赖凌师姐的修为又精进了一步，我如何才能超越她？: Senior Lailing has improved again.How can I surpass her?
text.看来小李子也不是一无是处嘛。: It seems that Lee is not useless after all.
text.如果碰到一些珍禽异兽，趁其未化形前收服它，待其修成化形，元婴期以下皆不是对手。: If you encounter some rare animals, subdue them before it is deformed.Attainment below Nascence would be no match if it transformed.
text.神识入体，元婴开目，胎息翕张，流转星芒。: Deity Possession, foundation starts, fetus open, the stars circulates.
text.元气所合列宿分，紫烟上下三素云，灌溉五华植灵根，七液洞流冲庐间: The vitality of the pool is divided into three points:consciousness as fire, breathing as wind, and the essences under these two influences changed into Vigor.You need to attain the base in order to protect the 5 internal organs.
text.碧波潭不是你来的地方，速速离去。: Bibo Pond is not a place where you could come, leave now.
text.百岁如流，富贵冷灰。大道日丧，若为雄才。: Life and death are not the most important, but the meaning of life process.The road is getting worse, who is the hero?
text.有什么事明天再说，我先去你师叔那里讨一杯醉仙酿。: Let's talk tomorrow.I'm going to your elder master for a cup of wine first.
text.天地与立，神化攸同。期之以实，御之以终。: Heaven and earth, standing together deifying.The truth of the period, the end of the royal.
text.你近日修炼进展不错，再接再厉！: You have been doing great in the recent practice, keep up the good work!
text.清涧之曲，碧松之阴。一客荷樵，一客听琴。: The song of Qingjian, the shade of Bisong.Only for you.
text.那些千山积雪，万家灯火，皆是人间炊烟，情义恩重，良辰美景，也都似昙花一现。: Those mountains and snow, thousands of lights, everything is just a flash in the pan.
text.妖怪大多吸收太阴之气修行，孤阴不生，所以大多要吸食人类阳气。: Most of the monsters absorb only Yin.But Yin is not enough, hence most monsters will need to absorb Yang from the Human.
text.师侄何必如此拘谨，我这里又不是龙潭虎穴。: Why are you so conscientious, it is not like I will eat you.
text.人人都说神仙好，古来几人能悟道？: Everyone says that being God is good.But how many people can be enlighten?
text.若无要事就离去吧，莫要耽误我修炼。: Please leave if you have no more question, I need to practice.
text.别丢人现眼了。: Do not make a fool of yourself.
text.虚天殿创立至今，已有五万余年了。: It has been more than 50,000 years since the establishment of the Vain Temple.
text.没先到上人惩治妖怪如此得心应手，失敬。: Sorry for not recognizing you.You are good in punishing these monsters.
text.资质不足悟性不足什么都不足，还修个什么仙，老老实实当个凡人吧！: You are insufficient in everything.It would be a waste to practice immortalization.Why not just stay a mortal!
text.没关系，这飞贼本不是一般人。: It doesn't matter, this thief is not an ordinary person.
text.我当初要是没有求得仙缘，如今也是个状元郎。: If I didn't ask to be immortal, I would be Top Scholar.
text.一得便超三界外，乘鸾跨鹤谒枫宸。: Exceed the world when one has time, and visit the imperial apartments on a crane.
text.为帮助XX炼制丹药，赠与她了一些药材。: In order to help XX in refining the Orb, you gave her some materials.
text.来来，看我这身皮囊如何？: Come here, have a look at my body?
text.人生百年，管他天意是什么，只要本心率性，修不得长生也无妨。: For the whole life, forget what is the God's will, as long as you stay kind, it doesn't matter even if unable to live forever.
text.我拜入师门至今已有数百年，山下亲友早已成为一抔黄土，真是让人伤感。: I have been in the division for hundreds of years, and all my relatives and friends have turned into soil.It is really sad.
text.修士在结丹之后，面容的衰老就变得极其缓慢。修为进阶至元婴，面容就不会再衰老下去。: After the Form completed, the aging of the face will become extremely slow.After being upgraded to Nascence, the face will no longer age.
text.我有一个妹妹，拜入万妖谷门下，不知道现在过的怎么样。: I have a younger sister who went to the Devil Valley.I wonder how she is now.
text.你还不够格跟我打。: You are not qualified to fight with me.
text.碧峰海面藏灵书，斗乘巨浪骑鲸鱼。: Hide book on the rippling surface of the sea.Dressed in a cloak, riding a whale on the surging wave.
text.没想到这孙老二如此厉害，连您也制不住。: I didn't expect this guy is so powerful, even you can't hold it.
text.下次做任务带上我，好不好嘛？: Can you bring me with you to the next quest?
text.山本无忧，因雪白头，水本无愁，因风起皱。: Mountain has no worries but white-headed due to the snow.Water has no worries, but starts to ripple when the wind blows.
text.空闻当真是天赋异禀，看来我梵天宗复兴有望了。: Kongwen is gifted.It seems that the revival of Brahma is possible.
text.修仙最忌七情六欲，不要妄动凡心。: Immortalization is abstain from seven emotions and six desires.
text.我贵我荣都不羡，重重再教炼黄房。: I'm not envy when I'm rich, but I'll repractice.
text.天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。: Heartless world, where everything is low living things.
text.你在藏经阁时有没有发现我的发簪？: Did you find my hairpin when you were in the Scripture Chamber?
text.求仙固然好，没了生老病死，若再没了七情六欲，当真无趣的紧。: It's good for immortality.No more aging and sickness.But it is really boring if there is no emotions.
text.功满自然居物外，人间寒暑任轮回。: Beyond natural habitats, the world will reincarnate.
text.这些突然果然不是好惹的。: These are surely not to be messed with.
text.收下礼物，微微一笑。: Receive the gift with a smile.
text.金炉飞篆乘鸾去，玉笈翻经引鹤还。: Golden furnace flies, and flip through the book.
text.随我直上仙霄游。且尽情欢娱倚红偎翠。生命苦短良宵过，畅快一时是一时。: Follow me to play.And enjoy the concubines around.Life is short, and cherish the time you have.
text.听说青瑶师叔新招了一个女弟子，长得是真水灵。: I heard that Qingyap Elder has recruited a pretty female disciple
text.药田里出现了一个巨大的蛹#它正准备羽化成蝶#可是在破开蛹的瞬间好似卡住了#不断挣: There is a huge pupa in the medicine field# It is preparing to change into a butterfly# But it seems to be stuck #Continuously struggling to come out?
text.凡人修仙一路艰险重重。能成仙者万中无一。: It is a tough journey to become immortals.Those who can become immortal is one in a million.
text.古今天下，没有不死的肉身，只有永恒的法身。: Since ancient times, there is no undead body, but only the eternal body.
text.弟子多年来忝列门墙，有负师父教诲: I have brought shame to the clan, I feel guilty towards Mentor.
text.多谢师傅发放用度。: Thanks you master for the payment.
text.与XX分享修真之道，相谈甚欢。: Sharing the journey of cultivation with XX, it's a joyful chat.
text.哎，连几个混混都打不过。: Hey, you can't even fight a few gangsters.
text.这神秘人到底有多高的修为啊…: How high is this mysterious man's attainment...
text.这妖怪可不是一般人惹得起的。: This monster is not what ordinary people can provoke.
text.我可真是信错了人。: I believe in the wrong person.
text.我在修道之前，是个铁匠铺的小伙计。: Before I start cultivation, I was a worker in a blacksmith shop.
text.你这点修为让我就更难下台了。: Your attainment is too low for me.
text.我觉得我只能亲自出手了。: I think I have to stand out myself.
text.我看你还是回去提升下修为吧。: I think you should return and improve your attainment.
text.你这修为还不如我呢，也敢去找那些流氓…: You are not as good as me, yet you went to look for those hooligans...
text.修行大道无止境，还不快去修炼！: There is no end to the cultivation path, time to practice now!
text.没想到你这么年前修为却这么高，帮我大忙了。: I didn't expect your attainment to be this high at this age, and you helped me a lot.
text.哈哈哈，上人果然厉害。: Hahaha, the Elder is really powerful.
text.总算找回这些钱了，真是辛苦上人了。: These money is finally recovered, thank you Elder!.
text.今日在北山结识了一位师妹，那姿色简直如画中人。: I've met a Junior Sis in Beishan today, and she looks like she came out from a drawing.
text.我建议你下次练练再来。: I suggest that you practice before coming back.
text.你这修为也敢如此狂妄？: How could you be so arrogant with this power?
text.啧啧，我都让你先打了。: Hey, I let you start first.
text.看来我的修为也不算差嘛: It seems that my attainment is not bad.
text.我是你都不好意思出手。: If I am you, I won't fight.
text.这修为你也敢动手。: You dare to fight with this attainment.
text.你以为我是好惹得嘛。: Do you think that I can be pushed around?
text.在下，自叹不如。: I admit I am not that good.
text.我输了你拿走就是。: I've lost, just take it away.
text.别打了，都给你。: Stop hitting me, it's all yours.
text.别站在外面了，到我跟前来。: Do not stand outside, come with me.
text.你们这帮小辈还算不错，比我年轻的时候强多了。: You guys are pretty good, better than me when I was younger.
text.我当年可是凌霄宫的天才，就连掌门师兄都不如我。: I was called the genius of Summit Palace, even my senior is not my match.
text.神仙结庵处，有青牛系柏，白鹿升天。: Where there is a tied green bull and ascending white deer, where there is deity.
text.你最近修炼到了瓶颈，不如下山寻找机缘。: You have reached the bottleneck, why don't you look for chance down the mountain?
text.好久没有出去过了，哪天我们去谷外转转吧。: I haven't been out for a long time.Let's go outside the valley one day.
text.来得正好，快陪我下一局，哈哈哈。: Just in time, come on, play with me.
text.大道无情，白鹤有情。: The nature is merciless, but the white crane is not.
text.徒儿你来白鹤谷也有些日子了，觉得这里怎么样？: You have been here for some time, how do you think about this place?
text.你师傅也真是的，这么大年纪了，还生小辈的气。: Your shifu shouldn't be this petty.
text.这些个外门弟子也太不争气了，杀了算了。: These outer disciples are good for nothing, just kill them.
text.前几日心绪不宁，为宗门卜了一卦，大凶，不妙啊。: I felt uneasy a few days ago and made divination for our sect.Something bad is going to happen.
text.我逍遥楼的门人，自当要过得逍遥快活。: We peripatetic must lead a carefree life.
text.近来修仙界的局势愈加动荡，怕是有大事要发生。: The situation is unsettling recently, something big is going to happen.
text.范师叔当真是仙子般的人物。: Uncle Fan is really a fairy-like person.
text.这次的宗门大比，我是赢定了，哈哈哈！: There is no way that I will lose the coming Sect match!
text.最近都不见你练功，莫不是又在偷懒？: Are you a bit slack recently?
text.人人都道白龙只是个传说，真是愚昧无知。: Everyone just know that White Dragon is a legend, how ignorant.
text.子轩师侄好像有些心事，你去宽慰宽慰他吧。: Something seems to be bothering Ziyuan.Go and comfort him.
text.为兄近日读了一本古籍，有些晦涩难懂。: I read an ancient book recently, but it is hard to comprehend.
text.徒儿你再修行个三年五载，就可以下山历练了。: You need 3 or 5 more years of practice before you can go to the outside world.
text.哎，饶是修炼了时间功法，也难敌岁月蹉跎。: No magic can stop the time.
text.师傅日理万机，我等做弟子的要为其排忧解难。: Shifu is so busy, we must help him out.
text.又来向我求那株龙樱草了？死心吧，我不会卖给你的。: You want to ask for the Dragon Grass again? Give up, I will never sell that to you.
text.没看到我正忙着吗？赶紧从我眼前消失！: Can you not see I am busy? Get out of my sight!
text.掌门师兄寿元无多，圣天宫该何去何从…: The days of the leader is numbered, what to do with the Heaven Palace?
text.师傅待我恩重如山，我绝不能辜负他老人家的期待！: Shifu is my benefactor, I can never let him down!
text.过些日子为师要闭生死关，门中事务就交给你大师兄了。: I am going to stay in an isolated place for practice.I will leave the affair of sect to your eldest senior.
text.想学鬼道功法吗？我可以教你。: Interested in Ghost Technique? I can teach you.
text.为何师弟们老是躲着我呢？就连师傅也一样。: Why are they hiding from me? Same to Shifu.
text.志业那小子，打扮的阴阳怪气的，我看到他就烦。: I feel vexed whenever I see Zhiye, that weirdo.
text.我这里还需要一些炼丹用的灵草，你帮我留意一下。: I still need some Spirit Herb, keep an eye for me.
text.有事就找你师傅去，不要来烦我。: Go to your Shifu if you need help, leave me alone.
text.我前些日子刚修炼了一门秘术，改天给你露一手。: I just learnt a new secret spell a few days ago, let me show me some other day.
text.下一次的三宗会盟，你随我一起去长长见识吧。: In the next Trinity Assembly, you can go with me to open your eyes.
text.哈哈哈，走，跟师叔去喝几杯！: Let's go and have a drink with me!
text.剑修者，一生只修一剑，切莫分神于旁门左道。: A sword practitioner, can practice only one sword in a lifetime.Do not be distracted.
text.我也要努力修炼，成为大师兄一样的人物。: I will work hard to become a figure like Elder Senior.
text.闷头苦修难有所成，不如随我外出寻找机缘。: It is better to go outside and look for chances to improve yourself.
text.为师传你的火龙焚天术，修炼的如何了？: How is your practice of Dragon Stifling Spell?
text.你最近修为提升太快，可能会根基不稳。: Your grow too fast recently, your basic might be unstable.
text.虚山性子鲁莽，你多留意下，别让他做傻事。: Xushan is reckless.Keep an eye on him, do not let him do anything silly.
text.三尸宗的那帮兔崽子欺人太甚，待我去收拾他们！: The 3 Corpse Sect is gone too far.I am going to teach them a lesson!
text.师傅在闭关，若非紧急之事，不要打扰他老人家。: Shifu is being isolated for practice now.We shall not disturb him unless we really have to.
text.为师过几日要闭关，这期间你切记不可懈怠。: I am going to stay in an isolated place for practice.Do not slack off during this time.
text.这些晚辈真不像话，简直不把门规放在眼里！: How absurd of these young people to ignore the sect rules!
text.好多年没有回过西域，不知那里变成什么样了。: I haven't been to the western region for many years.I don't know what has become there.
text.若是无事，就不要来打扰我。: Do not disturb me unless you really have to.
text.玉虚府的那帮臭道士，真是活得不耐烦了！: Are those priests getting tired of living?!
text.难道媚娘还没有看出我对她的情意吗？: Have she not noticed my affection for her?
text.谷内那么多女弟子，你就没有看得上眼的？: There are so many female disciples here, not even one you like?
text.陪我去后山玩好不好嘛~: Can you accompany me to the back mountain?
text.师侄啊，替我去灵山坊市买些丹药可好？: Can you go and get some orb back for me?
text.大师兄整日都在藏经阁研读经文，真令我等汗颜。: It makes us shame to see Elder Senior study scriptures all day long.
text.佛道两家殊途同归，世人愚昧，难见其真。: Both Buddhism and Taoism lead people to the same destination.Common people are too ignorant to realize the truth.
text.佛曰，不可言，不可言。: Buddha said, this is beyond words.
text.君既至柴扉前，何不叩门而入？: Since you are already here, why do you not knock and go in?
text.归然宗待我不薄，我会尽全力守护它。: Gui Ranzong has treated me well.I will protect it no matter what.
text.师傅整天喝酒，不干正事，得想个法子劝劝他。: Shifu drinks all day and does nothing.We must find a way to persuade him.
text.我私下传你的那些法术，可不要让你师傅知道。: Do not let your Shifu know that I am teaching you the spells.
text.白灵那丫头，近日好像有些心事。: Something seems to be bothering Bailing.
text.如今魔道势力越来越强，必须想个办法了。: The Diabolic is getting stronger.We must find a way to stop them.
text.听说虚天殿新招了一个小师妹，哪天过去认识一下。: I heard that Vain Temple has recruited a new female disciple.Let's go and see her some other day.
text.谁要是敢违反门规，老夫就把他吸成肉干。: I will turn those who violate the sect rules into dried meat.
text.正派的那些伪君子，满口的仁义道德，可笑！: Those hypocrites of the decent sect are full of lies, how ridiculous!
text.下次比试，我一定会赢了你的。: I will defeat you next time.
text.这位同门面生的紧，可是最近才入门的？: You look unfamiliar, you just came here?
text.听说您的居处有仙鹤灵猿，可否带我前去看看。: I heard there is crane and ape at your place, can you show me?
text.听说修道之后人会停止生长了，那我会不会长不高了呀。: I heard that the body of practitioner will stop growing up.So will I stop growing tall too?
text.山下的那些人眼睛很讨厌，看得人好不自在。: The way the people down the mountain look at me is so uncomfortable.
text.山中的生活寂寥如斯，我有些想念以前跟小姐妹们刺绣同游的生活了。: The life in the mountain is so lonely, I miss my life in the past now.
text.这山里的动物都有灵性，假以时日，修成内丹化为人形也不足为奇。: The animal here is very intelligent.They might be able to turn into human shape over time.
text.你将来得道飞升，切不可高高在上，孤家寡人，忘了我们这些同门师兄妹 。: If you become an immortal in the future, do not become arrogant and forget us.
text.朝露昙花，咫尺天涯。许多昨日的道友未扛过雷劫，身陨道消，教人唏嘘不已。: Flower in the morning, so near yet so far.Sadly, many of them failed to overcome the thunder tribulation and died.
text.每次渡劫都让我心惊肉跳，好害怕会魂飞魄散。: Every time of ascension scares me, I am afraid that my soul will break apart.
text.修仙经历的劫数#就是做人经历的劫数#也是踏错一步就天地之别。: What you experience in the process of immortalization is like what you experience when you are a mortal.One mistake would finish all.
text.掌门虽未得道成仙白日飞升#但要论才气之高心胸之旷达#就算真正的仙人也是万万不及。: Our leader is not an immortal yet, but even a deity might not be as talented and noble as him.
text.生在俗世，身为凡人，你没有可以得道成仙的灵丹妙药，也没有可以一步登天的灵异奇遇。: Born in this mortal world, you have neither elixir nor special encounter to make you an immortal.
text.我求仙问道可不是为了长生，只是嫁人生子的生活太过无趣罢了。: I want to become an immortal not for longevity, just because the mortal life is too boring.
text.物盛则衰，天地之常数也。故有缺，才能无限达至圆满。: Vicissitude in life is inevitable.It wanes, so it can wax.

text.西极海是妖兽的天下，海里的妖兽有亿万种，人类修士很少涉足，故而所知甚少。: The West sea is the domain of demon beasts, rarely explored therefore little knowledge of it.
text.北域之地濒临幽冥海，气候严寒，常年被冰雪覆盖，适合水灵根修士修行。: The northern land is close to the Nether Land with extremely cold climate.It is covered with snow and ice all year round.It is suitable for Water Aptitude practitioner.
text.大道三千，每个人都有自己心中的道，关键是如何让自己的道为天地所认同。: Everyone has their own interpretation of enlightenment, the key however is to convince the world of the path you've chosen.

text.上古时期的修仙界和现在大为不同，某种巨大的变故形成了现今的修炼体系。: The ancient immortal world is very different from the present, and some great changes have formed the current cultivation system.

text.修真之路并无捷径可走: There is no shortcut when it comes to Immortalization
text.人生得意须尽欢: Make the most out of your happiness
text.但愿长醉不复醒: I would rather live in the dreams
text.你念在相识一场，应声附和他所说。众人纷纷信以为真，他赚足了面子，大喜过望。等到结: You should just go along with what he said since he is your friend.Everyone believed in him, he is over the moon for gaining so much respect.He will give you the Ancestral Weld Cauldron when everything has ended

text.自那以后，女娃便常来，女子会说些烦心事与她听，偶有意怔之时，便大骂仕子腐儒，言道: From then on, the girl would come often, and the woman would tell her something that bothered her, and occasionally, when she was baffled, she would scold the scholar for being a rotten Confucian, saying that there were many scholars in the world, and when her anger subsided, she would pat the girl on the head, saying that what she had said was just a joke and could not be taken seriously.
text.最终，天帝虽收回法旨，却责令天地相隔，千载不得再见。: In the end, although the Emperor withdrew his decree, he ordered that heaven and earth be separated from each other for a thousand years.

text.\\t8岁，在一次捉迷藏时，由我来当鬼，花了半个小时我成功捉到了除了王小二之外的: \tWhen I was 8 years old, in a hide-and-seek game, I was the "it".It took me half an hour to catch all my friends except Wang Xiaoer.It happened that they didn't remember Wang Xiaoer also participated in the game. I purposely went ahead and declared myself victorious, and everyone went home. Later, I learned that Wang Xiaoer, who was alone, hid until it was dark before returning home.On the way home, he accidentally fell into a well and died.
text.\\t哎呀我的阎王大人呐，鬼差大老爷们呀，奴才可没做过什么恶事，一世骂名实在是冤: \tOh, my Lord Yama, the ghosts, I have done nothing evil, I have been cursed for a lifetime.\nWe were born in a peasant household and entered the palace as a eunuch at the age of 9.We served our masters in the palace with great diligence and did not dare to overstep the mark.When we entered the palace together with our fellow villagers, they were so uncaring that they offended their masters and had their heads cut off with a knife.Since then, we have always been mindful of our status, so how could we possibly be arrogant and bullying, as they say.
text.\\t步入中年的我，放弃了挣扎，选择了堕落，每日跟些狐朋狗友去喝酒，喝完酒要么躺: \tInto the middle of my life, gave up the struggle, chose to degenerate, daily with some evil friends to drink, drink the wine or lie in the street, or because of the trivial fight with people and by the prison disaster.
text.\\t步入中年的我经历了黑发人送白发人，慢慢的我已经习惯了一个人生活，不想与人沟: \tInto the middle of my life, I have experienced the experience of black hair to white hair, slowly I have been accustomed to a personal life, do not want to communicate with others, do not want to help others, even if I was bullied I also indifferent.
text.\\t步入中年的我依然是一个小县官，不甘同流合污的我主要是不想背叛我的良心，因此: \tInto middle age, I am still a small county official, not willing to be complicit in the main I do not want to betray my conscience, so I am still very high in the prestige of the local people.
text.\\t承蒙隆恩，边陲犯乱之际得承重任，然戍边之军良莠不齐，目光所余尽是烙身戴罪之: \tBy the grace of the border, when the border is in trouble, we have to take on the responsibility, but the strength and strength of the garrison troops are mixed.All we can see are the criminals, who will disobey us and make the art of war difficult.As a result, when the enemy comes, we will be defeated and captured, and become delirious in prison for more than twenty years.
text.\\t垂暮之年，形销立骨，岁月之摧犹胜刀创，荏苒数十载已是附杖难立之人，再临天恩: \tIn old age, the shape of pin stand bone, years of destruction like a sword, elapses for several decades has been attached to the staff difficult to stand, and then come to the day, was difficult to stand on the hall, pickled doting, difficult speech, decadent state yi smile huang Purple gongqing.
text.\\t待奴家身段稍长，举手投足尽是婀娜姿态，又因姿容秀绝，善工诗画，于附庸风雅之: \tTreat the slave a little longer, every gesture is graceful posture, and because of the beautiful, good poetry and painting, under the adulation of the arty people, the empty bear qing name, and after the admiration of everyone, will be chest full of gifts, to be able to be in the time of youth, yan pressure qunfang, name dynamic Beijing hua.
text.\\t到了青年的我，已经是孤身一人了，为了生存下来，我选择进入别人的府中当个杂役: \tBy the time I was a young man, I was already alone.In order to survive, I chose to enter someone else's house as a handyman.That family sold cloth, and for selfish reasons, I would steal a few sets from the finished product each time and sell them on the black market at a profit, and the profit was shared equally with the steward of the house.I could not stand the interrogation by the court and chose to bite my tongue, but in the end I did not confess that my accomplice was the butler.
text.\\t到了青年时期，边疆战乱不断，朝廷选择了招兵买马，而我也因为自己的吃住选择加: \tBy the time I was a young man, the frontier was in constant war and the court chose to recruit soldiers, and I chose to join the army because I was fed and housed.I spent the following days in the army for a while before I was pulled off to the frontier to go to war, and later became a deserter in one of the battles, and was lucky enough to escape the search and settle down in a nearby village.
text.\\t到了青年时期，我渐渐的自闭了起来，不喜欢与人交流，也不喜欢进行互动，慢慢的: \tWhen I was young, I gradually became self-absorbed.I didn't like to communicate and interact with people, which gradually led me to become more and more indifferent and ignorant of the world. Once, a man in need lay in front of my house and begged me to open the door to help him, but in the end I ignored him.
text.\\t到了这个年龄的我，暮暮老矣，经常意识不清，常常认错人，就如我会认为邻居家的: \tAt this age, I am old, often unconscious, often mistake people, such as I will think the neighbor's child is mine, I will teach him assiduously when I meet him, I will apologize for him when I see him and passers-by quarrel.
text.\\t到了中年的我，为自己碌碌无为的一生感觉到气愤，恨天道不公，恨世事无常，愤怒: \tAt middle age, I felt angry, hated the unfair way of the world, and hated the impermanence of the world.Anger took over my eyes, and I wanted to revenge all the haters, no matter whether they were good or bad, and whatever purpose they were in, but I also followed my idea and took revenge on all the things that I did not like.
text.\\t到了中年时期，我犯了人生中最大的错误，我因为赌博成瘾，抵押了家产，出卖了家: \tIn middle age, I made the biggest mistake of my life, because of gambling addiction, I mortgaged my family, sold my family, and ended up penniless.
text.\\t到了中年时期，因为过度的劳作，导致身体慢慢不行，领居家的孩子偶尔会往我家中: \tIn middle age, due to excessive work, my body gradually deteriorated, so my neighbor's children would occasionally throw vegetable leaves and stones at my home, but I did not choose to blame him.On the contrary, when I met him again, I often talked with him and taught him on behalf of my neighbors.
text.\\t度过了青年时期的我，生活上也净是不如意，没有温饱的饭，没有温热的水，当我吃: \tAfter my youth, my life was not satisfactory.There was neither enough food nor warm water.When I was hungry, I would steal food from shops, and when I was thirsty, I would drink river water.
text.\\t度过了中年时期的我，身体依旧硬朗，所以我便如往常一样工作，直到生病前的那一: \tPast the middle age, I was still strong, so I went to work as usual, until the moment before I fell ill, I did not know that my health had gone.It wasn't long before I was here reporting.
text.\\t度过青年，我也算是越来越老了，身体素质也大不如前。不知何时，早上咳嗽会咳出: \tAs I spent my youth, I was getting older and my physical fitness was not as good as before. I didn't know when I started to cough up blood in the morning, and I went to see a doctor, who just shook his head and left.I knew that my end was approaching, so I became even more arrogant.I started to beat other people, and I would complain over small things.Arguing non-stop, using my seniority to look down and find faults in others.
text.\\t父亲是个好吃懒做的人，在他的影响下，从小我便拥有着不劳而获的想法，别人家的: \tMy father was a lazy man, and under his influence, I grew up with the idea of getting something for nothing.Children in other families would have been working in the fields at my age, and I would not help the family with anything, and I often stole crops from the neighbour's fields.
text.\\t行至耄耋之岁，沐恩时殊，腐老枯朽之躯遍历刀斧之创，行廊过阁不能自持，每日例: \tLine to the age of 90, mu when the special, the body of the old and withered through the creation of the knife axe, the corridor over the pavilion can not hold, daily routine take medicine, bitter, thinking about the past, although life ups and downs, but also enough to cup sick, liao comfort life.
text.\\t后来有幸得到太后老佛爷恩宠，坐到了首领大太监的位置，但咱家时刻提醒自己谨记: \tLater fortunate to get the grace of the empress Lafayette, sitting in the position of the leader of the eunuch, but we always remind themselves to remember the ancestors of the emperor "eunuch can not regent" ban.Find our home to spend money to buy the future have been rebuffed one by one, and then the reform party and the old school in the court partisans, often someone to take sides, we never answer, that bewitched the government, really wronged our house ah, qingtianhainking the old man.
text.\\t及日年岁稍长，根骨渐开，家母良训持家，聆其苦语终是一展心中郁结，我束发及冠: \tI have been a little older and my roots are opening up, my mother has been a good disciplinarian, and I have listened to her bitter words to finally show my heart.
text.\\t及日娉婷而立，依托清婉之名，登楼恩客日趋见长，未曾想某日，生身父母竟来此以: \tI was not expecting that one day, my biological parents would come here and invite me to sell the deed on the grounds that there was no evidence, so I ordered someone to beat me out, but this was against filial piety, and for a while, the Confucian scholars all said that beauty was ungrateful.So be it.
text.\\t及至韶华，成大家之美，昔时恩客屡次登楼，欲纳奴家为妾，奴家知其出身高贵，遂: \tAt that time, into the beauty of everyone, in the past boon guest often climb the floor, to nanau house as a concubine, nu home know its noble birth, then said this body is difficult to be a lover, boon guest leaning on the column lamentation, long square way, may the afterlife negative jiangshan not beauty, nu home smile allow it, with the jinhairpin gift, through this closed floor xie guest, never meet.
text.\\t即便是步入了青年时期，家里人仍然没有放松对我的要求，还是掌控着我，不能有自: \tEven step into the youth, the family still did not relax on my request, or control, I can't have their own ideas, locked me in the yard every day, can only see the courts flowers and eaves, I feel that my freedom is restricted, I finally made a decision to free yearning, secretly run away in the middle of the night, but, unfortunately, because I stole go out at night, My guard knew but did not report it, and was finally punished by my father.Even though I begged for mercy, my father's anger could not disappear, so he lost his life.I blame it on me.
text.\\t即入轮回，所思五味万般苦，年幼蒙学，敏而好思，自认天资不负魏曹之流，我虽年: \tImmediately into the reincarnation, thinking all kinds of bitter, young educated, sensitive and thoughtful, I think the talent is not worthy of the wei Cao stream, although I am young, BUT also know everything about the family and the country, the heart of the myriad ambitions, only hate can not grow day by day, do the best, but the fate of the lack of life, I finally met the difficult sleep of the people.
text.\\t渐渐地，我脱离了年少的阶段，伴随的是悲剧也降临在了我头上，而我也是一个暴躁: \tGradually, I broke away from the young stage, accompanied by tragedy also fell on my head, and I am also a irritable person, often to provoke fights, but I just want to simply vent, never dare to hurt life.
text.\\t军中纪法严苛，令行禁止，我当值壮年，所求不过鱼水之欢却也因此犯了军中大忌，: \tThe military discipline was strict, and rules were enforced seriously.But I was in my prime, I wanted nothing but to taste the pleasures of intimacy, though it was a huge military taboo.The commander was furious, and put me through one-thousand-cuts execution, peeling off my skin and pulling out my tendons, to make an example for others.
text.\\t老夫一生以权谋入仕，不曾以清廉自居，宏图大展，伟绩丰功，死而无憾，如今得死: \tAll my life, I have been in the government with power and strategy, but I have never thought of myself as a clean person, with great ambitions and great achievements, I have no regrets in dying.\nThat's all I have to say.I'll leave it to the King of Hell to make his own decision.
text.\\t老夫以权谋之术平步青云，时值佞臣杨凡如日中天，朝野上下只有老夫能应对之，所: \tWhen the sycophant Yang Fan was in the ascendant, I was the only one who could deal with him, so that the government could carry out its orders and select talents.Later, I spent ten years in seclusion, defeated the sycophants, and settled all the unjust cases, recruiting the survivors and giving mercy to the dead.I also reduced taxes, cleaned up the salt merchants, and even abolished the useless expenses of the Emperor's envelope of Taoism.
text.\\t年岁渐起，风姿更甚，有诗赞称，起袖揽天惊风舞，一曲霓裳天下知，然时局动荡，: \tYears gradually, the charm is even more, there are poems praise, sleeve up to the sky surprise wind dance, a song neon skirt world know, but The Times are turbulent, home country only stay one night and die, and the slave house small building also flowers fall, no longer noisy in the past.To be one day, the guest face blood stains, led the masses to the floor, to nu home a dance for full three days of peace, zai, thousands of miles of rivers and mountains, a hundred years of the country was actually a woman nu home.
text.\\t年岁渐长，惜值动荒之年，家逢重变，兵荒马乱之际无奈落草，我自知愧对父老，遂: \tAs I grew older, I had no choice but to fall to the grass at the time of war and chaos.I knew I was ashamed of my father, so I changed my name to a new one, and I was brave and brave when I fell to the ground.However, the act of raiding was against the good way, and the flow of coarse grass was also difficult to enter the hall, so I cut off the head of the thief, took the capital and led the army.
text.\\t奴家凄然应允，独登高处，于万千锋簇前起舞而唱，生来无亲无爱，及死当三葬，一: \tI was born without family or love, and when I die, I will be buried three times.First, I will be buried without love and tears, second, I will be buried without righteousness and separation, and third, I will be buried with the grace of beauty.
text.\\t奴家少时家贫，因是女儿身，被父母易子售卖，后又几经辗转，才因长相伶俐被红袖: \tI was sold by my parents because I was a daughter, and after a few changes, I was bought by the Red Sleeve House because of my good looks.
text.\\t青年的我，变得傲慢了起来，并且愈加的严重，我开始看不起家中下人，看不起其他: \tAs a young man, I became arrogant and became more serious.I began to look down on my family, on other people my age, on people who had fallen on hard times, and felt that they deserved it, and that I did not care about those I despised.Even if I had extra money or food, I would have my servants chase away anyone who got in my way.
text.\\t青年时期，我帮着父母农作，照顾庄稼，从耕地，播种一直到收获果子，我都可以一: \tWhen I was young, I helped my parents with farming and took care of the crops.From ploughing, sowing to harvesting fruit, I could finish independently.I felt happy about my efforts, because it was my honor to help my parents in my cognition.Poor me, I had very few playmates in my youth, not even a peer to talk to.
text.\\t青年时期，我游手好闲，没事就上大街溜达，见过很多人，很多事情，有为了保护他: \tWhen I was young, I was idle and would walk on the street.I saw a lot of people and things, including those who let themselves have bad luck in order to protect others, and those who bullied others in order to live.I didn't want to go along with them, but I didn't know exactly what I should do in a day.For me at that time, I did not have to rush about for the family, nor did I have to choose to join in the dirty work in order to fill my stomach.The happiest thing was to secretly throw rotten vegetable leaves to aunts and uncles whom I did not like, and tease the little sister next door.
text.\\t青年时期的我，渐渐没有了年幼时的幼稚，受到家里的影响，我更加喜欢去私塾读书: \tWhen I was young, I gradually lost the naivety of my youth.Influenced by my family, I enjoyed going to private schools even more, and even when I met beggars on the road, I was willing to give some money.
text.\\t青年时期的我加入了当地最大的帮派当中，平常我们会暗地里收取保护费，但不进行: \tAs a young man, I joined one of the largest gangs in the area.Normally, we would secretly collect protection money, but not carry out the duty of protection.One day our gang went to war with another gang in the city, and I was unfortunately killed.
text.\\t青年时期遇到洪涝灾害，在官府的号召下，我成为了一名救助员。而在一次救助当中: \tWhen I was young, I became a relief worker at the call of the government.And in the midst of one of the rescues, I unfortunately lost my life.
text.\\t然则某日，那勾栏贱婢竟与她的姘夫合谋杀害我父，家母闻讯竟涕泪过度，心衰而亡: \tBut one day, the bitch conspired with her concubine to kill my father, and my mother died of heart failure.
text.\\t然则却是无法亦无路，命途诡谲难以为继，年岁渐长，往事积郁更甚，终有一日，父: \tOne day, my father died of illness and my family was on the wane.For a time, all around me were petty and harsh words.I could not bear it, so I hung up my bag and went to join the army under a different name.
text.\\t少时懵懂，自奴家记事起，就已身处莺袖燕舞之所，终日所闻不过媚笑揽客之言。及: \tWhen I was young and ignorant, as long as I can remember, I was already in a place of dancing and laughing, and all I heard all day long was the words of smiling and soliciting customers.When I was a young girl, I didn't know what the commandments of women and internal training were, but even though I had a shallow knowledge of human nature and didn't understand the writings of the sages, I was pure-hearted and good-hearted.
text.\\t十年边州，老夫想通了很多，在朝为官，污浊之徒甚众于清流之士，想实现自己的抱: \tfter ten years in the border state, I have learnt a lot.In the government, there are more dirty people than clean people, so if you want to realise your ambition, how can you get out of the mud? A simple decree, from the central government to the local government, requires hundreds of officials, large and small, and how many of them are clean? If I hadn't cultivated myself to be even more treacherous than this treacherous official, I'm afraid I'd still be over there in the state, sighing in disbelief.
text.\\t时年及笄，虽身段媃稚，然秀媚内敛，吐气若兰，惜是束阁之身，所行皆不能如愿，: \tI was at the age of maturity, but although I was a young girl, I was a beautiful girl, and my breath was like an orchid.
text.\\t时日渐长，名声愈显，王公贵族，风流雅士...成入幕之宾者皆非泛泛之辈，然欲: \tAs time went by, the reputation of the house became more and more obvious, and the princes and nobles, the elegant people...The people who have become guests of the curtain are not ordinary people, but there are many people who want to enter the building, so they set up three not to see, talent, blacksmith, fame without one, one day, the slave spontaneously recite poetry, murmuring, a person to enter the building with the flowers and water, the gentleman smiled and asked, can again and again no longer three, the slave gladly answered, so do not ask his name.
text.\\t世道坚阻，边陲犯险，从军之身难抵状令，然将军之帅无才无德，其手下营私者，献: \tThe people's grievances are boiling over and the people are suffering, and the frontier is eventually lost to the righteous.I have also been in prison for more than 20 years because of this.
text.\\t戍边动荡，然朝堂之上雄才大略，军中上下万众一心，将行下效，功赏过罚，我从军: \tThe garrison was in turmoil, but the court was eloquent, the army was united, the generals did what they were told, merit was rewarded and demerit was punished, I had been in the army for more than twenty years, and the emperor was gracious enough to promote the order to whip the horse and give it to the commander, so I was able to press the desert for a million miles with the division of the mighty emperor.
text.\\t虽然当时我的年龄已经到达了青年时期，但是我还是很幼稚，想象着自己是帮派老大: \tAlthough I had reached the age of youth at that time, I was still very naive, imagining myself as a gang leader, pulling a bunch of minions, having nothing to do with people fighting and grabbing territory.But if I encountered a tough fight, I would slip away, and even if I did get caught, it would just be a matter of a beating, but if I didn't encounter a tough fight, it would be a bumper day for me and my minions.
text.\\t随着年龄的增大，我愈发的成熟独立起来，不管是别人异样的目光还是其他的事情，: \tAs I got older, I became more and more mature and independent, whether it was the strange looks of others or other things, I wouldn't just complain about God, because I knew that my own strength was the real strength.
text.\\t随着我慢慢脱离孩童时代，步入青年时代，我也是愈加的懒惰起来，每天只想躺在床: \tAs I slowly left my childhood and entered my youth, I became more and more lazy, wanting to lie in bed every day instead of thinking about doing anything, just wanting to sleep well at home.I knew I was guilty of laziness, but I thought it was a good life and I didn't want to change it.
text.\\t踏入青年时期的我，不慎染上了博戏的恶习，天天拿着自己的工钱去博戏，虽然输多: \tInto the youth, I accidentally contracted the bad habit of bo opera, every day with their own wages to bo opera, although lose more win less, but also firmly believe that they will be able to win, so as to gain recognition soar.I know it's not a good habit to like the opera, but I was deeply impressed by the saying in my neighborhood that "children don't need to know how to write.
text.\\t听我娘说生我时是小产，幸得上天眷顾，母子平安。不幸的是我身子骨一直很弱，大: \tI heard my mother say that I was born in miscarriage, but fortunately, God was kind enough to let my mother and child live.Unfortunately, my health was always weak, and I was constantly suffering from major and minor illnesses, so I went to various doctors, but all I could do was sigh, shake my head and keep my mouth shut.It was not until I went to a local Taoist temple that an old man with an immortal spirit nodded at my forehead and my body slowly healed.Then later I overheard my mother talking to my father and vaguely heard some kind of demon...possession and other words.
text.\\t脱离了孩童时代的我，无论做什么事情都让我感觉不到快乐，与此同时感觉到无论干: \tOut of my childhood, NO matter what I do, I can not feel happy, at the same time, I feel that whatever I do will be targeted, always do the wrong thing.The irascible me will provoke arguments and even fistfights when I disagree with the person next to me.So I had the most fights with people during this period.
text.\\t我出身于勾栏梯榻之间，童蒙未启之时就已沦为贱籍，身份卑贫，食残羹，沥泔水，: \tI was born between the hook and ladder couch, when the children were not yet enlightened has been reduced to a lowly family, the status of humble poverty, eat scraps, drain slop, daily dust, spit face to accompany the smile, do not dare to have the slightest idea of overstepping the rules, but the evil maid bullying, tired of the pain of the skin is really to hard to tie, is why the day panic to escape, cold rain miserable when finally got an old man to save, thinking about the past tears and tears, so we call each other father and son.
text.\\t我出生在一个普通平凡的家庭，经不起大风大浪。在有次我跟朋友出去游玩的时候，: \tI was born in an ordinary family and could not afford to go through a big storm.On one occasion when I was out with a friend, I came across a mysterious cave entrance and we chose to go in and explore it.We relied on the light from our torches to keep our faith alive, and we slowly explored forward.I went home and hid under the covers for a long, long time, and in the evening my friend's family came and asked me if I had seen their child, and I shook my head hurriedly, and to this day, he has not been found.
text.\\t我从记事开始，右手便没有知觉，我也不知是天生残废还是小时候发生过意外让我失: \tI have had no feeling in my right hand since I can remember, and I don't know if I was born crippled or had an accident as a child that made me lose certain key parts of my memory, and then I coincidentally met a miracle doctor who cured my hand, but my family also became more impoverished because of the expenses of this visit to the doctor, and I was determined to make a good life for my family when I regained my life.
text.\\t我从小体质就很差，不能肆意的跟朋友奔跑与玩耍，每日待在家中望着窗外，那便是: \tI grew up with poor health and was not allowed to run and play with my friends, so I spent my childhood at home looking out of the window.That day, as usual, my parents were not at home, so I chose to sneak out by mistake.There was a calligraphy convention in the street, which was a shock to me as I had just opened the door to the outside world, and I couldn't resist walking towards the crowd, but unfortunately I was stopped by the doorman.But it was also my chance to meet a valuable person who saw my talent and said he could take me on as a disciple and help me heal my body, which I agreed to do.Later on, I became stronger and stronger, and my family's life became better and better.
text.\\t我的父亲是千万落榜书生中的一员，因此我从小就被给予很高的期望，但家境不好的: \tMy father was one of the millions of students who failed in school, so I was raised with high expectations, but I had to study hard at home because my family was not well off.Gradually during my studies I learnt that studying was not for me and that I had to put in more effort than my peers, even so I struggled to persevere for the sake of my father's dream.Eventually I lost my thoughts in an exam and fainted from anger for three whole days and nights.My father let go of his obsession when he knew how much I had given.
text.\\t我父亲为经商大亨，而我又是家中最小的，父亲母亲打小就疼爱我，我从小便是锦衣: \tMy father was a business tycoon and I was spoilt for choice, so I developed a domineering personality.When my family fell behind, I could not accept this life of poverty.At the beginning I chose to become a pickpocket and met many people living at the bottom.Their courage and optimism after their unbearable situation slowly infected me.I began to reform, work hard to face life positively, and maintain this spirit, with this spirit to infect many people, life is also bitter, bitter but also sweet.
text.\\t我父亲原是商界大佬，娇生惯养的让我养成了跋扈的性格。后面家道中落，我无法接: \tMy father was a business tycoon and I was spoilt for choice, so I developed a domineering personality.When my family fell behind, I could not accept this life of poverty.At the beginning I chose to become a pickpocket and met many people living at the bottom.Their courage and optimism after their unbearable situation slowly infected me.I began to reform, work hard to face life positively, and maintain this spirit, with this spirit to infect many people, life is also bitter, bitter but also sweet.
text.\\t我记得小时候认识一位比我年长几岁的大哥，他肆意妄为，危害四方。在当时我的眼: \tI remember as a child knowing a big brother who was a few years older than me, who was reckless and endangered the four directions.In my eyes at the time, he was a representative of freedom and he did whatever he wanted like a bird.I worshipped him and started to follow him around, stealing clothes from next door one day, destroying the neighbourhood's fields the next, and running amok.Whatever gave us pleasure, we were sure to try.
text.\\t我命丧于青年，在阳光明媚的一天里，我出门去打猎，看见一位孩子陷入淤泥当中，: \tI lost my life as a young man.On a sunny day, I went out hunting and saw a child caught in the mud, I saw him and thought of myself at the time, I pulled him out decisively, he was rescued and did not choose to go home immediately, but went hunting with me.But fate was unpredictable, and towards evening I met a large insect that struggled and did not escape, and we both perished in the tiger's mouth.
text.\\t我生活在一个富裕的家庭里面，家里的氛围让我成为一个很听话的小孩，不会违抗父: \tI lived in a wealthy family and the atmosphere in my home made me a very obedient child, not disobeying my parents' orders and not teasing the servants because of my status as a young master.I remember the most outrageous thing I ever did was to ask my servants to teach a child a lesson because I had lost to him once and that he was my playmate at the time.
text.\\t我生在一个幸福的家庭里面，父母不会因为我发脾气而训斥我，导致我娇生惯养。直: \tI was born inside a happy family, my parents would not reprimand me for losing my temper, leading me to be spoilt.It wasn't until one day when I was in an inexplicably irritable mood that I went for a walk down the street and smashed up any stall I came across that didn't agree with me, at which point I was advised to stop, and not only did I not listen but I contradicted him.It was only later when my home was seized and my parents were arrested that I realised my mistake, but it was all too late.They made me watch my parents being killed, and I couldn't take it for a moment and chose to hang myself.
text.\\t我为世家后嗣，生于钟鸣鼎食之家，然我不喜舞文弄墨，只偏好声色犬马，终日豪仆: \tI was born into a family of great wealth, but I didn't like writing and writing, I only liked sex, and I was always surrounded by servants and slaves.
text.\\t我相信，是的，即便是我背负了骂名，在那伟大变革降临的那一天，所有人都会理解: \tI believe that, yes, even if I take the blame, on the day when that great change comes, everyone will understand me and what I am doing, and yes, I am not wrong, I am not...it is all for that day...\n（The thin man's eyes drifted off into a trance of his own and he stopped talking.）
text.\\t我幼时家无余财却也足以安康度日，可我那父亲生性风流，常借备锦衣来往于声靡风: \tWhen I was young, my family had no money, but it was enough to get by.But my father who was a flirt, often borrowed brocade clothes to travel to and from entertainment venues.My mother tried to persuade him but always failed, and she ended up depressed.But I was young and ignorant, I only knew how to catch and play cricket fights, never once showing filial piety.
text.\\t我与一般纨绔的富家子弟不同，小时候常常虐待动物，小到昆虫大到乌龟、兔子这种: \tI was different from ordinary rich kids.When I was young, I used to abuse animals, from small insects to bigger animals like turtles and rabbits.I knew that my parents would not condone to it, so I asked my servants to secretly catch or buy the animals for me.I also used my pocket money to buy a small house for my 'research'.Over time, my story was circulated among people.
text.\\t我只记得小时候我备受家里人的喜爱，从小被惯到大，即便是打碎了父亲最喜欢的茶: \tI only remember that as a child I was much loved by my family and was spoiled from a young age, even when I broke my father's favourite tea set I was never chastised, if I had been a child of another family I would have been afraid that the skin would not have been split open.I did all these naughty things, but that was as far as it went.
text.\\t小时的我是开开心心度过的，父母会时常的带我出去逛，无论是集市还是野外的田地: \tI spent my childhood happily, and my parents would take me out from time to time, whether it was to the market or to the fields in the wilderness, to have a good experience.Just one day when I was visiting the market, I saw a man stealing something and I loudly warned that stall owner.Although I failed to catch the thief, the shopkeeper even praised me for being a good girl who would definitely make a career out of it.But little did I know that I would be held against that thief for this, and he followed and remembered my place of residence.The next morning I lay quietly in bed and never got up again.
text.\\t小时候的我很是调皮，会鼓动小伙伴们砸稻田边树上的马蜂窝，为了躲避马蜂，我们: \tAs a child, I was very naughty and would encourage my buddies to smash the hornets' nests in the trees by the rice fields.In order to avoid the hornets, we smashed and ran towards the streams, and it was none of my business as to how many people along the way would suffer from unwarranted injuries and casualties caused by not getting timely medical treatment as a result.
text.\\t小时候的我望着同龄的孩子因开始帮助父母而早早的下农地干活，但我没有与他们一: \tAs a child I looked at children of my age who had started to help their parents by going to work on the farm early, but I did not join them in thinking that I was a very thoughtful person who chose to go to the city to sell goods and later encountered difficulties with money and went home to discuss with my parents and received a negative answer from them.I didn't choose to make a fuss with my parents over this either, but listened to their ideas in line with children of my age and went into farming to work.But ploughing was boring until one day while working, a child my age was also farming and I had a friendly exchange with him, taking what little fun I had left as a little dessert in a boring day.
text.\\t小时候的我无恶不作，偷隔壁邻居的鸭到了晚上再给它放回去，每当我心情不好的时: \tAs a child I was up to no good, stealing my next door neighbour's duck and putting it back at night.Whenever I was in a bad mood I bullied their dog, but occasionally I would take the meat I couldn't finish and throw it at him.But things change.Just as I was happily heading out to the fields one day, I was knocked to the ground by a horse that had gotten out of control, and by the time people took me to the doctor's office I was beyond help, but it added to the money for my not-so-rich family, and my parents lived comfortably in their old age because of it.
text.\\t小时候的我无父无母，没有人照顾我，我为了生存，整日在街上偷、抢才能把握住一: \tAs a child, I had no father or mother and no one to take care of me.I spent my days stealing and robbing on the streets in order to survive, but only enough to feed myself.I understood that I couldn't go on like this.I resented everything, but there was nothing I could do about it.
text.\\t小时候的我性格软弱，家里也有点小钱，因此父母对我也很好。但是就在我出门玩的: \tAs a child, I was weak and my family had a little money, so my parents were good to me.But when I went out to play, I often met people who approached me with bad intentions, and my weakness fuelled their anger.I was often beaten by them, extorted by them, and forced to steal money from my home or else I would be beaten too.
text.\\t小时候调皮捣蛋，感觉别人骑马的样子很帅气，死缠烂打之下，父母耗尽钱财为我购: \tAs a child, I was naughty and mischievous and felt that other people looked handsome on horses.After stalking them, my parents spent all their money to buy horses for me, but because I was too young, I fell off the horses while riding and was injured as a result.
text.\\t小时候我会因为下雨天而故意踩水潭，让泥巴飞溅到别人衣服上，从而获取到快乐。: \tAs a child I would gain pleasure by deliberately stepping in puddles of water and letting mud splash on other people's clothes because it was raining.But once when I was wandering in the street and found an object on the ground that someone had lost, I opened it and looked at it and found a few dangling money that had been left inside.Although I had greed, I decidedly chose to give it to the magistrate, who would deal with the matter.Although it is possible that the magistrates would not have dealt with it, the young me was unaware of this.
text.\\t已经成家了的我，整日为了养家糊口而备受折磨，不仅仅是养活自己，妻子和孩子以: \tI had become a family and I was tortured all day long trying to provide for not only myself, but my wife and children and my parents who were lying in their sick beds.And I barely managed to hold it together for several years before I failed to top it.Eventually I chose to hang myself to end this painful life of mine.
text.\\t已经获得了成长的我想着如何帮助家里分担生活上的压力，也想着如何独立。但事与: \tI had grown and I thought about how I could help share the stress of life at home and how I could be independent.But against all expectations, I was treated as free labour by my boss, doing the work of two people by myself and enduring the oppression of life, but for the sake of my ambition and the heart to help share my parents' burden, I kept going.But things change, and soon our side met with the Great Riot and I lost the job.
text.\\t因为我从小就继承了父亲的理想，我无法左右自己的想法，但我也没有因此而进行反: \tBecause I had inherited my father's ideals from a young age, I couldn't sway myself, but I didn't let that stop me from rebelling.The sky was clear that day, and I rode on, as usual, to the tavern outside the city.After riding for about half an hour, the sky suddenly started to rain heavily, and when I tried to find somewhere to take shelter from the rain, who knew that my horse would slip and fall, and I would fall off my horse and die from a long untreated death.
text.\\t因为我家境较好，从小便被父母送去私塾读书，日复一日的跟着先生背书，有时看见: \tBecause my family was better off, I was sent to private school by my parents from a very young age.Day after day, I followed the teacher and memorised books, sometimes giving out expectant looks when I saw children of my age outside the door.Learning knowledge is hard work, and I knew this well and did not let the happiness of outsiders get to me.My only belief was to study well and become an adult so that my parents could live a good life.
text.\\t有些生命的诞生注定不会迎来喝彩，比如我，还在襁褓中就被父母遗弃。虽然后面找: \tSome lives are born that are not destined to be applauded, like me, who was abandoned by my parents when I was still in infancy.Although I found my parents later, I have long since become a stranger to them.I have always struggled to live alone, using every means possible simply to feed myself and not starve to death; I trust no one, accept no charity or help, and I feed myself by cheating and stealing.
text.\\t余年得庆，盖棺之年已至四代同堂，子孙绕膝之际难免思过，为此一生历经坎坷，却: \tI have celebrated the rest of my life, the year of the coffin has reached four generations with the same family, children and grandchildren around the knee when inevitably thinking about the past, for this life through the ups and downs, but can enjoy the blessings of human family in their final years, it is a great blessing, no regrets at the end of life.
text.\\t远在他乡的我，孤身一人便踏上了打工人的道路，而仅在上工的第一个月，听见有人: \tI was alone in my hometown when I set out to work as a labourer, and only in my first month of work, I heard someone shouting that their child had been robbed, and I rushed forward to fight with the culprit, and eventually got the child back, but failed to keep the culprit, and I lost my right thumb and my job, and have been living on the streets begging for a living ever since.
text.\\t在我还是孩童的时候，父母积劳成疾的身体每况愈下，我慢慢学着大人的样子去河边: \tWhen I was a child, my parents' health was deteriorating from strain, and I slowly followed the example of the adults and went to the river to pick herbs to support the family.However, accidents did happen.One rainy day I accidentally fell into the river while picking herbs, and got tangled in the water plants in a panic struggle.
text.\\t在我小时候的记忆中，我无父无母，从小便呆在一个陌生的家庭里，可能因为是外来: \tIn my childhood memories, I was fatherless and motherless, and I grew up in a strange family, probably because I was an outsider, so I was bullied by their family every day, and I had no idea what mistakes I had made.My so-called father drank heavily every day and would come to take out his anger on me for the smallest things, and this result today is the greatest happiness for me.
text.\\t长大了以后，我愈发的贪财，只要有银两进了我的口袋，想再拿出去那是不太可能的: \tAs I grew up, I became more and more greedy for money.As long as I had money in my pocket, it was impossible to take it out again.That's why I started to find various reasons to withhold money from my servants, so that I could enrich myself.I would also fight with people over a little money and almost lost my life because of it.
text.\\t峥嵘已过，岁月行催，然濒老枯死之躯得沐天恩，上位仁厚亲赐仙药，是以得幸压胜: \tBut my old and dying body was blessed by the grace of heaven and the kindness of the Lord who gave me an immortal medicine, so I was fortunate enough to be able to win and increase my life expectancy for more than ten years.
text.\\t正一将成名万古枯，在这康庄大道上，总有人会枉死，也有人会牺牲，难道你们觉得: \tIs that a general will die in vain, and on this congenial path, there will always be people who will die in vain and others who will be sacrificed.Do you think that I should give up the new birth of the world because of these small sporadic fires?\n（The young man in the hall was so thin and weak that he was almost frantic）.\n
text.\\t只有革新才能拯救我们，只有变革才能拯救天下！阻碍的人是什么？他们是安于现状: \tOnly innovation can save us, only change can save the world! What are the people who stand in the way? They are fools who are resting on their laurels, what they are preventing is a great coming, they don't know what they are doing, let us be clear, let us destroy, let us remove! We are going to let this great change come!
text.\\t至于…至于那贪财敛富，俗话说人为财死鸟为食亡呀大老爷们，咱家确实在负责宫内: \tAs for...as for that greed for wealth and enrichment, as the saying goes, people die for money and birds die for food...the great masters, we did have extortion and blackmail officials when we were in charge of the palace service preparation, purchasing and trading, but...but the Empress Dowager and the old Buddha are aware of it.I am asking you to make a clear decision.
text.\\t至于残害忠良更是冤枉呀，咱家就算在那后宫之中，如果有一般妃嫔宫娥、女官命妇: \tEven in the harem, if there were concubines or ladies who made mistakes and displeased the Empress Dowager, we would always try to cover up for them and protect them.The emperor is mindful of his old feelings, so I don't dare to say yes.
text.\\t至于已经达到青年时期的我，因为经历了太多的恶事，慢慢的，我也变成了一个作恶: \tAs for me, who has reached youth, because I have experienced too many evil things, slowly, I have also become an evil-doer, I chose to join the largest local gangs, following the gangs to bully the weak, burn and plunder as a way to support themselves.But I don't understand where my path lies ahead, and as for my thoughts? At least at this stage there is no pain to be felt.
text.\\t中年的我，已经算是半只脚踏进了地府。看世间的事情也比以前看的淡的多，我开始: \tIn my middle age, I have sort of half a foot in hell.Looking at things in the world is also much lighter than before, and I started to help others and rescue stray dogs.And then one morning later on, I never opened my eyes again.
text.\\t中年时候的我曾富甲一方，恰巧遭遇百年一遇的大旱，我掏出了全部的身家拯救苍生: \tIn my middle age, I was once rich, and it so happened that I was hit by a once-in-a-century drought, and I pulled out my entire fortune to save the people from the dawn.
text.\\t中年时期，我改过自新努力读书，想要为了自己的梦想而奋斗，愿望是美好的，但是: \tIn my middle age, I reformed myself and studied hard, wanting to fight for my dream.My wish was good, but the reality was cruel, and I spent a long time to study but failed to pass the exam.
text.\\t中年时期的我，因为身有残疾，找不到工作，只能在街头乞讨，也常常因为地区的原: \tIn my middle age, I was unable to find a job because of my disability, so I had to beg on the streets and often quarrelled and fought with people because of the area.Later on, I met an immortal who helped me and cured me of my disability, but I didn't want to go and earn money with my own hands either.
text.\\t中年时期的我，遇到贵人相助，拥有了自己的店面，虽然吃的是血肉馒头，但也赚的: \tIn my middle age, I met a nobleman who helped me to own my own shop, and although I ate blood and meat buns, I made a lot of money.
text.\\t中年时期的我飞腾黄达，突来的财运打破了我的一生平庸，在我感谢大自然馈赠的同: \tIn my middle age, I soared to great heights and my sudden fortune broke the mediocrity of my life.While I thanked nature for the gift, I also took out some of the money for disaster relief and definitely did not take out money to bribe officials.
text.\\t中年时期的我身体还算是硬朗，也理解了什么是正义，同时为了家庭苦苦奔波。一路: \tIn my middle age, I was still physically strong and understood what justice was, while struggling to get around for my family.I was a hero and a heroine, showing the way to those who were lost, and I would even help a caravan when I saw it being robbed by robbers.And it was in the midst of my daily running that I fell into a cliff because my horse lost its hoof.
text.\\t壮哉我李氏王朝，曾万国来朝，如今风雨飘摇，堪堪欲坠，为什么？因为出了问题！: \tThe Li dynasty, which was once a dynasty of nations, is now in a precarious state and is about to fall.Because there is a problem! What is the problem? The problem is that something has gone wrong! If it's wrong, it's wrong, and if it's wrong, we have to change it! We have to change, we have to innovate, we have to make this dynasty new, we have to make it rise to the top again!
