text.“先生，您是什么境界呢”\\n徭真拍了拍你的头“瑞儿，修士的境界和功法都是私密的:
"Sir, what realm are you in then？"
Your master gives a pat touch on your head, "Rui'er, the realm and cultivation method of cultivators are something that should be kept as secrets"
"Okay, sir.I've been interested in stuff like immortality for as long as I can remember.When I was eight, my mother told me that I had chosen the book Tao Te Ching in my one-year-old catch.And as for Classic of Changes, though I can't recite it backwards at least I am quite familiar with literary quotations in it.So you see, am I qualified for being a cultivator?"
"Sure, you are among the most gifted I've ever seen, though not as talented as me.However, as the old saying goes, as long as you step into the complicated world of Metaphysics, you will seldom have a sound sleep afterwards.And according to the experience of the established, one shall begin his pursuit of Taoist cultivation at the age of thirteen."
"Yes, sir"
"It has been five years since I left our sect, and I have an ever-growing feeling that my breakthrough is around the corner as I've experienced a great deal.I will return to our sect in a few days.When you turn thirteen, I will come here personally to invite you to join us."
"Ok, Sir, I wish you every success."
"Haha, Rui'er, thanks for your kind words.Go home then, and remember to keep studying hard."
With a vision of the future, you go home happily after school.

text.“这场战争，是大获全胜。”，准提看着远方说道。\\n祁云一脸愁云，欲言又止，似乎:
"Chan sect wins a great victory." says Zhunti, looking into the distance.
Qi Yun looks upset and wants to open his mouth to say something but stops.
"My kind friend, do you feel sorry for Jie sect?"
"Yes, I do.It makes sense that the twelve immortals of Chan sect signed their names on the list of god creation since they have to get involved in killing to cut off three desires, but why disciples of Jie sect who are innocent in the end either lose their life or get injured, with their whole sect falling apart?" Qi Yun laments.
"Amitabha, what you notice is that the twelve immortals have not yet cut off their three desires, but you fail to recognize that the members of Jie sect are also doomed to come across a disaster.Most of them are originally spiritual creatures in nature.Though they have cut off their three desires through cultivation method not suppressing their natural nature, heaven upholds justice and fairness：they must in the end confront with calamity before achieving immortality.Tongtian Jiaozhu knows about everything.He seems to be forced to get involved in the battle, but in fact, he is trying to find out a new way out for his disciples to free them from calamity.You see, those who are connected with our Western religion and join us are spared from tragic ending, and the rest though killed in the war end up being appointed as gods of the celestial court.The sect leader upholds righteousness by letting go of his Jie sect."
Qi Yun is enlightened upon hearing this, no wonder...he thought Tongtian was a fool but it turns out he himself is an idiot.Well, that would be great.
Tonight is the time for a glass of wine and a song , what a creation of the gods.

9.The stock market is run regionally, as such there can be a small delay （~10 seconds） when refreshing.

text.573年，李自明11岁，让我们把目光一直聚焦在他身上的目光收一收，就会发现这些年:
In 573, Li Ziming is 11 years old.Let’s shift our attention for a while from the prince to the wider world, and we will be taken aback by what happened over the past years.
In 570, emperor Li Mi suddenly fell ill.Days later when holding court again he looked ill and weak.
In 571, he sent for many famous doctors from far and wide to the palace for treatment, but that was in vain and his health went from bad to worse.
In the spring of 572, he has been obsessed with trying to make immortality pills and cultivate vital energy without caring about the affairs of state since the reopening of the Star-Picking Tower with Nanli Taoist priest Tong Kaiyang as its new owner.
In autumn, in the emperor's study memorials to be looked through were piling up.
In winter, secretary of the Grand Secretariat Mr Xie risked coming to meet the emperor and had a good long talk with him.Soon Mr.Xie returned to his hometown, but the emperor still did not leave the tower.
Still in winter, across the country rumor had it that the emperor was dead, and there were calls for the 11-year-old prince Li Ziming's taking the throne.
In early 573, the emperor finally came to court, brilliant and energetic.
Rumor collapses of itself.Li Mi is silent after listening to a flood of reports by all the ministers, and then he drafts an imperial decree as follow,
"The prince Li Ziming, who has an intention of conspiring to usurp the throne by spreading rumors, must be grounded within the Ciqing Palace."
The making of the decree brings an uproar in the court.Several officials immediately try to defend the prince, but end up being regarded as the prince’s adherents and inflicted on combined punishment for several crimes.The others, shake their heads and keep silent, heaving a sigh helplessly.
text.580年初，太子被封左将军，亲征北狄历练，赐8名虎卫随行。\\n刘铤请命同往，圣:
At the beginning of 580 A.D., the prince Li Ziming is entitled as the General on the Left.He is dispatched to conquer the northern invaders with 8 strong guards called Huwei accompanied.
Liu Ting asks the approval of the court to accompany the prince, but the emperor turns down his proposal.
The empress Guo, the foster mother of the prince, cried bitterly.Because the prince calls her mom from a very young age, she treats him as her own son.
 Since the emperor's mind is solely set on immortality cultivation, he shows no interest in sexual relations.He hasn't set foot in the rear court for a long time.For the empress, even she desires to be helpful, she can do nothing at all.
The prince and eight guards travel light.It take them almost two months to arrive the Northern Jurisdiction.
text.591年元月初四，李自明带着8名虎卫，以及乔装打扮成随从的刘铤与小九抵达了京城。:
On the forth day of the first month in the lunar calendar in 591, Li Ziming, with 8 guards and Liu Ting and Xiaojiu dressed like servants, arrived in the capital city.
Trying to avoid arousing Li Yuan's suspicion, Li Ziming walked in a leisure manner.He displayed his impatience on the way, giving the impression that he was unwilling to attend the funeral of his father.
From a distance, there were guards on the gate tower even on this occasion with less traffic flow of people.It seems very strange.
Li returned to the place once he called home, but now here is dangerous for him.
text.592年5月某日，牛家村普通村民牛二的老婆生了个男娃。\\n要知道并不是所有新生:
One day in May 592, an ordinary villager called Niuer in Niujiacun village whose wife gave birth to a new boy.
But not all the birth of new lifes was highly expected.There were three boys in the family already, but they all were not old enough to work in the fields.Recent years had witnessed a serious drought，which made it harder for Niuer to struggle to make end meets for the family of five.Now the new baby put more strains on the family.It was totally a disaster.
When his wife got pregnant at the very beginning, Niu tended to abort the child, but his wife couldn't bear to do so.And she persuaded her husband by saying that she had a preference for spicy food recently which probably signified that the child was a girl.The well-off Zhang family living in the east of the village desired to have a girl.They could give the girl to Zhang family.In doing so, they didn't have to suffer from hunger and they would got some money in a lump sum.Niuer was not so cold-blooded, so he agreed.But now it was too late to regret.
With the crying of the new baby at birth, the bright and sunny day suddenly changed into day with thunder and lightning.And there were red glow rising with purple air coming from the east.
At this time, an old man passed by their door.The old man was just like an immortal being on earth, and he congratulated them on the birth of the boy.He claimed that he had an acquaintance with the boy in previous life.So he hoped to have a tie with Niuer.
Since the man knew the birth of the boy in his family, Niuer thought the man must know how to foretell.In recent years, the immortal being cultivation had become a craze among folk people.As a result, many new schools of thought sprung up.It was said that many immortal beings often traveled around to select talented young boys and girls as their disciples.If it was true, his trouble would be solved.So he invited the old man into his house kindly.
The man said with a smile on his face, "The reincarnated boy is experiencing his doom here.If you insist on his stay at your home, troubles will incur.I have an acquaintance with the boy, so it will be very kind to give him to me.And you are free from these troubles as well."
During his speech, he took out three blocks of glittering gold ingots from his sleeve, placing them on the table in a row."Here are the three gold ingots as the filial piety that the boy should pay.And if you accept these gold ingots, it means that you allow me to cut off all his secular ties.Are you willing to do so?"
Although Niuer didn't quite get what the Taoist means, but he knew the general meaning.The glittering gold ingots were a really temptation for Niuer.He accepted the Taoist immediately without thinking twice.After he told what happened to his wife, her didn't say anything, but wiped her eyes silently.
The Taoist was amiable, and he told the parent that he was half immortal being.The child would be safe and sound.After several moments, he jumped on a cloud and left with the boy in his arm.
text.593年4月，罗艺率先起兵于北境，呈先皇遗旨诛杀逆贼李渊，一路南下。\\n5月初:
In the April of 593, Luo Yi took the lead to staging an uprise in the Northern Frontier.He acted in obedience to the instruction of the deceased Emperor to kill the usurper Li Yuan.He marched to the south straightly.
In early May, the Guanxi Army and Nanqiang Army were dispatched to oppress this uprise in the north.At this time, Guanxi Army changed his position and was on Li Ziming side.As a result, Nanqiang Army was destroyed thanks to the perfect cooperation between Luo Yi and Yin Wenyuan.
In mid-May, the truth of the elixir finally came to light.Taoist temples were destroyed nationwide.
At the end of May, Luo and Yin marched to the gate.20,000 soldiers with the help of miracle water were dispatched to fight against the unrise.These soldiers were courageous and they were ten times stronger than Luo and Yin's army.Then all of a sudden, Luo Yi flew into the air and a monk removed his prayer beads from his neck.In an instant, the Buddhism lights illuminated everywhere.Any soldiers from Li Yuan's troop who exposed to the light became much older.And most of them died instantly.Even a fraction of survived soldiers were staggering and couldn't fight any more.Li Yuan had to ring gongs to retreat in a hurry.
At that night, many panicky people vaguely saw that someone was practicing something strange.There were lightening and thunder.Many red lights shone in all directions.But when these lights shone brightest, a more shining gold light outshone them.Finally, these red lights failed to shine again.
Li Yuan ran away to the southeast region immediately.He travelled through Shanxi, Hunan, Zhejiang and Fujian province, and eventually arrived Lequeos.
The next day, the gate was open.Luo Yi and Yin Wenyuan led their troops into the city in an orderly manner.All the people were relieved.Li Ziming ascended the throne.
text.596年，李自明毁摘星楼，全国禁止一切修道修仙事宜。\\n凡私藏修仙修道典籍，或: In 596, Li Ziming destroys the Star-Picking Tower and bans all cultivation practices of immortality all over the state.\nAnyone who collects in private books on immortal cultivation and any practicer is severely punished.\n
text.596年，李自明推行西方教，毁摘星楼，建正阳寺，全国兴起庙宇，烧香拜佛。\\n小: In the year 596, Li Ziming introduces a Western religion, destroys the Star-Picking Tower and sets up a Zhengyang Temple.From then on, temples spring up all over the country and people flock there to burn incense and worship the gods.\nXiaojiu left quietly.
text.597年，小九向李自明请辞，李自明问她何故离去，又要前往何处，她也不说，只是低着:
In 597, Xiaojiu tenders her resignation.Li Ziming asks why she is leaving and where she is going.She gives no replies, just keeping looking down at the ground.
Having been through thick and thin with Xiaojiu who’s been with him for a long time, Li Ziming has long been secretly in love with her.But her attitude is as elusive as her look under the hood and veil she always wears.
Li Ziming has always been showing respect for her and keeps certain distance from her, but now that his beloved is about to leave, he finally gathers courage to profess his love.
She is overwhelmed by his confession, with face blushing evidently even hidden behind the veil.Both are in love.
Noticing her reaction, Li Ziming is no fool and realizes that she also has a crush on him, but just too shy to express anything, and that her resignation must be a tentative move.Therefore, he feels encouraged to inundate her with sweet words, and even intends to propose to her.
Xiaojiu feels astonished at his move and runs away from him in a rush, missing the jade pendant on her waist in the palace.
It's been a long time that Li Ziming didn't feel so joyful.He walks over to pick up the jade pendant, which looks so familiar to him, with characters "Li Ziming" engraved on it.
Six years old, back garden, rockery, nearly-drowning and chicken thigh-sneaking, everything occurs to him.
Their affection was doomed long time ago.
text.598年，西方教向凡间推行坐忘，结丹，舍利等，与当初炼丹修道大同小异，世人却又欣: In 598, the Western religion introduces to the mortal world the practice of meditation, Core formation and relics, which constitute a possess much the same as that of Taoist alchemy and cultivation.But people still embrace it and flock to spend their last penny to pursue it.\nLuo Yi and Yin Wenyuan retire and return to their hometowns.\n

text.601年，李自明身衰体竭寻医未果，遍寻修道之人庇佑亦未果，几近疯魔。\\n连续数:
The year 601 witnesses Li Ziming is in poor health.He is driven nearly insane since neither medicine nor the blessing of Taoists work to his disease.
Across the country, people see no yield because of consecutive years of droughts, and see no reliefs from the court afterwards either.As a result, peasant uprisings break out across all provinces.

text.八岁时，尚书房添了新学生，一个六岁的毛头小子，是当年与皇上出生入死的“开国五公王:
At the age of eight, the prince has a new classmate, a six-year-old boy who is the illegitimate child of one of the emperor’s "five grand dukes"Liu Xian, called Liu Ting.
Years ago, the country which was divided into two parts the north and the south was in a chaos.The emperor today was just a commoner Li Mi, but finally he stood out from others and unified the country in 4 years.Actually, his success owes much to a group of outstanding generals around him.
Among them, 5 most famous men, one talented man and four military masters, are collectively called "five grand dukes”.There is a limerick going among later generations：
Double spears rule the north and south, one sword fast comes the Central Plains; in Guanxi lives a sword breaker holder , in Jiangzuo resides a living god.
Li Yuan, the younger brother of emperor Li Mi, governs the south with a silver spear and excellent martial arts.
Luoyi in the north, famous for his fast and precise spear-killing and special spear skills that his family pass down for generations, is really good at breaking the enemy with one strike.
Liu Xian is a formidable and daunting martial expert with a sword with golden rings as weapon.
Yin Wenyuan who can hardly find rivals in the world with two sword breakers.
And Jiangdong counselor Yao Guang, a jack of all trades, knows everything including astronomy and geography.
Liu Xian died of illness last year and consigned his son to the emperor.Therefore, Liu Ting can be seen as the adopted son of the emperor, that is, Li Ziming’s younger brother.
This boy looks like a tough guy.He seldom talks and eats a lot, but still too thin like those who suffer from malnutrition.When he first came to the study, he was left behind in both cultural courses and physical education.However, he is very strict with himself, trying to work harder to keep up with his classmate.

One day, they passed by a valley where stood a Goddness of Mercy Temple.On seeing it, Bukong realized that this was a main quest that couldn’t be avoided.So he strode into the temple with his hand holding the horse, after a quick review of his dress.
Hearing that Bukong was a senior monk who came from Tang Dynasty and went to the west, Monks standing at the door bowed to Bukong immediately and ushered him into the temple to have a rest reverently.Bukong just sat down when a hunchbacked monk who was supported by two young monks walked in slowly.Bukong stood up immediately and bowed to them with his palm pressing together.The old monk also bowed to Bukong and he ordered monks to serve tea.Soon, two young monks came in with delicate tea set at hand.
After a sip, Bukong said some polite compliments.On hearing that, the old monk was pleased, and he began to show off his understanding of the Classic of Tea.Bukong continued his compliment out of polite.
Such compliments made the old monk elated.So he laughed aloud and ordered some monks to fetch twelve boxes full of cassocks.Actually there were more than hundreds of cassocks which were very beautiful.The old monk saw Bukong’s seemingly astounding expression and asked provocatively, "Dignitary, since you come from the great vast east land, Tang Dynasty, Can you show me something precious?”

One day, they came to a great turbulent river that stretched to horizon.When Bukong was thinking how to figure it out, the White Horse said, "The river is at least 800 meters wide."（!!!So there is no explanation about why the horse can speak?）
"How do you know that? Do you know the script?" Bukong asked.

The White Horse continued.
"Then how do you know the river is 800 meters wide." Bukong asked.
"Are you blind? The stone tablet says that." Bukong looked in the direction of the horse.There was a stone tablet on which inscribed three characters "Liusha River（which means sand river） with four lines of characters saying that 'The 800-meters wide sand river is 3,000 meters deep.The goose feather cannot remain afloat on the river, and the reed is sure to sink.'" On seeing that, Bukong gasped.Given the introduction of the instance zone, the real Boss is coming.
All of a sudden, with a huge bang, a monster jumped out of the river.There is a poem describing：
The red fluffy hair, two shining eyes.
The indigo face, thundering voice.
In a light yellow robe, two vines surrounded around the waist.
Eight skeletons hung under neck, a precious stick in hand.
The monster threw himself to Bukong with his moon-shaped shovel in hand.Bukong responded with his Nine-Ring Tin stick.After several rounds, the monster jumped into the river once realized that he was no match for Bukong.
After casting a spell of "Water resistant", Bukong continued his chase into the river.The monster just ran over the river.Bukong chased the monster under water and beyond water.But two hours later, he failed to catch the monster.Bukong was so exhausted that he had to have a rest along the river.
On seeing that, the monster appeared on the river and laughed, "Monk, even though you are stronger than me, I won't feel tired according to the system.As long as I keep running, you cannot catch me in your whole life.So you will die in the end.Have you seen these skeletons around my neck? These are your heads.You were eaten by me for the last eight rounds of incarnation.I remember you were also so strong in one of last incarnations, but you also died because you failed to catch me within one year."
Bukong thought to himself "In usually cases, the player can consume Boss's time and HP.But this time, Who designs the Boss?What the fuck!"
"I am Sandy.I used to be a General for Folding the Curtain in Heaven.I took charge of all the curtain-folding in Heaven each morning.Without me, the whole Heaven couldn't function well." Sandy began to brag about himself.
"I was highly respected by others in Heaven.Although my official title was not high, I am ……very important.Because, you know, i took charge of all the curtain folding."
"So why you end up staying at here?" The White Horse asked.
"It was my fault, but also a mistake.At that time when the Heaven was in chaos, I saved the Goddess of Heaven heroically.But i was carelessly broken her favorite glazed cup.Therefore, she punished me slightly.If it was broken by others, they would end up losing their life.It was impossible for them to have the same treatment as I have." Sandy babbled.
"As long as I work hard, I am able to return to Heaven after the punishment.What's more, I killed you for the last eight reincarnations.So these EXP can provide me with a high ranking job.Maybe I will be a guard serving at the South Heaven Gate."
"He is heavily brainwashed." The White Horse said to Bukong, "Oops, he is a watchdog.What shall we do?"

text.不知过了多久，琼英才清醒过来，她缓缓地吐出一口气，可是再睁眼的时候，却发现自己到:
After some time, Qiong Ying woke up.She took a deep breath, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself in an unknown place.
There was covered with snow and big snowflake fell down in the air.Qiong Ying knew that it was at the beginning of spring, but why it was snowing.And then she looked up, realizing that a tall man in his twenties standing in front of her.
Qiong was surprised, and then she supported herself.She said, "Predecessor, who are you?"
The "stranger" turned to Qiong Ying and smiled to her, "In such a short time, you just don't remember your master?"
On hearing it, the numbed-feet Qiong Ying slumped onto the ground.She asked, "master?"
She was confused and she felt like that she was in a dream.So she just asked the most urgent question, "master, what is this place? Why are you changed into this?"
The Coldstar just took out the halved wooden pieces and threw them to Qiong Ying.He scolded, "How dare you to ask me? What you have carved?"
Qiong Ying realized it immediately because it took the three of them half night to finish.She muttered, "This……this is a hierogram of trace tracking."
The master sighed, "You three are not capable enough to carve a hierogram that is unknown to you.You three are so bold.There are more than one mistake in the hierogram of trace tracking, so it has changed into a semi-hierogram of soul chasing.It is useless, but the King of All Demons activated it compulsorily.Now it chases us here in accordance with the trace of the King of All Demons' primordial spirit."
Qiong Ying thought quickly and then she asked her master tentatively, "Master, do you know him?"
The Coldstar Lay Buddhist said with a bitter smile, "Thanks to you all, i just figure out who he is right now."
After finishing his words, he touched his darkened jade pendant and said, "Many years ago, my master left the Sect and he left the jade pendant to me."
The Coldstar Lay Buddhist knocked on the jade for several times, and then a vague human shadow jumped out of it.And it turned into a middle-aged man.
After watching the man carefully for some time, the Coldstar knelt down slowly.And he said, "Master."

text.春去冬来，上山一年，琼英每天就是上课，吃饭，打坐，念经，那本师门心法《自在经》背:
As season went by, one year passed.During the year, Qiong Ying attended classes, had meals, sat in meditation and read scriptures.She could recite the Free Scripture owned by the Sect from memory.The Coldstar just yawned all day.Only the eldest disciple wield a wooden sword once in a while.
Today the master summoned the three disciples into the yard after the morning class with a wooden broadsword in his hand.Qiong pretended to be calm but she looked forward to it.
Lu Chen jumped here and there, and he looked around with interest.
Ye Tianhe took an ancient armchair from nowhere and lied in it comfortably.He fanned himself, which seemed that he was enjoying a drama.
《Qiong Ying and Xiaochen, today i will impart the Blade Technique of Springsun.Tianhe, since you have learned, you just have a review.》 The Master also the Sect Leader stood straightly in the yard with a serious look on his face.It seemed that something great will happen very soon.So Qiong held a higher expectation for it.
After his words, he raised his two arms and held a broadsword with two hands.He presented a flabby position, and then began to wield it.When wielding, he uttered some words from his mouth.
Qiong Ying was speechless.
Although she didn't conduct immortal cultivation nor did she exercised martial arts, she could recognize the wield was so informal.It seemed that the wooden broadsword was air.The wield of the broadsword even could not bring a wisp of wind.And each motion was extremely slow.If the broadsword was changed into a fan, the man who was wielding was dancing.In addition to the master's seductive words, the effect was amazingly impressive.
Lu Chen burst into laughter and he said that the acrobatics he saw on the street was more like sword motion than the master's wielding.
The master came to Lu and patted his head with the wooden broadsword.Lu was punished to write the Free Scripture five hundred times.Lu just restrained his laughter.
Sect Leader of Lu gave two different wooden swords to Qiong Ying and Lu Chen.What Qiong got was a slim sword with long and slim blade, while Lu got a pair of bent blade, which should be wielded with two hands.
《Tianhe, you lead them to practise.I want to have a snap.Later i will teach you the third motion.》 The Coldstar yawned and slipped away.
When the master went away, Lu burst into laughter, but not Qiong Ying.She found that the usually lazy eldest disciple stood up with a very concentrated look on his face.
Ye Tianhe took out what he got, a wooden sword.The Blade Technique of Springsun was strange enough, but what is strangers is that even the weapon for three disciples are totally different.

text.从五庄观出来，看过那本仙册，小白龙的话也没有以前多了。\\n他是西海龙王的第58:
The White Horse was not so eloquent since he had saw the book.
He is the 58th son of the Dragon King of West Ocean.He grew up in a unknown lake and never got a chance to the Dragon Palace.
When he was young, he dreamed to be a great dragon just like his father:Bringing favorable rain to the people in the world when flying in the sky to summon rain or cloud.And when he passed by, the people living on earth could give thumb-up to him.That was what he longed for.
So he kept sharpening his skills.When he was 18 years old, his father begged the Jade Emperor to arrange a job of distributing rainfall for him.Although it was in a remote area, the White Horse was very happy.
But when he assumed his position the very first day, he saw the notice on the board which reads:the local Emperor showed disrespect to the Jade Emperor, so no rainfall for this area for three years to serve as a warning.
The horse had to put away his bag used for rain precipitation.He thought the Jade Emperor's anger would melt away one day.He waited for three years.He had submitted many statements to ask the approval of rain precipitation, but didn't got any response.Actually the Jade Emperor had already forgotten this tiny thing.But those who were responsible for conveying information did not deliver the horse's statement to the Emperor because they wanted to avoid trouble as much as possible.So they just threw all the horse's statement into dustbins.
Later it is said that there was a white horse violated the Heaven rule by bringing rain to the prohibited area.According to the rule, he should be capitalized.
His mother required his father to beg the mercy for him by threatening to end her own life.Despite the spare of his life, he should be punished heavily.Therefore, he was demoted to here to experience nine times of reincarnation.
"White horse, you must realize that if you are not strong enough, you cannot change the world.So what you should do is to focus on your own business.There is no need to feel guilty for not being able to save so many people.the only wish is that when you are able to change the world, just bear in mind your initial aspiration." Bukong wiped away the tears in the horse's eyes who was in sound sleep.
Bukong patted the horse to wake him up."It is time to go ahead."
The horse felt a little lost.He said nothing and followed Bukong to go ahead.

text.大师兄醒来已经是一个时辰后，黑衣人队长死了，琼英昏迷不醒倒在血泊里，三师弟陆沉不:
It was already one hour later when the eldest disciple woke up.The leader in black was dead, and Qiong Ying got a black out surrounded by blood.And Lu Chen was nowhere to be found.
He held Qiong Ying in his arm.Qiong's body was cold, but his heart was colder.
He held Qiong Ying for a very long time.He thought that he was a loser, and why their master asked him to be the Leader of the Sect? Or in other words, why he accepted the offer? He should have brought his younger sisters and brothers back to the mountain.They could live a happy secular life there.Why should they pursue immortality and cultivation?

The office of Tang Dynasty was not sloppy but efficient.And the Emperor was easy-going enough that he made Bukong as his younger brother who did not have blood ties with him.
Holding Bukong's hand, the Emperor said to Bukong with tears in his eyes:"Younger brother, I have been troubled by many innocent ghosts day and night.It is said that only the Buddhism in the west can save those innocent ghosts.I wonder if you can……"
"Yes, I can.I can.I will set out to the west right now."Bukong put his hands on the Emperor's to stop the latter's more words.Bukong thought to himself that did he have other option? If he refused, he would stuck at here.
The Emperor waved his hand and then one of the servants ran to send the luggage and the pass needed for the journey.And the Emperor sent Bukong an exquisite cassock, a gold alms bowl, a nine-ring tin stick and a swift horse.He said emotionally:"Younger brother, wish you a safe journey.Please take care of yourself."
Bukong thought to himself that the Emperor even didn't prepare dinner for him.To send the alms bowl was to ensure that he could use it to hold the food he begged.So he would not starve to death.
After several moments of thought, Bukong accepted it peacefully and he took all these gifts, laughed and went out.
When Bukong walked away, the Emperor bowed respectfully to the sky in four directions and said, "Golden XXX has already set out.According to the script, he should set out at the age of 13.It has nothing to do with me for the late.He comes here too late."
A loud voice came out from the sky, "Got it! No more words."

text.的确是父皇的笔记。\\n“自明，见字恐难再见面，朕的胞弟李渊应该是已经篡位成功了:
It is truly written by father
"Ziming, when you read this letter, i am afraid that we cannot meet each other any more.I suppose my younger brother,the usurper Li Yuan, has successfully ascended to the throne."
"At the time when the Dynasty was founded after the unity of the central plain, i attempted to abdicate my throne to him.But he was not a man of integrity.Yao Guang once suggested that i should kill him to save many potential threats.But i was not coldblooded enough to do so.Later he grew so powerful that i couldn't control him."
"You must believe what i am going to say.It is true that there are immortal beings in the world, but not all of them are nice.You uncle got some opportunities to gain acquaintance with some immortal beings.And he offered sacrifices to them.In doing so, these immortal beings protect him.He could not be killed by knifes or swords.Nor he would drown or burn to death.What's more, he obtained a kind of item called "shenxianshui" literally means miracle water.By drinking it, ordinary people can get superpower to fight without the sense of hurt or fear at the cost of reduced life.He possesses a troop like that.I can do nothing about it."
"The royal military adviser Yao Guang once also had some ties with immortal beings.But because of constant fighting in battlefields, his ties were getting increasingly loose.Similarly he could do nothing about it.When you were eight years old, on the surface he left his government position and became a recluse.But in fact he managed to figured out how to cope with the strong army force possessed by Li Yuan.And as for my part, i tried to stop Li Yuan's action as long as possible."
"In early stage, Li Yuan didn't dare to take action recklessly, because he couldn't find perfect opportunities and he was unclear about my real strength.Therefore he just played tricks in the dark.Actually the death of your two older brothers was associated with him.When you were 15 years old, i has a serious illness which was a result of the spell cast by an immortal being asked by Li Yuan.So i took this chance to project myself as coward and mediocre.Seeing that, he did not rise in rebellion directly.He thought that it was perfectly justifiable if i died naturally and abdicated my throne to him.Consequently he ordered Tong Kaiyang and other people to rebuild the Star Picking Pavilion, in order to kill me at a stroke."
"As for the depose of your title of princess, i aim to make it more reliable and to protect you as well."
"I left you with some loyal assistants whom you can resort to in any time.They are military adviser Yao Guang, the general Luo Yi, Liu Ting, the son of Liu Xian, and Yin Wenyuan.They are loyal to me.And there are a group of old ministers who retired because of handling the cases of the death of imperial sons and the depose of the prince.They are all useful assistants that i left to you."
"I have done many things in my whole life, but i seldom do things for you.Now i ask you to change the current situation which require hard work.I am really feel guilty about it."
"I have already said that the throne would belong to you one day.Ziming, i know that you hold a casual attitude towards life.But this time, you should strive to get the thing that should belong to you.It is not for me, nor for you, but for people in the whole nation."
"My dear child, i watched with pride, as you grew into a man of righteousness.You must bear in mind that we rule the nation with our wisdom and power.To inspire your people to be high in spirit is the real victory.My life will come to an end one day, but you will be the Emperor."
Dropping the letter down slowly, Li Ziming has found the answer of many problems that perplexed him before.But at the same time, he has a strong desire to take revenge on Li Yuan.He realizes that he should refrain from being a kind person this time."

"OK.Immortals can date back to 600 years ago.At that time, our human ancestors modeled after demonic beasts to absorb the essence of the sun and moon, and created cultivation methods from scratch.The process of ascending to immortality involves several levels, and I heard that the highest one is Nascent Soul.The master of our sect leader has reached the early stage of the level."says the master.
"Demonic beasts? Nascent Soul? Master, what are these?"
"Demonic beasts refer to beasts and spirit creatures that instinctively absorb the essence from nature to cultivate and strengthen themselves after being accidentally enlightened by eating rare and precious herbs or by absorbing spiritual energy.In their terms, after transforming into human beings they generally call themselves demons.Most of them feed on human blood."
Yao Zhen continues quietly, "The ascension process of demonic beasts involves Enlightenment, Spiritual wisdom-gaining, Core formation, and Transformation.Accordingly, the process of human race is divided into Qi refining, Base establishment, gold core-Forming, and Nascent soul, and each realm is divided into early, middle, late and peak four stages.

When seeing that it is you who come, the Elder asks you how's everything going, and you tell him about the problems you've encountered in your cultivation.He then helps you analyse and solve them one by one.
Gaining a lot from the Elder, you leave and come back to your place.Then, you settle down to practice again.This time, you are surprised to find you can feel the spiritual energy very easily, saying the spell to absorb the stray wood spiritual energy into your body.

text.高配不空问：道大佛大？道高佛高？\\n不空答：你把他们叫来我给你量量。\\n高配:
The advanced-version Bukong asked, "Which one is greater, the Taoism or the Buddhism? And which one is higher? (higher means greater)"
Bukong answered, "I can measure their height if you bring them in front of me."
And he asked, "We are not allowed to utter any noise in front of Buddhas, if so, how can we have access to Buddha?"
Bukong answered, "If you are true, why you still make noise."
He asked again, "Since human body is dirty, why Taoism continues to stress the importance of cultivation and refinement?"
Bukong answered, "Before you were a real Buddha, you also got a human body.But if you had abandoned the dirty body, could you still be there?"
He continued asking, "Buddhism attaches great importance on the equality of all beings.Is there any similar doctrine in Taoism?"
Bukong answered, "porcelain and title are made of clay.But are you trying to purchase a porcelain with the money you paid for a piece of title?"
He asked, "I am talking Buddhism with you, but why are you always talking ordinary things?"
Bukong answered, "I just judge the case as it stands.Since all of us exist in this world, and we take from it as well, shall we still despise the worldly world?"
The advanced-version Bukong asked, "The mundane world is tough, why don't you keep your distance with it?"
Bukong answered, "The Taoism generates everything in the world, but still, it is not restrained by anything.The Heaven and Earth breed us, and our mother gave birth to us.Do you want to abandon the Heaven, Earth and your mother?"
He asked, "In your eyes, what is the difference between monk and Taoist?"
Bukong answered, "A man with hair and a man without hair.That is it."
The advanced-version Bukong remained silent for a while and finally he said, "I fail."

text.告别东方庆后，独自走在回府的路上，心中暗自思量着以后该如何解决此事。\\n回到家:
After waving goodbye to Dongfang Qing, you walk alone home, trying to figure out a solution.
Upon back home, you come to Mrs Rong directly, asking "Mrs Rong, where did you get this soul-soothing incense stick?".She casts a look at you, "Long time ago, the capital was hit by droughts for years on end.People suffered from severe famines and exchanged children for food, thus incurring armies of evil spirits.Thanks to your family, my family survived.One day, a Taoist priest was found fainted in the neighborhood of our house, half dead, and he did not get better until my father gave him a little saline water to drink.When he recovered and left later, he presented us three soul-soothing incense sticks.I gave one to you considering that it might be helpful when you come across something evil in your first journey far away from home."
"I see, I owed my life to the incense that night."then, you told her what happened in the inn that night.
"Do you still remember where did the Taoist priest come from and where he was heading for?" you continue asking.
"He did not mention that.We must do something else to handle the evil spirit then."

You explain in a low voice, "Zhongyang has..."

You then tell him exactly what happened to his son.As the news turns his joy into gloom, Jia Baohe asks you to leave him alone.

text.孩子，当你出生的时候，洛丹伦的森林，哦不，紫禁城的假山真水轻声唤出了你的名字：李:
My son, when you were born, the very forests of Lordaeron...no, the rockeries and pools of the Forbidden City whispered your name：Li Ziming.
I am your dad, working as a king.
You have a big family, armies of brothers and sisters, and a ravishing harem.
You are my third child, and your mother was a maid of my empress.One night I drank too much...and wanted to spend a beautiful night with your aunt empress...but that was not the right time for her...so I had some fun with your mother, the maid.This is why you were born.
Your mother got a high status because of you, buried as a high-ranking concubine.But to be honest, I have no affection for her, and you are the tie of this unexpected marriage.
You may have had two older brothers, but one died before three, another died before seeing the light of day.
In order to bear you seccessfully, your mother made many sacrifices, including but not limited to her rights of reputation, property and portrait, her life and even her 《right of paternity》 to you that she valued most.
You should not feel confused about the empress being your mother now, because this is commonly seen in imperial family.
Before long, you will become the crown prince, if you can survive.
I would like to take particular care of you of course, but...sometimes it is out of my reach, because I can't take you with me all the time.Your aunts, those concubines, always intrigue against each other.The harem is like an officialdom.
I wish you a healthy growth and be safe.And you must be independent under some circumstances.
--the Diary of the Emperor, arounf 1-3 am, lunar May 8th, 562.

These guards deserves the name of the most valiant horse-riding soldiers in the capital city.They are unstoppable.And it is like a piece of cake to kill these bandits.
Li Ziming orders these guards to make a breakthrough instead of continuing to fight.Therefore, they attempt to get ride of these bandits, but these people chase after in disregard of their own life.
Galloping his horse for more than a hundred mi, Li Ziming is ahead of his enemies.Suddenly he find something strange when looking ahead.He has no time to explain but shouts, "get up".With his feet beating the horse stomach heavily, the horse leaps high in the air which escape the horse rope set by enemies.At this time, the eight guards also realize what happened and they model after Li's action.

text.花巷作为京都最大的烟柳之地，凌晨一点依然是灯火通明，商贩尖细的吆喝声，客人粗犷的:
As the largest brothel in the capital city, Floral Street is still brightly lit.The trade shouts of street vendors and the laughter of customs and the girls are mixed.The night is so vibrant.
A middle-aged man walked out of the Flower Intoxication Building.He worn a thin white robe in the depth of winter.The man staggered and is drunken.
He walked through as there were no one else around him.No matter people in high positions or street gangs, they all made way for the man.Some were respectful, while some were grinning.
"Who is that lunatic man? Why everyone makes way for him?" A new man asked.
"He is Mr.Liu.Although he is a shabby scholar, he has a high reputation here.Many prostitutes gain popularity by singing the lyrics composed by him.So his reputation is widely spread across the country.Everyone here will show some respect for him."A regular customer said to the new man to show off his knowledge.
"He is Mr.Liu? How does he degrade to compose vulgar works?"
"Because he met with unfair treatment in the imperial examination.So he composed a poem to satirize it.He compared himself with a lyric composer with brilliance.It is okay to make such a comparison.But he also compared the Imperial examination to a vanity title.His behavior offended all scholars in the country.What's worse, the Emperor was also enraged.So the Emperor banned Liu to take the Imperial examination in his whole life.Later his wife died of illness.Only a daughter accompanied him."
Maybe Liu overheard it, or he was dizzy because of the wind.He stopped suddenly and then he staggered forward.He left the brightly lit street and went to a dark place.

text.话分两边，南蜀君与沈渊旷世大战时，在场的修士纷纷跳进水里规避伤害，虽然有人受伤，:
At the moment when the Nanshu Priest and Shen Yuan were fighting with each other, all present cultivators jumped into water to avoid being hurt.Though some people got hurt, no one died.But all boats no matter large or small floating on the ocean were destroyed.
The personnel of Tianshu Island came very late.When they arrived, they helped rescue all the cultivators in the water, and brought them back to the Island.
The eldest disciple and the third younger disciple also followed the rescue team to go to the Island.To their surprise, the Island owner Chen Tanlang met them in person.And the owner was amicable, and he treated the two kindly as if he was treating his juniors.He arranged accommodations for them and helped search for their master and Qiong Ying.
The eldest disciple could feel that all these immortal cultivators were hostile to him and Lu Chen.The reason may lie in his original high-profile purchasing of the big boat, or other’s envy of the owner’s personal meeting, or the evil Shen Yuan coming from the Springsun Sect.
Having waiting for seven days in the Island, the eldest disciple felt every day was like a year long.
Seven days later, Qiong Ying went the Island for searching.The eldest disciple rushed to her without acknowledging Lu Chen.
Because of days of worries, the eldest disciple got pent-up anger.But when he saw Qiong Ying who looked untidy, his anger half died away.And when he knew their master was still missing, his anger had gone completely.
"What happened? Why are you like this? Where have you gone all these days? Where is our master?" The eldest disciple asked Qiong Ying and he stared at Qiong, which made her feel uncomfortable.
Qiong Ying took a deep breath, and then she took out a tiny seal from her arms with the uninjured hand.She handed it to the eldest disciple and said in a very low voice, "This is the Leader Seal, eldest brother, our master asked me to bring it to you." After hearing it, the eldest brother stepped back several steps.
"Our master died, and he said you are the Leader of the Springsun Sect from then on.I saw him disappearing into nothing." Qiong Ying continued and then she got a blackout.
Well, Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing came to…
text.话说姜子牙当初下山时，表示弟子才疏学浅恐怕难当大任，元始告诉他不用担心如果有困难:
When Jiang Ziya left Mount Kunlun, he told his master that he was afraid of being not equal to the task, and his master asked him to take it easy, because he would always be helped when in difficulties.Then, a highly-skilled boy Nezha whose body has been reshaped with lotus blossoms, really comes to his aid within a couple of days after he hangs up the board of truce.
Jiang Ziya feels relieved when he hears that Nezha is a disciple of Taiyi Zhenren who is a senior disciple of Chan sect in the Golden Light Cave of Qianyuan Mountain.
He at once leads his troops out of the city to provoke his enemy, and Zhang Guifang, who was just concerned about how to prompt Xiqi to make an attack, hastens to take up the challenge.
Nezha is riding on the Wind Fire Wheels, has the Universe Ring around his body, the Red Armillary Sash around his shoulders and a Fire-tipped Spear in his right hand, obviously a non-mortal.Zhang Guifang asks, "Who are you? I am the general of Green Dragon Pass, I don't fight with a nameless man."
Nezha arrogantly replies, "My name is Nezha.I am here to cut your head off and kick it as a ball." Hearing that, Zhang Guifang feels pleased secretly and engages in a fight with Nezha.
After 20 or 30 rounds of battles, Zhang Guifang realizes that he is no match for Nezha, so he attacks quickly with his spear and forces his adversary back, saying, "Nezha, get down from your Wind Fire Wheels." But Nezha remains motionless.He repeats, but in vain.Then he feels something’s wrong and intends to flee, whipping up his horse.Suddenly, Nezha hits him from behind with his Universe Ring, breaking his ribs.Zhang Guifang retreats in a flurry, which leads the Xiqi side to a cheer, but they cease to pursue and attack in case of ambush.
Seeing Leizhenzi's confusion, Qi Yun begins to explain, "Zhang Guifang's skill is oriented towards the three spiritual and seven physical souls of mortals, but Nezha is the incarnation of lotus with no souls, so we can say that he is a deadly rival to Zhang Guifang." Leizhenzi nods with seeming understanding.
Following the defeat, Zhang keeps inside his camp.Xiqi army dares not to make a sudden attack for fear that he might have some other schemes.In fact, he writes a letter to Zhao Ge asking for reinforcement.
text.话说众人正商议如何破阵，便有十位高人一一到来，这十位高人中有八位同属那阐教十二仙:
When all are discussing how to break the formations, ten immortals come to their aid one after another, eight of whom are members of the Twelve Immortals of Chan sect including Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun, Ju Liusun, Cihang Daoren, Puxian Zhenzhen, Guangchengzi, Taiyi Zhenzhen, Chijingzi, Master Virtue of the Pure Void, and the rest of whom are even more remarkable, one being Nanji Xianweng of the same sect, an immortal of fortune and virtue as Yunzhongzi, and the other non-cultivator Luya Daoren, a mystical and highly-skilled immortal who’s never suffered any loss in battle.
After swapping pleasantries the two sides are on the verge of coming to blows.The Chan side jeers at the Jie side for courting death for themselves, while the Jie side retaliates by provocating its adversaries.
The Ten Crucible Battle Formation is the very thing that Qi Yun criticised when he read the book.
In fact, the reason of the Chan sect’s participation in the war is that its twelve senior disciples have to go through a trial, namely, the killing process.Because the sect’s cultivation method is Taoist orthodoxy, it is not necessary to suppress one's emotions and temperament all the time during cultivation, which leads to the fact that their three desires are not cut off when cultivators ascend to immortality.
What are three desires? They can be seen as the symbol of human emotions, or Internal Demons.This is why the twelve senior disciples need to get involved in a killing process.But that doesn't mean they have to kill, but have a doom to be involved in the process of killing, and to surmount the doom is about how to survive.
Among the twelve high-level immortals, eight come to face the Ten Crucible Battle Formation, none of them are 100%sure they can get through this doom.How they handle it?- looking for fall guys.Qi Yun remembers very clearly, they send a scapegoat to get killed in each formation, and then destroy the formations based on the information they gain in the expense of the life of fall guys.In the end, they even slay all of the Ten Heavenly Monarchs so as to satisfy their internal demons.they are just hypocrites who sacrifice others’ life for their own safety.

text.皇帝的身子一天比一天硬朗，甚至脸上皱纹都在退却，但总觉得作为活人的新鲜气越来越少:
Over time, the emperor becomes stronger and healthier and even the wrinkles on his face have disappeared, but somehow he doesn't look like a living person.
The imperial court runs as well as before, but the emperor becomes every moody and arbitrary.
In the autumn of 574, Lord Protector Luo Yi who is dissatisfied with the court, resigns and returns to his hometown.
Among the rest of the "five grand dukes", Yin Wenyuan has been garrisoning the country’s western part for years; Yao Guang has been living a recluse’s life and Liu Xian passed away.Only the emperor’s brother Li Yuan is holding a position in the court.
Li Yuan, a man approaching his fifties, is different from the heroic general who kills enemies in a breeze, and now he is quite affable and smiles to everyone he meets.He is always found napping in the court, which amuses the emperor even though he is in a fury.
Li Ziming is still grounded in his palace.It's been a long time that the emperor avoids talking about the crown prince, which is actually the worst news for the prince himself.
text.皇帝李密对生命和权力的渴望几乎达到了极致，凡事皆登摘星楼，小事卜卦，大事问天。\:
Emperor Li Mi has an overwhelming lust for life and power, as found in his frequent visits to the Star-Picking Tower for everything from divination to heaven asking.
Taoist priests, monks, and alchemists as professions become most popular overnight.
Today Li Mi comes to the tower again because he dreamed about the "Emperor Star"(Polaris)’s falling from the sky of outer space last night.
Over there, Tong Kaiyang, the Taoist, holds the emperor edict in his left hand, ignites it with a fire burning is his palm, and then throws it into the air.It somehow hovers in midair, burning to ashes from right to left naturally as if it is being read literally by an immortal.
Great yearning and awe are evident in the emperor’s eyes which are fixed on the fire.
The piece of edict burns for half a quarter of an hour until it completely turns into black ashes.Then they move and fall slowly onto the table as if they are controlled by a magical power to form a character "East".
Tong Kaiyang says in a low voice："The fall of the Emperor star is a sign of the new’s ousting the old.The usurper may be the crown prince."
It seems that Li Mi wants to pause and ponder.His eyes glaze over for a while, but are filled with strong desire soon.

text.家园建筑\\n\\n家园建筑分为普通建筑、功能建筑和增益建筑\\n普通建筑：无附:
Home Buildings

House Builidings are divided into Common Builidings，Functional Buildings and Buff Buildings
Common Buildings：no added stats, simply decorations
Functional Buildings：just as its name, buildings that have some functions, click to open the Function Panel.For examle, click to open our own stats panel, and if you click Spirit Pool, you would open Aptitude Panel
Buff Buildings：buildings have stats of Fengshui, including Metal, Wood, Water, FIre, Earth and Mana.You could check each stats through Fengshui Compass.Some Functional Buildings need certain amount of Fengshui stats, to get special buu
Calculation of Fengshui stats：set Mana as an example, if a Functional Building covers 4 ：squares, the stats of mana for each square is：10, 10, 10 and 30, and the mana stats of this building is：mana=（10+10+10+30）/4=15

text.将暗羽兽带回宗门后，详细讲明了本次任务经历，将灵兽带回了住处。\\n可是本门不擅:
After bringing the dark-feathered beast to the sect, you report in detail the experience of this mission and then bring the spirit beast to your dwelling.
Unfortunately, your sect is not a good beast tamer, and the beast hardly eats ordinary food, so you have to find a way to make your own beast-taming pills.
As a result, you exchange most of your contribution from the mission for the book for Alchemy in the grocery hall, intending to read it carefully back home.
A few months later, Elder Shi Yuan comes to your residence, holding in his hand the gourd you handed in before "Cold Wind, bring this back.It is not the belonging of any cultivators here.I have managed to wash away the residual soul on it, and now it may help gather the surrounding spiritual energy together around you and facilitate your absorption."
"Thank you, your Excellency.I must be your helper whenever you please." The Elder smiles, "Good boy."
"Your Excellency, may I ask something about the True Extreme sect since nothing can be known about it through the Jade Slip now, but I remember there were Five great sects including Tianji Pavilion, Lingxiao Mount, True Extreme sect, Nine Heaven Sword Pavilion and we Qingyuan Palace when I was initiated into our sect? What happened to the True Extreme sect then?"
The Elder wears a complicated look, saying, "The True Extreme sect, whose overall strength used to rank third among the Five sects, was unfortunately exterminated a few years ago by the demon force the Ten Thousand Demon Valley, because..."
After you are told the story of the elimination in detail, you feel a bit guilty, since you scarcely remember your previous appointment with Mr.Yao after your accession to the sect until today.He was right：as long as you step into the complicated world of Metaphysics, you will seldom have a sound sleep afterwards.

text.姜子牙终日死守，转眼就过去一年，西岐虽然富裕，但是也架不住这么吃，一个月前余粮就:
It's been one year since the Xiqi side retreated and warded off their enemy's attack in town.More than one month ago, the wealthy city already came across deficiency of food, but there's nothing Jiang Ziya can do about it.Knowing that grains would run out in two days, he looks calm on the surface, but actually feels very anxious, thinking, my master, you told me I would be helped whenever in difficulty, I wish you are not a liar.
Then his wish comes true.The day sees two kids visiting, whom are warmly welcomed by Jiang Ziya.
The two boys bow down to him in the hall, saying, "Uncle-Master, we are disciples under Daoxing Tianzun of the Jade House Cave in the Golden Court Mountain.My name is Han Dulong, and this is Xue E Hu.We are ordered by our master to bring grain here today."
Ziya is overjoyed："Where is the grain?"
The boy replies, "Here it is." taking out a bowl from his bag and handing it to Ziya.
Jiang Ziya is delighted and orders someone to take the boy to the granary, which, after half an hour when the boy places the bowl there, becomes as full as it could be.
Applying his identification technique to the bowl, Qi Yun finds it is just an ordinary object rather than a magic treasure.It must have been enchanted.
Plenty of food in the city has soothed everyone’s nerves, and they begin to shift their focus on defending the city.
Soon, the war is once again in a deadlock, with Jiang Ziya strengthening his army while burning incense and praying for other superior men to come to his aid quickly.

text.截教十天君全部魂归封神榜，朝歌军大败，连退七十里。\\n申公豹连忙游说赵公明下山:
As the ten Heavenly Monarchs of Jie sect have all died and been listed into Fengshen Bang as gods, the Shang army is defeated and takes 70 miles backward in a row.
Shen Gongbao hastens to lobby Zhao Gongming to help.As a senior member of Jie sect, Zhao Gongming knows the inner workings of Fengshen Bang.When the list saw the light of day, the names of all disciples of the three sects were signed on it, and whoever dies in wars would be listed into it, while whoever wants to survive must avoid those wars.
Zhao Gongming is reluctant to leave the mountain and help, but Shen Gongpao adds inflammatory details to the tragic death of his ten fellow immortals, and says Zhao Jiang’s corpse is hung and whipped after his death.Zhao Gongming then, in a fit of rage, decides to assist Grand Old Master Wen Zhong.
As the the first generation of disciple of Jie sect under Tongtian Jiaozhu, he is rather distinguished in both martial arts and magical arts.Upon reaching the battlefield, he is furious and kills Jiang Ziya （who is later resurrected） with his whip and wounds Chijingzi, Guangchengzi, Yuding Zhenren, Daoxing Tianzun and Lingbao Dafashi, coming across no obstructions as if he moves into the free region.
Then he gives chase to Randeng Daoren to Mount Wuyi, where two distinguished men Xiao Sheng and Cao Bao comes to his adversary’s aid.He charges them and kills Xiao Sheng, but little does he expect that Cao Bao whould flip into the air a treasured item called Treasure-Catching Golden Coin, which sucks his Sea-Conquering Pearls and Dragon-Binding Rope.
After losing his two treasures, Zhao Gongming leaves to the Three Fairy Island to borrow Golden Dragon Scissors from his sisters, and with it cuts the deer of Randeng Daoren into two halves in an instant.Randeng flees for his life back to Xiqi and immortals of the Chan sect dare not to take any challenge.
As things progress, it is time for Luya to show up and instruct Jiang Ziya to build a straw effigy of Zhao Gongming so as to curse him to death.
Qi Yun, as Luya, doesn't feel sorry for Zhao Gongming but feels concerned about himself since he has no idea how to teach Jiang Ziya to build a straw effigy at all.Things end up in a deadlock.

Qi Yun has been preparing for the war since he came to the mountain to cultivate ten years ago.As the war will impact the entire immortal world god knows if he would be killed or not by accident.
He sums up that there are only two ways to improve strength：pressuring others first and magic treasures second, after fully inquiring about and analyzing the ways of fighting in the world.
Therefore, he’s never shown favoritism over any magical arts, practising the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire and earth, and even versed in some skills of heterodoxy.
As for magic treasures, he has practiced the skill of weapon-copying so well that he can basically imitate a less complicated magic treasure in a few breaths of time, and he’s also collected many raw materials and stored them in his Qiankun bag.
The battle among gods and men is a seckill one, and rarely does it result in a lose-lose situation, so as long as he can get the upper hand in overpowering others and applying magic treasures, he can be able to defend himself in the face of others more powerful than him.
what Qi Yun is worried about now is his master Yunzhongzi, whose sense of justice is too strong.His becoming his disciple is not a plot that can be found in the book, so he wonders if this will have any impact on his master, and whether he should tell him the truth of everything and what is coming soon.

text.离京时还是一片春色，至北境已经是夏日炎炎。\\n北方是游牧民族的天下，大大小小数:
In springtime, Li Ziming left capital city.Now it is already in summer when he arrives the Northern Frontier.
Nomadic tribes mainly live in the northern where scatters dozens of tribes, large or small, around the sprawling prairie.
These tribes posed no threat to the nation till around a hundred years ago when a man Alutai who claimed as the Grand Preceptor of the heaven upheld Guilichi to be Khagan.By persuading or threatening, the Tartar tribe was united.The nomadic tribe united as a whole, which caused many trouble for the central plain area.
Since these nomadic tribes made a living by grazing instead of farming, it was common to suffer from hunger because of many uncertain factors such as weather, natural disaster, and diseases.But they didn't just sit around and starved to death.Therefore, they went to the south to grab food as well as some clothes and some daily necessities.If the court sent troops to guard against, they would change to another place.Because this region was sprawling enough.This tactics was not applicable until the year of 564 when the Emperor Li Mi led Luo Yi(titled Beiqiang) to fight against the Northern invaders.They conquered many regions even the distant Oirats.And then they returned in triumph.The war brought the region ten years of peace.The Luo Army therefore stationed at the Northern Jurisdiction.
Now more than a decade later, the deterrent of the war has faded away.Tartars begin to stage provocations frequently.
This is what faced by Li Ziming.

So he fights against himself, against others, and then against the immortals.
In the end, he seems to hold little grudge against his foe Li Yuan.He forgives the miserable man, for whom is just an insatiable pawn of those immortals.As for his tragic ending, he brings that on himself.

text.李自明把帽子取下来拿在手里，顺着一个比较大的缝隙钻了过去，听到小太监们越来越近，:
Taking off his hat and holding it in hand, Li Ziming starts to climb through a wider gap of the fence.Hearing the eunuchs’ approaching, he hurriedly steps onto the plank bridge.
Not frequented by pedestrians, the bridge is covered with moss, and it is a foggy morning.As a result, he skids and is falling into the lake.
At this critical moment, Li Ziming's arm is held by a hand behind the rockery, and his whole body is pulled back as he hears a shout.
Li Ziming still in lingering fear, looks at the girl who is half-a-head higher than himself.She is about two years older than him, with a chubby face, dark eyes and snow-white skin.She looks like a fairy.
But what is funny is, she is holding half a drumstick in her other hand.
"Shhh..." the girl motions for him to stop speaking until the eunuchs walk far away.
"Who are you?"
"Yun Yao, the ninth disciple of Star-Picking Tower, Nomnomnom(chewing)..."
"What are you doing here?"
"Sneaking a snack, Nomnom..."
"You...thank you for saving me."
"You're welcome, Nom...nom...nom."
"..."
A boy who is not as high as a Cauldron calls himself his highness, and assumes an air of superiority mismatching with his age, which is really adorable instead of august.
A girl who is slightly higher than a Cauldron saves a boy from a lake, and then is busy enjoying her snack with all her attention, which makes her look attractive and particularly cute.
One doesn't know what to say, and the other is not available to speak.For the first time, Li Ziming feels that it is not bad to do nothing just like this.
Here are the cries of eunuchs, and Li Ziming knows that it is time to go, otherwise someone would be punished if he is found lost.
"I live in the Ciqing Palace.If you want to eat chicken thighs...or whatever, you can come to me." Li Ziming takes off a piece of jade pendant with his name engraved on it and hands it to her.
"So, it's okay, you are the type who is grateful" the girl directly takes the pendant, and than lowers her head to continue eating.
"I...have to go, good bye." Li Ziming carefully crosses the plank bridge and back to the main road.Groups of eunuchs who are at the end of their wits run over from a distance and look at him carefully.After being sure that he is alright, they cry and laugh in a frenzy of excitement.

Taking off his hat and holding it in hand, Li Ziming starts to climb through a wider gap of the fence.Hearing the eunuchs'approaching, he hurriedly steps onto the plank bridge.
Not frequented by pedestrians, the bridge is covered with moss, and it is a foggy morning.As a result, he skids and is falling into the lake.Li Ziming has fallen into the water, which, though half a meter depth, is fatal to children.He is overwhelmed by weightlessness and coldness.Eunuchs have been aware what's going on here, but they are far away.There is not much time for Li Ziming.
text.李自明被封东平王。\\n新皇李渊并无新政，和以前相比唯一不同的地方便是在全国兴建:
Li Ziming is conferred as the King of Dongping.
No new policies are rolled out in the reign of the newly enthroned emperor Li Yuan.The only difference is the rising number of Taoist temples across the nation.As Taoism is promoted in this time, elixir refiners and those who pursue immortal cultivation enjoy a high social status.
It is believed that these elixirs can keep people young forever or empower people to be strong enough.Therefore, there is a craze for it and many people trade these elixirs with their asset and even go bankrupted.
During the year, in order to avoid associating with immortal cultivation, he spent his time with Liu Ting all day.The two were inseparable.If it were not the frequent presence of brothel, there must be rumors that they are gay.
 Having a brief understanding of the nation in the letter written by his father, his desire to take avenge on Li Yuan has gradually turned into a kind of extraordinary "responsibility".
He counts the day appointed with Yao Guang to come.He must stay alive before the approach of that day.
text.李自明本人其实对于当太子这件事是不在乎的。\\n他对自己的评价是：一个很好说话的:
In fact, Li Ziming himself doesn't care about his status.
He believes that he is an easygoing good boy.
Born to be a prince, then do the things that a prince should do; made a crown prince, then behave like a crown prince; required to learn etiquette, then practice well in life what have been taught; placed high expectations, then work hard to acquire knowledge and gain mastery over martial arts.
When he was a kid, he sneaked out his palace for fun for hours on one occasion.When scolded and asked to transcribe essays as punishment after returning, he saw that his entourages were beaten really hard for the sake of dereliction of duty.As a result, whenever he sneaks out he always thoughtfully appears back in the sight of them at the appropriate time from then on.
He believes that while confined in the palace now, he is doing his best without bringing troubles to anyone.
Sometimes he will be visited by Liu Ting.After succeeding to his father's title, Liu Ting looks more presentable than before and is of nearly the same height of Li Ziming.He brings a jar of wine whenever he comes but they always get drunk very soon.
text.李自明大喝一声来人！贴身侍卫持刀剑而入扑向高僧，高僧笑而不避，佛光灿灿，任刀剑砍:
Li Ziming shouts, "Help!” His personal bodyguards with swords and sabers immediately enter the room and rush to attack the monk.The monk, surrounded by Buddha light, smiles without dodging at all and seems unhurt all over.
"Ziming, my young friend, I notice that you have a special connection with our Western religion, so I am here to invite you to join us.But since you have no such an intention, I might as well leave now.” The monk stands up, still smiling, lightly touches Li Ziming's forehead with his hand, and then disappears along with the Buddha light.
Then, Li Ziming falls into a dead faint, and Xiaojiu kneels down and begins crying.
Three days later, he wakes up and learns from Xiaojiu that his lifeblood has been broken by the monk’s one-finger death touch and that he has only a few days left to live.
He accepts the fact with equanimity.He has long known that the only difference between the Western religion and the Southern Li sect is that they have different interests of their own to safeguard.
Divinity, Taoism, and immortality are hard to pursue and should not be pursued.
After all, what is more pleasing is the secular world.
As a result, Li Ziming bans all pursuits of Immortal Ascension in the country and passes the throne to Luo Cheng, son of Luo Yi.
Li Ziming dies later.
text.李自明等人按辔徐行，到城门后出示皇帝召见进京的手谕，守城的官兵竟然说手谕是假的，: Li Ziming and his guards walked slowly with horse bridle at their hands.At the gate he showed the handwritten imperial edict to gain entry.But the gate soldiers should claimed that it was a fake.Pointing to Li's knifes and swords, they viewed Li Ziming as rebels.With an order in place, a great number of archers shot on the gate tower.As a result, Li Ziming was shot dead on site.

text.李自明率领罗家军，沿着皇帝李密当年一往无前的路线进军，却发现事情远没有那么简单。: Li Ziming himself leads the Luo army to march along the same route that Emperor Li Mi marched on in his day, only to find that things are far from simple as expected.Ten years on, the Tatars are no longer just brave and tactless; they have made substantial progress in their military thinking.\nInstead of charging head-on with Li Ziming's forces, the Tatars lead his forces to remote areas by keeping pulling back in line with the strategy brought by their ally Oirats and force them to retreat for lack of provisions.
text.李自明满三岁当天，册封太子。\\n祭天、祭祖、民间免税双年。\\n奉天殿群臣宴罢:
The day when Li Ziming turns 3 years old, he is made the crown prince.
The emperor worships Heaven and ancestors, and orders that civilians are exempted from paying tax for two years.
In the Hall of Heaven Worship where groups of officials and concubines have finished their banquet, the emperor is particularly joyful, and announces to begin immediately his son's one-year-old catch ritual(On a baby’s first birthday, parents will lay out a lot of items on the floor for the child to pick from.It's said that whatever he picks is an indicator of the child's future career.)
In an apricot robe with four dragon patterns, baby Li Ziming is surrounded at the center of the hall.The highest-rank eunuch, glowingly exclaims with evident excitement,"In the right time, begins the ceremony".
Four items carefully selected by imperial astronomer are laid out in front of the prince：seal, sword made of peach wood, horsetail whisk and a pouch embroidered with lotus.
text.李自明请教军中老兵得到了十几种克制骑兵的陷阱，命后方批量制作，并沿着长城内外布置:
Li Ziming is taught by veterans in the army a dozen traps to subdue cavalry, and then orders his troops in the rear to make them in bulk and set up two hidden lines of defence along the Great Wall and beyond.
The unsuspecting Tatars make their usual surprise attack, but lose their ability to manoeuvre before even hitting the Great Wall and are then pursued by Li's reinforcements mustered through beacon fire.
Li Ziming even deliberately places traps along the outer defences of the Wall in a random manner.The Tartars are overjoyed to see that, but only to find that double inner traps and ambushing Li Luo's elite troops await them there after they rush across the Wall.As a result they are almost wiped out.
The Tartars are then distressed to find if they could recognize any traps, then what wait for them behind the Wall are infantries.If they couldn't discover any, there might be bigger traps behind the Wall.They are put into a quandary, having no idea how to handle the situation.

Li Ziming seems to be on the top of the pyramid since he was born.However, behind his high status hides a tragic life which was even doomed the moment he was born.
When he is a just-weaned babbling toddler, he begins to learn etiquette from eunuchs.There are rules for eating, speaking, sitting and walking, and dealing with interpersonal relationship.
One noon, Li Ziming stands in front of the threshold of the Daming Palace which is higher than himself, trying to figure out how to step over it.

After Li Ziming's withdrawal, Tong Kaiyang stepped out from behind the throne and asked Li Yuan whether he should kill Li Ziming immediately.Shaking his head, Li Yuan said, "If Ziming is killed at this moment, my reputation must be damaged.Ziming knew little calculation since childhood.Judging from the answers he gave, i can tell that his personality hasn't been changed.Although he are mad at Li Mi, he is the son of Li Mi.Therefore he has deep affection on him."
"So we won't kill him?", Tong Kaiyang asked.
"No, what i mean is we can kill him next year.", Li Yuan said smilingly.
"I cannot understand how you mortal being think.Why you just handle things hesitantly?", Tong mocked.
Li Yuan just continued his tea drinking with no more words.

text.李自明想到了李渊的浑身本事，想到了文武盖世如父皇在仙人小小手段面前的无能为力，想:
It occurred to Li Ziming that Li Yuan was so strong with the help of these immortal beings, His father could do nothing in face of these immortal beings despite his father's superb Kungfu, and Tang Kaiyang was able to control the weather.
He has persuaded himself with many reasons, such as for the purpose of sustaining the court, making Liu Ting's sacrifice more meaningful.But in the end there is only one though left：'to be immortal' Is there anyone who doesn't want to be so?
He answeres the monk smilingly, "I am longing to build a tie with the religion."
The monk leaves happily, with the "'good indeed, good indeed' echoing around outdoors".
text.李自明一席白衣胜雪，衣服的垂感极好，腰束月白祥云纹的宽腰带，其上挂了一块玉质极佳:
Li Ziming wore a white drapery robe with a broad belt stitched with the white cloud patterns around his waist, hanging down a fine black jade pendant.The shape of the jade looks tough but it is quaint.Li held a flagon in one hand and a glass in the other.He drank on his own.
Liu Ting worn a black clothes with the pattern of flying fish.He looked gentle in the clothes though it was often worn by those who practise martial arts.He sipped his wine.
"You can't drink any more, do you?", asked by Li.He noticed that Liu didn't drink much after he went to the toilet.
Liu answered simperingly, "Li Ziming, no one in the world knows you better than me."
"Why are you being so mushy? Are you trying to borrow money from me?", Li ziming joked.
"You will take your left leg first when you walk, and your left pinkie will crook unconsciously when you are lying.", Liu said.
"You have keen observation, please continue.", Li said while drank another glass of wine.
Liu also drank and continued, "You will raise your right corners of the mouth when you smile, and you wrinkle your left eyebrow lower when you are thinking.You are sympathetic to your enemies' women and children.And you got a strong impulse of killing when you look deadpan."
Li Ziming turned to look at him thoughtfully.
"There are three moles on you body.One is on the bottom of your right foot, and the rest are on the back.You are good at Shaolin Kungfu , and can wield the Wudang Sword, the Storm Pear Blossom Spear .You master a little knowledge of the Xiaoyao Quick Running.", Liu Ting paused a while, and then he unfastened his clothes to bare his chest.He continued, "And i know that you have some pain and itching around your left chest in rainy or cloudy days.That is because your chest were knifed by Tartars .The wound shaped like a crescent, five itches in length."
"Who the hell are you?", Li shouted.Staring at Liu, Li found that Liu born a strong resemblance to Li himself when Liu smiled in the dark night.And his scar was also the same.
"I learned to how to become you at every night when i was a child.What i like most about you is your 'No Why' style.You never ask me any reason about anything.And I even don't have to explain the reason why i always was beaten black and blue.", Liu said and he rubbed his face very hard.Surprisingly he transformed his face into one that was completely the same as Li Ziming.
All of a sudden, L i felt that he was feeble, and he couldn't see the people front him clearly.But he could still hear clearly.He said, "Liu Ting, Are you…"
"I used to think that life was bored, but because of you, i think life is okay.", Liu said.He watched Liu's head gradually falling down.
"It is a pity that we cannot be friends any more."
"I am your shadow."
text.李自明已经做完了一切他想为这个国家和人民做的事情。\\n他完成了父亲的嘱托，为天:
Li Ziming has done everything he wants to do for his country and people.
He has fulfilled his father's wish, fighting to safeguard the security and peace of his country.He has also realized the dream of his late bosom friend, living in glory.
Now, he wants to think about himself.He, weighed down by years of military and political career and ruling of the country, wants a life of his own.And he dosen't want to see his offspring born in the imperial family like him.
Li Ziming comes to the graves of his father and Liu Ting, gives a deep bow, and then leaves.
In 604, Li Ziming abdicates, succeeded by Luo Cheng, son of Luo Yi.From then on, he is nowhere to be found.
text.李自明在北境历练多年，自知鞑靼人野心勃勃，不能养虎为患，披甲上阵御驾亲征，带领罗:
After years of experience in the North, Li Ziming knows that the Tartars are ambitious and that he should not adopt appeasement that brings disasters.Thus, he himself leads Luo Army to launch another expedition against the Tartars.
He adopted a military strategy years ago to deal with the Tatars, namely, buying Tatar war-horses through free trade and making use of them to breed such kind of horses in bulk in his own horse ranches.Now, it proves very successful, as the war-horses of his troops are as strong as that of his enemy.
In addition, his army stationed in the North has been developing such weapons as small crossbows and three-eyed guns and tactics against Tartar cavalry, and equipped with these weapons, the Luo Army is now considered the nemesis of the cavalry.
Not surprisingly, Li's army succeeds again, cutting its enemy to pieces, and this time it does not stop and even continues to hit the territory of the Oirats(another tribe).In the end, the two tribes dare not harry the Central Plains.
However, Li Ziming knows that it is impossible to wipe out these nomads from the grasslands, and he has no idea how many years of peace in the North could be enjoyed in the wake of this battle.
After the war, Li Ziming who feels fatigued, with old injuries flaring up, embarks on a journey back to the capital.
