text.两只猫紧紧盯着李自明，身子压低，后足犹如弹簧一般弓起收缩，身子也抖了起来，让全身:
The cats stare at Li Ziming, their bodies lower, hind feet arch and close like springs, and their bodies begin to shake to relax their muscles and gain momentum.Obviously, they are ready for hunting.
All of a sudden, they pounce on Li Ziming, ejecting like sharp swords on a bow, tearing and biting at Li Ziming.
Hearing the prince's cry, eunuchs hurry to pull away the cats, but just in a few seconds, there have been many wounds and scratches on the his body, and he even begins to froth at the mouth and goes into convulsion.
When the imperial doctors come, Li Ziming is proved dead.They tremblingly report to the emperor that his son has died of excessive fright.
It turns out that Concubine E usually feeds her cats with raw meats or live poultry instead of the livers of lambs or pigs, and always wraps the food with red silk fabrics.
At that time, the two cats have been starved for two days.When seeing Li Ziming who is in red and brisk, they perceive him as a meal.
As the old saying goes, under blossoms and leaves hide thorns, so in the heart of people harbors viciousness.

But Yao Guang doesn't show up all the time.Even his disciple Xiaojiu does not know where he is.Despite the constant investigation and survey, Li Ziming failes to find out Yao's trace.
Until one day a monk who claimes himself as the envoy of the Western Religion pays a visit to Li Ziming.His intention is to build up a relation between the religion and the court.He promises that the religion will protect the descendant of Li if all the people in the country worship the Western Religion.And the immortal cultivation can extend one's life and even be immortal.
The monk tells Li where Yao is："the monk, unemptyness, is believed to be an immortal being in his previous incarnation.He has a deep ties with our religion.We made a promise ten years ago.I promised to help you bring the gang of Nanli Taoists under control.Correspondingly he would be burned into śarīra after ten years later to be placed in the religion."
On hearing half of the conversation, Xiaojiu 's weak body trembles and then he lookes down.
"What do you mean?", asked by Li Ziming, without any expression on his face.
"He has already detached himself from his body and became the śarīra.He has integrated into the Western Religion.Amitabha good indeed, good indeed."
"My master died, the cost of the promise is his death…"，Xiaojiu whispered in Li's ear in a broken voice.

Mr Liu's full name is Liu Huaiyu.He has only one daughter, and he named his daughter as Qiong Ying in memory of his wife whose surname is also Qiong.Liu runs a well-off family by selling his lyric composition and paintings.
Qiong Ying is very weak since she was born.She took various herbs and medicines before the age of two.
At the age of three, her mother died of illness.But since then, she became healthy.His father's mental health fluctuates widely.Sometime she even needs to take care of her father.
When Qiong was very young, she showed her extraordinary talent in calligraphy and painting.With her father's guidance, she could integrate what she had learned together.However, women are not allowed to take the imperial examination.
Qiong is able to read the Book of Family Names at three years old, recite long articles at four years old, write essays containing three thousand characters at the age of five,and able to compose poems easily.Despite all of these outstanding achievements, she is still not allowed to take the examination.
Her neighbor Mr.Wang has a dumb son.Qiong Ying thought the dumb son is superior to her.
The reason why an eight-year-old girl desires to take the exam lies in that she believed that to pass the exam is her father's lifelong aspiration.If she can fulfill her father's dream, he will recover from the current insanity.
Now as the one-year-held provincial examination is approaching, Qiong Ying disguised herself to be a male scholar.Her appearance, figure and voice are similar to man.She even devised a fake laryngeal protuberance for herself.Even her father who is drunk cannot tell who she is.

text.陆沉兜兜转转带琼英来到后山试炼谷。\\n刚进谷，琼英便感觉到前边有一股不同寻常的:
After going round and round, Lu Chen led Qiong Ying to the Training Valley behind the mountain.
When they entered into the Valley, she found that there was extremely cold and bleak.At the same time, she smelt an elusive whiff of blood.
Lu Chen also realized that.He just planed to show Qiong to a random place initially, but what they meet now was out of his expectation.
He was going to apologize to Qiong Ying, because there was dangerous, and they should go back right now.But he saw Qiong Ying was staring at his back, and told him to move to her back seriously.
Lu Chen turned back and he was nearly scared to death.He saw a man hanging in the air in his back.The man's face was completely pale.
Lu Chen stood still for a while, but the man did nothing and without any action.Lu Chen thought his behavior was a shame, and he knew the senior disciple Qiong Ying would protect him.So he picked up a stone and threw it to the man.
The stone hit the man and bounced back on the ground.So the man noticed both of them.
Qiong Ying felt frustrated about what Lu Chen had done.Because finally she recalled that the strange smell generated from the man was the same as that of one from the ghost cultivator described in the books.
At the time when Qiong Ying realized, the man also moved.With a gentle waving of hand, a gale of bleak wind blew to them.Qiong Ying held Lu Chen to dodge.She asked Lu to inform their master what happened, but Lu was too scared to lift his feet.When Qiong's brain was working fast to figure out how to respond, she grabbed the hierogram of mind purity which was carved during her base building period.She had carried the hierogrom along with her all the time.
The hierogram has the effect of mind clearance.So she activated the hierogram in no time.But the man just stopped, and his pale face became clear.He said, "This is ……the hierogram of mind purity."
Then the man returned to himself and said to Qiong, "I am not the ghost cultivator.I am the primordial spirit of immortal cultivators.Don't be afraid."
However, Qiong Ying said, "Bullshit, all primordial spirit are young girls.Are you a young girl?" After saying that, she held the wooden blade and stood in front of Lu Chen to protect him.
Realizing that Qiong Ying was doubtful about his words, he bent down to pick up the stone thrown by Lu Chen before.
On seeing that, Qiong Ying was surprised, because she knew that an ordinary ghost cultivator could not touch a physical material.Since the man could pick up the stone, he must be a real primordial spirit of a particular immortal cultivator.After a while, she dropped her wooden blade.After all, whether his words were true or not, both of them didn't have the chance to win because only immortal cultivators above initial being stage can cultivate the primordial spirit.
"I am Li Ziming from the Penglai Island.In fact, i met your master before." The man said, and he was a little absent minded."About a hundred years ago, i was plotted by the Ghost Evil, so my primordial spirit was locked in the Blood-Soul Box.Luckily it was not completely refined to nothing, and escaped from the Box.But due to the over a hundred years of locking, i lost my mind, and i even forget who I am.Thanks to the hierogram of mind purity, could you please give it to me?"
text.陆沉勘察了一番，找到了阵眼最为薄弱的地方。\\n大师兄首当其冲，陆沉和琼英分列左:
After a careful observation, Lu Chen spotted the weakest spot of the formation.
The eldest brother rushed ahead firstly, and then Qiong Ying and Lu Chen lined next to him.The three got concentrated and mobilized all their celestial energy to have a strike.
The white, black and red lights concentrated on the place marked by Lu Chen at the same time.The fierce shock made the ground shake.Then there were cracks on the struck place and these cracks grew wider.In the end, the whole formation collapsed.The three appeared in the outside world.
The three people from the Springsun Sect stood there, while the three people from decent sects died in a piece of blood.
Zhang Junhong stood up and clapped his hand.He said, "Hahahaha.Disciples from the Springsun Sect are excellent.The three seniors from decent sects are defeated.But you three are so ruthless that you kill them."
text.陆沉评估了以力破阵的风险极大，最终大家放弃了以力破阵，于是纷纷寻找阵眼。\\n琼:
A careful evaluation of the formation revealed that it was risky to break it by force.So they gave up the idea.They chose the second method to find out the eye of the formation.
It occurred to Qiong Ying that she read the formation once in scripture garret."Since the formation could absorb these celestial energy, why don't drain out all these people and absorb these energy slowly? The celestial energy……then absorbed, and ……was transformed to the formation creator? Oh, i got an idea!" Qiong Ying thought to herself.
"Listen to me!" Qiong Ying spoke out, which drew the public attention."I got an idea! But it is a little bit risky.I don't know whether you want to have a try.I once read the principle of the formation in scripture garret.These celestial energy absorbed from our body need the formation creator to transform slowly, and use medicine to help enhance his level.Otherwise, such a behavior will lead to heaven doom.Let's transport our celestial energy to him voluntarily.He could not take all these energy in a short time, so heaven doom will ensue.How about your opinion?” Qiong Ying asked.
People under the stage began to discuss the suggestion.Several senior cultivators nodded their heads, and some people who had some knowledge about formation also supported her idea.So they agreed to transport 80 % of their celestial energy to the formation.
Three, two, one.As the order in place, the huge celestial energy were transported into the formation.All of a sudden, a gust of gale blew in.The sky was clouted with dark clouds.It was true that the thunder was about to come.
text.陆掌门对弟子一概放养，门内更是连门规都没有。只是嘱咐他们不要作奸犯科走上歪门邪道:
The Sect Leader Lu did not pay much attention to disciples' behavior and even no regulation was set for them.Those disciples were instructed not to commit illegal acts.As for immortal cultivation, they were forced to cultivate themselves in the morning.In the afternoon, they were free to do things they like.
On the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month, after their morning classes, their master asked them to stay.Lu Chen asked whether they stayed to eat moon cake.But the master beaten his head.
Their master brought the prepared wood and carving knife, and said to disciples, "today, i will teach you how to carve a hierogram.One should use a board and a carving knife.If one is a master, he can carve a hierogram on a gold with his fingers.And the effect of the hierogram is various.The stronger effect requires more sophisticated carving skills."
Qiong Ying was looking forward to it, and this time even Lu Chen showed great interest on it.He just sat there quietly to wait his master's performance.
"En, Qiong Ying and Xiaochen, you two are not allowed to learn this yet.The prerequisite for hierogram carving is to be an immortal first, or is called base building.Later i will ask your eldest principle to present it to you.You two watch it careful, which may be useful for base building."
Qiong Ying had read book before, so she knew that base building is a hallmark of immortal cultivation for a beginner, and it is a ceremony for officially being an immortal.Base building refers to one's personal understanding of the way of everything in the world.Moreover, it is a ceremony that requires luck and talent.Since different people have different interpretations towards immortal cultivation, everyone has different ways of being an immortal.It is said that a genius finished base building at the age of eight, while someone didn't finish it in his whole life.
The process of the eldest principle's presentation can be summarized into one word：dawdling.
He complained about the uncomfortable seat, or the hot weather.Then he realized that he could not dawdle any more, so he unwillingly held the knife.
The previous languid eldest principle was mighty.And he scrawled quickly.In no time a hierogram finished.The sweat pored from his forehead, which indicated that it was not an easy job.
The Sect Leader patted on his shoulder satisfactorily, but the eldest disciple just dodged his pat.The leader didn't care it, and he took the hierogram carved by eldest disciple and crumbed it.All of a sudden, the yard was covered by a wave of coolness.Then their master began to introduce：
"This is a hierogram of coolness that can be used to beat the heat.Let us give a round of applause to your eldest principle." On hearing that, the eldest principle did not raise his head.Instead he just rushed to take a shower.
There was a strong desire in Qiong's small eyes.Suddenly Qiong felt that she was surrounded by a strong wave of celestial energy.So she wanted to have a try.

text.罗氏王朝始于200年前李自明禅让皇位，开朝皇帝罗成文治武功，后世皇帝励精图治爱民:
As early as two hundred years ago when Li Ziming abdicated his throne to Luo Cheng, the Luo family reigned Imperial court came into being.The founding Emperor Luo Cheng was a high achiever in political and military field.And succeeded Emperors also make every efforts to pursue prosperity for the country.As a result, the Dynasty remains thriving all the time without any sign of decline.
Although most of policies implemented during the reign of Li Ziming are passed down, the single one, the prohibition of immortal cultivation, is abolished due to force majeure.
Five hundred years later after the catastrophe of the Immortal Cultivation Community, the shortage of celestial spirit resulted from the shock of the Fight between Immortals and Demons gradually recovered.And some immortal cultivators who survived from the fight began to establish new sects, thus new immortal cultivators emerging gradually.
During the chaos of the Li Dynasty, the immortal cultivation was not widely spread.But after the founding of the Luo Dynasty, the longevity and the immortal power are a great appeal to ordinary people.Therefore a great number of private immortal cultivators emerged and they were protected by different sects.The even the constant ban of the imperial court could not curb it.
Different immortal cultivation sects fought against each other.The Monster Cultivation reappeared in southern Shu region.And the Demon Cultivation in the south of the country waged rebellion.It seemed that a world of chaos was about to approach.
In 719, the Luo Dynasty realized it was better to recognize it than to ban it.So the Star-Picking Pavilion was reopened.And the imperial court recruited immortal cultivators.In doing so, the court aimed to make a balance in the world.
In 811, the eighth Emperor Luo Chong ascended to the throne.The world was relatively peace.

text.没有爆竹声声辞旧岁，却仍是锣鼓阵阵新年来。\\n商朝的春节是十二月初一，恰逢冬雪:
There are no firecrackers but are still gongs and drums to ring out the old year and ring in the new.
The Chinese Spring Festival in the Shang Dynasty falls on the first day of December on lunar calendar, when the first flakes of snow showers come.The Qi's reaps a bumper harvest this year, with only 70% of the grain harvested given to the owner of manor, leaving the family with a great deal of surplus grain.Firewood has also been stocked up in fall.Whenever having some cheap wine, Qi Yun will be held in the arms of his father and kissed.
The time traveler, Qi Yun is endowed with some supernatural abilities.For instance, he is able to automatically analyze in his brain matters of ancient China such as characters and daily things that have references available in modern China, and he can also both understand and speak various dialects, so if he could travel back in modern time, he would be an expert in oracle bones.
But Qi Yun soon realizes that this skill is rather useless, because he is now in the Shang Dynasty, when written language is still in its infancy and literature has not yet really been created.It makes no sense that he is quite familiar with poetry and miscellaneous rhapsodies since no one can understand.
When his father falls asleep drunk, Qi Yun cautiously gets out from his arms, in the fear of waking him up and being caught back to him.
It is snowing outside, but the weather is fine, not too cold.Qi Yun dressed in many clothes makes his way out and wanders about slowly along the village paths.Without electronic devices, the boy returns to nature to have fun.
At the east end of the village, stands an old pagoda tree with a breath equivalent to about twenty arms' length, a playground for Qi Yun, but today it has been already occupied by someone else.
Under the tree is a stone Go table and two stone piers, with two old men pitted against each other.
Go? .....it was already created in this time, but I do not know how to play it, hey.Qi Yun heaves a sign quietly, how come protagonists in time-travel novels know everything?

text.没有心情用餐，跑到后院马厩，牵出坐骑，径直离开小镇，前往京都仪銮府。\\n由于你:
Not in the mood for a meal, you lead your horse out from the backyard stable and leave the town directly for the Yiluan government office in the capital.
As the son of the Xing family, you seldom come across obstacles in your journey and successfully meet Dongfang Qing, the head of the office.
You give a detailed account of what happened in the town and, having held out till now, you feel exhausted and have a splitting headache.
Dongfang Qing sees a faint flash of blood flashing across your forehead and comes up to grab your wrist.You feel a stream of air running through your body.
"My Lord, what is this?" You ask.
"You have been invaded by an evil spirit.I can only seal it temporarily with my limited power."
"What should I do then" you are terrified, face growing pale.
"There is nothing we mortals can do about it.We shall turn to the immortals for help."said Dongfang Qing.
"My Lord, are there really immortals in this world" you ask excitingly.
"Yes, that soul-soothing incense in your arms is the very stuff of immortals.It is said that immortals can soar high into the sky and cut down their enemies with flying swords, and those who are powerful enough can even move mountains to reclaim land from the sea." the official answers.
You touch the incense, and then bid farewell to Dongfang Qing with a feeling of apprehension.

In facing of the extremely disappointed Tianpeng, Bukong cast a spell of "coming".Then the grass-chewing White Horse appeared in the yard from nowhere.The horse was confounded.
"I don't care what happened to you before, or what i have done before.I just want to do something i want." Bukong pointed to the White Horse and turned the horse into a young man who was handsome.
When casting a spell, Bukong pointed to the pig monster and the young man turned from White Horse with one hand, and pointed to the lady in sound sleep with the other.He cast a spell of "Marriage Dream".As a result, the lady had a dream and burst into tears.
"Finished." The system prompted in a perfunctory way.
"Let's go, White Horse.It is done!" It seemed that Bukong was in high spirit.
"Frozen!" Bukong stopped all these approaching NPCs from Gao Village.It seems that he doesn't want his good mood to be interrupted."
The horse asked, "How do you solve it?"
"Just a lady's longing for love.I sent you and the pig monster into her dream, and made you two a couple of the same sex.She believed what she saw, so she gave up.And she gave her sincere wishes to you two." Bukong said gently.
"Fuck you!" The White Horse's curses turned into neigh as the human body turned into a horse.
"Tianpeng, you did nothing wrong.Hahahahaha.Good Indeed, Good Indeed." Bukong and the White Horse continued their journey westward.

Nezha rushes into the battlefield and snatches Huang Tianhua's corpse back to Xiqi.Before anyone could lament, a boy pays a visit to Jiang Ziya and carries Huang Tianhua's corpse back to the Purple Sun Cave.Over there, Huang Tianhua takes a pill under the help of his master and in a quarter of an hour comes back to life.
Having been scolded by his master and given another magic treasure, he is asked to hurry back to Xiqi and help.Huang Tianhua dares not to delay and embarks on his journey the moment he receives the treasure.
In less than two hours, he arrives in Xiqi again.Jiang Ziya is already used to surprises like this.Joyfully, anyway, he leads his troops out of the city again to challenge the four generals.The four, seeing Huang Tianhua resurrected, feel really confused and fear that he would open his mouth and say, 'Dormammu, I've come to bargain'.
Mo Liqing duels against him immediately.After a couple of rounds of battles, Huang Tianhua pretends to be overpowered and flees, and then, he turns around quickly and hits the heart of Mo Liqing who’s pursuing him with his Heart Penetrating Nails given by his master, bringing his adversary’s life to an end.
Seeing his brother’s death, Mo Lihong charges at Huang Tianhua but is killed by a blow hitting his heart too.
Having witnessed everything, Mo Lihai rushes to the frontline to take revenge but also ends up being finished off by Huang Tianhua with the same nail.
Furious Mo Lishou sends his pet out from his bag which is actually Yang Jian in disguise, but never suspected that he would be taken a bite by it.Seized by a fierce pang of pain, he is beheaded by Huang Tianhua with a single blow.
After the four demon generals are killed, Zhao Ge, or Shang Army, falls into disorder, and the Zhou Army advances.As Jiang Ziya dispatches his superior men such as Nezha who have respective strengths, Shang Army is put to rout, suffering a heavy casualty.
Qi Yun watches everything from afar and uses his technique to recognize Huang Tianhua's Heart Penetrating Nails.As far as he knows, there are few nails among magic treasures in the novel, if any, they always have power beyond imagination.
Leizhenzi has been staring off into space for half a day, and now he opens his mouth, asking, "Is it a coincidence that Jiang Ziya, Huang Tianhua, and Huang Feihu who were all killed but brought back to life soon, while those of the Shang Army really died?"
Qi Yun gets stumped by the question.Looking at Leizhenzi's childish face, he fails to give a reply at once.

text.祁云对着云中子有模有样的作了一个道家的揖手，奶里奶气的说道：“懂也非懂”。\\n:
Qi Yun makes a Taoist bow to Yunzhongzi and says with a child tone, "Yes, I do, and no, I don't".
Looking at the adorable kid, Yunzhongzi presumes that his family elders may be believers of Human sect and continues asking, "What do you mean?"
Qi Yun replies, "The earth is a chessboard and people are Go pieces.Though I don't understand the very Go game you are playing, I am myself also part of a another Go game."
Yunzhongzi asks seriously, "If the earth is a chessboard and men are pieces, who are players?"
Qi Yun steps forward with one foot, with one hand behind his back, and points at the sky.
"Hahahahahaha, it is immortal who plays.Great." the old man in Confucian robe, Bi Gan, bursts into laughter and drops a black piece, shouting, "You have lost, Brother Yun."
Smiling a smile, Yunzhongzi does not grow upset due to his losing of the game, but looks at Qi Yun sideways.He seems to become interested in the gifted boy.
Gazing at Qi Yun, he holds a manual in his hand, and begins to say spells and predict the fate of Qi Yun.After finishing his work, he scowls heavily.
"It is strange! It is strange! You have more than a dozen different fates, either fortunately ascending to immortality, or miserably dying on the streets, and all of them are clear but hard to trace." Yunzhongzi says to Qi Yun, "I wonder if you would like to follow me to become a cultivator?"
Qi Yun thinks to himself, Well, here is the chance.It seems that striking up a conversation works.To his knowledge, Yunzhongzi is among the few who stress benevolence and righteousness and are very kind, though he is not among the top in Chan sect.
What's more, his goodness will beget good ending, as he will survive the later Jiuqu Yellow River Array.He can be regarded as an immortal of fortune and virtue.If this world is really the backdrop where the creation the gods occurs, then what is the most important is to survive.Therefore, Yunzhongzi can be a dependable master who has three fundamental values consistent with his and will not fool him.
Thinking of this Qi Yun immediately kneels down and kowtows three times and says, "Your Excellency is a man of great fortune and virtue, and it is my great honor to become your disciple.Master, please accept my obeisances."
The master nods in satisfaction and immediately follows Qi Yun home hand in hand with him after biding goodbye to Bi Gan and then explains to his parents the situation.Hearing that, his parents are sad but overjoyed, and then urges Qi Yun to cultivate seriously under the guidance of his master and not to be lazy in his training.
Qi Yun believes now that Yunzhongzi is a good person, compared with other immortals who always take children away directly like human trafficking when they accept disciples, and then years later send those kids to rescue their parents in troubles whom have believed that their kids had been missing.This makes the parents hold gratitude toward the immortals, but such behavior is actually really improper.

And when Bi Gan knows that Qi Yun can read and write, he likes him even more and accepts him as a student, which is greatly appreciated by the boy.
However, a storm may arise from a clear sky, while human fortunes are as unpredictable as the weather.A plague breaks out on the estate later the year, and Qi's family dies.

Qi Yun remembers that in the book, Luya also fights with Kong Xuan but is defeated and flees, so he wonders if there's a need for him to go through the motions.
But he doesn't know that only when he employs Seven-Rainbow Light Technique to escape can he be spared from Kong's light.
Dueling recklessly against his adversary, Qi Yun is on the point of escaping with one of the Five-Element escaping techniques, when Kong Xuan catches him with the help of his magical light.
Qi Yun feels that he has been placed in a strange space, the inner world of the five rays of light, to which he does not belong.Imprisoned inside for just a while, he becomes suffocated.And when he is released from the world, he's been dead.
text.祁云觉得自己打也打不过赵公明，谈也谈不拢，所幸挂机混日子。\\n由于对扎小人日思:
No match for Zhao Gongming and having no room for negotiation, Qi Yun can only sit and idle away his time.
One night when Jiang Ziya who ages and subjects to a low-quality sleep gets up for the toilet, he hears Qi Yun who’s been thinking about “straw effigy” days and nights murmuring in his dream in the room, "straw effigy, straw effigy", which reminds him of unorthodox ways that might work.
Coming back to his room, Jiang Ziya devotes himself to reading all manner of books for three days, and finally finds out a spell in a book.
Then he brings immortals of Chan sect together for deliberation of the mean, and all give approval.
The prime minister soon follows the instructions to cast a curse against Zhao Gongming.Zhao Gongming, who’s been challenging his enemy for days but gained no answers, begins to feel a bit unwell one day.After a moment’s reflection, he realizes he is inflicted on a curse, a terrifying one that might be fatal, which can be negated only when the initiator is killed or the straw effigy destroyed.As his health goes from bad to worse, he dispatches his subordinates Chen Jiugong and Yao Shaosi to annihilate the man or the object, but the two end up being killed by Nezha and Yang Jian.Zhao Gongming himself also dies from the curse and is appointed as a god.
At the victory banquet, when the crowd ask Jiang Ziya how he came up with this good idea, Ziya humbly says, "I was watching stars in the sky that night, when I heard Luya murmuring in his sleep about straw effigy.Then I hurried to look for it and found a spell related to it in a book.” what ensues is a chorus of praise.
When repeated more than twice, a rumor becomes true.Since Luya, also as Qi Yun, has a mystical background and style of behavior which tend to be constituents of interesting stories people like, people begin to hail that "Luya instructed Jiang Ziya to build a straw effigy of Zhao Gongming which causes him to death".
When Qi Yun hears the rumor, Zhao Gongming has already been dead for a few days.He can't help sighing：don't believe in rumours, nor spread them.
text.祁云看到这里，默默的收回神识退出了直播间。\\n后面的事一如书上写的那样，女娲回:
When Qi Yun sees this, he quietly draws back his mind sense and exits the live broadcast.
What follows is as written in the book:Nüwa flies into a fury when she returns to the palace and sees the poem and wants to immediately kill King Zhou.But after all, King Zhou, the king on earth, is destined to rule his kingdom for another twenty-eight years, and therefore Nüwa begins to plan her female revenge after calming down.
At her palace where the demon-recruiting streamers rise, which brings soughing wind, heavy mist and devil wind in an overcast sky, all devils and demons in the world are gathering and kneeling down in front of the Goddess.
Ordinary demons leave after a command from her, but the three spirits of Xuanyuan grave are asked to stay to follow instructions.
These three spirits include the thousand-year-old vixen, the nine-headed pheasant and the jade Pipa.They are asked to enter the palace of King Zhou of Shang Dynasty to bewitch him, and none of them dare to reject.
As a liberal arts student, Qi Yun was also an aspiring young man for a number of years who loved cultures and arts, though an idiot in the eyes of others.Although he was reduced to an ordinary youth after stepping into society, the affective thinking in his bones was only hidden rather than dead.
At this moment, in addition to his curiosity in the man who sets the wheels of history back in place, he deeply feels angry and sad about the misunderstanding of a man's deep feelings.
text.祁云料想原著如此，自己既然成了陆压，还是得遵从结果原则，于是一剑取了白天君姓名。: Qi Yun kills Bai Li with a single slash of sword in line with the result in the book since he is now Luya.\nWith the Blazing-Flame Battle Formation broken, Xiqi wins a landslide victory.
text.祁云亲自经历了数场大战，从初上战场的震撼到尸横遍野的残酷，他才明白那句话，马革裹:
Qi Yun has personally witnessed several great battles.At first he just felt shocked, and then he realizes how cruel war is, and only then does he understand the saying that to die on the battlefield is not heroic but sad.
Leaders of Chan sect who are merciless and see all humans as worthless things, manipulate the whole process of creation of the gods at will, leading a huge number of ordinary men and cultivators to lose their life.And unfortunately, the dead were in the dark about everything, and thought that they were killing in wars, on behalf of the way of heaven and justice.
When it comes to Jie sect, Qi Yun feels sympathetic and sorry for Zhang Guifang, who would probably have been a good friend of his if they did not meet on the battlefield.More than anything else, he feels baffled as he did when he read the novel：instead of ordering or forbidding them or getting intervened like Lao Jun or Yuanshi did, why does Tongtian Jiaozhu just remind his disciples not to leave their sect as they please, since he knows about the plan of god creation?
Suddenly, he hears a reverberant "Amitabha", and looking up, he finds that he is surrounded by a complete white.What's the matter? A daydream?
“My young friend, I notice that you have a special connection with our Western religion, so I am here to invite you to join us.” the voice continues.Looking up, Qi Yun sees a man dressed as a Buddhist monk and on a flamboyant lotus flower descending from the sky.The line is so familiar to him that he instantly knows who he is.After wielding his technique, he is sure enough.
Name：Zhunti
Strength：???
Profile：a heavenly saint coming from the remote Western Heaven, the land of Buddha, the second leader of the Western religion in the faith of Pure land, a Mixed Yuan Da Luo Golden Immortal.
While giving an obeisance to Quanti, Qi Yun ponders, the man shouldn't be here now.Does the plot of the story change because of him, or the results will be the same as written in the book even with different processes?
Before Qi Yun could say anything, Zhunti speaks first, "I have been observing you for a long time.You are not linked with karma, you have no past, and your future is beyond prediction.You seem to have the skill to foresee things that have not yet happened; though a member of Chan sect, you still extended a helpful hand to Zhang Guifang.I've never seen a man like you before, and I wonder if you would like to join our Western religion or not?"
Qi Yun looks nonplussed, since the master before him, whose rank is equal with Yuanshi Tianzun and Taishang Laojun from the East, has not only secretly observed him for a long time, but also seen through him in some ways.
"My...my fellow Daoist priest, may I know what prompts you to leave the heaven and come here?" Qi Yun decides to play the fool first.
"My young friend, stop kidding me.You, a highly skilled man, must know who I am.I just wonder if you have the intention of joining our Western religion and join hands with us to start a business?", says Zhunti amiably.
Qi Yun tries to contact his master with his magic art, but finds he is in a world which seems to be cut off from the real world by something.As Zhunti puts on a look indicating he sees through everything, Qi Yun feels at a loss, finding it's hard to give an answer.

text.祁云上了终南山玉柱洞，此时雷震子还未入到云中子门下，他就成了嫡传。\\n这一年里:
Qi Yun goes to Jade Column Cave atop Mount South End when Leizhenzi has yet to become a disciple of Yunzhongzi, so he is direct lineal disciple.
During the first year, he has made some progress and also figured out why immortals like to set up their dwellings in some strange places, because they are simply the places most rich in spiritual energy in the world.
After he learns the basic method of Breathing Exercises, namely expelling the turbid Qi within the body and drawing in the Qi of the natural world, spiritual energy surrounding Mount South End begins to enter his body automatically and continuously, so even when he is eating and sleeping his cultivation base grows.As a result, he feels like he is playing an idle game that is over-popular on the market in modern time and gaining currency and leveling up by merely clicking on the screen repeatedly.
In the context of the creation of the gods, it is considered late for a boy like Qi Yun to get initiated in the cultivation world at the age of 5, because in contrast, Leizhenzi begins at the age of 1, and some starts even when they are still in their mother's womb.Qi Yun used to grumble about this setting in games before time-traveling, but now it seems it is interesting to level up through merely repeated clicks on the screen.Then he cannot help praising the game, saying, idle games are so interesting, come and play infinite immortality with me.Eh? It is strange, why I would suddenly come up with such a line?
In addition to cultivating, Qi Yun also asks his master about people and things in the cultivation world, and he feels relieved after learning that their stories are basically consistent with the plots of Creation of the Gods with which he is familiar.
For the time being...it is the 6th year under the reign of King Zhou, and the ensuing year is the time for the story of King Zhou dallying with the Goddess Nuwa.With the idea that only he knows well the main plot of the whole story can he survive, Qi Yun has learned a magical art which helps him see what's happening in the mortal world from Yunzhongzi on the pretext that he misses and wants to see his parents.
The art is not difficult to learn, but to apply it with ease is hard because it requires a mental chanting of a target's geographical location, a possess similar to that of Baidu map.But it can not be more useful to Qi Yun, as he knows the exact time and place of the great events of the story by heart.
text.祁云上山转眼已经是第7年了，除了日常偷窥，其他时间都在勤勤恳恳跟随师父学习道术，:
It’ s been the 7th year since Qi Yun cultivated on the mountain.In addition to watching the mortal world everyday, he devotes the rest of his time to diligently following his master to learn the Daoist magical arts.He is good in nature, and always sees eye to eye with his master.As a result, his master is very fond of him, and even wants to present him with all his magic treasures.
What Qi Yun takes is only a monster-revealing mirror, which is used to conceal his identification skill.As for important weapons of main plot like Gold Stick and the Stick of the God of Fire, he dares not to accept.But the more non-greedy Qi Yun is, the more his master likes him, and he is even taught by his master the skill of creating weapons.
Qi Yun is amazed to find that the skill is really remarkable.It is so useful that as long as one grasps the principle and structure of other’s magic treasure, he would be able to create an imitation.And the effect of this imitation depends on its material chosen, which means that if the material is better than the original, an imitation that exceeds the original can be made.
Indeed this skill is amazing, but to apply it is a problem, since no one will make public the principle and structure of his magic treasures.Besides, it is easily criticised by others, so Yunzhongzi usually just uses it to create some talismans and other things in bulk.
But for Qi Yun, it is of great use, because when he tries to apply his intrinsic system identification skill to his monster-revealing mirror, surprisingly he is able to gain insight into its principle and structure, and he is ...shameless, who doesn't care what others think of him and what he cares about is only his own life.
Then the next crux is about raw materials.It is true that in the cultivation world things important are wealth, partners, methods and cultivation places, among which what ranks first is wealth.One can't make bricks without straw.As a result, Yunzhongzi is aware that his disciple begins to become greedy for money ...But he doesn't take it seriously, because after all, he is satisfied with him overall.
text.祁云思来想去，雷震子在原著中结果上没有出意外，自然就不会有意外，故选择静观其变。:
On second thoughts, Qi Yun decides to wait and see, since he knows that Leizhenzi would probably be spared from accidents as written in the book.
The three enter the formation.King Wu, though has Leizhenzi and Nezha as guards, is killed by Zhang Shao with whirling red sand.Both Nezha and Leizhenzi fall into a faint, severely injured.
Nanji Xianweng has already figured out how to break the formation while he's outside, and after he gets into it, he burns the red sand with blaze given out by his magical fan.An immortal of fortune and virtue, he hesitates to kill, and sends a boy atop a white crane to hit Zhang Shao with Jade Ruyi Scepter and slay him with a single slash of sword.
As the formation is destroyed, Nezha and Leizhenzi are rescued and King Wu is resurrected, which is to the satisfaction of all.
text.祁云思来想去也放心不下雷震子，但是自己出手的话恐怕会影响太大，于是将雷震子传音喊:
Qi Yun couldn't help worrying about Leizhenzi, and considering his involvement might bring noticeable impacts, he calls Leizhenzi over through voice transmission art.
He has copied all the magic tools of the Chan immortals while they are managing to spoil the battle formations.Though not first-class in raw materials, the imitations are huge in number.
Qi Yun flings the pirated copies of auspicious clouds, eight trigrams immortal robe, seven-coloured lotus seat and other defensive magic treasures into Leizhenzi's arms, and tells him to be safe, not trying to be a hero; if asked where he got these tools, he must say they are granted by his master.Leizhenzi keeps nodding gigglingly.
The three enter the formation.King Wu, though has Leizhenzi and Nezha as guards, is killed by Zhang Shao with whirling red sand.Both Nezha and Leizhenzi fall into a faint but the former is severely injured, while the latter is unscathed with the help of defensive magic treasures.
Nanji Xianweng has already figured out how to break the formation while he’s outside, and after he gets into it, he burns the red sand with blaze given out by his magical fan.An immortal of fortune and virtue, he hesitates to kill, and sends a boy atop a white crane to hit Zhang Shao with Jade Ruyi Scepter and slay him with a single slash of sword.
As the formation is destroyed, Nezha and Leizhenzi are rescued and King Wu is resurrected, which is to the satisfaction of all.
text.祁云思量再三，把自己在女娲宫的见闻，以及自己对这个局的了解用猜测得出的口吻都说给:
Qi Yun thinks twice and decides to tell his master what he saw in Nüwa Palace and his conjecture about the scheme.
Yunzhongzi feels shocked after knowing everything and Qi Yun wonders if this is a blow too great for his upright and honest master.
Just as Qi Yun is worried whether he can accept the truth or not, Yunzhongzi rises in anger with hand-seals.He wants to shed light on the truth in the world of cultivation.
At the eight-view palace of the Xuandu cave in Da Luo mountain, Daode Tianzun, who seems to be refreshing his spirit by closing his eyes, is in fact constantly performing divination.Slowly opening his eyes and heaving a sigh, he feels pitiful for the two skilled men.After hesitating for a while, he arrives at the gate of Yunzhongzi's cave with a wave of his hand, and in just one breath destroys the whole Jade Column Cave by activating his Diagram of the Utmost Extremes, together with Yunzhongzi filled with indignation and Qi Yun who is just aware of something wrong.
It is often said that the way of heaven can not go against, but what is the way of heaven? Perhaps it is the rule set by power holders.
text.祁云思量再三，决定沉默是金，倒不是信不过自己的师父，而是太信得过了，他觉得师父一:
On second thoughts, Qi Yun decides not to tell his master anything.He knows too well his master, whom would definitely make the inside story known to the world once he knows about it, and there is no telling what the consequences would be.Therefore, he might as well work hard to gain mastery over magical arts to protect him quietly.
The moment Qi Yun makes this decision, Yunzhongzi notices that one of dozen different lifelines of Qi Yun dims, following several that already dimmed in the past two years.He himself doesn't know why.And in managing to foresee his future, what he sees is still in a state of chaos, so he can not help worrying about his disciple.
What an amiable teacher and a filial apprentice they are.
Daji is a qualified fox spirit who, in one year, has wrecked the Shang Dynasty's fortunes.
She develops a cruel torture to tie Mei Bo(the Number One Grand Counselor to King Zhou) to a bronze pillar heated with charcoal fire, causing him to burn to death.
She schemes against and kills Empress Jiang and drives her two sons away.
She bewitches the king to kill the Counts of the East and the South and imprison Ji Chang the Count of the West in Zhao Ge, leading the lords across the country to launch rebellions.
She forces Shang Rong to bang his head against a column at the court to death, and subjects Zhao Qi to a cruel torture, thus deterring anyone from remonstrating and bringing about the near collapse of the great Shang Dynasty.
text.祁云思量再三还是决定告诉师父云中子事情的前因后果，他事先准备好了一番说辞和铺垫，:
Qi Yun decides to tell his master Yunzhongzi what happened before and sets up a plan of how to put it beforehand.After knowing everything, Yunzhongzi who knows that the way of heaven is irreversible, remains calm, but tells Qi Yun to leave him alone for a while.
After thinking about it all day, Yunzhongzi, though as part of the Chan sect, still can not figure out why his master and brothers would have such a plan, so he simply goes to ask his master Yuanshi Tianzun in person.
When Yuanshi Tianzun felt the mind sense from Jade Column Cave as King Zhou insulted Nüwa by writing an erotic poem to her, he thought that it belonged to Yunzhongzi whom may have been told the inside story by his brothers.But until now he finds that Yunzhongzi knows nothing about it.Then, he bursts into a very heated argument with his disciple, but fails to convince him and can only ask him to leave.
After this argument, Yuanshi realizes that Yunzhongzi would not agree with him in any way, so he kills him, and Qi Yun whose mind is seen through, is wiped out too by his world-beating magical power.
text.祁云虽然对阐教众人有所不齿，但也知道大势所趋天命难违，自己如果加入截教，虽然心里: Qi Yun holds disdain against Chan sect, but he also knows that it is better to follow the order of heaven.He will feel glad if he joins Jie sect, but he might be put at risk of being killed, and worstly, destroyed to smokes and ashes.As a result, he decides to take sides in Jiang Ziya(Chan sect) along with Leizhenzi.\nBut here comes the problem.To his knowledge, basically all junior disciples of Chan sect are also killed in the war, and to avoid this he must find a way to become a direct lineal disciple of the sect.But he does not know what will happen if he, who should not exist in the sect, becomes one of its direct lineal disciples.\nWhen he arrives in Xiqi, Qi Yun gets caught in another moment of hesitation.
text.祁云虽然想过遵从原著，但是实在是下不去手，只是困住白天君，让他散去阵法，便出阵。:
Although Qi Yun wants to kill Bai Li in line with the plot of the novel, he really can't do it but to trap him with his magic tools and force him to invalidate his formation.
Seeing Qi Yun's righteousness, Bai Li removes his formation and surrenders, and then commits suicide with a sword.He would not like to live alone in the world following his brothers’ deaths.
Well, Qi Yun sighs, the result remains the same.I spare his life, but he chooses to die.
text.祁云眼看着大哥们一个个被收走，自己并没有陆压那些本事，万一没逃掉也被收走呢，那五:
Seeing a bunch of immortals have been caught one after another, Qi Yun hesitates to fight considering what if he fails to escape since he is not as skilled as Luya himself, and he has no idea why the light is so mysterious that those who are released from it all become listless.Why not come to Zhunti, the one who might beat Kong Xuan as written in the book?
Qi Yun then uses his technique to call the immortal, and in a burst of white light Zhunti descends from the sky.
"Master, this Kong Xuan has a special bond with our Western religion, so why don't you have him converted?", says Qi Yun, who is already used to the master’s opening line.
"My friend, you do have the magical prowess to foretell things, that's exactly what I intend to do".After saying this, he vanishes into thin air.
What Zhunti impresses Qi Yun is his power and volubility, whose presence would always bring about a commotion.It appears to be the same this time around.
The moment he sees Kong Xuan he disarms him by taking away his golden whip with his treasured tool Seven Treasures Tree.The latter, controlled by a great rage, wields his Five-Colored Holy Light upon him.Suddenly, an avatar appears in the sky, with eighteen hands, twenty-four of them.They hold a variety of magic treasures to directly fix Kong Xuan and then use Buddhist light to reveal his original form, which turns out to be a peacock that’s attained immortality.
Taking the peacock away as his mount, Zhunti waves a goodbye to the Xiqi army and leaves.
Marching through the Golden Cock Range, the Xiqi army meets no obstructions since their enemy army lacking superior men.They are doomed to win the war.
text.祁云一时没有靠近，愣了下神，再抬头看去，面前已经是空无一人，哪还有什么棋盘和老者: With mind wandering, Qi Yun doesn't walk up to Yunzhongzi immediately.And when he looks up again, only to find there is already no one in front of him, the chessboard and the old men all disappearing.\nFeeling at a loss, he realizes that he missed a chance.\nIn the second half of the year, a plague breaks out at the manor, and Qi Yun's family is not spared.Qi Yun dies without committing something evil as a time traveler.
text.祁云以道术传音请来准提帮助，他记得原著中并没有描述阐教如何与西方教联系的，而今生: Qi Yun then calls Zhunti for help via his voice transmission technique.He doesn't remember that in the book there's any account of the way Chan sect keeps contact with Western religion, and now he realizes he's the very intermediary.Upon Zhunti's arrival, he finds that many followers of Chan sect are somehow"connected to the West", and then happily asks his brother Jieyin Daoren to come over to shatter the formation with him.\n
text.祁云以陆压的身份找到赵公明，他自诩当时自己破十绝阵对截教众人留有情面，殊不知申公:
Qi Yun, in his capacity as Luya, tells Zhao Gongming that he held respect for his brothers in breaking the ten Battle Formation, unaware that Zhao Gongming is very angry with him since Shen Gongbao accused him of killing Bai Li after torturing him.
He even tries to persuade Zhao Gongming into returning to the mountain, otherwise he would lose his life.
But Zhao Gongming charges at him furiously as he believes Qi Yun is provoking him.
Little does Qi Yun expect such a response, and he is unfortunately cut into two parts by the Golden Dragon Scissors.
text.祁云仔细想了一下，至今为止，发生的事情可能过程与书中写的不同，但是结果一定是相同: After careful consideration, Qi Yun believes that what has happened so far may be different from what is written in the book, but their results must be the same.And Yunzhongzi as the immortal of fortune and virtue, would beget good ending if nature is allowed to take its own course.Otherwise, if the master knows too much, messing up the cause and effect, no one knows what the future will hold in store for him.\nIn the 13th year of King Zhou, Qi Yun is ready for the war.\n
text.祁云走近，方才看得清两位老者。\\n居左的老者手持白子，鹤发童颜，仙风道骨，这么:
Qi Yun walks up to have a clear look at the two old men.
The head-hoary old man on the left of the chessboard who holds white pieces, looks young and has a demeanour of a transcendent being, wearing only a Taoist robe in such a freezing cold day.
The other on the right with black pieces, wearing a thick Confucian robe, differs from the ordinary obviously.
The closer Qi Yun approaches, the stranger he feels.Suddenly, he realizes that there is not a single snowflake overhead around the two.Looking up, he finds that the big tree has already withered with only dead branches left, and it can by no means be a shelter from every snowflakes.While he hesitantly looks at the two old men again, some kind of message comes into his mind itself.
Old man in Taoist robes：
Name：Yunzhongzi
strength：???
Description：A disciple of Yuanshi Tianzun of Chan sect, and a practitioner of qi in Jade Column Cave atop Mount South End, he is an immortal of fortune and virtue who is most compassionate in his sect.
Old man in Confucian robe.
Name：Bi Gan
strength：5
Description：The owner of the manor he is in, uncle of King Zhou and vice-minister of the Shang Dynasty, he is benevolent and upright, and care for his country and the people.
Qi Yun's interpretation ability is activated.He sums up after many tests that this ability would only be activated when he comes across people or objects that did exist in history, and the interpretation results are completely correct.
So the old man on the right is undoubtedly Bi Gan, the noble lord of the manor, and a great benefactor in the eye of his parents.But who is Yunzhongzi on the left, whom seems to be a figure in legends, the Creation of the Gods?
Qi Yun has been fond of reading mystery novels on immortals and read the original of the Creation of the Gods more than a dozen times since he was a child, so that he is quite familiar with characters in it.While his eyes turn glazed over, Yunzhongzi asks, "Do you also play Go, my young friend?"

text.其实关于筑基和刻画符咒的事情琼英早就在师门的经楼里阅读过，她看完了整本的《符咒从:
In fact, Qiong Ying had read the base building and hierogram carving in books in the scripture garret.And she finished reading the whole Hierogram and Curse：from beginning to giving up.
Since the Sect Leader knew it, he approved her ask when she wanted to have a try.
Qiong Ying held a board with one hand, and held a carving knife with the other.She recited silently in her heart the spell rhythm from the book：Hierogram and Curse：from beginning to giving up.She carved slowly, and she tended to carve a character of 《Qing》 which means purity.It turned out that she wanted to carve a hierogram of mind purity that was given by the Sect Leader to her father at that time.
In Sect Leader Lu's opinion, given that Qiong Ying was inquisitive, he approved of her try.After all, the way of carving for an ordinary people who did not experience base building was the same as that of a carpenter.But what surprised them was that Qiong finished her base building at that moment, which can be attributed to her previous inspiration got from the eldest disciple's instruction.Due to the touch of Qiong's knife on the board, it was extremely harmful to stop halfway.So Sect Leader Lu could do nothing but to worry.
Now Qiong Ying realized why the eldest disciple dawdled all the time, because it suffered to carve a hierogram.
The celestial energy stored in the 13-year-old Qiong Ying is not so abundant, but now the carving knife just absorbs her remaining celestial energy.
But Qiong Ying is stubborn, and she never know make progress step by step, nor does she stop where should stop.The tougher it gets, the stronger desire she gets to conquer it.The knife was carved on the board difficultly.Every inches it moved, Qiong Ying thought she was drained out.But she just toughed it out to hold the carving knife.When the last stroke of the character was finished, the knife dropped on the ground.Qiong was weak and she fell back.
The Sect Leader Lu hurried to hold her, and he put his hand on Qiong's heart in the back.In doing so, he transferred celestial energy to Qiong Ying.And he patted her back gently and said, 《what kind of young girl are you?》
Looking at the semi-qualified hierogram of mind purity, the eldest principle was a little bit astounded.Because Qiong Ying just came in the mountain two years ago, but she finished her base building and carved the hierogram.That night, he spent a long time in the academy.

text.且说元始天尊、道德天尊、准提道人、接引道人一起来到阵前，准提笑眯眯劝通天收了阵莫:
The four,Yuanshi Tianzun, Daode Tianzun, Zhunti Daoren and Jieyin Daoren, come to the front of the formation together.Zhunti smilingly asks Tongtian to annul the formation otherwise he would have to duel against four.Tongtian Shrugs off the advice and enters the array directly, which mutes Zhunti and makes him give a wistful half-smile.
After a moment’s discussion, the four step into the array too.
Yuanshi Tianzun enters the Immortal Executing Gate.With auspicious clouds overhead, he is prevented by thousands of golden flowers and myriad jade-like stones from the Immortal Executing Sword.
Jieyin Daoren enters the Immortal Slaying Gate.Three Buddhist relics rising from his brain soul help keep the flying Immortal Slaying Sword away from him.
Daode Tianzun enters the Immortal Falling Gate, and he immediately raises his Ling Long Pagoda which gives out one thousand rays of lights to nullify the power of the Sword of Immortal Falling.
When Zhunti enters the Immortal Eliminating Gate, he slashes the Seven-Treasure Tree that releases a thousand green lotuses to stop the Immortal Eliminating Sword.
The four swords, symbol of death and destruction, cannot be restrained by a saint without greatest treasure.And If they are controlled, it means 80% of the power of the array is lost.
Seeing this, Tongtian Jiaozhu flies into a rage and wields his sword to interfere with the four saints.He charges directly at Jieyin Daoren, but his body is well protected by colorless lotus flowers discharged from his fly whisk.
The other three saints while keeping immortal swords in place, draw back to attack their common opponent with other magic treasures.At one point, Daode Tianzun's flat crutch, Yuanshi Tianzun's Jade scepter and Zhunti's newly acquired mount are mustered.
Barely can he handle the four, Tongtian is overpowered.With a low shout, Zhunti then calls out his avatar with twenty-four heads and eighteen hands, each hand holding a magic treasure to attack Tongtian.
Tongtian who’s at a disadvantage is hit by Daode Tianzun with one smash of his crutch, and then smashed in the front heart by Zhunti, and finally he has to flee away through technique of escape.Followers of Jie sect scatter then, and among them those who are skilled defect to Zhunti who convinces everyone by repeating the line "you are destined to join our Western religion."
text.且说这九曲黄河阵是什么门道，此阵内按三才，包藏天地之妙；中有惑仙丹、闭仙诀，能失:
This formation is mind-bogglingly powerful, containing pills and chanting that can damage immortal’s spirits, souls, form and qi, undermining them physically and mentally.Upon entering the trap, immortals will be reduced to be mortal, and mortals will be ended at once.
Therefore unfortunately, the twelve immortals of Chan lose their thousand-year Taoist attainment in a day.
What on earth is Taoist attainment? It is actually something that distinguishes immortals from ordinary cultivators.Magical arts refer to the art of escape and unconventional ways that Jiang Ziyia and Zhang Guifang can employ, while Taoist attainment is something those who are gifted accumulate for years, equivalent to record of schooling.To increase Taoist attainment requires passing of multiple tests, namely, examinations.The Twelve Immortals have lost their attainment in the trap, equivalent to students deprived of their post-doctoral diplomas, and if they want to regain their attainment, they have to go through another thousand years of cultivation.
The Twelve Immortals are destined to meet this as a result of their cultivation method.In the wake of the ten battle formations, they thought that they had weathered their doom but little do they expect that the previous difficulties are only the tip of the iceberg.Among senior disciples of Chan sect except Randeng who flees away as fast as he could, only Nanji Xianweng and Yunzhongzi two immortals of fortune and virtue are spared.
Qi Yun knew long how mighty the Yellow River Trap is, so he takes Leizhenzi along with him to hide far away.

text.琼英被他这一嗓子叫得呆住了，一时间不知道自己是不是也该开口唤声“师祖”什么的。\:
Qiong Ying was stunned on hearing that.She was not sure whether she should call the man "grand-master".
The man waved his hand and said, "Just get up, Hanxin, when i was still alive, you seldom knelt down in front of me.Why you now do it?"
"I used to think that master died and disappeared into nothing.Your primordial spirit became reincarnated.But I don't expect that you are still alive, and you attached on the jade pendant." The Coldstar replied.
The man didn't respond to it.
The Coldstar asked, "The primordial spirit stayed in secular world for such a long time, and it has nothing to attach.Even though master , you are the King of All Demons, it is possible to end up with the disappear of body and soul."
The Nanshu Priest smiled and said, "It doesn't matter whether i am alive or not."
The Coldstar asked again, "Does the elder brother Shen die?"
The Nanshu Priest stopped for a while and then blinked his eyes.He replied, "He does not disappear completely.But i shattered the fire of soul in the Blood-Soul Box with my own soul, which deals a heavy blow to him.But Shen went so far.He integrated the Box into himself, so his own soul and energy also became the soul and energy of the Box.Since he could not enter into the round of incarnation, he is no longer a man any more.You can view him as a dead man."
After asking all what he wanted to know, the Coldstar called Qiong Ying.It seemed that he wanted to show off his disciples were better than his master's.Qiong Ying reached out and grabbed the corner of her master's coat.But she failed.She was shock.
"Many years ago, my eldest brother deviated into evil.At that time, your grand-master was practising in isolation.So i had to chase out lonely.I was defeated by the Blood-Soul Box, and in the end only a wisp of soul escaped from it.Xiaoying, actually master has died very long ago."
Qiong Ying was confounded and she was going to burst into tears.
Lu Hanxin said to Qiong Ying, "This is the Leader seal of the Springsun Sect.Bring it back to your eldest disciple Ye, and tell him to take care of you."
After finishing his words, he looked Qiong Ying affectionately and he said in a very low voice, "I am gone."
Then he disappeared on site, which was like a glow of shredded light hitting into the soil.He could not be found any more.And the King of All Demons also disappeared.

text.琼英不顾大师兄的眼色，提起一口气，突然想起来自己身上那把天煞孤星刀，这应该算是万:
Ignoring the eldest brother's wink, Qiong Ying took a deep breath and it occurred to her that she had the Blade of Heavenly Evil along with her.This moment could be viewed as urgent, couldn't it?
She unfolded the scented pouch and placed it on her palm.As expected, the Blade turned into the real size.When Qiong held the handle, the remaining celestial spirit in her body was drained.The Blade, not be activated for a long time, began to vibrate and generate pleasant clinking.Then Qiong felt that a whiff of celestial spirit mixed with bloody smell was transported from the handle, and it was much stronger than last time.
Now the eldest brother had gotten a back out because of the vibration.Qiong Ying held the Blade and attacked from the behind.She stabbed the back of the leader of the black.Then the leader stepped aside immediately with blood bleeding all the time.
"You should capitalize him." Qiong Ying realized that somebody was talking to her, but she found on one opened his mouth.Was it the Blade that talked with her?
After checking his wound, the leader was astonished because it was very strange:the flesh wound just kept bleeding and it was getting worse.When he noticed that the Blade that Qiong held was the Blade of Heavenly Evil, he was stunned.It is said that it will take seven days for the wound caused by the Blade to cure.
The leader took out a red pill from his packing and swallowed it, but the wound didn't cure.However, the body's hematopoietic function was greatly enhanced.He rushed towards Qiong Ying.
As the Blade was touched with blood, Qiong Ying noticed that the blood was visibly engulfed by the Blade.When it finished, the Blade was a little red.Then the celestial spirit transported from the handle was stronger with stronger smell of blood.
Realizing that the leader in black was rushing towards her, Qiong Ying wielded her sword to fight against him.Although this was her first fighting, the Blade Technique of Springsun that Qiong had practiced thousands of times was helpful.She found out that she was quite familiar with the technique.As long as her eyes could keep pace with the opponent's motion, she knew how to handle in her mind.After several rounds, the leader realized that Qiong's technique was perfect, if he continued to fight with her, he would drain to death.
The leader in black retreated a step to stay away from Qiong.In doing so, he aimed to summoned his talisman, a flying sword.The flying sword flew in an exceeding speed, and flew towards Qiong directly.Qiong dodged it by wielding the Blade of Heavenly Evil Soul.As she rushed ahead, the leader in black operated the flying sword and stayed away from her.But what was unexpected was that Qiong Ying crushed a hierogram of land drilling.So she reappeared at the behind of the leader.The leader was hurried to operate the flying sword to attack her.So she could retreat.But Qiong didn't dodge at all.Instead, she just hacked the leader's chest directly.She herself also attacked by the flying sword with the sword penetrating from her back to her chest.Both the leader in black and Qiong Ying were dead.The Blade of Heavenly Evil was transformed into a glow of light flying into Qiong's body.

text.琼英当年确实时已经死了。\\n死时魂魄附在了天煞孤星刀身上，暂时保留，但这种残魂:
It was true that Qiong Ying died.
But since her soul was attached on the Blade of Heavenly Evil, her soul was temporarily kept.But it only could be kept for seven days in secular world.
At this time, Qiong Ying, in the form of the soul, met the primordial spirit of the cultivator Li Ming who was given the hierogram of mind purity.
His primordial spirit hadn't reentered into his body yet, but he studied the way of souls and spirits.So his primordial spirit could still stay in secular world.He recommended a method to reshape Qiong Ying's body which was not yet proved effective by predecessors.Qiong Ying took his advice immediately.
Li Ming showed Qiong to the 3000-feet Chilly Pool in the Soul Valley, and he gave her half spirit-condensing jade.
Qiong Ying began to practice at here day and nigh.She had to endure the suffering of the Chilly Pool and reshaped her body with her energy of complete yin combined with the spirit-condensing jade.But such a behavior was anti-nature order.Therefore it triggered the heaviest thunder from the Heaven.Li Ming had already waited on her side.By employing a particular talisman, he led the thunder to his body.With the thunder stricken on him nine times, his primordial spirit reentered into body.
Qiong Ying bowed to Li Ming to express her thanks.Li Ming smiled and waved his hand, "Never mind.Thanks to your hierogram of mind purity, otherwise i am still a wild ghost.And i also need to suffer nine times of the thunder before my primordial spirit can reenter into my body.We are helping each other, so don't bear in mind.Since my primordial spirit has separated from my body for many years, i got many things to handle.The Meeting of Demon Slay is held in Tianji Palace recently.Do not go there if you don't have to.I can foretell that it's very dangerous there."
Li Ming left.Qiong Ying who was in the form of her body felt exceedingly frigid.So she jumped tens meters high.When she stood outside of Chilly Pool, she checked her level：she already enters into the Body Integration stage.
And then she examined with her celestial commonsense.She found out that her initial being disappeared.The initial being was formed when she stepped across the threshold of being a priest with heart.It was a sword-embryo instead.She was very familiar with it, and then she realized that it was the Blade of Heavenly Evil.
When she went out the the Soul Valley, she returned to the Springsun Mountain.But only to find that the gate was closed and the protecting formation was activated.So she estimated that on one was in the mountain.Qiong didn't know where to find her brothers.Then the Meeting of Demons Slay in Tianji Palace came to her mind, so she decided to head towards it.
text.琼英跟着寒星居士走了。\\n寒星居士体态阴柔，像是没骨头一样，拉着琼英，就像是个:
Qiong Ying followed the Coldstar Lay Buddhist.
The lay Buddhist was gentle.And it seemed that he didn't have bones.When he held Qiong, it gave the impression that a playboy led his young mermaid.
Before their departure, he gave a crystal-clear jade to her father.The hanging of the jade could help maintain a clear sense.So her attitude turned better to the man, but she still doubted whether the man was a swindler or not.
The Coldstar yawned and said, "Our sect is called Springsun Sect, with the younger brother of the one of the Eight Immortals Lv Dongbing as its founding father.The sect is a sister sect with the prestigious Puresun Sect."
Qiong Ying thought to herself that just keep telling a story, watch out maybe Lv Dongbing would send a thunder to you.
Coldstar turned a blind eye to her response, and continued, "Our way of immortal cultivation is into the mortal world.Having meal is immortal cultivation, so does farming land and going to toilet.And doing what you like is also immortal cultivation."
After hearing that, Qiong Ying thought it was unavoidable to chop firewood and carry water in mountain.
When Coldstar was going to brag about his sect, a strong gale of wind came with thunder and lightening.It seemed that torrential rain was about to come.
Coldstar held Qiong Ying to run towards a shabby temple.
While running, Qiong Ying muttered to herself, "You are a great master who have a good command of arts.You still need to take shelter in a temple?"
"When conducting immortal cultivation, one should not adopt celestial arts for convenience, which is viewed as a way of test." He got an exceedingly good hearing.He ran ahead and responded to Qiong as well.
But it rained too fast that even a wild cat got totally soaked, let alone both of them.
The two came in the temple awkwardly.Coldstar tended to tell Qiong what was immortal cultivation when a smell of fish flew in and disrupted his mind.He sought where the smell came and then saw a ragamuffin who was one or two years senior than Qiong Ying at the corner of the temple.
The boy set a ball of fire and had a wooden grill devised from something unknown.There was a big black fish grilled on the wooden grill with a lot of grease coming out.At this time, the boy was sprinkling some seasonings on the fish, with a strong fragrance coming out.
He took a gulp of his saliva and then went straight to the boy.He greeted to the boy and said carefully, "Dear friend, you got unique bones, so i believe that you are a talent once in a hundred years in immortal cultivation.Why don't you follow me to go into mountain?"
The boy seemed smart and was unlikely to be deceived by the man.But he nodded his head and approved.Qiong Ying guessed that the boy was happy to find a deceptive organization which should be his home.
The ragamuffin kowtowed to Coldstar and gave the grilled fish to him with his two hands.It was viewed as a ceremony for apprentice.

text.琼英那年十岁。\\n有个居士游历途路过，到柳府上讨一碗水喝，琼英替宿醉的爹爹招待:
At the year when Qiong was ten years old.
A lay Buddhist passed by her house where he went for a bowl of water.Qiong Ying instead of her drunken father entertained the man.
The man was in his thirties with a pair of strangely blue eyes.He yawned all the time, which suggested that he was a dawdler.Instead of an immortal cultivator, he was more like a middle-aged man who experienced sudden abjection.
When he was drinking, he glanced at Qiong Ying for a while.Such glances made Qiong uncomfortable.After his drinking, he insisted that he should meet her drunken father Mr.Liu.Qiong had to crouch at the corner of walls.She hoped to hear their conversation, but failed.She just saw her father nodding his head all the time.Needless to say that it was the man's deceitful words that caused it.Qiong was going to rush in to stop the swindler.But when she was about to speak, the man took a hierogram from nowhere.He took it with his two fingers and than touched her father's head gently.All of a sudden, the hierogram turned into a wisp of smoke, and then flew into her father’s nose and mouth.In no time, her father's eyes were clearer.And he was not so insane anymore.His father looked normal and thanked the man promptly.
Liu talked all night with Qiong Ying.It seemed that the two hadn't seen each other for many years but they would be parted with each other again.Liu talked a lot and talked a wide range of things.The whole night was not long enough to deliver his deep affection and care to Qiong Ying.
Qiong Ying was determined to stay with her father.Despite her curiosity and longing for immortal cultivation, she was not touched by it.But she changed her mind when she heard her father's final words：
"Yinger, i believe that in that celestial mountain, girls are allowed to conduct immortal cultivation which is prohibited in the secular world.When you finish your studying, i hope you can employ what you have learned to arrange a meeting between me and your passed away mother.If you can do it, i will die without any regrets."

At this time, the eldest disciple was cornered.Qiong Ying picked up one sword left on the ground to join in the battlefield.

text.琼英如在春阳派时那般自律，练刀，念经，刻符，打坐。\\n琼英今日如往常般练刀回来:
Qiong Ying was as disciplined as she was in the Springsun Sect.She practiced the Blade Technique, read scriptures, carved hierogram, and sit in medication.
After practicing the Blade Technique, Qiong went back her room.When she opened the door, her smile disappeared.She realized that someone had entered into her room.
She checked her room carefully to make sure the people had gone.She found a slim blade on the table.It was not a wooden one, but a real one, with dazzling light.
Qiong Ying closed the door carefully.She noticed that there were many unknown hierograms and spells carved on the blade.She wanted to touch the blade, then she stopped when her finger and the blade was half-inch apart.She felt that the blade was animated, and it was magically ecstatic.
At the moment, Qiong found a note under the blade which reads, "The Blade of Heavenly Evil returns to where it belongs to.Do not use it if unnecessary.Bear in Mind!"
Qiong Ying touched the blade gently.It could be felt that the blade was ecstatic.And then the blade minimized itself into a pendant size.
Qiong Ying put the pendant into her scented pouch and hung it around her waist.Then she went to the scripture garret of the Tianshu Island for some useful clues.She found some recordings about the blade at dusk：The Blade of Heavenly Evil, is acclaimed as a magic blade because there was a righteous powerful man holding it to kill three demons in a row.
However less than five years later, the righteous man passed away.The Blade was therefore snatched by another demon.From then on, many people were killed by the Blade.And the demon almost became a King of ALL Demons.So the Blade became the Evil Blade in the world.
A few years later, the demon died suddenly.Then the Blade once again became a sharp weapon to defend justice and eliminate evils wielded by a righteous mighty man.But the man died several years later.His disciples believed that the Blade was ominous, so they called it The Blade of Heavenly Evil.And they threw it into the Eastern Ocean.From then on, on one saw the Blade.
After reading this, Qiong Ying was in a panic and she didn't know how to deal with the Blade.
text.琼英说不清为什么，她觉得这把刀跟师父，或者说自己的门派有些渊源，以及字条上的物归: Qiong Ying didn't know why, but she believed that the Blade had something to do with her master, or the Sect.And she very cared the returning of the Blade to its owner written on the note.\nShe didn't tell anyone about the Blade.She just carried it along with her all the time.
text.琼英思量再三，觉得这清心符是自身唯一有用的东西，担心和男鬼是惧怕此物想骗过去，于: After careful consideration, Qiong Ying believed that the hierogram of mind purity was the only useful thing.She worried that the man tried to deceive it, so she refused to give it to the man.And she told L u Chen to inform their master what happened.\nThe man shook his head and he tried to say something.But his eyes became dim and he resumed to be frigid as before.And he didn't speak any more.It seemed that he lost his mind again.\nWith a waving of his hand, a gust of gale flew again.As Qiong Ying and Lu Chen, they couldn't resist the gale.As a result, they died eventually.
text.琼英思前想后，还是决定算了，她觉得自己一定哪里有疏漏，着延续几百年成熟的科举制度: After careful consideration, Qiong Ying decided to give up her idea.She believed that something must go wrong.Because the system of the imperial examination was mature and it had spanned for several hundred years.It was impossible for her to take advantage of it.\nAlthough she didn't take action, she kept the habit of disguising herself as a boy.
text.琼英问师父何时才能用真刀，师父让她不要心急，心中有刀，手中自然有刀: Qiong Ying asked her master when could she use a real sword.Her master told her to be patient.If she got extremely familiar with the sword in her heart, she would be able to wield a real one in her hand.
text.琼英想了想，将木牌放在了地上，而后谨慎地抓着陆沉往后退了十几步，男人脸上喜色一闪:
After a moment of thinking, Qiong Ying placed the wooden carving hierogram on the ground and retreated dozens of steps backward together with Lu Chen.The man was happy and then reached out to get the hierogram.All of a sudden, the hierogram emitted strong glow and then turned into a cloud of white light flying into the man's body.In no time, the bloody and stinky smell from the man were not so strong as before.And he looked not so pale.
The so-called Li Ming took a deep breath, and took a low bow to Qiong Ying and Lu Chen.He said, "I cannot express my gratitude with my words.Please send my sincere wishes to your master.The Ghost Evil Shen Yuan held grudges with the sect.So tell him to be careful."
After finishing his words, he disappeared in the air.It seemed that he had not existed at all.
"What does he mean?" Lu Chen asked curiously.
Without answering his question, Qiong Ying had a blackout and toppled on the ground.
