text.一人一马从通天河出来后就进了一个大林子，这个林子大的望不到边际，大的不空以为出了:
Bukong and the White Horse walked into a large forest after their departure from the Sand River, also called Heaven Leading River.The forest was so large that Bukong thought the system map got stuck because of bug.But in the end, Bukong walked out of the frost thanks to his perseverance.
Not far away from the frost, a magnificent mansion was looming.When getting closer, Bukong saw a middle aged woman coming out.Bukong didn't feel surprised for such a quest presence.
The woman ushered Bukong to the hall, and ordered her servants to prepare food for Bukong.After that, she began to chat with him, "My family is exceedingly affluent with hundreds of thousands of cultivated fields.Alas, but my husband died the year before last year.I only have three daughters around.I believe you are a decent man.Why don't you stay at here and be my son-in-law? What do you think?"
Bukong realized that this was a honey trap."Even beautiful and charming ladies cannot disturb my mind.I am a monk." Bukong thought to himself.He replied, "No need for it.No need for it."
The woman invited again and again, but Bukong just refused repeatedly.
The next morning, Bukong bid a farewell to the woman.The woman leaned over and her body was attached to Bukong.She whispered to Bukong, "Golden Buddha, it is unexpected that you should pass the Sand River in this incarnation.Therefore, some people are working overtime to design following plots.If you act in large picture, you'd better to stay at here for half year.I will treat you well.But if you insist on leaving, the system will kill you directly and uses the excuse of bug to handle these players."
Bukong was astonished on hearing that.How the woman could call out his name completely.Because his name was prohibited by system, even the dialogue could not speak it out.
text.一人一马来到火云洞，在洞口看见一家三口，丈夫生的像头牛，憨厚又很有安全感，妻子貌:
Bukong and the Horse passed through the Fire Cloud Cave.They saw a family of three at the gate of the Cave.The husband born resemblance to a cow that is very honest and reliable.The wife was beautiful, and the boy in a red bellyband was very cute.The family was happy.
On seeing Bukong and the White Horse, the boy shouted to his father, "Daddy, the horse is so cool.I want to ride on the cool horse."
The father caught a glance of Bukong apologetically and then said to his son, "The horse belongs to that man, not mine.My Dear, can you just ride on Daddy?" Then he was about to lift the boy to his shoulder.
"No, I don't want to ride on you! I want to ride on that Horse." The boy began to cry.
"That Horse was dirty.We cannot ride it.What if you get ill? My dear boy, i will buy a new better one, is it okay? And you see, that Horse is old and ugly.It is bad to ride it." The beautiful wife coddled the boy.
"I just want to ride it! I just want to ride it!" The boy began to roll on the ground.
"Just look at the son, he behaves so badly.Honghaier, just stood up, and follow me to go home!" The father said strictly.The boy recognized that his father was really angry, so he stopped crying and was ready to stood up.At this time, his mother uttered.
"What is wrong with me? I only have one child.What's wrong to treat him better.Why you throw your temper to a child? If you are capable, just be strong outside.Look at the Grand Eagle.How awesome he is! You cannot be strong outside, so you just bully your own child?" Honghaier realized that his mother supported him, and knew her mother was stronger than his father.Therefore, he cried aloud again.
The father couldn't persuade the boy, so he came to Bukong with an apologetic look on his face.He said to Bukong, "Sorry for disturbing you.My wife just spoils the son.Could you please lend the Horse to me? My son wants to ride it."
When Bukong was thinking whether this round of quest was looking after the child, the silent White Horse utilized the telepathy to communicate with Bukong, "Just let me go.I can feel that my data stream runs out.After my passed from the Sand River, the West XXX changed the script.Maybe this is my fate."
"What if you don't go?" Bukong asked.
"If i don't go,your quest will fail.At that time, i will end up with the same fate." The Horse said.
"So, we don't have other solutions?" Bukong said to the Horse.
"Fine, i was forced to accompany you on the journey.We all know that i will leave you one day, so just let me leave first.I don't want to see you die first before me." The White Horse said.

text.一日准提讲学传道后，不空上前询问:“师傅，您说我派乃是佛门，您为什么授我的全是道:
One day when Zhun Ti finished his instruction, Bu Kong asked, "Master, you said that this Sect belongs to Buddhism, but you never impart any knowledge related to Buddhism to me.All you teaching is skills related to the Taoism."
Zhun Ti smiled and said, "because you are my teacher in Buddhism.I can teach you nothing about it."
On hearing it, Bu Kong sneered."The reason is so unreal.Master, can you stop playing joke with me?"
Zhun Ti got angry, and said, "Monks are not allowed to tell lies.As a disciple, you should have the gut to doubt your master which shows you are so disrespectful.Now let's end our mentoring relationship.And you should leave the mountain.Remember never to mention your master to anyone else.Otherwise, you are not the disciple of the Sect anymore." Finishing his words, Zhun Ti waved his hand.Then Bu Kong reappeared in the wild.When he looked around, he could not find the Fangcun Mountain.
Bu Kong turned and bowed three times to the direction that he thought where the Fangcun Mountain located.He stood up and raised his voice to shout, "Master, i still think that you are cheating me." after getting no response, Bu Kong turned around and left leisurely, humming a song happily.
Zhun Ti burst into laughter.He thought to himself "Golden Buddha, you have not changed a bit.You will remember everything."

text.一身轻松地回到宗门，又闭关修炼了一段时间。感觉身心圆满，法力满溢，是时候凝结道基:
You return to the sect with relief and embark on closed-door cultivating.Complete physically and mentally, and overflowing with mana, you feel it is time to establish the Taoist foundation.
You come to Elder Shi and ask him about the do's and don'ts of Foundation Establishment.
Elder Shi answers, "Foundation Establishment, as its name implies, a foundation laying, is to help achieve the smooth flow of Meridians, so as to set the stage for the subsequent realm advancement.There are three dominant methods to achieve it in the cultivation world.The first method is to refine the essence and transform it into qi by producing elixirs.It requires cultivators to have a strong mind and unwavering commitment to Taoism.The second is called external Yun, which involves inscribing runes and Taoist discourses on natural materials and treasures to form an external foundation.It is connected closely to the practitioner's life.The last refers to internal Yun, that is to say, absorbing Sha Qi from the natural world into the cultivator's body.If coordinated with compatible spells, the Sha Qi is dauntingly powerful."
"Then what are the pros and cons or strengths and weaknesses of the three methods?"
"All of them lead to immortality.The first method, characteristic of gentle and profound power, is compatible with almost any techniques.And those who adopt the second method are good at manipulating, and can achieve buffs while using elixirs, magic tools, formation and talismans.They are research-oriented, but their achievements are closely related to the material used to build foundation.A practitioner who chooses the third method has to absorb the Five Elements into his body, and must choose a technique that corresponds to the attribute of the element he absorbs.Otherwise, he will either lose all his magic power or die.But those who succeed in this method are unmatched no matter in fighting against enemies or in magical-power matches.
After leaving the Elder's, you make up your mind to adopt the method of internal Yun, as you will definitely get involved in fights in the future to avenge Mr Yao.

As there has been no news from Mr Yao, you decide not to wait any longer and go ahead to test your qualifications.
When it's your turn to go up for the test, you feel quite nervous since none of the candidates queuing before you can empower the Spiritual Crystal shine.
"Take it easy, boy, think of something interesting in the past."
You look up and see the cultivator is encouraging you, smiling.
After calming down a great deal, you slowly place your hand on the top of the crystal, only to see it gives out a flash of dazzling green light.
"Great! Superior Wood Spiritual Root.I never expect that you would have a Wood Spiritual Root unseen in a century.Where you live and what is your name my boy?"
"Your Excellency, my name is Xing Daorui, without a courtesy name yet, and I live in Xing's mansion at sweet water lane."
"Good.Go home then, and tomorrow I will come and take you away to Qing Yun Mountain."
Then, in a deluge of envy of the onlookers, you rush home.

text.又过了两个月，姜子牙已经闲得在殿上擦拭自己钓鱼竿了，忽报有一道者求见，姜子牙赶忙:
Two more months later, Jiang Ziya is idly polishing his fishing rod in the hall, when he is suddenly reported to have a priest dropping by.He then extends warm welcome to his visitor.
The priest, wearing a hat with three peaks and phoenixes flying, a robe of a pale goose−yellow and a pair of hemp shoes, walks into the hall and bows down, saying, "Uncle-Master, my name is Yang Jian, a disciple of Yuding Zhenren of Jade Spring Mountain’s Golden Cloud Cave.I have been ordered by my master to come here at your disposal."
Jiang Ziya is pleased to see a young man with extraordinary qualities, and then tells him everything about the four demon generals.
Yang Jian says, "Now that I am here, I would like to take the offensive against the four brothers."
Seeing the confidence of Yang Jian, Jiang Ziya agrees.
The four brothers are happy to see the Zhou army again, because they have gained nothing since they laid siege to the city, and they are afraid that the Grand Old Master Wen Zhong would blame them for this.
On the battlefield, they stand in front of the Zhou army with Yang Jian taking the lead.
Seeing Yang Jian, a man with extraordinary bearing and inscrutable ability, they don't dare to make a move recklessly, but send out the ferret(mink) of Mo Lishou.
Once flung in the air, the ferret transforms into a huge beast, and swallows Yang Jian with its large mouth in one gulp.
This leads to a commotion among the Zhou army and its forced retreat.The four brothers return to their camp with irrepressable laughter.
Jiang Ziya thinks to himself, what should I do, now the superior man has been consumed by the beast? But how can this be? Is it because he takes the enemy too lightly?
The four haven't won such a victory for a long time, so they are particularly happy and have a carouse after arranging soldiers to patrol around their camps.
At midnight, as the four are in a deep sleep, the ferret gets out of the pocket of Mo Lishou and transforms into a human with a breeze.The man is Yang Jian.It turns out that he deliberately allowed himself to be consumed by the beast, and after killing it he takes its form.
While the four are sleeping, Yang Jian steals away the Green Cloud Sword, the Havoc-Umbrella and the Jade Pipa and flees back to Xiqi.
Jiang Ziya who stays up late at night is joyful to see Yang Jian’s suddenly coming back, and when seeing what Yang Jian takes with him, he knows the whole story.Then he asks him to return to his enemy in the form of ferret again.
The next morning, a young man riding a jade kylin and holding a Fire Dragon Javelin visits.He is Huang Tianhua, a highly skilled man, who is son of Huang Feihu and disciple of Master Virtue of the Pure Void of Purple Sun Cave of Qingfeng mountain.
Jiang Ziya gets really confident and takes the lead to charge at their enemy.The four demon generals are put into a great fury when they find that their magic treasures have been stolen away, but they still have the ferret left, so they brace themselves and go out to fight.
Seeing that it is a young man unknown to him who charges first on behalf of the Zhou army, Mo Liqing takes the initiatives to fight but can only reach a tie with his rival.Then, he hits directly the heart of Huang Tianhua from behind with his White Jade Diamond Bracelet, causing the latter falling off his horse and dead.

When country was shaped later, patriarchy was kept intact until now.
In patriarchy, men have many advantages over women in various respects, for example, the birth of a boy is called Nongzhang which means a piece of jade, while the birth of a girl is called Nongwa which refers to a piece of tile.Although it doesn't mean that boys are jade while girls are tile, it refers to the item given to newborns:boys are given a piece of jade, but girls a toy for spinning.Obviously male and female grownups are given different expectation in the society.

After experimenting with many plants and animals, you find that the higher the dose each time is used, the faster creatures age, with fierce beasts and spirit herbs less affected than small animals and weeds and the like.
If well used, it will probably become a powerful weapon against enemies, and in the future it might be an ace in the hole when you avenge Mr.Yao against the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons, you think to yourself.
Therefore in your spare time, you often steep yourself in the scripture library to find a suitable magic art to tap the potential of the moon dew.
Finally one day, you find out a water and earth mixing art, a nourishing art, which can help you imperceptibly absorb the liquid along with spiritual energy by raising it in midair through your psychokinesis after integrating it into earth.
Now with its help and in a late-stage Qi-refining, you can cause forbidding mass destruction faced with those who are less powerful than you.

So they summoned their respective talisman.For the eldest brother, the flying sword of his real being had made progress, in addition to the inborn sword-embryo, and his talisman.He could operate three flying swords simultaneously.Since the celestial energy of sword cultivators was several times stronger that that of cultivators in the same level.So he grew more courageous.
Qiong Ying only got the Blade of Heavenly Evil.The Blade could absorb the enemies' celestial energy once it hacked them.So the Blade could cut the flesh at every wield, which was extremely frightened.
As for Lu Chen, he was more exaggerated.He even summoned the evil dragon.And he turned into a black evil dragon, which could not be pierced by swords or knives.He swallowed a whiff of black smoke which could suffocate enemies who were clouted by the smoke.
The fighting came to an end very soon.Qiong was slightly injured, and the eldest brother lost much of celestial energy.Lu Chen was not injured at all.After checking no enemies were left in the formation, they began to discuss how to get out of the formation.

text.在天枢宫已经待了有些日子了。\\n大师兄、琼英的陆沉都已经结出元婴，算是摸到了道:
They had stayed in the Tianshu Palace for some time.
The eldest disciple, Qiong Ying and Lu Chen all entered into the initial being stage.They all gained basic understanding of how to conduct immortal cultivation.
The eldest disciple stepped across the threshold of being a priest with sword, and now he had reached to the G.8 at initial being stage.Given that the initial being was transformed from a sword-embryo, it is reasonable for those who are self-disciplined to enter into this stage.But it is strange for the eldest disciple to enter into the initial being stage.
Qiong Ying also stepped across the threshold of being a priest with sword, which was not a surprise, because she was always disciplined.Now she entered into the G.6 at initial being stage.
Lu Chen stepped across the threshold of being a priest with sophisticated tricks which belongs to one of the three thousand kinds of immortal cultivation.But it only belongs to a small branch, focusing on elixir and wares refining, formation, spell and hierogram.And even the alchemy is included in it.Such a method was relied on external factors, not the cultivation itself.As a result, Lu Chen improved his level very slowly.He just reached to the Level Ⅰat the initial being stage.
The tenth celestial meeting of the Tianshu Island was approaching.A review of last celestial meeting revealed that numerous celestial beings came to congratulate.The scene was spectacular.As the leader of the Big Dipper, Chen Tanlang was capable of commanding all the immortal cultivators nationwide.

text.在宗门内兑换了，凡人可服用的延寿丹药，又置换了一些符箓法器后，暂时告别师门，打算:
After redeeming life-prolonging pills for mortals and some talismans and magic tools in the sect, you leave the sect for the time being and return to your hometown.
After a month's journey, you finally arrive at the capital.Looking at your birth place that you have left behind for twenty years, you are brimming with complicated emotions.Walls that were unreachable to you at that time can now be crossed with a single bound.
You feel like you are totally an outsider when walking along the road towards the Xing's at sweet water lane from memory and looking at all the different kinds of pedestrians.
When arriving at the door of the Xing Mansion, which has changed so much, you have a sense of disconnection.
"Dong-Dong"you knock the door."Wait a second."it is an old man that opens the door, whom bears resemblance to the former housekeeper.He looks at you and asks, bewildered "Who are you?"
You smile, reply "Uncle Fook, don't you remember me?" "You are...Are you little Rui?" "Yes, I am.I'm home." "Master, Madam come out quickly, the young master is back~" the housekeeper rushes to the backyard in a flurry.You follow behind and slowly walk into the house, surrounded by maids and servants who look at you curiously.A little while later, an old couple supported by a young man come out, looking at you ill at ease.You step forward to pay your respects, "Father, mother, forgive me for my inability to visit you for such a long time until today, as I've been occupied with many things since I joined the sect.I've been missing you all day and night." "Brother, rise please."The young man helps you up.You ask in confusion "who are you?" "When you left, the master told us that you were destined to pursue immortality, and then your mother and I adopted Kai'er from your second uncle."your parents explain carefully.
Later, you give them the life-extension pills you've brought and tell Xing Dao Kai to come to you at Qingyun Mountain for whatever difficulties the family comes across afterwards.
After dealing with your mundane affairs, you say goodbye to your family and return to the sect.

text.张桂芳死战不降几乎力竭，眼看就要自尽，祁云让雷震子不要乱跑，施展土遁来到阵前，祭:
On the brink of exhaustion, Zhang Guifang is on the point of committing suicide.Seeing this, Qi Yun, asking Leizhenzi to stay still, gets to the front-line of the battlefield through his underground-fleeing technique, and wields his Bagua Cloud and Light Kerchief modeled after the magic tool of Shi Niangniang.A glaring light comes out from the kerchief, causing people around to cover their eyes and flinch, and at the moment, Qi Yun takes Zhang Guifang hundreds of miles away instantly.
When Zhang Guifang refreshes, he finds he has been freed from enemies hundreds of miles away, alone, and he realizes that he has been saved by a superior man.
After making a few solemn obeisances in all directions instead of uttering words of thanks, he makes a deep bow in the direction of Zhao Ge, and then commits suicide by impaling himself with a long spear.
"I have degraded my country and do not want to live on in degradation, may your Excellency take my remains back to my army."
Zhang Guifang was already gone before Qi Yun could make any responses, and he can do nothing but to comply with his last words to bring his remains back.
Why different processes would still lead to the same result? Qi Yun feels sad about the fact that he is not able to save a loyal and righteous man though taking such a risk.
After Zhang Guifang dies, Zhao Ge army retreats, representing its another failure to suppress Xiqi.
text.张桂芳死战不降几乎力竭，在无法脱身的情况下断然绝顶自尽殉国，魂魄也入了封神榜，便: Sieged by his enemies on the battlefield and fighting until on the edge of exhaustion, Zhang Guifang kills himself in the end.After his death, he is appointed as the deity of Sangmen Xing that later generations dislike.\nQi Yun sighs to himself, why do people in later generations only focus on the result of a battle, wouldn't it be also respectable to be a loser who makes all-out efforts?
text.张桂芳战败自尽的消息传到朝歌，闻太师扼腕叹息之余也深感西岐实力如今如此强大，再不:
When the news of Zhang Guifang's defeat and death hits Zhao Ge, Wen Zhong, while lamenting with sorrow, is convinced that Xiqi is now so powerful that it must become a recipe for disaster.As a result, he makes up his mind to eliminate it rather than persuading it to surrender, and at once calls for the four demon generals who guard Good Dream Pass to launch a battle against Xiqi.
The four’s arrival in Xiqi puts superior men there in distress, obviously they are really powerful.
In terms of force alone, the four brothers together can only match a single Zhang Guifang, but if with magic treasures, each of them is neck and neck with him.
Mo Liqing, is equipped with a magic treasure called Green Cloud Sword which gives out a black wind when wielded, and within that wind are thousands of dagger-axes and spears that can smash adversaries’ limbs to pieces.
Mo Lihai, has a jade pipa with four strings, namely 'earth, water, fire and wind'; when the strings are plucked, wind and fire inundate together.
Mo Lihong, is famous for his Havoc-Umbrella, which when opened, can darken the whole world; when turned, can vibrate the universe.
Mo Lishou, is followed by a pet called Purple and Gold ferret, which when flung into the air will look like a white elephant with wings on its ribs.It is in the habit of eating humans.
The Xiqi side has to bite the bullet to fight against the four.when everyone rushes forward, Qi Yun secretly sighs that had it not been for him, Leizhenzi would probably have given Mo Liqing a great blow in the face, since this flying soldier can run faster than an infantry soldier even though without his wings.
As the war rages, Jinzha is the first to make an attack with his Golden Lotus, which is unfortunately taken into the Havoc-Umbrella of Mo Lihong, so is Jiang Ziya’s Devil Beating Whip later.Seeing this, Nezha refrains from using his magic treasures but duels against his enemy with his own fists.As a result, the four brothers get an upper hand by applying all their magic weapons and defeat the Xiqi army, leading them to beat a retreat back to their base.
Later, Jiang Ziya hangs up his truce board again, refusing to take up any challenge from his enemy outside the city.The four demon generals try to storm the city by dispatching soldiers to scald up its city walls with ladders but fail.Over time, both sides suffer a great loss, and considering to launch further attacks like this would do no good, the four brothers decide to by lay siege to the city and wait until their enemies run out of their provisions.

text.掌门大殿：宗门星级是宗门这个大功能的基础，其他玩法功能升级或开启都依赖于宗门星级:
Sect Hall：star level is the basis of the sect, upgrade or open of other gameplay are both rely on the star level, you can redeem sect level-up stone in spiritual realm
Upgrading of sect level could improve character as well as disciple practice speed, prior to upgrade sect level

Disciple Hall：recruiting disciples.You need disciples everywhere in sect zone, sect foreign affairs, sect array, explioiting spiritual vein and settled in abode.And the main method you get disciples is from the Disciple Hall.Also, you could buy disciple giftpack to get 5-star discples.

Sect Zone：the mainly method of obtaining materials in heaven.After upgraded the sect level, you could upgrade sect zone with Woods and Stones
The higher level of the sect quest and the more disciples dispatched, the more rewards you will get.For example, one disciple dispatched for 1-star quest would get 100 Div.Gems, if dispatched2 disciples you could get 200 Div.Gems.Disciples with buff on sect will obtain 250 Div.Gems.So the quality of disciples and level of zone quest are very important.

Recast Pool：place you could add attributes on dicsiples.Disciples of the sect array would recast here.The spirit fluid consumed for recasting could be get from Destiny Tower.And you can also upgrade the recast pool by usting herbs and minerals

Sect Array：you could allocate disciples on it when you are going through the map or having a fight, with which you could add extra attributes on yourself.You can prior to allocating disciples with array buff.After upgrading, you can unlock more arrays with which you could add more attributes

Foreign Affairs Hall：you don't neeed to complete daily quest manually, but directly apply disciples with extra buff on foreign affairs, and you can just receive rewards after quest completed.

Wanfa Tower：place where you can make your own skills attached with 5-element DMG.Please remember that each Atlas could only be used once, unless you recast the already comprehended one.Please be careful for your choice.

Zhenpai Chamber：you can redeem Divine Fire by comsuming Tima Hourglass produced in Time Realm from Realm-Realm Merchant and refine Zhenpai Trump.The quality of Divine Fire is very important.The higher grade of Divine Fire used to refine, the higher buff on attributes you will get.

Xinhuo Chamber：open after passed through East Pole Islan, where you could transmit to disciples.Transmitting is inheriting the character attributes to disciples according to the percentage of transmitting progress.You can open the extra soul energy for direact disciples by consuming ensoul materials in the Ensoul Chamber.And you can upgrade the disciple sills in the Skill Hall.

text.赵公明就这么死了，祁云都觉得憋屈，那可是通天一代门人啊，申公豹故技重施，又跑到三:
Qi Yun feels really sorry for late Zhao Gongming, since he was the distinguished one among the first generation of disciples of Tongtian Jiaozhu.Shen Gongbao visits the Three Fairy Island to ask Zhao Gongming’s three sisters for help.Holy mothers of three skies(Qiongxiao, Yunxiao and Bixiao), or three Xiao Niangniangs, originally hesitate to extend a helpful hand, but after learning that their brother dies a tragic death they change their mind.
The three sisters, also among the first generation of disciples of Tongtian Jiaozhu, are in the possession of the Golden Dragon Scissors and the Universe Muddling Dipper.Though not as powerful as Zhao Gongming in terms of force, they are famous for a deadly trap that would bring great damage to superiormen of Chan sect.
Originally, they just intend to teach their Chan counterparts a lesson, but end up being sieged by them who regard the situation as very grave.
As Yunxiao is slashed upon by Jiang Ziya with his whip and Bixiao is wounded by Yang Jian's Sky Barking Hound, they in a great rage deploy a Yellow River Trap.
Jinzha, Muzha and Yang Jian, not knowing the immensity of heaven and earth, take the challenge but are thrown into the trap shortly afterwards, and had it not been for Qi Yun's disguise as Luya, Leizhenzi would have charged forth too.
It is well-recognized in Chan sect that when younger generation is in trouble, the elders should give a hand.Then here come a bunch of immortals including Randeng Daoren who are really confident, unaware of the trouble around the corner.
Yunxiao slashes her Unverse Muddling Dipper upon first Chijingzi and then Guangchengzi, both of whom are flung into the trap.
Then the rest hurry to rescue the captive as Calabash Brothers rescue their grandfather, with Wenshu Guangfa, Puxian Zhenren, Cihang Daoren, Daode Zhenjun, Taiyi Zhenren, Lingbao Fashi, Ju Liusun and Huanglong Zhenren all being taken into the formation, with only one exception of sharp-witted Randeng Daoren fleeing away through escape technique.

text.这场变故影响了岛上的所有人，春阳一派也遭到了围攻。\\n参与围攻的都是分神期之上:
The chaos affected everyone in the Island, and the Springsun Sect was also under attack.
Most of these attackers were cultivators above Spirit Separating stage, and some of them were masters of Virtuality Practicing stage.
These men in black never expected that these people were so weak.With a slap, Qiong Ying was kicked out miles away, with blood splashed around.Lu Chen blacked out immediately.The eldest disciple decided to give in at the beginning, but he saw Qiong and Lu.He got angry all of a sudden, and took out his real sword to have a fight with them.The sword cultivator was the most powerful of its kind with strong foundation.What's more, its initial being was transformed from the inborn sword-embryo.
Therefore, it was highly destructive.One of the men in black was hurt by the sword spirit emitted from the eldest disciple.The leader of the black group felt embarrassed because his member was hurt by a cultivator in the initial being stage.So he hit the eldest disciple extremely hard.It seemed that he wanted to kill the eldest disciple immediately.For them, the number of the hurt and the dead was limited to certain amount, after all.
The eldest disciple was not a rival to them.After several round of fighting, he was in danger.
Lu Chen still blacked out.The eldest disciple who was in trouble had to winked at Qiong Ying for help.Despite the bleeding, Qiong Ying struggled to stand up.

text.这次不光四圣，阐教全部一代、二代门人都到了。\\n截教也是全员出动，四大嫡传分列:
In addition to the four saints, all the members of the first and second generation disciples of Chan sect are involved in the battle.
Jie sect also turns out in full force, with four core disciples standing on the left and right of their master and twenty eight immortals in an aggressive posture, delivering a magnificence of the presence of ten thousand immortals.
Upon meeting the two parties start a fierce battle.
Chijingzi is the first to break the Tai Chi Trap and duels against Immortal Dark Cloud.As an immortal deprived of age-old Taoist attainment Chijingzi can hardly defeat his opposition and has no choice but to escape.Immortal Dark Cloud keeps pursuing him, but persuaded by Zhunti Daoren, he ends up becoming part of the Western Paradise, to the great rage of Tongtian.
When Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun enters the trap, Zhunti flips at his brain to reopen his brain soul and burst out three rays of light and gives him an ancient magic treasure.Activating the treasure, Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun not only subdues the trap but gains an avatar surrounded by lotus blossoms with pleasant aroma.Seized by great joy he then uses the Immortal Binding Rope to take the first immortal who's guarding the formation.Following the battle, the master is converted to Western religion.
As Puxian Zhenren enters the Two-Yi Trap, Yuanshi gives him a Tai Chi talisman which helps open his brain soul, inviting his avatar featured by a purple complexion and a huge mouth with fangs.His ferocious avatar then ties Immortal Spiritual Teeth with the same Immortal Binding Rope.In the wake of the war, Puxian follows his brothers to join the Western religion.
With Yuanshi's Jade Scepter Cihang Daoren enters the Four-Elephant Trap.Such a powerful magic treasure enables him to reveal his avatar too, and he defeats and captures the trap defender Immortal Golden Light.Cihang is initiated into Western religion too after the battle, and Guiling Shengmu becomes a disciple of Jieyin Daoren.It seems that the words Tongtian Jiaozhu told Daode Tianzun come true, "Now I am being bullied by others, so are you."
Seeing that the moment has come, Tongtian Jiaozhu shouts to Long Ear Dingguangxian for the Six-Soul Streamer, but to his surprise, the disciple turns a deaf ear to him and instead defects to Chan sect with the streamer.Anger engulfs him and almost leads him to fall off his buffalo.
He then pulls out his sword and decides to fight to the death, but ends up being defeated by the four saints, with all his disciples overpowered and his trap destroyed.As a result, most followers of his sect defect to Western religion except those who die or flee.
Seeing the situation is beyond salvation, Tongtian repels the crowd with his magical aura and tries to make the best use of all his magical powers to annihilate the world and create another.
The four saints who see through him want to halt him, but when they are on the point of stopping him, they behold in the south a Taoist priest with a bamboo stick surrounded by a thousand auspicious clouds, a thousand rays of air and curls of special fragrance.The man is nobody but Hongjun Laozu.
With an absolute authority, the master separates the crowd and has his three disciples Yuanshi, Daode and Tongtian prostrate in a line.After criticizing them all and giving Tongtian a particular lesson, he orders each of them to take a poison pill, which would bring an end to their life no matter who they are the moment they come into conflict with each other again.The three who are deeply ashamed of themselves, nod repeatedly in approval.
The battle between the three sects has finally come to an end.

text.这老道打扮的老头自称半个仙人着实是谦虚了，1500年前封神一役中，他便是大名鼎鼎:
The old man dressed like a Taoist called himself as half immortal being, which was too modest.He was the well-known Zhunti in the Battle of Deification 1,500 years ago.
Prior to the Battle of Deification, the predecessor of Buddhism, the Western Religion, was born in the remote western region.Zhunti was the second in command in the Religion.
Compared with the vast east land, the west was much smaller.And people here were uncivilized.Therefore, the number of followers was not very big.
For this reason, the chief of the Religion Jieyindaoren and the second in command Zhunti traveled long distance to the Battle of Deification to support the Chanjiao Religion, with the purpose of expanding their religious sect.
In the end, the Jiejiao Religion was defeated and broken into pieces due to the combined strike of the Western Religion and Chanjiao Religion.So the Western Religion took this chance to incorporate many disciples who were in the Jiejiao Religion before into Western Religion.In addition to some widely recognized figures such as Wenshu, Cihang, Puxian, Randeng, Duobao and Kongxuan, there were a large number of disciples who were called the Three-Thousand Disciples of secular world in the Immortal Diagram.
The growing of the Western Religion led to the alert of the east.Therefore, the east invited the Religion to join in and to prosper together in the official identity of the Heaven.By doing so, the east could place constraint on the Religion.Jieyindaoren realized that he could not refuse the invitation, so he accepted it.
While the Religion was under the constraint of the Heaven, it dispersed the seed of its religion on the land of the east.And in order to attract more followers, Jieyindaoren updated the tenet of the Religion.
When it comes to the development of the Religion, it was necessary to have a understanding of the history of these religious sects in the east.
There were numerous sects in the east whether they were small or big.But they were originated from Taoism.And the Taoist tents can be concluded as follow：when one was born, he exists in this world.And he should cultivate his inner mind and refine his character as well.The ultimate goal of Taoism is to cultivated into an immortal being.At the same time, all followers should respect nature and learn from nature.Since different people have different understanding towards these tenets, so quite a number of different sects emerge.However, only very few people can be immortal beings because most of people in the secular world are ordinary people.What's worse, some greedy individuals swindled people out of money and even committed murder in the name of immortal cultivation and refining elixirs.As a result, traditional Taoism met with mixed reputation.
Seizing on this point, Jieyindaoren localized the tenet of Mahayana which advocates the saving of the universe.But now it advocates that life is a tough journey it is true for this life and the next life.One can escape from such a circle and get relived after death.As for the way how to get relieved, it is pointless to stress the method because all methods will end up with nothing.
Such an universal solution quickly ignited people's enthusiasm.For those who have a poor background, are in a decline family, fail to have a beloved one, and who don't have a smooth career, they can find out the root of their misery.And the solution is easy to understand：just to hold a strong faith that the world is itself tough, and to endure all the sufferings will gain release after death.
Since one cannot tell it is right or not after death, the tenet met with wide popularity.All of a sudden, a great number of people followed the Religion.Later it was renamed as Buddhism.
It was exactly at this time when Zhunti split with Jieyindaoren.The current Buddhism was far away from what it was insisted by himself at the beginning.He could accept his own mistakes during this process.But if the destination had changed, he could not move forward anymore.

text.这一年雷震子上山，云中子收了这个徒弟，也代表着对商朝的彻底失望和背离。陈塘关总兵:
This year, Yunzhongzi takes Leizhenzi as a disciple, representing that he is completely disappointed at and gives up the Shang Dynasty.
Nezha, the youngest son of military commander Li Jing of Chentang Pass, is now seven years old.When Qi Yun switches the shot, he sees Nezha riding on the third prince of the Dragon King and beating him, and what happens afterwards is just as it is in the book.
Later generations of films and televisions have coincidentally depicted Nezha as a young hero who goes from a childish and capricious boy to a prodigal son, but in the book the Creation of the Gods Nezha can be considered a problem child through and through, which is caused by education issue.
First of all, Li Jing and his wife fail to pay much attention to the mind of Nezha who is precocious, but always either scold or take sides in him when he causes troubles.What's more, Nezha's master Taiyi Zhenren, is also a man who is to blame.Because what he always tells Nezha who kills Yaksha, rips out the dragon tendons of Ao Bing(the third prince) and bullies Dragon King is, "Don't be afraid, I’ll be always on your side.You are the reincarnation of spirit pearl, and the way of heaven is irreversible.Killing a few people is not a big deal".
When Nezha mischievously kills a servant of stone spirit Shiji Niangniang with his Xuanyuan arrow and seeks protection in his cave, Taiyi first takes Yuanshi Tianzun and the way of heaven as excuse and then even kills Shiji Niangniang.With such an educational background, it will be surprising that Nezha does not grow up to be a problem child who is selfish, arrogant and domineering.
In the same year, Nezha dies and then is recreated by Taiyi with lotus flowers, and everything moves forward in a step-by-step manner.

One day at dusk, the white horse was hungry.Bukong looked for a place to beg food and some food for horse.He came to the Gaolaozhuan Village where bustled with citizens.Soon he found a inn.After getting some food and food for horse from the inn owner, he ate in a corner.
When he was eating, a male servant rushed into the inn, and shouted loudly.He was looking for a master who can conquer devils.The inn owner answered, "What a coincidence.The monk sitting in the southeast of the corner, table 198, is a master.He is an expert in conquering devils."
The servant came to Bukong and knelt down immediately.He asked Bukong to help eliminate a devil.
Bukong thought to himself "Oh, you guys are really good actors.How can you know that I am a master.You can recognize me despite my obscure seat.Alas, maybe I shouldn't have a meal at here.Can't you guys wait until I finish my meal to play a trick? Fine! Fine!"
Although Bukong made a complaint in his mind, he stood to help the servant up, and said, "Don't do that.Just show me the way."
The story goes that, the Mr Gao once came across a land slide on a heavily pouring day.He was rescued by the monster incarnated from pig.In order to express his thanks, he arranged a job in his mansion for the pig monster.
The monster had lived in here for many years, but he didn't commit anything evil.Instead, he helped villagers who were lost in the mountain.The rescue of Mr Gao made Gao treated the monster as human.Many people praised it very much.And the story helped Mr Gao achieve a good reputation which in return helped Gao to be elected as the chairman of the village.But things changed later.
There were three daughters in Gao family.The eldest married a squire.The second daughter marries a well-off man.So when it comes to the youngest daughter, Mr Gao hoped to find a live-in son-in-law to complete the family.The most affluent family in local village had a single son who was a little numb after his birth.Except this, they had the same family background and were a quite match.So Mr Gao approved this marriage.
However, the pig monster coveted the property of Gao family, so he returned ingratitude for kindness.He cast a spell on the daughter.Consequently the daughter locked herself and the monster into the backyard.She cried and even threatened to commit a suicide if the family tried to persuade her.She said she would marry no one except the pig monster.
When Mr Gao described this, he emotionally asked Bukong to conquer the monster without any guilty.

text.周天子与商纣王的胜败基本尘埃落定，三教之争却正要迎来高潮--通天教主进场。\\n:
While the result of the war between the king of Zhou Dynasty and King Zhou of the Shang Dynasty has been clearly defined, the battle between the three sects is reaching its climax - with the presence of Tongtian Jiaozhu.
Initially when Tongtian Jiaozhu signed on the list of creations, he thought the other two sects were also signing the "safety waiver" for their disciples.But now, as he sees that many of his own elites including Zhao Gongming and three Xiao Niangniangs have been dead and assigned to the list while those killed among the other two sects are only some nonentities, coupled with the instigation of Duobao Daoren, anger surges and an intense hatred suddenly arises in his heart.
When Guangchengzi who killed Huoling Shengmu visits Biyou palace to return her relics magic treasures, he is held back by other disciples of Jie sect there and forced to pay three visits.Tongtian Jiaozhu who is already angry, then flies into a fury when he is reported by Duobao, an expert in adding fuel to the fire, that Guangchengzi once swore most of his disciples as wicked beasts.
Yes, what's been disturbing him for years is the scorn of his two brothers though he is skilled enough.And now they even look down on his own disciples, which he could ill endure.As a result, fury empowers him to set up the Immortal Execution Sword Array.
The Immortal Execution Sword Array, said to be the most ferocious battle formation in the world, is unmatched in killing and destroying and is also the most important treasure and defender of Jie sect.
It is believed that when Pangu intended to create the world, three-thousand celestial demons unaware of the will of heaven stood in his way; then the Immortal Execution Sword Array was delivered to bring an end to those demons.Following this, as Pangu regarded the formation diagram and its four swords as a barrier to the harmony of heavens, he sealed them off at Mount Sumeru the birthplace of the Western land.
Later, Hongjun somehow gained the swords and the diagram and passed them on to his most favored younger disciple, Tongtian Jiaozhu, at the Treasure-Sharing Hill.He said, "You are upright and outspoken.I am now giving you the Four Immortal Execution Swords and the formation diagram, then you will be unparalleled in killing and destroying.But remember, don't employ them as you please."
Faced with the formation, followers of Chan sect realize the situation is really grave.Yuanshi Tianzun and Daode Tianzun come personally to break the formation, but are soon put into a quandary since they fail to handle it unless they have another two superior men.

text.纣王12年，姜子牙在西岐已经钓了一年多的鱼，经常怀念起当初在昆仑山修道的日子。\:
In the 12th year of King Zhou’s reign, Jiang Ziya who has been fishing in Xiqi for over a year often misses his days as a cultivator at Mount Kunlun.
As an optimistic man by nature who harbored no lofty ideals, he merely aimed at achieving immortality in the first place when he became a cultivator at the age of thirty-two.Though not highly skilled after forty years of study at Mount Kunlun due to his mediocrity, he feels content since he can at least prolong his life by absorbing all day long the essence of the sun and the moon surrounding the mountain.
One day, his master suddenly sent him to the mortal world, to seemingly assist the King of Zhou Dynasty to be to defeat King Zhou of Shang Dynasty while secretly carry out the task of creating the gods.Then he knew that his peaceful life ground to a halt, but soon accepted the reality thanks to his optimistism.
In the first year after his departure from the mountain, he has experienced failures in business, political career and marriage, so in an old age, he is childless, wifeless, having no money nor status.In such a case, average people may grow depressed, but he can still enjoys fishing everyday by a tributary of the Wei River (near today's Xi'an).
And Ji Chang, the Marquis of the West, has just experienced the most painful thing in life：losing his son.
After successfully fooling King Zhou, he escapes from Zhao Ge overnight with the help of Huang Feihu, and is escorted by Leizhenzi(his adopted son) down the mountain to cross the five passes.
However, after fleeing back to Xiqi, he is saddened to find that he does not even have the intention of taking revenge on King Zhou any more.
Yes, he’s grown old, not physically but mentally.
All his vigour has been eaten away by the seven years of life in jail in Zhao Ge, subsequent dangerous escape has left him physically and mentally exhausted, and now all he wants is to spend his rest of life in peace in Xiqi.
But how can the wish of an old man outweigh the will of heaven?
With a wave of an old man from eight-view palace, a flying bear comes into his dream, bringing him resurgence of ambitions.
Then the Wei River sees Ji Chang clutching Jiang Ziyia's hand.
Jiang foresees Ji’s success, and Ji sees Jiang’s happiness to live in peace and contentment.
This is what they want to see, and perhaps they may be helpful to each other.
King Wen’s meeting and employing Ziya by the Wei River heralds the oncoming war.
text.纣王七年，三月十五，女娲诞辰，祁云算好了日子，在百度地图输入了女娲宫，镜头便转移:
It is the 7th year of King Zhou's reign; and the day March 13 on the lunar calendar is the birthday of Nuwa.Calculating the date and inputting Nuwa Palace into his Baidu map, Qi Yun comes into sight the palace through a camera lens.
It consists of hall and attic that are neat and tidy, with two servant statues of boy and girl standing side by side, so grand that one may feel awed just looking at it.
As for King Zhou, one of his sins is reluctance to worship heaven and show respect for gods and immortals, which in fact will be a good example of not believing in blind faith and not spreading it.But in ancient times, when the king's power is bestowed by heaven, it is a smear if he is loath to respect it.
Indeed, King Zhou does not like this kind of etiquette, as he can be seen now walking to the palace while dozing off supported by his ministers carefully, with a reluctant look on his face.He is unaware at all that his every move is being broadcast live.
If Qi Yun is powerful enough, he would have noticed that there are more than a dozen mind senses from different directions snooping in the palace at the same time.
It seems that King Zhou is not as thievish-looking as written in the book; instead, he is tall and extraordinarily handsome.At the moment he is is about to leave after paying his respects in a perfunctory manner without any sign of getting funny with the statue of Nuwa, which makes Qi Yun doubt if he is mistaken in terms of the date.
Suddenly a mind sense from the direction of Da Luo Mountain becomes very strong, leading to an evil wind to roll up the light curtain in front of the statue of the Goddess.She looks so beautiful that she can compare with a fairy like Chang'e coming down from heaven, and even Qi Yun is dumbfounded for a moment when he sees her.
The king who is drowsy and fails to know what's happening, is on the point of leaving, while ministers accompanying him stand there in a daze at the sight of the Goddess's face.
Then the king bumps into a minister to the ground with a thud, and the minister comes back to his senses and hastens to beg for pardon, while King Zhou waves his hand to tell him to disappear from his sight.Then, following everyone's gaze, the king comes into sight of Nuwa's statue.He feels fascinated and is assigned to a daze by her compelling beauty, with his breath quickening.
When he regains his senses, he sends his guard for writing brush, ink stick, ink slab and paper, and slowly writes on the wall of the palace a poem：
You are like the moon above that yao platform, and it is a pity that I was born in an imperial family where personal feelings must make concessions.If there is an afterlife, I hope to be a small Taoist priest rather than a king, so that I can always be by your side.
After finishing writing, he gives three respectful bows to the statue of the Goddess and turns around and leaves resolutely.
As if they are waking from a dream, the ministers behind him feel ashamed of this poem, with faces flushing, and do nothing but to follow their king to leave quietly.
Qi Yun begins to feel confused at this moment, as he is sure that this person is King Zhou after applying his identification skill to him, but what this poem expresses is ...obviously a man's deep confession and regret without any sign of desecrating the gods.Is it true that the plot of the story in this world will be different?
As Qi Yun ponders, the owners of other mind senses who see this also fall into silence.After a long time, a mind sense from Kunlun Mountains becomes stronger, and then Qi Yun seems to see an old man waving the sleeve of his daoist robe against the wall of the palace.With a breeze blows by, he can see clearly the verses on the wall：
The Fengluan curtain is of great delicacy, and the statue of the Goddess is gilded.The winding hills and mountains are lush and green, and the beauty in dress looks like dancing.Her cheek is as pink as pear blossoms drenched by rain, with make-up as charming as peony.If she, the lovely Goddess, is a real person, I must fetch her back to my palace to be one of my concubines.

Deity Slain Array

text.准提的提前出场以及祁云加入西方教，似乎并没有对事情的推进产生什么影响。\\n魔家:
Zhunti's ahead-of-schedule appearance and Qi Yun's joining the Western religion seem not to play a great role in advancing the story.
The news of the defeat of the four generals spreads back to Zhao Ge and brings an outbreak of panic at the court.After all, the four were in everybody's mind's eye impregnable city wall, and now that wall has crumbled, the people behind it are as weak as ants.
The Grand Old Master Wen Zhong has not slept a wink.As the official who’s served three generations of kings of Shang, he has dedicated his life to the country.
Grateful to the appreciation of the wise former king, he would like to die for him.
Now though the descendant of that king is fatuous and brutal, he only lectures him as if he was one of his own sons, never giving him up.
Looking at the chaotic court, Wen Zhong sinks into a deep bow in the direction of the late king’s grave, "Such being the case, I Wen Zhong, an incompetent official, would like to fight in person on the battlefield".
In the 22nd year of King Zhou's reign, Wen Zhong himself launches an offensive against Xiqi, on behalf of the last glory of the great Shang Dynasty.

text.紫霄宫中三位教主都签了排行榜，却各自有各自的算盘，这里先不细表。\\n且看东方大:
The three godfathers in the Zixiao palace all signed names on the list, but each had their own plans.But let's not go into detail here and move on.
Now let's shift our attention to the Central Plains of the East.It had been more than 500 years since Cheng Tang overthrew the tyrant Jie at the end of the Xia Dynasty and established the Shang Dynasty.
The current ruler was Di Xin, the thirtieth king of the country, also known to later generations as King Zhou.He was born with great strength and intelligence, and under his reign, he valued men of talents and took active steps internally to develop agriculture to strengthen his country; and waged wars externally to expand the territory of the Shang Dynasty.
The 5th year of Di Xin's reign was both an extremely unfortunate and extraordinarily fortunate year for four-year-old Qi Yun.
Unfortunately, the small southern vassal state in which Qi Yun's family lived was involved in a rebellion and defeated by the Shang Dynasty, making its people become prisoners.
Fortunately, King Zhou enacted a very important policy that year：instead of slaughtering the captives, he allowed them to participate in productive work as slaves.
So young Qi Yun went with his parents as slaves to Zhao Ge, the capital of the Shang Dynasty, and was then assigned to the manor of one noble as a private property.
His parents, ordinary farmers, soon adapted to their new life after a brief period of initial trepidation.In the south they had farmed for landlord, and now they did the same, and their new master was so generous that they would have food left over for the year.As farmers they felt satisfied with this, as simple as their ancestors had ever been.
It was Qi Yun, however, who always looked so miserable and dazed in the distance for a whole afternoon, that his mother was very worried about him.Fortunately, he had been always quiet and in good health.So in this case, his mother would take him in her arms and hum him a nursery rhyme she had learned in childhood.
Qi Yun has a sadness that is hard to be understood by anyone, because he is a time traveler.
Qi Yun, also called Qi Yun before he time-traveled to the past, is originally a well-educated and ethics-observant university student who doubts ideals and discipline while believes in socialism.He somehow becomes the 4-year-old Qi Yun on one occasion when he used the applet"Test your ancient identity" which is popular in Wechat moments.
After spending six months confirming that he is neither rich nor gifted, he cheers himself up and makes up his mind to make his own way in the world.But all of sudden he is involved in a war and inexplicably made a slave.Qi Yun touches the slave mark on his face put by someone with a branding iron, humming a song by Mao Buyi slowly in his heart, "A good person like me should have lived a brilliant life, but at the age of just five, I am leading a miserable life as a slave.
text.自从拿到葫芦后，总是挂在胸口。\\n今晚，练功完毕后将葫芦解下放在桌上，打算喂养:
Since you bring the gourd back, it has always been hanging on your chest.
Tonight after practising, you unhook and put it on the table, intending to put it on again when you finish feeding the spirit beast and begin to meditate and cultivate.
But the time when you try to put it on, you find that it is slightly heavier than usual.Then you open it and look inside, only to find there is something liquid-like at the bottom.Taking a bowl, you pour out a green drop of water from it, which emits a green light accompanied by an inexplicably faint fragrance.
You remain alert, thinking it's better to explore the water drop's effects tomorrow.

text.自入门起，时间已满三年。今天，宗门将要举行新入弟子入门考核。\\n来到传功殿后，:
Three years have passed since your initiation into the sect.Today, the sect is going to give you freshmen an examination.
When you come to the Chuangong Hall, you are asked by the Elder there to take turns to release your spiritual energy onto the Spiritual Disc to make it shine, a way to measure your cultivation progress according to the brightness of the disc.
You are the first to take the test.You press your palm on the disc and whisper your spell, only to see the disc gradually gives out light.
"Xing Daorui, you've reached early-stage Qi Refining.Excellent." the Elder praises you.
You breathe a sigh of relief, knowing that your practice has paid off.
The test comes to an end, and only you and the other disciple have succeeded in the Qi condensation stage among all the freshmen.Later, the rest who fail the exam but wish to stay in the sect will be considered as informal disciples or lay brothers.

text.通关东极岛后，即可开启化圣之路\\n\\n1、化圣分为功德成圣、斩三尸成圣和以力:
After passing the East Pole Island, you could start the jouney to ascend.

1、Currently, sainting is divided into Merits Sainting, Cutting 3-corpse Sainting and Power Sainting, Merits need the time accumulation, while Cutting 3-corpse depends on attributes and levels.
2、After ascending by Power Sainting, you can continue to challenge other monsters to obtain the Rules rewards on them, the Rules effects need to be equipped to take effect.
3、Merits Saint need to complete the quests from the Merits Hall in Heaven to accumulate merits; and Cutting 3-corpse need the qualification in level which you need to redeem the materials to reveal 3-corpse in all layers of the Cloud Nine.Lower Corpse material：layer 1-5, Midium Corpse material：layer 6-9, Upper Corpse material：layer 10-11.
4、The source of the Heavenly Rules materials consumed during sainting, Cloud Nine：9-11 levels, Heaven Palace - Heavenly Lord Vault, the store of the Time River.
5、You can choose your Primary Power after sainting, Primary Power can provide higher buff, choose and upgrade it according to your needs.
6、Time River, the new instance zone of Outland opened after sainting, whose maps are in accordance with the ancient mythologies.You could make a choice after you finished one lever to change some result, and the correspoding map will be changed also.

Instructions of Sect Forgien Affairs：

text.1.天赋伴随元神而生，可同时在主世界和元世界中使用多种天赋技能，暴击天赋除外。\:
1.Talent points are generated through the Essence Soul, acquired Talents affect both the Main World and the Essence Soul World, excluding Talents that affect CRI.
2.Some Talents are mutually exclusive, not all Talents can be activated at the same time.
3.Talent Points are obtained when the Essence Soul increases in level.
4.Skills obtained through Talents can still be upgraded even if the Talent has been reset, Talent must be reactivated to equip skill.
5.When activating Talents, the extra cost talent points are not calculated into accumulated consumption.
6.Extra cost occurs when activating Talents on multiple Talent trees.
7.Yuan Qi can be used to cover the extra cost instead of using Talent points.
8.When traveling in the Essence Soul World, there is a low chance to obtain Yuan Qi orbs.

1、Currently, sainting is divided into Merits Sainting, Cutting 3-corpse Sainting and Power Sainting, Merits need the time accumulation, while Cutting 3-corpse depends on attributes and levels.

5、You can choose your Primary Power after sainting, Primary Power can provide higher buff, choose and upgrade it according to your needs.
6、Time River, the new instance zone of Outland opened after sainting, whose maps are in accordance with the ancient mythologies.You could make a choice after you finished one lever to change some result, and the correspoding map will be changed also.
7、Sage Remains, the first time pass each level of each difficulty can obtain the optional pack, you can pass the easy levels first, and then see the demand for suit attributes to pass the corresponding level

text.境界从低到高分为：炼气、筑基、金丹、元婴、分神、合体、炼虚、大乘、游仙、真仙、玄:

 Attainment gaining method 
1、Div.Jade Tower, Dark Gold Chamber, 7-day activity etc.to buy sutras to improve practice speed 
2、Disciple practice in the sect Aerify Peak, Elder transmission etc.
3、Alchemy, dual-cultivation, Dragon Realm etc.to obtain attainment 
4、Aimless Quiddity Orb， Ultimate Quiddity Orb etc.to improve practice speed 
 The higher phase you are in, the more functions you will open and the more game plays you will have.

1.Open the function of Enlightenment of Fairy School after reached <Veinify G.1> 
2.Enlightenment Time：Monday to Friday, rest on Saturday and Sunday 
3.Set different enlightenment types from Monday to Friday, and the added attribute types will also be different 
4.Each Fairchild chooses Deity Emperor Class or Tao Ancestor Class for enlightenment every day （there is only one chance to choose very day and can't be changed） 
5.Fairy School enlightenment attribute will be converted into character attribute according to the Fairchild's quality 
6.Fairchild will get 1 credit for each enlightenment, which will be used for listed on Credit Ranking.The credits will be cleared at 24：00 every Saturday 
7.The Credit Ranking lists the rankings of all enlightenment Fairchild this week （according to the ranking of credits, the same credits are ranked according to the time of achievement） 
8.The Credit Ranking is reset at 24 o'clock every Saturday, and reward of Credit Ranking is issued at 24 o'clock every Saturday （each Fairchild on the list can get a reward） 
9.Enlightenment event follows this enlightenment and will be cleared when enlightenment ends 
10.When the Fairchild inherits：the Fairy School attribute will also be inherited

text.在天枢宫已经待了有些日子了。\\n大师兄、琼英和陆沉都已经结出元婴，算是摸到了道:
I have been in Tianshu Palace for some days.
 My eldest martial brother, Qiong Ying and Lu Chen have all upgraded into Nascence period, which can be regarded as touching the door of Tao.
 Eldest martial brother entered the Tao with swordsmanship, reached the phase of Nascence G.8.His Nascence is a sword fetus.Normally the swordsmen are all people who hone themselves.But the eldest martial brother's appearance of being pampered is somehow favored.
 Qiong Ying also entered the Tao with swordsmanship, which is not surprising.No one can hone herself better than her.Now her attainment is Nascence G.6.
 Lu Chen entered the Tao with "dexterity", which is also one of the three thousand paths but a narrow path, which is specializing in alchemy, blacksmith, arrays and spells and even some spagyrics in it.It is the way that using external things to form the Tao rather than cultivation oneself.Therefore, the upgrading of phase is dawdling, just reached Nascence G.1.
 The day of the 10th Fairy Gathering of the Tianshu Palace is coming.Recalling the previous gathering, all immortals came to celebrate with unprecedented grandeur.Chen Tanlang, as the head of the Big Dipper seven liters, has faintly got the power to summon all from the world.
 This year, the gathering is even more extraordinary.The Roche Dynasty sent LV Xilin, the owner of Star Picking TOwer, to confer a great name and recruited Chen Tanlang to be the new owner.While Chen Tanlang unexpectedly refused.Practitioners originally pursue freedom, and the ones in the imperial court were despised by others.
 Emissary Zhang Junhong was not surprised when he received the reply of rejection.He just asked to stay temporarily on Tianshu Island and join the gathering as to fulfill the duty of supervision.The island owner was polite to them and arranged their accommodation and daily living.
 There are continuously some practitioners arrived early who all moved into Tianshu island.
 On the night three days before the gathering was held, accidents occurred on the island.The imperial court envoy Zhang Junhong and the practitioners moved onto island sbefore suddenly launched attack on the practitioners on Tianshu island.
 Many disciples on the island rebelled.Under the combination of inside and outside, most practitioners on Tianshu Island were controlled.The island owner Chen Tanlang, along with a small number of elite disciples, was trapped in Tianshu Palace.
 Zhang Junhong, the messenger of the Star Picking Tower, threatened with all practitioners’ lives on the island, and the island owner finally surrended.In fact, he could continue to resist until the arrival of backup.But he could not watch his disciples and grandchildren die on the spot.
 The day before the gathering, Tianshu Island announced to all over the world that the gathering of this year was cancelled.And the island owner Tanlang took the position of the Elder of Star Picking Tower.

text.“记住杀你的人，小朋友。我叫漫歌，下辈子投胎的时候看着点人。”说完漫歌便挥刀砍向: "Do remember the one who killed you, young kid.Things will be better in your next life." Saying so, Man Ge swung his sword at your neck.Just as you were to accept that destiny, a sudden voice came down, forcing the sharp blade to stay unmoving."That should be enough.Sorry to mess your plan up, boy." Seeing this, Man Ge put away his weapon, and bowed deeply to the old man, "My apologies, master.I'll leave as you wish."\nWatching that man slowly disappeared in your sight, you promised to yourself that, you won't live in peace unless Man Ge and his family are completely destroyed.

text.1、法宝内丹、主材在<color=#4f9a12>门派藏宝阁</color>，<:
1、Trump main materials and Inner Orbs can be obtained from the <color=#4f9a12>Sect Treasure, Exploration, training map （starting from Mt.Buzhou）, Deity Market</color> etc.
\n2、After turning on the automatic infusing essence for 7-star Array, the 7-star Array will take priority for essence infusion.
\n3、You can activate <color=#4f9a12>set effects</color> by refining trumps using <color=#4f9a12>Inner Orbs</color> , but you can also refine trumps without using Inner Orbs.
\n4、When refining, choosing different opening times will give different effects like TaiYin, TaiYang etc.
\n5、The higher attributes trump has, the higher its grade will be.You can increase trump's attributes by leveling it up.
\n6、You need to reach the specified Blacksmith level to be able to refine trumps.If the assisting materials are not enough, the refining success rate will be reduced.
\n7、You can equip <color=#4f9a12>multiple trumps of the same type</color> , and trumps can be dismantled to obtain materials.
\n8、Trumps that has been refined can be fused to replace the Inner Orb effect of the trump, and the fusion has a chance to fail.
\n9、If two different Inner Orbs are put in, the effect of the Inner Orb after fusion will be randomly chosen from the two.
\n10.The Trump Qi will be increased at Mao time, Strength will be increased at Wu time, Health will be increased at You time, and Agility will be increased at Zi time.
\n11.Refined trumps （artifacts） could be upgraded with star levels （max of 5 stars） through quenching to obtain stronger attributes.Upgraded trumps equipped in 7-star Array could provide <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color> attribute, <color=#4f9a12>the higher</color> Divine Stamp is, the less DMG will receive in fighting.
\n12.When the total star levels of trumps in the 7-star Array reached some extent, it will unlock connecting <color=#4f9a12>Infinite Star Shining</color> , providing special effects in fighting.

text.仿佛回到了孩时，他总是紧紧攥住你的衣袖，生怕你遗失在人流之中。总是嘴角带笑的看着: It felt as if you were back in your childhood, when he used to look at you with a smile and grip your sleeve so tightly lest you get lost in the crowd.
text.闭合的折扇有意无意敲打着扶手，慵懒的眼神貌似没有任何焦点。他目前对任何事情都提不: He kept knocking an arm of the chair with his folding fan, his eyes wandering about.He seemed uninterested in anything at the moment.
text.他眼神冰冷，嘴角没有一丝笑意。从紧握的双拳可以看出，目前他的心情并不愉悦。: His eyes were cold and face unsmiling, with his clenched fists indicating his displeasure.
text.像一尊平静的布娃娃一样躺在躺椅上，不吃不说，轻眯着眼睛，看不出一丝喜怒。: He was lying on a chaise longue like a quiet doll, neither eating nor saying anything.All his emotions were hidden in his squinted eyes.
text.把坐在他腿上的你紧紧搂入怀中，力道有些蛮横，恨不得把你融入他的身体。老远能听到一: He held you, sitting on his lap, into his arms in an almost violent way, as if trying to absorb you into his own body.His heart beat was loud enough to be heard even in the distance.
text.她眼神冷清，白净如雪的脸庞没有一丝笑意。眉关紧锁，冷若冰霜，宛若临凡的雪山仙子。: She had icy eyes and a pale, unsmiling face.Frowning coldly, she looked like a fairy from the snowy mountains.
text.时间仿佛在这一刻静止，相拥的两人成为刹那天地的焦点。: Time seemed frozen at this moment.The couple embracing each other becomes the center of the whole world.
text.轻轻的环拥，你可以清晰听到他炙热心脏的有力跳动。: In his gentle arms you could clearly hear his warm heart beating powerfully.
text.用力将他拥入怀中，你可以清晰感受到他双手驻留在你背后的僵硬和无措。: Holding him firmly in you arms, you could feel his flustered hands behind your back seeking a place to rest.
text.你的拥抱让他紧皱的眉头有所舒展，但男人的自尊，让他决定与你暂时保持距离。: His frown seemed to have relieved a bit with your hug, but he decided to maintain the distance between you and him out of his pride as a man.
text.突如其来的拥抱，让他感觉不适。情绪宣泄的出口一刹那被堵塞。: He felt somewhat uneasy because of the sudden hug, His outlet of emotions is suddenly blocked.
text.你的拥抱，让他紧绷的脸开始有了一丝绽放的微笑。: Your hug added a light smile to his serious look.
text.他用力回抱，并亲吻了你的头顶。鼻息的热气让你觉得异常温馨。: He responded with a firm embrace and a kiss on the top of your head.His warm breath brought you a homely feeling.
text.沉默是他对抗你的最佳方式，但忽然的拥抱让他不知所措。: Silence is his best weapon against you, but the sudden hug surprises him.

text.有阴阳两面，阳是生，阴是死，拥有掌控生死之能。: It has two sides:Yang representing life, and Yin representing death.It has the power to control life and death.
text.混沌青莲的莲茎结合天地间凶煞之气化为弑神枪，可伤圣人。: The stem of he blue lotus of chaos mixed all evil spirits in the world and became the Gold-Slaying Spear, which has the power to hurt immortals.
text.太上扁拐: The Flat Stick of the Supreme Lord
text.鸿蒙开辟三年，采一片阳晶芭蕉叶，交予童子扇焰，过得一量劫，沾染融合兜率火所成。: Three year after the primitive world was created, a Palm-Leaf was given to the apprentice to fan the fire.A Kalpa later, the leaf fused with Doushuai's flame and became the fan.
text.摇晃可令敌人魂不附体，失魂落魄，从而昏倒不醒人事。: When shaken, it stupefies and stuns its enemies, causing them to faint.
text.以古陨星炼成，外形只是一根簪子，神气内敛。: Made from an ancient fallen star, it seems ordinary just like a normal hairpin.
text.蕴含日月灵气的宝珠，可祭起攻击敌人，令人防不胜防。: An orb containing the spirit of the sun and moon.Can be used to start a surprise attack.
text.混沌青莲半成熟莲子所化。灯高有九寸，其形作宝莲盛开，大有海碗，莲心即是灯心。: A nine-inch lantern derived from the half-mature seed of the blue lotus of chaos.It has the shape of a blossoming lotus and the size of a large bowl, with its core as the central part of the flower.
text.天道规则凝结而成，内含各种无上伟力，可化各种属性攻击。: Made from the concentration of all laws in the universe.It contains strong power that can turn into attack of different elements.
text.高四五丈有余，光分五彩，可召命天下妖族。: With a height of over 40 feet and iridescent light, it has the power to summon all demons in the world.
text.上古祖龙的龙角，锋利无比，坚不可摧。: Horn of the elder dragon.Its extremely sharp and can break all defense.
text.老君以昆仑山下一美玉雕琢而成，后乘水乘丹养成灵气，为玉净瓶，可颠覆阴阳。: Carved from a fine piece of jade by the supreme lord and developed spirit with the nurturing of water and orbs.The clean vase of jade can switch Yin and Yang.
text.环体洁白无瑕，投掷攻击，百发百中。: A perfectly white jade ring.After thrown out, it never misses its target.
text.灯内有一团金色火焰，名唤万灵古燚。相传此火有探查万灵之能。: A golden flame named Ancient Flame of Ten-Thousand-Ghosts hides burns in the center of the lantern.It's told the flame can detect any ghost.
text.玉虚琉璃灯: Glazed Glass Lantern of Void Jade
text.以吸收了天地五行精气的桃木制作而成，可降服百鬼。: Made from peach wood that absorbed the spirit of 5-elements in the world.Capable of defeating all ghosts.
text.枪刃有三个尖端，枪缨为紫色火焰，蕴藏着无穷的力量，为斩妖除魔、诛兵屠将的神兵利器: A trident with purple flame as its tessel.It contains infinite power for killing demons and monsters.
text.此剪乃是两条蛟龙，采天地灵气，受日月精华，起在空中，往来上下，祥云护体，头并头如: The scissors are formed by two dragons that collected spirit of heaven and earth and absorbed essens of the sun and the moon.Flying in the sky along with clouds, their bodies crosses each other's and form the scissors.
text.此宝装于一个红葫芦内，真形不明，放出白色毫光即现封住对手元神法力，使其无法逃脱。: Contained in a red gourd, the treasue's real shape remains unknown.It can release a stream of white light that seals its opponent's power to escape.
text.三十六品造化青莲莲叶所化，剑长三尺六寸五分，有青色莲花覆绕其上，通天教主证道法宝: Derived from the leaf of the blue lotus with 36 levels of variation, the sword has a length of 4 feet and is surrounded by blue lotus flower.A treasure used by the Sky Bishop to prove his Way.
text.老子之物，坐禅之宝，此宝是一个具有收人收物神力的坐垫，蕴含风与火大道，故名风火蒲: The treasure of Lao Tsu.A sitting cushion with the power of containing both people and items.It's named Wind-Fire Cushion for the power it contains.It can also summon fighters for you.
text.只要抓得敌人气息，便用降法拜进幡中，不论何时何地，三魂七魄不知不觉被蛊虫吞噬，以: Once it catches the existence of its enemies anytime or anywhere, it confines them under the flag.The enemies' soul will be swallowed by worms and vanish along with their bodies.
text.至金至刚之宝，由黄金打造，坚不可摧，投掷而出能暴击万物，可改变大小。: A treasure of utmost hardness.It's made of gold and impossible to break.Attacks anything critically once thrown out.It's size can be changed freely.
text.暗藏风火之力，可踏在脚下代步，飞快如风，火速冲天。: It contains the power of wind and fire, and can be used to travel.Its speed compares to wind and flame.
text.元始天尊执掌之宝，三十六品造化青莲莲藕所化，白玉如意，投掷攻击，打人天灵盖，使人: A treasure possessed by the Primeval Lord.A Ruyi scepter made of white jade derived from the root of the blue lotus with 36 levels of variation.When released, it hits the enemies on head and deprive them of power.
text.剑内蕴一鸾凤，祭出后可自动追敌。: The sword contains a phoenix inside it, which can pursue its enemy automatically when released.
text.汲取日之精华辅以千年玄铁炼制而成，其细如针，大小由心。: It was forged with darksteel and absorbed the essense of the sun.It's thin as a needle, and it's size can vary freely.
text.上古奇物，寄放分魂，滋润壮大之用，最终可炼成元神分身。: An ancient treasure used for storing soul fragment and nurturing it.The soul will eventually develop into a separated body of the original spirit.
text.天地秩序所化，上刻大道至理，可借之参悟神则。: Derived from the order of heaven an earth.It has the supreme Tao carved on it and can be used to learn about the rule of immortals.
text.以魔气祭炼，伤人后魔气渗入体内，痛不欲生。: Forged with evil spirit.When it hurts people, the evil spirit will infiltrate into the target's body and torture him.
text.可装乾坤，包裹天地，其汇集天地之力。: Capable of containing the whole universe and covering heaven and earth.It collects all power from heaven and earth.
text.元始天尊执掌之宝，分金色日光神水、银色月光神水、紫色星光神水，存于八宝琉璃瓶中，: A treasure possessed by the Primeval Lord.Stored in a glazed glass bottle, it includes golden divine water of sunlight, siLv.er divine water of moonlight, and purple divine water of starlight.It has the power to resurrect dead people.
text.长短变化，伸缩自如，能困仙神。: It can change its length freely and bind immortals.
text.发出悠扬娱耳异声，专摄修道人元神，阴毒无比。: It can release a mysterious, pleasant sound and steal the original spirit of the victim.
text.一位大能所制，神符水火不侵，能守元神。: Forge by a powerful character, it can resist fire and water and protect the original spirit of its owner.
text.百年寒铁打造，共七七四十九根，放出不伤敌人绝不飞回。: Made form the century-old cold iron.It consists of 49 piece, and will not return after its release until it hurts the enemy.
text.千年凶兽所结元珠，其大若卵，赤红如火，纯阳至宝。: The orb of spirit in the 1000-year-old beast of disaster.Being the treasure of the utmost Yang, it has the size of an egg and the color of flame.
text.开天辟地间有一金斗，内按叁才，包藏天地之妙，因果不知，劫数不显，神通不明。: There was a gold dipper when the universe was first created.It contains three mysteries:the unseen cause, the unforeseenable fortune, and the unknown power.
text.周身霞光万道、瑞彩千条，呈混沌阴阳色。显现大道无极之象。: Surrounded by colorful light, it has the color of Yin and Yang mixed and the shape of the ultimate Tao.
text.状若紫色丝带，可刀枪不入，水火不侵，抵挡攻击。: Looking like a purple ribbon, it can resist attacks from all weapon and magical power.
text.拿在手中轻如鸿毛，一旦祭出重如泰山，威力巨大。: It's as light as a feather held in hand, but heavy as a mountain and super powerful when summoned.
text.三十六品造化青莲莲花所化，太上老君的证道法宝。: Derived from the flower of the blue lotus with 36 levels of variation, it's a treasure used by the Supreme Lord to prove his Way.
text.相传以神兽毛发辅以天蚕丝制成，穿上如化风而行，肉眼难以捕捉。: It's said to be made of the fur of the divine beast and the silk of heaven silkworm.
text.元始天尊执掌之宝，拥有撕裂鸿蒙混沌之威、粉碎诸天时空之力、统御万法奥义之功、开辟: A treasure possessed by the Primeval Lord.It has the power to tear the chaos, shatter the timespace, rule all orders, and create a brand-new world.
text.鼎身漆黑，鼎内蕴含紫色火焰，此火遇水不灭。: The black tripod has purple flame burning inside it.The fire will not be extinguished by water.

text.琼英走过去，她能感觉到如果李明对自己这些人有恶意，临死前也能将众人抹杀。\\n“:
Qiongying walked up.She sensed that if Li Ming were hostile to them, he could wipe them out before his own death.
 "My original name was Li Ziming," Li Ming started to talk slowly 
 "I was the last emperor of the Li Dynasty, which became the Luo Dynasty you live in now.Back then, there no crisis under the sky, so I abdicated the throne and gave it to Luo Cheng.Now it seems a wise choice.Later I went to wandering around the world along with Yunyao.Since she had practice for a while before, although she had little attainment, her life is still much longer than mine.As I age continuously, she didn't seem to have changed a bit.In the biginning, I hated the cultivation very much.She never tried to persuade me into it, but would only wipe off her tearing everytime she thought of me dying in front of her.The other day, she went secretly to the Soul-Breaking Cliff to search for the Spirit-Condensing Jade in order to extend my life, and then she never came back.I went searching for her as if crazy, but I couldn't even find the entrance of the cliff." Li Ziming went on after some bad coughs.
 "Later, I started cultivation.Thankfully, I had some talent for this.After I started, I learned about the gap of power between us.I kept practicing, and didn't enter the Soul-Breaking Cliff until I reached Severance state.By the cold lake I found her body and the Spirit-Condensing Jade in her hand.It had been too long, and her soul had already vanished.I left her in peace at the bottom of the lake and left alone." 
"Since then, I've been looking for the way to resurrect her.I reopened the Star-Picking Tower and asked all capable men to search for me, and my search led me to the Ghost Cultivation.The Blood-Soul Box detected my desire and lured me to Ghost cultivation, and went on to swallow me.Me body was burned up by it, and only my original spirit survived.Then I met you and restored my mind with your Mind-Clearing Rune.Later you died, and I witness how your sad fellow apprentice resembled me back then.So I found you and tried to help you reshape your body with the Spirit-Condensing Jade, and you really made it.I also sent my primordial spirit back to my body thanks to the thunder triggered by your body reshaping." 
"After that, I deployed this Immortal Slaying Field.There's no way to resurrect Yunyao in the mortal world, and I'm going to try my luck in heaven.I warned you against coming here, yet here you are now." Li Ziming continued.
"Your idea of trigger the tribulation in advance was brilliant, but it was a bit too late.I had taken the elixir that can boost my power and accelerate absorption before.And before the tribulation came, I'd already felt my my ascension coming." Said Li Ziming.

1.Fairchild is born from the essence crashing of dual-cultivation of partners （quality and chance of the Fairchild are related with partner quality:green or blue partner-max G.Mythic fairchild, purple partner-max G.Earth fairchild, orange partner-max G.Heaven Fairchild）.Up to 3 fairchildren could be deployed in the Spirit Fetus to give your character a a stat bonus.For different Fairchildren of the same quality, the quality of their each stats is generated randomly.The higher their stat qualities are, the higher their limit will be.
