text.眼看一年期就要满，不空都想放弃了，一个声音传了过来。\\n“黄风怪不是让你不要放:
As the one-year limit will end soon and Bukong was considering giving up, a voice suddenly came.
 "The Yellow Wind told you not to give up, didn't he?" Bukong looked up and saw a decent man standing in front of him.It was the pig monster he met previously in Gaolaozhuang.The pig monster was just as hands as before, only with his body glowing continuously as if he was to disappear.
"Tianpeng? How could you be here? Did you..." The Sandy Monk started panicking in the water.
 "Juanlian, haven't you seen what these people are after all these years?" The pig monster told the Sandy Monk.
"That's not your business.You are only jealous of my morality and the respect I will receive in the future.You don't work hard, and you forbid others to do so." Yelled the Sandy Monk.
" Juanlian, I see you are far too obssessed.Let me save you from it." Tianpeng raised his right hand, and his rake appeared in his hand.
"With your body like this? Ha-ha-ha." the Sandy Monk laughed.
"In case you don't remember, I'm the Tianpeng emperor, the head of...100 thousand soldiers" Tianpeng said as his body suddenly started to glow blue light.He jumped high and split the Flowing Sand River with only one hit.The Sandy Monk's body was thrown up high and fell heavily like a descarded piece of cloth, and his blood colored the riverbank red.
"Ha-ha-ha, Tianpeng, even with me killed, ha-ha, the Golden XXX wouldn't make it far.Ha-ha-ha.You broke the barrier and offended the lords.You will spend your next life as an animal.Hahahaha!" The Sandy Monk died laughing.
Tianpeng gave Bukong a smile and faded, leaving not another word.
Bukong saluted towards where Tianpeng disappeared, and pulled the White Dragon across the split Flowing Sand River to went on to the west.

text.从五庄观出来，看过那本仙册，小白龙的话也没有以前多了。\\n他是西海龙王的第58:
Leaving Wuzhuangguan, the white dragon talked much less after reading that book.
He was the 58th son of the Dragon King of the West Ocean, growing up in a unnamed lake.He'd never been in the Dragon Palace.
 His dream since childhood was to become a dragon in the tale, just like his father, flying freely in the sky and bring rain to people.People would only need to praise him when he flies by.
So he kept sharpening his skills, and when he came to age, his father got him a position of rainmaker.It was in a remote place, but he was happy.
 The first day he came to his post, he saw a notice:Due to their disrespect for the Jade Emperor, the nation shall receive no rainfall for three years.The White Dragon put back his rainbag silently, thinking that the the Jade Emperor's rage would vanish soon.Two year had passed, and he never got any reply to his suggestion for raining.In fact, the Jade Emperor had left his rage way behind, but the official would rather stay indifferent than take the risk of making any mistake.All suggestion letters were discarded by them.
 Later, it was heard that a white dragon violated the law and brought rain to the nation.He would face death sentence according to the law.
His mother threatened to suicide for his father's mercy.The death sentence was replaced with other punishment.He would be sent to the immortal world and experience reincarnation for 9 lives.
 "White, a dragon cannot change the world unless he has ultimate power.In that case, you only need to be yourself.Don't blame yourself for being unable to save everyone.Only remember what choice you would make back then if you are really in a position to change the world." 
 Bukong wiped tears again for the sleeping White Dragon.
 Wake up, White Dragon.Time to roll.
 Bukong tapped White Dragon lightly.White Dragon had not come back to himself from his dream.He followed Bukong without a word.

text.柳公子全名柳怀瑜，膝下仅有独女，为了缅怀去世的妻子，女儿随母亲姓琼，单名一个英字:
Mr Liu's full name is Liu Huaiyu.He has only one daughter, and he named his daughter as Qiong Ying in memory of his wife whose surname is also Qiong.Liu runs a well-off family by selling his lyric composition and paintings.
Qiong Ying is very weak since she was born.She took various herbs and medicines before the age of two.
At the age of three, her mother died of illness.But since then, she became healthy.His father's mental health fluctuates widely.Sometime she even needs to take care of her father.
When Qiong was very young, she showed her extraordinary talent in calligraphy and painting.With her father's guidance, she could integrate what she had learned together.However, women are not allowed to take the imperial examination.
Qiong is able to read the Book of Family Names at three years old, recite long articles at four years old, write essays containing three thousand characters at the age of five,and able to compose poems easily.Despite all of these outstanding achievements, she is still not allowed to take the examination.
Her neighbor Mr.Wang has a dumb son.Qiong Ying thought the dumb son is superior to her.
The reason why an eight-year-old girl desires to take the exam lies in that she believed that to pass the exam is her father's lifelong aspiration.If she can fulfill her father's dream, he will recover from the current insanity.
Now as the one-year-held provincial examination is approaching, Qiong Ying disguised herself to be a male scholar.Her appearance, figure and voice are similar to man.She even devised a fake laryngeal protuberance for herself.Even her father who is drunk cannot tell who she is.

text.掌门大殿：宗门星级是宗门这个大功能的基础，其他玩法功能升级或开启都依赖于宗门星级:
Sect Hall：star level is the basis of the sect, upgrade or open of other gameplay are both rely on the star level, you can redeem sect level-up stone in spiritual realm
Upgrading of sect level could improve character as well as disciple practice speed, prior to upgrade sect level

Disciple Hall：recruiting disciples.You need disciples everywhere in sect zone, sect foreign affairs, sect array, explioiting spiritual vein and settled in adobe.And the main method you get disciples is from the Disciple Hall.Also, you could buy disciple giftpack to get 5-star discples.

Sect Zone：the mainly method of obtaining materials in heaven.After upgraded the sect level, you could upgrade sect zone with Woods and Stones
The higher level of the sect quest and the more disciples dispatched, the more rewards you will get.For example, one disciple dispatched for 1-star quest would get 100 Div.Gems, if dispatched2 disciples you could get 200 Div.Gems.Disciples with buff on sect will obtain 250 Div.Gems.So the quality of disciples and level of zone quest are very important.

Recast Pool：place you could add attributes on dicsiples.Disciples of the sect array would recast here.The spirit fluid consumed for recasting could be get from Destiny Tower.And you can also upgrade the recast pool by usting herbs and minerals

Sect Array：you could allocate disciples on it when you are going through the map or having a fight, with which you could add extra attributes on yourself.You can prior to allocating disciples with array buff.After upgrading, you can unlock more arrays with which you could add more attributes

Foreign Affairs Hall：you don't neeed to complete daily quest manually, but directly apply disciples with extra buff on foreign affairs, and you can just receive rewards after quest completed.

Wanfa Tower：place where you can make your own skills attached with 5-element DMG.Please remember that each Atlas could only be used once, unless you recast the already comprehended one.Please be careful for your choice.

Zhenpai Chamber：you can redeem Divine Fire by comsuming Tima Hourglass produced in Time Realm from Realm-Realm Merchant and refine Zhenpai Trump.The quality of Divine Fire is very important.The higher grade of Divine Fire used to refine, the higher buff on attributes you will get.

Xinhuo Chamber：open after passed through East Pole Islan, where you could transmit to disciples.Transmitting is inheriting the character attributes to disciples according to the percentage of transmitting progress.You can open the extra soul energy for direact disciples by consuming ensoul materials in the Ensoul Chamber.And you can upgrade the disciple sills in the Skill Hall.

Realm of Circles：A periodical mode which opens from Monday to Friday; Sect Treasure - the major way of getting cultivation materials for Secret Treasures.Don't miss it!

You could obtain red roses through Wandering with the most of 2
You could obtain Time Illusory rose by dual-cultivation with the most of 3; meanwhile you could obtain by purchasing with items or Jades
3.It will prior to send flowers obtained by consuming quests when sending them.When the activity ends, we will clear all roses and retrieve unused Time Illusory roses with the price of 45 Jades each for the ones purchased with Jades
4.Every time you send flowers could add up with Attraction value for the fairy as well as Contribution value for yourself, and you would obtain Flower Fluid and rewards of sending flowers
By accumulating Attraction value could contribute to the ranking of fairies, and you could also send flowers to different fairies
Contribution value could be accumulated to redeem contribution rewards, and gain ranking of cross-server contributions
Flower Fluid could be used to redeem items from shop, and will be cleared up when the activity ends, please be aware
Rewards available can be previewed from the reward list.
5.After the activity ends, the top 3 fairies of the Beauty Ranking will obtain certain dual-cultivation buff when being as partners, continuous for 7 days
6.After the activity ends, we would spare an extra day to display the rankings of Beauties and Contributions for you to check and obtain rewards, as well as redeem from shop, while you can't do other operations like sending flowers
7.Beauty Ranking will be updated every minute, but the calculation of rankings are real time calculation, so the rankings in the final minute will be shown after the activity ends.

text.仙塾悟道说明：\\n1.灵童境界达到<炼虚一阶后>开启仙塾悟道功能\\n2.悟道:
Instructions for Enlightenment in Fairy School：
1.Open the function of Enlightenment of Fairy School after reached <Veinify G.1> 
2.Enlightenment Time：Monday to Friday, rest on Saturday and Sunday 
3.Set different enlightenment types from Monday to Friday, and the added attribute types will also be different 
4.Each Fairchild chooses Deity Emperor Class or Tao Ancestor Class for enlightenment every day （there is only one chance to choose very day and can't be changed） 
5.Fairy School enlightenment attribute will be converted into character attribute according to the Fairchild's quality 
6.Fairchild will get 1 credit for each enlightenment, which will be used for listed on Credit Ranking.The credits will be cleared at 22：00 every Sunday 
7.The Credit Ranking lists the rankings of all enlightenment Fairchild this week （according to the ranking of credits, the same credits are ranked according to the time of achievement） 
8.The Credit Ranking is reset at 22 o'clock every Sunday, and reward of Credit Ranking is issued at 24 o'clock every Saturday （each Fairchild on the list can get a reward） 
9.Enlightenment event follows this enlightenment and will be cleared when enlightenment ends 
10.When the Fairchild inherits：the Fairy School attribute will also be inherited

Instruction of Prize Pool Selection：
1、Select 10 prizes in total (1 from Heaven-Class, 2 from Earth-Class, 3 from Mythic-Class, and 4 from Novice-Class) and put them into the Prize Pool.No change is allowed once your selection is made.
2、Once you get the Heaven-Class Prize, you can reset the pool and re-select your prizes.All prizes will be changed.
3、Each type of prize can only be put into the pool for limited times.If the count comes to zero, it can no longer be selected.If the count of every prize of any class is zero, the pool can no longer be reset.
4、If you choose to reset the pool after getting the Heaven-Class prize, all prizes left in the pool will still be counted as consumed.Please decide carefully.
5、The number of draws left in each class indicates the total times you can selection from this class, and if it's larger than one, you can select one prize for multiple times until it's used up.

text.为周期性玩法：每周一0点至周五24点开放，周六日关闭\\n·参与条件：只要创建宗:
Periodical Gameplay：available from 0：00 every Monday to 24：00 every Friday, unavailable on Saturday and Sunday
Requirements：Create a guild
Introduction：
1.Corresponding character level, stats, skills, affixes and currencies are active only in the Realm of Circles
2.Tap your avatar from down left to see your character stats and related info
3.Skills you obtained in Realm of Circles can be equipped on your profile page
4.All stats, skills and related data reset when the Realm of Circles becomes available again
Character death and resurrection
1.Your character will be dead when its HP falls to 0 （keep an eye on it）
2.HP recovery：you can recover HP by upgrading, triggering events and buy items from vendors
3.Tap your avatar and select resurrect to restore your HP to 100%.You have 5 chances each week （spend them wisely）
4.All your moves consume Action Points, and they reset at 0：00 every day
5.<color=#D92622>Resetting Action Points：after every weekly reset, all unused Action Points will be removed （including Action Points gained through Jades and Beastial Orbs）</color>
Character Level：
1.Slay monsters or Breath （cost Action Points） will grant XP that improves your Realm once it reaches its max
2.Improving Realm increases character stats
Rewards：
1.External rewards obtained in this mode can be brought away （Essenses, of Sun and Moon, Chaos Essenses, Treasure Seeking Orders, Beastial Orbs）
2.Rewards will be sent each time you pass 5 levels （must be claimed manually）
3.Ranking rewards apply in this mode, based on highest level passed and time taken
4.Rankings settle at 24：00 every Friday and rewards will be sent at 24：00 every Saturday

text.1.好感度达到100的道侣可以带回洞府进行双修。\\n2.根据道侣的体质不同，双:
1.Partners reached 100 friendliness can be taken to abode for dual-cultivation.
2.According to the different qualities of partners, the effects of dual-cultivation are different.
3.Giving items to partners can improve intimacy.The higher the intimacy is, the better dual-cultivation effects will get.
4.Departed partners will have their friendliness reduced into 60, and their intimacy cleared.
5.The mood value of partners is re-randomized once a day.Interacting with partners will change the mood value.
6.Partner's mood value will have an impact ondual-cultivation effect, but not all.The impact will not exceed some limited values of the original dual-cultivation effect.
7.When the partner's mood value is too low, he will refuse the dual-cultivation invitation.
8.The reserved partner will be cleared from the list at 24:00 the next day if he didn't have dual-cultivation.
9.Reserved partners will use Butterfly Jade based on a descending quality order after toggling auto use.

text.1.灵童通过与道侣双修时灵气碰撞而诞生（灵童品质和概率与双修道侣品质有关，绿色和:
1.Fairchild is born from the essence crashing of dual-cultivation of partners （quality and chance of the Fairchild are related with partner quality:green or blue partner-max G.Mythic fairchild, purple partner-max G.Earth fairchild, orange partner-max G.Heaven Fairchild）.Up to 3 fairchildren could be deployed in the Spirit Fetus to give your character a a stat bonus.For different Fairchildren of the same quality, the quality of their each stats is generated randomly.The higher their stat qualities are, the higher their limit will be.
2.After being deployed, Fairchildren will practice automatically.Daily learning of external spells could strengthen power, and their inner orb could improve attainment quickly.
3 Failure in breaking through in practicing time limit will lead to temporary seal.You can consume gem to unlock the seal.
4.With inner orb, Fairchildren can use orbs to increase their attributes.Orbs of different quality share the usage limit within a big state.Please choose carefully.
5.Within each state there's a limit to the attribute a Fairchild can obtain.If it breaks through onto the next state before fully obtaining its attributes, the left attribute will not be added to the new limit.The substitution function can temporarily restore the lost limit in previous states.
6.DissoLv.ed Fairchildren will be lost forever and could not be retreved.
7.Jade will be returned when a G.Huang Ne-Zha or a Fairchild is substitured by one of higher quality.
8.Explore the game for more interesting facts of Fairchildren.

text.1.排行榜每周日晚上24点结算，23点30分不可挑战\\n2.排行依据是积分高低:
1.Rankings will be sumed up at 24:00 every Sunday, and players could not challenge from 23:30
2.Rankings are sorted according to the points, if players have the same points, the one came to the point first get to win
3.System would match players with close rankings, when there is no other players to match, players would be ranked with ranking spirit.
4.Every day one would get to challenge for 25 times.
5.The higher ranking your opponent is, the more points you would get, while you could get points only when you won the challenge
6.Winning the challenge would obtain more honors than losing the challenge, honors could be used in redeeming goods in shops
7.Extra challenge attempts awarded are based on the level brackets
text.1.奇遇每日<color=#458114>特定时间点</color>自动刷新，每:

2.Obtaining <color=#458114>Official Position</color> grants 2 extra encounter chances.
3.Cultivators have a chance to trigger encounters during <color=#458114>Map Training</color> and <color=#458114>Wandering</color>.
4.Different choices made by cultivators will <color=#458114>affect</color> encounter rewards, please choose carefully.
5.Cultivators have limited fortune, so when simultaneous encounters reach 2 days of refresh count, new encounters will not be triggered. World encounters daily limit is 5.
text.1.天赋伴随元神而生，可同时在主世界和元世界中使用多种天赋技能，暴击天赋除外。\:
1.Talent points are generated through the Essence Soul, acquired Talents affect both the Main World and the Essence Soul World, excluding Talents that affect CRI.
2.Some Talents are mutually exclusive, not all Talents can be activated at the same time.
3.Talent Points are obtained when the Essence Soul increases in level.
4.Skills obtained through Talents can still be upgraded even if the Talent has been reset, Talent must be reactivated to equip skill.
5.When activating Talents, the extra cost talent points are not calculated into accumulated consumption.
6.Extra cost occurs when activating Talents on multiple Talent trees.
7.Yuan Qi obtained after using corresponding orbs can be used to cover the extra cost instead of using Talent points.
8.When traveling in the Essence Soul World, there is a low chance to obtain Yuan Qi orbs.

text.别看贫道一副吊儿郎当的样子，如果认真起来的话，可也是一等一的高手呢。回想起来这一: Don't worry about my casual or even sloppy look.You know, if I take something serious, I can also be a first-class master.Looking back on my cultivation along the way, there were really someone who helped me, and there were so many opportunities.When I was a rambunctious boy, I thought about participating in the apprenticeship trial of the Saga Clan.But I failed the first assessment, so I couldn't get in as wished.But how could I give up such an opportunity? Well, I was so young and I simply cried and rolled, except leaving that place.Then, Master Mo of the Saga Clan saw my persistence, so he interceded for me and asked me if I'm going to take the exam again.The second time, I went all out and won applause from all the halls, later, I was accepted as a disciple of the clan and started cultivation from then on.It's really funny to think about it now.Master Mo was regarded as the first noble person at the beginning of my cultivation.
text.别人称呼我为风华绝代的美人，而我却一心只想当放情肆意于江湖之间的侠士。我的银剑锐: I don't like them calling me a peerless beauty, indeed, I only want to be an unrestrained, and chivalrous swordswoman.My sword is sharp enough to kill all troublemakers in the world; my words are straightforward, and I can communicate with anyone.I treat my friends sincerely, and I am willing to travel thousands of miles to help my confidant.When I was a child, I witnessed the murder of my parents under the plot of a demon.So in order to eliminate the evil sects, I went through all kinds of difficulties and dangers, and finally joined the Yellowind Valley.This is the gathering place for righteous monks in Guangdong, and it is also a new starting point for me to implement my chivalry.

text.从桃夭那里回来的时候，已经下雪了……\\n漆黑的一片，北风带来的浑身刺痛……\\:
When I came back from Taoyao, it was already snowing……
It was pitch black, and my body was stinging from the north wind……
I want to go back to Beast Mountain, which is my home……
However, I couldn't stand the cold, so I curled up
under a tree and fell asleep for a while.After regaining consciousness
I found that my body was frozen……
I wanted to open my eyes so bad……
I don't want to be frozen to death in the cold wild……
My body suddenly felt a strong sense of cold.
I suppressed this feeling and slowly opened my eyes.
It was snowing heavily, I slowly got up and struggled hard.
I walked forward step by step, but soon hunger
had me.The strength in the legs gradually disappeared.
"Am I dying here? No, I can't……"
I was about to fall down, but I heard a gentle male voice
"You don't look well, do you need help?"
But still, I fell before I could speak.
I just remember I gradually became unconscious……

text.其实，本宫与冰魄仙子以及极北女王三人，万年以前也曾是同门师姊妹，皆拜于泠海龙王门: In fact, Ben Gong, Fairy Bingpo and Queen of the Extreme North were also sisters of the same school ten thousand years ago, and they all worshiped under Linghai Dragon King to learn the art of ice and snow.It's just that the Bingpo Fairy wanted to transform into a god and Ascend, so she stole the clan treasure of the Bengong clan, the Zhenhai Bell.From that day on, I broke up with Fairy Bingpo, and used the cold power of the Zhenhai Bell to counterattack Fairy Bingpo, causing her to lose a thousand years of Attainment for no reason.From then on, Fairy Bingpo hated me very much.Later, on the day when Fairy Bingpo finally Ascend, she used her calculations to freeze the sea palace of the palace, causing the death and injury of the clan of the palace to be irrelevant.In order to avenge the Beiyeji Palace, I came to the Queen of the Extreme North, Mumei.At the beginning, our three sisters made an oath in front of the master.If we dared to hurt our sisters, we would be punished by heaven and earth.Now that Bing Po has broken his oath, this palace wants Mumei to fulfill the contract and go to liquidate Beiyeji Palace together.But Mumei said, Fairy Bingpo has already Ascend, and the Strength of the two of us alone may not be enough to liquidate Beiyeji Palace.Mumei recommended two female Cultivator, Shi Yujian Yan Shiyu and Jiutian Jiange Xue Si.These two female cultivators joined us to attack the Northern Night Pole Palace together.

text.如果你想问我，我是怎么引导雨滴落下的。那么我悄悄的告诉你，我有一把油纸伞，上面描: If you want to ask me, how do I guide the raindrops to fall.Then let me tell you quietly, I have an oil-paper umbrella with beautiful blue petals painted on it, which was painted by Ju Yunxiu for me.As long as I open this umbrella under the sky, the rain will fall centered on me.Once I was sad for a long time because of something, and I stood under the umbrella and cried uncontrollably.As a result, I cried for three days and three days, and the torrential rain also fell for three days and three nights, flooding many houses.It seems that the size of the rain is also related to my mood.

text.我在年纪尚幼时就加入了黄风谷，一切都是家里安排妥当的，水到渠成的。我所发挥的作用: I joined the Yellow Wind Valley when I was still young, and everything was arranged at home, and it happened naturally.The role I play is to let the teacher know that there is such a person as me.As for the Other things, I can't decide……Originally, a self-cultivation life would be spent in a mediocre life, but I didn't expect that, The Sect arranged for me to get acquainted with a brother named Lu.The teachers hope that I will agree to this marriage and facilitate a good talk.I have been docile since I was a child, and I only know how to obey the arrangements of my teachers and dare not do anything against them.Maybe I'm just such a……puppet-like solitary person in essence.
text.我找大夫给爹爹看过病，大夫说这是因为爹爹在修炼的时候，太过急于求成，所以不小心走: I asked a doctor to see a doctor for my father.The doctor said that it was because my father was too eager for success when he was practicing, so he accidentally lost his temper.Now his meridians are disordered, almost paralyzed, and his life expectancy may not be long.I'm really worried about him……But our Qinglingmen is only a very small Guild, and we can't afford my father's medical expenses.In the past, the kind Ziling Fairy Wang Ning would give us some spiritual herbs, but unfortunately it wasn't enough……So I had to go to the Medicine Valley to gather herbs by myself, and that's when I was attacked by monsters.

text.我自己对于争斗之术并不感兴趣。我所擅长的，仅仅是炼丹制药，让其他修仙者安心定魂，: I'm not interested in the art of combat myself.What I am good at is just Concoct and medicine, so that Other immortal cultivators can feel at ease and calm their souls, and reduce the pain of the invasion of Inner Demon .Because of my withdrawn personality, I like to study the obscure knowledge of pharmacology.And relieving the suffering of others is something that makes me, who is naturally shy and kind, enjoy it.In order to find the best spiritual herb, another female cultivator, Gongsun Li, and I forcibly ventured into the Falling Demon Valley, which is rumored to be the most dangerous place in the south of the sky.But in order to find medicine, we still set foot in without hesitation.Finally, with the help of a nun named Qingcha, we found the precious elixir.Immediately, I refined the Orb that could resist the invasion of the Inner Demon , successfully Ascend and became a Nascence cultivator, and then continued my life of living in seclusion and collecting herbs.

text.吾辈听过很多来求占者来倾诉她们的心声。大概就是别人内心的声音听得太多了，所以吾辈: We have heard many people who come to seek occupation to confide their aspirations.Probably because I listened too much to other people's inner voices, so we started to ignore our own inner voices instead.My generation has become a confidant sister who heals the wounds in others' hearts, but I have forgotten the five disadvantages and three disadvantages designed by the Tendo for us fortune-tellers.As long as people like us who try to understand the Destiny, they will have misfortunes in their lives.And the misfortune that belongs to us is probably doomed to be unable to alleviate the loneliness in our hearts for the rest of our lives.Although my generation is the confidant of all monks, but none of us know my own heart.This kind of mentality of sharing the breeze and the moon, and the high mountains and flowing waters with few bosom friends, no one who has experienced it will understand.So we can only stay in the Destiny Pavilion all our lives, and be the fortune teller who asks about the fate of others.In the end, the only ones who can keep in touch with us are Miss Dongqiao, or Master Yu, who lives in the mortal world but doesn't care about the impermanence of fate.They didn't come to me to ask for their fate, but they became one of the few people who can let me confide in my heart.
text.昔年，本宫原是冰海里的一只凤凰，遨游在冰面之下，享受着万年的清凉和海水滋润。作为: In the past, Bengong was originally a Phoenix in the ice sea, Roam under the ice surface, enjoying the coolness and the nourishment of the sea water for thousands of years.As the master of the ice sea, the worship of the sea people and the waves of the ice sea are enough to make me intoxicated.Bengong doesn't want to leave the seabed, nor does he have any intention of interfering with the affairs of the human world.It's just that the peaceful days are always difficult to last.That year, before Ascend, Fairy Bingpo used her great Divinity power to freeze Bingyuan Island for a hundred years to vent her anger.It forced us and the rest of our family to give way to the monks of the Northern Night Pole Palace.Since then, the enmity between the sea monster and the Northern Night Pole Palace has been forged.In order to fight against Fairy Bingpo, I want to find another fairy, Mumei, hoping that the guardian queen of the extreme north can follow Master's instructions and join hands with me to punish Beiyeji Palace.

text.小女子出生在岚州城墨家，是墨家的长女。父亲墨居仁精通医术，早年以行医行走江湖。他: The little girl was born in the Mo family in Lanzhou City, she is the eldest daughter of the Mo family.His father, Mo Juren, was proficient in medical skills and practiced medicine in his early years.After seeing the Ice Soul Fairy fighting with people in the extreme north, he was shocked by the magic of immortality, so he embarked on the road of cultivating immortality.In the end, his father founded the Jingjiao Club surrounded by everyone, and became one of the famous three tyrants in Lanzhou.As the eldest daughter of the Mo House, the little girl has been fond of spiritual cultivation since she was a child, and she has known Yulingzong's sisters Xiyue and Han Yunzhi since she was a child, but it is a pity that she did not go to practice with them later.Since childhood, it has been widely rumored in the outside world that Luzhu, the eldest daughter of Mo, was born with a beautiful country and a beautiful country; therefore, the little girl has many suitors and is quite flocked by people.I thought that the little girl's life would always be perfect like this, but the accident still happened unexpectedly.

text.小女子的家母是前任妙音门主，但她死于极阴岛修士的杀害。极阴老祖贪恋我的容貌，强娶: The little girl's mother was the former head of the Miaoyin Sect, but she died of being killed by a monk on Jiyin Island.The ancestor of Jiyin was greedy for my appearance, and he couldn't marry me by force, so Dispatch monks to assassinate my family.After the death of my mother, Miaoyinzong became a mess, fighting and attacking each other.I know very well that this is because Senior Sister Jingmei and Senior Sister Zhuo each have intentions for the position of sect master, so they split into two factions to fight internally.But the little girl's thoughts are very simple, no matter which senior sister, as long as she can avenge her mother, the little girl will voluntarily give up her position as the head of the sect.To show her determination, the little girl withdrew from the Miaoyin Sect, and someone else temporarily took the position of sect master.Until the revenge was avenged, the sect master reassignment ceremony was held.After leaving the Sect, the little girl became a casual cultivator with the Title of Fairy Ziling, and became a close sister who often helped others and gave them medicine and pills.
text.小女子虽然外貌柔弱，但轻视小女子的话，可是会遭来邪毒噬身之苦哦。在小女子的家乡苗: Although the little girl looks weak, but if you look down on the little girl, you will suffer from the evil poison.In Miaojiang, the little girl's hometown, there are evil insects and poisonous snakes crawling everywhere, and scorpions and centipedes are rampant.So the people of Miaojiang used these poisonous substances to form poisonous Gu for cultivation, and the monks in the Han area called me "poison cultivator".But ah, in the huge Han land, people's hearts are sinister, how can the people of Miaojiang protect themselves without using poisonous Gu? Miss Taoyao is the number one poison master in Miaojiang, and is famous for her Dual Practice of voodoo and poison.Even she said to the little girl, "Only poisonous insects and evil Gu are the way for Miaojiang girls to protect their lives and bodies."
text.小女子想向你倾诉一些话，这是只有我自己一个人的时候，小女子才会思索的话语……从前: The little girl wants to confide some words to you.These are the words that the little girl will think about when I am alone……Once upon a time, a girl was wearing a white gauze, and others praised her for her skin as smooth as jade.Her satiny black hair hung down her shoulders, and her features were exquisite.However, people also said that the girl's face was pale, as if she had lost a layer of blood.People looked at her and felt that she was like a fairy who didn't eat fireworks, like a dream……In the Miaoyin Sect, the disciples were all talking about it , Can this girl really take over the heavy responsibility of the sect master? text.小女子原本只是魁星岛附近一个小门派的女修，与师姐颜丽从出生时便相识。二人从小一起: The little girl was originally just a nun from a small Guild near Kuixing Island, and she and her senior sister Yan Li had known each other since birth.The two grew up together, like sisters.We wandered around Kuixing Island at first, occasionally visiting the young master Mei Ning of Taiyang Gate.Under Mei Ning's introduction, we went to Tianxing City to look for celebrities to apprentice.As a result, there was an accident on the way, and our sisters were separated.Later, the little girl practiced in the first generation of Chaos Xinghai, and finally learned that her senior sister Yan Li was imprisoned by Sanyang Daoist of Qingyangmen.So the little girl wanted to rescue Yan Li regardless of the danger, but the news leaked out, and I had to fight fiercely with Master Sanyang.In the end, she finally got rid of Master Sanyang, but Yan Li's body was destroyed in the process.The little girl found the Nurture Soul wood, and wanted to use the resurrection technique to bring her senior sister back to life.But when the spell was cast, a cloud of strange ghost fog appeared out of thin air, engulfing the little girl.

text.因为本小姐相貌很漂亮，为了不引发过多的关注，所以在外都是女扮男装活动。现在乱星海: Because this lady is very beautiful, in order not to attract too much attention, she is always Event as a man outside.Now the thieves in Luan Xinghai actually want to unite against Star Palace.They formed the Anti-Star Alliance and even ambushed Miss Ben on Nanming Island.Fortunately, there are many high-ranking cultivators in the Star Palace, and a passing male cultivator wiped out the thieves of the Anti-Star Alliance without any effort.That male cultivator's methods dazzled Miss Ben, so Miss Ben invited him to go to Skystar City together.It's a pity, but in the end, the male cultivator couldn't be kept.He borrowed the teleportation from the Star Palace and went to the Alien Sea.
text.因为轩辕氏的背信弃义，所以两军在阪泉爆发大战。本将单靠一把钢斧，便杀得轩辕氏丢盔: Because of Xuanyuan's treachery, a battle broke out between the two armies in Banquan.With just a single steel axe, this general killed Xuanyuan's family and fled in a panic.Unexpectedly, they actually used tricks to Summon a thick fog to confuse their sight.This general was also lured into the mist, lost in it, and could not use his force without strength.However, our army was divided and surrounded, and finally defeated one by one.
text.因为域外的人，也有许多心怀不轨，想要偷盗百花弟子的法宝灵药的。百花女修们为了自身: Because there are many people outside the territory who have evil intentions and want to steal the Trump weapon and elixir of disciple Baihua.For their own safety and to preserve this paradise, the Hundred Flowers Sisters will select previous Hundred Flowers Patronus to protect them and the Floral Realm.This lady is the Patronus of Hundred Flowers this term.It may be because she is more ruthless in her actions, so outsiders call her the Hundred Flowers Witch.In fact, Floral Realm was originally created by Shenni Youtan.Since Shenni herself is a naughty little nun who looks only twelve or thirteen years old, she has no intention of hurting others, but just likes to tease those who want to sneak into Baihuayu .A rogue who steals treasures in the Floral Realm.After the Ascend of the gods and nuns, in order to continue to protect the Floral Realm , the post of Baihua Patronus was Setting .
text.因为灼热，我必须不停的奔跑着，每一步都撕心裂肺般疼痛。而三足金乌就像是在看承受炮: Because of the scorching heat, I had to run non-stop, and every step was piercingly painful.And the three- Golden Crow laughed happily as if he was looking at someone who was being burned.I must touch the Golden Crow's feathers, and this painful punishment will end.For the rest of my life, I have to run all the time, chasing the Golden Crow that I can't reach.
text.银灵子居然逃回了他心爱的素女旁边，害的冀州城几乎沦陷。孤怒不可遏，只能派遣帐下大: Yin Lingzi actually fled back to his beloved Su Nu, and Jizhou City almost fell as a result.Furious, he had no choice but to Dispatch his general, Yu Shi Feng Bo, to Jizhou for rescue.On the other side, it is unknown what kind of tricks the Yellow Emperor was planning in private.
text.应龙被咱家用风雨击败后，黄帝老头便又向天帝老头求援。黄帝老头要到一人，是一名女的: After Yinglong was defeated by our family's wind and rain, the old man Yellow Emperor asked the old man Tiandi for help.The old man Yellow Emperor wants to find one person, a woman, and that is the woman who can stop the rain.As a result, the female demon summoned a drought, which made our family's Divinity of wind and rain unable to use.So our side suffered a loss in the battle of Jizhou, and finally lost miserably in the battle of Zhuolu.
text.幽冥双神，是我姐姐所在冥都的一对舞女。如果你侥幸过了我这一关，可在幽冥双神那里，: The Phantom Twin are a pair of dancers in the capital where my sister lives.If you are lucky enough to pass my level, the Phantom Twin will never let you pass, they will imprison you in the Nether Prison.Let you suffer from suffering and pain for thousands of years.
text.由于奴家本来学的就是一些招待来宾，取悦墨客的才艺。于是便被护法安排专门负责外事接: Because the slave family originally learned the skills of entertaining guests and pleasing scholars.So he was assigned by the Patronus to be responsible for the reception of foreign affairs.Over the years, the slave family has also been fascinated by it, and has learned many cultivation methods of the Star Picking.This Star Picking is far different from the general Sect sects.Those who can enter this sect are all top monks from all over the world.Therefore, it was purely a Fortuity that the slave family was able to visit the Star Picking by mistake.It's just that what I want to learn the most is the fundamental method of this Guild, the wonderful art of Star Picking.It is said that if you have cultivated to the level of the old man who Star Picking, you can pick up the Star Picking and take the moon, and it is nothing.If my family can pluck the stars from the night sky, it will be so romantic and beautiful!
text.游戏内有以下属性：\\n真气：增加攻击\\n根骨：增加防御\\n体魄：增加生命上:
The game has the following Stats：
 Qi：Increase ATK

text.有句话，叫做天妒英才，不知道用在妾身的身上是否合适。\\n妾身从一出生，就让家人: There is a saying called "Heaven is jealous of talents", I don't know if it is appropriate to use it on concubines.\nSince the concubine was born, her family has been worried……At that time, she even caused a sensation in the surrounding neighborhood.According to the elders, when he was born, he seemed to hear the whisper of a dragon, and then the room was filled with golden light.The concubine came to this world amidst the golden light and the sound of the dragon's chant.The neighbor, Grandpa Qi, is an experienced craftsman, and he immediately concluded that the concubine possessed an invisible physique called the quality of dragon chanting.It's a pity that the concubine's body was a man's body and gave birth to a daughter's body by mistake.I'm afraid it will not last long.
text.有人的美食总是能让人心情愉悦，少年很快抛弃了心头的抑郁，专心对付桌上的美食。: Someone's food can always make people feel happy, the boy quickly abandoned his depression and concentrated on dealing with the food on the table.
text.有人说云就是在天上的雾，亦或者雾就是在地下的云；云雾都是笼罩在三界的一层朦朦胧胧: Some people say that the cloud is the fog in the sky, or the fog is the cloud in the ground; the cloud and fog are a layer of hazy decoration that covers the Three Realms and makes it difficult to see clearly.And Xiaoxian is the exiled immortal who is responsible for weaving clouds and mist for the Mortals.Although he lived in exile in the Mortals, he lived a happy and happy life, with the company of the world of mortals and his home all over the world.Probably because Xiaoxian has traveled too many places, the monks in the Mortals compiled Xiaoxian's deeds into a story from the end of the world, which attracted countless people to search for Xiaoxian's footprints.So Xiaoxian didn't dare to reveal her real name, so they called Xiaoxian Miss Dongqiao.
text.有一次叶凝烟问起我，为什么我总是一袭红衣打扮？我说这是因为我崇拜缥缈剑宗的大师兄: Once Ye Ningyan asked me, why am I always dressed in red? I say this because I admire Han Yi, the elder brother of Misty Sword Sect.When I was still young, the name of "Xia Ke Xing Han Yi" was already resounding all over the country.Because he often acts chivalrously and kills the unrighteous people in the world, his clothes are always stained with blood.For convenience, he simply wears a red robe forever.I regard Senior Brother Hanyi as a model, and in order to emulate him, I deliberately wore a red dress as well.
text.于是，大猫变成了我的灵兽。在灵兽山，它是首屈一指的强力灵兽，也是陪伴我的伙伴。云: So, the big cat became my Pet.In Pet Mountain, it is the most powerful Pet and also my companion.Yunzhi also likes this big cat very much, and caresses the soft fur of this big cat all day long.However, An An from Destiny Pavilion is also our good friend, but she predicted from the standpoint of a fortune teller that the HP of a big cat is extremely limited, and it will consume its own life soon.We were very scared when we heard this, and asked An An how to resolve this disaster.An An said that the catastrophe cannot be resolved, but she can ask Tao Yao for help, she has a way to keep the dead big cat by my side.\nJust after An'an finished divination for us, the demonic invasion occurred, and Pet Mountain was attacked by a large number of enemies.As the strongest Pet in Pet Mountain, the big cat is regarded as the primary target of ATK, but even so, it is also desperately covering us from escaping.I was dragged away by Yunzhi, but when I looked back, I saw a sharp tiger-killing spear piercing the big cat's chest……After the war, Pet Mountain was merged into the Imperial Spirit Sect, and I was able to get back the big cat corpse.So I went to find Taoyao according to An'an's words.She is a witch from Miaojiang.With her help, the big cat's soul was called back and lodged in my body.Since then, I have shared a body with the big cat.
text.于是本公主就在她们的安排下，成功混迹进入魔木崖。这里地势极为险要，易守难攻，实际: So under their arrangement, the princess successfully sneaked into the Demonwood Cliff.The terrain here is extremely dangerous, easy to defend but difficult to attack.In fact, it is a magic circle fortress converted from a military pass.But since this princess has successfully entered, she is a golden flower lurking in the magic wood cliff.Here, the princess also met Yan Shiyu, a Cultivator known as Shiyu Sword.According to her, she sneaked in to find the peerless sword hidden in the magic wood cliff.But according to what this princess knows, the peerless sword has already been transferred away, so Yan Shiyu has no choice but to make friends with Miss Ben, and left sadly.
text.于是汉地的修士，便用蛇蝎心肠，来形容我们这些貌美心毒的苗疆女子。小女子曾和清茶仙: So the monks in the Han area used the heart of snakes and scorpions to describe us Miaojiang women who are beautiful and venomous.The little girl once traveled with Qingcha Fairy and Li Qingjun to the Tiannan area of ??Han, and all the monks she met along the way were whispering and sneaking behind the little girl's back.It was as if they expected that the little girl would come to Tiannan with malicious intentions, intentionally spreading some kind of plague and miasma poison to Tiannan.But in fact, the purpose of the little girl and her party is to go to the Destiny Pavilion, find the famous divination master An An, and divination for my father, Venerable Wan Du.Unexpectedly, as soon as they arrived outside the Destiny Pavilion, the monks from Tiannan had already set up an ambush.They fired all arrows and blocked the little girl.The two female companions, Qingcha and Qingjun, tried to stop him, but they failed.
text.于是接下来的事情变开始变得有些荒谬。在京城人人尽传，薛家大小姐不待字闺中等着嫁给: So what happened next became a little ridiculous.It is well known in the capital that Miss Xue did not wait in her boudoir to marry her son-in-law Chenglong Kuai, but instead used the excuse that she wanted to Exploration her past life experience, so she went to Experience to famous mountains and rivers, trying to find the so-called way to become a fairy.Everyone in the capital rumored that the little girl had gone crazy, and my family kept writing to me, urging the little girl to go home.But I have made up my mind, and I will not give up halfway.Along the way, I also met Yan Shiyu, a Cultivator, and learned sword art with her.She heard me talk about the purple fairy grass, so she pointed me to the Jiutian Jiange to find it.
text.于是我便代替共工被锁在不周山上，每日被铁索贯心。共工则在我的指点下，先去找雨师屏: So instead of Gonggong, I was chained on Buzhou Mountain, and I was impaled by iron chains every day.Under my guidance, Gonggong first went to the Pingyi, and after finding Pingyi's soul, we were able to Summon wind and rain and create fog.Under the thick cloud cover, the gods have no idea of ??our actions.
text.于是我的游历继续进行着，可惜啊……战争还是没有停止，在一场大战之后，天兰草原大获: So my Experience continued, but unfortunately……the war still didn't stop.After a big battle, the Tianlan Grassland won a complete victory, and the Mulan Grassland became an area under the rule of the Tianlan people.In the easternmost part of the grassland, I met Qin Yutong, who is called the Baihua Witch.As the envoy of Floral Realm, she came to me and begged me to put an end to the senseless killings on the grassland.I assured her that the war was over and that the next thing we could do was at least to quell the hatred.I use my status as a saint to assure the world and announce to the people on the grassland that the war is over and the hatred should not continue.We can no longer continue the hatred to our next generation.Now the people on the grassland should join hands to abandon the millennium disputes and build their own Home together.Beyond the prairie, there is a wider world waiting for us to Exploration.
text.于是我开始游历整个草原。在天兰草原的东部，是木兰草原。那里同样是木兰人的家园，他: So I started to Experience the whole prairie.In the east of Tianlan Grassland is Mulan Grassland.It is also the Home of the Mulan people, who, like us, are shepherds on the grassland.But, I don't know when the hatred started, blinding everyone's eyes.Since I was young, I have seen everyone's endless disputes.In the Mulan Grassland, I met a cultivator hired by the Mulan people.His name is Ge Tianhao.Unexpectedly, Tianhao looks rude and rude on the outside, but he is a chivalrous person in his heart.I told him, I am tired of seeing bloody killings and hell-on- Mortals scenes.May I ask, we are all citizens of the grasslands, the sons and daughters of Changshengtian, why do we have to fight each other like this, we have to kill each other without leaving any blood in order to be quicker? \n Tianhao was stunned after hearing this, and finally, under the education of the little girl, he abandoned this kind of hatred for no reason.I told him that if I were a saint on the grassland, then my first duty as a saint would be to quell the war between the Tianlan people and the Mulan people.
text.于是我为了发泄心头恨意，便在凡间制造了大干涸。黄帝却借口此事，把我驱逐到了弱水之: So in order to vent my hatred, I created a great dryness in the mortal world.The Yellow Emperor excused this and expelled me to the north of Ruoshui.People see me as a disaster, and the criticism is endless.Oh, it turns out that human beings are such ruthless creatures just like gods.
text.于是我在碧海畔奏起了我的《碧海潮生曲》，当曲子和碧海的涛声产生一种共鸣后，如影像: So I played my 《Blue Sea Tide Song》 on the bank of the blue sea.When the song resonated with the sound of the blue sea, the image-like memory flooded into my thoughts.I played the jade flute, but I watched scene after scene of my previous life in meditation with my eyes closed.It turned out that when the teacher picked up a little baby girl at the foot of Mount Emei, she learned from the jade flute in the baby that she was a descendant of the fairy clan, a banished fairy in the mortal world.So she named me Li Xian'er, hoping that when I grow up, I can use my flute to pursue my past memories.The mysteries of the previous life, the reincarnation of the present life, the unfulfilled wish, all the unsolved Story surrounding my jade flute, how many have not been told yet.
text.于是我主动靠近旱神女魃，取得她的信任，和她成为同伴。同时我为了女魃寻求认同，带她: So I took the initiative to approach the Nvba, to gain her trust and become her companion.At the same time, I sought approval for my daughter-in-law and brought her to this ancient battlefield in the Heaven.Under DragonDog's guidance, I Setting a sacrificial ceremony to turn the female demon into a zombie.DragonDog divided his soul into four, and one of them entered the body of Nv Yao.
text.于是在亭子里另一位隐士叶凝烟的指点下，本公主来到了百花域，和来此寻找忆梦草的薛思: So under the guidance of Ye Ningyan, another hermit in the pavilion, the princess came to Floral Realm, and met Xue Si who came here to look for Yimengcao.Xue Si said that she was a reincarnated sword fairy and wanted to start her cultivation career again.From then on, the princess and Xue Si began to practice Aerify together.After breaking through the State, the two of us came to the pavilion by the Hanjiang River again.This time, Ye Ningyan and Hanyi were waiting for the princess.It turned out that the war of the Demon Dao's invasion of Guangdong was about to begin, and they were recruiting manpower behind the front, trying to counter the Demon Dao.
text.于是在一次外出执行任务的过程中，我遇到了执行攻击灵脉任务的怜非花。她是魔焰宗掌门: So in the process of going out to perform a mission, I met Lian Feihua who was on a mission to ATK the Spirit Vein.She is the daughter of the Leader of the Demon Flame Sect.It is said that she can use fire to burn other people's souls, taking pleasure in abusing others, and improving her own Attainment.Lian Feihua recognized me at a glance as the recent active female disciple of Huangfenggu, and ordered the minions to surround me.Lian Feihua wanted to take me away to practice her evil fire Technique, so naturally I wouldn't let her succeed easily, so I vowed to resist to the death.But Lian Feihua is not an idle person, I fought her very hard, and she used the evil fire to trap me, and I couldn't use it for a while.Just when I was about to fall into a desperate situation, I heard a person approaching with a song.I looked up, and it turned out to be Hanyi, a hero known to both righteous and demonic people.He was dressed in red, as if he came here specially to rescue me, and within a few rounds he repelled Lian Feihua.I escaped from the evil fire and was about to thank Han Yi, but he floated away in a red blood coat, leaving me only his back.
text.与我常一起的，还有叶家的千金小姐叶凝烟，我经常去寒江畔的枫叶亭里，找她们一群散仙: I often go with Ye Ningyan, the daughter of the Ye family, and I often go to the Maple Leaf Pavilion by the Hanjiang River to drink and have fun with a group of Sanxian hermits.Getting to know Ningyan was the greatest Fortuity in my life, and through her, I came into contact with a strange and bizarre world.Whether it is the Dongqiao girl who weaves the clouds, or Xiao Lingxuan who Summon the rain, those exiled immortals who should only exist in legends have now appeared in front of me alive one by one.Sometimes when I come to the Maple Leaf Pavilion, I see such a group of loose immortals gathered together, playing and playing like mortal young women.I even mistakenly think that this is in a dream, and I have to pinch myself fiercely to get rid of it.feel real.
text.郁垒、神荼，我们是来自幽都的两姊妹，一对魑魅魍魉。千百年来，我们一直在幽冥的万鬼: Yu Lei and Shen Tu, we are two sisters from Youdu, a pair of ghosts and monsters.For thousands of years, we have been dancing to our heart's content in the ghostly haunted land.We scratched our heads and posed, and twisted our hips and waists to our heart's content.All the ghosts were fascinated by us, and we forgot our hatred and resentment.If you dare to come before us, are you not afraid of being dragged into the abyss of temptation?
text.原来极北女王牧梅实际上也有自己的思量，她知道北夜极宫的虚灵殿中心，有一处空间节点: It turns out that the Queen of the Extreme North, Mumei, actually has her own thinking.She knows that there is a space node in the center of the Void Spirit Hall in the Northern Night Pole Palace, which can help the monks in the transformation stage to quickly Ascend.Mumei actually wants to take the opportunity to occupy this space node and study the shortcut method of Ascend.Bengong was also very jealous of this space node, so he had a dispute with Mumei.The two sisters Yan Shiyu and Xue Si persuaded us to capture the Void Spirit Hall and discuss it again, so we put the quarrel on hold for the time being.How could the minor cultivators of Jigong be able to resist our Strength, even Beiye's junior sister Bai Yaoyi was injured by us.It's just that while we were arguing, Fairy Bingpo was also very slippery, and she didn't hesitate to destroy the Void Spirit Hall by herself, destroying the entrance of that space node.The huge explosion triggered an energy vortex, and Bengong and Mumei couldn't move forward.In the end, they had to give up this crusade against Beiye and wanted to fight again in the future.
text.原来是那群修士借口小女子到天南是故意散播瘟疫，他们以扫奸锄恶为名，非要要逼小女子: It turned out that the group of monks used the excuse that the little girl went to Tiannan to intentionally spread the plague.They used the name of sweeping up rape and evil, and they insisted on forcing the little girl to leave the poisonous treasures and beasts on her body before they would let her go.Seeing this group of people being so stubborn, the little girl turned her anger into a smile, and pretended that she was willing to keep the poisonous magic Trump on her body, but she wanted to invite fellow Taoists to drink a glass of wine.Those people thought that the little girl was going to invite them to drink poisonous wine, but it was not the case.The little girl took out the nest of poisonous insects on her body, crushed them and flew out countless poisonous insects, stung them one by one on the head, and they immediately scattered and fled.It turns out that Miaojiang people are used to drinking poisonous insects, and the top of their heads will become more and more swollen, and eventually they will lose their minds, as if they were drunk every day.
text.原来是三阳真人想要让奴家成为他的傀儡，奴家宁死不从，于是他威胁要将奴家囚禁起来。: It turned out that Sanyang Daoist wanted to make Nujia his puppet, and Nujia would rather die than obey, so he threatened to imprison Nujia.The slave family had no choice but to pretend to agree, while contacting their sister Yuanyao.With Yuanyao's help, we designed a trap to assassinate Sanyang Zhenren.As a result, during the operation, Nujia was accidentally destroyed by Sanyang, and his spirit was forced to live in the magic weapon.Yuanyao got the Nurture Soul wood later, and wanted to perform the resurrection technique for the slave family, but was interrupted by a ghost fog in the process.The two of us sisters were involved in the ghost mist, and finally trapped in the dark place in the center of the ghost mist.Here, the two of us became half ghosts, but fortunately, we met Yan Qingyan, the eldest lady of the Ghost Spirit Gate., with her help, the two sisters from the slave family reformed the ghost way.
text.愿世间千种金钱，万般财气，皆滚滚自来。: May all kinds of money and wealth in the world flow freely.
text.云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还。当你累了的时候，你要记得你有一个在家中细细描眉的人在: The cloud has no heart to go out of Xiu, and the bird knows to return when it is tired.When you are tired, you have to remember that you have a person waiting for you who is at home to paint your eyebrows; there is a person who is waiting for you at home who is playing the piano.The flowers in front of the court are blooming and falling, and the clouds are rolling and relaxing in the sky; a picture scroll and a book, remember that I will always be waiting for you.Whether it is piano, chess, calligraphy, painting or poetry, as long as you think, I can accompany you.In the courtyard, you can practice, and I can play the flute next to you.Isn't this kind of fairy couple's life that everyone yearns for? Isn't that what you want? As long as you will come back to me, then I will always be waiting for you.
text.云萧大哥为了帮妾身根治龙吟之质的疾病，便用颠倒五行阵去换取了一株千年灵药紫桂花，: In order to help my concubine cure the disease of dragon-yin quality, brother Yunxiao exchanged the upside-down five-element array for a plant of purple osmanthus, a thousand-year-old elixir, which became a primer for my concubine's life-saving medicine.So the concubine temporarily got rid of the worry of her life, but brother Yun Xiao was assassinated because he was suspected of having more magic circle treasures.The concubine entrusts another friend, Wen Siyue, a disciple of Miaoyinzong, to use the 《Cloud Note》 left by her elder brother as a reward on her behalf, hoping to recruit knights to avenge her elder brother, and at the same time find her wandering soul.It is rumored that someone said that he saw his eldest brother being rescued by a member of the wolf tribe.It is not debatable whether it is true or not.I hope that the fairy will be willing to find news about the eldest brother for my concubine.Thank you!
text.再次来到了两界峰，望着眼前熟悉的仙门，之前飞升的情景历历在目，仿佛就在昨日……: Came to 2-World Peak again, looking at the familiar fairy gate in front of me, the scene of the previous Ascend was vivid in my mind, as if it was just yesterday……
text.在过去，人们到了腊月二十五便开始磨豆腐，供春节期间食用。寄予了吉祥如意的好兆头。: In the past, people began to grind tofu on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth lunar month for consumption during the Spring Festival.A good sign of good luck.Which moral is wrong?
text.在和蚩尤的作战中，我不幸身死在荒野之中。但没有人为我收尸，我的那些曾经的同伴，丝: In the battle with Chi You, I unfortunately died in the wilderness.But no one collected my body, and my former companions ignored me at all.They celebrated their own victory, but let me expose my corpse to the wilderness like this, smelling and corrupting.No one cared until I showed my bones.
text.在犼的帮助下，我变成了世间的第一具僵尸，万尸之祖。我被称呼为飞魃，变成僵尸之后我: With the help of DragonDog, I became the first zombie in the world, the ancestor of corpses.I am called Fei Ba, and after becoming a zombie, I Strength extremely powerful.I can use the technique of soul-moving and blood-sucking to absorb human souls and flesh and blood; I can also travel between heaven and earth, and even infect human beings as my own kind.
text.在犼魂的指点下，本将冲破了天界，来到了上古战场。这里是炼狱废墟一般的地方，正是本: Under the guidance of the DragonDog, the general broke through the Heaven and came to the ancient battlefield.This is a place like the ruins of purgatory, and it is a good battlefield for this general to flex his muscles.Ben will Dispatch DragonDog to contact Chiyou's former subordinates, Gonggong and Kua Fu, and summon them as well.As long as a group of demon gods can be gathered here and the line of defense is set up, they can let go and wake up Chi You.Then the situation between the enemy and ourselves will be very different.
text.在冀州前线，雨师风伯召唤出雷暴雨，将应龙的烈焰熄灭。应龙的神通无法使用，只能俯首: On the front line of Jizhou, Master Yu Fengbo Summon a thunderstorm to extinguish Yinglong's flames.Yinglong's Divinity cannot be used, so he can only bow his head and be punished.Our army uses its dragon head to sacrifice to heaven.The Yellow Emperor, who became angry from embarrassment, went to the Emperor of Heaven to borrow a woman named Drought God, and then attacked Jizhou.
text.在冀州战场上，风伯雨师降下大暴雨，故黄帝来请求止雨。于是我的父亲天帝，便让我下凡: On the battlefield of Jizhou, Fengbo Yushi rained a heavy rain, so the Yellow Emperor came to ask to stop the rain.So my father, the Emperor of Heaven, sent me down to quell the rain.Because my ability is to summon drought and make all the wind and rain disappear.Just this time, the gate of Heaven will be closed to me forever.
text.在仅剩下魂魄的犼建议下，本将接受了联合蚩尤一道的策略。因为想要救出炎帝，仅仅打败: Under the suggestion of DragonDog, who only had his soul left, Ben Jiang accepted the strategy of joining forces with Chi You.Because if you want to save Yan Emperor, it is not enough to just defeat the Yellow Emperor, you must also defeat the Emperor of Heaven standing behind the Yellow Emperor.Only by wiping out all the enemies in a nest of snakes and rats can our army win the final victory.
text.在漫长的关押之中，每天面对后土那个八婆，咱几乎绝望。要酒水也不给，要蜂蜜也不给，: During the long period of detention, facing that eighth woman in Houtu every day, we almost despaired.She won't give you wine if you ask for it, or honey if you ask for it.The whole menopause is a neurotic aunt.Hey, who can come to this ancient ghost prison to save us? As a result, Chi You did it.He turned into an ax and split open the ghost prison, releasing Zan and Soar.When we escaped from the dungeon, we knew that Chi You had the grace of rebuilding me.
text.在母亲红拂师姑的关系下，奴家进入到黄风谷成为了一名青年女修。于是奴家正式开始把自: Under the relationship of his mother, Aunt Hongfu, the slave family entered the Yellow Wind Valley and became a young female cultivator.So the slave family officially began to display their hatred of men.There are a lot of brainless male cultivators in Huangfeng Valley, as long as Nujia winks at them, they will think that Nujia has a heart of love for them, and fall in love with Nujia like a demon.Therefore, the slave family maintained an ambiguous relationship with multiple men at the same time, making them jealous for the sake of the slave family, and even developed to fight with swords and fight with each other with their lives.Every time I saw those men killing each other, the slave family was very excited.The slave family even tricked that idiot Senior Brother Lu into taking Chen Qiaoqian's Base.Later, I heard that the fool failed to grab the pill, and he was killed, which is really interesting.
text.在女魃召唤出来大干旱之下，雨师风伯的神通无法施展，最终他们二人被黄帝击败，冀州城: Under the great drought Summon by the female demon, Yu Shifeng's Divinity could not be displayed.In the end, the two of them were defeated by the Yellow Emperor, and Jizhou City was reduced to ruins.Gu then left everything behind, went to the land of Zhuolu and fought against the Yellow Emperor.With Gu's presence on the battlefield in person, the morale of the front line was greatly boosted.The Yellow Emperor lost nine of nine battles.
text.在我的脑海里，总有这么一段似有似无的记忆，好似云海的鸣声，又好似云霄的琴音。在那: In my mind, there is always such a vague memory, like the sound of the sea of ??clouds, and like the sound of the piano in the sky.In such vague impressions, I am a fairy, standing at the end of the sea of ??clouds, looking at the endless Xiandu Xiandian, the golden fence of the Jade Palace, and the swaying Xianjiao……as if all this happened for real Passed, something deliberately kept in my mind to remind me of my identity.But what about my past? No one can tell me.The only thing that can prove that I did have a unique past is this set of 《Pure Girl Reincarnation》.This is not something taught to me by the master in the Moon Sect, but a set of Technique that have been imprinted in my mind since I was born, and let me practice spontaneously……I can't tell myself who I am.Yan Qingyan, a younger junior sister from the same school, is well-versed in poetry and books, and has a close relationship with me.She secretly told me that maybe I might be a reincarnation.And the so-called reincarnated person is a person who reincarnated with some memories of his previous life.With the opening of a certain Fortuity, the memory of the previous life will gradually recover.
text.在颜丽的介绍下，伦家得知，原来鬼雾的正中央叫做阴冥之地，在这里面，还有许多的阴冥: Under Yan Li's introduction, the Lun family learned that the center of the ghost mist is called the land of the underworld, where there are many ghosts of the underworld.They stared at the Lun family one by one, as if they wanted to devour the Lun family at any time.The Lun family was terrified, because in the land of darkness, All human beings cannot use mana, and only ghost cultivators can use Divinity.When the Lun family was at a loss, Yan Li gave advice to the Lun family, saying that the Lun family was originally a body of jade and phoenix marrow.The characteristic of this physique is that they can transfer the Lun family's mana to the other party through skin-to-skin contact.The Lun family kissed on the lips of a female cultivator Bai Yaoyi who was also involved in the dark place like the Lun family.Bai Yaoyi recovered Mana and pulled the Lun family away from the ghost fog.It was really too dangerous, so the Lun family never dared to leave Taiyang Gate, because the outside world was too dangerous.Even if they had to endure their father's severe accusations inside the door, the Lun family did not dare to leave.
text.在这个三界内外，吾所知唯一可能撼动天帝权威的，便是已成为征伐之神的兵神蚩尤。可惜: Inside and outside the Three Realms, the only thing I know that can shake the authority of the Emperor of Heaven is Chi You, the Chiyou who has become the God of Conquest .It's a pity that after the Zhuolu War, Chi You's soul has been suppressed on the ancient battlefield.Although the Original has endless tricks, but to awaken Chi You, he needs the help of Other demon gods.
text.在正面战场上，孤所向披靡，攻无不克战无不胜。于是轩辕氏便派遣大将应龙，去偷袭孤后: On the frontal battlefield, Gu is invincible and invincible.So the Xuanyuan clan Dispatch General Yinglong to attack Jizhou, the base camp behind Gu.As Yinglong arrived, he spit out flames and melted the city, and Jizhou was terrified.But Yin Lingzi, who was in charge of guarding Jizhou, sensed the fear in advance and ran away.Gu Reflection's biggest mistake in using soldiers in his life was picking Yin Lingzi as a general.
text.咱确实是北夜极宫里的一个异类弟子啦，咱待人很热情，也很话痨啰嗦，一见到新朋友就有: We are indeed a different kind of disciple in Beiyeji Palace.We treat people very enthusiastically, but we are also very talkative.Whenever we meet new friends, we can't finish talking.But this does not mean that we are very happy and have no worries in our hearts.In fact, the Beiye Pole Palace is now facing very great difficulties.We Experience to the south so frequently, on the one hand, we also want to seek help.Recently, Che Laoyao from Wan Yao Valley led a group of demons, joined forces with Xue Feng in the ice sea, and attacked the entire Beiye Pole Palace.In the end, it was the palace lord who detonated the Void Spirit Hall to injure Xuefeng and drive back the demons in the Valley of Ten Thousand Monsters.Now that the Northern Night Polar Palace has been seriously damaged, we would like to invite some powerful monks to become the foreign aid of the Northern Night Polar Palace to protect the safety of the Polar Palace.I don't know if the Immortal Elder intends to become the honorary Patronus of the Northern Night Pole Palace together?
text.咱只是一个从小就喜欢灵兽的修士，比起什么正道魔道来说，咱只在乎是不是可以让咱养灵: We are just a monk who has liked Pet beasts since we were young.Compared with the orthodox way, we only care about whether we can raise Pet.And Yulingzong is such a good place, everyone raises insects and beasts, and even the Pet raised by others are more powerful.We live happily here, and we don't want to get involved in any dispute between good and evil.At the Tainan Xiaohui, we also sold a Jinzhu talisman pen to a female cultivator who was also obsessed with Pet.Her name was Xiyue.I didn't expect Xiyue to help us a lot when we were about to encounter difficulties later.
text.早先我在苗疆修行之时，便和程程一道在腊尔山追寻五圣老祖的步伐。我一开始只是希望能: When I was practicing in Miaojiang earlier, I followed the footsteps of the Five Sacred Patriarchs on Mount Laer with Cheng Cheng.At the beginning, I just hoped to make myself a step further in poison art.But I didn't expect the ancestor of the five sages to tell me that I not only have the Talent of using poison, but also the Talent of controlling flowers and plants.Under his guidance, I came to a huge vine forest.After careful inspection, I found out that this is actually an ancient ivy that has grown into a spirit, so a single vine grew into a whole forest of vines, and All the vines are connected.In the middle of the forest, I saw the vine spirit, a wood spirit with the appearance of an old woman.She said that she failed to Ascend, Yuan Yang was exhausted, and now she was looking for a descendant to Inherit her mantle.Seeing me is my Fortuity.
text.盏茶过后，少年驱马赶至。满目残垣断壁和熊熊燃烧的大火，行凶之人已不知去向。少年紧: After a cup of tea, the young man drove his horse to arrive.There are ruins and blazing fires everywhere, and the perpetrators have disappeared.The young man frowned, raised his hand and waved "Save!".Dozens of people were divided into small teams and began to treat the wounded.I saw a few soldiers carrying the elderly and helping the wounded with broken arms out of the fire.Moans and cries filled the eardrums, a scene of hell.
text.占卜这种事情，向来都是站在求占者的立场上考虑的。就是说不问对方求占的是多么恶念的: Divination has always been considered from the standpoint of the seeker.That is to say, it is an evil thing not to ask what the other party is asking for divination.As a fortuneteller, we must not refute the other party's position.For example, Ge Tianhao, who used to be a demon, once came to ask for possession.He first asked if he could succeed in forming the alchemy next time, so we can just answer the other party's yes or no.But if the other party adds a sentence, when forming the alchemy, it is necessary to treat others as medicine dregs to improve the chance of alchemy, is it harmful to the sky? Then we would say：Just do what you want, and you don’t have to ask whether it is moral……Our purpose in doing this is actually to prevent ourselves from refuting the other party’s position and causing disaster.The behavior of the monks is beyond the control of the fortuneteller, and the results of good and bad are often derived from good and evil thoughts.As a fortune teller, what we have to do is not to interfere with other people's positions, and to ensure that we do not get involved in disputes.
text.这都赶上猴子的七十二变了。能不能教我一手？: This has caught up with the seventy-two changes of the monkey.Can you teach me a hand?
text.这片天界的上古战场，在成为战场之前，曾是我的家园。在天界之战爆发之前，盘古遗留的: This ancient battlefield in the Heaven was my Home before it became a battlefield.Before the Battle of the Heaven broke out, the descendants of Pangu lived here.Even the gods privately call this place the Heaven Beyond Heaven, and envy the relaxation and freedom here.This is a paradise that is not controlled and restrained by the emperor of heaven.
text.这时一个獐头鼠目的瘦小个子献媚策马走至大汉身侧，拱手作揖。“大王，小的有一计。”: At this time, a thin and small man with a deer-headed mouse look flattered and rode up to the side of the big man, bowing his hands."My lord, the little one has a plan." Then he whispered a few words into the big man's ear.I saw the big man's complexion turned from cloudy to sunny, he randomly slapped the thin and small man with his palm, and praised "good plan".The thin and small man suddenly felt a strong attack on his shoulders, and his body tilted sideways.The horse under him staggered and almost fell.Grinning his teeth, he straightened up, not daring to put his hands on his injured shoulder, and said with an apologetic smile, "Your Majesty is wise."
text.这世间的凡夫俗子，又有谁人得知世间万物的演化规律。亘古以来，世间万事万物之更易，: Ordinary people in this world, who knows the evolution law of all things in the world.Since ancient times, everything in the world has been changed, such as Zhouyi, Yin and Yang, following the law of Hetu and Luoshu.Tens of thousands of years ago, the old man Attainment a great achievement, he overwhelmed the number one cultivator of Tiannan's righteous and demonic ways, and subdued them, so as to give me the land of the extreme west, so that he will be famous in future generations The Thousand Bamboo Sect; I created the Technique in the Thousand Bamboo Sect, and only then did I have the Dayan Jue that countless talented monks in later generations pursued enthusiastically.It's a pity that people in the world are short-sighted.The puppet art that I have devoted my whole life to is the real treasure in the world! No one knows how to appreciate it.It's really the breeze and the bright moon who share the same, the mountains and rivers have few bosom friends.
text.这一晚你睡得并不怎么舒坦，早上还要被惊吓。原来事情是这样的，早上的你还犯着困，感: You haven't slept very well that night, and you'll be terrified in the morning.It turns out that the thing is like this, you are still sleepy in the morning, and you feel that your face is being poked by someone, and you are so annoyed that you can't push it away with your hands or turn over.You opened your eyes directly to see what's going on, this time it's good, a black ghost-like person is facing you, you thought you really met a ghost, so you jumped up.It wasn't until he calmed down that he remembered that this person was the person he saved yesterday, but his skin was completely destroyed because of the thunder disaster.\nAfter the two of you finished the question and answer like in the script, you learned that her name is Concubine Mu Xue.Because there are no practitioners in the city, and you don’t have a master.I found a deep mountain to Ascend, but I didn't expect to be very unlucky.In the same way, you also informed her of the situation, and she begged you to help her recover her skin after learning about the situation.You also agreed.
text.正月初一还要吃大年三十夜里包好的素饺子，取“平安素净”的意思，而吃前一天包的饺子: On the first day of the first lunar month, we also eat vegetarian dumplings made on the night of the New Year's Eve, which means "safe and clean", while eating the dumplings made the day before means?
text.正月初一在古代不叫春节，而是叫什么？: The first day of the first lunar month was not called the Spring Festival in ancient times, but what was it called?
text.之后，犼继续将自己的魂魄注入进战将嬴勾的体内。又复活了它自己留下的肉体虚壳，将其: After that, DragonDog continued to inject his soul into the body of the general Yinggou.It also revived the empty shell of its own body, and named it General.In the end , DragonDog divided his soul into four and controlled the four zombies respectively.This is the origin of all zombies in the later generations.All people who died unjustly can become zombies to take revenge on their former enemies.
text.之后本尊便施计帮助夸父捉到了三足金乌，破了他的刑罚。夸父向本尊致谢，但本尊要他一: After that, the Original helped Kua Fu catch the three-legged Golden Crow and broke his punishment.Kua Fu thanked the Original, but the Original asked him to wake up Chiyou together and revive the Heaven.The giant not only agreed, but also brought his own friend Xing Tian along.
text.之前山门来了一个名叫厉非宇的小药童，说自己只有炼气期的道行，师长安排他在小女子手: A little Medical Assisitant named Li Feiyu came to the Cult Gate before, saying that he only had the Taoism of the Aerify stage, and the teacher arranged for him to work under the little girl's hands.The little girl herself has few desires and pure cultivation.In fact, she hates contacting the opposite sex, but seeing the honest face of the little drug Medical Assisitant, and the teacher insisted on asking the little girl to give him some advice.There is no other way but to let him work hard in the Herbal Fields.The little girl originally thought that little Medical Assisitant was very inconspicuous, but she didn't expect that his ability was really not small, and he actually got a good result in the top ten in the sword test meeting.It feels like he is not an ordinary disciple in the Aerify period, but a master who deliberately pretended to be a disciple and came to the little girl's Herbal Fields to steal the teacher.Alas, there are too many Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon practitioners in the Sect, and it's not just the little Medical Assisitant.Even Nie Ying, the girl from Yellow Wind Valley, is only spending the night in our Sect to cultivate, and even her Strength may surprise the outside world.
text.之所以我有遁神这个称号，是因为我善于躲避危险。但为了爱我可以不顾危险。我问你，你: The reason why I have the Title of Escaping God is because I am good at avoiding danger.But for love I can ignore danger.I ask you, have you ever loved someone else? Have you ever loved someone who doesn't love you at all, but you are bitterly in love with her! I did not hesitate to annoy my big brother Chi You for the sake of my virgin girl……
text.只记得，在梦里我已经修炼至大乘，准备渡过飞升雷劫之际，却被一位被称为轮回殿主的大: I just remember that in my dream, I had already cultivated to Mahayana, and when I was about to go through the Ascend disaster, I was Summon to the fairyland by a great man called the master of the reincarnation hall.When I came to the fairy world, I saw that the Lord of the Reincarnation Palace was a handsome man.He asked his beautiful daughter Gan Jiuzhen to take me to Huangquan Daze.In front of me.Only then did I suddenly realize what had happened in my previous life.But after Gan Jiuzhen showed me the experience of the previous life, he said that I was only allowed to see the Destiny in my dreams, and once I woke up, I would forget all about it.So when I woke up, I could only remember the Hall of Reincarnation, Huangquan Daze, and the Six Paths Reincarnation Disk, but I couldn't Memory the scenes in the reincarnation disk at all.So I can only speculate that my previous life probably has something to do with the Hall of Reincarnation and even the fairy Gan Jiuzhen.It's just speculation……
text.只是血灵大法过于霸道，想要修炼此法，必须要一男一女共同双修才行。而灵根资质对其能: It's just that the Blood Spirit Dafa is too overbearing.If you want to practice this method, you must have a man and a woman to Dual Practice together.And the Aptitude qualification is very important for it to be able to cultivate to several levels.The Hehuan Sect once came over and told the matchmaker that Dong Xuanxuan and this young master should be allowed to Dual Practice together, but Dong Xuanxuan is not someone with Aptitude, so this young master refused.Later, after I heard that the Yan family in Guangdong had a daughter who was born with a heavenly Aptitude, I personally went to the Yan family.Sure enough, hard work pays off, the old man of the Yan family wisely said that he would marry his daughter to me, and he would also lead the entire Yan family into the Ghost Gate.Hmph, in this day and age, there are very few people who are so knowledgeable about current affairs and who are outstanding, so this young master naturally agreed to him immediately.Just wait for the Yan family's daughter to pass through the door, and then they can Dual Practice the blood spirit Dafa together, and wait to dominate the magic way!
text.只是在涿鹿大战上，我姊妹二人与蚩尤都败于轩辕氏。我们姊妹忠心耿耿，仍旧想要复活旧: It's just that in the battle of Zhuolu, both my sisters and Chi You were defeated by the Xuanyuan clan.Our sisters are loyal and still want to revive the old master Chi You.Under the guidance of Pingyi, we came to this ancient battlefield in the Heaven, just waiting for the resurrection of the old master Chi You, so that we can dance gracefully again.
text.终究是皮肉扛不住马鞭的犀利，人们眼神充满惊惧，纷纷远离大道，让出来一条路。壮汉使: After all, flesh and blood couldn't bear the sharpness of the whip, and people's eyes were full of fear, and they all moved away from the road to make way.The strong man shook the bloody whip vigorously and threw it to the groom.He jumped onto the shaft of the car sideways and said "Hurry up".The vehicle started, and the wheels were covered with blood and dust and drove towards the city.
text.终于，还是皇天不负苦心人。那日风伯飞廉的魂魄流浪到不周山来，见了本尊。飞廉说他愿: In the end, the sky paid off.That day, Feilian's soul wandered to Mt.Buzhou and met Original.Soar said that he was willing to be tortured for the Original, but only asked the Original to go out to find the old department.So the Original cleverly used a trick to replace himself with Feng Bo, and his body was free.Immediately afterwards , the Original Wander to the inside and outside of the Three Realms, looking for allies from the past.
text.主上炎帝被轩辕俘虏，而本将也被生擒。由于本将不肯屈尊投降轩辕氏，于是被斩去了头颅: The Lord Emperor Yan Emperor was captured by Xuanyuan, and Ben was also captured alive.Because the general refused to condescend to surrender to the Xuanyuan clan, he was beheaded.The Yellow Emperor was afraid of Xingtian's reputation as a fierce general, so he separated the general's body.The general's head was buried in Changyang Mountain, and the general's body was shackled in the weak water prison as a prisoner.
