text.<color=#0c5a8b>写在前面的话</color>：\\n1、无论哪种化:
<color=#0c5a8b>Developer's Note</color>：
1、You will earn <color=#9e4444>all 3 avatar frames and tags</color> regardless of the ascension order you selected;
2、Outland and Time River can be unlocked through <color=#9e4444>all types of ascension</color>;

<color=#0c5a8b>Ascension</color>：
1、Subsage：<color=#9e4444>Finish daily Merit Hall quests</color> and activate all 9 Merit Lotuses （<color=#9e4444>Easiest way that takes longest time</color>）
2、Sursage：<color=#9e4444>Collect materials, reveal the 3 corpses and slay them</color>.（Requires high <color=#9e4444>Realm</color>, as well as passing <color=#9e4444>Outland Yin</color> and <color=#9e4444>Jade Deity G.10</color>.）
3、Marsage：<color=#9e4444>Win the fight to ascend</color>, （no need to collect resources and no Realm required）, but requires a lot to <color=#9e4444>activate Divinity</color>.

<color=#0c5a8b>Ascension Order</color>：
<color=#9e4444>Subsage - Sursage - Marsage</color>.This order <color=#9e4444>is fixed</color>.
1、After becoming the Subsage, you can start the process of <color=#9e4444>ascension to Sursage and Marsage</color>;
2、If you choose to ascend to the Marsage first, then you cannot ascend to <color=#9e4444>Subsage or Sursage</color>;
but you can still <color=#9e4444>finish the related quests and collect the avatar frames</color>.

<color=#0c5a8b>200% Divinity Materials</color>：
If you choose to ascend by <color=#9e4444>default order</color>, it will cost <color=#9e4444>1 material each time you ascend</color>, and the Divinity you have activated will upgrade automatically;
If you choose to ascend to <color=#9e4444>Marsage</color> directly, then you will need <color=#9e4444>2 pieces of material</color> each time you activate a Divinity.

text.灵兽-<color=#9e4444>提供大量属性加成</color>\\n\\n:
Spirit Beasts - <color=#9e4444>Provide massive attribute bonuses</color>

1、For each additional Spirit Beast, it increases Mount's attributes by <color=#9e4444>10%</color>, so <color=#9e4444>the more the better</color>.
2、Every <color=#9e4444>10</color> levels a single Spirit Beast is raised, it can increase character attributes by <color=#9e4444>5%</color> of that Spirit Beast (up to <color=#9e4444>80%</color>).
3、Early game recommends <color=#9e4444>Azure Dragon, Fiend Flood Dragon</color>, late game recommends <color=#9e4444>Divine Deer / Black Tortoise</color>
Note：Spirit Beasts account for a large portion of attributes. Very significant for fellow Daoists wishing to <color=#9e4444>ascend early</color>.

Spirit Beast Veins - <color=#9e4444>Provide massive attribute bonuses</color>
<color=#0c5a8b>Fiend Trapping at Home</color>
1.Using Fiend Tempter in the <color=#9e4444>Trapping Array</color>, you can trap Fiends of different qualities <color=#9e4444>（Plant Fiend Tempter at Home）</color>
2.The higher the quality of the Fiend, the stronger it is！ You can <color=#9e4444>upgrade array level to weaken Fiend strength</color> （Warm tip：When strength is insufficient and array level is low, try trapping lower-level Fiends first）
3.Successful challenge will drop two vein cultivation items：<color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】【Fiend Essence】</color> （Failed challenge drops a small amount of 【Fiend Blood】）
4.Successful challenge will also <color=#9e4444>have a chance to drop 【Gem of Veins】</color>, which is an advanced item to lock vein refining affixes

<color=#0c5a8b>Spirit Beast Vein Cultivation</color>
1.Every Spirit Beast can awaken its veins, higher quality beasts can awaken more veins
2.Spirit Beasts have two types of cultivation：<color=#9e4444>Vein Enhancement</color> and <color=#9e4444>Vein Quenching</color>
3.Vein Enhancement
（1） Each vein has 2 basic enhancement attributes, consume <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】【Fiend Essence】</color> to enhance and increase vein attributes
（2） Higher quality Spirit Beasts have a higher enhancement level cap
<color=#FF0000>Heaven Grade Spirit Beast Lv.40 （Black Tortoise Lv.50）</color>
<color=#FF8C00>Earth Grade Spirit Beast Lv.30</color>
<color=#9400D3>Mythic Grade Spirit Beast Lv.20</color>
<color=#0000FF>Novice Grade Spirit Beast Lv.10</color>
4.Vein Quenching
（1） Each Spirit Beast can possess up to 4 quenching attributes！
<color=#FF0000>Heaven Grade Spirit Beast</color> 4 veins = 4 quenching attributes
<color=#FF8C00>Earth Grade Spirit Beast</color> 3 veins = 3 quenching attributes
<color=#9400D3>Mythic Grade Spirit Beast</color> 2 veins = 2 quenching attributes
<color=#0000FF>Novice Grade Spirit Beast</color> 1 vein = 1 quenching attribute
（2） Consume <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Essence】</color> to quench attribute affixes of different qualities
（3） Quenching <color=#9e4444>20 times</color> consecutively guarantees a purple quality attribute on the next quenching
（4） When high-quality quenching attributes appear, you can consume <color=#9e4444>【Gem of Veins】</color> to lock them；locked attributes will not be refreshed during the next quenching！ （Each quenching retains the last locked selection, please check carefully and update selections in time）
5.Quenching attribute quality probability：
<color=#008000>Green Quality：60.5%</color>
<color=#0000FF>Blue Quality：24%</color>
<color=#9400D3>Purple Quality：10%</color>
<color=#FF8C00>Orange Quality：5%</color>
<color=#FF0000>Red Quality：0.5%</color>

1.Every Spirit Beast can have its Veins awakened, tthe higher the quality of the Beast, the more blood veins can be awakened.
2.Spirit Beasts can have their Veins <color=#9e4444>enhanced</color> or <color=#9e4444>quenched</color>.
3.Vein Enhancement
（1） Each blood vein has 2 kinds of basic enhancement attributes, consuming <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】 and 【Fiend Essence】</color> for improvements.
（2） The higher the quality of the Spirit Beast, the higher the upper limit of the enhancement level will be.
<color=#FF0000>G.Heaven：Lv.40 （Tortoise：Lv.50）</color> 
<color=#FF8C00>G.Earth：Lv.30</color> 
<color=#9400D3>G.Mythic：Lv.20</color> 
<color=#0000FF>G.Novice：Lv.10</color> 
4.Vein Quenching

<color=#FF0000>G.Heaven</color>：4 Blood Veins = 4 quenching attributes
<color=#FF8C00>G.Earth</color>：3 Blood Veins = 3 quenching attributes
<color=#9400D3>G.Mythic</color>：2 Blood Veins = 2 quenching attributes
<color=#0000FF>G.Novice</color>：1 Blood Vein = 1 quenching attribute

（3） Quenching <color=#9e4444>20 times</color> consecutively, the next quenching will be guaranteed with a purple quality attribute
（4） When a high quality quenching attribute appears, you can consume <color=#9e4444>【Gem of Veins】</color> to lock it; the locked attribute will not be replaced in the next quenching! （Each quenching retains the last locked selection, carefully check the timely replacement of the selection）

<color=#0c5a8b>Treasure Pavilion</color>：Cultivate treasures to gain attribute bonuses

<color=#0c5a8b>Law Enlightenment Pavilion</color>：<color=#9e4444>Break skill level cap</color>, can increase <color=#9e4444>skill</color> level cap up to <color=#9e4444>Lv.22</color>.

text.1、法宝内丹、主材在<color=#4f9a12>门派藏宝阁</color>，<:
1、Trump main materials and Inner Orbs can be obtained from <color=#4f9a12>Sect Treasure</color>, <color=#4f9a12>Exploration</color>, Training (Map <color=#4f9a12>starting from Mt.Buzhou</color>), <color=#4f9a12>Deity Market</color> etc.
2、After turning on the automatic infusing essence for 7-star Array, essence will be preferentially infused into the 7-star Array
3、Refining trumps by <color=#4f9a12>placing Inner Orbs</color> can grant <color=#4f9a12>set bond</color> effects, and trumps can also be refined without placing Inner Orbs
4、Choosing different furnace opening times during refining will produce different effects such as Taiyin and Taiyang
5、The higher the trump attributes, the higher the trump grade. Upgrading trumps can increase attributes
6、Trump refining requires reaching the specified Blacksmith level. If auxiliary materials are insufficient, the success rate of trump refining will be reduced
7、<color=#4f9a12>Multiple trumps of the same type can be equipped</color>, and trumps can be dismantled to obtain materials
8、Refined trumps can replace previous Inner Orb effects through smelting; trump smelting has a chance to fail
9、If 2 different Inner Orbs are placed, the Inner Orb effect after smelting will be randomly selected from the 2 Inner Orbs
10、Trump Qi is enhanced at Mao hour, Strength increases at Wu hour, Health increases at You hour, and Agility increases at Zi hour
11、Refined trumps (Relics) can increase star levels (max 5 stars) through quenching to gain stronger attribute effects. Star-raised trumps equipped in the 7-star Array can provide <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color> attributes; the higher the <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color>, the less damage received in combat
12、When the total star levels of trumps in the 7-star Array reach a certain level, the bond <color=#4f9a12>Infinite Star Shining</color> is unlocked, providing special effects in combat
13、For quenched trumps, clicking dismantle will return a portion of Cosmos Star Souls normally. Double Cosmos Star Souls can be obtained through Void Gem and Tianmen Gem. Jiuyou Night Mist will not be returned after dismantling.

Cauldron and Tripod of Lv.1-2 can be bought in Market with spirit stones, and then need to be exchanged in Sect Treasure Pavilion; of course, if lucky, can be obtained from Tavern. Also, when refining the same item, the higher the Cauldron/Tripod level used, the shorter the time consumed for refining.

text.声名远扬，威震四海: Fame spreads far and wide, awe-inspiring the Four Seas.
text.道法自然，天人合一: The Dao follows nature; Heaven and Man become one.
text.天地无极，仙途无尽: Heaven and Earth are limitless; the path to Immortality is endless.
text.龙腾千里神姿动，风云变幻万物尽: The dragon soars a thousand miles with divine grace; wind and clouds shift, encompassing all creation.
text.烟雨蒙蒙花间悄，芳菲馥郁入梦魂: Quietly among flowers in the misty rain; lush fragrance enters the soul of dreams.
text.等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春: Easily recognizing the face of the East Wind; a myriad of purples and reds—it is always Spring.
text.夫唯大雅,卓尔不群: Only the truly elegant stand apart from the crowd; outstanding and extraordinary.
text.待到云开月明，我自笑傲九霄。: Waiting until the clouds part and the moon shines, I laugh proudly at the Nine Heavens.
text.四载欢庆，岁月如歌。时光荏苒，笑语盈盈。: Four years of celebration, years passing like a song. Time flies, filled with laughter and joy.
text.明月花前同把盏，佳期圆满共婵娟。: Raising a cup before the bright moon and flowers; a perfect time to share the beauty together.
text.知音难觅今得遇，心弦共鸣奏清音。: A soulmate is hard to find but met today; heartstrings resonate to play a clear, harmonious tune.
text.明月入怀思绵绵， 云端寄语随风去。: Embracing the bright moon, thoughts are endless; sending words from the clouds to drift away with the wind.
text.剑光如水月如弓，万里江山一剑平。: Sword light like water, moon like a bow; ten thousand miles of mountains and rivers leveled by a single strike.
text.金蛇盘道授真经，渡尽红尘化众生。: The Golden Snake coils to teach the True Scripture, ferrying all living beings across the Red Dust (Mortal World).
text.一朝破茧证真空，今朝应龙傲苍穹。: Breaking the cocoon to prove the Void; today the Flood Dragon becomes the Yinglong, proudly roaming the firmament.
text.寒光淬雪刃玲珑，龙吟出鞘破苍穹。: Cold light quenches the snowy, exquisite blade; a dragon's roar unsheathes to pierce the sky.
text.烈焰焚身入九霄，残魂煅骨铸新骄。: Raging flames burn the body entering the Nine Heavens; remnant soul forges bones to cast a new legend.
text.春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。: Spring fills the garden and cannot be contained; a single branch of red apricot reaches over the wall.
text.遇事不决，可问己身。: If indecisive in matters, one can only ask their own heart.
text.五瑞莲华映日月，福泽绵长贯乾坤。: Five auspicious lotuses reflect the sun and moon; blessings stretch long across the Universe.
text.道韵长明照千古，心灯不灭破鸿蒙。: The rhythm of the Dao shines through the ages; the lamp of the heart never extinguishes, breaking the primordial chaos.
text.金风玉露结良缘，红线三生绕指缠。: Golden wind and jade dew form a perfect union; the red thread of three lifetimes winds around the finger.
text.一气吞云啸沧海，山河万里入怀来。: One breath swallows the clouds and roars at the ocean; ten thousand miles of land enter my embrace.
text.阴阳两界皆客旅，渡厄原是守护心。: A traveler in both Yin and Yang realms; overcoming calamity is essentially guarding the heart.
text.厚土承天载万物，德泽化雨润苍生。: The thick earth bears the sky and carries all things; virtuous blessings turn to rain to nourish the common people.
text.岁华开泰辟新元，启道辰光叩紫霄。: Time opens peace and starts a new cycle; initiating the light of dawn to knock on the Purple Heavens.
text.言念君子，温其如玉，总让人心生敬意: A true gentleman, gentle and flawless as jade, always inspiring respect in others.
text.一身墨绿长袍，腰悬长剑，干净利落，显得她英气勃发: Clad in dark green robes with a longsword at her waist; crisp and sharp, radiating a heroic spirit.
text.容貌秀丽，眸子深邃，长发如瀑，身着华丽的仙袍，身姿挺拔，行动矫健: Exquisite features, eyes deep as the abyss, hair flowing like a waterfall, dressed in magnificent immortal raiment.
text.世家嫡女，体质为元灵仙体，自然亲和程度极高，性格活泼，开朗，嘴角总是挂着若有若无: Legitimate daughter of a Noble Clan. Possesses the Primordial Spirit Physique, with an extremely high affinity for the Great Dao of Nature.
text.出身于仙界一个古老而神秘的家族，气质高雅而不失锋芒，自幼便展现出非凡的天赋。: Hails from an ancient and mysterious clan within the Immortal Realm.
text.自幼父母双亡，且天资愚钝。: Orphaned at a young age with dull natural aptitude for cultivation.
text.剑仙眷侣之女，先天的剑仙胚子。: Daughter of a Sword Immortal couple; a natural-born "Sword Embryo" (innate genius for the sword).
text.一代顶尖剑仙，战力极高。: A peerless Sword Immortal of her generation, possessing immense combat power.
text.娴静时如娇花照水，行动处似弱柳扶风: In stillness, she is like a delicate flower reflected in water; in motion, she resembles a fragile willow supported by the breeze.
text.气质高雅而不失锋芒: Possesses an elegant temperament, yet retains a sharp, hidden edge.
text.少年时期，早熟内向而多心计。: In his youth, he was precocious, introverted, and shrewd (full of schemes).
text.救死扶伤，悲天悯人。: She heals the dying and supports the injured, feeling deep compassion for the suffering of the world.
text.以琴音入道，抚琴时常有百鸟朝凤之异象。: Entered the Dao through music; when she plays, the phenomenon of "A Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix" often manifests.
text.我想明白了，对世界不要失去希望，除了一定要好好活着之外，其实还有一层意思，就是当: I have attained enlightenment on this matter: one must never lose hope in this world. Beyond the necessity of surviving, there is a deeper layer of meaning. When we offer benevolence to the world, if we receive no kindness in return—or even only malice—yet can remain undismayed at that very moment... that is the Dao of true hope.
text.她是个很独立的人。她的父母因为代表剑气城出战，失败后殒命，非但没有得到尊重，他们: She is a fiercely independent soul. Her parents fell in battle defending Sword Qi City. In defeat, they received no honor; instead, those they protected turned to blame them. Her parents passed away bearing the weight of infamy—one can only imagine the resentment involved. Yet, she harbors no grudge against the Heavens, nor does she seethe with indignation. She simply observes it all with a cold eye. She knows that to alter this reality, the sword within her heart must simply be swifter. And she has never once doubted her sword.
text.通明剑体，一个真正的天生剑修，伴生之物为上品飞剑法宝，可炼化至仙品，体内灵力可幻: Possessing the "Illuminated Sword Physique," she is a true natural-born Sword Cultivator. Her Natal Artifact is a high-grade flying sword, capable of being refined into an Immortal-grade treasure. The spiritual power within her can manifest as five phantom spirit swords, destroying enemies and exterminating demons as easily as...
text.除了精通御剑斩敌之术外，还掌握了一门强大的防护之术，可以化解攻击并保护己方人员。: Beyond mastering the art of sword control to slay foes, she has also mastered a powerful defensive art, capable of neutralizing attacks and protecting her allies. Due to her extreme devotion to the Sword, she can fluidly channel spiritual energy through her Sword Spirit to soothe the wounds of others. This has earned her immense prestige. On the day she Transcended Tribulation to Ascend, a vast crowd of admirers came spontaneously to stand guard and protect her Dao._x000D_
text.出身东荒，古老修行世家嫡女。出生时，继承了其母元灵之体，与自然大道亲和度极高，修: Born in the Eastern Wastelands, the legitimate daughter of an ancient Cultivation Clan. At birth, she inherited her mother's "Primordial Spirit Physique," granting her an extremely high affinity with the Great Dao of Nature. Her progress in cultivating the Five Elements Arts advances a thousand miles in a single day._x000D_
text.某日，族学先生在课堂中进行问答。\\n先生非常严峻的问道：“为什么说修真界中，最: One day, the Clan Elder conducted a Q&A session in the lecture hall. \nThe Elder asked with great severity："Why is it said that in the Cultivation World, the three types of people you must never trifle with are the elderly, children, and women?"_x000D_
text.锦歌生于一个春日的黎明，传说她出生时，天空中绽放出七彩祥云，预示着她不凡的命运。: Jin Ge was born at the break of dawn in spring. Legend has it that upon her birth, seven-colored auspicious clouds bloomed in the sky, foretelling her extraordinary destiny. Her name is taken from an ancient celestial melody._x000D_
text.她尤其擅长音律之道，能以琴音入道，抚琴时常有百鸟朝凤之异象。\\n锦歌居住在一座: She is particularly skilled in the Dao of Rhythm. She entered the Dao through music, and when she plays the zither, the phenomenon of "A Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix" often appears. \nJin Ge resides in a celestial palace known as the "Soaring Cloud Pavilion," which floats above..._x000D_
text.锦歌非常专注于自己的修行和对天道的探索。她经常游历人间，体悟众生百态，增进自己对: Jin Ge is deeply focused on her own cultivation and the exploration of the Heavenly Dao. She frequently roams the Mortal Realm to experience the myriad states of sentient beings, deepening her understanding and empathy for the world. These experiences have made her nature more open-minded and magnanimous, unconstrained by the rigid dogmas of the Immortal Realm._x000D_
text.墨蕴仙姿，鹤舞丹青: Imbued with immortal grace in ink, as white cranes dance across the painted landscape.
text.山河无恙，国泰民安: May the mountains and rivers remain inviolate, and the people dwell in eternal peace.
text.狼行天下: The alpha wolf of the frozen wastes treads across the mortal realm.
text.昔日仙音犹在耳，不教妖邪跨天门: Divine melodies echo still; no demon shall ever breach the Heavenly Gate.
text.浓情岁月年年有，鸿运当头福满身: Deep affection through the passing years; crowned with fortune and bathed in blessings.
text.宠柳娇花含秀色，娇艳芳华映翠流: Graceful willows and tender blooms; a vivid radiance reflected in emerald waters.
text.斜阳西下人归处，无声无息半江烟: Towards home as the sun descends; silent mist veils the river's flow.
text.天上地下，唯我独尊: Throughout the heavens and the earth, I alone am supreme.
text.葫芦虽小藏天地，伴我云山万里身: A tiny vessel containing the cosmos, my companion across ten thousand miles of mist.
text.幻影双生，表里如一: Dual phantoms born of one soul; a reflection of perfect unity between inner and outer.
text.烛阴之怒吞噬天地，唯勇者能平息其怒火。: The fury of Zhuyin devours the world; only the valiant may quench his flame.
text.祥瑞降临，人间喜庆，四季平安，福运绵长。: Divine signs descend upon the realm; eternal peace and boundless fortune for all.
text.千佛山水映晚霞，丝路驼铃传天涯。: Divine peaks glow in the sunset; camel bells echo along the Silk Road to the ends of the earth.
text.锦鳞共舞惊涟漪，碧波荡漾映朝天。: Radiant scales stir the waters; azure waves ripple and reflect the dawning sky.
text.嫦娥奔月离凡尘，蟾宫折桂入梦闲。: Transcending the mortal coil for the Moon Palace; a dream of laurel and celestial quietude.
text.鲛绡裁月系冰绡，璎珞垂星十二桥。: Woven from moonlight and glacial silk; starlight drapes over the twelve bridges.
text.火尖枪扫怒涛翻，混天绫卷乾坤荡。: The Fire-Tipped Spear rages through waves; the Red Sash stirs the foundations of the world.
text.云海拜佛潮跪月，星河垂袖岳低头。: Clouds bow to the divine as stars descend; even the great mountains lower their heads.
text.金龙衔镜照千峰，太虚烟霞一鉴中。: A golden dragon reflects a thousand peaks; the boundless void captured in a single glance.
text.千年修得指间盟，不羡长生羡此辰。: A vow forged through a millennium; I crave not immortality, but this single moment with you.
text.紫翼垂天金作脉，魔纹噬日羽为锋。: Wings of violet veined with gold; demonic sigils eclipse the sun as feathers turn to blades.
text.银阙临虚星作瓦，蟾光浮海月为舟。: A silver tower amidst the stars; moonlight drifts upon the sea like a celestial vessel.
text.赤阳灼灼煅乾象，玄阴湛湛润坤灵。: The blazing Sun forges the Heavens; the profound Yin nurtures the spirits of the Earth.
text.如果本回合没有受到伤害，增加%s%%的五行抗性，最多叠加%s层，受到伤害重置: If no damage is sustained in the current round, increase Five Elements Resistance by %s%%. Stacks up to %s layers; resets upon taking damage.
text.寓意何为？不遇无忿。: Where lies the intent? To meet not, yet grieve not
text.谁说团子只是宠物！: Who says this chubby dumpling is merely a Spirit Pet!
text.一起去堆雪人吧: Let's go craft a snowman from the drifting snow!
text.快带我去海滩玩啊: Hurry, take me to the beach for some fun!
text.粽子节到啦: The Dragon Boat Festival is here!
text.神仙快乐水，专治不开心！: Celestial Happy Soda, the ultimate cure for the blues!
text.山水画中游仙影,飘然身世似云烟: An immortal silhouette roaming through a landscape painting; a life as ethereal and fleeting as drifting clouds and smoke.
text.大白兔，白又白，两只耳朵竖起来: A big white rabbit, white as snow; with two long ears standing up high.
text.幻蓝星河，璀璨如梦，仿若银河倾泻人间。: A phantom blue galaxy, dazzling as a dream; as if the Silver River (Milky Way) is cascading down into the Mortal Realm.
text.白羽扫尽千劫尘，金面犹照世间人: The white plume sweeps away the dust of a thousand Tribulations; the golden visage still shines upon the people of the world.
text.又一年，织女鹊桥边，盼得王母赐良缘，天上人间梦相连: Another year by the Magpie Bridge, awaiting the Queen Mother's blessing to unite dreams across Heaven and Earth.
text.丹青妙手，笔下生花: A master of ink and wash, where flowers bloom beneath the stroke of the brush.
text.欲上蟾宫折桂，金榜题名有时: Ascending the Moon Palace to pluck the laurel; the time has come for fame on the Golden List.
text.开目为昼， 闭目为夜: When its eyes open, it is day; when its eyes close, it is night.
text.山河万里，气吞如虎: Encompassing ten thousand miles of mountains and rivers, with a spirit as fierce as a tiger.
text.奇遇连年，仙缘永续: Years of miraculous encounters, forging an eternal bond of immortality.
text.百川归海财源丰，宝库丹青聚金银: Rivers flow to the sea bringing fortune; the treasury gathers alchemy, gold, and silver.
text.金龙腾跃云霞起，昂首凌空照乾坤: The Golden Dragon leaps amidst rosy clouds, head raised to the sky, illuminating the Universe.
text.人面桃花相映红，春风人面不知秋: The face and blossoms reflect each other's red; the spring breeze knows not the sorrow of autumn.
text.低花树映小妆楼，春入眉心两点愁: Low flowering trees reflect on the makeup tower; spring brings two points of sorrow to the brow.
text.云开天色似蔚蓝,蝴蝶飞舞入梦间: The clouds part to reveal an azure sky; butterflies dance into the realm of dreams.
text.碧浪滔天，暑意难侵: Azure waves touch the sky; the summer heat cannot invade this cool vastness.
text.四载同行几度情，岁月无声暖心萦。: Four years of walking the path together; the silent years warm the heart's entanglement.
text.御剑乘风破云霄，天外寻梦万里遥，: Riding the wind on a sword to pierce the clouds, seeking dreams ten thousand miles away.
text.金乌玉兔轮转间，天地浩瀚成造化。: The Golden Crow (Sun) and Jade Rabbit (Moon) turn the wheel; the vastness of Heaven and Earth shapes creation.
text.蛟龙得水入云霄，四海八荒皆可攀。: The Flood Dragon enters the water and rises to the clouds; the Four Seas and Eight Wildernesses are within reach.
text.双蛇盘绕护青莲，阴阳相济道韵全。: Twin snakes coil to protect the green lotus; Yin and Yang complement in a perfect Daoist rhythm.
text.金蛇盘旋御灵光，道韵悠悠显仙祥。: The Golden Snake coils, controlling spiritual light; the Daoist rhythm reveals immortal omens.
text.两界缘牵结道情，跨境相逢展新程。: Fate connects two worlds to form a Daoist bond; meeting across borders to start a new journey.
text.莲动鱼衔半颗星，荷香扶影认前生。: Lotuses move, fish carry half a star; the lotus scent helps trace shadows of a past life.
text.烈焰缠身逆九霄，混天血刃斩龙袍。: Wrapped in flames, defying the Nine Heavens; the chaotic blood blade slays the Dragon Robe.
text.春风有信如期至，细雨无声润物生。: The spring breeze arrives as promised; fine rain silently nourishes all life.
text.青菰裹月浮星汉，赤帜劈波碎玉壶。: Green leaves wrap the moon floating in the galaxy; red banners split the waves, shattering the jade pot.
text.黑龙腾云噬九天，烈焰焚穹破万渊。: The Black Dragon soars to devour the Nine Heavens; raging flames burn through ten thousand abysses.
text.青荷欲衔岳色浮，碧叶如唇衔远山。: Green lotuses desire to reflect the floating mountain colors; emerald leaves kiss the distant hills like lips.
text.仙寰永驻五曜光，此间长乐胜无常。: The Immortal World is eternally lit by five stars; eternal joy here surpasses the impermanence of life.
text.鹊羽织就星河路，祥云托起相思桥。: Magpie feathers weave the Milky Way road; auspicious clouds hold up the Bridge of Longing.
text.月阙悬檐聆风语，桂香落影缀云裳。: Listening to the wind at the Moon Palace eaves; osmanthus scent falls upon cloud-like robes.
text.绛月垂光判阴阳，紫魇凝爪叩心窗。: The crimson moon casts light to judge Yin and Yang; purple magic claws tap on the window of the heart.
text.金穗垂芒扫云鬓，南瓜抱日缀秋容。: Golden ears of grain sweep the cloud-like hair; pumpkins embrace the sun, adorning the autumn look.
text.双曜轮转照影久，一念浮沉纪年深。: The Twin Luminaries (Sun & Moon) turn, casting long shadows; a single thought floats through the depths of years.
text.金乌神弓: Divine Bow of the Golden Crow
text.上古大能所创造，通体晶莹剔透，散发着柔和的光芒。修炼者只需将心神凝聚于玉盘之上，: Created by ancient Almighty beings... Cultivators need only focus their spirit upon the jade disk to receive guidance and revelation.
text.相传永生花长在九天之上，只在牛郎织女相会时才会绽放。这种花象征着永恒和不朽。只有: Legend says it grows in the Nine Heavens, blooming only when the Cowherd and Weaver Girl meet. It symbolizes eternity and immortality.
text.同心佩由两个相连的佩坠组成，象征着永恒的友谊和情感纽带。这对佩坠形状独特，一个是: Composed of two connected pendants, symbolizing eternal friendship. One is Yang, one is Yin, representing the balance of the Universe.
text.据传是太玄道祖之物，在教导众弟子时，轻摇羽扇可使人悟性临时提升一大截（无法通过寻: Belonged to the Dao Ancestor Tai Xuan. Gently fanning it while teaching disciples can temporarily boost their enlightenment significantly.
text.翻云覆雨扇，组合使用可号令云雨，代行降雨之事，单独用法力催动也可令云气翻涌，变化: When combined, it commands clouds and rain; used alone, it can stir up surging mists, creating ever-changing illusions.
text.东海海眼深处历经千年孕育而出，凝聚五行之水（无法通过寻宝获得）: Nurtured for a millennium in the depths of the East Sea Eye, condensing the Essence of Water from the Five Elements.
text.以法力驱动，可燃尽世间凡物，传说此物可使天仙之下燃为灰烬，天仙之上自爆灵机一换一: Fueled by magic power, it burns all mortal things to ash. Legend says it allows one to trade their life to destroy even a Celestial.
text.上古朱雀的一缕余晖，足够使此物燃烧千万年而不灭，传说为天外天圣人之物，使用时请保: Contains a wisp of the Ancient Vermilion Bird's afterglow, burning for eternity. Keep it hidden to avoid detection by its original owner.
text.远古神人采用天外寒玉锻造而成，法力催动之下可凝结护体冰晶。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Forged by ancient gods using Outer Heaven Cold Jade. When activated, it condenses protective ice crystals around the wearer.
text.上界大能，斩杀啸月天狼后，将其残躯炼化入玉如意内，使得如意呈现出狼首形态，活灵活: An Upper Realm mighty figure refined the body of the Howling Moon Celestial Wolf into this jade, giving it a lifelike wolf head shape.
text.仙界有名的套装法宝，由九九八十一颗灵珠组合而成，每一颗都拥有千钧之重，祭出之后，: A famous set of artifacts consisting of 81 spiritual beads. Each is heavy as a mountain; when released, they stir the winds and clouds.
text.高阶制符师必备法宝，可令成符威力增加一倍。（无法通过寻宝获得）: An essential tool for high-rank Talisman Masters. It doubles the power of any talisman drawn with it.
text.据说炼制时加入了一缕神兽玄武真意，施展之后重逾万钧，以堂皇之势镇压敌人。（无法通: Infused with the intent of the Divine Beast Black Tortoise （Xuanwu） during forging. It suppresses enemies with the majestic force of a falling mountain.
text.天下武功唯快不破，其上光洁，施展时，有片羽飘落，速如流光。（无法通过寻宝获得）: In martial arts, speed is paramount. The blade is pristine; when used, falling feathers appear, moving as fast as flowing light.
text.据说可抵御天劫，并存储天劫之力，释放后犹如开天，因此得名。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Said to withstand Heavenly Tribulation and store its power. Releasing it is like splitting the sky, hence its name.
text.原是一株普通灵芝，沾染仙人功德之力后进化为金灵芝，有起死回生之效。（无法通过寻宝: Originally a common Lingzhi, it evolved into the Golden Lingzhi after being tainted by Immortal Merit. It has the power of resurrection.
text.历经千年吸收昆仑祖脉之气，成品蕴含丰沛的水属灵韵，寒气慑人。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Having absorbed Qi from the Kunlun Ancestral Vein for a millennium, it contains abundant Water Essence and exudes a chilling aura.
text.其疾如风，装备后可大幅增强挪移之速。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Fast as the wind. Equipping this cloak greatly increases movement speed.
text.于火焰之中绽放，内蕴无边火海。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Blooms amidst flames, containing a boundless sea of fire within.
text.曾伴随一代古佛，因果愿力加身，法不可侵。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Once accompanied an ancient Buddha. Blessed by the power of Karma and wishes, they are impervious to magic.
text.可藏匿自身修为，驭使后发动幻境，使敌方神识沉浸其中，无法自拔。（无法通过寻宝获得: Can conceal one's cultivation level. When activated, it creates an illusion that traps the enemy's consciousness.
text.由一条千年巨龙的鳞片炼化而成，蕴含着无尽的力量。拥有真龙印章的人，可以驭龙呼风，: Refined from the scale of a millennial giant dragon. The wielder can command wind and rain; the Dragon Breath carries unmatched destructive power.
text.由天地之力凝聚而成，能够操控时间与空间的法器。只有在九天神界诞生的才能触发其神奇: An artifact condensed from the power of Heaven and Earth, capable of manipulating time and space.
text.可以吸纳任何生命的灵魂并注入持有者体内，让其获得无尽的智慧和力量。然而，凝魂钵失: Can absorb the souls of living beings and grant the holder endless wisdom and power. However, it has been lost for many years.
text.浸润着龙脉之力，能够呼唤龙威，驱散邪气。传世的龙腾剪纸稀缺而珍贵，拥有它的人将被: Soaked in the power of the Dragon Vein, it can summon Dragon Might to dispel evil Qi.
text.翎羽冠，明晕散彩，灵光缭绕。含天地玄机，植仙道根基。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Radiant with spiritual light. It contains the mysteries of Heaven and Earth, planting the foundation of the Dao.
text.桃花坠，幽香乍现，花瓣飘摇。含月华灵气，拂人心弦。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A faint fragrance appears with drifting petals. Contains the Essence of the Moon, stirring the heartstrings.
text.玲珑骰子，灵气飘散，命运转折。承天地造化，卜命定缘。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Spiritual Qi scatters, fate turns. Inherits the creation of Heaven and Earth to divine destiny.
text.取神兽金乌遗落的羽毛与太阳真火熔炼而成，开弓时有金乌虚影衔火出击。（无法通过寻宝: Smelted from Golden Crow feathers and True Sun Fire. When drawn, a phantom Golden Crow shoots out with the arrow.
text.仙踪缥缈，缘分难求，持此玉可增强自身气运，好运连连。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Immortal tracks are mist-like and fate is hard to find. Holding this jade enhances one's luck and fortune.
text.以紫晶为薪柴，丹火为基，燃起的灵火。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A spiritual fire fueled by Amethyst and based on Pill Fire.
text.药王当年炼药时，用以收取药液的宝瓶，其内尚有当年药物残留。（无法通过寻宝获得）: The bottle used by the Medicine King to collect medicinal liquids; it still contains residue of ancient medicines.
text.据说是八卦炉的仿制品，但是威能不逊于一般仙人法宝。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Said to be a replica of the Eight Trigrams Furnace, but its power rivals that of average Immortal Artifacts.
text.相传是古人祭祀神灵，沟通天地所用神物，亦可用于辟邪护身。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Legend says ancients used this divine tool to communicate with Heaven and Earth; it can also be used to ward off evil.
text.以旷世奇珍铸其本体后，功德金莲投影其中，具有映照他人吉凶祸福之能。（无法通过寻宝: Cast from worldly treasures with a projection of the Merit Golden Lotus inside. It has the ability to reveal the fortune and misfortune of others.
text.其白如玉，其洁如光，天生仙石，历经漫长岁月雕琢而成。（无法通过寻宝获得）: White as jade, pure as light. A natural Immortal Stone carved by the passage of time.
text.原是普通火鸦之羽，却因沾染了一丝仙人之血，使其拥有了不俗的御火之力。（无法通过寻: Originally a common fire crow feather, it gained extraordinary fire-controlling power after being stained with a drop of Immortal Blood.
text.天雷地火勾连，其上形成了阴阳双鱼纹路，持之可观他人命数，俯览阴阳。（无法通过寻宝: Formed by the connection of Sky Thunder and Earth Fire with a Yin-Yang Fish pattern. It allows one to view the destiny of others.
text.锏身双龙灵气绕，挥动风雷天地跳；一朝掌握傲四方，纵横九州任逍遥。（无法通过寻宝获: Surrounded by Twin Dragon Qi. Wielding it stirs wind and thunder; dominate the Four Directions and roam the Nine Provinces freely.
text.镜中乾坤万象存，洞察天地无所遁；阴阳逆转驱邪魔，修行路上镇心神。（无法通过寻宝获: Contains the myriad phenomena of the universe; nothing can hide from it. It reverses Yin and Yang to expel demons and stabilizes the mind.
text.鎏金斗，聚灵真。星辰日月皆掌控，风雷云雾尽随心。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Gathers True Spirit. It controls the stars, sun, and moon, and commands the wind, thunder, and clouds at will.
text.莲开九瓣映天娇，灵气缭绕万法消。莲心凝翠聚灵力，护身避难百邪退。（无法通过寻宝获: Nine petals open to reflect the sky; spiritual Qi swirls to dispel ten thousand spells. The lotus heart gathers power to protect the body from evil.
text.传说由轩辕黄帝亲手炼制。此盘蕴含天地至理，可演算万物变化，预知未来。（无法通过寻: Legend says it was refined by the Yellow Emperor. It contains the logic of Heaven and Earth, calculating the changes of all things to predict the future.
text.内蕴万年玄冰精华，可冻结时空，封印万物。冰系修士梦寐以求的无上法器。（无法通过寻: Contains Essence of Millennial Black Ice. It can freeze time and space and seal all creation. A supreme artifact for Ice Cultivators.
text.蕴含天地至善之力。凡佩戴者无不逢凶化吉，遇难呈祥。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Contains the Supreme Kindness of Heaven and Earth. Wearers invariably turn misfortune into fortune.
text.内蕴烈焰之力，双刃形如凤翼。挥舞之际，烈焰滔天。修炼至深者，更可御火凌空，焚山煮: Contains the power of raging flames, shaped like Phoenix wings. Wielding them fills the sky with fire. Masters can burn mountains and boil seas.
text.内蕴真龙精魄，可御风驭雷，呼风唤雨。龙珠一出，紫光万丈，可破万法、镇压邪祟。（无: Contains the essence of a True Dragon. It commands wind, thunder, and rain. Once released, its purple light suppresses all evil.
text.冠顶跃动三昧真火，真火可随心而动。佩戴可增强神识，净化心灵，抵御邪祟。（无法通过: Samadhi True Fire dances on top, moving at will. Wearing it strengthens Divine Consciousness, purifies the mind, and resists evil.
text.凤凰赤羽所制，扇面绘有玄妙符文。可御火飞行，炼化灵气。实为攻防兼备的上乘法宝。（: Made from Phoenix feathers and inscribed with mysterious runes. It allows flight on fire and refines Spiritual Qi.
text.通体碧绿如玉，挥舞之际，青光闪烁，如灵蛇出洞。既可缠绕制敌，又可化作藤蔓。（无法: Green as jade. When waved, it flashes like a spirit snake. It can bind enemies or transform into vines.
text.蕴含无穷造化之力，挥动之际，花瓣纷飞，既可迷惑敌人，又可治愈伤势。（无法通过寻宝: Contains infinite power of creation. Its drifting petals can confuse enemies and heal wounds.
text.金纸朱砂所书，蕴含业火之力。既可净化心灵，又能灼烧妖魔。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Written with cinnabar on gold paper. It contains the power of Karmic Fire, purifying the soul and burning demons.
text.内蕴真龙之力，可号令风雨，镇压山河。印一落下，可破万法，镇压邪祟。（无法通过寻宝: Contains the power of a True Dragon. It commands wind and rain and suppresses mountains and rivers.
text.此盘集阴阳二气，可推演天机，演化日月星辰之力。每逢昼夜交替之际威能最盛，可开辟虚: Gathers Yin and Yang Qi to deduce Heavenly Secrets. Its power peaks at the turn of day and night, opening the Void to the Star Realm.
text.蕴含远古狮王一缕真灵，戴上此面，可化身金狮战体，力可撼山。更可操控炽烈金焰，焚尽: Contains a wisp of the Ancient Lion King's spirit. Wearing it grants the Golden Lion Battle Body with strength to move mountains.
text.此镜乃为九天星辰所铸。可照破虚妄，显化真实。持镜者可沟通星辰之力，借天地之势。（: Cast from the Starlight of the Nine Heavens. It breaks through falsehoods to reveal the truth, borrowing the power of the Universe.
text.万年寒玉为骨，瑶池仙梅为面，扇中藏有小天地，内有终年不化的仙梅林，可采集入药，炼: Bone of Millennial Cold Jade, face of Yaochi Immortal Plum. It hides a small world inside with a forest of plums for alchemy.
text.由上古灵溪底部的千年玄冰玉髓雕琢而成，表面隐现水波状天然纹路，似流淌的溪泉被凝于: Carved from Millennial Black Ice Essence found at the bottom of the Ancient Spirit Creek, featuring natural water ripple patterns.
text.九幽冥渊深处孕育的「蚀界紫晶」雕琢而成的莲花吊坠，花瓣层叠如真莲绽放，通体萦绕暗: Carved from "World-Eroding Amethyst" from the deep Nether Abyss. Its layers of petals resemble a blooming lotus, emitting a dark purple halo.
text.一柄以天界瑶池崩塌时残存的「无垢莲心」织就的法幡，中央绣着十二瓣玉莲图腾，莲蕊处: Woven from the 《Stainless Lotus Heart》 remains of the fallen Celestial Yaochi. The center features a twelve-petal Jade Lotus totem.
text.以九霄玄火淬炼的双生灵器，轮转间罡风破空、赤焰燎天。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A pair of spiritual weapons tempered by Nine Heavens Mystic Fire. They break through space with astral winds and scorch the sky with red flames.
text.采东海鲛绡织就的赤霞仙绫，挥动时引动四海之力，可缚千军、镇邪祟。（无法通过寻宝获: A red celestial silk woven from East Sea Mermaid Silk. Wielding it stirs the power of the Four Seas, binding armies and suppressing evil.
text.以祝融神铁锻冶的裂空炎矛，矛刃淬三昧真火，突刺时引动九霄雷火，可破甲胄、焚妖邪。: Forged from Zhu Rong Divine Iron and quenched in Samadhi True Fire. A thrust triggers Nine Heavens Thunder Fire to break armor and burn demons.
text.锉柄镌刻“天工敕令”四枚太古篆文，握之触感温润似活物，似与掌心经脉隐隐共鸣。（无: The handle is engraved with "Heavenly Craft Edict" in ancient script. It feels warm and alive, resonating with the meridian of the palm.
text.青铜古币浸染鎏金，外圆内方处嵌着九道轮回齿纹。（无法通过寻宝获得）: An ancient bronze coin soaked in gold, inlaid with nine Samsara gear patterns within its square hole.
text.玄色幡面绣三千混沌云纹，暗藏周天星辰流沙，幡角坠九枚太初骨铃，摇动时似有洪荒兽吼: A black banner embroidered with Chaos Clouds and Star Sand. Shaking its nine bone bells mimics the roar of desolate beasts.
text.通体以金龙玉髓淬炼，鞭身九节镶嵌帝王紫檀木，裂空时隐现万民耕作、兵戈征伐虚影。（: Quenched in Gold Dragon Jade Marrow and inlaid with Imperial Rosewood. Cracking the whip reveals illusions of civilization and war.
text.上古大能所绘，蕴含天道遁术真意，符光一闪，纵是天罗地网亦难困缚。（无法通过寻宝获: Drawn by ancient mighty figures, containing the true intent of the Heavenly Escape Dao. A flash of light allows escape from any trap.
text.取北冥万年玄冰精髓融合不周山心炼制，曾镇压东海魔渊三千年不损分毫。（无法通过寻宝: Fused from North Sea Millennial Ice Essence and the Heart of Buzhou Mountain. It suppressed the East Sea Demon Abyss for 3,000 years undamaged.
text.舟身龙骨采自渡劫失败的应龙遗骸，以九天云霞为帆，催动时瑞气千条，瞬息可至九霄青冥: Keel made from the remains of a Yinglong dragon. With sails of Nine Heavens Clouds, it travels instantly beyond the azure sky.
text.太上老君所炼，灯芯为不灭金精，灯焰含八种天火，焚山煮海，威能无穷。（无法通过寻宝: Refined by the Grand Supreme Elderly Lord. The wick is Indestructible Gold Essence; the flame contains Eight Heavenly Fires with boundless power.
text.琴身由万年灵木所制，弦乃天蚕丝与凤羽交织，琴音可引百花盛开，灵气汇聚成阵。（无法: Made from Millennial Spirit Wood with strings of Celestial Silk and Phoenix Feathers. Its music makes a hundred flowers bloom.
text.扇骨为五爪金龙之骨，扇中蕴藏龙魂，乃天帝赐予人皇之宝，象征天命所归。（无法通过寻: Made from the bone of a Five-Clawed Gold Dragon, containing a Dragon Soul. A treasure given by the Celestial Emperor, symbolizing the Mandate of Heaven.
text.玉佩内含七色霞光，映照人心欲望，佩戴者可吸食情绪修炼，悲喜皆成养料。（无法通过寻: Glows with seven-colored light, reflecting human desires. The wearer cultivates by absorbing emotions; joy and sorrow become nourishment.
text.青铜镜面青光流转，照彻世间虚妄幻象，妖魔显形无所遁藏，乃修士破障明心之至宝。（无: A bronze mirror flowing with green light. It reveals the true form of demons and leaves them nowhere to hide. Essential for breaking mental obstacles.
text.伞面金纹密布，展开时金光护体，诸邪退避百毒不侵，是行走阴煞之地的必备法器。（无法: Densely covered in golden patterns. Opening it provides golden light protection, warding off evil and poison. Essential for Yin-filled lands.
text.采九霄紫气淬炼而成，中自成一方小天地，可纳灵药、镇妖邪，紫光流转间尽显无上道韵。: Refined from Nine Heavens Purple Qi. It contains a small world inside to store elixirs or suppress demons, displaying supreme Daoist rhythm.
text.汲取万家愿力凝成的琉璃盏，盏中灯火不灭，可照世间温情，护佑一方平安。（无法通过寻: A glass lantern condensed from the wish power of ten thousand homes. The flame never dies, illuminating the warmth of the world and protecting peace.
text.以浩然正气淬炼之笔，书写之处皆成法旨，可定是非功过，载录千秋史册。（无法通过寻宝: Quenched in Awe-Inspiring Righteous Qi. Whatever it writes becomes law; it determines right from wrong and records the annals of history.
text.壶中自蕴云海霁月，倾泻时有清风绕梁，可涤心魔杂念，助人顿悟天地至理。（无法通过寻: Naturally contains clouds and a bright moon. Pouring from it releases a clear breeze that cleanses Heart Demons and aids in enlightenment.
text.纳山川灵脉于尺素之间，展卷时千峰竞秀，可用乾坤之力镇压诸邪。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Absorbs the spiritual veins of mountains and rivers. Unfurling it reveals a thousand peaks, suppressing evil with the power of the Universe.
text.以千年南瓜镂刻成灯，内置幽冥鬼火，可照亮阴阳两界之路，指引亡魂归乡。（无法通过寻: Carved from a millennial pumpkin containing Nether Ghost Fire. It illuminates the path between Yin and Yang to guide lost souls home.
text.取子时夜蝠精魄熔炼而成，覆面可匿踪潜行于夜幕之中，无人可察。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Smelted from Night Bat essence at midnight. The wearer can move invisibly in the dark, undetected by anyone.
text.笔杆取自三途河畔古木，笔毫聚敛阴司煞气，一挥可定游魂罪业，暂执幽冥法度。（无法通: The shaft is wood from the Sanzu River; the tip gathers Netherworld Qi. A wave judges wandering souls and wields the laws of Hell.
text.凝聚丰收愿力的金色稻穗，轻轻摇动便有谷香四溢，为持有者带来祥瑞祝福。（无法通过寻: Condensed from the wish power of a bountiful harvest. Gently shaking it releases a fragrance of grain, bringing auspicious blessings.
text.收割千年灵稻淬炼的神镰，挥动时泛起金色麦浪，可斩断因果羁绊。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A divine sickle tempered by harvesting millennial spirit rice. Wielding it creates golden waves and cuts through the ties of Karma.
text.吹动此角可引动地脉龙气，令枯木逢春、灵药繁生，蕴含无限生机。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Blowing this horn stirs the Earth Vein Dragon Qi, bringing dead wood back to life and promoting the growth of spirit medicines.
text.以时光本源凝炼的玄异之器，沙砾每粒皆封存刹那光阴，可溯过往、凝当下、窥须臾未来。: Refined from the Source of Time. Each grain of sand is a sealed moment. It allows glimpses of the past, present, and future.
text.由百鸟翎羽织就，映照心中至美之象，可幻化万千华裳，亦能织就虚实相生的蜃楼幻境。（: Woven from the feathers of a hundred birds. It reflects the beauty within the heart and can weave mirage-like illusions.
text.取万年古松精魄合玄冰玉髓淬炼，铃响如松涛过涧，可宁神定魄，迟滞万法侵袭。（无法通: Refined from Millennial Pine Essence and Black Ice. Its ring sounds like wind through pines, calming the spirit and slowing magical attacks.
text.晷盘熔炼日月双晖，晷针引动阴阳时序，可测算并调和天地间日精月华流转。（无法通过寻: Smelted from the brilliance of the Sun and Moon. The needle moves by the order of Yin and Yang, harmonizing the flow of celestial essence.

text.乘风驭龙章凤彩，神采飞扬世无双: Riding the wind with the majesty of dragons and phoenixes; a spirited radiance unmatched in this world.

text.侧身持笛，巧笑倩兮，擅长治愈之术，一曲笛音可渡冤魂: Standing elegantly with a flute, her smile is enchanting. Skilled in the arts of healing, a single melody from her flute can ferry wandering souls.
text.妙手回春，仙灵医师。: With a miraculous touch that brings life, she is the Celestial Healer.
text.擅于治愈，人送称号青莲仙姑。: Expert in healing, known by the title "Green Lotus Fairy."
text.降生时，满室生香，有祥光照耀，五行五灵之气绕体，是天生的五蕴神体，五行灵气亲和度: At her birth, the room was filled with fragrance and auspicious light. The Qi of the Five Elements surrounded her. Born with the Five-Element Divine Body, she possesses an extreme affinity for spiritual energy. Whether in cultivation or mastering arts, she always shows extraordinary talent.
text.离家是一个世代为医的修仙家族，医术最高者被称为仙医，这为她的医道之路奠定了坚实的: The Li family is a lineage of medical cultivators, where the most skilled are called Celestial Healers. This laid a solid foundation for her path. From a young age, she displayed remarkable memory and insight, never forgetting what she saw. It was as if phrases like "perceiving the whole from a fragment" were tailored for her. She followed her elders to learn the properties of herbs and how to treat various bizarre ailments of the cultivation world—such as those with damaged souls who wail at midnight："I'm not sick, I've ascended, hahaha..." and other confusing matters. She also mastered the family's secret technique：the Great Healing Art. Rumor has it that to activate this art, a certain price must be paid. Ah, where was I? Oh, right, the Li family is a medical lineage...

text.1、三阶满级招式开启<color=#9e4444>招式参悟</color>\\n:
1、Tier 3 max-level skills unlock <color=#9e4444>Skill Comprehension</color>
2、Cultivators can consume comprehension items to <color=#9e4444>refresh</color> new affixes and enhance current skill attribute effects.
3、After rolling a red affix, the effect of red-quality affixes rolled in the same slot next time will be higher （will not exceed max limit）
4、Comprehension requires basic and extra consumable items, please check your resource reserves carefully～
【Flame of Epiphany】 Skill attribute affix refresh rates：
Green：<color=#008000>73.8%</color> Blue：<color=#0000FF>20.5%</color>
Purple：<color=#9400D3>4.2%</color> Orange：<color=#FF8C00>1%</color>
Red：<color=#FF0000>0.5%</color>
【Flame of Inspiration】 Skill attribute affix refresh rates：
Green：<color=#008000>44.6%</color> Blue：<color=#0000FF>37.5%</color>
Purple：<color=#9400D3>13.4%</color> Orange：<color=#FF8C00>2.7%</color>
Red：<color=#FF0000>1.8%</color>
4、Using <color=#9e4444>Sand of Enlightenment can lock</color> current affixes from being refreshed. （Can lock up to <color=#9e4444>4</color> affixes simultaneously; locking more affixes increases Sand of Enlightenment cost）
5、Prompts appear when replacing affixes; prompt on purple quality is enabled by default, which can be modified or disabled.
6、If you <color=#9e4444>forget a Tier 3 skill, cultivation items from Comprehension will NOT be returned</color>！ Please be careful～

mod.传说中一切都在按照着盘古薨逝前的意志所运行，但是这股无穷力量却不甘就此耗尽，在极: The legend says that everything was running according to the will of Pan Gu before his death, but this infinite power was not willing to be exhausted, and in the course of time, 84,000 pillars of demons were created, which accelerated the expansion of the universe.In order to stop the wind disaster, many gods and immortals were ordered by Emperor Taiyi to fight in the void of the universe to turn the true source of the demon gods to open up countless small worlds, while immortals and Buddhas were actively opening up small worlds to spread the fire of civilisation, but in the long run the floods would come, all energy would be exhausted and everything would be as silent as dead water.But before the chaos is reopened, everything will return to chaos and collapse like molten fire, so called the Great Collapse of Fire, which are the three plagues of the universe…….

mod.传说中一切都在按照着盘古薨逝前的意志所运行，但是这股无穷力量却不甘就此耗尽，在极: The legend says that everything was running according to the will of Pan Gu before his death, but this infinite power was not willing to be exhausted, and in the course of time, 84,000 pillars of the demon gods were created, and the demon gods urged the universe to continue to expand at an accelerated rate.In order to stop the wind disaster, many gods and immortals were ordered by Emperor Taiyi to fight in the void of the universe to turn the true source of the demon gods to open up countless small worlds, while immortals and Buddhas were actively opening up small worlds to spread the fire of civilisation, but in the long run the floods would come, all energy would be exhausted and everything would be as silent as dead water.In order to prevent the three plagues, the gods, immortals and saints fought a long and protracted divine war over the extinction of the world, while 84,000 pillars of demons took advantage of the opportunity to invade, and eventually everything was silenced and everything returned to chaos.

According to legend, everything was running according to the will of Pan Gu before his death, but this infinite power was not willing to be exhausted, and in the course of time, 84,000 pillars of the demon gods were created, which accelerated the expansion of the universe.In order to stop the wind disaster, many gods and immortals were ordered by Emperor Taiyi to fight in the void of the universe to turn the true source of the demon gods to open up countless small worlds, while immortals and Buddhas were actively opening up small worlds to spread the fire of civilisation, but in the long run the floods would come, all energy would be exhausted and everything would be as silent as dead water.In order to prevent the three plagues, the gods, immortals and saints fought a long and protracted divine war over the extinction of the world and the continent of Pangaea was broken up into nine large pieces.

mod.别看贫道一副吊儿郎当的样子，如果认真起来的话，可也是一等一的高手呢。回想起来这一: Don't worry about my casual or even sloppy look.You know, if I take something serious, I can also be a first-class master.Looking back on my cultivation along the way, there were really someone who helped me, and there were so many opportunities.When I was a rambunctious boy, I thought about participating in the apprenticeship trial of the Saga Clan.But I failed the first assessment, so I couldn't get in as wished.But how could I give up such an opportunity? Well, I was so young and I simply cried and rolled, except leaving that place.Then, Master Mo of the Saga Clan saw my persistence, so he interceded for me and asked me if I'm going to take the exam again.The second time, I went all out and won applause from all the halls, later, I was accepted as a disciple of the clan and started cultivation from then on.It's really funny to think about it now.Master Mo was regarded as the first noble person at the beginning of my cultivation.

mod.黄帝攻打蚩尤的一次战争中，后卿不幸战死。死后曝尸荒野，魂魄在四周游离。他生前为黄: In a battle during the Yellow Emperor's attack on Chiyou, Houqing was killed.After his death, Houqing's corpse is exposed in the wilderness, and the soul is wandering around.When he was alive, he fought tooth and nail for the Yellow Emperor, but after his death, no one came to collect his body! As time went on, Houqing's resentment became more serious.In order to avenge the Yellow Emperor, Houqing dedicated his souls to Hou, becoming one of the four ancestors of zombies! Later, Houqing met Nvba, who was also abandoned in the north bank of the Ruoshui River, and helped her become a zombie.Houqing used his soul to curse all the recently deceased corpses, to help them become zombies after an unjust death.
mod.黄帝与蚩尤的战争延续了不少时日，最后的决战进行于冀州之野。黄帝呼唤有翼的应龙畜水: The war between the Yellow Emperor and Chi You lasted for a long time, and the final decisive battle took place in the wilderness of Jizhou.The Yellow Emperor called on the winged dragons to drown Chi You's army.Chi You also asked Fengbo and Yushi to help.A sudden storm came, and the Yellow Emperor's army was in trouble again.In the crisis, the Yellow Emperor had to ask Nvba to stop the wind and rain.The weather suddenly changed, and Chi You's army was extremely surprised.Then, the Yellow Emperor took the opportunity to command the army to cover up and kill them, and won the final victory.

mod.蚩尤的部族不愿臣服于轩辕，便联合黄河下游的九个部族组成九黎族对抗黄帝。九黎与华夏: Chi You's tribe did not want to surrender to Xuanyuan, so they united nine tribes in the lower reaches of the Yellow River to form the Jiuli tribe to fight against the Yellow Emperor.In the battle between Jiuli and Huaxia, Chiyou joined forces with Xingtian and Kuafu, and with the help of Fengbo and Yushi, they defeated the Yellow Emperor.Later, the Yellow Emperor invited Nvba to capture Chi You alive in the Battle of Zhuolu.Huangdi was afraid that Chi You would cause trouble after his death, so he buried his head and body in two places far apart.The shackles that Chi You wore were thrown on the barren mountains and turned into a maple forest.Every blood-red maple leaf was stained with Chi You's blood.

mod.逐鹿之战后发生了严重的旱灾，太阳像个大火球，烤得大地龟裂，江湖涸干，一片荒凉。夸: After the Battle of Zhulu, a severe drought occurred.The blistering sun scorched the earth into cinders, and the rivers dried up and became desolate.Such irritated Kua Fu, so that he wanted to take off the sun, as he kept chasing the sun and drank all the water from the Yellow River and Wei River along the way, but he still felt unbearably thirsty.Kua Fu decided to drink the water from the great swamp before he could the sun.As soon as he reached the edge of the swamp, he suddenly fell to the ground.Exhausted, Kua Fu looked regretfully at the setting sun, sighed, threw his stick towards the sun, closed his eyes and died.Later, Kua Fu's walking stick turned into a peach forest, where the trees were full of huge fruits.

mod.小女子虽然外貌柔弱，但轻视小女子的话，可是会遭来邪毒噬身之苦哦。在小女子的家乡苗: Although the little girl looks weak, nobody would ignore her as it leads to evil poison.In Miaojiang, the little girl's hometown, evil insects and poisonous snakes are crawling everywhere, and scorpions and centipedes are rampant.So the Miaojiang people used these poisons cultivation, who, called by the Han monks, as poisonous cultivators.But, in the vast Han land, people can be hostile, and Miaojiang people must protect themselves with such poison.Miss Taoyao is a poison master in Miaojiang, and is famous for her cultivation of voodoo.Even Taoyao said to the little girl, "Only the evil poisons are the way to protect the lives in Miaojiang."
mod.其实，本宫与冰魄仙子以及极北女王三人，万年以前也曾是同门师姊妹，皆拜于泠海龙王门: In fact, I, the Ice Soul Fairy and the Queen of the Far North were all sisters in the same discipline thousands of years ago.We all worshiped under the Linghai Dragonlord and learned the techniques of frost.It's just that the Ice Soul Fairy, who wanted to transform into a god and ascend, stole the Ocean Bell, the treasure of my clan.From that day on, I broke up with her, and used the frost power of the Ocean Bell to backfire on the Ice Soul Fairy, causing her to lose a thousand years of cultivation for no reason.From then on, the Ice Soul Fairy had nothing but extreme hate on me.Later, on the day when the Ice Soul Fairy finally achieved enlightenment and ascended to heaven, she used tricks to freeze my sea palace, causing numerous casualties to my clan.In order to take revenge , I came to see the Queen of the Far North, Mu Mei.At the beginning, we three sisters made an oath in front of our master.If we dare to hurt our sisters, we will be punished.Now that the Ice Soul Fairy has broken this oath, I want Mu Mei to fulfill what we swore and destroy her palace.But Mu Mei said that the Ice Soul Fairy has ascended, and the strength of the two of us alone may not be enough.Mu Mei recommended two female sword cultivators, Yan Shiyu and Xue Si.These two female cultivators joined us in the crusade against the Ice Soul Fairy.

norm.凡事皆有目的，修仙亦是如此。修仙一途艰难坎坷，非大毅力之人不可为。那么你为何要踏: All thing happen for a reason, so does Immortalisation.The road of practice is a rough one, not for the faint of heart.So what brought you to this journey?
norm.修士之中多有能工巧匠之士，炼制天地灵物为法宝。你最喜欢哪种类型的法宝？: There are skillful artificers among the practitioners, they refine the spirits to trump.Which type of Trump do you like the most?
norm.修炼之途，功法为基。修仙界功法林林总总，不可胜数。在这众多功法之中，你认为哪种功: Technique is the basis of traininG.There are countless varieties of techniques in this world.Among these techniques which do you think is most useful?
norm.世人皆有处世之道，或放荡不羁，或循规蹈矩，或谨言慎行。你的处世之道是什么？: Everyone has their own world view, some let loose, some abide law, some act cautiously.What is your belief?
norm.修仙者皆知要感悟天道，但每个人对天道都有自己的理解。在你心中，何为天道？: Each Practitioner must have their varied thoughts of heaven.So what does heaven mean to you?
norm.修仙一途，并非只需要恒心即可，灵石功法皆不可少。在你看来，修士最重要的是什么？: The road of practice not only requires perseverance but also gem technique mastery.What is most essential to a practitioner in your opinion?
norm.这是最后一问，回答之后，我便带你飞升仙界。我且问你，飞升之后，你有何打算？: This is the last question, answer it and I'll ascend you to heaven.Here is my question, what is your plan upon ascension?
norm.修仙一途艰难叵测，修士之心善恶难辨，杀戮之举亦在所难免。你这一生做过多少杀戮之事: Should the practitioner unable to distinguish between good and evil, the act of carnage will be inevitable.How many times have your hands taint with blood?
norm.年十九，锦衣丝裙，金钗髻顶，珠光宝气。: 19 years old, well dressed, resplendent lady.

norm.年十七八，体貌憨厚，笑脸迎人。: 17 years old, honest and welcomes everyone with a smile.

norm.他是一处坊市主人的二儿子，对各种珍奇货物感兴趣，但是却对生意没兴趣，因此被家里人: He is the second son of one of the city mayor.He is interested to any rare stuff, except the business, therefore his family dislike him.
norm.他是一个内向不多言的人，但是心里却总是有着的自己的小心思，谁也不知道他在想什么。: He is an introvert, always had thoughts in his mind, no one gets what he is thinking.
norm.九尾天狐，修炼千年的绝世妖物，被镇压三百年，后被救出，化身女子，柔媚入骨，颠倒众: The Nine-tailed Fox, transforms herself into a lovely, alluring lady after being suppressed for 300 years.
norm.他衣服濡湿，忍冻蹲若犬，细长的狭目透露凶光。: His shirt wet, squats like a dog, glances menacingly.
norm.她是一名采茶女，终日采茶炒茶，有一天她看到一只蝴蝶正在破茧而出，她开始思考起她的: She is a tea-picking lady, and busy to pick the tea leaves.She saw a butterfly getting out from the shell, she starts thinking about her future.
norm.身裹银裘，朱唇玉面，体寒无比，似是冰凌。: Beauty enveloped in silver, her body cold as snow.
norm.年十六七，红妆艳丽，纤腰秀项，翩翩而行。: 16 years old, well dressed, walks in striking confidence.
norm.玉质灵秀，妙颜无双，嬉笑中两脸羞红，甚是可爱。: Peerless elegance, smiles with a blush, almost cute.
norm.她是一名艺伎，虽能琴棋书画样样精通，却总是被人指指点点。: A famed Geisha, skillful in all forms of art, but yet always being ridiculed.
norm.他是个天资聪慧的人，从小就生活在富有的家庭里，但也使他成为了一个纨绔子弟。: Born with a silver-spoon, talented and smart however these qualities made him a foppery disciple.
norm.幼时而被修行者收为弟子，后来凭借升仙令牌加入修仙门派，正式踏上修仙之路。: Taken in as disciple when young, officially began the journey of practice upon joining Guild with Ascension Token.
norm.他面白若霜，随风摇曳，屡欲倾侧。: His face pale; Body sways with the wind.
norm.身世不明，被人收养。从小受到阴寒侵体，导致体质虚弱，身体长期冰凉。: Adopted, with unknown origin.Affected by the frost since young, body weak and cold for ages.
norm.算不得俊俏，却有超然之气，手握噬魂，眼神坚毅。: Hand holds a Soul Eater with unwavering eyes; A strong presence.
norm.具她所说，她的爷爷在九岁的时候就被妖兽咬死了，所以他非常痛恨妖兽。: Her grudges towards beasts came from her grandfather's death in her youth for he was killed by them.
norm.家里世代皆是粮商，从小在粮仓里长大，对于经商之道有着自己的独特见解。: Descendant to a family of food dealers, has a unique perspective on trading.
norm.他的家族统治着一个座城，看起来他前途无量，直到一场叛变推翻了他的家族。: His family governs a city; Future seemed bright until his family was overturned through treason.
norm.前世出身于大炎王朝天都郡炎城青阳镇，因在山洞间偶然捡到的一块神秘的石符从而改变了: He was born in the Qingyang Town of Junyan City, he found a mystery Stone Amulet in the cave and it changed his fate.
norm.从小就失去父亲的他一直想要成为人上人，但却一直不得志。: Lost his father since young, inspired to be a noble but to no avail.
norm.她是一位易容师，从小就跟着师傅学习易容之术，在易容的造诣上深不可测。: She is a Disguise Master, she learnt it when she was young, and become skillful in disguising.

norm.彼时有天地异象长虹贯日，铸造大师苍天弃观之，心有所感遂铸一剑一甲。: Once a rainbow strikes over the sky, a master blacksmith was inspired and forged a pair of sword and Armor.
norm.使用后将二品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.2 Tripod in Forge.
norm.周身燃烧着炎阳之火，驱使之后，可形成万丈火海。: Surrounded by the flame of scorching sun, if one is able to control it, forming a burning sea is not a problem.
norm.封印有太乙玉仙魂魄，可在斗法时驱使仙魂御敌。: Sealed with the Taiyi soul, able to control the soul during contest.
norm.将钧天石置入北冥离火之中，熔炼七七四十九天方可成型。: Made by forging the Juntian Stone within the Northern Nether Fire for 49 days.
norm.使用噬空兽的皮炼制而成，催动时风云雷动，威势惊人。: Being made with the skin of Sky Devouring Beast, when used it will cause the sky to change, a terrifying weapon.
norm.通常是初次经历过天劫的修士使用的武器，采用精铁炼制物美价廉。: Normally a weapon used by practitioner who passed tribulation for the first time, forged with fine iron, it is very affordable.
norm.选用整块的异兽皮，再以火蚕丝缝制，不仅驱寒保暖，防御效果也不错。: Using the whole skin of an Exotic Beast and sewed with fire silk, not only does it keeps the wearer warm, it provides great defense.
norm.青云门镇派仙剑，传闻能够诛杀仙人，威力乃人间之首，有逆天之能。: The legendary sword of Qingyun Sect, it was said to be able to decimate immortals, the most powerful weapon amongst the mortal realm.
norm.鬼修常用的法宝，可释放出动摇神魂的灭魂之光，威能不俗。: A commonly trump used by those who taken the Ghostly Path, able to give out light that wavers the soul of enemy, has immense power.
norm.北冥苍雷书院炼制的法宝，防御力颇为不俗。: The trump made by Canglei Academy of the Nether North, it has extraordinary defensive capabilities.
norm.天庭玉帝凌霄天尊执掌的代表天地正道的法剑。: The sword of the Jade Emperor that represents justice.
norm.使用后将七品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.7 Tripod in Forge.
norm.蕴含一缕天劫雷霆之力，驱动后在周身形成雷电屏障，攻守兼备。: Containing a strand of the tribulation thunder, it forms a lightning barrier around the owner when activated, providing both offense and defense.
norm.以异兽冰璃蟠龙的龙角炼制而成，催动后可形成龙魂护身。: Being made with the horn of the Ice Dragon, it forms a dragon soul to protect the owner when activated.
norm.道门祖师太清真人的成名法宝，具有焚山煮海之威能。: The famous trump of the Taoist Master Taiqing Immortal, it has immense power.
norm.全部由金刚玄晶纱打造，坚固无比，寻常攻击不可破之。: Being made by Diamond silk, it is very tough and no normal attack can go through it.
norm.加持了由幻形如意阵生出来的如意阵，威力较寻常法器有所提升。: An augmented Ruyi Array, it has more power compare to average craft.
norm.以水属性灵液炼制而成，柔若无物，可自由变换形体。: Being made with the essence fluid of water element, it is extremely flexible and can change it's form freely.
norm.东海龙族身上最硬的鳞片制作的铠甲，其防御力在人间无出其右。: An Armor made with the toughest scale of the dragons, it's defensive capability is no match in the mortal realm.
norm.腾挪之间会释放出狂暴火焰，干扰敌人移动，可进可退。: It releases wild flame when the owner is moving, able to disturb the opponents movement.
norm.鞋子上绑着一对驱魔铃，是初入修行之人常用的低阶防具。: A pair of exorcism bell is tied on the shoe, a common equipment for those who just started the path of practicing.
norm.使用后将五品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.5 Tripod in Forge.
norm.辅助型的法宝，可窥视万里山海的任何一处景象。: A supportive trump, able to have a peek of any scene in the world.
norm.使用后将三品丹炉放置于炼丹室。: Using will put G.3 Cauldron in Furnace.
norm.因炼制时掺入了大量雷炎石，使得剑身雷火闪耀，故而得名。: Accidentally fused with many Thunderflame stone during forging, it made the sword shines brightly, thus the name was given.
norm.蕴含空间法则的至宝，可踏破虚空，穿梭两界之间。: A treasure that contains the rules of space, able to breakthrough the void and grant access to travel between the two world.
norm.通体莹白、晶莹剔透的手镯，充满了浓郁的空灵气息。: A crystal clear bangle that is heavily filled with the sky essence.
norm.元始天尊曾经佩戴过的法宝，成道之后遗失下界，至今仍踪迹不明。: A trump that the Primeval Lord once wore, it is lost since he ascended.
norm.传闻执掌该宝可掌控生死，不入轮回，超脱三界。: It was said that owning the trump would grant you the ability to control life and death, able to exit from karma.
norm.使用空冥玄铁炼制而成，注入灵力之后剑身会巨大化，威力惊人。: Being forged with the Desolation steel, the sword will grow in size when being infused with mana, holding incredible power.
norm.使用后将六品器鼎放置于锻器室。: Using will put G.6 Tripod in Forge.
norm.相传为东海龙王化形时所穿，乃水之精华编织而成，有覆海之威。: It was said to be worn by the Dragon King, being woven by water essence, it has the power to overturn the ocean.
norm.炼制时掺入了幻金粉末，能够幻化成一片幻境困住敌人。: Fused with Illusionary Gold powder during making, it can transform into a illusion realm to trap enemy.
norm.使用后将一品丹炉放置于炼丹室。: Using will put G.1 Cauldron in Furnace.
norm.使用霓虹木雕刻的手镯，能够守护魂魄，阻隔神识。: A bangle made by carving the Neon Wood, able to protect the soul of it's wearer, and block out bad intention.
norm.鬼修法宝，阴气腾腾，常被鬼修用来摄魂炼魄。: Trump of the Ghostly Path, it gives out a creepy aura, normally used to trap and refine souls.
norm.由无光铁吸纳大量阴气，再经地火锻造而成，充满黑暗压抑气息。: It was made by using a dark steel that absorbed a huge amount of Yin essence, and through the forging of ground fire, it is filled with a dark and depressing aura.
norm.使用帝魂石打造，能够吸收魂力，并能够对神魂法术起到增幅作用。: Made with Emperor Soul Stone, it can absorb energy, and boost soul spell.
norm.用多种异兽身上材料制成，不仅驱魔辟邪，而且能够有效抵御各类攻击。: Made by using different body parts of an exotic beast, not only does it expels evil stuff, it can resists all kinds of attack effectively.
