norm.分为红豆和相思两镯，持有者可以感知另一镯所在方位。: This bangle was split into 2 parts, granting one of the bangle's owner to know the location of the other owner.
norm.使用灵蚕丝炼制的法宝，质地柔软，可以随意变幻外形。: A trump made with spirit silk, it is extremely soft and flexible.
norm.常见的低阶饰品，无甚亮点。: A commonly seen accessory, there is nothing special about it.
norm.蕴含空间之力的至宝，可踏破虚空，穿梭两界之间。: A treasure that contains the power of space, able to breakthrough the void and grant access to travel between the two world.
norm.使用至阳至刚的炎阳沙炼制，对阴魂鬼物有极大的克制之效。: Made by the burning sand that contains the absolute Yang power, very effective towards evil being.
norm.炼制时加持了御灵锁妖阵，能够封印魂魄，是御灵宗修士的必备之物。: Augmented with Soul-control array during making, able to seal demon, an essential for Spirit Sect's practitioner.
norm.使用亡魂木雕刻的手镯，能够束缚魂魄，阻隔神识。: A bangle carved from Deceased Wood, able to bind soul and block out bad intention.
norm.寻宝修士在上古遗迹昆虚殿中发现了此宝，拥有种种不可思议的妙用。: It was found by a treasure hunting practitioner within the ancient Relic of Kun Xu Temple, it has all kinds of incredible uses.
norm.加持了破灭法阵，对法术攻击有不错的加成效果。: Augmented with destruction array, it boosts magic attack.
norm.五行宫混元子的成名法宝，在其陨落后下落不明。: The famous trump of Hunyuan Zi of the 5-Element palace, it has disappeared since his fall.
norm.太玄门的独门法宝，现世流传的多为其仿制品。: The special trump of the Taixuan Clan, most of it on the market are fake.
norm.通天道尊的成名法宝，通天道尊在飞升之后将其留给了子孙后人。: The famous trump of Sky Lord, left to his descendants after he ascend
norm.能够让修士进入奇异的梦境，显著提升参悟功法的速度。: Grants the wearer the ability to enter mysterious dream , greatly increase the speed of comprehending technique.
norm.蕴含时间之力的至宝，可减缓周身区域的时间流逝，自身却不受影响。: A treasure that contains the power of time, able to slow down the time of the wearer's surrounding.
norm.由万年檀木炼制，后经佛门高僧开光，对妖魔鬼魅有克制之效。: Made from a million years old sandalwood and being blessed by great monks, it has great effect towards evil being.
norm.分为日月两鉴，日为阳，月为阴，日月合并则阴阳平衡。: Split into two scroll of Sun and Moon which represents Yin and Yang, combine both scrolls for balance.
norm.使用蛮荒大陆特产的一种晶石打造，造型粗犷，充斥着蛮荒气息。: Made from a special crystal that only produced in the Wildlands, it has a rough look and filled with a wild aura.
norm.剑身使用青冥铁炼制，剑柄使用云山石雕刻，如碧海云天。: The blade is forged with Blue Nether steel while the handle is made from cloud mountain stone, it resembles the sky and the ocean.
norm.使用长生木雕刻而成，佩戴后可延缓衰老，增加寿元。: Carved from longevity wood, wearing it slows down the aging process, thus granting a longer life.
norm.旋光石打造的戒指，凡人看了之后会迷惑失神。: A ring made from Revolving Light Stone, a sight of it would impact a mortal's soul with confusion.
norm.传闻穿戴之后可直上九霄，一窥上界仙家景象，故名“望仙”。: Rumor has that wearing it would immediately ascend to the Ninth Heaven, giving a peek of the deity world, thus the name.
norm.炼制时参入了阴灵石，故而散发出阴冷的气息，长期佩戴会影响心智。: Fused with Yin Spirit stone during forging, it gives out a dark aura, wearing it for a long time will affect the wearer's mental.
norm.造型华丽，传说中仙人才会穿，深受高阶修士喜爱。: Having a gorgeous look, it was said that only the immortals wear it, very popular amongst advanced practitioner.
norm.适合体修用的法宝，能够大幅度提升肉身力量。: A trump suitable for physical training, it greatly increases the power of body.
norm.由大神通修士将一整朵玉华莲炼制而成，以灵力驱动可释放莲华幻术。: Made by a powerful practitioner from a jade lotus, able to release a jade illusion when activated.
norm.传说中蛟龙死后，其眼睛会化为龙睛，炼制之后可破世间幻术。: Rumor has that aerifying the eye of Sea Dragon would grant you an item that is able to break most of the illusion spell.
norm.使用陨星炼制，蕴含星辰之力，使用灵气催动后可形成星璇御敌。: Made from meteorite, it contains the power of stars, activating it with mana will form a star to attack your enemies.
norm.天蚕丝炼制的法袍，因绘制了流云花纹而得名。: A robe made from heavenly silk, it's name comes from the woven cloud art.
norm.道门祖师玄清上人的成名法宝，具有平山移海之威能。: The famous trump of the Taoist Master Xuanqing elder, it has immense power.
norm.内有浑天金刚阵，催动后形成灵气结界，防御力极佳。: Containing the Heavenly Emery array, activating it would form an essence barrier, has exceptional defense.
norm.使用镇海水晶打造，有极佳的辟水功效，是猎杀海兽的必备之物。: Made from sea crystal, it has excellent effect on controlling water, a must-have for killing sea beasts.
norm.穿戴此宝踏于海泽之上，整片大海都将停止涌动。: Set your foot on the ocean while wearing these, and the ocean will stop moving.
norm.比较常见的法宝，各大宗门的坊市中都能买到。: A more commonly seen trump, able to buy it in every market.
norm.门派发放给外门弟子的武器，几乎人手一把，威力着实有限。: A weapon distributed to Outer Disciple, almost everyone has it, it has limited capabilities.
norm.无量山无涯子前辈亲自打造的长刀，威力不凡，在修仙界颇有名气。: A long blade made personally by the senior of Limitless Mountain, it is famous for its formidable power.
norm.西域婆罗门的空法大师炼制的佛门法宝，可度化冤魂。: The utmost trump made by the Void Master of Western Brahmin, it is able to purify the soul of enmity.
norm.儒家至宝，蕴含精纯的浩然之气，能清心宁神，抵御神魂攻击。: The utmost treasure of Confucianism, it contains the purest essence of justice, able to calm souls and resist attack towards mental.
norm.常见的低阶防具，多为男性修仙者穿戴。: A common Armor normally worn by male practitioner.
norm.分为阴阳两镯，阳镯主攻，阴镯主守，两镯合并则攻守兼备。: Split into Yin and Yang, the Yang bangle is offensive while the Yin Bangle is defensive, having both grant good balance.
norm.造型古朴的戒指，因物美价廉而备受低阶修士青睐。: A simple ring, it is popular amongst the average practitioner due to it's price.
norm.元明玉乃归元山特产的一种玉石，有加速修炼之神效。: Autor Jade is a jade that only yields from Mt.Guiyuan, able to speed up practice.
norm.造型古朴的头冠，造价低廉，防护能力一般。: A simple crown, it is cheap and provide decent defense.
norm.名为玉，实际却是真灵血肉炼制，肉身严重损毁时，可借助此宝涅槃重生。: A jade that is made from blood and soul, it could be use to resurrect your body.
norm.使用鸾凤的尾羽炼制，催动后可凝聚鸾凤法相御敌。: Made from the tail feather of phoenix, able to summon the power of phoenix when activated.
norm.催动后可形成幽冥幻阵，让敌人仿佛置身于幽冥地狱之中。: Able to form a nether array when activated, trapping your enemies as they are within the nether hell.
norm.由碧海阁的欧阳大师亲自炼制，在东海修仙界非常出名。: Made personally by the Ouyang Master of Bihai Chamber, it is very famous throughout the practice world of Eastern Seas.
norm.常见的低阶防具，坊市里随处可见。: A common Armor that sells everywhere.
norm.使用蛟龙牙齿雕刻而成，散发出妖兽的气息。: Carved from sea dragon's tooth, it gives out an ominous aura.
norm.使用凤凰火晶打造而成，炽热无比，对火属性法术有明显的增幅效果。: Made from Phoenix Crystal, it is extremely hot, and greatly increases the power of Fire Spell.
norm.炼制时融入了乾坤八卦阵，看似轻薄，实际上能够抵御法宝攻击。: Fused with the Eight Diagram array, it seems light but it can resist the attack from other trump.
norm.轻若无物的靴子，据说穿上后可踏云而行，足见其不凡。: This shoe weights nothing, it was said that wearing it grants you the ability to walk on clouds.
norm.使用蜃楼石炼制而成，能够感知修士的神识，颇为神妙。: Made from the Mirage Stone, it could sense the minds of the practitioner, very amazing.
norm.青冥纱炼制的防具，防护能力不俗，并且能提升对阴气的感知能力。: An Armor made from nether silk, it grants extraordinary defense while increasing the power to sense Yin aura.
norm.使用蓬莱海域特有的妖兽皮制作，在中土修仙界并不常见。: Made from the skin of a demon beast that only appears at the Penglai Seas, it is quite rare in the practice world.
norm.以血精石为主材炼制，灌注精纯煞气，威力霸道异常。: Made with Blood Gem, it was fused with the purest kill intent, contains immense power.
norm.使用玄天青藤编织而成，可瞬间蔓延至全身，形成藤甲。: Made with heavenly vine, it is able to surround it's wearer instantly, forming an Armor.
norm.剑修门派真武门的标志性武器，在中土修仙界可谓家喻户晓。: The symbol weapon of the Zhenwu Sect, it is widely known amongst the practice world.
norm.使用玄铁打造，后经弱水淬炼，使得其剑刃锋利又极具韧性。: Made from mystic steel and being quenched in water, the blade is extremely sharp and flexible.
norm.使用混沌石炼制的法宝，可抵御五行法术，价值难以估量。: A trump made from Chaos Stone, it is able to resist the spell of 5-Elements, it is immensely expensive.
norm.炼制时融入了巨人的精魂，御敌时可幻化出上古巨人的虚影。: Fused with the soul of Giants, it is able to make an illusion of giant when activated.
norm.本是佛门至宝，后被魔气侵蚀，虽然威力大增，但容易让人丧失心智。: Originally a treasure of buddhism, after it being corrupted by demon aura, it became more powerful but would corrupt the user
norm.精铜打造，形似龙眼，颇有皇家帝王的风格。: Made with fine bronze, it has the shape of a dragon eye, giving out a majestic aura.
norm.封印有仙人魂魄，可在斗法时驱使仙魂御敌。: Sealed with Immortal souls, able to control the soul during contest.
norm.元始仙尊亲自炼制的宝甲，赏赐给对仙界有大贡献之人。: An Armor personally made by the Primodial Lord, it is only given to those who heavily contributed for Heaven.
norm.多种灵材混合锻造的护甲，防御力不俗，但是颇为沉重。: An Armor made by fusing multiple materials, it has extraordinary defense but weighs a lot.
norm.鬼修法宝，阴气腾腾，穿戴之后可变化为青罗巨鬼。: Trump of the Ghostly Path, it gives out a creepy aura, able to transform into a Huge Ghost when worn.
norm.镶嵌有昊阳暖玉，可强自身气血，避阴气邪毒。: Embedded with Sun Jade, it strengthens the wearer's blood, provide resistance to evil aura and poison.
norm.禁锢类的法宝，催动后形成弥天锁魂阵，可困住百里之内的生灵。: A trump of imprisonment, able to form a soul-locking array after activating, trapping any creatures within 5000 meters.
norm.其内封印了朱雀的一缕魂魄，可召唤朱雀虚影发动攻击。: Sealed with a part of Vermilion Bird's soul, able to summon the shadow of Suzaku to attack.
norm.全力催动后会化作一道流光，显著提升遁速，颇为实用。: Able to create an aura after fully activating it, improving the speed of art significantly.
norm.按照九宫八卦打造的法器，炼制手法拙劣，价值不高。: A craft made accordingly to the Eight Diagram of the 9 Grids, it was poorly made thus inexpensive.
norm.全部由金刚玄晶打造，坚固无比，寻常攻击不可破之。: Being made by Diamond, it is very tough and no normal attack can go through it.
norm.北冥无极宫发放给门下弟子的法宝，威能中规中矩。: A trump given to the disciple of Infinite Palace, has average power.
norm.炼制时掺入了蛟龙的的一滴精血，穿戴后如龙游天地。: Fused with a drop of dragon blood during making, wearing it grants immense power.
norm.传闻该宝物可掌控生死，超脱轮回，已然超出了法宝的范畴。: It was said that this treasure could control life and death and exit from karma, extremely powerful.
norm.使用裂空兽的皮炼制而成，催动时风云雷动，威势惊人。: Being made with the skin of Skybreak Beast Beast, when used it will cause the sky to change, a terrifying weapon.
norm.由青璃石炼制而成，表面有璃水流动，难得的水属性宝物。: Made with green glaze, it seems like water is flowing on it's surface, a rare water treasure.
norm.离火木雕刻而成，上面印有火焰纹路，常见的低阶法器。: Carved from Inferno Wood, it has a fire pattern on it, a commonly seen craft.
norm.炼制时加持了低阶风灵阵，能够略微提升行动力。: Augmented with a low grade wind array during making, sightly increases the wearer's mobility.
norm.使用火云沙炼制，御寒效果极佳，但防御效果不甚出众。: Made with Fire Cloud Sand, it is very effective to resist cold, but doesn't provide much defense.
norm.鬼修常用的法宝，其内封印着万千魂魄，需要时可驱使御敌。: A commonly used trump by the Ghostly Path, it contains thousands of soul within it, able to use it to attack enemy when needed.
norm.由大神通修士炼制，内含须弥结界，可将一片天地封印其中。: Made by a powerful practitioner, it contains huge space inside, able to seal the world within it.
norm.样式华丽的头冠，其上有玉龙盘绕，像是世俗之物。: A gorgeous crown surrounded by jade dragon, seems like an otherworldly item.
norm.传闻某位仙界大能，将整个大陆连同其内生灵炼化成此宝。: It was said that once a powerful individual made this treasure from a continent, including all the living being inside.
norm.使用真灵玄武的皮炼制而成，并封印了玄武的一缕魂魄，防御力极佳。: Made from the skin of Black Tortoise and sealing a part of it's soul inside, it provides extreme defensive capabilities.
norm.万年寒玉打造，触之冰冷刺骨，只适合修习水属性功法的修士穿戴。: Made with Millennial Jade, wearing it would feel chills to the bone, only suitable for practitioner who practices water technique.
norm.炼制时加入了少量雷劫石，使得其威力较寻常飞剑有很大提升。: A small amount of Thunder Tribulation stone were added during it's forging process, giving it superior power compare to average flying sword.
norm.辅助型的法宝，可窥视万里之内的任何一处景象。: A supportive trump, able to have a peek of any scene within a wide range.
norm.由玄冥铁吸纳大量煞气，再经冥火锻造而成，充满杀戮血腥气息。: Made from the Nether Steel that absorbed a huge amount of kill intent and forged with Nether Flame, it is filled with a slaughtering aura.
norm.由琅琊晶打造而成，当年天琊上人正是凭借此剑纵横人界数千年。: Made with Langya Crystal, once Tianya Elder wielded this sword and ruled the mortal world.
norm.使用青山石打造，因表面刻有青龙而得名。: Made from green mountain stone, it got his name from the Azure Dragon engraved on the surface.
norm.剑身嵌有七颗星璇石，暗含北斗七星之势，可施展七星剑阵。: Embedded with 7 star gem, it contains the power of the stars, able to perform the seven star array.
norm.蕴含雷霆之力，驱动后在周身形成雷电屏障，攻守兼备。: Contains the power of thunder, it forms a lightning barrier around the owner when activated, providing both offense and defense.
norm.使用万年雪晶炼制，蕴含冰雪之力，可将河川化为冰川。: Made with a ice crystal that is million years old, it contains the power of ice, able to freeze any river.
norm.使用多种水属性材料炼制，对水系法术有不错的抵抗力。: Made with all kinds of water element material, it has good resist towards water spell.
norm.由上古真灵“天睛兽”的独目炼制而成，可看破世间幻象，乃世间异宝。: Made with the single eye of the ancient spirit "Heavenly Shine Beast", it is able to see through every illusion, an exotic treasure.
norm.使用灵蚕丝炼制的法袍，质地柔软，能够抵消部分五行法术伤害。: A robe made with spirit silk, it is soft and able to neutralize most of the 5-Element spell's damage.
norm.将钧天石置入地火之中，熔炼七七四十九天方可成型。: Made by forging the Juntian Stone within the ground fire for 49 days.
norm.魔族之人炼制的法宝，表面魔气隐现，内部有血光流动。: A trump made by the devils, you can feel the evilish accent from the surface.
norm.炼制时加持了绝灵法阵，对五行法术攻击有克制之效。: Augmented with Soulbreak array during making, able to counter the attack of 5-Element spells.
norm.因炼制时掺入了大量秘银，使得剑身银光闪耀，故而得名。: Fused with huge amount of Mithril during forging, it made the sword shines brightly, thus the name was given.
norm.加持了神风法阵，催动之后如御风而行，堪比飞行法宝。: Augmented with Godwind array, the owner could walk on wind after activation, a flying trump.
norm.使用人、鬼、魔三界的顶级灵材融合炼制，佩戴者在三界之间自由穿梭。: Fused with the top material amongst to the 3-world of human, ghost and devil, grants the wearer the ability to traverse freely between the 3-world.
norm.使用冥河魂玉炼制而成，能够吸纳阴魂并将其炼化为阴气。: Made from the Nether River Soul Jade, it could absorb bad souls and refine them into Yin essence.
norm.炼制时掺入了天蚕丝，能够变化成罗天巨网困住敌人。: Fused with heavenly silk during making, able to form a huge web to trap enemy.
norm.将冥河幽铁置于白磷鬼火中祭炼而成，施展时阴风阵阵。: Made by forging Nether River Iron within the Phosphorus fire, you could feel the chills when it activated.
norm.门派发放给外门弟子的衣服，有少许的防护效果。: A shirt distributed to Outer Disciple, it provides minimal defense.
norm.妙音门炼制的法宝，专门用于破除幻阵，以及修士的幻化伪装。: A trump made by Miaoyin Clan, specialize in breaking illusion and camouflage.
norm.加持了由八卦阵衍生出来的坎离阵，威力较寻常法器有所提升。: Augmented with Kun Li array of the Eight Diagram, it has more power compare to average craft.
norm.定魂玉雕琢而成，有少许温养神识的作用。: Carved from Soulfix Jade, it can calm your mental.
norm.将万灵石置于炎阳精火中煅烧万余载，方可得此异宝。: This treasure can only be obtained by burning the Million Spirit Stone within the Refined Sun Fire for million years.
norm.使用青魂矿打造，并且参入了少量秘银，能够有效抵御法术攻击。: Forged with Green Soul Ore and fused with a small amount of Mithril, it is able to resist spell attack effectively.
norm.由寒魄冰晶炼制，催动之后，方圆万里皆化为冰雪之地。: Made with Cryosoul Crystal, activating it will freeze all of your surroundings.
norm.元始仙尊曾经佩戴过的法宝，可将整片天空化为虚无。: A trump that the Primeval Lord once wore, it could turn the sky into void.
norm.加持了高阶法阵，穿上之后能极大提升速度，移动时只能看到一片残影。: Augmented with advanced array, wearing it would greatly improve your speed, leaving only shadow during moving.
norm.防御力不佳，但是可以遮掩自身气息，隐匿踪迹。: It has poor defense but is able to hide the wearer's aura.
norm.造型古朴，紫气缭绕，穿戴之后颇有仙家气范。: With a classic look and surrounded by auspicious aura, wearing it makes you feel like a deity.
norm.使用五行玉打造的玉佩，蕴含着淡淡灵气。: A jade accessory made with 5-Element Jade, it contains weak essence.
norm.据说此宝乃是仙界大能炼化九天星辰而成，其真伪无从考究。: It was said that this trump was made by a powerful individual from the ninth stars, but no one knows the truth.
norm.通体碧绿、晶莹剔透的手镯，充满了浓郁的水灵之气。: A crystal clear, green bangle that is heavily filled with water essence.
norm.以特殊材料炼制，可存储灵气，法力枯竭时可取而用之。: Made with a special material, it could store essence, able to withdraw from it when your power has used up.
norm.可将一缕魂魄置于其中，炼化为分魂，多为鬼修所用。: Able to store a part of your soul and refine it into split soul, normally used by Ghostly Path.
norm.魔修所用的法宝，需以自身精血催动，未伤人先伤己。: Trump used by people who took the Demonic Path Path, activated by using own blood, hurting ownself before hurting others.
norm.腾挪之间会释放出烟波雾气，干扰敌人视线，隐匿自身行踪。: It releases smoke and mist when the owner is moving, able to distract opponent and hide your track.
norm.使用墨蛟的鳞片炼制而成，血祭之后可将鳞片融于肉身。: Made from the scale of the dark dragon, melt it to fuse with your body.
norm.元始仙尊早年曾用此剑灭杀过域外魔神，后将其赏赐给门下弟子。: Primeval Lord once used this sword to kill the outer devils, and gave it to his disciple.
norm.炼化整条河川方得此剑，施展时波涛汹涌，威势惊人。: Forged with the whole river, it gaves out a fierce wave when used.
norm.周身散发出灼热气息，充满至阳至刚之力，对阴魂鬼魅有克制之效。: Giving out a flaming aura, it is filled with the force of Yang and justice, greatly counters those that practice Yin technique.
norm.内含充沛的浩然之气，非常适合修习儒家功法的修士使用。: It contains the Qi of Justice, suitable for those who practices the technique of Confucianism.
norm.六道轮回冠的仿制品，虽说是仿制品，但也有正品的六七分威能。: The imitation of the Reincarnation Crown, but it still has quite the power.
norm.清源居士经常穿着的靴子，当然市面上看到的都是仿制品。: The shoe that Qingyuan Householder always wears, but most of those on the market are fake.
norm.本身只是品阶一般的法器，因融入了一滴巽龙血液而有了一丝灵性。: It was originally just an average craft, but became superior after fused with a drop of dragon's blood.
norm.普贤高僧坐化后遗留的至宝，传闻可扭转命数，度过灾厄。: A treasure left by a great monk after he ascended, it was said to be able to turn destiny and pass tribulation.
norm.奇特的辅助性法宝，多个万珑玉之间可互相感应彼此的位置。: A special supportive trump, every Wanlong Jade could sense the others location.
norm.使用可隔绝灵气的元磁砂炼制，穿戴后能遮掩自身的灵力波动。: Made with a magnet sand that is able to block essence, wearing it could hide your own essence aura.
norm.使用云海石打造，能够吸收水灵气，并能够对水系法术起到增幅作用。: Made with Cloud Ocean Stone, able to absorb water essence and amplify water spell.
norm.使用血珀石打造的指环，表面十分光滑。: A ring made with blood amber stone, has a smooth surface.
norm.使用西域灵云纱炼制的法袍，有助于吸纳天地灵气，加速修行。: A robe made with cloud silk from the western region, able to absorb the essence of universe, speed up practices.
norm.使用蛮荒异兽的皮炼制的护甲，寻常武器不可伤之。: An Armor made with the skin of exotic beast, average weapon would not do any harm.
norm.青云门的镇派之宝，传闻能够诛杀仙人，是人界最顶级的法宝。: The legendary treasure of the Qingyun Sect, rumors said that it could kill the immortal, the top class treasure amongst mortal world.
norm.加持了四象法阵，无论是肉身攻击还是五行法术，都能应对自如。: Augmented with Four Aggregates array, it could resist whether physical or spell attack.
norm.形似泪珠，灿若星辰，每到夜晚可吸收月光，转化为精纯灵气。: It has the shape of a tear, and shine brightly like the stars, absorbing the moonlight every night and turn it into pure essence.
norm.罕见的空间法宝，其内自成一方天地，只有炼器宗门百巧院才能炼制。: A rare space trump, it contains a small world within it, only the refining sect of Baiqiao Hall can make it.
norm.采用精铁炼制的飞剑，物美价廉，颇受低阶修士喜爱。: A flying sword made with fine iron, it is popular amongst the average practitioner due to it's price.
norm.天晶只产于九霄之上的玉皇天，使用其炼制的法宝自然珍稀至极。: The Skystal Jade only produce above the ninth heaven, trump that made from it are extremely rare.
norm.为感谢你又为仙界引渡了一位杰出的修仙之士，小小心意，不成敬意，还望笑纳。: To thank you for guiding another outstanding practitioner to the deity world, here is a little gift for you.
norm.拥有一座灵兽院，可以用来饲养灵兽。: Having a Pet Hall could use it to raise pet.
norm.龟灵可以领悟到矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃。: Turtle is able to learn Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane.
norm.莽荒大陆上著名的魔兽，身负六翼，能说人话，通万物之理，很少出没，除非当时有天下大: A famous demon beast on the Desolated Land, it bears six wings, able to communicate with human and knows the law of nature, it rarely shows itself unless the world is in chaos.It is a beast of omen.
norm.北冥有鱼，其名为鲲。鲲之大，不知其几千里也。化而为鸟，其名为鹏。鹏之背，不知其几: There is a fish named Kun at the Northern Nether.The size of Kun is enormous as a mountain.It could morph into a bird named PenG.The size of Peng is enormous as well, it's wing could match the cloud on the sky.It is a bird, traveling through seas would reach the southern region.And southern region is where the heavenly pool lies.
norm.豹是森林中的大型兽类，而豹灵则是豹在逝去后，由神魂吸收月精地华而生，是一种攻击性: Leopard is a huge beast within the forest, and the Spirit Leopard born from the soul of leopard absorbing the essence of heaven and earth after dying, a very aggressive pet.
norm.魔蛟可以领悟到魔焰、烟水、壁障、长生、雷界、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Sea Demon is able to learn Demon Flame, Smoke Water, Barrier, Longevity, Thunder Bound, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.

norm.鲲鹏可以领悟到魔焰、烟水、壁障、长生、雷界、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Kunpeng is able to learn Demon Flame, Smoke Water, Barrier, Longevity, Thunder Bound, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.

norm.苍龙是古代神话中的天之四灵之一，源于远古星宿崇拜，是代表太昊与东方七宿的东方之神: The Ash Dragon is one of the four great ancient spirits from ancient mythology, it represents the sun and spring season.
norm.焰狼可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警: Flame Wolf is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective, Piercing Fang, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.犼可以领悟到利爪、兽血沸腾、刚鬃。: Hou is able to learn Sharp Claw, Bloodlust, Tough Mane.
norm.有一种鸟，它长得像鸡而有三个头，六只眼，六条腿，三只翅膀。它的名字叫尚付。见了这: There is one bird, it resembles a chicken but it has 3 head, 6 eyes, 6 legs and 3 wings.It's name is Shangfu.Those who sees the appearance of Shangfu would lost their mind and power, spreading rumors about it.
norm.鹿是森林中的精灵，食草木，善跳跃，性情温和，后因缘际会化为鹿灵，感知敏锐，是修真: Deer is a warm animal within the woods, by chance it could transcend into Deer Spirit that is very sensitive to surroundings, a very good companion for those practitioner who likes to travel.
norm.白虎是古代神话中的天之四灵之一，源于远古星宿崇拜，是代表少昊与西方七宿的西方之神: The Byako is one of the four great ancient spirits from ancient mythology, it represents the moon and autumn season.
norm.玉山，山中有一种灵狼，形状像狐狸却通身是火红色，名称是焰狼，吞食天地间的火属灵气: There is a spirit wolf within the Jade Mountain, it has the shape of the fox but is crimson in color, it's name is Flame Wolf, it devours the fire essence of the world, and it's howl sounds like deer's cry, wherever it appears, the place will surely have a fire disaster.
norm.麒麟可以领悟到魔焰、烟水、壁障、长生、雷界、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Kylin is able to learn Demon Flame, Smoke Water, Barrier, Longevity, Thunder Bound, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.青丘国在朝阳谷的北边，分为上青丘和下青丘。上青丘多为灵气充盈、五行均衡的福地，下: The Qingqiu Nation is located at the north side of Chaoyang Valley, and is separated into upper and lower Qingqiu.Upper Qingqiu is a blessed land filled with essence, whereas Lower Qingqiu only contains fire essence, within it there is a spirit fox that bears blue flame, people called it as Ghost Fox.
norm.头好象孔雀的头，头上的角峥嵘古怪，有一条蛇一样的尾巴。他曾与蚩尤一起拜一真道人为: It heads resembles a peacock but has a very strange horn, and a tail resembles the snake.It once practiced together with Chiyou under the Yizhen Immortal at Mt Lu.
norm.上古灵兽，有书曰：青丘之山有兽焉，其状如狐而九尾，其音如婴儿，能食人，食者不蛊。: An ancient beast, it was written in a book saying that it sounds like a baby and would devour human.
norm.雷神山，山中有一方雷池，有兽，形状像普通的狗，头上的角与牛角相似，名称是狡，发出: Within the thunder pool of Mt.Leishen, there is one creature that resembles the shape of a dog but has the horn of an ox, it is called as Thundog, it's howl is like thunder, disaster would fall on wherever this beast sets foot on.
norm.青灵牛原住在中土神州的最南端，因驼伏上古圣人西出阳关，而获得气运加身，是修真者采: The Oriental Ox originally lives at the most southern part of Middle Earth, but once it carried an ancient deity to the west and obtained great luck, a good companion for practitioner who likes to collect treasure.Now as it is near extinction, it is hard to even have sight of it.
norm.雷狡可以领悟到火咒、水咒、岩咒、木咒、气刃、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Thundog is able to learn Fire Curse, Water Curse, Stone Curse, Wood Curse, Blade Wave, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.尚付可以领悟到火咒、水咒、岩咒、木咒、气刃、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Shangfu is able to learn Fire Curse, Water Curse, Stone Curse, Wood Curse, Blade Wave, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.传说苍雷山脉中有一山峰，遍布金石之物，因为太过高大，经常吸引天地雷气汇聚于此，过: It was said that there is a mountain within the Canglei Veins that contains a massive amounts of metal, but as the mountain is too tall, it often attracts thunder, and the Thunder Beasts are born after 3000 years, it howl is like the thunder, and has powerful combat capabilities.
norm.雷兽可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主、尖牙、潜伏技能。: Thunder Beast is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective, Piercing Fang, Stealth.
norm.鹿灵可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾。: Deer Spirit is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust.
norm.炎虎可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主、尖牙技能。: Thunder Beast is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective, Piercing Fang.
norm.东海有兽名犼，形如兔，两耳尖长，仅长尺余。狮畏之，盖吼溺着体即腐。体型虽小，亦能: There is a beast named Hou at the Eastern Seas, it resembles the shape of a rabbit, having very long ears but small in size.It's howl could rot the bodies of any creature, even the lions are afraid of it.It could even edge out in a fight with a dragon despite it's size, and feasts on the corpse of dragon after triumphing.
norm.龟族是无边海中的长寿种族，而龟灵身体上灵气充盈，许多修真人士都渴望拥有一只作为灵: The turtles is a long-living creatures in the endless seas, and the Spirit Turtle is filled with essence, many practitioner desire a spirit turtle as their pet to understand the way to longevity.
norm.豹灵可以领悟到利爪、矫健。: Spirit Leopard is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust.
norm.苍龙可以领悟到魔焰、烟水、壁障、长生、雷界、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Seiryu is able to learn Demon Flame, Smoke Water, Barrier, Longevity, Thunder Bound, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.凤凰可以领悟到魔焰、烟水、壁障、长生、雷界、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警。: Phoenix is able to learn Demon Flame, Smoke Water, Barrier, Longevity, Thunder Bound, Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.麒麟，是上古人类最企望出现的吉祥动物，它们的出现表示一代的幸福。因此，那时的人们: Kylin is the most auspicious creature ever existed, their appearance means the bliss for entire generation.Thus, people during that time hope that Kylin will always follow them to bring them light and luck.
norm.青灵牛可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主、尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机: Oriental Ox is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective, Piercing Fang, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant.
norm.虎啸山，是上古虎族的发源地。有虎降生之后天赋异禀，浑身异火缭绕，被称为炎虎。战力: Mt.Huxiao is where the ancient tigers originated from.There was one tiger showed supreme talent since born, being surrounded by fire, it's called the Flame Tiger.It has immense power, the best pet that suits the needs of all practitioner.
norm.东山往南三百里，是座栒状山，山上有丰富的金属矿物和玉石，山中有一种野兽，形状像一: There once was a mountain that is full of mineral and jade, and one unique beast has born from there, it resembles the shape of a dog, but has 6 legs, it's name is Congcong, came from the howl of the beast.
norm.凤有六象九苞。六象者，头象天，目象日，背象月，翼象风，足象地，尾象纬。九苞者，口: The phoenix has many auspicious traits.It's head represents the sky, it's eye the sun, it's back the moon, it's wing the wind, it's leg for the earth, and it's tail for the latitude.Whereas it's mouth represents life, it's heart for tolerance, it's ear for smart, it's mouth for changes, it has colorful feathers, a red crown, sharp claws, inciting sound and a smooth belly.If it cries in the night it means bliss, in the morning it is auspicious, in the sky it is peace, it feasts on the fruits of trees.
norm.从从可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主、岩咒技能。: Congcong is able to learn Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective, Stone Curse.
norm.飞廉可以领悟到利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主、气刃技能。: Fei Lian is able to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective, Blade Wave.
norm.使用后给当前灵兽增加50000经验。: Using adds 50000 EXP to current pet.
norm.有几率领悟技能火咒、水咒、岩咒、木咒、气刃: Has a chance to learn Fire Curse, Water Curse, Stone Curse, Wood Curse, Blade Wave
norm.有几率领悟技能尖牙、潜伏、凶神血裔、朱鬣、机警: Has a chance to learn Piercing Fang, Stealth, Savage Blood, Red Mane, Vigilant
norm.有几率领悟技能利爪、矫健、兽血沸腾、刚鬃、护主: Has a chance to learn Sharp Claw, Agile, Bloodlust, Tough Mane, Protective

norm.它身上覆盖着坚硬的鬃毛，以使他们避免受到伤害。: It is covered with hard mane to protect themselves.
norm.它们在林间或者深潭里潜伏，伺机待发。: They hide within the forest or deep swamp to ambush their prey.
norm.大荒远古时期的凶神血统遗传至今。: The blood of the savage god passed down from ancient times.
norm.灵活的躯体会让它躲避掉绝大部分攻击。: It's agile body grants it the ability to dodge most attack.
norm.颈部的鳞片可以很好地保护自己的弱点。: It's scale on the neck protects it's weak point well.
norm.一旦被收服后，它会保护自己的主人。: Once tamed, it will protect it's master.
norm.灵兽的利爪会让所有来犯之人付出代价。: The sharp claw of the beast would made those who intrudes pay.
norm.大幅度增强自己对于木系仙法的控制力。: Greatly strengthens control over Wood magic.
norm.大幅度增强自己对于金系仙法的控制力。: Greatly strengthens control over Metal magic.
norm.大幅度增强自己对于土系仙法的控制力。: Greatly strengthens control over Earth magic.
norm.大幅度增强自己对于水系仙法的控制力。: Greatly strengthens control over Water magic.
norm.灵兽的獠牙会将敌人的骨头咬得粉碎。: The fang of the beast will tear down even the bone of enemy.
norm.大幅度增强自己对于火系仙法的控制力。: Greatly strengthens control over Fire magic.
norm.它们很机警，会对隐藏的危险发出警告。: They could easily sense the danger laying around.
norm.它们内心有着对鲜血的渴望与暴虐。: They desire the blood and slaughter within them.
norm.有紫气东来，连绵不绝，悬停于墟上，继而凝结为云，如冠如盖，香飘千里。世人啧啧称奇: There once was an endless auspicious aura that lingers upon a mountain, and through time it formed into a cloud that resembles the shape of a crown, and fragrance could be felt from thousand miles away.Being amazed, people called it as the Sandalcloud.It was said that once a deity came down from the skies and granted great luck for those fortunate enough to meet him.
norm.有金蚨，生南海，形大如蝉。逾千年，终得道，遂于附近山内开辟洞府，传授修真大道。为: There once was a water beetle that born on the southern seas that is as huge as a cicada.After a thousand year passed, it has transcended, and created an abode within the mountain nearby, and teaches people the way of practice.To commemorate the deity, people named the place in the name of it.
norm.嵯峨的石峰林凸起在浑圆的山顶上，远远望去，犹如一座雄踞山巅的古代城堡。曾有上界谪: Many high and steep stone pillar lies on the top of the mountain, looking from afar, it resembles an ancient castle built upon the mountain.Once a deity secretly practiced here and led a life of freedom, then went back to the heavens.
norm.古源有座万灵山，石刻天书识字难。有人能解其中义，金山银山任君担。山巅之上，佛家道: Mt.Wanling has existed since the ancient times, it's stone wall is carved with uninterpretable words.Those that is able to interpret the words would obtain immense wisdom.On the top of the mountain is the buddhism dojo, the place shines brightly and is able to repel evil.
norm.云梦大泽之畔，水灵根修炼者的圣地。物华天宝，人杰地灵。后为妖魔所忌惮，在异族联手: The lake beside the Dreamy Swamp, best place for practitioner that has the water aptitude.This place is full of treasures and talented people.Being feared by the evil, they joined forces to wipe out the place, causing endless war and corpse, turning the place into a living hell.
norm.曾经是妖族之主苍狼王的起源地。有人意外发现此地不时出现狼王遗迹。一时风起云涌，各: Once the origin place of the Devil King Canglang.People would discover the Relic of the Devil King from time to time.The myth got popular overtime, attracting practitioner of all races to travel and practice at the spot.
norm.曾为北寒仙宫的领地。修真者为求机遇福缘，常入山历练探索。福祸相依，更有妖修魔兽潜: Once the territory of Beihan Immortal.Practitioners that want to try out their luck often came here to practice and explore.But evil practitioners and demon beasts lies within the mountain to prey on those innocent practitioner.
norm.丹门大派奇灵门坐落于此。因常年炼丹，丹药提炼出炉时的雾霭笼罩在山间，仿若绚丽斑斓: The great sect of alchemy, Qiling Sect lies here.Due to endlessly concocting pills over the years, smoke and fog clouded the mountain heavily.As many of the places within the mountain is still not explored yet, many practitioner often came here to travel.
norm.佛修宗门菩提的山门所在。菩露山历来是妖魔怨魂藏龙卧虎之地，菩提老祖开山立派之际，: The place where the buddhism sect Bodhi Clan lies.Mt.Pulu was originally a place filled with demons and beasts, but as the Bodhi Patriarch came, he got rid all of the evil and made a sect there.
norm.牡丹，傲然高贵之物。这连绵不绝的牡丹花海，姹紫嫣红，似朝霞绽放于漫山遍野之间。若: Peony is a flower of elegance.This endless field of peony is like embracing twilight within the mountains.It is an amazing view, but this endless field has too many unknowns, training here proves to be difficult.

norm.看来我的勇气还是比师兄差远了。: Seems like my courage is still incomparable with senior.
norm.我当年也是这么想的，他们的仇敌又未必是一些坏人。: I thought about that too, their enemy might not be the bad guys.
norm.等你得道之后可不要忘了我啊。: Do not forget me after you ascend.

norm.很好，敢作敢当才是我的好徒儿，为师马上传功与你。: Good, you acted responsibly for your own doings, I will now transmit to you.
norm.你小师妹跟我一起外出的，你当为师不知道吗？: Junior went out together with me, did you not know as a master?
norm.徒儿错了，是我干的: I was wrong, it was I who did it
norm.你怎么就知道吃。: Why would you not stop eating.
norm.怎么样，是不是感觉浑身灵气充盈。: Do you feel like filled with essence now.
norm.师侄行事还是如此仗义，师叔我实在佩服。: Your righteous doing has earned my respect.
norm.我会全力帮助母女: I will help the mother and daughter
norm.这个锦盒在灵宝阁也有售，没了就去那买吧。: This brocade box are being sold at the Treasure Chamber too, buy it there when runs out.
norm.宗门弟子需每隔一段时间去坊市采购日常物资。: Sect disciple require to purchase dairies at the market from time to time.
norm.在门派周围的山峰上布置法阵，互相呼应，防止外敌入侵。: Set up array on the peak of mountain around the guild, to prevent invader.
norm.引动灵泉之水，灌溉后山药田。: Guide the water of Spirit Fountain to water the Yam Field.
norm.在藏经阁里整理一些经年日久落满灰尘的书籍。: Sorting some old books in the scripture hall.
norm.去接待前来拜访的各门各派的道友，参观我宗门气象。: Go and welcome our visitors from other clan and faction to have a look at our sect.
norm.通过空间节点进入异界，探索并带回异界的信息。: Enter the other world through space node, explore and bring back information.
norm.运送灵果至后山灵兽山庄。: Transport the fruit to the village behind the mountain.
norm.带领门人弟子守护空间节点，抵御异界凶灵的侵袭。: Lead the disciple to guard the space node from the wraith of other world.
norm.清扫大殿前的落叶，是一项非常简易的门派任务。: Cleaning the fallen leaf in front of the hall is an easy guild quest.
norm.虫谷的瘴气即将爆发在即，师尊命你前往消除扩散的瘴气。: Miasma of the Worm Valley is bursting soon, master orders you to go and clear the miasma.
norm.前往其他宗门，获取有用情报，监视对方宗门动向。: Proceed to other sect in order to obtain useful information while monitor their movement.
norm.带领门人弟子前往神魔谷，铲除盘踞于此的妖魔鬼怪。: Lead the disciple to the Shaytan Valley and remove the devil there.
norm.代表门派下山历练，通过游历各地和增长见闻磨练自己的心志。: Go out to travel representing your guild and train yourself.
norm.门中灵兽稀少，急需一批新的灵兽补充。: Clan beast is running low, require a new batch of beast.
norm.藏书阁三长老需要一名弟子代为抄录典籍。: The 3rd elder of Book Store needs a disciple to copy books.
norm.将自己的成仙感悟传道于万物生灵，指点它们修行。: Spread your thoughts of ascension to other living being, helping them in their practice.
norm.在门派山门外进行巡逻，警惕一些外来人士进入。: Patrol the outside of the guild gate, prevent the invasion of outsider.
norm.为新入门的弟子讲解初级功法，指导他们进行修行。: Explain the primary technique to new disciple, helping them out in practice.
norm.照顾门派灵田，清理灵田内杂草。: Take care of the clan field, clean out the weeds.
norm.考核刚刚入门弟子的修为，了解一下他们的修炼境界。: Test the attainment of new disciple, and understand their state of practice.
norm.你刚来到深渊的底层，尚未有所行动，便有大批魔物向你围过来。: You just reached the bottom of the abyss, and a huge swarm of monster surrounds you.
norm.你一直走到洞窟尽头，正欲返回，身后突然传出了沉闷的呼吸声。: You've reached the end of the cave, just when you want to head back, a depressed breath came from behind.
norm.山脚下有一条小河，你在河畔发现一间草屋，呼喊了几声，无人应答。: There is a small river under the mountain, you found a shack beside the river, but no one seems to be around.
norm.你走到岔道尽头，发现一具修士遗骸躺在地上，看样子已死去多年。: You walked to the end of the road and found a practitioner skeleton on the ground.It seems that he has been dead for many years.
norm.莫名闯进了一座废弃的修士洞府。正准备探索，一个眼露杀机的修士拦住了去路。: Inexplicably broke into an abandoned practitioner abode.Being ready to explore, a practitioner stopped your way.
norm.前方一片区域遍布着蜘蛛网，你还看到了一些小蜘蛛在爬来爬去。: The area infront is filled with spider web, and some spiderlings crawling around.
norm.你从死去的邪修身上找到了一副地图，看起来是他存放宝物的秘密洞府。: You found a treasure map from the corpse of the evil practitioner, it seems like the map shows where he hid his treasure.
norm.击败了蒙面修士，你一路上到石塔的顶层，看到几个檀木盒子散落在地上。: Defeating the masked practitioner, you walked to the top of stone tower, and saw a few wooden boxes lying on the floor.
norm.你在一片空旷之地发现了几栋建筑废墟，思索着要不要探查一番。: You found a few building ruins in the plains, thinking if you want to explore it.
norm.你在密林间发现了血迹，追寻过去，看到一个受伤的修士正在疗伤。: You found blood track in the jungle, following it, you saw a wounded practitioner is healing himself.
norm.你看到远处树林里有一个被触发的陷阱，应该是山里的猎户布置的。: You saw a triggered trap in the forest, seems like a hunter from the mountain set it up.
norm.你在赶路时意外发现了一个灵物，灵物旁边有一个强大的妖兽在看守。: You found a spiritual being while on a hurry, and a strong devil beast is guarding the being.
norm.你听到附近传来了奇怪声响，循声望去，看到石壁上有条巨大的石缝。: You heard a weird sound coming from nearby, looking over, you saw a huge crack on the stone wall.
norm.你在一片密林之中看到一个水池，池中逸散出浓郁的灵气。: You saw a pool within the jungle that is filled with essence.
norm.你偶然发现了一个洞天福地，只可惜这里已经被妖兽占据了。: You found a cave paradise accidentally, too bad that it is occupied by devil beast.
norm.进门之后是个石室，里面布满了灰尘，似乎很久都没人来过了。: Within it is a stone room filled with dusts, seems like no one came here for a long time.
norm.你尾随一个气息诡异的修士，来到了座山神庙，里面有一股股魔气在涌动。: You stalked a mysterious practitioner to a temple that is filled with evil aura.
norm.你颇费了一番手段，才击败了栖居于此的妖兽，准备探查一番。: After a hard fight, you defeated the demon beast, and decide to explore the place.
norm.在一处僻静之地，你发现了一个深不见底的地穴，散发出阴冷的气息。: In a silent place, you found a hole with an endless depth, giving out a chilling sense.
norm.正思索的时候，旁边的树枝突然缠向你，树干之上浮现出一张人脸。: In your thoughts, the vine suddenly tangles you, and a human face appears from the tree trunk.
norm.进到山洞内，突然一股猩风从背后袭来，你险险躲过。一个不知名野兽进入视野。: After entering the cave, you felt a fierce wind from your back, and you dodged it.An unknown wild beast enters your sight.
norm.你发现了一个乱石堆，石堆中有灵气溢出，可能会有什么灵物。: You found a stone pile with flowing essence, something might be inside.
norm.你发现一颗数十人环抱的巨型灵木，其底部有一个树洞，似乎能通到树顶。: You found a enormous tree with a huge hole at it's roots, seems like it could lead to the top of the tree.
norm.你查阅了地图，发现附近有个小型坊市，过去看一下可能会有所收获。: You checked the map and discovered a small market, taking a look might give unexpected rewards.
norm.你正在追逐一只妖兽，突然周围景色大变，似乎是闯进了一个幻阵。: You were chasing a demon beast, suddenly the scenery changes, it seems like you've broke into a illusion array.
norm.山腰处耸立着一座破败的石塔，还没进入其中，一个蒙面修士便冲了出来。: A ruined stone tower is on the hill, just when you were going in, a masked practitioner rushed out from it.
norm.你追寻妖兽来到了一个破败的寺庙，却不想这里正站着一个相貌怪异的修士。: You followed the devil beast to a broken temple, and saw a weird looking practitioner standing there.
norm.当你找到了遗留的宝物时，同行修士却突然翻脸，威胁你交出宝物。: When you found the treasure, the other practitioner suddenly betrays you and threatens to gain possession of the treasure.
norm.刚下到坑底，就看到一群马蜂向你飞来，每一只都有拳头大小。: Once you've reached the end of the pit, you saw a bunch of hornet flying towards you, each at the size of a punch.
norm.你发现了一个黝黑的洞窟，里面有一丝丝血腥味散发出来。: You found a dark cave that emits a bloody scent.
norm.行走间，前方突然出现一个打扮怪异的修士，身上散发出邪恶的气息。: While you were walking, a weirdly dressed practitioner appeared in front of you, emitting an evil aura.
norm.前方出现了一片建筑废墟，还残留有少量阵法波动，似乎刚废弃不久。: A building ruin appeared in front, with some array wave still left in it, seems like it has just been abandoned.
norm.进入洞穴之后，发现里面的灵气非常浓郁，这种地方往往存在天地灵物。: After entering the cave, you could feel that the cave is filled with essence, only heavenly being lives in places like this.
norm.你在山谷里发现一个小型湖泊，湖泊中传出了婴儿哭泣般的声音。: You found a small lake within the valley, within it comes the crying voice of a baby.
norm.山顶处一个石亭里聚集着几个修士，他们邀请你参加他们的小型交易会。: Few practitioner gathered at the stone hut located at the top of the mountain, they invited you to join their small trading session.
norm.你路过一个修士洞府，考虑着要不要进去结识一番，交流下修炼心得。: You passed by a practitioner cave, wondering if you should go in to acquaint with the practitioner and have a talk about practicing.
norm.你沿着树洞向上攀爬，发现树顶处有一只丑陋的独眼巨鸟正目光不善地盯着你。: You climbed upwards following the hole, and found an ugly, one-eyed huge bird looking at you in a bad way.
norm.山腰处有一个妖兽的巢穴，里面散落着一些兽类残骸，还有些血迹。: There is a devil beast's cave on the hill, within it is some remains of other beasts and some blood track.
norm.翻过一个山坡，一片郁郁葱葱的竹林映入眼帘，似乎是人为种植的。: After walking over a hill, you saw a huge field of bamboo forest, seems to be artificially.

norm.进入到密林深处，你发现这里灵气充沛，非常适合修行。: After entering to the depth of the jungle, you feel that it is filled with essence, a place very suitable to practice.
norm.击败了守护妖兽之后，你终于进入了秘境，可以好好探索一番了。: After defeating the guardian beast, you can finally enter the realm and explore it.

norm.祸福无门，唯人自召。善恶之报，如影随形。: It's people who brought luck or misfortune by themselves.Karma is deeply attached.
norm.妖道成仙，天理难容，我辈当斩除妖孽，以儆天下。: It is intolerable for demon to become immortal.We slay the evildoer to admonish the world.
norm.想当年我御剑下山之时，黑衣如墨，长剑如雪，可惜白云苍狗间，百年光阴已过。: Back in the days when I went down the mountain so young and handsome.But the time has passed.
norm.妖徒妖法高明时#善玄功变化#身外化身#炼就三尸元神，你等下山修行时定要小心。: When the demon is powerful# the power change# the body incarnates# and 3-corpse is refined, you must be careful when you go down the mountain.
norm.结云朋霞友，物外同修。: Meet friends from all over the world, and practice together.
norm.这个世界早晚被仙家采伐一空。: The world will be cut by immortal family sooner or later.
norm.请留步，能否指点小弟几招？: Please stay, can you give some guidance?
norm.看什么看？再看我就让小白咬你。: What are you looking at? I'll make Xiao Bai bite you.
norm.上古时期，人族大修抱朴子曾言：得胎息者，能不以口鼻嘘吸，如在胞胎之中。: In the ancient times, Baopuzi once said：Those who managed fetal breathing is able to breath without using nose and mouth.
norm.记述了某位体修大能的淬体心得，据说其仅靠肉身就渡过了飞升天劫。: Training Notes recorded by capable practitioner, said to avoid doom with mere flesh.
norm.修仙者追求清心寡欲，不为外物所动，一心追求大道，如此方有可能感悟天道。: Practitioner has to pursue zero desire, not moved for any other things, so that it is possible to feel the heavens.
norm.据说是异界大能所著，讲述了通过空间节点穿梭各个位面的方法。: Said to be written by capable other-worldly being, that describes rite utilization in travel.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在筑基期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Base Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.修仙者应能压制欲望，恪守本心，方能不被外物侵扰，用心感悟天道。: Practitioners should hold down their urges, abide by their heart against temptations to be enlightened.
norm.道法无痕，不能强求，顺其自然，方能至真至善，寻得道法本源。: Allow nature to take its course back to its true and kind form to the origin of Tao.
norm.心魔侵袭时，应放弃肉身，坚守灵台清明，保持道心不乱，方能度过难关。: When the Inner Demon invades, you should give up the flesh, keep your soul clear and be calm in order to survive.
norm.明月几时有，把酒问青天。 不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年？: Question the divines of the moon with wine in hand.To disregard of time and the divines.
norm.白日何短短，百年苦易满。苍穹浩茫茫，万劫太极长。麻姑垂两鬓，一半已成霜。: Century goes by in a blink of an eye.Amidst of vast heaven, the extent of time is insufferable.Half adorned in silver, the hair of a long living nun.
norm.沧海桑田有时，海若未枯，愁应无已。: The transformations of the world, before the sea runs dry, the anxiety however dissipated.
norm.合欢宗的某位长老所著，记述了其关于双修的一些心得体会，在合欢宗备受推崇。: Written by an Acacia Sect elder, contains years experience from practicing, a book adored by many from its Sect.
norm.蓬莱是西海靠近大陆的一片群岛，物产丰富，也是人类在西海的唯一栖息地。: Penglai is an archipelago near the mainland in the West Sea.It is rich in resources, and also the only habitat for humans in the West Sea.
norm.鸿蒙祖师留下的修炼心得，被仙都的仙玉楼收藏，全书共四卷。: A practice note left by the Primordial Founder kept within Jade Tower, it has a total of 4 volumes.
norm.凡人皆有生死，然而修仙者却能吸纳天地灵气，修炼到一定境界后，可以与天地同寿。: Death will come to all mortals, but not practitioners, by harnessing Universal Essence to an extent where age is irrelevant.
norm.踏仙途，斩因果，从此凡间无此人。: Journey to Ascension, karma break, cease to exist among mortals.
norm.中土乃是人族修士数量最多的地区，修仙界赫赫有名的几大宗门都在这里。: Midland is where most practitioners gather, the place where the major sects reside.
norm.玉皇即昊天金阙无上至尊自然妙有弥罗至真玉皇，记录成皇大道。: The Jade Emperor is the utmost supreme, and the path is recorded,
norm.青山依旧在，几度夕阳红。白发渔樵江渚上，惯看秋月春风。: The land remains flourished, the dusk retains it's hue.Acclimated to the scene by the hermit of the shore.
norm.星辰无垠，星为何？星之上，亦为何？: What are the stars among the boundless sky? What is above the stars?
norm.前人汇总了诸多大能的修炼心得，收录为天地，全书共五卷。: A note summarized by many capable ancestors about heaven and earth, it has a total of 5 volumes.
norm.忽兴起，于旧时居所游历，感慨红尘万象，追忆前尘旧梦，略有所感。: Past moments flashes before eyes, reminiscent to it.
norm.对酒当歌，人生几何？譬如朝露，去日苦多。慨当以慷，忧思难忘。何以解忧，唯有杜康。: How long can we sing to wine while being alive? Time flies.An unforgettable sorrow ensues, in amidst of glee.To drink the wine is to clear off the anxiety.
norm.苍穹浩瀚，天为何？天之上，亦为何？: What is the limitless sky? What is above the sky?
norm.观沧海，感悟天地之大，自身之渺小，有所得。: The vastness of the sea, illuminates how minuscule life is.
norm.生死之数，何止亿万，修炼而得道，自当敬畏。: Perpetual cycle of life and death, illuminated practitioners are to be revered.
norm.天地之大，无边无际，变迁而永存，自当敬畏。: Boundless World, it's ever-changing but everlasting nature is to be revered.
norm.得即高歌失即休，多愁多恨亦悠悠。今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁。: Sing at will at given chance, embrace relief, deter both hate and bottomless anxiety.Today's wine will be finished today, tomorrow's worries only be left for tomorrow.
norm.白兔捣药秋复春，嫦娥孤栖与谁邻？今人不见古时月，今月曾经照古人。: When the spring comes, the white rabbit picks up the medicine there, and who is the neighbor in the moon palace? It is impossible for today to see ancient moon, and today's has shined the ancients.
norm.世事短如春梦，人情薄似秋云。不须计较苦劳心。万事原来有命。: In a flash the life goes by, bonds as thin as the air.Stress not upon hardships.For all things are destined as they should be.
norm.春宵一刻值千金，花有清香月有阴。歌管楼台声细细，秋千院落夜沉沉。: Spring night are worth a thousand dollars; as there is a fragrance of flowers, and moonlight.There was a sweet voice on the terrace.Looking at the swing frame of the courtyard late at night.
norm.日出东方隈，似从地底来。历天又入海，六龙所舍安在哉？: The Sun seemingly emerged from the ground as it rises from the East.As the day cycles yet again, where art thou, the Six Dragon Carriers of the Sun?
norm.朝阳不再盛，白日忽西幽。去此若俯仰，如何似九秋。人生若尘露，天道邈悠悠。: Gone by the glorious days, where dawn sky radiates in flame.Gone by the glorious days will the beauty of 9 Autumn ever reemerge.If life is so minuscule, how much must one endure in order to ascend.
norm.人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥。泥上偶然留指爪，鸿飞那复计东西。: Human life is like a swan's traces on mud snow.The claw is seen by chance on mud snow.The flying swan does not care what is left?
norm.世事一场大梦，人生几度秋凉？夜来风叶已鸣廊。看取眉头鬓上。: Life is like a dream.But how long will this dream last? The corridor is loud with wind-blown leaves at night.The brows frown and hair turn white!
norm.修士进阶大乘期时，需要将五行灵根合而为一，以追求元婴稳固，称为“五行归一”。: When the practitioner advanced to Mahayana period, they need to combine the five aptitude elements into one, in order to pursue the stability of Nascence, called "5-Element into 1".
norm.修士渡劫升仙时，要面临神魂衰弱、法力衰弱、肉身衰弱三大难关，称为“天人三衰”。: During ascend, the practitioner has to face 3 feeble trials of the soul, magic and flesh, named "The Feeble Three"
norm.凡事皆有因果，通过推衍之术，可预知未来之事。然而其准确性尚有待验证。: Everything has its cause and effect.Through the technique of derivation, we can predict the future.However, its accuracy has yet to be verified.
norm.修仙之途漫长而艰辛，本书论述的就是如何在修仙大道上寻求机缘。: The journey of cultivation is long and arduous.This book discusses how to seek opportunities on the Road of Practice.
norm.修炼之道分为法体两脉，法修重法术，体修重肉身。但有极少数修士选择法体兼修。: There are two practice paths, the one that emphasizes Magic while the other on flesh.Only a handful can hone both to perfection.
norm.剑修的所有追求全在一把本名飞剑上，而如何凝练剑元就成了剑修最关心的事情。: The famed sword that bears all essences of discipline, it's mastery is a common topic among swordsman.
norm.神识是修士感知外界的最重要手段，此书讲述的就是对神识的各种妙用。: Deity conscience is an important milestone for practitioners to sense the outer world, this book is all about it.
norm.吐纳之法虽然是非常基本的知识，但其中也包含不少诀窍，并非简单的吸纳灵气。: Although the Breathing Skill is a basic knowledge, there are many other tips and tricks to it, it's not that simple.
norm.引气入体是修炼的第一步，能够做到这一点，才能算是真正的修仙者。: The introduction of qi into the body is the first step to be a practitioner.
norm.古往今来，不知多少修士在天劫之下道消身陨，参悟这本渡劫心得或许能有所收获。: Throughout the ages, there are many practitioners that have lost their lives while ascending.It is possible to gain some insight by reading this book.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在大乘期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Mahayana Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在炼虚期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Vainify Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在合体期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Embodiment Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在分神期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Severance recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在元婴期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Nascence Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在金丹期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Formation Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.记述了前辈高人们在炼气期的修炼心得，其它境界的修士读了也能有所收获。: Aerify Notes recorded by capable ancestors, beneficial for all practitioner readers.
norm.诸生于道已得，执着人我即非，务要放下身心，乃能冲开龙虎。: To devote oneself into attainment, one must let go in order to progress.
norm.上古遗迹偶得之法，载：道生法。法者，引得失以繩，而明曲直者也。: Law obtained from Ancient Relic.Record：Daosheng Law.Various laws have been produced.The law determines the success or failure of things.
norm.兹敬读纯阳祖师心经，实与大士般若波罗密多心经。互相表里。然诸法空相。不生不灭。妙: The Puresun Sutra is the same as the Heart Sutra.Look at each other.However, the laws are empty.Indestructible Endless possibilities.
norm.论述长生久视之道，为了修炼得法，把人体分为上中下三部，每部有八景神镇守，合称二十: Describes the teachings of longevity, separating the flesh into 3 parts with 8 divisions each from top to bottom, named the 24 Conscience.
norm.西方极乐之西，有不周神山，自上古以来，修真得道之人，无不从此飞升。: The West Rapture, since the ancient times those who achieve attainment will always ascend from it.
norm.记述了幽冥界的一些信息，但是其中的小部分内容还有待考究。: Described some information about the Nether World, but a small part of it remains to be studied.
norm.记述了中州修仙界的发展历程，包括各大宗门的兴衰史。: Contains histories of heaven along with each Sect's glorious and cowardly days.
norm.南荒百万大山中居住着数不尽的异族，他们对人族来讲非常神秘。: There are countless interracial living in the South Mountain, and they are very mysterious to the Terran.
norm.灵族是仅存于北域之地的几个特殊种族的统称，其外貌和修炼方式颇为奇特。: The Spirits, a general address of a few special races from the North, their training are quite peculiar so does their appearances.
norm.蜀山剑宗乃是和昆仑仙宗齐名的超级宗门，正是建在这蜀山之巅。: Shushan Sect is famed eye to eye with Kunlun Sect, built at the peak of Shushan.
norm.琼华谷是一个游离不定的须弥空间，里面产出一些外界难得一见的天地灵物。: Qionghua Valley is a drifting sacred space, which produces some rare creatures.
norm.昆仑山是超级宗门“昆仑仙宗“的山门所在，在整个修仙界都负有盛名。: Mt.Kunlun is where the famed "Kunlun Sect", well known across the heaven.
norm.天南处在中土的东南方，修炼资源较为贫瘠，故而在修仙界不是很出名。: Tiannan is located in the southeast of China, with relatively poor practice resources.Therefore, it is not very famous in the cultivation immortal world.
norm.东荒是东海之上所有群岛的统称，虽说是群岛，但加在一起堪比一小块大陆。: The Wasteland is a general term for all the islands by the West Sea, their total size however can be viewed as a small continent.
norm.南域百万大山是各个异族的居住地，这些蛮荒异族的修炼方式和人族迥然不同。: The Mt.Millions by the South is the place where non-natives live, their training method differs from other mortals.
norm.西极海是妖兽的天下，海里的妖兽有亿万种，人类修士很少涉足，故而所知甚少。: The West sea is the domain of demon beasts, rarely explored therefore little knowledge of it.
norm.北域之地濒临幽冥海，气候严寒，常年被冰雪覆盖，适合水灵根修士修行。: The northern land is close to the Nether Land with extremely cold climate.It is covered with snow and ice all year round.It is suitable for Water Aptitude practitioner.
norm.大道三千，每个人都有自己心中的道，关键是如何让自己的道为天地所认同。: Everyone has their own interpretation of enlightenment, the key however is to convince the world of the path you've chosen.
norm.修士施展法术时，应带动天地元气，融于其中，使法术的威力更加强大。: When the practitioner casts a spell, he should bring the power of heaven and earth into it, making the spell more powerful.
norm.修真有四大要素：财、侣、法、地。缺少任何一项，修真之路就不会走的长远。: 4 Points for Practices：Wealth, Partner, Law, Place.Lack any one of them, the path of practice will fall short.
norm.上古时期的修仙界和现在大为不同，某种巨大的变故形成了现今的修炼体系。: The ancient immortal world is very different from the present, and some great changes have formed the current cultivation system.
norm.天地之间共有五种气，仙气、魔气、灵气、阳气、阴气，每种气都有不同的用途。: There are five kinds of aura that serve different purpose, which includes Deity aura, Demon Aura, Essence, Yang and Yin.
norm.生灵死后，其魂魄会进入轮回，在另一个生灵身上转世重生，甚至能保留前世的部分记忆。: The Samsara of rebirth continues upon death onto a new body, even retain part of previous life's memory.
norm.世间万物皆有阴阳之分，男子为阳，女子为阴，阴阳结合，才符合天道。: All matters are divided into Yin and Yang, man as Yang, women as Yin, to fuse both Yin and Yang together, that is the way of god.
norm.修仙者要入世修心，感受人间百态，方能破除心魔，突破瓶颈。: Practitioner will enter the mortal world to cultivate the heart, to feel the human aspects, so to breakthrough the inner demon and bottleneck.
norm.修仙者要避世清修，感悟天道之理，方能升华道心，求得正果。: Practitioners must avoid all contacts to embody the course of nature
norm.在某些特殊情况下，修仙者会进入顿悟状态，领悟力明显提升，这种事可遇不可求。: In some special cases, the practitioner will enter an enlightenment state where comprehension will be significantly improved.This is rare.
norm.修仙者若是杀戮过多，自身便会产生煞气，煞气会影响心智，使人嗜杀成性。: If the practitioner killed too much, Kill Intent will be created that will affect the mind and make people love killing.
norm.体质之说自古便有，有人认为是天道孕育，有人认为是肉身异变而生。: The theory of physique has existed since ancient times.Some people think that it is nurtured, and some people think that it is a physical change.
norm.灵气分五行，灵根亦有五行之分，灵气和灵根之间想必有着某种联系。: Both Essence and Aptitude has 5 elements.Hence, there must be some connection between the two.
norm.传说中除了人界之外，还有仙界和魔界，有人甚至见过仙界的仙人和魔界的魔尊。: The legend says that besides the Mortal Realm, there are Heaven and Devildom, some even affirmed deities and devils' existence.
norm.善有善报，恶有恶报，不是不报，时候未到。这句话在修仙界也是有道理的。: What goes around comes around.Makes sense In the context of Immortalisation.
norm.煞气由杀戮而生，会影响心智。但有修士另辟蹊径，想出了将煞气炼化为己用的方法。: The kill intent is born from act of slaughter, it affects the mind.However, there are fraters who took an alternate route and came up with a way to refine the Kill Intent into their own use.
norm.其讲述人体内丹修炼整个过程，而详于大周天之工，即炼炁化神一节，直至阳神出壳为止: It tells the whole process of Elixir cultivation in the body.The work is detailed from the alteration until it extricated.
norm.传说中，天地初生是一片混沌，后来清气上升浊气下降，方才形成如今的一方天地。: Legend says that it was a chaos when it first begin.Later, when the clear air increases, made this world.
norm.万物静观皆自得，四时佳兴与人同。道通天地有形外，思入风云变态中。: Everything is self-satisfied, people are interested in the beauty of the scenery all year round.The truth is through all the seen and unseen, and the thoughts permeate in the changing circumstances.
norm.修仙者若是做了有违本心之事，便会滋生心魔，修炼时容易走火入魔。: If the practitioner does something that is contrary to his heart, it will breed inner demons, and it will be easy to get demonized.
norm.世人皆知有灵根者方可修行，但却没人知道灵根从何而来，因何而生。: Everyone knows that people with spiritual root can practice, but no one knows where the roots come from and how.
norm.中古以上，人各完神，运无或蹇，道无或晦也。直指天仙大道之法。: Before the Middle Ages, people are all sacred, with no difference.Direct at the Heaven Deity path skill.
norm.但凡修士，皆有心魔。平时修炼难以见其危害，可一旦要突破境界，心魔就是最大的难关。: Inner demon always dwells within every practitioner.A seamless force during practice, but a formidable foe during breakthrough.
norm.凡事皆有因果，只可顺其而行，不可妄自忤逆。如此，方为天地所容。: Everything has its cause and effect.You can only follow and not against.In this way, it is acceptable by the world.
norm.记述了肉身修炼心得，曾有修士不依靠法力，仅靠肉身就渡过了飞升天劫。: Describe the experience of physical cultivation.There was once a monk ascend by using only mortal body.
norm.阅桑田，感悟时间宝贵，事物之变迁，有所悟。: After field learning I feel that time is precious and things changes.
norm.曾有道侣反目成仇，经历了艰难坎坷，终摒弃前嫌，双双成就大道。: There was once a couple who turned against each other and experienced various hardships.In the end, they disregard previous enmity and made great achievement.
norm.记述了太虚真人飞升仙界的经验，他也是近万年来唯一一个飞升仙界的修士。: Journal of Taixu the ascended, the only Practitioner who had ascend into heaven in ten thousand years.
norm.入仙门，断尘缘，从此不恋凡世间。: Enter immortalization, cut of everything and forget the mortal world.
norm.苍峦山乃是火云尊者飞升之前的隐居之所，无数人慕名而来，希望能寻得机缘。: Mt.Cangwu is where the Fire Cloud Elder lives before the ascend.Many people are attracted to visit and hope to find opportunities.
norm.上清道汲取道家真谛，万法自然，可用自身能力构造出一片太极紫府，修行道心。: The Plain Path absorbed true meaning of Taoism.You can use your own ability to create a Taiji Mansion from the nature and practice the Taoist heart.

3、If the camp is defended by enemy players or guardian, <color=#9e4444>Repel</color> them first to capture the Array Crux.

5、If being defeated by enemy player during the capture duration, you will <color=#9e4444>automatically be sent out</color> from the Array Crux location, requiring a recapture.
6、Defend and Break quests <color=#9e4444>shares the same count</color> , simply choose one to complete.
7、Supply truck refreshes every hour daily, rob the truck on <color=#9e4444>12:00, 20:00</color> for double rewards. <color=#9e4444>Destroy the supply truck</color> before it reaches it's destination to complete intercept quest.
8、Quest chances resets on <color=#9e4444>00:00</color> of the next day, please beware.

norm.\\t8岁，在一次捉迷藏时，由我来当鬼，花了半个小时我成功捉到了除了王小二之外的: \tWhen I was 8 years old, in a hide-and-seek game, I was the "it".It took me half an hour to catch all my friends except Wang Xiaoer.It happened that they didn't remember Wang Xiaoer also participated in the game. I purposely went ahead and declared myself victorious, and everyone went home.
