norm.\\t哎呀我的阎王大人呐，鬼差大老爷们呀，奴才可没做过什么恶事，一世骂名实在是冤: \tOh, my Lord Yama, the ghosts, I have done nothing evil, I have been cursed for a lifetime.\nWe were born in a peasant household and entered the palace as a eunuch at the age of 9.We served our masters in the palace with great diligence and did not dare to overstep the mark.When we entered the palace together with our fellow villagers, they were so uncaring that they offended their masters and had their heads cut off with a knife.Since then, we have always been mindful of our status, so how could we possibly be arrogant and bullying, as they say.
norm.\\t步入中年的我，放弃了挣扎，选择了堕落，每日跟些狐朋狗友去喝酒，喝完酒要么躺: \tInto the middle of my life, gave up the struggle, chose to degenerate, daily with some evil friends to drink, drink the wine or lie in the street, or because of the trivial fight with people and by the prison disaster.
norm.\\t步入中年的我经历了黑发人送白发人，慢慢的我已经习惯了一个人生活，不想与人沟: \tInto the middle of my life, I have experienced the experience of black hair to white hair, slowly I have been accustomed to a personal life, do not want to communicate with others, do not want to help others, even if I was bullied I also indifferent.
norm.\\t步入中年的我依然是一个小县官，不甘同流合污的我主要是不想背叛我的良心，因此: \tInto middle age, I am still a small county official, not willing to be complicit in the main I do not want to betray my conscience, so I am still very high in the prestige of the local people.
norm.\\t承蒙隆恩，边陲犯乱之际得承重任，然戍边之军良莠不齐，目光所余尽是烙身戴罪之: \tBy the grace of the border, when the border is in trouble, we have to take on the responsibility, but the strength and strength of the garrison troops are mixed.All we can see are the criminals, who will disobey us and make the art of war difficult.As a result, when the enemy comes, we will be defeated and captured, and become delirious in prison for more than twenty years.
norm.\\t垂暮之年，形销立骨，岁月之摧犹胜刀创，荏苒数十载已是附杖难立之人，再临天恩: \tIn old age, the shape of pin stand bone, years of destruction like a sword, elapses for several decades has been attached to the staff difficult to stand, and then come to the day, was difficult to stand on the hall, pickled doting, difficult speech, decadent state yi smile huang Purple gongqing.
norm.\\t待奴家身段稍长，举手投足尽是婀娜姿态，又因姿容秀绝，善工诗画，于附庸风雅之: \tTreat the slave a little longer, every gesture is graceful posture, and because of the beautiful, good poetry and painting, under the adulation of the arty people, the empty bear qing name, and after the admiration of everyone, will be chest full of gifts, to be able to be in the time of youth, yan pressure qunfang, name dynamic Beijing hua.
norm.\\t到了青年的我，已经是孤身一人了，为了生存下来，我选择进入别人的府中当个杂役: \tBy the time I was a young man, I was already alone.In order to survive, I chose to enter someone else's house as a handyman.That family sold cloth, and for selfish reasons, I would steal a few sets from the finished product each time and sell them on the black market at a profit, and the profit was shared equally with the steward of the house.I could not stand the interrogation by the court and chose to bite my tongue, but in the end I did not confess that my accomplice was the butler.
norm.\\t到了青年时期，边疆战乱不断，朝廷选择了招兵买马，而我也因为自己的吃住选择加: \tBy the time I was a young man, the frontier was in constant war and the court chose to recruit soldiers, and I chose to join the army because I was fed and housed.I spent the following days in the army for a while before I was pulled off to the frontier to go to war, and later became a deserter in one of the battles, and was lucky enough to escape the search and settle down in a nearby village.
norm.\\t到了青年时期，我渐渐的自闭了起来，不喜欢与人交流，也不喜欢进行互动，慢慢的: \tWhen I was young, I gradually became self-absorbed.I didn't like to communicate and interact with people, which gradually led me to become more and more indifferent and ignorant of the world. Once, a man in need lay in front of my house and begged me to open the door to help him, but in the end I ignored him.
norm.\\t到了这个年龄的我，暮暮老矣，经常意识不清，常常认错人，就如我会认为邻居家的: \tAt this age, I am old, often unconscious, often mistake people, such as I will think the neighbor's child is mine, I will teach him assiduously when I meet him, I will apologize for him when I see him and passers-by quarrel.
norm.\\t到了中年的我，为自己碌碌无为的一生感觉到气愤，恨天道不公，恨世事无常，愤怒: \tAt middle age, I felt angry, hated the unfair way of the world, and hated the impermanence of the world.Anger took over my eyes, and I wanted to revenge all the haters, no matter whether they were good or bad, and whatever purpose they were in, but I also followed my idea and took revenge on all the things that I did not like.
norm.\\t到了中年时期，我犯了人生中最大的错误，我因为赌博成瘾，抵押了家产，出卖了家: \tIn middle age, I made the biggest mistake of my life, because of gambling addiction, I mortgaged my family, sold my family, and ended up penniless.
norm.\\t到了中年时期，因为过度的劳作，导致身体慢慢不行，领居家的孩子偶尔会往我家中: \tIn middle age, due to excessive work, my body gradually deteriorated, so my neighbor's children would occasionally throw vegetable leaves and stones at my home, but I did not choose to blame him.On the contrary, when I met him again, I often talked with him and taught him on behalf of my neighbors.
norm.\\t度过了青年时期的我，生活上也净是不如意，没有温饱的饭，没有温热的水，当我吃: \tAfter my youth, my life was not satisfactory.There was neither enough food nor warm water.When I was hungry, I would steal food from shops, and when I was thirsty, I would drink river water.
norm.\\t度过了中年时期的我，身体依旧硬朗，所以我便如往常一样工作，直到生病前的那一: \tPast the middle age, I was still strong, so I went to work as usual, until the moment before I fell ill, I did not know that my health had gone.It wasn't long before I was here reporting.
norm.\\t度过青年，我也算是越来越老了，身体素质也大不如前。不知何时，早上咳嗽会咳出: \tAs I spent my youth, I was getting older and my physical fitness was not as good as before. I didn't know when I started to cough up blood in the morning, and I went to see a doctor, who just shook his head and left.I knew that my end was approaching, so I became even more arrogant.I started to beat other people, and I would complain over small things.Arguing non-stop, using my seniority to look down and find faults in others.
norm.\\t父亲是个好吃懒做的人，在他的影响下，从小我便拥有着不劳而获的想法，别人家的: \tMy father was a lazy man, and under his influence, I grew up with the idea of getting something for nothing.Children in other families would have been working in the fields at my age, and I would not help the family with anything, and I often stole crops from the neighbour's fields.
norm.\\t行至耄耋之岁，沐恩时殊，腐老枯朽之躯遍历刀斧之创，行廊过阁不能自持，每日例: \tLine to the age of 90, mu when the special, the body of the old and withered through the creation of the knife axe, the corridor over the pavilion can not hold, daily routine take medicine, bitter, thinking about the past, although life ups and downs, but also enough to cup sick, liao comfort life.
norm.\\t后来有幸得到太后老佛爷恩宠，坐到了首领大太监的位置，但咱家时刻提醒自己谨记: \tLater fortunate to get the grace of the empress Lafayette, sitting in the position of the leader of the eunuch, but we always remind themselves to remember the ancestors of the emperor "eunuch can not regent" ban.Find our home to spend money to buy the future have been rebuffed one by one, and then the reform party and the old school in the court partisans, often someone to take sides, we never answer, that bewitched the government, really wronged our house ah, qingtianhainking the old man.
norm.\\t及日年岁稍长，根骨渐开，家母良训持家，聆其苦语终是一展心中郁结，我束发及冠: \tI have been a little older and my roots are opening up, my mother has been a good disciplinarian, and I have listened to her bitter words to finally show my heart.
norm.\\t及日娉婷而立，依托清婉之名，登楼恩客日趋见长，未曾想某日，生身父母竟来此以: \tI was not expecting that one day, my biological parents would come here and invite me to sell the deed on the grounds that there was no evidence, so I ordered someone to beat me out, but this was against filial piety, and for a while, the Confucian scholars all said that beauty was ungrateful.So be it.
norm.\\t及至韶华，成大家之美，昔时恩客屡次登楼，欲纳奴家为妾，奴家知其出身高贵，遂: \tAt that time, into the beauty of everyone, in the past boon guest often climb the floor, to nanau house as a concubine, nu home know its noble birth, then said this body is difficult to be a lover, boon guest leaning on the column lamentation, long square way, may the afterlife negative jiangshan not beauty, nu home smile allow it, with the jinhairpin gift, through this closed floor xie guest, never meet.
norm.\\t即便是步入了青年时期，家里人仍然没有放松对我的要求，还是掌控着我，不能有自: \tEven step into the youth, the family still did not relax on my request, or control, I can't have their own ideas, locked me in the yard every day, can only see the courts flowers and eaves, I feel that my freedom is restricted, I finally made a decision to free yearning, secretly run away in the middle of the night, but, unfortunately, because I stole go out at night, My guard knew but did not report it, and was finally punished by my father.Even though I begged for mercy, my father's anger could not disappear, so he lost his life.I blame it on me.
norm.\\t即入轮回，所思五味万般苦，年幼蒙学，敏而好思，自认天资不负魏曹之流，我虽年: \tImmediately into the reincarnation, thinking all kinds of bitter, young educated, sensitive and thoughtful, I think the talent is not worthy of the wei Cao stream, although I am young, BUT also know everything about the family and the country, the heart of the myriad ambitions, only hate can not grow day by day, do the best, but the fate of the lack of life, I finally met the difficult sleep of the people.
norm.\\t渐渐地，我脱离了年少的阶段，伴随的是悲剧也降临在了我头上，而我也是一个暴躁: \tGradually, I broke away from the young stage, accompanied by tragedy also fell on my head, and I am also a irritable person, often to provoke fights, but I just want to simply vent, never dare to hurt life.
norm.\\t军中纪法严苛，令行禁止，我当值壮年，所求不过鱼水之欢却也因此犯了军中大忌，: \tThe military discipline was strict, and rules were enforced seriously.But I was in my prime, I wanted nothing but to taste the pleasures of intimacy, though it was a huge military taboo.The commander was furious, and put me through one-thousand-cuts execution, peeling off my skin and pulling out my tendons, to make an example for others.
norm.\\t老夫一生以权谋入仕，不曾以清廉自居，宏图大展，伟绩丰功，死而无憾，如今得死: \tAll my life, I have been in the government with power and strategy, but I have never thought of myself as a clean person, with great ambitions and great achievements, I have no regrets in dying.\nThat's all I have to say.I'll leave it to the King of Hell to make his own decision.
norm.\\t老夫以权谋之术平步青云，时值佞臣杨凡如日中天，朝野上下只有老夫能应对之，所: \tWhen the sycophant Yang Fan was in the ascendant, I was the only one who could deal with him, so that the government could carry out its orders and select talents.Later, I spent ten years in seclusion, defeated the sycophants, and settled all the unjust cases, recruiting the survivors and giving mercy to the dead.I also reduced taxes, cleaned up the salt merchants, and even abolished the useless expenses of the Emperor's envelope of Taoism.
norm.\\t年岁渐起，风姿更甚，有诗赞称，起袖揽天惊风舞，一曲霓裳天下知，然时局动荡，: \tYears gradually, the charm is even more, there are poems praise, sleeve up to the sky surprise wind dance, a song neon skirt world know, but The Times are turbulent, home country only stay one night and die, and the slave house small building also flowers fall, no longer noisy in the past.To be one day, the guest face blood stains, led the masses to the floor, to nu home a dance for full three days of peace, zai, thousands of miles of rivers and mountains, a hundred years of the country was actually a woman nu home.
norm.\\t年岁渐长，惜值动荒之年，家逢重变，兵荒马乱之际无奈落草，我自知愧对父老，遂: \tAs I grew older, I had no choice but to fall to the grass at the time of war and chaos.I knew I was ashamed of my father, so I changed my name to a new one, and I was brave and brave when I fell to the ground.However, the act of raiding was against the good way, and the flow of coarse grass was also difficult to enter the hall, so I cut off the head of the thief, took the capital and led the army.
norm.\\t奴家凄然应允，独登高处，于万千锋簇前起舞而唱，生来无亲无爱，及死当三葬，一: \tI was born without family or love, and when I die, I will be buried three times.First, I will be buried without love and tears, second, I will be buried without righteousness and separation, and third, I will be buried with the grace of beauty.
norm.\\t奴家少时家贫，因是女儿身，被父母易子售卖，后又几经辗转，才因长相伶俐被红袖: \tI was sold by my parents because I was a daughter, and after a few changes, I was bought by the Red Sleeve House because of my good looks.
norm.\\t青年的我，变得傲慢了起来，并且愈加的严重，我开始看不起家中下人，看不起其他: \tAs a young man, I became arrogant and became more serious.I began to look down on my family, on other people my age, on people who had fallen on hard times, and felt that they deserved it, and that I did not care about those I despised.Even if I had extra money or food, I would have my servants chase away anyone who got in my way.
norm.\\t青年时期，我帮着父母农作，照顾庄稼，从耕地，播种一直到收获果子，我都可以一: \tWhen I was young, I helped my parents with farming and took care of the crops.From ploughing, sowing to harvesting fruit, I could finish independently.I felt happy about my efforts, because it was my honor to help my parents in my cognition.Poor me, I had very few playmates in my youth, not even a peer to talk to.
norm.\\t青年时期，我游手好闲，没事就上大街溜达，见过很多人，很多事情，有为了保护他: \tWhen I was young, I was idle and would walk on the street.I saw a lot of people and things, including those who let themselves have bad luck in order to protect others, and those who bullied others in order to live.I didn't want to go along with them, but I didn't know exactly what I should do in a day.For me at that time, I did not have to rush about for the family, nor did I have to choose to join in the dirty work in order to fill my stomach.The happiest thing was to secretly throw rotten vegetable leaves to aunts and uncles whom I did not like, and tease the little sister next door.
norm.\\t青年时期的我，渐渐没有了年幼时的幼稚，受到家里的影响，我更加喜欢去私塾读书: \tWhen I was young, I gradually lost the naivety of my youth.Influenced by my family, I enjoyed going to private schools even more, and even when I met beggars on the road, I was willing to give some money.
norm.\\t青年时期的我加入了当地最大的帮派当中，平常我们会暗地里收取保护费，但不进行: \tAs a young man, I joined one of the largest gangs in the area.Normally, we would secretly collect protection money, but not carry out the duty of protection.One day our gang went to war with another gang in the city, and I was unfortunately killed.
norm.\\t青年时期遇到洪涝灾害，在官府的号召下，我成为了一名救助员。而在一次救助当中: \tWhen I was young, I became a relief worker at the call of the government.And in the midst of one of the rescues, I unfortunately lost my life.
norm.\\t然则某日，那勾栏贱婢竟与她的姘夫合谋杀害我父，家母闻讯竟涕泪过度，心衰而亡: \tBut one day, the bitch conspired with her concubine to kill my father, and my mother died of heart failure.
norm.\\t然则却是无法亦无路，命途诡谲难以为继，年岁渐长，往事积郁更甚，终有一日，父: \tOne day, my father died of illness and my family was on the wane.For a time, all around me were petty and harsh words.I could not bear it, so I hung up my bag and went to join the army under a different name.
norm.\\t少时懵懂，自奴家记事起，就已身处莺袖燕舞之所，终日所闻不过媚笑揽客之言。及: \tWhen I was young and ignorant, as long as I can remember, I was already in a place of dancing and laughing, and all I heard all day long was the words of smiling and soliciting customers.When I was a young girl, I didn't know what the commandments of women and internal training were, but even though I had a shallow knowledge of human nature and didn't understand the writings of the sages, I was pure-hearted and good-hearted.
norm.\\t十年边州，老夫想通了很多，在朝为官，污浊之徒甚众于清流之士，想实现自己的抱: \tfter ten years in the border state, I have learnt a lot.In the government, there are more dirty people than clean people, so if you want to realise your ambition, how can you get out of the mud? A simple decree, from the central government to the local government, requires hundreds of officials, large and small, and how many of them are clean? If I hadn't cultivated myself to be even more treacherous than this treacherous official, I'm afraid I'd still be over there in the state, sighing in disbelief.
norm.\\t时年及笄，虽身段媃稚，然秀媚内敛，吐气若兰，惜是束阁之身，所行皆不能如愿，: \tI was at the age of maturity, but although I was a young girl, I was a beautiful girl, and my breath was like an orchid.
norm.\\t时日渐长，名声愈显，王公贵族，风流雅士...成入幕之宾者皆非泛泛之辈，然欲: \tAs time went by, the reputation of the house became more and more obvious, and the princes and nobles, the elegant people...The people who have become guests of the curtain are not ordinary people, but there are many people who want to enter the building, so they set up three not to see, talent, blacksmith, fame without one, one day, the slave spontaneously recite poetry, murmuring, a person to enter the building with the flowers and water, the gentleman smiled and asked, can again and again no longer three, the slave gladly answered, so do not ask his name.
norm.\\t世道坚阻，边陲犯险，从军之身难抵状令，然将军之帅无才无德，其手下营私者，献: \tThe people's grievances are boiling over and the people are suffering, and the frontier is eventually lost to the righteous.I have also been in prison for more than 20 years because of this.
norm.\\t戍边动荡，然朝堂之上雄才大略，军中上下万众一心，将行下效，功赏过罚，我从军: \tThe garrison was in turmoil, but the court was eloquent, the army was united, the generals did what they were told, merit was rewarded and demerit was punished, I had been in the army for more than twenty years, and the emperor was gracious enough to promote the order to whip the horse and give it to the commander, so I was able to press the desert for a million miles with the division of the mighty emperor.
norm.\\t虽然当时我的年龄已经到达了青年时期，但是我还是很幼稚，想象着自己是帮派老大: \tAlthough I had reached the age of youth at that time, I was still very naive, imagining myself as a gang leader, pulling a bunch of minions, having nothing to do with people fighting and grabbing territory.But if I encountered a tough fight, I would slip away, and even if I did get caught, it would just be a matter of a beating, but if I didn't encounter a tough fight, it would be a bumper day for me and my minions.
norm.\\t随着年龄的增大，我愈发的成熟独立起来，不管是别人异样的目光还是其他的事情，: \tAs I got older, I became more and more mature and independent, whether it was the strange looks of others or other things, I wouldn't just complain about God, because I knew that my own strength was the real strength.
norm.\\t随着我慢慢脱离孩童时代，步入青年时代，我也是愈加的懒惰起来，每天只想躺在床: \tAs I slowly left my childhood and entered my youth, I became more and more lazy, wanting to lie in bed every day instead of thinking about doing anything, just wanting to sleep well at home.I knew I was guilty of laziness, but I thought it was a good life and I didn't want to change it.
norm.\\t踏入青年时期的我，不慎染上了博戏的恶习，天天拿着自己的工钱去博戏，虽然输多: \tInto the youth, I accidentally contracted the bad habit of bo opera, every day with their own wages to bo opera, although lose more win less, but also firmly believe that they will be able to win, so as to gain recognition soar.I know it's not a good habit to like the opera, but I was deeply impressed by the saying in my neighborhood that "children don't need to know how to write.
norm.\\t听我娘说生我时是小产，幸得上天眷顾，母子平安。不幸的是我身子骨一直很弱，大: \tI heard my mother say that I was born in miscarriage, but fortunately, God was kind enough to let my mother and child live.Unfortunately, my health was always weak, and I was constantly suffering from major and minor illnesses, so I went to various doctors, but all I could do was sigh, shake my head and keep my mouth shut.It was not until I went to a local Taoist temple that an old man with an immortal spirit nodded at my forehead and my body slowly healed.Then later I overheard my mother talking to my father and vaguely heard some kind of demon...possession and other words.
norm.\\t脱离了孩童时代的我，无论做什么事情都让我感觉不到快乐，与此同时感觉到无论干: \tOut of my childhood, NO matter what I do, I can not feel happy, at the same time, I feel that whatever I do will be targeted, always do the wrong thing.The irascible me will provoke arguments and even fistfights when I disagree with the person next to me.So I had the most fights with people during this period.
norm.\\t我出身于勾栏梯榻之间，童蒙未启之时就已沦为贱籍，身份卑贫，食残羹，沥泔水，: \tI was born between the hook and ladder couch, when the children were not yet enlightened has been reduced to a lowly family, the status of humble poverty, eat scraps, drain slop, daily dust, spit face to accompany the smile, do not dare to have the slightest idea of overstepping the rules, but the evil maid bullying, tired of the pain of the skin is really to hard to tie, is why the day panic to escape, cold rain miserable when finally got an old man to save, thinking about the past tears and tears, so we call each other father and son.
norm.\\t我出生在一个普通平凡的家庭，经不起大风大浪。在有次我跟朋友出去游玩的时候，: \tI was born in an ordinary family and could not afford to go through a big storm.On one occasion when I was out with a friend, I came across a mysterious cave entrance and we chose to go in and explore it.We relied on the light from our torches to keep our faith alive, and we slowly explored forward.I went home and hid under the covers for a long, long time, and in the evening my friend's family came and asked me if I had seen their child, and I shook my head hurriedly, and to this day, he has not been found.
norm.\\t我从记事开始，右手便没有知觉，我也不知是天生残废还是小时候发生过意外让我失: \tI have had no feeling in my right hand since I can remember, and I don't know if I was born crippled or had an accident as a child that made me lose certain key parts of my memory, and then I coincidentally met a miracle doctor who cured my hand, but my family also became more impoverished because of the expenses of this visit to the doctor, and I was determined to make a good life for my family when I regained my life.
norm.\\t我从小体质就很差，不能肆意的跟朋友奔跑与玩耍，每日待在家中望着窗外，那便是: \tI grew up with poor health and was not allowed to run and play with my friends, so I spent my childhood at home looking out of the window.That day, as usual, my parents were not at home, so I chose to sneak out by mistake.There was a calligraphy convention in the street, which was a shock to me as I had just opened the door to the outside world, and I couldn't resist walking towards the crowd, but unfortunately I was stopped by the doorman.But it was also my chance to meet a valuable person who saw my talent and said he could take me on as a disciple and help me heal my body, which I agreed to do.Later on, I became stronger and stronger, and my family's life became better and better.
norm.\\t我的父亲是千万落榜书生中的一员，因此我从小就被给予很高的期望，但家境不好的: \tMy father was one of the millions of students who failed in school, so I was raised with high expectations, but I had to study hard at home because my family was not well off.Gradually during my studies I learnt that studying was not for me and that I had to put in more effort than my peers, even so I struggled to persevere for the sake of my father's dream.Eventually I lost my thoughts in an exam and fainted from anger for three whole days and nights.My father let go of his obsession when he knew how much I had given.
norm.\\t我父亲为经商大亨，而我又是家中最小的，父亲母亲打小就疼爱我，我从小便是锦衣: \tMy father was a business tycoon and I was spoilt for choice, so I developed a domineering personality.When my family fell behind, I could not accept this life of poverty.At the beginning I chose to become a pickpocket and met many people living at the bottom.Their courage and optimism after their unbearable situation slowly infected me.I began to reform, work hard to face life positively, and maintain this spirit, with this spirit to infect many people, life is also bitter, bitter but also sweet.
norm.\\t我父亲原是商界大佬，娇生惯养的让我养成了跋扈的性格。后面家道中落，我无法接: \tMy father was a business tycoon and I was spoilt for choice, so I developed a domineering personality.When my family fell behind, I could not accept this life of poverty.At the beginning I chose to become a pickpocket and met many people living at the bottom.Their courage and optimism after their unbearable situation slowly infected me.I began to reform, work hard to face life positively, and maintain this spirit, with this spirit to infect many people, life is also bitter, bitter but also sweet.
norm.\\t我记得小时候认识一位比我年长几岁的大哥，他肆意妄为，危害四方。在当时我的眼: \tI remember as a child knowing a big brother who was a few years older than me, who was reckless and endangered the four directions.In my eyes at the time, he was a representative of freedom and he did whatever he wanted like a bird.I worshipped him and started to follow him around, stealing clothes from next door one day, destroying the neighbourhood's fields the next, and running amok.Whatever gave us pleasure, we were sure to try.
norm.\\t我命丧于青年，在阳光明媚的一天里，我出门去打猎，看见一位孩子陷入淤泥当中，: \tI lost my life as a young man.On a sunny day, I went out hunting and saw a child caught in the mud, I saw him and thought of myself at the time, I pulled him out decisively, he was rescued and did not choose to go home immediately, but went hunting with me.But fate was unpredictable, and towards evening I met a large insect that struggled and did not escape, and we both perished in the tiger's mouth.
norm.\\t我生活在一个富裕的家庭里面，家里的氛围让我成为一个很听话的小孩，不会违抗父: \tI lived in a wealthy family and the atmosphere in my home made me a very obedient child, not disobeying my parents' orders and not teasing the servants because of my status as a young master.I remember the most outrageous thing I ever did was to ask my servants to teach a child a lesson because I had lost to him once and that he was my playmate at the time.
norm.\\t我生在一个幸福的家庭里面，父母不会因为我发脾气而训斥我，导致我娇生惯养。直: \tI was born inside a happy family, my parents would not reprimand me for losing my temper, leading me to be spoilt.It wasn't until one day when I was in an inexplicably irritable mood that I went for a walk down the street and smashed up any stall I came across that didn't agree with me, at which point I was advised to stop, and not only did I not listen but I contradicted him.It was only later when my home was seized and my parents were arrested that I realised my mistake, but it was all too late.They made me watch my parents being killed, and I couldn't take it for a moment and chose to hang myself.
norm.\\t我为世家后嗣，生于钟鸣鼎食之家，然我不喜舞文弄墨，只偏好声色犬马，终日豪仆: \tI was born into a family of great wealth, but I didn't like writing and writing, I only liked sex, and I was always surrounded by servants and slaves.
norm.\\t我相信，是的，即便是我背负了骂名，在那伟大变革降临的那一天，所有人都会理解: \tI believe that, yes, even if I take the blame, on the day when that great change comes, everyone will understand me and what I am doing, and yes, I am not wrong, I am not...it is all for that day...\n（The thin man's eyes drifted off into a trance of his own and he stopped talking.）
norm.\\t我幼时家无余财却也足以安康度日，可我那父亲生性风流，常借备锦衣来往于声靡风: \tWhen I was young, my family had no money, but it was enough to get by.But my father who was a flirt, often borrowed brocade clothes to travel to and from entertainment venues.My mother tried to persuade him but always failed, and she ended up depressed.But I was young and ignorant, I only knew how to catch and play cricket fights, never once showing filial piety.
norm.\\t我与一般纨绔的富家子弟不同，小时候常常虐待动物，小到昆虫大到乌龟、兔子这种: \tI was different from ordinary rich kids.When I was young, I used to abuse animals, from small insects to bigger animals like turtles and rabbits.I knew that my parents would not condone to it, so I asked my servants to secretly catch or buy the animals for me.I also used my pocket money to buy a small house for my 'research'.Over time, my story was circulated among people.
norm.\\t我只记得小时候我备受家里人的喜爱，从小被惯到大，即便是打碎了父亲最喜欢的茶: \tI only remember that as a child I was much loved by my family and was spoiled from a young age, even when I broke my father's favourite tea set I was never chastised, if I had been a child of another family I would have been afraid that the skin would not have been split open.I did all these naughty things, but that was as far as it went.
norm.\\t小时的我是开开心心度过的，父母会时常的带我出去逛，无论是集市还是野外的田地: \tI spent my childhood happily, and my parents would take me out from time to time, whether it was to the market or to the fields in the wilderness, to have a good experience.Just one day when I was visiting the market, I saw a man stealing something and I loudly warned that stall owner.Although I failed to catch the thief, the shopkeeper even praised me for being a good girl who would definitely make a career out of it.But little did I know that I would be held against that thief for this, and he followed and remembered my place of residence.The next morning I lay quietly in bed and never got up again.
norm.\\t小时候的我很是调皮，会鼓动小伙伴们砸稻田边树上的马蜂窝，为了躲避马蜂，我们: \tAs a child, I was very naughty and would encourage my buddies to smash the hornets' nests in the trees by the rice fields.In order to avoid the hornets, we smashed and ran towards the streams, and it was none of my business as to how many people along the way would suffer from unwarranted injuries and casualties caused by not getting timely medical treatment as a result.
norm.\\t小时候的我望着同龄的孩子因开始帮助父母而早早的下农地干活，但我没有与他们一: \tAs a child I looked at children of my age who had started to help their parents by going to work on the farm early, but I did not join them in thinking that I was a very thoughtful person who chose to go to the city to sell goods and later encountered difficulties with money and went home to discuss with my parents and received a negative answer from them.I didn't choose to make a fuss with my parents over this either, but listened to their ideas in line with children of my age and went into farming to work.But ploughing was boring until one day while working, a child my age was also farming and I had a friendly exchange with him, taking what little fun I had left as a little dessert in a boring day.
norm.\\t小时候的我无恶不作，偷隔壁邻居的鸭到了晚上再给它放回去，每当我心情不好的时: \tAs a child I was up to no good, stealing my next door neighbour's duck and putting it back at night.Whenever I was in a bad mood I bullied their dog, but occasionally I would take the meat I couldn't finish and throw it at him.But things change.Just as I was happily heading out to the fields one day, I was knocked to the ground by a horse that had gotten out of control, and by the time people took me to the doctor's office I was beyond help, but it added to the money for my not-so-rich family, and my parents lived comfortably in their old age because of it.
norm.\\t小时候的我无父无母，没有人照顾我，我为了生存，整日在街上偷、抢才能把握住一: \tAs a child, I had no father or mother and no one to take care of me.I spent my days stealing and robbing on the streets in order to survive, but only enough to feed myself.I understood that I couldn't go on like this.I resented everything, but there was nothing I could do about it.
norm.\\t小时候的我性格软弱，家里也有点小钱，因此父母对我也很好。但是就在我出门玩的: \tAs a child, I was weak and my family had a little money, so my parents were good to me.But when I went out to play, I often met people who approached me with bad intentions, and my weakness fuelled their anger.I was often beaten by them, extorted by them, and forced to steal money from my home or else I would be beaten too.
norm.\\t小时候调皮捣蛋，感觉别人骑马的样子很帅气，死缠烂打之下，父母耗尽钱财为我购: \tAs a child, I was naughty and mischievous and felt that other people looked handsome on horses.After stalking them, my parents spent all their money to buy horses for me, but because I was too young, I fell off the horses while riding and was injured as a result.
norm.\\t小时候我会因为下雨天而故意踩水潭，让泥巴飞溅到别人衣服上，从而获取到快乐。: \tAs a child I would gain pleasure by deliberately stepping in puddles of water and letting mud splash on other people's clothes because it was raining.But once when I was wandering in the street and found an object on the ground that someone had lost, I opened it and looked at it and found a few dangling money that had been left inside.Although I had greed, I decidedly chose to give it to the magistrate, who would deal with the matter.Although it is possible that the magistrates would not have dealt with it, the young me was unaware of this.
norm.\\t已经成家了的我，整日为了养家糊口而备受折磨，不仅仅是养活自己，妻子和孩子以: \tI had become a family and I was tortured all day long trying to provide for not only myself, but my wife and children and my parents who were lying in their sick beds.And I barely managed to hold it together for several years before I failed to top it.Eventually I chose to hang myself to end this painful life of mine.
norm.\\t已经获得了成长的我想着如何帮助家里分担生活上的压力，也想着如何独立。但事与: \tI had grown and I thought about how I could help share the stress of life at home and how I could be independent.But against all expectations, I was treated as free labour by my boss, doing the work of two people by myself and enduring the oppression of life, but for the sake of my ambition and the heart to help share my parents' burden, I kept going.But things change, and soon our side met with the Great Riot and I lost the job.
norm.\\t因为我从小就继承了父亲的理想，我无法左右自己的想法，但我也没有因此而进行反: \tBecause I had inherited my father's ideals from a young age, I couldn't sway myself, but I didn't let that stop me from rebelling.The sky was clear that day, and I rode on, as usual, to the tavern outside the city.After riding for about half an hour, the sky suddenly started to rain heavily, and when I tried to find somewhere to take shelter from the rain, who knew that my horse would slip and fall, and I would fall off my horse and die from a long untreated death.
norm.\\t因为我家境较好，从小便被父母送去私塾读书，日复一日的跟着先生背书，有时看见: \tBecause my family was better off, I was sent to private school by my parents from a very young age.Day after day, I followed the teacher and memorised books, sometimes giving out expectant looks when I saw children of my age outside the door.Learning knowledge is hard work, and I knew this well and did not let the happiness of outsiders get to me.My only belief was to study well and become an adult so that my parents could live a good life.
norm.\\t有些生命的诞生注定不会迎来喝彩，比如我，还在襁褓中就被父母遗弃。虽然后面找: \tSome lives are born that are not destined to be applauded, like me, who was abandoned by my parents when I was still in infancy.Although I found my parents later, I have long since become a stranger to them.I have always struggled to live alone, using every means possible simply to feed myself and not starve to death; I trust no one, accept no charity or help, and I feed myself by cheating and stealing.
norm.\\t余年得庆，盖棺之年已至四代同堂，子孙绕膝之际难免思过，为此一生历经坎坷，却: \tI have celebrated the rest of my life, the year of the coffin has reached four generations with the same family, children and grandchildren around the knee when inevitably thinking about the past, for this life through the ups and downs, but can enjoy the blessings of human family in their final years, it is a great blessing, no regrets at the end of life.
norm.\\t远在他乡的我，孤身一人便踏上了打工人的道路，而仅在上工的第一个月，听见有人: \tI was alone in my hometown when I set out to work as a labourer, and only in my first month of work, I heard someone shouting that their child had been robbed, and I rushed forward to fight with the culprit, and eventually got the child back, but failed to keep the culprit, and I lost my right thumb and my job, and have been living on the streets begging for a living ever since.
norm.\\t在我还是孩童的时候，父母积劳成疾的身体每况愈下，我慢慢学着大人的样子去河边: \tWhen I was a child, my parents' health was deteriorating from strain, and I slowly followed the example of the adults and went to the river to pick herbs to support the family.However, accidents did happen.One rainy day I accidentally fell into the river while picking herbs, and got tangled in the water plants in a panic struggle.
norm.\\t在我小时候的记忆中，我无父无母，从小便呆在一个陌生的家庭里，可能因为是外来: \tIn my childhood memories, I was fatherless and motherless, and I grew up in a strange family, probably because I was an outsider, so I was bullied by their family every day, and I had no idea what mistakes I had made.My so-called father drank heavily every day and would come to take out his anger on me for the smallest things, and this result today is the greatest happiness for me.
norm.\\t长大了以后，我愈发的贪财，只要有银两进了我的口袋，想再拿出去那是不太可能的: \tAs I grew up, I became more and more greedy for money.As long as I had money in my pocket, it was impossible to take it out again.That's why I started to find various reasons to withhold money from my servants, so that I could enrich myself.I would also fight with people over a little money and almost lost my life because of it.
norm.\\t峥嵘已过，岁月行催，然濒老枯死之躯得沐天恩，上位仁厚亲赐仙药，是以得幸压胜: \tBut my old and dying body was blessed by the grace of heaven and the kindness of the Lord who gave me an immortal medicine, so I was fortunate enough to be able to win and increase my life expectancy for more than ten years.
norm.\\t正一将成名万古枯，在这康庄大道上，总有人会枉死，也有人会牺牲，难道你们觉得: \tIs that a general will die in vain, and on this congenial path, there will always be people who will die in vain and others who will be sacrificed.Do you think that I should give up the new birth of the world because of these small sporadic fires?\n（The young man in the hall was so thin and weak that he was almost frantic）.\n
norm.\\t只有革新才能拯救我们，只有变革才能拯救天下！阻碍的人是什么？他们是安于现状: \tOnly innovation can save us, only change can save the world! What are the people who stand in the way? norm.“这场战争，是大获全胜。”，准提看着远方说道。\n祁云一脸愁云，欲言又止，似乎想:

Qi Yun is enlightened upon hearing this, no wonder...he thought Tongtian was a fool but it turns out he himself is an idiot.Well, that would be great.

1.The opening of the Jiuzhou Commerce Chamber alternates with the Deity Slain Array activity.It will open at 10:00 on Saturday, and close at 00:00 the following Friday
2.Each time the activity opens, all associated resources other than Jiuzhou Orders will be reset.
3.The stock exchange is open for trades between 10:00-20:00 every day during the event.If there are any unsold stocks by 20:00 on the last day there will be a delay in closure by roughly 30 minutes.
4.100,000 Coupons, which are the primary currency of the exchange, are released automatically every day during the event （as long as you are online）.
5.Every day the player has a transaction limit of 500,000 stocks （750,000 if the player has purchased Jiuzhou membership）.Any purchase of stocks contributes to the transaction limit, once the limit has been reached the player can not purchase any further stocks that day.
6.Throughout trading hours, the price of stocks varies once a year.The increase or decrease in value is related to a number of factors including （but not limited to） company status, stock purchases along with special information.
7.Every time the player sells stocks, they will receive Jiuzhou Orders equal to the profits * 1.5%.
8.Jiuzhou Orders are an important item that can be redeemed for pet cultivation materials.It is possible to purchase Jiuzhou Orders with Coupons at an expensive exchange rate.
9.The stock market is run regionally, as such there can be a small delay （~10 seconds） when refreshing.
10.When the activity ends, the player with the most profits will obtain a time-limited buff （gem production increased by 10% ）, a title and their name card displayed over the Jiuzhou Commerce Center for one week.

norm.573年，李自明11岁，让我们把目光一直聚焦在他身上的目光收一收，就会发现这些年:
In 573, Li Ziming is 11 years old.Let’s shift our attention for a while from the prince to the wider world, and we will be taken aback by what happened over the past years.
In 570, emperor Li Mi suddenly fell ill.Days later when holding court again he looked ill and weak.
In 571, he sent for many famous doctors from far and wide to the palace for treatment, but that was in vain and his health went from bad to worse.
In the spring of 572, he has been obsessed with trying to make immortality pills and cultivate vital energy without caring about the affairs of state since the reopening of the Star-Picking Tower with Nanli Taoist priest Tong Kaiyang as its new owner.
In autumn, in the emperor's study memorials to be looked through were piling up.
In winter, secretary of the Grand Secretariat Mr Xie risked coming to meet the emperor and had a good long talk with him.Soon Mr.Xie returned to his hometown, but the emperor still did not leave the tower.
Still in winter, across the country rumor had it that the emperor was dead, and there were calls for the 11-year-old prince Li Ziming's taking the throne.
In early 573, the emperor finally came to court, brilliant and energetic.
Rumor collapses of itself.Li Mi is silent after listening to a flood of reports by all the ministers, and then he drafts an imperial decree as follow,
"The prince Li Ziming, who has an intention of conspiring to usurp the throne by spreading rumors, must be grounded within the Ciqing Palace."
The making of the decree brings an uproar in the court.Several officials immediately try to defend the prince, but end up being regarded as the prince’s adherents and inflicted on combined punishment for several crimes.The others, shake their heads and keep silent, heaving a sigh helplessly.
norm.580年初，太子被封左将军，亲征北狄历练，赐8名虎卫随行。\n刘铤请命同往，圣上:
At the beginning of 580 A.D., the prince Li Ziming is entitled as the General on the Left.He is dispatched to conquer the northern invaders with 8 strong guards called Huwei accompanied.
Liu Ting asks the approval of the court to accompany the prince, but the emperor turns down his proposal.
The empress Guo, the foster mother of the prince, cried bitterly.Because the prince calls her mom from a very young age, she treats him as her own son.
 Since the emperor's mind is solely set on immortality cultivation, he shows no interest in sexual relations.He hasn't set foot in the rear court for a long time.For the empress, even she desires to be helpful, she can do nothing at all.
The prince and eight guards travel light.It take them almost two months to arrive the Northern Jurisdiction.
norm.591年元月初四，李自明带着8名虎卫，以及乔装打扮成随从的刘铤与小九抵达了京城。:
On the forth day of the first month in the lunar calendar in 591, Li Ziming, with 8 guards and Liu Ting and Xiaojiu dressed like servants, arrived in the capital city.
Trying to avoid arousing Li Yuan's suspicion, Li Ziming walked in a leisure manner.He displayed his impatience on the way, giving the impression that he was unwilling to attend the funeral of his father.
From a distance, there were guards on the gate tower even on this occasion with less traffic flow of people.It seems very strange.
Li returned to the place once he called home, but now here is dangerous for him.
norm.592年5月某日，牛家村普通村民牛二的老婆生了个男娃。\n要知道并不是所有新生命:
One day in May 592, an ordinary villager called Niuer in Niujiacun village whose wife gave birth to a new boy.
But not all the birth of new lifes was highly expected.There were three boys in the family already, but they all were not old enough to work in the fields.Recent years had witnessed a serious drought，which made it harder for Niuer to struggle to make end meets for the family of five.Now the new baby put more strains on the family.It was totally a disaster.
When his wife got pregnant at the very beginning, Niu tended to abort the child, but his wife couldn't bear to do so.And she persuaded her husband by saying that she had a preference for spicy food recently which probably signified that the child was a girl.The well-off Zhang family living in the east of the village desired to have a girl.They could give the girl to Zhang family.In doing so, they didn't have to suffer from hunger and they would got some money in a lump sum.Niuer was not so cold-blooded, so he agreed.But now it was too late to regret.
With the crying of the new baby at birth, the bright and sunny day suddenly changed into day with thunder and lightning.And there were red glow rising with purple air coming from the east.
At this time, an old man passed by their door.The old man was just like an immortal being on earth, and he congratulated them on the birth of the boy.He claimed that he had an acquaintance with the boy in previous life.So he hoped to have a tie with Niuer.
Since the man knew the birth of the boy in his family, Niuer thought the man must know how to foretell.In recent years, the immortal being cultivation had become a craze among folk people.As a result, many new schools of thought sprung up.It was said that many immortal beings often traveled around to select talented young boys and girls as their disciples.If it was true, his trouble would be solved.So he invited the old man into his house kindly.
The man said with a smile on his face, "The reincarnated boy is experiencing his doom here.If you insist on his stay at your home, troubles will incur.I have an acquaintance with the boy, so it will be very kind to give him to me.And you are free from these troubles as well."
During his speech, he took out three blocks of glittering gold ingots from his sleeve, placing them on the table in a row."Here are the three gold ingots as the filial piety that the boy should pay.And if you accept these gold ingots, it means that you allow me to cut off all his secular ties.Are you willing to do so?"
Although Niuer didn't quite get what the Taoist means, but he knew the general meaning.The glittering gold ingots were a really temptation for Niuer.He accepted the Taoist immediately without thinking twice.After he told what happened to his wife, her didn't say anything, but wiped her eyes silently.
The Taoist was amiable, and he told the parent that he was half immortal being.The child would be safe and sound.After several moments, he jumped on a cloud and left with the boy in his arm.
norm.593年4月，罗艺率先起兵于北境，呈先皇遗旨诛杀逆贼李渊，一路南下。\n5月初，:
In the April of 593, Luo Yi took the lead to staging an uprise in the Northern Frontier.He acted in obedience to the instruction of the deceased Emperor to kill the usurper Li Yuan.He marched to the south straightly.
In early May, the Guanxi Army and Nanqiang Army were dispatched to oppress this uprise in the north.At this time, Guanxi Army changed his position and was on Li Ziming side.As a result, Nanqiang Army was destroyed thanks to the perfect cooperation between Luo Yi and Yin Wenyuan.
In mid-May, the truth of the elixir finally came to light.Taoist temples were destroyed nationwide.
At the end of May, Luo and Yin marched to the gate.20,000 soldiers with the help of miracle water were dispatched to fight against the unrise.These soldiers were courageous and they were ten times stronger than Luo and Yin's army.Then all of a sudden, Luo Yi flew into the air and a monk removed his prayer beads from his neck.In an instant, the Buddhism lights illuminated everywhere.Any soldiers from Li Yuan's troop who exposed to the light became much older.And most of them died instantly.Even a fraction of survived soldiers were staggering and couldn't fight any more.Li Yuan had to ring gongs to retreat in a hurry.
At that night, many panicky people vaguely saw that someone was practicing something strange.There were lightening and thunder.Many red lights shone in all directions.But when these lights shone brightest, a more shining gold light outshone them.Finally, these red lights failed to shine again.
Li Yuan ran away to the southeast region immediately.He travelled through Shanxi, Hunan, Zhejiang and Fujian province, and eventually arrived Lequeos.
The next day, the gate was open.Luo Yi and Yin Wenyuan led their troops into the city in an orderly manner.All the people were relieved.Li Ziming ascended the throne.
norm.596年，李自明毁摘星楼，全国禁止一切修道修仙事宜。\n凡私藏修仙修道典籍，或私: In 596, Li Ziming destroys the Star-Picking Tower and bans all cultivation practices of immortality all over the state.\nAnyone who collects in private books on immortal cultivation and any practicer is severely punished.\n
norm.596年，李自明推行西方教，毁摘星楼，建正阳寺，全国兴起庙宇，烧香拜佛。\n小九: In the year 596, Li Ziming introduces a Western religion, destroys the Star-Picking Tower and sets up a Zhengyang Temple.From then on, temples spring up all over the country and people flock there to burn incense and worship the gods.\nXiaojiu left quietly.
norm.597年，小九向李自明请辞，李自明问她何故离去，又要前往何处，她也不说，只是低着:
In 597, Xiaojiu tenders her resignation.Li Ziming asks why she is leaving and where she is going.She gives no replies, just keeping looking down at the ground.
Having been through thick and thin with Xiaojiu who’s been with him for a long time, Li Ziming has long been secretly in love with her.But her attitude is as elusive as her look under the hood and veil she always wears.
Li Ziming has always been showing respect for her and keeps certain distance from her, but now that his beloved is about to leave, he finally gathers courage to profess his love.
She is overwhelmed by his confession, with face blushing evidently even hidden behind the veil.Both are in love.
Noticing her reaction, Li Ziming is no fool and realizes that she also has a crush on him, but just too shy to express anything, and that her resignation must be a tentative move.Therefore, he feels encouraged to inundate her with sweet words, and even intends to propose to her.
Xiaojiu feels astonished at his move and runs away from him in a rush, missing the jade pendant on her waist in the palace.
It's been a long time that Li Ziming didn't feel so joyful.He walks over to pick up the jade pendant, which looks so familiar to him, with characters "Li Ziming" engraved on it.
Six years old, back garden, rockery, nearly-drowning and chicken thigh-sneaking, everything occurs to him.
Their affection was doomed long time ago.
norm.598年，西方教向凡间推行坐忘，结丹，舍利等，与当初炼丹修道大同小异，世人却又欣: In 598, the Western religion introduces to the mortal world the practice of meditation, Core formation and relics, which constitute a possess much the same as that of Taoist alchemy and cultivation.But people still embrace it and flock to spend their last penny to pursue it.\nLuo Yi and Yin Wenyuan retire and return to their hometowns.\n

norm.八岁时，尚书房添了新学生，一个六岁的毛头小子，是当年与皇上出生入死的“开国五公王:
At the age of eight, the prince has a new classmate, a six-year-old boy who is the illegitimate child of one of the emperor’s "five grand dukes"Liu Xian, called Liu Ting.
Years ago, the country which was divided into two parts the north and the south was in a chaos.The emperor today was just a commoner Li Mi, but finally he stood out from others and unified the country in 4 years.Actually, his success owes much to a group of outstanding generals around him.
Among them, 5 most famous men, one talented man and four military masters, are collectively called "five grand dukes”.There is a limerick going among later generations：
Double spears rule the north and south, one sword fast comes the Central Plains; in Guanxi lives a sword breaker holder , in Jiangzuo resides a living god.
Li Yuan, the younger brother of emperor Li Mi, governs the south with a silver spear and excellent martial arts.
Luoyi in the north, famous for his fast and precise spear-killing and special spear skills that his family pass down for generations, is really good at breaking the enemy with one strike.
Liu Xian is a formidable and daunting martial expert with a sword with golden rings as weapon.
Yin Wenyuan who can hardly find rivals in the world with two sword breakers.
And Jiangdong counselor Yao Guang, a jack of all trades, knows everything including astronomy and geography.
Liu Xian died of illness last year and consigned his son to the emperor.Therefore, Liu Ting can be seen as the adopted son of the emperor, that is, Li Ziming’s younger brother.
This boy looks like a tough guy.He seldom talks and eats a lot, but still too thin like those who suffer from malnutrition.When he first came to the study, he was left behind in both cultural courses and physical education.However, he is very strict with himself, trying to work harder to keep up with his classmate.

The horse changed from the white horse was much stronger than the previous one.So Bukong held it much easier when walking ahead.Bukong avoided many sideline quests because he walked very fast and he tried to avoid trouble as much as possible.
With the passage of time, Bukong and his horse continued their journey.
One day, they passed by a valley where stood a Goddness of Mercy Temple.On seeing it, Bukong realized that this was a main quest that couldn’t be avoided.So he strode into the temple with his hand holding the horse, after a quick review of his dress.
Hearing that Bukong was a senior monk who came from Tang Dynasty and went to the west, Monks standing at the door bowed to Bukong immediately and ushered him into the temple to have a rest reverently.Bukong just sat down when a hunchbacked monk who was supported by two young monks walked in slowly.Bukong stood up immediately and bowed to them with his palm pressing together.The old monk also bowed to Bukong and he ordered monks to serve tea.Soon, two young monks came in with delicate tea set at hand.
After a sip, Bukong said some polite compliments.On hearing that, the old monk was pleased, and he began to show off his understanding of the Classic of Tea.Bukong continued his compliment out of polite.
Such compliments made the old monk elated.So he laughed aloud and ordered some monks to fetch twelve boxes full of cassocks.Actually there were more than hundreds of cassocks which were very beautiful.The old monk saw Bukong’s seemingly astounding expression and asked provocatively, "Dignitary, since you come from the great vast east land, Tang Dynasty, Can you show me something precious?”

norm.不知过了多久，琼英才清醒过来，她缓缓地吐出一口气，可是再睁眼的时候，却发现自己到:
After some time, Qiong Ying woke up.She took a deep breath, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself in an unknown place.
There was covered with snow and big snowflake fell down in the air.Qiong Ying knew that it was at the beginning of spring, but why it was snowing.And then she looked up, realizing that a tall man in his twenties standing in front of her.
Qiong was surprised, and then she supported herself.She said, "Predecessor, who are you?"
The "stranger" turned to Qiong Ying and smiled to her, "In such a short time, you just don't remember your master?"
On hearing it, the numbed-feet Qiong Ying slumped onto the ground.She asked, "master?"
She was confused and she felt like that she was in a dream.So she just asked the most urgent question, "master, what is this place? Why are you changed into this?"
The Coldstar just took out the halved wooden pieces and threw them to Qiong Ying.He scolded, "How dare you to ask me? What you have carved?"
Qiong Ying realized it immediately because it took the three of them half night to finish.She muttered, "This……this is a hierogram of trace tracking."
The master sighed, "You three are not capable enough to carve a hierogram that is unknown to you.You three are so bold.There are more than one mistake in the hierogram of trace tracking, so it has changed into a semi-hierogram of soul chasing.It is useless, but the King of All Demons activated it compulsorily.Now it chases us here in accordance with the trace of the King of All Demons' primordial spirit."
Qiong Ying thought quickly and then she asked her master tentatively, "Master, do you know him?"
The Coldstar Lay Buddhist said with a bitter smile, "Thanks to you all, i just figure out who he is right now."
After finishing his words, he touched his darkened jade pendant and said, "Many years ago, my master left the Sect and he left the jade pendant to me."
The Coldstar Lay Buddhist knocked on the jade for several times, and then a vague human shadow jumped out of it.And it turned into a middle-aged man.
After watching the man carefully for some time, the Coldstar knelt down slowly.And he said, "Master."

norm.春去冬来，上山一年，琼英每天就是上课，吃饭，打坐，念经，那本师门心法《自在经》背:
As season went by, one year passed.During the year, Qiong Ying attended classes, had meals, sat in meditation and read scriptures.She could recite the Free Scripture owned by the Sect from memory.The Coldstar just yawned all day.Only the eldest disciple wield a wooden sword once in a while.
Today the master summoned the three disciples into the yard after the morning class with a wooden broadsword in his hand.Qiong pretended to be calm but she looked forward to it.
Lu Chen jumped here and there, and he looked around with interest.
Ye Tianhe took an ancient armchair from nowhere and lied in it comfortably.He fanned himself, which seemed that he was enjoying a drama.
《Qiong Ying and Xiaochen, today i will impart the Blade Technique of Springsun.Tianhe, since you have learned, you just have a review.》 The Master also the Sect Leader stood straightly in the yard with a serious look on his face.It seemed that something great will happen very soon.So Qiong held a higher expectation for it.
After his words, he raised his two arms and held a broadsword with two hands.He presented a flabby position, and then began to wield it.When wielding, he uttered some words from his mouth.
Qiong Ying was speechless.
Although she didn't conduct immortal cultivation nor did she exercised martial arts, she could recognize the wield was so informal.It seemed that the wooden broadsword was air.The wield of the broadsword even could not bring a wisp of wind.And each motion was extremely slow.If the broadsword was changed into a fan, the man who was wielding was dancing.In addition to the master's seductive words, the effect was amazingly impressive.
Lu Chen burst into laughter and he said that the acrobatics he saw on the street was more like sword motion than the master's wielding.
The master came to Lu and patted his head with the wooden broadsword.Lu was punished to write the Free Scripture five hundred times.Lu just restrained his laughter.
Sect Leader of Lu gave two different wooden swords to Qiong Ying and Lu Chen.What Qiong got was a slim sword with long and slim blade, while Lu got a pair of bent blade, which should be wielded with two hands.
《Tianhe, you lead them to practise.I want to have a snap.Later i will teach you the third motion.》 The Coldstar yawned and slipped away.
When the master went away, Lu burst into laughter, but not Qiong Ying.She found that the usually lazy eldest disciple stood up with a very concentrated look on his face.
Ye Tianhe took out what he got, a wooden sword.The Blade Technique of Springsun was strange enough, but what is strangers is that even the weapon for three disciples are totally different.

norm.从五庄观出来，看过那本仙册，小白龙的话也没有以前多了。\n他是西海龙王的第58个:
The White Horse was not so eloquent since he had saw the book.
He is the 58th son of the Dragon King of West Ocean.He grew up in a unknown lake and never got a chance to the Dragon Palace.
When he was young, he dreamed to be a great dragon just like his father:Bringing favorable rain to the people in the world when flying in the sky to summon rain or cloud.And when he passed by, the people living on earth could give thumb-up to him.That was what he longed for.
So he kept sharpening his skills.When he was 18 years old, his father begged the Jade Emperor to arrange a job of distributing rainfall for him.Although it was in a remote area, the White Horse was very happy.
But when he assumed his position the very first day, he saw the notice on the board which reads:the local Emperor showed disrespect to the Jade Emperor, so no rainfall for this area for three years to serve as a warning.
The horse had to put away his bag used for rain precipitation.He thought the Jade Emperor's anger would melt away one day.He waited for three years.He had submitted many statements to ask the approval of rain precipitation, but didn't got any response.Actually the Jade Emperor had already forgotten this tiny thing.But those who were responsible for conveying information did not deliver the horse's statement to the Emperor because they wanted to avoid trouble as much as possible.So they just threw all the horse's statement into dustbins.
Later it is said that there was a white horse violated the Heaven rule by bringing rain to the prohibited area.According to the rule, he should be capitalized.
His mother required his father to beg the mercy for him by threatening to end her own life.Despite the spare of his life, he should be punished heavily.Therefore, he was demoted to here to experience nine times of reincarnation.
"White horse, you must realize that if you are not strong enough, you cannot change the world.So what you should do is to focus on your own business.There is no need to feel guilty for not being able to save so many people.the only wish is that when you are able to change the world, just bear in mind your initial aspiration." Bukong wiped away the tears in the horse's eyes who was in sound sleep.
Bukong patted the horse to wake him up."It is time to go ahead."
The horse felt a little lost.He said nothing and followed Bukong to go ahead.

norm.大师兄拜别了天枢岛，四处云游寻找三师弟陆沉的踪迹。\n十年，未果。\n大师兄把掌: The eldest disciple bid a farewell to the Tianshu Island, and he travelled around to look for Lu Chen.\nBut he didn't find Lu after ten year later.\nPutting the seal of the Springsun Sect in his pocket, the eldest disciple went to his original home.And he lived a comfortable life again.The Springsun Sect had disappeared from then on.
norm.大师兄醒来已经是一个时辰后，黑衣人队长死了，琼英昏迷不醒倒在血泊里，三师弟陆沉不:
It was already one hour later when the eldest disciple woke up.The leader in black was dead, and Qiong Ying got a black out surrounded by blood.And Lu Chen was nowhere to be found.
He held Qiong Ying in his arm.Qiong's body was cold, but his heart was colder.
He held Qiong Ying for a very long time.He thought that he was a loser, and why their master asked him to be the Leader of the Sect? Or in other words, why he accepted the offer? He should have brought his younger sisters and brothers back to the mountain.They could live a happy secular life there.Why should they pursue immortality and cultivation?
He didn't stop crying until he was tired.Then it was dawn, and the Island owner was recruited by the court.
Since the dead are still dead, the eldest disciple needed to look for Lu Chen.So he buried Qiong Ying in person.
norm.大师兄最初是不能接受这样的结果，一个是像父亲一样为他遮风挡雨的师父没了，另一个是:
At the beginning, the eldest disciple could not accept the result.For one thing, his master who was like his father protecting him from the rain died.For another, the once-pampered himself needs to be a leader of a sect.He had planed to pack to lead a happy life in the secular world with Qiong Ying and Lu Chen.But when he saw Qiong Ying, though very tired, practiced the whole set of the Blade Technique of Springsun at the first morning when she woke up, he slapped himself hard and gave up his idea to run away.
The young leader of the Springsun Sect and two disciples stayed in the Tianshu Island temporarily.The Island owner Chen Tanlang instructed them in person.Even Lu Chen began to take it seriously.
But they had a rough time in here.From outside cultivators to disciples in the Island, they were jealous of the Island owner’s personal instruction given to the three new low-ranking cultivators.Therefore all people began to isolate them.Although they held a positive attitude towards it, they felt depressed at the bottom of their hearts.
The eldest disciple became strong.Qiong Ying worked harder than usual, and Lu Chen was taciturn.Qiong Ying knew that Lu viewed their master as his relative.
Although they said nothing at all, their relationship became closer than usual.

norm.大唐办事处效率惊人，丝毫不拖泥带水，皇帝也是很亲民，冲过来随便找个理由就认了不空:
The office of Tang Dynasty was not sloppy but efficient.And the Emperor was easy-going enough that he made Bukong as his younger brother who did not have blood ties with him.
Holding Bukong's hand, the Emperor said to Bukong with tears in his eyes:"Younger brother, I have been troubled by many innocent ghosts day and night.It is said that only the Buddhism in the west can save those innocent ghosts.I wonder if you can……"
"Yes, I can.I can.I will set out to the west right now."Bukong put his hands on the Emperor's to stop the latter's more words.Bukong thought to himself that did he have other option? If he refused, he would stuck at here.
The Emperor waved his hand and then one of the servants ran to send the luggage and the pass needed for the journey.And the Emperor sent Bukong an exquisite cassock, a gold alms bowl, a nine-ring tin stick and a swift horse.He said emotionally:"Younger brother, wish you a safe journey.Please take care of yourself."
Bukong thought to himself that the Emperor even didn't prepare dinner for him.To send the alms bowl was to ensure that he could use it to hold the food he begged.So he would not starve to death.
After several moments of thought, Bukong accepted it peacefully and he took all these gifts, laughed and went out.
When Bukong walked away, the Emperor bowed respectfully to the sky in four directions and said, "Golden XXX has already set out.According to the script, he should set out at the age of 13.It has nothing to do with me for the late.He comes here too late."
A loud voice came out from the sky, "Got it! No more words."

norm.到后山抓了老鼠回来，将一点点液体放在馒头上扔给老鼠。\n只见它直接窜向馒头，咬了:
You catch a rat back from the back hill, and feed it with a steamed bun on which you've already dripped a bit the green liquid.
The rat scurries directly towards the bun and takes a bite, and then it whose eyes turn red, in a frenzied manner tries to rush towards you.You jump back with a start, leaving the bowl knocked over on the grass.The rat falls down on the ground motionless in less than a quarter of an hour.After a while, it wakes up but moves only in the same place.Stepping closer to have a clear look, you find that the mouse's whiskers turn gray.
Afterwards, you experiment with several other animals, and they also end up becoming senile for no reason.
Suddenly, a spot on the grass covered with the bowl you tipped over before reminds you that the liquid might have a fatal effect on plants.
However, either subsequent attempts to inject spiritual energy into the gourd or placing it in the room result in no new liquid, until one night when the moon is in full bloom, the gourd emits a green light again and is replenished with liquid.You happen to find the gourd resembles the moon so much, and decide to name the liquid in it moon dew.

norm.的确是父皇的笔记。\n“自明，见字恐难再见面，朕的胞弟李渊应该是已经篡位成功了”:
It is truly written by father
"Ziming, when you read this letter, i am afraid that we cannot meet each other any more.I suppose my younger brother,the usurper Li Yuan, has successfully ascended to the throne."
"At the time when the Dynasty was founded after the unity of the central plain, i attempted to abdicate my throne to him.But he was not a man of integrity.Yao Guang once suggested that i should kill him to save many potential threats.But i was not coldblooded enough to do so.Later he grew so powerful that i couldn't control him."
"You must believe what i am going to say.It is true that there are immortal beings in the world, but not all of them are nice.You uncle got some opportunities to gain acquaintance with some immortal beings.And he offered sacrifices to them.In doing so, these immortal beings protect him.He could not be killed by knifes or swords.Nor he would drown or burn to death.What's more, he obtained a kind of item called "shenxianshui" literally means miracle water.By drinking it, ordinary people can get superpower to fight without the sense of hurt or fear at the cost of reduced life.He possesses a troop like that.I can do nothing about it."
"The royal military adviser Yao Guang once also had some ties with immortal beings.But because of constant fighting in battlefields, his ties were getting increasingly loose.Similarly he could do nothing about it.When you were eight years old, on the surface he left his government position and became a recluse.But in fact he managed to figured out how to cope with the strong army force possessed by Li Yuan.And as for my part, i tried to stop Li Yuan's action as long as possible."
"In early stage, Li Yuan didn't dare to take action recklessly, because he couldn't find perfect opportunities and he was unclear about my real strength.Therefore he just played tricks in the dark.Actually the death of your two older brothers was associated with him.When you were 15 years old, i has a serious illness which was a result of the spell cast by an immortal being asked by Li Yuan.So i took this chance to project myself as coward and mediocre.Seeing that, he did not rise in rebellion directly.He thought that it was perfectly justifiable if i died naturally and abdicated my throne to him.Consequently he ordered Tong Kaiyang and other people to rebuild the Star Picking Pavilion, in order to kill me at a stroke."
"As for the depose of your title of princess, i aim to make it more reliable and to protect you as well."
"I left you with some loyal assistants whom you can resort to in any time.They are military adviser Yao Guang, the general Luo Yi, Liu Ting, the son of Liu Xian, and Yin Wenyuan.They are loyal to me.And there are a group of old ministers who retired because of handling the cases of the death of imperial sons and the depose of the prince.They are all useful assistants that i left to you."
"I have done many things in my whole life, but i seldom do things for you.Now i ask you to change the current situation which require hard work.I am really feel guilty about it."
"I have already said that the throne would belong to you one day.Ziming, i know that you hold a casual attitude towards life.But this time, you should strive to get the thing that should belong to you.It is not for me, nor for you, but for people in the whole nation."
"My dear child, i watched with pride, as you grew into a man of righteousness.You must bear in mind that we rule the nation with our wisdom and power.To inspire your people to be high in spirit is the real victory.My life will come to an end one day, but you will be the Emperor."
Dropping the letter down slowly, Li Ziming has found the answer of many problems that perplexed him before.But at the same time, he has a strong desire to take revenge on Li Yuan.He realizes that he should refrain from being a kind person this time."

norm.冬去春来，转眼已到天圣十七年。\n徭真已经来到京都两年了。\n“先生，今天给我们:
As winter turns to spring, it is now the year 1039.It's been two years since Yao Zhen became your teacher in the capital.
"Master, tell us something about immortals today, please~"
"OK.Immortals can date back to 600 years ago.At that time, our human ancestors modeled after demonic beasts to absorb the essence of the sun and moon, and created cultivation methods from scratch.The process of ascending to immortality involves several levels, and I heard that the highest one is Nascent Soul.The master of our sect leader has reached the early stage of the level."says the master.
"Demonic beasts? Nascent Soul? Master, what are these?"
"Demonic beasts refer to beasts and spirit creatures that instinctively absorb the essence from nature to cultivate and strengthen themselves after being accidentally enlightened by eating rare and precious herbs or by absorbing spiritual energy.In their terms, after transforming into human beings they generally call themselves demons.Most of them feed on human blood."
Yao Zhen continues quietly, "The ascension process of demonic beasts involves Enlightenment, Spiritual wisdom-gaining, Core formation, and Transformation.Accordingly, the process of human race is divided into Qi refining, Base establishment, gold core-Forming, and Nascent soul, and each realm is divided into early, middle, late and peak four stages.

norm.高配不空问：道大佛大？道高佛高？\n不空答：你把他们叫来我给你量量。\n高配不空:
The advanced-version Bukong asked, "Which one is greater, the Taoism or the Buddhism? And which one is higher? (higher means greater)"
Bukong answered, "I can measure their height if you bring them in front of me."
And he asked, "We are not allowed to utter any noise in front of Buddhas, if so, how can we have access to Buddha?"
Bukong answered, "If you are true, why you still make noise."
He asked again, "Since human body is dirty, why Taoism continues to stress the importance of cultivation and refinement?"
Bukong answered, "Before you were a real Buddha, you also got a human body.But if you had abandoned the dirty body, could you still be there?"
He continued asking, "Buddhism attaches great importance on the equality of all beings.Is there any similar doctrine in Taoism?"
Bukong answered, "porcelain and title are made of clay.But are you trying to purchase a porcelain with the money you paid for a piece of title?"
He asked, "I am talking Buddhism with you, but why are you always talking ordinary things?"
Bukong answered, "I just judge the case as it stands.Since all of us exist in this world, and we take from it as well, shall we still despise the worldly world?"
The advanced-version Bukong asked, "The mundane world is tough, why don't you keep your distance with it?"
Bukong answered, "The Taoism generates everything in the world, but still, it is not restrained by anything.The Heaven and Earth breed us, and our mother gave birth to us.Do you want to abandon the Heaven, Earth and your mother?"
He asked, "In your eyes, what is the difference between monk and Taoist?"
Bukong answered, "A man with hair and a man without hair.That is it."
The advanced-version Bukong remained silent for a while and finally he said, "I fail."

norm.告别东方庆后，独自走在回府的路上，心中暗自思量着以后该如何解决此事。\n回到家中:
After waving goodbye to Dongfang Qing, you walk alone home, trying to figure out a solution.
Upon back home, you come to Mrs Rong directly, asking "Mrs Rong, where did you get this soul-soothing incense stick?".She casts a look at you, "Long time ago, the capital was hit by droughts for years on end.People suffered from severe famines and exchanged children for food, thus incurring armies of evil spirits.Thanks to your family, my family survived.One day, a Taoist priest was found fainted in the neighborhood of our house, half dead, and he did not get better until my father gave him a little saline water to drink.When he recovered and left later, he presented us three soul-soothing incense sticks.I gave one to you considering that it might be helpful when you come across something evil in your first journey far away from home."
"I see, I owed my life to the incense that night."then, you told her what happened in the inn that night.
"Do you still remember where did the Taoist priest come from and where he was heading for?" you continue asking.
"He did not mention that.We must do something else to handle the evil spirit then."

At the time Jia Baohe just returns home, "Mr.Xing, why you are here alone and Zhong Yang is not with you? Such a spoiled brat, I am gonna kick hardly his ass!"

You explain in a low voice, "Zhongyang has..."

You then tell him exactly what happened to his son.As the news turns his joy into gloom, Jia Baohe asks you to leave him alone.

norm.孩子，当你出生的时候，洛丹伦的森林，哦不，紫禁城的假山真水轻声唤出了你的名字：李:
My son, when you were born, the very forests of Lordaeron...no, the rockeries and pools of the Forbidden City whispered your name：Li Ziming.
I am your dad, working as a king.
You have a big family, armies of brothers and sisters, and a ravishing harem.
You are my third child, and your mother was a maid of my empress.One night I drank too much...and wanted to spend a beautiful night with your aunt empress...but that was not the right time for her...so I had some fun with your mother, the maid.This is why you were born.
Your mother got a high status because of you, buried as a high-ranking concubine.But to be honest, I have no affection for her, and you are the tie of this unexpected marriage.
You may have had two older brothers, but one died before three, another died before seeing the light of day.
In order to bear you seccessfully, your mother made many sacrifices, including but not limited to her rights of reputation, property and portrait, her life and even her 《right of paternity》 to you that she valued most.
You should not feel confused about the empress being your mother now, because this is commonly seen in imperial family.
Before long, you will become the crown prince, if you can survive.
I would like to take particular care of you of course, but...sometimes it is out of my reach, because I can't take you with me all the time.Your aunts, those concubines, always intrigue against each other.The harem is like an officialdom.
I wish you a healthy growth and be safe.And you must be independent under some circumstances.
--the Diary of the Emperor, arounf 1-3 am, lunar May 8th, 562.

These guards deserves the name of the most valiant horse-riding soldiers in the capital city.They are unstoppable.And it is like a piece of cake to kill these bandits.
Li Ziming orders these guards to make a breakthrough instead of continuing to fight.Therefore, they attempt to get ride of these bandits, but these people chase after in disregard of their own life.
Galloping his horse for more than a hundred mi, Li Ziming is ahead of his enemies.Suddenly he find something strange when looking ahead.He has no time to explain but shouts, "get up".With his feet beating the horse stomach heavily, the horse leaps high in the air which escape the horse rope set by enemies.At this time, the eight guards also realize what happened and they model after Li's action.

norm.花巷作为京都最大的烟柳之地，凌晨一点依然是灯火通明，商贩尖细的吆喝声，客人粗犷的:
As the largest brothel in the capital city, Floral Street is still brightly lit.The trade shouts of street vendors and the laughter of customs and the girls are mixed.The night is so vibrant.
A middle-aged man walked out of the Flower Intoxication Building.He worn a thin white robe in the depth of winter.The man staggered and is drunken.
He walked through as there were no one else around him.No matter people in high positions or street gangs, they all made way for the man.Some were respectful, while some were grinning.
"Who is that lunatic man? Why everyone makes way for him?" A new man asked.
"He is Mr.Liu.Although he is a shabby scholar, he has a high reputation here.Many prostitutes gain popularity by singing the lyrics composed by him.So his reputation is widely spread across the country.Everyone here will show some respect for him."A regular customer said to the new man to show off his knowledge.
"He is Mr.Liu? How does he degrade to compose vulgar works?"
"Because he met with unfair treatment in the imperial examination.So he composed a poem to satirize it.He compared himself with a lyric composer with brilliance.It is okay to make such a comparison.But he also compared the Imperial examination to a vanity title.His behavior offended all scholars in the country.What's worse, the Emperor was also enraged.So the Emperor banned Liu to take the Imperial examination in his whole life.Later his wife died of illness.Only a daughter accompanied him."
Maybe Liu overheard it, or he was dizzy because of the wind.He stopped suddenly and then he staggered forward.He left the brightly lit street and went to a dark place.
