norm.话分两边，南蜀君与沈渊旷世大战时，在场的修士纷纷跳进水里规避伤害，虽然有人受伤，:
At the moment when the Nanshu Priest and Shen Yuan were fighting with each other, all present cultivators jumped into water to avoid being hurt.Though some people got hurt, no one died.But all boats no matter large or small floating on the ocean were destroyed.
The personnel of Tianshu Island came very late.When they arrived, they helped rescue all the cultivators in the water, and brought them back to the Island.
The eldest disciple and the third younger disciple also followed the rescue team to go to the Island.To their surprise, the Island owner Chen Tanlang met them in person.And the owner was amicable, and he treated the two kindly as if he was treating his juniors.He arranged accommodations for them and helped search for their master and Qiong Ying.
The eldest disciple could feel that all these immortal cultivators were hostile to him and Lu Chen.The reason may lie in his original high-profile purchasing of the big boat, or other’s envy of the owner’s personal meeting, or the evil Shen Yuan coming from the Springsun Sect.
Having waiting for seven days in the Island, the eldest disciple felt every day was like a year long.
Seven days later, Qiong Ying went the Island for searching.The eldest disciple rushed to her without acknowledging Lu Chen.
Because of days of worries, the eldest disciple got pent-up anger.But when he saw Qiong Ying who looked untidy, his anger half died away.And when he knew their master was still missing, his anger had gone completely.
"What happened? Why are you like this? Where have you gone all these days? Where is our master?" The eldest disciple asked Qiong Ying and he stared at Qiong, which made her feel uncomfortable.
Qiong Ying took a deep breath, and then she took out a tiny seal from her arms with the uninjured hand.She handed it to the eldest disciple and said in a very low voice, "This is the Leader Seal, eldest brother, our master asked me to bring it to you." After hearing it, the eldest brother stepped back several steps.
"Our master died, and he said you are the Leader of the Springsun Sect from then on.I saw him disappearing into nothing." Qiong Ying continued and then she got a blackout.
Well, Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing came to…
norm.话说姜子牙当初下山时，表示弟子才疏学浅恐怕难当大任，元始告诉他不用担心如果有困难:
When Jiang Ziya left Mount Kunlun, he told his master that he was afraid of being not equal to the task, and his master asked him to take it easy, because he would always be helped when in difficulties.Then, a highly-skilled boy Nezha whose body has been reshaped with lotus blossoms, really comes to his aid within a couple of days after he hangs up the board of truce.
Jiang Ziya feels relieved when he hears that Nezha is a disciple of Taiyi Zhenren who is a senior disciple of Chan sect in the Golden Light Cave of Qianyuan Mountain.
He at once leads his troops out of the city to provoke his enemy, and Zhang Guifang, who was just concerned about how to prompt Xiqi to make an attack, hastens to take up the challenge.
Nezha is riding on the Wind Fire Wheels, has the Universe Ring around his body, the Red Armillary Sash around his shoulders and a Fire-tipped Spear in his right hand, obviously a non-mortal.Zhang Guifang asks, "Who are you? I am the general of Green Dragon Pass, I don't fight with a nameless man."
Nezha arrogantly replies, "My name is Nezha.I am here to cut your head off and kick it as a ball." Hearing that, Zhang Guifang feels pleased secretly and engages in a fight with Nezha.
After 20 or 30 rounds of battles, Zhang Guifang realizes that he is no match for Nezha, so he attacks quickly with his spear and forces his adversary back, saying, "Nezha, get down from your Wind Fire Wheels." But Nezha remains motionless.He repeats, but in vain.Then he feels something’s wrong and intends to flee, whipping up his horse.Suddenly, Nezha hits him from behind with his Universe Ring, breaking his ribs.Zhang Guifang retreats in a flurry, which leads the Xiqi side to a cheer, but they cease to pursue and attack in case of ambush.
Seeing Leizhenzi's confusion, Qi Yun begins to explain, "Zhang Guifang's skill is oriented towards the three spiritual and seven physical souls of mortals, but Nezha is the incarnation of lotus with no souls, so we can say that he is a deadly rival to Zhang Guifang." Leizhenzi nods with seeming understanding.
Following the defeat, Zhang keeps inside his camp.Xiqi army dares not to make a sudden attack for fear that he might have some other schemes.In fact, he writes a letter to Zhao Ge asking for reinforcement.
norm.话说众人正商议如何破阵，便有十位高人一一到来，这十位高人中有八位同属那阐教十二仙:
When all are discussing how to break the formations, ten immortals come to their aid one after another, eight of whom are members of the Twelve Immortals of Chan sect including Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun, Ju Liusun, Cihang Daoren, Puxian Zhenzhen, Guangchengzi, Taiyi Zhenzhen, Chijingzi, Master Virtue of the Pure Void, and the rest of whom are even more remarkable, one being Nanji Xianweng of the same sect, an immortal of fortune and virtue as Yunzhongzi, and the other non-cultivator Luya Daoren, a mystical and highly-skilled immortal who’s never suffered any loss in battle.
After swapping pleasantries the two sides are on the verge of coming to blows.The Chan side jeers at the Jie side for courting death for themselves, while the Jie side retaliates by provocating its adversaries.
The Ten Crucible Battle Formation is the very thing that Qi Yun criticised when he read the book.
In fact, the reason of the Chan sect’s participation in the war is that its twelve senior disciples have to go through a trial, namely, the killing process.Because the sect’s cultivation method is Taoist orthodoxy, it is not necessary to suppress one's emotions and temperament all the time during cultivation, which leads to the fact that their three desires are not cut off when cultivators ascend to immortality.
What are three desires? They can be seen as the symbol of human emotions, or Internal Demons.This is why the twelve senior disciples need to get involved in a killing process.But that doesn't mean they have to kill, but have a doom to be involved in the process of killing, and to surmount the doom is about how to survive.
Among the twelve high-level immortals, eight come to face the Ten Crucible Battle Formation, none of them are 100%sure they can get through this doom.How they handle it?- looking for fall guys.Qi Yun remembers very clearly, they send a scapegoat to get killed in each formation, and then destroy the formations based on the information they gain in the expense of the life of fall guys.In the end, they even slay all of the Ten Heavenly Monarchs so as to satisfy their internal demons.they are just hypocrites who sacrifice others’ life for their own safety.

norm.皇帝的身子一天比一天硬朗，甚至脸上皱纹都在退却，但总觉得作为活人的新鲜气越来越少:
Over time, the emperor becomes stronger and healthier and even the wrinkles on his face have disappeared, but somehow he doesn't look like a living person.
The imperial court runs as well as before, but the emperor becomes every moody and arbitrary.
In the autumn of 574, Lord Protector Luo Yi who is dissatisfied with the court, resigns and returns to his hometown.
Among the rest of the "five grand dukes", Yin Wenyuan has been garrisoning the country’s western part for years; Yao Guang has been living a recluse’s life and Liu Xian passed away.Only the emperor’s brother Li Yuan is holding a position in the court.
Li Yuan, a man approaching his fifties, is different from the heroic general who kills enemies in a breeze, and now he is quite affable and smiles to everyone he meets.He is always found napping in the court, which amuses the emperor even though he is in a fury.
Li Ziming is still grounded in his palace.It's been a long time that the emperor avoids talking about the crown prince, which is actually the worst news for the prince himself.
norm.皇帝李密对生命和权力的渴望几乎达到了极致，凡事皆登摘星楼，小事卜卦，大事问天。\:
Emperor Li Mi has an overwhelming lust for life and power, as found in his frequent visits to the Star-Picking Tower for everything from divination to heaven asking.
Taoist priests, monks, and alchemists as professions become most popular overnight.
Today Li Mi comes to the tower again because he dreamed about the "Emperor Star"(Polaris)’s falling from the sky of outer space last night.
Over there, Tong Kaiyang, the Taoist, holds the emperor edict in his left hand, ignites it with a fire burning is his palm, and then throws it into the air.It somehow hovers in midair, burning to ashes from right to left naturally as if it is being read literally by an immortal.
Great yearning and awe are evident in the emperor’s eyes which are fixed on the fire.
The piece of edict burns for half a quarter of an hour until it completely turns into black ashes.Then they move and fall slowly onto the table as if they are controlled by a magical power to form a character "East".
Tong Kaiyang says in a low voice："The fall of the Emperor star is a sign of the new’s ousting the old.The usurper may be the crown prince."
It seems that Li Mi wants to pause and ponder.His eyes glaze over for a while, but are filled with strong desire soon.

norm.家园建筑\n\n家园建筑分为普通建筑、功能建筑和增益建筑\n普通建筑：无附加属性:
Home Buildings

House Builidings are divided into Common Builidings，Functional Buildings and Buff Buildings
Common Buildings：no added stats, simply decorations
Functional Buildings：just as its name, buildings that have some functions, click to open the Function Panel.For examle, click to open our own stats panel, and if you click Spirit Pool, you would open Aptitude Panel
Buff Buildings：buildings have stats of Fengshui, including Metal, Wood, Water, FIre, Earth and Mana.You could check each stats through Fengshui Compass.Some Functional Buildings need certain amount of Fengshui stats, to get special buu
Calculation of Fengshui stats：set Mana as an example, if a Functional Building covers 4 ：squares, the stats of mana for each square is：10, 10, 10 and 30, and the mana stats of this building is：mana=（10+10+10+30）/4=15

norm.将暗羽兽带回宗门后，详细讲明了本次任务经历，将灵兽带回了住处。\n可是本门不擅驭:
After bringing the dark-feathered beast to the sect, you report in detail the experience of this mission and then bring the spirit beast to your dwelling.
Unfortunately, your sect is not a good beast tamer, and the beast hardly eats ordinary food, so you have to find a way to make your own beast-taming pills.
As a result, you exchange most of your contribution from the mission for the book for Alchemy in the grocery hall, intending to read it carefully back home.
A few months later, Elder Shi Yuan comes to your residence, holding in his hand the gourd you handed in before "Cold Wind, bring this back.It is not the belonging of any cultivators here.I have managed to wash away the residual soul on it, and now it may help gather the surrounding spiritual energy together around you and facilitate your absorption."
"Thank you, your Excellency.I must be your helper whenever you please." The Elder smiles, "Good boy."
"Your Excellency, may I ask something about the True Extreme sect since nothing can be known about it through the Jade Slip now, but I remember there were Five great sects including Tianji Pavilion, Lingxiao Mount, True Extreme sect, Nine Heaven Sword Pavilion and we Qingyuan Palace when I was initiated into our sect? What happened to the True Extreme sect then?"
The Elder wears a complicated look, saying, "The True Extreme sect, whose overall strength used to rank third among the Five sects, was unfortunately exterminated a few years ago by the demon force the Ten Thousand Demon Valley, because..."
After you are told the story of the elimination in detail, you feel a bit guilty, since you scarcely remember your previous appointment with Mr.Yao after your accession to the sect until today.He was right：as long as you step into the complicated world of Metaphysics, you will seldom have a sound sleep afterwards.

norm.姜子牙终日死守，转眼就过去一年，西岐虽然富裕，但是也架不住这么吃，一个月前余粮就:
It's been one year since the Xiqi side retreated and warded off their enemy's attack in town.More than one month ago, the wealthy city already came across deficiency of food, but there's nothing Jiang Ziya can do about it.Knowing that grains would run out in two days, he looks calm on the surface, but actually feels very anxious, thinking, my master, you told me I would be helped whenever in difficulty, I wish you are not a liar.
Then his wish comes true.The day sees two kids visiting, whom are warmly welcomed by Jiang Ziya.
The two boys bow down to him in the hall, saying, "Uncle-Master, we are disciples under Daoxing Tianzun of the Jade House Cave in the Golden Court Mountain.My name is Han Dulong, and this is Xue E Hu.We are ordered by our master to bring grain here today."
Ziya is overjoyed："Where is the grain?"
The boy replies, "Here it is." taking out a bowl from his bag and handing it to Ziya.
Jiang Ziya is delighted and orders someone to take the boy to the granary, which, after half an hour when the boy places the bowl there, becomes as full as it could be.
Applying his identification technique to the bowl, Qi Yun finds it is just an ordinary object rather than a magic treasure.It must have been enchanted.
Plenty of food in the city has soothed everyone’s nerves, and they begin to shift their focus on defending the city.
Soon, the war is once again in a deadlock, with Jiang Ziya strengthening his army while burning incense and praying for other superior men to come to his aid quickly.

norm.截教十天君全部魂归封神榜，朝歌军大败，连退七十里。\n申公豹连忙游说赵公明下山帮:
As the ten Heavenly Monarchs of Jie sect have all died and been listed into Fengshen Bang as gods, the Shang army is defeated and takes 70 miles backward in a row.
Shen Gongbao hastens to lobby Zhao Gongming to help.As a senior member of Jie sect, Zhao Gongming knows the inner workings of Fengshen Bang.When the list saw the light of day, the names of all disciples of the three sects were signed on it, and whoever dies in wars would be listed into it, while whoever wants to survive must avoid those wars.
Zhao Gongming is reluctant to leave the mountain and help, but Shen Gongpao adds inflammatory details to the tragic death of his ten fellow immortals, and says Zhao Jiang’s corpse is hung and whipped after his death.Zhao Gongming then, in a fit of rage, decides to assist Grand Old Master Wen Zhong.
As the the first generation of disciple of Jie sect under Tongtian Jiaozhu, he is rather distinguished in both martial arts and magical arts.Upon reaching the battlefield, he is furious and kills Jiang Ziya （who is later resurrected） with his whip and wounds Chijingzi, Guangchengzi, Yuding Zhenren, Daoxing Tianzun and Lingbao Dafashi, coming across no obstructions as if he moves into the free region.
Then he gives chase to Randeng Daoren to Mount Wuyi, where two distinguished men Xiao Sheng and Cao Bao comes to his adversary’s aid.He charges them and kills Xiao Sheng, but little does he expect that Cao Bao whould flip into the air a treasured item called Treasure-Catching Golden Coin, which sucks his Sea-Conquering Pearls and Dragon-Binding Rope.
After losing his two treasures, Zhao Gongming leaves to the Three Fairy Island to borrow Golden Dragon Scissors from his sisters, and with it cuts the deer of Randeng Daoren into two halves in an instant.Randeng flees for his life back to Xiqi and immortals of the Chan sect dare not to take any challenge.
As things progress, it is time for Luya to show up and instruct Jiang Ziya to build a straw effigy of Zhao Gongming so as to curse him to death.
Qi Yun, as Luya, doesn't feel sorry for Zhao Gongming but feels concerned about himself since he has no idea how to teach Jiang Ziya to build a straw effigy at all.Things end up in a deadlock.

In springtime, Li Ziming left capital city.Now it is already in summer when he arrives the Northern Frontier.
Nomadic tribes mainly live in the northern where scatters dozens of tribes, large or small, around the sprawling prairie.
These tribes posed no threat to the nation till around a hundred years ago when a man Alutai who claimed as the Grand Preceptor of the heaven upheld Guilichi to be Khagan.By persuading or threatening, the Tartar tribe was united.The nomadic tribe united as a whole, which caused many trouble for the central plain area.
Since these nomadic tribes made a living by grazing instead of farming, it was common to suffer from hunger because of many uncertain factors such as weather, natural disaster, and diseases.But they didn't just sit around and starved to death.Therefore, they went to the south to grab food as well as some clothes and some daily necessities.If the court sent troops to guard against, they would change to another place.Because this region was sprawling enough.This tactics was not applicable until the year of 564 when the Emperor Li Mi led Luo Yi(titled Beiqiang) to fight against the Northern invaders.They conquered many regions even the distant Oirats.And then they returned in triumph.The war brought the region ten years of peace.The Luo Army therefore stationed at the Northern Jurisdiction.
Now more than a decade later, the deterrent of the war has faded away.Tartars begin to stage provocations frequently.
This is what faced by Li Ziming.

norm.李渊隐忍数十年终登皇位，幸结仙缘有望长生不老，却一朝散尽，在上琉球岛之前，就已经:
Li Yuan finally ascends to the throne after biding his time for decades and is fortunately expected to achieve immortality, but he ends up going mad before he goes to the Ryukyu Island.
His inner circle(confidant/henchmen) has won themselves over a group of people by bragging about his invulnerability in his early years.
But once hearing that the 100,000-strong naval force of the Li Dynasty has been assembled in Fujian, the rabble kidnaps Li Yuan and sends him overnight to Fujian to surrender themselves to the Li Dynasty.
But the Li Dynasty refuses to accept the surrender.
Li Ziming, in command of the naval forces in person, invades the Ryukyu island and wipes out the remnants of Li Yuan's party, and recaptures the Ryukyu island.
Li Ziming is wounded in the battle.

norm.李自明，回顾一生，他最初是不喜争斗的，后来发现如果他不斗，只不过是有人在替他斗，:
Li Ziming, looking back on his life, finds that initially he hated fighting, but then realised that if he did not fight, someone would do that for him, or die for him.
So he fights against himself, against others, and then against the immortals.
In the end, he seems to hold little grudge against his foe Li Yuan.He forgives the miserable man, for whom is just an insatiable pawn of those immortals.As for his tragic ending, he brings that on himself.
But the Tartars would always be a thorn in Li's side, and wars will not halt unless cultural differences between the two ethnic groups are reconciled.
Fortunately, the far-reaching battle leaves the North northward, leading to an integration of the Tartars and their culture into the Chinese community.The Tartars gradually become part of the Li Dynasty.
He would never have known that it is himself, Li Ziming, who brings the Northern part of the country long-lived peace.
In the spring of 602, he dies of wounds and illness on his way back to the capital from a Tatar expedition.The whole nation mourns their king.
Luo Cheng, son of Luo Yi, succeeds to the throne.

Li Ziming, looking back on his life, finds that initially he hated fighting, but then realised that if he did not fight, someone would do that for him, or die for him.
So he fights against himself, against others, and then against the immortals.
Enduring great sufferings and making untold efforts, he finally killed Li Yuan with his own hands.
But caught in a deep sense of loss, he doesn't feel as excited as he expected after the revenge.
In the spring of 599, he dies of his wounds and illness on his way back to the imperial court.
The whole nation mourns, and Luo Cheng, son of Luo Yi, succeeds to the throne.
norm.李自明把帽子取下来拿在手里，顺着一个比较大的缝隙钻了过去，听到小太监们越来越近，:
Taking off his hat and holding it in hand, Li Ziming starts to climb through a wider gap of the fence.Hearing the eunuchs’ approaching, he hurriedly steps onto the plank bridge.
Not frequented by pedestrians, the bridge is covered with moss, and it is a foggy morning.As a result, he skids and is falling into the lake.
At this critical moment, Li Ziming's arm is held by a hand behind the rockery, and his whole body is pulled back as he hears a shout.
Li Ziming still in lingering fear, looks at the girl who is half-a-head higher than himself.She is about two years older than him, with a chubby face, dark eyes and snow-white skin.She looks like a fairy.
But what is funny is, she is holding half a drumstick in her other hand.
"Shhh..." the girl motions for him to stop speaking until the eunuchs walk far away.
"Who are you?"
"Yun Yao, the ninth disciple of Star-Picking Tower, Nomnomnom(chewing)..."
"What are you doing here?"
"Sneaking a snack, Nomnom..."
"You...thank you for saving me."
"You're welcome, Nom...nom...nom."
"..."
A boy who is not as high as a Cauldron calls himself his highness, and assumes an air of superiority mismatching with his age, which is really adorable instead of august.
A girl who is slightly higher than a Cauldron saves a boy from a lake, and then is busy enjoying her snack with all her attention, which makes her look attractive and particularly cute.
One doesn't know what to say, and the other is not available to speak.For the first time, Li Ziming feels that it is not bad to do nothing just like this.
Here are the cries of eunuchs, and Li Ziming knows that it is time to go, otherwise someone would be punished if he is found lost.
"I live in the Ciqing Palace.If you want to eat chicken thighs...or whatever, you can come to me." Li Ziming takes off a piece of jade pendant with his name engraved on it and hands it to her.
"So, it's okay, you are the type who is grateful" the girl directly takes the pendant, and than lowers her head to continue eating.
"I...have to go, good bye." Li Ziming carefully crosses the plank bridge and back to the main road.Groups of eunuchs who are at the end of their wits run over from a distance and look at him carefully.After being sure that he is alright, they cry and laugh in a frenzy of excitement.

Taking off his hat and holding it in hand, Li Ziming starts to climb through a wider gap of the fence.Hearing the eunuchs'approaching, he hurriedly steps onto the plank bridge.

norm.李自明被封东平王。\n新皇李渊并无新政，和以前相比唯一不同的地方便是在全国兴建道:
Li Ziming is conferred as the King of Dongping.
No new policies are rolled out in the reign of the newly enthroned emperor Li Yuan.The only difference is the rising number of Taoist temples across the nation.As Taoism is promoted in this time, elixir refiners and those who pursue immortal cultivation enjoy a high social status.
It is believed that these elixirs can keep people young forever or empower people to be strong enough.Therefore, there is a craze for it and many people trade these elixirs with their asset and even go bankrupted.
During the year, in order to avoid associating with immortal cultivation, he spent his time with Liu Ting all day.The two were inseparable.If it were not the frequent presence of brothel, there must be rumors that they are gay.
 Having a brief understanding of the nation in the letter written by his father, his desire to take avenge on Li Yuan has gradually turned into a kind of extraordinary "responsibility".
He counts the day appointed with Yao Guang to come.He must stay alive before the approach of that day.
norm.李自明本人其实对于当太子这件事是不在乎的。\n他对自己的评价是：一个很好说话的人:
In fact, Li Ziming himself doesn't care about his status.
He believes that he is an easygoing good boy.
Born to be a prince, then do the things that a prince should do; made a crown prince, then behave like a crown prince; required to learn etiquette, then practice well in life what have been taught; placed high expectations, then work hard to acquire knowledge and gain mastery over martial arts.
When he was a kid, he sneaked out his palace for fun for hours on one occasion.When scolded and asked to transcribe essays as punishment after returning, he saw that his entourages were beaten really hard for the sake of dereliction of duty.As a result, whenever he sneaks out he always thoughtfully appears back in the sight of them at the appropriate time from then on.
He believes that while confined in the palace now, he is doing his best without bringing troubles to anyone.
Sometimes he will be visited by Liu Ting.After succeeding to his father's title, Liu Ting looks more presentable than before and is of nearly the same height of Li Ziming.He brings a jar of wine whenever he comes but they always get drunk very soon.
norm.李自明大喝一声来人！贴身侍卫持刀剑而入扑向高僧，高僧笑而不避，佛光灿灿，任刀剑砍:
Li Ziming shouts, "Help!” His personal bodyguards with swords and sabers immediately enter the room and rush to attack the monk.The monk, surrounded by Buddha light, smiles without dodging at all and seems unhurt all over.
"Ziming, my young friend, I notice that you have a special connection with our Western religion, so I am here to invite you to join us.But since you have no such an intention, I might as well leave now.” The monk stands up, still smiling, lightly touches Li Ziming's forehead with his hand, and then disappears along with the Buddha light.
Then, Li Ziming falls into a dead faint, and Xiaojiu kneels down and begins crying.
Three days later, he wakes up and learns from Xiaojiu that his lifeblood has been broken by the monk’s one-finger death touch and that he has only a few days left to live.
He accepts the fact with equanimity.He has long known that the only difference between the Western religion and the Southern Li sect is that they have different interests of their own to safeguard.
Divinity, Taoism, and immortality are hard to pursue and should not be pursued.
After all, what is more pleasing is the secular world.
As a result, Li Ziming bans all pursuits of Immortal Ascension in the country and passes the throne to Luo Cheng, son of Luo Yi.
Li Ziming dies later.
norm.李自明等人按辔徐行，到城门后出示皇帝召见进京的手谕，守城的官兵竟然说手谕是假的，: Li Ziming and his guards walked slowly with horse bridle at their hands.At the gate he showed the handwritten imperial edict to gain entry.But the gate soldiers should claimed that it was a fake.Pointing to Li's knifes and swords, they viewed Li Ziming as rebels.With an order in place, a great number of archers shot on the gate tower.As a result, Li Ziming was shot dead on site.
norm.李自明等人按辔徐行，到城门后出示三皇子身份腰牌，守城的官兵竟然说是冒牌货，三皇子: Li Ziming and his guards walked slowly with horse bridle at their hands.At the gate he showed his pendant token to prove his identity.But the gate soldiers should claimed that it was a fake, alleging that the third son of the late Emperor had arrived one month ago.Pointing to Li's knifes and swords, they viewed Li Ziming as rebels.With an order in place, a great number of archers shot on the gate tower.As a result, Li Ziming was shot dead on site.
norm.李自明等人把兵器都解了，将之前的马匹换作马车，几个虎卫假扮成家丁管家，推着大包小: After disarming themselves, Li and his guards used carriage instead of horse to continue their journey.With several guards disguising as servants and bulcher.Li Ziming pretended to a merchant visiting his home with many bags.Gate soldiers inspected their packings without finding anything wrong.One of the guards gave a lump of silver to the head of these soldiers on duty.The head tested the purity of the silver with his fingernail, and then he satisfactorily waved his hand as a signal to lift the entry ban.
norm.李自明率领罗家军，沿着皇帝李密当年一往无前的路线进军，却发现事情远没有那么简单。: Li Ziming himself leads the Luo army to march along the same route that Emperor Li Mi marched on in his day, only to find that things are far from simple as expected.Ten years on, the Tatars are no longer just brave and tactless; they have made substantial progress in their military thinking.\nInstead of charging head-on with Li Ziming's forces, the Tatars lead his forces to remote areas by keeping pulling back in line with the strategy brought by their ally Oirats and force them to retreat for lack of provisions.
norm.李自明满三岁当天，册封太子。\n祭天、祭祖、民间免税双年。\n奉天殿群臣宴罢，皇:
The day when Li Ziming turns 3 years old, he is made the crown prince.
The emperor worships Heaven and ancestors, and orders that civilians are exempted from paying tax for two years.
In the Hall of Heaven Worship where groups of officials and concubines have finished their banquet, the emperor is particularly joyful, and announces to begin immediately his son's one-year-old catch ritual(On a baby’s first birthday, parents will lay out a lot of items on the floor for the child to pick from.It's said that whatever he picks is an indicator of the child's future career.)
In an apricot robe with four dragon patterns, baby Li Ziming is surrounded at the center of the hall.The highest-rank eunuch, glowingly exclaims with evident excitement,"In the right time, begins the ceremony".
Four items carefully selected by imperial astronomer are laid out in front of the prince：seal, sword made of peach wood, horsetail whisk and a pouch embroidered with lotus.
norm.李自明请教军中老兵得到了十几种克制骑兵的陷阱，命后方批量制作，并沿着长城内外布置:
Li Ziming is taught by veterans in the army a dozen traps to subdue cavalry, and then orders his troops in the rear to make them in bulk and set up two hidden lines of defence along the Great Wall and beyond.
The unsuspecting Tatars make their usual surprise attack, but lose their ability to manoeuvre before even hitting the Great Wall and are then pursued by Li's reinforcements mustered through beacon fire.
Li Ziming even deliberately places traps along the outer defences of the Wall in a random manner.The Tartars are overjoyed to see that, but only to find that double inner traps and ambushing Li Luo's elite troops await them there after they rush across the Wall.As a result they are almost wiped out.
The Tartars are then distressed to find if they could recognize any traps, then what wait for them behind the Wall are infantries.If they couldn't discover any, there might be bigger traps behind the Wall.They are put into a quandary, having no idea how to handle the situation.
norm.李自明似乎一生下来就站在了金字塔的顶端，然而在光芒万丈的身份下，却掩藏着千锤百炼:
Li Ziming seems to be on the top of the pyramid since he was born.However, behind his high status hides a tragic life which was even doomed the moment he was born.
When he is a just-weaned babbling toddler, he begins to learn etiquette from eunuchs.There are rules for eating, speaking, sitting and walking, and dealing with interpersonal relationship.
One noon, Li Ziming stands in front of the threshold of the Daming Palace which is higher than himself, trying to figure out how to step over it.
norm.李自明似乎真的认了这份罪名似的，终日在慈庆宫闭门思过，一日三餐粗茶淡饭，刻苦读书: Li Ziming seems to have really admitted the charge, spending his days in Ciqing Palace and reflecting on what he did behind closed doors.He eats simply, studies hard and rejects recreation.
norm.李自明顺着李密的话往下说。\n“兴许是小太监打了瞌睡。”\n李渊笑了笑继续说道：: Li Ziming followed his words.\n"Maybe these eunuchs fell asleep."\nYi Yuan laughed and continued, "Ziming should wake them up.Your return should be celebrated greatly.For these days, i am looking forward to your return.Now finally you come back.Your imperial father was suspicious of you and then he deposed of your title of prince.Everyone knew that he was muddleheaded.And he even abdicated his throne to me.I know clearly that i am not qualified for this throne.It did not make any sense.Now since you have come back, i will give the throne back to you." It seems that his attitude is very sincere."
norm.李自明偷偷向大家传达了指令，一声令下众人咆哮像是冲杀，却原路返回加速急奔。\n虎: Li Ziming sends an instruction to these guards secretly.So with an order, guards pretend to roar aloud and rush ahead but actually they speed up their peace to turn back.\nHorses riding by guards run faster, so these bandits are gradually left behind.When they are about to approach Gukou, they hear deafening sound with dozens of stones falling from the steep slope on the two sides of the gorge.Several guards hasten to tighten ropes.Although they are not hit by stones, the gate is blocked by these stones.All of a sudden, many bandits armed with bow and arrow stand on the mountain.Li Ziming and his guards are shot dead by the waves of arrows.
norm.李自明退下殿去，童开阳从幕后走出询问是否要斩草除根，李渊点了点头说道：“三皇子刚: After Li Ziming's withdrawal, Tong Kaiyang stepped out from behind the throne and asked Li Yuan whether he should kill Li Ziming immediately.Nodding his head, Li Yuan said, "Despite the fact that my reputation must be damaged given that Ziming is killed at the arrival of the capital city, Ziming has changed a lot.At the beginning of our dialogue, i mentioned to give the throne back to him.He gave a righteous answer which proves that he has some calculations now.I am afraid he will be a threat to us.".Finishing his words, Li Yuan made a gesture of throat cutting smilingly.\nAfter knowing the real intention of Li Yuan, Tong Kaiyang flew away just like an immortal being.

After Li Ziming's withdrawal, Tong Kaiyang stepped out from behind the throne and asked Li Yuan whether he should kill Li Ziming immediately.Shaking his head, Li Yuan said, "If Ziming is killed at this moment, my reputation must be damaged.Ziming knew little calculation since childhood.Judging from the answers he gave, i can tell that his personality hasn't been changed.Although he are mad at Li Mi, he is the son of Li Mi.Therefore he has deep affection on him."
"So we won't kill him?", Tong Kaiyang asked.
"No, what i mean is we can kill him next year.", Li Yuan said smilingly.
"I cannot understand how you mortal being think.Why you just handle things hesitantly?", Tong mocked.
Li Yuan just continued his tea drinking with no more words.
norm.李自明下令众人换上便服，在镇子里买了许多货物佯装成商旅，一路低调行军，虽然缓慢确: Li Ziming ordered his eight guards to change into casual clothes, and then they purchased a great numer of goods in the town.So as to pretend to be merchants.They marched ahead without attracting too much attention.Although it was very slow, they managed to escape several ambushes.Despite some ups and downs, it took them almost three months to arrive the Northern Jurisdiction.
norm.李自明想到了李渊的浑身本事，想到了文武盖世如父皇在仙人小小手段面前的无能为力，想:
It occurred to Li Ziming that Li Yuan was so strong with the help of these immortal beings, His father could do nothing in face of these immortal beings despite his father's superb Kungfu, and Tang Kaiyang was able to control the weather.
He has persuaded himself with many reasons, such as for the purpose of sustaining the court, making Liu Ting's sacrifice more meaningful.But in the end there is only one though left：'to be immortal' Is there anyone who doesn't want to be so?
He answeres the monk smilingly, "I am longing to build a tie with the religion."
The monk leaves happily, with the "'good indeed, good indeed' echoing around outdoors".
norm.李自明一席白衣胜雪，衣服的垂感极好，腰束月白祥云纹的宽腰带，其上挂了一块玉质极佳:
Li Ziming wore a white drapery robe with a broad belt stitched with the white cloud patterns around his waist, hanging down a fine black jade pendant.The shape of the jade looks tough but it is quaint.Li held a flagon in one hand and a glass in the other.He drank on his own.
Liu Ting worn a black clothes with the pattern of flying fish.He looked gentle in the clothes though it was often worn by those who practise martial arts.He sipped his wine.
"You can't drink any more, do you?", asked by Li.He noticed that Liu didn't drink much after he went to the toilet.
Liu answered simperingly, "Li Ziming, no one in the world knows you better than me."
"Why are you being so mushy? Are you trying to borrow money from me?", Li ziming joked.
"You will take your left leg first when you walk, and your left pinkie will crook unconsciously when you are lying.", Liu said.
"You have keen observation, please continue.", Li said while drank another glass of wine.
Liu also drank and continued, "You will raise your right corners of the mouth when you smile, and you wrinkle your left eyebrow lower when you are thinking.You are sympathetic to your enemies' women and children.And you got a strong impulse of killing when you look deadpan."
Li Ziming turned to look at him thoughtfully.
"There are three moles on you body.One is on the bottom of your right foot, and the rest are on the back.You are good at Shaolin Kungfu , and can wield the Wudang Sword, the Storm Pear Blossom Spear .You master a little knowledge of the Xiaoyao Quick Running.", Liu Ting paused a while, and then he unfastened his clothes to bare his chest.He continued, "And i know that you have some pain and itching around your left chest in rainy or cloudy days.That is because your chest were knifed by Tartars .The wound shaped like a crescent, five itches in length."
"Who the hell are you?", Li shouted.Staring at Liu, Li found that Liu born a strong resemblance to Li himself when Liu smiled in the dark night.And his scar was also the same.
"I learned to how to become you at every night when i was a child.What i like most about you is your 'No Why' style.You never ask me any reason about anything.And I even don't have to explain the reason why i always was beaten black and blue.", Liu said and he rubbed his face very hard.Surprisingly he transformed his face into one that was completely the same as Li Ziming.
All of a sudden, L i felt that he was feeble, and he couldn't see the people front him clearly.But he could still hear clearly.He said, "Liu Ting, Are you…"
"I used to think that life was bored, but because of you, i think life is okay.", Liu said.He watched Liu's head gradually falling down.
"It is a pity that we cannot be friends any more."
"I am your shadow."
norm.李自明已经做完了一切他想为这个国家和人民做的事情。\n他完成了父亲的嘱托，为天下:
Li Ziming has done everything he wants to do for his country and people.
He has fulfilled his father's wish, fighting to safeguard the security and peace of his country.He has also realized the dream of his late bosom friend, living in glory.
Now, he wants to think about himself.He, weighed down by years of military and political career and ruling of the country, wants a life of his own.And he dosen't want to see his offspring born in the imperial family like him.
Li Ziming comes to the graves of his father and Liu Ting, gives a deep bow, and then leaves.
In 604, Li Ziming abdicates, succeeded by Luo Cheng, son of Luo Yi.From then on, he is nowhere to be found.
norm.李自明在北境历练多年，自知鞑靼人野心勃勃，不能养虎为患，披甲上阵御驾亲征，带领罗:
After years of experience in the North, Li Ziming knows that the Tartars are ambitious and that he should not adopt appeasement that brings disasters.Thus, he himself leads Luo Army to launch another expedition against the Tartars.
He adopted a military strategy years ago to deal with the Tatars, namely, buying Tatar war-horses through free trade and making use of them to breed such kind of horses in bulk in his own horse ranches.Now, it proves very successful, as the war-horses of his troops are as strong as that of his enemy.
In addition, his army stationed in the North has been developing such weapons as small crossbows and three-eyed guns and tactics against Tartar cavalry, and equipped with these weapons, the Luo Army is now considered the nemesis of the cavalry.
Not surprisingly, Li's army succeeds again, cutting its enemy to pieces, and this time it does not stop and even continues to hit the territory of the Oirats(another tribe).In the end, the two tribes dare not harry the Central Plains.
However, Li Ziming knows that it is impossible to wipe out these nomads from the grasslands, and he has no idea how many years of peace in the North could be enjoyed in the wake of this battle.
After the war, Li Ziming who feels fatigued, with old injuries flaring up, embarks on a journey back to the capital.
norm.李自明直言不讳，自己乔装成商贾进城，一来是不想大张旗鼓，二来想给皇后额娘一个惊喜: Li Ziming replied honestly that there were two reasons for his disguised merchant identity：first, he wanted to keep a low profile.Second, he wanted to surprise his imperial mother.\nLi Yuan continued with a smile, "Your return should be celebrated greatly.For these days, i am looking forward to your return.Now finally you come back.Your imperial father was suspicious of you and then he deposed of your title of prince.Everyone knew that he was muddleheaded.And he even abdicated his throne to me.I know clearly that i am not qualified for this throne.It did not make sense.Now since you have come back, i will give the throne back to you." It seems that his attitude is very sincere.

norm.两只猫紧紧盯着李自明，身子压低，后足犹如弹簧一般弓起收缩，身子也抖了起来，让全身:
The cats stare at Li Ziming, their bodies lower, hind feet arch and close like springs, and their bodies begin to shake to relax their muscles and gain momentum.Obviously, they are ready for hunting.
All of a sudden, they pounce on Li Ziming, ejecting like sharp swords on a bow, tearing and biting at Li Ziming.
Hearing the prince's cry, eunuchs hurry to pull away the cats, but just in a few seconds, there have been many wounds and scratches on the his body, and he even begins to froth at the mouth and goes into convulsion.
When the imperial doctors come, Li Ziming is proved dead.They tremblingly report to the emperor that his son has died of excessive fright.
It turns out that Concubine E usually feeds her cats with raw meats or live poultry instead of the livers of lambs or pigs, and always wraps the food with red silk fabrics.
At that time, the two cats have been starved for two days.When seeing Li Ziming who is in red and brisk, they perceive him as a meal.
As the old saying goes, under blossoms and leaves hide thorns, so in the heart of people harbors viciousness.

The monk tells Li where Yao is："the monk, unemptyness, is believed to be an immortal being in his previous incarnation.He has a deep ties with our religion.We made a promise ten years ago.I promised to help you bring the gang of Nanli Taoists under control.Correspondingly he would be burned into śarīra after ten years later to be placed in the religion."
On hearing half of the conversation, Xiaojiu 's weak body trembles and then he lookes down.
"What do you mean?", asked by Li Ziming, without any expression on his face.
"He has already detached himself from his body and became the śarīra.He has integrated into the Western Religion.Amitabha good indeed, good indeed."
"My master died, the cost of the promise is his death…"，Xiaojiu whispered in Li's ear in a broken voice.

Qiong Ying is very weak since she was born.She took various herbs and medicines before the age of two.
At the age of three, her mother died of illness.But since then, she became healthy.His father's mental health fluctuates widely.Sometime she even needs to take care of her father.
When Qiong was very young, she showed her extraordinary talent in calligraphy and painting.With her father's guidance, she could integrate what she had learned together.However, women are not allowed to take the imperial examination.
Qiong is able to read the Book of Family Names at three years old, recite long articles at four years old, write essays containing three thousand characters at the age of five,and able to compose poems easily.Despite all of these outstanding achievements, she is still not allowed to take the examination.
Her neighbor Mr.Wang has a dumb son.Qiong Ying thought the dumb son is superior to her.
The reason why an eight-year-old girl desires to take the exam lies in that she believed that to pass the exam is her father's lifelong aspiration.If she can fulfill her father's dream, he will recover from the current insanity.
Now as the one-year-held provincial examination is approaching, Qiong Ying disguised herself to be a male scholar.Her appearance, figure and voice are similar to man.She even devised a fake laryngeal protuberance for herself.Even her father who is drunk cannot tell who she is.

norm.陆沉兜兜转转带琼英来到后山试炼谷。\n刚进谷，琼英便感觉到前边有一股不同寻常的阴:
After going round and round, Lu Chen led Qiong Ying to the Training Valley behind the mountain.
When they entered into the Valley, she found that there was extremely cold and bleak.At the same time, she smelt an elusive whiff of blood.
Lu Chen also realized that.He just planed to show Qiong to a random place initially, but what they meet now was out of his expectation.
He was going to apologize to Qiong Ying, because there was dangerous, and they should go back right now.But he saw Qiong Ying was staring at his back, and told him to move to her back seriously.
Lu Chen turned back and he was nearly scared to death.He saw a man hanging in the air in his back.The man's face was completely pale.
Lu Chen stood still for a while, but the man did nothing and without any action.Lu Chen thought his behavior was a shame, and he knew the senior disciple Qiong Ying would protect him.So he picked up a stone and threw it to the man.
The stone hit the man and bounced back on the ground.So the man noticed both of them.
Qiong Ying felt frustrated about what Lu Chen had done.Because finally she recalled that the strange smell generated from the man was the same as that of one from the ghost cultivator described in the books.
At the time when Qiong Ying realized, the man also moved.With a gentle waving of hand, a gale of bleak wind blew to them.Qiong Ying held Lu Chen to dodge.She asked Lu to inform their master what happened, but Lu was too scared to lift his feet.When Qiong's brain was working fast to figure out how to respond, she grabbed the hierogram of mind purity which was carved during her base building period.She had carried the hierogrom along with her all the time.
The hierogram has the effect of mind clearance.So she activated the hierogram in no time.But the man just stopped, and his pale face became clear.He said, "This is ……the hierogram of mind purity."
Then the man returned to himself and said to Qiong, "I am not the ghost cultivator.I am the primordial spirit of immortal cultivators.Don't be afraid."
However, Qiong Ying said, "Bullshit, all primordial spirit are young girls.Are you a young girl?" After saying that, she held the wooden blade and stood in front of Lu Chen to protect him.
Realizing that Qiong Ying was doubtful about his words, he bent down to pick up the stone thrown by Lu Chen before.
On seeing that, Qiong Ying was surprised, because she knew that an ordinary ghost cultivator could not touch a physical material.Since the man could pick up the stone, he must be a real primordial spirit of a particular immortal cultivator.After a while, she dropped her wooden blade.After all, whether his words were true or not, both of them didn't have the chance to win because only immortal cultivators above initial being stage can cultivate the primordial spirit.
"I am Li Ziming from the Penglai Island.In fact, i met your master before." The man said, and he was a little absent minded."About a hundred years ago, i was plotted by the Ghost Evil, so my primordial spirit was locked in the Blood-Soul Box.Luckily it was not completely refined to nothing, and escaped from the Box.But due to the over a hundred years of locking, i lost my mind, and i even forget who I am.Thanks to the hierogram of mind purity, could you please give it to me?"
norm.陆沉勘察了一番，找到了阵眼最为薄弱的地方。\n大师兄首当其冲，陆沉和琼英分列左右:
After a careful observation, Lu Chen spotted the weakest spot of the formation.
The eldest brother rushed ahead firstly, and then Qiong Ying and Lu Chen lined next to him.The three got concentrated and mobilized all their celestial energy to have a strike.
The white, black and red lights concentrated on the place marked by Lu Chen at the same time.The fierce shock made the ground shake.Then there were cracks on the struck place and these cracks grew wider.In the end, the whole formation collapsed.The three appeared in the outside world.
The three people from the Springsun Sect stood there, while the three people from decent sects died in a piece of blood.
Zhang Junhong stood up and clapped his hand.He said, "Hahahaha.Disciples from the Springsun Sect are excellent.The three seniors from decent sects are defeated.But you three are so ruthless that you kill them."
norm.陆沉评估了以力破阵的风险极大，最终大家放弃了以力破阵，于是纷纷寻找阵眼。\n琼英:
A careful evaluation of the formation revealed that it was risky to break it by force.So they gave up the idea.They chose the second method to find out the eye of the formation.
It occurred to Qiong Ying that she read the formation once in scripture garret."Since the formation could absorb these celestial energy, why don't drain out all these people and absorb these energy slowly? The celestial energy……then absorbed, and ……was transformed to the formation creator? Oh, i got an idea!" Qiong Ying thought to herself.
"Listen to me!" Qiong Ying spoke out, which drew the public attention."I got an idea! But it is a little bit risky.I don't know whether you want to have a try.I once read the principle of the formation in scripture garret.These celestial energy absorbed from our body need the formation creator to transform slowly, and use medicine to help enhance his level.Otherwise, such a behavior will lead to heaven doom.Let's transport our celestial energy to him voluntarily.He could not take all these energy in a short time, so heaven doom will ensue.How about your opinion?” Qiong Ying asked.
People under the stage began to discuss the suggestion.Several senior cultivators nodded their heads, and some people who had some knowledge about formation also supported her idea.So they agreed to transport 80 % of their celestial energy to the formation.
Three, two, one.As the order in place, the huge celestial energy were transported into the formation.All of a sudden, a gust of gale blew in.The sky was clouted with dark clouds.It was true that the thunder was about to come.
norm.陆掌门对弟子一概放养，门内更是连门规都没有。只是嘱咐他们不要作奸犯科走上歪门邪道:
The Sect Leader Lu did not pay much attention to disciples' behavior and even no regulation was set for them.Those disciples were instructed not to commit illegal acts.As for immortal cultivation, they were forced to cultivate themselves in the morning.In the afternoon, they were free to do things they like.
On the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month, after their morning classes, their master asked them to stay.Lu Chen asked whether they stayed to eat moon cake.But the master beaten his head.
Their master brought the prepared wood and carving knife, and said to disciples, "today, i will teach you how to carve a hierogram.One should use a board and a carving knife.If one is a master, he can carve a hierogram on a gold with his fingers.And the effect of the hierogram is various.The stronger effect requires more sophisticated carving skills."
Qiong Ying was looking forward to it, and this time even Lu Chen showed great interest on it.He just sat there quietly to wait his master's performance.
"En, Qiong Ying and Xiaochen, you two are not allowed to learn this yet.The prerequisite for hierogram carving is to be an immortal first, or is called base building.Later i will ask your eldest principle to present it to you.You two watch it careful, which may be useful for base building."
Qiong Ying had read book before, so she knew that base building is a hallmark of immortal cultivation for a beginner, and it is a ceremony for officially being an immortal.Base building refers to one's personal understanding of the way of everything in the world.Moreover, it is a ceremony that requires luck and talent.Since different people have different interpretations towards immortal cultivation, everyone has different ways of being an immortal.It is said that a genius finished base building at the age of eight, while someone didn't finish it in his whole life.
The process of the eldest principle's presentation can be summarized into one word：dawdling.
He complained about the uncomfortable seat, or the hot weather.Then he realized that he could not dawdle any more, so he unwillingly held the knife.
The previous languid eldest principle was mighty.And he scrawled quickly.In no time a hierogram finished.The sweat pored from his forehead, which indicated that it was not an easy job.
The Sect Leader patted on his shoulder satisfactorily, but the eldest disciple just dodged his pat.The leader didn't care it, and he took the hierogram carved by eldest disciple and crumbed it.All of a sudden, the yard was covered by a wave of coolness.Then their master began to introduce：
"This is a hierogram of coolness that can be used to beat the heat.Let us give a round of applause to your eldest principle." On hearing that, the eldest principle did not raise his head.Instead he just rushed to take a shower.
There was a strong desire in Qiong's small eyes.Suddenly Qiong felt that she was surrounded by a strong wave of celestial energy.So she wanted to have a try.

As early as two hundred years ago when Li Ziming abdicated his throne to Luo Cheng, the Luo family reigned Imperial court came into being.The founding Emperor Luo Cheng was a high achiever in political and military field.And succeeded Emperors also make every efforts to pursue prosperity for the country.As a result, the Dynasty remains thriving all the time without any sign of decline.
Although most of policies implemented during the reign of Li Ziming are passed down, the single one, the prohibition of immortal cultivation, is abolished due to force majeure.
Five hundred years later after the catastrophe of the Immortal Cultivation Community, the shortage of celestial spirit resulted from the shock of the Fight between Immortals and Demons gradually recovered.And some immortal cultivators who survived from the fight began to establish new sects, thus new immortal cultivators emerging gradually.
During the chaos of the Li Dynasty, the immortal cultivation was not widely spread.But after the founding of the Luo Dynasty, the longevity and the immortal power are a great appeal to ordinary people.Therefore a great number of private immortal cultivators emerged and they were protected by different sects.The even the constant ban of the imperial court could not curb it.
Different immortal cultivation sects fought against each other.The Monster Cultivation reappeared in southern Shu region.And the Demon Cultivation in the south of the country waged rebellion.It seemed that a world of chaos was about to approach.
In 719, the Luo Dynasty realized it was better to recognize it than to ban it.So the Star-Picking Pavilion was reopened.And the imperial court recruited immortal cultivators.In doing so, the court aimed to make a balance in the world.
In 811, the eighth Emperor Luo Chong ascended to the throne.The world was relatively peace.

norm.没有爆竹声声辞旧岁，却仍是锣鼓阵阵新年来。\n商朝的春节是十二月初一，恰逢冬雪初:
There are no firecrackers but are still gongs and drums to ring out the old year and ring in the new.
The Chinese Spring Festival in the Shang Dynasty falls on the first day of December on lunar calendar, when the first flakes of snow showers come.The Qi's reaps a bumper harvest this year, with only 70% of the grain harvested given to the owner of manor, leaving the family with a great deal of surplus grain.Firewood has also been stocked up in fall.Whenever having some cheap wine, Qi Yun will be held in the arms of his father and kissed.
The time traveler, Qi Yun is endowed with some supernatural abilities.For instance, he is able to automatically analyze in his brain matters of ancient China such as characters and daily things that have references available in modern China, and he can also both understand and speak various dialects, so if he could travel back in modern time, he would be an expert in oracle bones.
But Qi Yun soon realizes that this skill is rather useless, because he is now in the Shang Dynasty, when written language is still in its infancy and literature has not yet really been created.It makes no sense that he is quite familiar with poetry and miscellaneous rhapsodies since no one can understand.
When his father falls asleep drunk, Qi Yun cautiously gets out from his arms, in the fear of waking him up and being caught back to him.
It is snowing outside, but the weather is fine, not too cold.Qi Yun dressed in many clothes makes his way out and wanders about slowly along the village paths.Without electronic devices, the boy returns to nature to have fun.
At the east end of the village, stands an old pagoda tree with a breath equivalent to about twenty arms' length, a playground for Qi Yun, but today it has been already occupied by someone else.
Under the tree is a stone Go table and two stone piers, with two old men pitted against each other.
Go? .....it was already created in this time, but I do not know how to play it, hey.Qi Yun heaves a sign quietly, how come protagonists in time-travel novels know everything?

norm.没有心情用餐，跑到后院马厩，牵出坐骑，径直离开小镇，前往京都仪銮府。\n由于你是:
Not in the mood for a meal, you lead your horse out from the backyard stable and leave the town directly for the Yiluan government office in the capital.
As the son of the Xing family, you seldom come across obstacles in your journey and successfully meet Dongfang Qing, the head of the office.
You give a detailed account of what happened in the town and, having held out till now, you feel exhausted and have a splitting headache.
Dongfang Qing sees a faint flash of blood flashing across your forehead and comes up to grab your wrist.You feel a stream of air running through your body.
"My Lord, what is this?" You ask.
"You have been invaded by an evil spirit.I can only seal it temporarily with my limited power."
"What should I do then" you are terrified, face growing pale.
"There is nothing we mortals can do about it.We shall turn to the immortals for help."said Dongfang Qing.
"My Lord, are there really immortals in this world" you ask excitingly.
"Yes, that soul-soothing incense in your arms is the very stuff of immortals.It is said that immortals can soar high into the sky and cut down their enemies with flying swords, and those who are powerful enough can even move mountains to reclaim land from the sea." the official answers.
You touch the incense, and then bid farewell to Dongfang Qing with a feeling of apprehension.

"I don't care what happened to you before, or what i have done before.I just want to do something i want." Bukong pointed to the White Horse and turned the horse into a young man who was handsome.

"Finished." The system prompted in a perfunctory way.
"Let's go, White Horse.It is done!" It seemed that Bukong was in high spirit.
"Frozen!" Bukong stopped all these approaching NPCs from Gao Village.It seems that he doesn't want his good mood to be interrupted."
The horse asked, "How do you solve it?"
"Just a lady's longing for love.I sent you and the pig monster into her dream, and made you two a couple of the same sex.She believed what she saw, so she gave up.And she gave her sincere wishes to you two." Bukong said gently.
"Fuck you!" The White Horse's curses turned into neigh as the human body turned into a horse.
"Tianpeng, you did nothing wrong.Hahahahaha.Good Indeed, Good Indeed." Bukong and the White Horse continued their journey westward.

Having been scolded by his master and given another magic treasure, he is asked to hurry back to Xiqi and help.Huang Tianhua dares not to delay and embarks on his journey the moment he receives the treasure.
In less than two hours, he arrives in Xiqi again.Jiang Ziya is already used to surprises like this.Joyfully, anyway, he leads his troops out of the city again to challenge the four generals.The four, seeing Huang Tianhua resurrected, feel really confused and fear that he would open his mouth and say, 'Dormammu, I've come to bargain'.
Mo Liqing duels against him immediately.After a couple of rounds of battles, Huang Tianhua pretends to be overpowered and flees, and then, he turns around quickly and hits the heart of Mo Liqing who’s pursuing him with his Heart Penetrating Nails given by his master, bringing his adversary’s life to an end.
Seeing his brother’s death, Mo Lihong charges at Huang Tianhua but is killed by a blow hitting his heart too.
Having witnessed everything, Mo Lihai rushes to the frontline to take revenge but also ends up being finished off by Huang Tianhua with the same nail.
Furious Mo Lishou sends his pet out from his bag which is actually Yang Jian in disguise, but never suspected that he would be taken a bite by it.Seized by a fierce pang of pain, he is beheaded by Huang Tianhua with a single blow.
After the four demon generals are killed, Zhao Ge, or Shang Army, falls into disorder, and the Zhou Army advances.As Jiang Ziya dispatches his superior men such as Nezha who have respective strengths, Shang Army is put to rout, suffering a heavy casualty.
Qi Yun watches everything from afar and uses his technique to recognize Huang Tianhua's Heart Penetrating Nails.As far as he knows, there are few nails among magic treasures in the novel, if any, they always have power beyond imagination.
Leizhenzi has been staring off into space for half a day, and now he opens his mouth, asking, "Is it a coincidence that Jiang Ziya, Huang Tianhua, and Huang Feihu who were all killed but brought back to life soon, while those of the Shang Army really died?"
Qi Yun gets stumped by the question.Looking at Leizhenzi's childish face, he fails to give a reply at once.

norm.祁云对着云中子有模有样的作了一个道家的揖手，奶里奶气的说道：“懂也非懂”。\n云:
Qi Yun makes a Taoist bow to Yunzhongzi and says with a child tone, "Yes, I do, and no, I don't".
Looking at the adorable kid, Yunzhongzi presumes that his family elders may be believers of Human sect and continues asking, "What do you mean?"
Qi Yun replies, "The earth is a chessboard and people are Go pieces.Though I don't understand the very Go game you are playing, I am myself also part of a another Go game."
Yunzhongzi asks seriously, "If the earth is a chessboard and men are pieces, who are players?"
Qi Yun steps forward with one foot, with one hand behind his back, and points at the sky.
"Hahahahahaha, it is immortal who plays.Great." the old man in Confucian robe, Bi Gan, bursts into laughter and drops a black piece, shouting, "You have lost, Brother Yun."
Smiling a smile, Yunzhongzi does not grow upset due to his losing of the game, but looks at Qi Yun sideways.He seems to become interested in the gifted boy.
Gazing at Qi Yun, he holds a manual in his hand, and begins to say spells and predict the fate of Qi Yun.After finishing his work, he scowls heavily.
"It is strange! It is strange! You have more than a dozen different fates, either fortunately ascending to immortality, or miserably dying on the streets, and all of them are clear but hard to trace." Yunzhongzi says to Qi Yun, "I wonder if you would like to follow me to become a cultivator?"
Qi Yun thinks to himself, Well, here is the chance.It seems that striking up a conversation works.To his knowledge, Yunzhongzi is among the few who stress benevolence and righteousness and are very kind, though he is not among the top in Chan sect.
What's more, his goodness will beget good ending, as he will survive the later Jiuqu Yellow River Array.He can be regarded as an immortal of fortune and virtue.If this world is really the backdrop where the creation the gods occurs, then what is the most important is to survive.Therefore, Yunzhongzi can be a dependable master who has three fundamental values consistent with his and will not fool him.
Thinking of this Qi Yun immediately kneels down and kowtows three times and says, "Your Excellency is a man of great fortune and virtue, and it is my great honor to become your disciple.Master, please accept my obeisances."
The master nods in satisfaction and immediately follows Qi Yun home hand in hand with him after biding goodbye to Bi Gan and then explains to his parents the situation.Hearing that, his parents are sad but overjoyed, and then urges Qi Yun to cultivate seriously under the guidance of his master and not to be lazy in his training.
Qi Yun believes now that Yunzhongzi is a good person, compared with other immortals who always take children away directly like human trafficking when they accept disciples, and then years later send those kids to rescue their parents in troubles whom have believed that their kids had been missing.This makes the parents hold gratitude toward the immortals, but such behavior is actually really improper.
norm.祁云对着云中子有模有样的作了一个道家的揖手，奶里奶气的说道：“很遗憾，小子不懂”:

Hearing that, Yunzhongzi doesn't want to know more about him though young Qi Yun looks very adorable.After a while, he loses the game and leaves.
Bi Gan, however, appreciates the loveliness and smartness of Qi Yun, and orders that Qi Yun's family be exempted from 30% of the food tax after knowing that the Qi's is property of his manor.
The family is grateful and pays obeisances to the owner.
And when Bi Gan knows that Qi Yun can read and write, he likes him even more and accepts him as a student, which is greatly appreciated by the boy.
However, a storm may arise from a clear sky, while human fortunes are as unpredictable as the weather.A plague breaks out on the estate later the year, and Qi's family dies.
It is true that mortals cannot change the will of heaven, as pawns don't have free spirits at all.
norm.祁云根据以往结果正确即可的经验，想到如果自己打死赵公明，应该也算可以推动剧情发展: Based on past experience that result outweighs process, Qi Yun thinks his killing Zhao Gongming may help move the plot forward, so he comes to challenge Zhao Gongming.\nBut obviously he underestimates the power of the Golden Dragon Scissors as he is cut into two parts by it after failing to guard himself with his imitation magic treasures.
norm.祁云记得书中陆压也与孔宣有过交手，敌不过逃了，于是也想去走个过场。\n怎料他不知:

Dueling recklessly against his adversary, Qi Yun is on the point of escaping with one of the Five-Element escaping techniques, when Kong Xuan catches him with the help of his magical light.

norm.祁云觉得自己打也打不过赵公明，谈也谈不拢，所幸挂机混日子。\n由于对扎小人日思夜:
No match for Zhao Gongming and having no room for negotiation, Qi Yun can only sit and idle away his time.

The prime minister soon follows the instructions to cast a curse against Zhao Gongming.Zhao Gongming, who’s been challenging his enemy for days but gained no answers, begins to feel a bit unwell one day.After a moment’s reflection, he realizes he is inflicted on a curse, a terrifying one that might be fatal, which can be negated only when the initiator is killed or the straw effigy destroyed.As his health goes from bad to worse, he dispatches his subordinates Chen Jiugong and Yao Shaosi to annihilate the man or the object, but the two end up being killed by Nezha and Yang Jian.Zhao Gongming himself also dies from the curse and is appointed as a god.
At the victory banquet, when the crowd ask Jiang Ziya how he came up with this good idea, Ziya humbly says, "I was watching stars in the sky that night, when I heard Luya murmuring in his sleep about straw effigy.Then I hurried to look for it and found a spell related to it in a book.” what ensues is a chorus of praise.
When repeated more than twice, a rumor becomes true.Since Luya, also as Qi Yun, has a mystical background and style of behavior which tend to be constituents of interesting stories people like, people begin to hail that "Luya instructed Jiang Ziya to build a straw effigy of Zhao Gongming which causes him to death".
When Qi Yun hears the rumor, Zhao Gongming has already been dead for a few days.He can't help sighing：don't believe in rumours, nor spread them.
norm.祁云看到这里，默默的收回神识退出了直播间。\n后面的事一如书上写的那样，女娲回宫:
When Qi Yun sees this, he quietly draws back his mind sense and exits the live broadcast.
What follows is as written in the book:Nüwa flies into a fury when she returns to the palace and sees the poem and wants to immediately kill King Zhou.But after all, King Zhou, the king on earth, is destined to rule his kingdom for another twenty-eight years, and therefore Nüwa begins to plan her female revenge after calming down.
At her palace where the demon-recruiting streamers rise, which brings soughing wind, heavy mist and devil wind in an overcast sky, all devils and demons in the world are gathering and kneeling down in front of the Goddess.
Ordinary demons leave after a command from her, but the three spirits of Xuanyuan grave are asked to stay to follow instructions.
These three spirits include the thousand-year-old vixen, the nine-headed pheasant and the jade Pipa.They are asked to enter the palace of King Zhou of Shang Dynasty to bewitch him, and none of them dare to reject.
As a liberal arts student, Qi Yun was also an aspiring young man for a number of years who loved cultures and arts, though an idiot in the eyes of others.Although he was reduced to an ordinary youth after stepping into society, the affective thinking in his bones was only hidden rather than dead.
At this moment, in addition to his curiosity in the man who sets the wheels of history back in place, he deeply feels angry and sad about the misunderstanding of a man's deep feelings.
norm.祁云料想原著如此，自己既然成了陆压，还是得遵从结果原则，于是一剑取了白天君姓名。: Qi Yun kills Bai Li with a single slash of sword in line with the result in the book since he is now Luya.\nWith the Blazing-Flame Battle Formation broken, Xiqi wins a landslide victory.
norm.祁云亲自经历了数场大战，从初上战场的震撼到尸横遍野的残酷，他才明白那句话，马革裹:

Leaders of Chan sect who are merciless and see all humans as worthless things, manipulate the whole process of creation of the gods at will, leading a huge number of ordinary men and cultivators to lose their life.And unfortunately, the dead were in the dark about everything, and thought that they were killing in wars, on behalf of the way of heaven and justice.

Suddenly, he hears a reverberant "Amitabha", and looking up, he finds that he is surrounded by a complete white.What's the matter? A daydream?

Name：Zhunti
Strength：???

norm.祁云上了终南山玉柱洞，此时雷震子还未入到云中子门下，他就成了嫡传。\n这一年里祁:
Qi Yun goes to Jade Column Cave atop Mount South End when Leizhenzi has yet to become a disciple of Yunzhongzi, so he is direct lineal disciple.
During the first year, he has made some progress and also figured out why immortals like to set up their dwellings in some strange places, because they are simply the places most rich in spiritual energy in the world.
After he learns the basic method of Breathing Exercises, namely expelling the turbid Qi within the body and drawing in the Qi of the natural world, spiritual energy surrounding Mount South End begins to enter his body automatically and continuously, so even when he is eating and sleeping his cultivation base grows.As a result, he feels like he is playing an idle game that is over-popular on the market in modern time and gaining currency and leveling up by merely clicking on the screen repeatedly.
In the context of the creation of the gods, it is considered late for a boy like Qi Yun to get initiated in the cultivation world at the age of 5, because in contrast, Leizhenzi begins at the age of 1, and some starts even when they are still in their mother's womb.Qi Yun used to grumble about this setting in games before time-traveling, but now it seems it is interesting to level up through merely repeated clicks on the screen.Then he cannot help praising the game, saying, idle games are so interesting, come and play infinite immortality with me.Eh? It is strange, why I would suddenly come up with such a line?
In addition to cultivating, Qi Yun also asks his master about people and things in the cultivation world, and he feels relieved after learning that their stories are basically consistent with the plots of Creation of the Gods with which he is familiar.
For the time being...it is the 6th year under the reign of King Zhou, and the ensuing year is the time for the story of King Zhou dallying with the Goddess Nuwa.With the idea that only he knows well the main plot of the whole story can he survive, Qi Yun has learned a magical art which helps him see what's happening in the mortal world from Yunzhongzi on the pretext that he misses and wants to see his parents.
The art is not difficult to learn, but to apply it with ease is hard because it requires a mental chanting of a target's geographical location, a possess similar to that of Baidu map.But it can not be more useful to Qi Yun, as he knows the exact time and place of the great events of the story by heart.
norm.祁云上山转眼已经是第7年了，除了日常偷窥，其他时间都在勤勤恳恳跟随师父学习道术，:
It’ s been the 7th year since Qi Yun cultivated on the mountain.In addition to watching the mortal world everyday, he devotes the rest of his time to diligently following his master to learn the Daoist magical arts.He is good in nature, and always sees eye to eye with his master.As a result, his master is very fond of him, and even wants to present him with all his magic treasures.
What Qi Yun takes is only a monster-revealing mirror, which is used to conceal his identification skill.As for important weapons of main plot like Gold Stick and the Stick of the God of Fire, he dares not to accept.But the more non-greedy Qi Yun is, the more his master likes him, and he is even taught by his master the skill of creating weapons.
Qi Yun is amazed to find that the skill is really remarkable.It is so useful that as long as one grasps the principle and structure of other’s magic treasure, he would be able to create an imitation.And the effect of this imitation depends on its material chosen, which means that if the material is better than the original, an imitation that exceeds the original can be made.
Indeed this skill is amazing, but to apply it is a problem, since no one will make public the principle and structure of his magic treasures.Besides, it is easily criticised by others, so Yunzhongzi usually just uses it to create some talismans and other things in bulk.
But for Qi Yun, it is of great use, because when he tries to apply his intrinsic system identification skill to his monster-revealing mirror, surprisingly he is able to gain insight into its principle and structure, and he is ...shameless, who doesn't care what others think of him and what he cares about is only his own life.
Then the next crux is about raw materials.It is true that in the cultivation world things important are wealth, partners, methods and cultivation places, among which what ranks first is wealth.One can't make bricks without straw.As a result, Yunzhongzi is aware that his disciple begins to become greedy for money ...But he doesn't take it seriously, because after all, he is satisfied with him overall.

norm.祁云思来想去也放心不下雷震子，但是自己出手的话恐怕会影响太大，于是将雷震子传音喊:

norm.祁云思量再三，把自己在女娲宫的见闻，以及自己对这个局的了解用猜测得出的口吻都说给:
Qi Yun thinks twice and decides to tell his master what he saw in Nüwa Palace and his conjecture about the scheme.
Yunzhongzi feels shocked after knowing everything and Qi Yun wonders if this is a blow too great for his upright and honest master.
Just as Qi Yun is worried whether he can accept the truth or not, Yunzhongzi rises in anger with hand-seals.He wants to shed light on the truth in the world of cultivation.
At the eight-view palace of the Xuandu cave in Da Luo mountain, Daode Tianzun, who seems to be refreshing his spirit by closing his eyes, is in fact constantly performing divination.Slowly opening his eyes and heaving a sigh, he feels pitiful for the two skilled men.After hesitating for a while, he arrives at the gate of Yunzhongzi's cave with a wave of his hand, and in just one breath destroys the whole Jade Column Cave by activating his Diagram of the Utmost Extremes, together with Yunzhongzi filled with indignation and Qi Yun who is just aware of something wrong.
It is often said that the way of heaven can not go against, but what is the way of heaven? Perhaps it is the rule set by power holders.
norm.祁云思量再三，决定沉默是金，倒不是信不过自己的师父，而是太信得过了，他觉得师父一:
On second thoughts, Qi Yun decides not to tell his master anything.He knows too well his master, whom would definitely make the inside story known to the world once he knows about it, and there is no telling what the consequences would be.Therefore, he might as well work hard to gain mastery over magical arts to protect him quietly.
The moment Qi Yun makes this decision, Yunzhongzi notices that one of dozen different lifelines of Qi Yun dims, following several that already dimmed in the past two years.He himself doesn't know why.And in managing to foresee his future, what he sees is still in a state of chaos, so he can not help worrying about his disciple.
What an amiable teacher and a filial apprentice they are.
Daji is a qualified fox spirit who, in one year, has wrecked the Shang Dynasty's fortunes.
She develops a cruel torture to tie Mei Bo(the Number One Grand Counselor to King Zhou) to a bronze pillar heated with charcoal fire, causing him to burn to death.
She schemes against and kills Empress Jiang and drives her two sons away.
She bewitches the king to kill the Counts of the East and the South and imprison Ji Chang the Count of the West in Zhao Ge, leading the lords across the country to launch rebellions.
She forces Shang Rong to bang his head against a column at the court to death, and subjects Zhao Qi to a cruel torture, thus deterring anyone from remonstrating and bringing about the near collapse of the great Shang Dynasty.
norm.祁云思量再三还是决定告诉师父云中子事情的前因后果，他事先准备好了一番说辞和铺垫，:

After this argument, Yuanshi realizes that Yunzhongzi would not agree with him in any way, so he kills him, and Qi Yun whose mind is seen through, is wiped out too by his world-beating magical power.
norm.祁云虽然对阐教众人有所不齿，但也知道大势所趋天命难违，自己如果加入截教，虽然心里: Qi Yun holds disdain against Chan sect, but he also knows that it is better to follow the order of heaven.He will feel glad if he joins Jie sect, but he might be put at risk of being killed, and worstly, destroyed to smokes and ashes.As a result, he decides to take sides in Jiang Ziya(Chan sect) along with Leizhenzi.\nBut here comes the problem.To his knowledge, basically all junior disciples of Chan sect are also killed in the war, and to avoid this he must find a way to become a direct lineal disciple of the sect.But he does not know what will happen if he, who should not exist in the sect, becomes one of its direct lineal disciples.\nWhen he arrives in Xiqi, Qi Yun gets caught in another moment of hesitation.
norm.祁云虽然想过遵从原著，但是实在是下不去手，只是困住白天君，让他散去阵法，便出阵。:

norm.祁云眼看着大哥们一个个被收走，自己并没有陆压那些本事，万一没逃掉也被收走呢，那五:
Seeing a bunch of immortals have been caught one after another, Qi Yun hesitates to fight considering what if he fails to escape since he is not as skilled as Luya himself, and he has no idea why the light is so mysterious that those who are released from it all become listless.Why not come to Zhunti, the one who might beat Kong Xuan as written in the book?
Qi Yun then uses his technique to call the immortal, and in a burst of white light Zhunti descends from the sky.
"Master, this Kong Xuan has a special bond with our Western religion, so why don't you have him converted?", says Qi Yun, who is already used to the master’s opening line.
"My friend, you do have the magical prowess to foretell things, that's exactly what I intend to do".After saying this, he vanishes into thin air.

norm.祁云以道术传音请来准提帮助，他记得原著中并没有描述阐教如何与西方教联系的，而今生: Qi Yun then calls Zhunti for help via his voice transmission technique.He doesn't remember that in the book there's any account of the way Chan sect keeps contact with Western religion, and now he realizes he's the very intermediary.Upon Zhunti's arrival, he finds that many followers of Chan sect are somehow"connected to the West", and then happily asks his brother Jieyin Daoren to come over to shatter the formation with him.\n
norm.祁云以陆压的身份找到赵公明，他自诩当时自己破十绝阵对截教众人留有情面，殊不知申公:
Qi Yun, in his capacity as Luya, tells Zhao Gongming that he held respect for his brothers in breaking the ten Battle Formation, unaware that Zhao Gongming is very angry with him since Shen Gongbao accused him of killing Bai Li after torturing him.
