norm.祁云仔细想了一下，至今为止，发生的事情可能过程与书中写的不同，但是结果一定是相同: After careful consideration, Qi Yun believes that what has happened so far may be different from what is written in the book, but their results must be the same.And Yunzhongzi as the immortal of fortune and virtue, would beget good ending if nature is allowed to take its own course.Otherwise, if the master knows too much, messing up the cause and effect, no one knows what the future will hold in store for him.\nIn the 13th year of King Zhou, Qi Yun is ready for the war.\n
norm.祁云走近，方才看得清两位老者。\n居左的老者手持白子，鹤发童颜，仙风道骨，这么冷:
Qi Yun walks up to have a clear look at the two old men.
The head-hoary old man on the left of the chessboard who holds white pieces, looks young and has a demeanour of a transcendent being, wearing only a Taoist robe in such a freezing cold day.
The other on the right with black pieces, wearing a thick Confucian robe, differs from the ordinary obviously.
The closer Qi Yun approaches, the stranger he feels.Suddenly, he realizes that there is not a single snowflake overhead around the two.Looking up, he finds that the big tree has already withered with only dead branches left, and it can by no means be a shelter from every snowflakes.While he hesitantly looks at the two old men again, some kind of message comes into his mind itself.
Old man in Taoist robes：
Name：Yunzhongzi
strength：???
Description：A disciple of Yuanshi Tianzun of Chan sect, and a practitioner of qi in Jade Column Cave atop Mount South End, he is an immortal of fortune and virtue who is most compassionate in his sect.
Old man in Confucian robe.
Name：Bi Gan
strength：5

Qi Yun's interpretation ability is activated.He sums up after many tests that this ability would only be activated when he comes across people or objects that did exist in history, and the interpretation results are completely correct.

norm.且说元始天尊、道德天尊、准提道人、接引道人一起来到阵前，准提笑眯眯劝通天收了阵莫:
The four,Yuanshi Tianzun, Daode Tianzun, Zhunti Daoren and Jieyin Daoren, come to the front of the formation together.Zhunti smilingly asks Tongtian to annul the formation otherwise he would have to duel against four.Tongtian Shrugs off the advice and enters the array directly, which mutes Zhunti and makes him give a wistful half-smile.
After a moment’s discussion, the four step into the array too.
Yuanshi Tianzun enters the Immortal Executing Gate.With auspicious clouds overhead, he is prevented by thousands of golden flowers and myriad jade-like stones from the Immortal Executing Sword.
Jieyin Daoren enters the Immortal Slaying Gate.Three Buddhist relics rising from his brain soul help keep the flying Immortal Slaying Sword away from him.
Daode Tianzun enters the Immortal Falling Gate, and he immediately raises his Ling Long Pagoda which gives out one thousand rays of lights to nullify the power of the Sword of Immortal Falling.
When Zhunti enters the Immortal Eliminating Gate, he slashes the Seven-Treasure Tree that releases a thousand green lotuses to stop the Immortal Eliminating Sword.
The four swords, symbol of death and destruction, cannot be restrained by a saint without greatest treasure.And If they are controlled, it means 80% of the power of the array is lost.
Seeing this, Tongtian Jiaozhu flies into a rage and wields his sword to interfere with the four saints.He charges directly at Jieyin Daoren, but his body is well protected by colorless lotus flowers discharged from his fly whisk.
The other three saints while keeping immortal swords in place, draw back to attack their common opponent with other magic treasures.At one point, Daode Tianzun's flat crutch, Yuanshi Tianzun's Jade scepter and Zhunti's newly acquired mount are mustered.
Barely can he handle the four, Tongtian is overpowered.With a low shout, Zhunti then calls out his avatar with twenty-four heads and eighteen hands, each hand holding a magic treasure to attack Tongtian.
Tongtian who’s at a disadvantage is hit by Daode Tianzun with one smash of his crutch, and then smashed in the front heart by Zhunti, and finally he has to flee away through technique of escape.Followers of Jie sect scatter then, and among them those who are skilled defect to Zhunti who convinces everyone by repeating the line "you are destined to join our Western religion."

This formation is mind-bogglingly powerful, containing pills and chanting that can damage immortal’s spirits, souls, form and qi, undermining them physically and mentally.Upon entering the trap, immortals will be reduced to be mortal, and mortals will be ended at once.
Therefore unfortunately, the twelve immortals of Chan lose their thousand-year Taoist attainment in a day.
What on earth is Taoist attainment? It is actually something that distinguishes immortals from ordinary cultivators.Magical arts refer to the art of escape and unconventional ways that Jiang Ziyia and Zhang Guifang can employ, while Taoist attainment is something those who are gifted accumulate for years, equivalent to record of schooling.To increase Taoist attainment requires passing of multiple tests, namely, examinations.The Twelve Immortals have lost their attainment in the trap, equivalent to students deprived of their post-doctoral diplomas, and if they want to regain their attainment, they have to go through another thousand years of cultivation.
The Twelve Immortals are destined to meet this as a result of their cultivation method.In the wake of the ten battle formations, they thought that they had weathered their doom but little do they expect that the previous difficulties are only the tip of the iceberg.Among senior disciples of Chan sect except Randeng who flees away as fast as he could, only Nanji Xianweng and Yunzhongzi two immortals of fortune and virtue are spared.

Qiong Ying was stunned on hearing that.She was not sure whether she should call the man "grand-master".
The man waved his hand and said, "Just get up, Hanxin, when i was still alive, you seldom knelt down in front of me.Why you now do it?"
"I used to think that master died and disappeared into nothing.Your primordial spirit became reincarnated.But I don't expect that you are still alive, and you attached on the jade pendant." The Coldstar replied.
The man didn't respond to it.
The Coldstar asked, "The primordial spirit stayed in secular world for such a long time, and it has nothing to attach.Even though master , you are the King of All Demons, it is possible to end up with the disappear of body and soul."
The Nanshu Priest smiled and said, "It doesn't matter whether i am alive or not."
The Coldstar asked again, "Does the elder brother Shen die?"
The Nanshu Priest stopped for a while and then blinked his eyes.He replied, "He does not disappear completely.But i shattered the fire of soul in the Blood-Soul Box with my own soul, which deals a heavy blow to him.But Shen went so far.He integrated the Box into himself, so his own soul and energy also became the soul and energy of the Box.Since he could not enter into the round of incarnation, he is no longer a man any more.You can view him as a dead man."
After asking all what he wanted to know, the Coldstar called Qiong Ying.It seemed that he wanted to show off his disciples were better than his master's.Qiong Ying reached out and grabbed the corner of her master's coat.But she failed.She was shock.
"Many years ago, my eldest brother deviated into evil.At that time, your grand-master was practising in isolation.So i had to chase out lonely.I was defeated by the Blood-Soul Box, and in the end only a wisp of soul escaped from it.Xiaoying, actually master has died very long ago."
Qiong Ying was confounded and she was going to burst into tears.
Lu Hanxin said to Qiong Ying, "This is the Leader seal of the Springsun Sect.Bring it back to your eldest disciple Ye, and tell him to take care of you."
After finishing his words, he looked Qiong Ying affectionately and he said in a very low voice, "I am gone."
Then he disappeared on site, which was like a glow of shredded light hitting into the soil.He could not be found any more.And the King of All Demons also disappeared.

Ignoring the eldest brother's wink, Qiong Ying took a deep breath and it occurred to her that she had the Blade of Heavenly Evil along with her.This moment could be viewed as urgent, couldn't it?
She unfolded the scented pouch and placed it on her palm.As expected, the Blade turned into the real size.When Qiong held the handle, the remaining celestial spirit in her body was drained.The Blade, not be activated for a long time, began to vibrate and generate pleasant clinking.Then Qiong felt that a whiff of celestial spirit mixed with bloody smell was transported from the handle, and it was much stronger than last time.
Now the eldest brother had gotten a back out because of the vibration.Qiong Ying held the Blade and attacked from the behind.She stabbed the back of the leader of the black.Then the leader stepped aside immediately with blood bleeding all the time.
"You should capitalize him." Qiong Ying realized that somebody was talking to her, but she found on one opened his mouth.Was it the Blade that talked with her?
After checking his wound, the leader was astonished because it was very strange:the flesh wound just kept bleeding and it was getting worse.When he noticed that the Blade that Qiong held was the Blade of Heavenly Evil, he was stunned.It is said that it will take seven days for the wound caused by the Blade to cure.
The leader took out a red pill from his packing and swallowed it, but the wound didn't cure.However, the body's hematopoietic function was greatly enhanced.He rushed towards Qiong Ying.
As the Blade was touched with blood, Qiong Ying noticed that the blood was visibly engulfed by the Blade.When it finished, the Blade was a little red.Then the celestial spirit transported from the handle was stronger with stronger smell of blood.
Realizing that the leader in black was rushing towards her, Qiong Ying wielded her sword to fight against him.Although this was her first fighting, the Blade Technique of Springsun that Qiong had practiced thousands of times was helpful.She found out that she was quite familiar with the technique.As long as her eyes could keep pace with the opponent's motion, she knew how to handle in her mind.After several rounds, the leader realized that Qiong's technique was perfect, if he continued to fight with her, he would drain to death.
The leader in black retreated a step to stay away from Qiong.In doing so, he aimed to summoned his talisman, a flying sword.The flying sword flew in an exceeding speed, and flew towards Qiong directly.Qiong dodged it by wielding the Blade of Heavenly Evil Soul.As she rushed ahead, the leader in black operated the flying sword and stayed away from her.But what was unexpected was that Qiong Ying crushed a hierogram of land drilling.So she reappeared at the behind of the leader.The leader was hurried to operate the flying sword to attack her.So she could retreat.But Qiong didn't dodge at all.Instead, she just hacked the leader's chest directly.She herself also attacked by the flying sword with the sword penetrating from her back to her chest.Both the leader in black and Qiong Ying were dead.The Blade of Heavenly Evil was transformed into a glow of light flying into Qiong's body.

It was true that Qiong Ying died.
But since her soul was attached on the Blade of Heavenly Evil, her soul was temporarily kept.But it only could be kept for seven days in secular world.
At this time, Qiong Ying, in the form of the soul, met the primordial spirit of the cultivator Li Ming who was given the hierogram of mind purity.
His primordial spirit hadn't reentered into his body yet, but he studied the way of souls and spirits.So his primordial spirit could still stay in secular world.He recommended a method to reshape Qiong Ying's body which was not yet proved effective by predecessors.Qiong Ying took his advice immediately.
Li Ming showed Qiong to the 3000-feet Chilly Pool in the Soul Valley, and he gave her half spirit-condensing jade.
Qiong Ying began to practice at here day and nigh.She had to endure the suffering of the Chilly Pool and reshaped her body with her energy of complete yin combined with the spirit-condensing jade.But such a behavior was anti-nature order.Therefore it triggered the heaviest thunder from the Heaven.Li Ming had already waited on her side.By employing a particular talisman, he led the thunder to his body.With the thunder stricken on him nine times, his primordial spirit reentered into body.
Qiong Ying bowed to Li Ming to express her thanks.Li Ming smiled and waved his hand, "Never mind.Thanks to your hierogram of mind purity, otherwise i am still a wild ghost.And i also need to suffer nine times of the thunder before my primordial spirit can reenter into my body.We are helping each other, so don't bear in mind.Since my primordial spirit has separated from my body for many years, i got many things to handle.The Meeting of Demon Slay is held in Tianji Palace recently.Do not go there if you don't have to.I can foretell that it's very dangerous there."
Li Ming left.Qiong Ying who was in the form of her body felt exceedingly frigid.So she jumped tens meters high.When she stood outside of Chilly Pool, she checked her level：she already enters into the Body Integration stage.
And then she examined with her celestial commonsense.She found out that her initial being disappeared.The initial being was formed when she stepped across the threshold of being a priest with heart.It was a sword-embryo instead.She was very familiar with it, and then she realized that it was the Blade of Heavenly Evil.

Qiong Ying followed the Coldstar Lay Buddhist.
The lay Buddhist was gentle.And it seemed that he didn't have bones.When he held Qiong, it gave the impression that a playboy led his young mermaid.
Before their departure, he gave a crystal-clear jade to her father.The hanging of the jade could help maintain a clear sense.So her attitude turned better to the man, but she still doubted whether the man was a swindler or not.
The Coldstar yawned and said, "Our sect is called Springsun Sect, with the younger brother of the one of the Eight Immortals Lv Dongbing as its founding father.The sect is a sister sect with the prestigious Puresun Sect."
Qiong Ying thought to herself that just keep telling a story, watch out maybe Lv Dongbing would send a thunder to you.
Coldstar turned a blind eye to her response, and continued, "Our way of immortal cultivation is into the mortal world.Having meal is immortal cultivation, so does farming land and going to toilet.And doing what you like is also immortal cultivation."
After hearing that, Qiong Ying thought it was unavoidable to chop firewood and carry water in mountain.
When Coldstar was going to brag about his sect, a strong gale of wind came with thunder and lightening.It seemed that torrential rain was about to come.
Coldstar held Qiong Ying to run towards a shabby temple.
While running, Qiong Ying muttered to herself, "You are a great master who have a good command of arts.You still need to take shelter in a temple?"
"When conducting immortal cultivation, one should not adopt celestial arts for convenience, which is viewed as a way of test." He got an exceedingly good hearing.He ran ahead and responded to Qiong as well.
But it rained too fast that even a wild cat got totally soaked, let alone both of them.
The two came in the temple awkwardly.Coldstar tended to tell Qiong what was immortal cultivation when a smell of fish flew in and disrupted his mind.He sought where the smell came and then saw a ragamuffin who was one or two years senior than Qiong Ying at the corner of the temple.
The boy set a ball of fire and had a wooden grill devised from something unknown.There was a big black fish grilled on the wooden grill with a lot of grease coming out.At this time, the boy was sprinkling some seasonings on the fish, with a strong fragrance coming out.
He took a gulp of his saliva and then went straight to the boy.He greeted to the boy and said carefully, "Dear friend, you got unique bones, so i believe that you are a talent once in a hundred years in immortal cultivation.Why don't you follow me to go into mountain?"
The boy seemed smart and was unlikely to be deceived by the man.But he nodded his head and approved.Qiong Ying guessed that the boy was happy to find a deceptive organization which should be his home.
The ragamuffin kowtowed to Coldstar and gave the grilled fish to him with his two hands.It was viewed as a ceremony for apprentice.

A lay Buddhist passed by her house where he went for a bowl of water.Qiong Ying instead of her drunken father entertained the man.
The man was in his thirties with a pair of strangely blue eyes.He yawned all the time, which suggested that he was a dawdler.Instead of an immortal cultivator, he was more like a middle-aged man who experienced sudden abjection.
When he was drinking, he glanced at Qiong Ying for a while.Such glances made Qiong uncomfortable.After his drinking, he insisted that he should meet her drunken father Mr.Liu.Qiong had to crouch at the corner of walls.She hoped to hear their conversation, but failed.She just saw her father nodding his head all the time.Needless to say that it was the man's deceitful words that caused it.Qiong was going to rush in to stop the swindler.But when she was about to speak, the man took a hierogram from nowhere.He took it with his two fingers and than touched her father's head gently.All of a sudden, the hierogram turned into a wisp of smoke, and then flew into her father’s nose and mouth.In no time, her father's eyes were clearer.And he was not so insane anymore.His father looked normal and thanked the man promptly.

norm.琼英如在春阳派时那般自律，练刀，念经，刻符，打坐。\n琼英今日如往常般练刀回来，:
Qiong Ying was as disciplined as she was in the Springsun Sect.She practiced the Blade Technique, read scriptures, carved hierogram, and sit in medication.
After practicing the Blade Technique, Qiong went back her room.When she opened the door, her smile disappeared.She realized that someone had entered into her room.
She checked her room carefully to make sure the people had gone.She found a slim blade on the table.It was not a wooden one, but a real one, with dazzling light.
Qiong Ying closed the door carefully.She noticed that there were many unknown hierograms and spells carved on the blade.She wanted to touch the blade, then she stopped when her finger and the blade was half-inch apart.She felt that the blade was animated, and it was magically ecstatic.
At the moment, Qiong found a note under the blade which reads, "The Blade of Heavenly Evil returns to where it belongs to.Do not use it if unnecessary.Bear in Mind!"
Qiong Ying touched the blade gently.It could be felt that the blade was ecstatic.And then the blade minimized itself into a pendant size.
Qiong Ying put the pendant into her scented pouch and hung it around her waist.Then she went to the scripture garret of the Tianshu Island for some useful clues.She found some recordings about the blade at dusk：The Blade of Heavenly Evil, is acclaimed as a magic blade because there was a righteous powerful man holding it to kill three demons in a row.
However less than five years later, the righteous man passed away.The Blade was therefore snatched by another demon.From then on, many people were killed by the Blade.And the demon almost became a King of ALL Demons.So the Blade became the Evil Blade in the world.
A few years later, the demon died suddenly.Then the Blade once again became a sharp weapon to defend justice and eliminate evils wielded by a righteous mighty man.But the man died several years later.His disciples believed that the Blade was ominous, so they called it The Blade of Heavenly Evil.And they threw it into the Eastern Ocean.From then on, on one saw the Blade.
After reading this, Qiong Ying was in a panic and she didn't know how to deal with the Blade.
norm.琼英说不清为什么，她觉得这把刀跟师父，或者说自己的门派有些渊源，以及字条上的物归: Qiong Ying didn't know why, but she believed that the Blade had something to do with her master, or the Sect.And she very cared the returning of the Blade to its owner written on the note.\nShe didn't tell anyone about the Blade.She just carried it along with her all the time.
norm.琼英思量再三，觉得这清心符是自身唯一有用的东西，担心和男鬼是惧怕此物想骗过去，于: After careful consideration, Qiong Ying believed that the hierogram of mind purity was the only useful thing.She worried that the man tried to deceive it, so she refused to give it to the man.And she told L u Chen to inform their master what happened.\nThe man shook his head and he tried to say something.But his eyes became dim and he resumed to be frigid as before.And he didn't speak any more.It seemed that he lost his mind again.\nWith a waving of his hand, a gust of gale flew again.As Qiong Ying and Lu Chen, they couldn't resist the gale.As a result, they died eventually.
norm.琼英思前想后，还是决定算了，她觉得自己一定哪里有疏漏，着延续几百年成熟的科举制度: After careful consideration, Qiong Ying decided to give up her idea.She believed that something must go wrong.Because the system of the imperial examination was mature and it had spanned for several hundred years.It was impossible for her to take advantage of it.\nAlthough she didn't take action, she kept the habit of disguising herself as a boy.
norm.琼英问师父何时才能用真刀，师父让她不要心急，心中有刀，手中自然有刀: Qiong Ying asked her master when could she use a real sword.Her master told her to be patient.If she got extremely familiar with the sword in her heart, she would be able to wield a real one in her hand.
norm.琼英想了想，将木牌放在了地上，而后谨慎地抓着陆沉往后退了十几步，男人脸上喜色一闪:
After a moment of thinking, Qiong Ying placed the wooden carving hierogram on the ground and retreated dozens of steps backward together with Lu Chen.The man was happy and then reached out to get the hierogram.All of a sudden, the hierogram emitted strong glow and then turned into a cloud of white light flying into the man's body.In no time, the bloody and stinky smell from the man were not so strong as before.And he looked not so pale.
The so-called Li Ming took a deep breath, and took a low bow to Qiong Ying and Lu Chen.He said, "I cannot express my gratitude with my words.Please send my sincere wishes to your master.The Ghost Evil Shen Yuan held grudges with the sect.So tell him to be careful."
After finishing his words, he disappeared in the air.It seemed that he had not existed at all.
"What does he mean?" Lu Chen asked curiously.
Without answering his question, Qiong Ying had a blackout and toppled on the ground.
norm.琼英一行人马不停蹄安前往东边寻找阵主: Qiong Ying and other people rushed to the east to search for the fomartion creator
norm.琼英再三思量，不知道该如何处置，便把事情汇报给了大师兄，大师兄思量再三，觉得这刀: After careful consideration, Qiong Ying didn't know how to deal with it.So she reported it to the eldest disciple.The eldest disciple thought twice, and he believed that the Blade was ominous.Since the number of disciples in the Springsun Sect was diminishing, he thought the Sect could not bear the burden of the Blade.\nHe told Qiong not to be worried, and he would handle it properly.After careful consideration, he could not figure out a good method.In the end, he threw the Blade into the Ocean in a dark night.\n
norm.琼英再三思量，觉得这刀肯定是个祸害，秉着报喜不报忧的原则，她也没有跟大师兄说。\: After careful consideration, Qiong Ying believed that the Blade was a trouble.Just like what all the Chinese do:only report what is good while concealing what is unpleasant, Qiong Ying didn't tell the eldest brother what happened.\nAt the very that night, she threw the Blade into the Ocean quietly.\nJust go back to where you come from.
norm.琼英正闭目养神，突然觉得天黑了，她睁眼一看，方才还晴空万里的天空此时已经乌云密布:
Qiong Ying was taking a nap.Then she found out that it was dark.So she opened her eyes, noticing that the bright and clear sky had turned into cloudy one.
All the boats on the sea stooped, and those predecessors who flew in the air before also stood on their board quietly.It seemed that they were going to face some formidable enemies.
At this time, a series of freak laughter came from the sky, which made all present people tremble.
The eldest disciple came out of the board and jumped to the small boat from the big one.He held Qiong and told her to follow him to the big boat.Qiong wanted their master to go with them, but she couldn't find him after a round of searching.She got a spasm of panic, and took the eldest disciple's hand and said to him, "Our master is missing." The eldest disciple replied, "I have no idea.I am also looking for him.You go to the big boat first.I don't know what will happen in here." Then he had a hierogram of track tracing pasted on Qiong Ying.He was afraid that Qiong Ying would also missing so he did so.He pulled Qiong in the big boat with one hand, and then he continued to search for his master.
After searching for a while, he could not find the master.He returned to the big boat with a pale face.He said, "I am familiar with the smell.It is the smell generated from the ghost cultivator." Qiong Ying thought to herself that the smell was the same as the smell from the primordial spirit Li Ming she met several days ago.
When she looked up, she found that more and more vague ghost shadows appeared in the dark sky.These numerous shadows turned the Eastern Ocean into the port of the Naihe Bridge.Why there are so many ghost shadows?
How strong the Ghost Cultivator Shen Yuan is?
norm.琼英挣脱大师兄的怀抱，看向台子: Qiong Ying freed herself from the eldest brother's arm, and looked to the stage.
norm.琼英筑基成功后，提升的飞快，两年突破了八段。\n大师兄入门的早，琼英入门时大师兄:
After Qiong Ying's successful base building, she improved so quickly that she reached Golden Level Ⅷ within two years.\nSince the eldest disciple started his apprentice earlier, he had already reached the Golden Level Ⅱ when Qiong Ying was ushered by master to began her apprentice.In fact, the eldest disciple should improve faster due to his great talent.But he was reluctant to experience tests when he was in the bottleneck of the base building level Ⅸ.It was not until one year later that the master forced him to leave the mountain to finish his test.In the end, he reached Golden level.After that, he didn't begin his training on the excuse of the tough training.
However, that is not the case for Qiong Ying.She worked very hard, and her quick enhancement motivated the eldest disciple.So he reached Golden Level Ⅶ.Lu Chen finished his base building last year, one year later than Qiong Ying.He improved very slowly.He reached base building level Ⅲ at present because he focused his attention on something interesting.Even in immortal cultivation, he was addicted to some interesting spell, such as series traps, paper person, and immortal connection in formation.\nOn the eighth of the eighth lunar month, the four of them did not used to eat moon-cake.So they just focused on doing their own things.At the clock of eleven, as Lu Chen sneaked out, he bumped into Qiong Ying.So he said to Qiong, "senior sister disciple, i saw a ghost at there, which scared me to death." Qiong believed that this was a trick from Lu.Last time, he told her that there was a ghost in order to scare her.But she still wanted to have a look for the purpose of caring the younger disciple.
norm.琼英走过去，她能感觉到如果李明对自己这些人有恶意，临死前也能将众人抹杀。\n“我:
Qiong Ying went over there, and she could feel that if Li Ming held grudges against them, he could kill them before he died.
"My real name is Li Ziming." Li Ming said slowly.
"The predecessor of the present Luo Dynasty is Li Dynasty whose last emperor was me.At that time, it was peaceful, so i abdicated my throne to Luo Chen.Now i know it's a wise decision.Then i traveled around with Yun Yao.But given that she had learned some skills of immortal cultivation, she could live much longer than me though she didn't master some martial arts.As time went by, i was getting old, but she didn't change at all.At the beginning, i loathed immortal cultivation.And she never persuaded me to have a try.She just shed her tears secretly at the realization of the fact that i would die before her.Then one day, she went to the Soul Slay Cliff for the spirit-condensing jade for me with the aim of extending my life.But she never came back.I searched her crazily, but i could not even find the entrance of the Cliff." Li Ziming coughed heavily.And he continued.
"From then on, i have been searching for methods to resurrect her.I even reopened the Star Picking Pavilion to mobilize the whole nation to search her.Then i turned to Ghost Cultivator.The Blood-Soul Box knew my desire, so it tempted me into cultivating the Ghost Cultivation in order to engulf me.My body was integrated into the Box, with only the primordial spirit left.Then i met you, and the hierogram of mind purity given by you restored my sanity.They you died.I witnessed how grieved your eldest brother was.He was just like me back then.So i found you, trying to instruct you to use the spirit-condensing jade to reshape your body.It was a surprise that you made it.And i also have my primordial spirit back to my body thanks to the thunder triggered by your body reshaping."
"Later i prepared the formation of Immortal Slay, because i wanted to go to the Heaven to look for ways to resurrect Yun Yao since no ways were available in secular world." Li Ziming said.
"It was fantastic for you to lead the thunder in advance, but you are too late.I took some elixirs to expand my celestial energy pool and facilitate digestion.Before i entered into Heaven, i can feel that i am about to fly into the Heaven and become an immortal."

After Randeng escapes, he realizes that things have gone terribly wrong and rushes to visit Yuanshi Tianzun.
When Yuanshi Tianzun comes to the battlefield and sees what's happening, he turns back to invite Daode Tianzun.
In the presence of the two, three xiao Niangniangs begin to feel scared, but now that many disciples of Chan sect have been trapped in the formation, it's too late to retreat so they decide to keep on fighting till the end.
When the two enter the formation, Qiongxiao Niangniang slashes forth Golden Dragon Scissors upon them, and Daode Tianzun riding on the back of his ox simply lifts forth one of his sleeves, fixing the scissors in the air in an instant.
While Unverse Muddling Dipper is wielded by Bixiao Niangniang to make an attack, it is taken away by Lao Tzu with his Wind-Fire Cushion.
The three are at their wit's end and lunge forth at the two immortals with their swords.
Daode Tianzun who even has not yet gotten off his ox, unfolds the Universe Cloth and catches Yunxiao directly, toppling the entire Unicorn Cliff upon her body; Qiongxiao has her skull smashed by the Jade Sceptor and dies; Bixiao ends up even more miserably with her flesh dissolved in a magical casket.
After Daode Tianzun breaks the Yellow River Trap, the twelve celestials are awakened.With only techniques left, they are saddened to accept the truth that they have to spend years to reinstate their Daoist attainment.
The two Tianzuns return to their respective palaces after finishing their rescue, leaving the rest in place staring at one another, sighing and groaning.

norm.若要追溯世界的起源，便是盘古。\n在天地还没有开辟以前，整个世界处于混沌状态，他:
The genesis of the world is credited to Pangu.
In the beginning, there was nothing and the universe was in a featureless, formless primordial state.Pangu was the first being of the universe.Waking up from his sleep lasting tens of thousands of years, he found that he was shrouded in a complete dark.Then he separated the chaos with a swing of his giant axe, creating the earth (something murky ) and the sky (something clear and light).
To keep them separated, Pangu stood between them and pushed up the sky.Each day as he grew taller, the sky and the earth grew farther apart.This task took many many years, and until the sky and the earth finally became settled, Pangu collapsed from exhaustion, never to wake up again.
After his death, his breath became the wind and clouds; his voice, thunder; his eyes, the Sun and the Moon; his limbs, towering mountains; his skin, vast land; and his blood became mighty rivers.
This is how the world took shape, when not a creature could be seen.
Along with Pangu's death, his essence became living beings; his breath, a way of heaven to enlighten all; and his spirit disappeared into thin air.But it is believed that the spiritual energy that cultivators absorb is his very spirit.
Many years later, his spirit transformed into a human being, called Patriarch Hongjun who founded the Taoist sect and took on three disciples, one being Daode Tianzun, another Yuanshi Tianzun, and still another being Tongtian Jiaozhu, in charge of Human sect, Chan sect and Jie sect respectively.They were collectively called three masters coming from One Breath.
At the same time, all living things were enlightened, and the world was divided into three realms.
The three realms include the human realm, which was ruled by the human emperor Fuxi; the demon realm, where all living things other than humans were brought together; and the immortal realm, where both humans and demons could join only by cultivating and ascending to immortality.
When the immortal world came into being, all gods were human beings who succeeded in cultivation as demons enlightened were next to none.
As all creatures are malleable, many demons and devils gradually established themselves immortals too, but they were excluded because of their background.As a result, cultivators in the demon world began to regard human-transforming as a milestone in their pursuit.

norm.三位弟子接到鸿钧老师传唤自然是不敢怠慢，连夜赶到紫霄宫。\n既然说到这里就不得不:
The three disciples rushed to the Zixiao palace the moment they received their master's call.
Now let's have a brief introduction of these three disciples.
The eldest disciple, Daode Tianzun, in charge of the Human sect, was responsible for teaching and enlightening the mortals.His sect covered all human beings who had yet to join other sects.Therefore, he was a household name among mortals.
However, although there were a number of disciples in his sect, most of them were mortals, and only the three saints of the Fire Cloud palace, Fuxi, Yandi and Xuanyuan, ranked high in the cultivation world.
The second apprentice Yuanshi Tianzun was the head of Chan sect, and his vice-sect leader Randeng Daoren, was a man of great and unpredictable powers.His sect was featured by a small but outstanding number of disciples; among the first generation, there were twelve distinguished disciples; and among the second generation of disciples, Yang Jian, Leizhenzi, Li Jing and his sons, Huang Tianhua, Tu Xingsun, Yin Jiao and Yin Hong were also very outstanding.
The third disciple, Tongtian Jiaozhu, was at the helm of Jie sect.His sect had no classes, accepting anyone who had magical abilities in the three realms, establishing itself into a large-scale group characteristic of great powers.Among the first generation of disciples, the best included Duobao Daoren, Jinling Shengmu, Zhao Gongming, Holy mothers of three skies(Qiongxiao, Yunxiao and Bixiao); among the second generation, Wen Zhong, Huoling Shengmu stood out for their superior talents; and 10 lords of heaven, 36 generals of heaven and 72 malignant stellar gods were also excellent representations.In a word, Tongtian Jiaozhu was blessed with an army of distinguished disciples.
Although different from each other, the three sects were a family in essence.However, they found hard to get along well with different features of their owns.
In Human and Chan sects, cultivators were all human beings who followed the path of "benevolence", restraining themselves and denouncing killing; in the Jie sect, many demons, spirits and monsters whose lives differed from each other, were willful and unrestrained, often acting according to their own preferences.And the minority of them were so cruel that they ate animals raw and drank blood.As a result, friction always occurred between Chan and Jie two sects.
Now let's shift our focus back to the Zixiao palace, where three sect leaders arrived, and were quietly waiting for their master's speech after greeting.
After a long time, Hongjun began to say, "Now with the establishment of the heavenly court, we face the issue of job vacancy.Haotian turned to me for help, so I am here to consult with you."
Tongtian straightforwardly asked, "How many people you need, sir? It's our great honor to do our favor since we were also the witnesses of its foundation, to say nothing that now it is you who ask for help."
Hongjun gave an approving nod and said after a pause："We need 365 deities and 74,000 celestial soldiers and generals."
Astonished, Tongtian regretted that he really shouldn't have given such a reply, and looked up helplessly at his two brothers, while Yuanshi looked directly away from him.
Daode Tianzun who was good at fortune-telling, began to use his Diagram of the Utmost Extremes(Taijitu) to predict the future.After half an hour he opened up his eyes, and started to think aloud that "This is the will of heaven, the will of heaven", with the others daring not to say anything.Another half an hour later when the master finished his work, he said slowly to Hongjun, "Just now, I divined the will of heaven and learned that there will be a war in the mortal world that may oust the old dynasty and replace with a new one.We might as well bestow upon a man of virtue the Fengshen Bang, a list that empowers him to endow the excellent ministers and brave generals who die in the war with heavenly ranking and elevate them to their roles as deities.I will select men from my disciples as 74,000 heavenly soldiers and generals, and I hope that my two junior brothers could deal with job vacancy of gods."
The other two exchanged a look with each other, thinking that since their own disciples would also get involved in the war that their senior brother had predicted just now, and the brother himself had already made commitment, they could by no means just shirk.The next to pledge was Yuanshi, "Although there are not many people who have attained immortality among my disciples, I also have a duty to inscribe their names on the list, and we will see if they could eventually be enlisted as gods or not."
So did the Tongtian Jiaozhu.
To strike the iron when it was still hot, Hongjun immediately summoned Haotian Emperor into the room, where he was asked to create a Fengshen Bang with his heaven and earth pen, with the three sect leaders signing the names of their own disciples behind divine posts.When everything was done, the Emperor expressed his thanks and left the Zixiao palace, and the three leaders left too.

norm.上次考核时，传功长老吩咐过将所修功法修至小成后可前往宗门大殿，递交申请，成为真传:
During the last test, the Elder of Chuangong Hall told you that one could go to the main hall of the sect and submit an application to become a core disciple of a master after reaching a certain stage in practicing his cultivation method.
A core disciple will be given more resources from the entire sect.
At present, there are only five such disciples in the sect, all of whom are exceptional talent.With the spirit stone rewarded by the sect as you win the first place in the exam, you study cultivation method in your residence alone.
After practicing days and nights, you finally reach the state of minor achievement today.Although still at the early stage of Qi refining, you can now exert your spiritual energy to facilitate the growth of plants.
It seems the right time to apply for becoming a core disciple now since you cannot continue your cultivation any further on your own.
After you submit your application a few days, a lay brother comes and asks you to go to the main hall for a ceremony.
When you arrive at there, you meet the sect leader, the Elder of Chuangong hall and your senior brothers, the other five core disciples.You are then given the Daoist name Cold Wind, and calmly finish reading the sect oath as required.The ceremony concludes with your paying respects to the ancestors of the sect.

Now among the Ten Formations, only Blazing-Flame Battle Formation remains.But Bai Li is still calm and fearless.
The Xiqi side does not know there is a man called Luya.Immortals look at each other, and none of them want to be involved in killing again after getting through their doom.
Qi Yun is also bewildered, and suddenly he finds himself shrounded in a white light and dragged into the lotus world again, with Zhunti descending from the sky with a smiling face.
"My friend, I see that you are waiting for someone to break this formation," he says.
"I am just watching.I have no idea who can break the formation," Qi Yun says, trying to muddle through.
"There is no need to hide anything from me, since you and I are in the same religion now, and I find that you are a kind man that I appreciate after a-long-period-of-time observation of you.”he continues.
"To be honest, through my divination technique I’ve learned that someone has indeed the capability to break this formation, but I don't know where he is", says Qi Yun.
"I believe, he’s been here for a long time, but he himself doesn't know who he really is", adds Zhunti.
"Where is he?" Qi Yun asks.
"Right here.I am not him, then you must be him, my friend", continues Zhunti, "You need a new identity to join our religion.I have removed your original karma, erasing all previous relationships you built and the memories of others of you."
Qi Yun appears taken aback.But this might be really good for him, because perhaps only to appear with such an identity can he be spared from doubt of Heavenly way.He nods and says, "That may work."
Hearing the answer, Zhunti continues, "Great.Since your previous karma has been cut off, now you need a new daoist name, why don't you call yourself Luya? And please hail yourself hermit before our Western religion comes to help Chan sect at the agreed time."
Qi Yun astonished, mutters that no wonder Luya is still absent and no wonder his background can not be found in the novel, it turns out he is originally a time-traveler? He himself is the very Luya?

norm.时光流逝，转眼已到天圣十九年春。\n又到了一年一度的童试，考场外挤满了赶考的考生:
As time flies, now comes the spring of 1041.
It is time for the annual child exam, and the doorway of the examination hall is packed with candidates who are accompanied by their friends or relatives.
You arrive at the hall accompanied by your mother when there are half an hour to go before the exam.
"dunh-dunh-dunh"after the ring, an official shouts, "Now it's the time for candidates to enter the examination hall in an orderly manner".
Hearing that, you wave goodbye to your mother and enter the hall.
Skimming through the paper, you find that it is different from the previous ones which are based on poems and essays writing and eight-legged essay; instead, it focuses on classics and scriptures and discourse-writing on politics.
As you have been dedicating yourself to metaphysics and the I Ching and seldom pay much attention to current affairs, you can only try your best to finish the poetic part.
Four hours later, you turn in the paper as required and quietly return to your family's carriage.
Your mother asks, "Rui'er, how's it going?"
"Not very well, most of the topics are unfamiliar to me." you reply in a low voice.
"It's OK, you got another chance.Let's go home."
Three days later results are released, and not surprisingly you fail.

norm.事实上皇帝老子还是特别照顾三皇子的。\n满月当天，监察院接到密令复查大皇子中毒案:
In fact, the prince has been cared particularly by his father.
The day when he turns one-month old, the Control Yuan receives a secret order to reinvestigate into the poisoning of the first prince.It involves more than one hundred people, 50 percent of whom are put into exile, 40 percent decapitated immediately and the rest, end up with the nine familial exterminations.
When he is 6-month old, the Control Yuan begins to inquire into the miscarriage of the second prince without laying bare the details and result of the case.But a few days later, Dong and Lv two concubines commit a suicide by hanging themselves in their palaces, and a group of officials are deposed or relegated to outlying regions.
Fights among concubines are abated for a while, leading to a seeming peace admist chaos.Empress Guo adopts the eldest prince, actually the third prince, with great mercy, which reinforces her magnificent air of authority.It seems to be a happy ending.

norm.事已至此，祁云感到一阵莫名的心酸，他并没有收回神识而是继续窥探。\n他是文科生，:
At the point, Qi Yun is seized by a pang of inexplicable grief, and he does not withdraw his mind sense but continues to peer.
As a liberal arts student, he was also an aspiring young man for a number of years who loved culture and arts, though an idiot in the eyes of others.Although he was reduced to an ordinary youth after stepping into society, the affective thinking in his bones is only hidden rather than dead.
At this moment, in addition to his doubts about who sets the wheels of history back in place, he deeply feels angry and sad about the misunderstanding of a man's deep feelings.
His feeling is perceived by a mind sense from Mount Kunlun which just made a move, and he is immediately discovered that he is not Yunzhongzi himself.Suddenly, an attack is made to hit him, and he fails to dodge, killed with his mind sense broken into pieces.

norm.收起了自己的怀疑精神，收拾好心情重新上路，不日便来到了法门寺，寺里的和尚赶忙出来:
Bukong was not doubtful anymore.He adjusted his mood and set out again.A few days later he arrived the Famensi Temple.Monks in the Temple rushed out to welcome him.
At night these monks gathered together to discuss Buddhism.The chief monk of the Temple asked Bukong, "The journey to the west is so tough.You are so excellent to tough it out."
Bukong thought to himself "How can you know that i am going to the west since i haven't mention it.Are you guys NPC(non-player character)?." But his face was determined with his palm pointing to his heart, "As long as i have a strong faith, i will be able to overcome every danger." After hearing this, the monks praised his determination.
Next day Bukong left Fangmensi Temple and rode his horse to continue his journey.Within a few days he came to Hezhou, the boundary of Tang Dynasty.The general military commander, local monks, and Taoists arranged Bukong to have a rest in Fuyuansi Temple.
According to the original script, Bukong should spend a night at Fuyuansi Temple.Bukong realized it and then refused to stay at here.So he continued his journey.By doing so, he attempted to test the response ability of the system.People in Fuyuansi Temple did not force him to stay, so after entertaining Bukong, they saw Bukong off.
Despite the scorching sun, Bukong was not hot.And it was inconvenient to ride along mountain road.So he walked the horse along the road.He walked ao fast that the horse could not keep pace with him.
Several hours of their walk, the night fell.Bukong found out that a spooky atmosphere scattered around in the front.He felt extremely happy.
He thought, "Here comes the instance zones.I am going to strike creeps.All i got were dialogues and running quests.I want to have a fight."
Bukong tied the horse where they were, and then he moved forward carefully.The overgrown road was difficult to move ahead.So he expected to strike boss very soon.
All of a sudden, he fell down.At this time, Bukong made a gesture and recited the word "riding the wind"silently.In no time a gust of celestial wind helped him from falling into the trap.
"Take him! Take him!" A group of petty monsters appeared after a gust of wind.But they didn't saw any person in the trap.When looking up, they saw Bukong standing in front of them safely.These monsters did not know what should do.So they turned to their king, the King of Tiger, for further instruction.
The King of Tiger was good at acting.He improvised by waving his hand and instructing "My men, go ahead!" All these monsters rushed ahead without thinking too much.After all, they were good at obeying instructions.
Bukong put his hands together to bow calmly, and he said "Amitabha" at the same time.Then he adopted a Taoist spell with one of his right hand fingers pointing to these monsters, and he uttered a word "frozen".All these monsters couldn't move immediately.
Bukong watched the King of Tiger with a meaningful smile on his face.Although the Tiger was jaw dropped, he pretended to be confident and asked "Are you the monk who comes from the Tang Dynasty in the east and will go to the west for Buddhist scriptures?"

norm.书信如下：\n别来无恙，道友近期判的案件可还顺畅？\n受到人间反馈，由于道友判鬼:
The epistle reads as follows：
Well, how are the recent cases adjudicated by you, Daoist, still going well?
Received feedback from the earth that due to your mistake in sentencing ghosts, the evil spirits were released back to the earth without receiving the proper punishment.Now the evil spirits are still on earth, do you dare to take the responsibility?
If you still misjudge good and evil, don't blame me for being ruthless.
norm.书信如下：\n别来无恙，道友近期判的案件可还顺畅？\n受到十殿阎王反馈，由于道友:
The letter reads as follows：
Long time no see, daoist friend recently judged the case is still smooth?
Feedback from the Ten Courts of Hell, due to the mistake of the Daoist judge of ghosts, the good people who should have been transferred to the reincarnation earlier were punished in the hell, I wonder if you can admit your guilt?
This punishment is only a small one.If you still misjudge good and evil, don't blame the emperor for being merciless when the time comes.
norm.书信如下：\n大人，我冤枉啊！我是一个好人，生平所历之事中，善举之七八，不至于因: The letter is as follows：\nLord, I have been wronged! I am a good person, and I have done seven or eight good deeds in my life, so I should not be sent to the eighteenth level of hell because I was naughty and mischievous as a child.My Lord! Don't be gullible to trust treacherous people, and please give me a clean slate.
norm.书信如下：\n大人，我在地狱忍受折磨七七四十九天，终于有了机会给您书信一封，望您: The letter reads as follows：\nLord, I have been suffering in hell for seventy-nine days, but I finally have the opportunity to write to you.I really do not understand why I did good deeds in my life but did not receive good fruits, my lord! I am truly wronged.
norm.书信如下：\n老人常言道，做好事有好报，果然没有错啊，我前世就是因为做了很多好事: The letter reads as follows：\nThe old man used to say that good deeds are rewarded with good karma, and I was indeed right.I did a lot of good deeds in my previous life and accumulated enough yin virtue to keep the Lord of Hell from escorting me into the Ten Hells.In this life I have to accumulate yin virtue just like I did in my last life.
norm.书信如下：\n没想到我躲了一辈子，也终究没逃得过惩罚。如今的我在地狱当中经受十阎: The letter reads as follows：\nI never thought that I could escape punishment after a lifetime of hiding.Now I am in the Ten Hades of Hell.It is really a cycle of karma and retribution.
norm.书信如下：\n判决不公！我生前做了那么多善事，死后居然进入了十八层地狱忍受折磨！: The letter reads as follows：\nThe verdict is unjust! I did so many good deeds during my life, but after death I have entered the eighteenth circle of hell to endure torture! Heaven has no eyes, when I reincarnate in the future and regain my cultivation, I will retaliate with an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth!
norm.书信如下：\n为何？为何我一世英名，接济他人，就连大雷音寺的主持都说我是功德万世: The letter reads：\nWhy? Why am I sentenced to this painful hell by you, when I have been so famous in my life, helping others, and even the presiding officer of the Great Thunderbolt Temple said that I am of great merit and virtue? I am resigned! God does not help me!
norm.书信如下：\n我曾经虽是个恶人，但自从受到了您的审判之后，我醒悟了，开始改邪归正: The letter reads as follows：\nAlthough I was once an evil person, since being judged by you, I have awakened and begun to change my ways.I have tried hard to perform various good deeds in order to make up for the mistakes I made in my previous life.The thing is that after helping the old man for the first time, seeing the old man's heartfelt smile, my heart was inexplicably touched, and since then I have to be a good person, and also thank you, here I offer a small gift, and I hope that you will accept it.
norm.书信如下：\n我重回人间后，作恶多端，不曾悔改，哈哈哈哈哈。: The epistle reads as follows：\nAfter I returned to earth, I did much evil and did not repent, hahahahahaha.
norm.书信如下：\n我做了一辈子的恶都没有收到惩罚，反而到了地狱当中受尽恶刑，即是情理: The letter reads as follows：\nI have not received punishment for my lifetime of evil deeds, but instead I have been sent to hell to suffer all kinds of evil punishments, which is both reasonable and unexpected.It is true to the old saying, "The wicked will have their own way."
norm.书信如下：\n因为我上辈子的恶事太多，导致我当初在地狱当中受尽了折磨。这一世我打: The letter reads：\nBecause I did too many evil deeds in my last life, I was tortured in hell.In this life I intend to be a good person, to do great good deeds, and to become a great fruit of the Way.If I can really find it, it will not have been in vain that I have spent two lives searching for it.
norm.书信如下：\n在十八层地狱受尽艰苦后并没有磨灭他内心中黑暗，再次回到人间时，他如: The letter reads as follows：\nAfter suffering all the hardships in the eighteenth level of hell did not wear out the darkness in his heart.When he returned to earth again, he did as much evil as he did in his last life, but he would rob the rich and give to the poor, and would not bully the weak, which is perhaps what he followed.
norm.书信如下：\n真的是谢谢您啊，我的地府大人，如果没有您的误判，我才不能这么轻松的: The epistle reads as follows：\nI am really grateful to you, my Lord of the Earth, for without your misjudgment I could not have got out so easily and turned a good life.I really do thank you! But what about the fact that I am already an evil person, a villain who does nothing but evil, and I do not intend to change my own mind in this life.

After the swallow, a system prompt in Bukong's head "An important prop is missing! Please get it back within half an hour.Otherwise the quest fails."
Bukong sneered in his mind "Fine, the horse is more important than me.Who set the plot?" But he still fought against the dragon.Although he moved to the cliff in no time, the white dragon did not slow down, and it was about to dive into the stream.
Bukong had to accelerate his spell casting.But he was not clear about the dragon's weakness, he had no choice but to cast a spell to the stream.
"No water" With an order in place, Bukong cast a spell immediately.As a result, the flowing water was frozen instantly.The white dragon had no time to dodge, so it smashed on the ice heavily.
The amiable monk rode the wind down on the ice slowly.He cast a spell of "mountain lifting"to the petrified white dragon.Then mountains around were lifted on the dragon.Since the dragon is water-born, it could not move in face of the spell of land-bound.It had to beg for mercy."Dignitary, please spare my life, please spare my life.I got a quest to do so.I was forced by the West XXX (whose name was prohibited by system).Please spare my life."
Bukong smiled and cast a spell of "No speaking".He bowed and explained, "Don't you know that disasters come out of mouth? What you have said is shut by the system.How dare you to shout it out.Just shut off your mouth.I ask you question and you just nod or shake your head."
The dragon nodded its head vigorously.
"You are forced to eat my horse,not out of your own will?"
The dragon kept nodding its head all the time.
"My merciful Buddha.If so, i don't mean to be harsh on you.But I also got my quest.The disappear of the horse will lead to the death of me.I suppose you will feel guilty if i died?"
The white dragon nodded quickly.
"As for the adult creatures, his job tends to determine his way of life.If you don't like your current way of life, why don't you change a job?"
The dragon nodded its head unconsciously, but then it tilted its head which meant that it didn't know how to change because the job was arranged by its father.And others were envious of the job.
How Bukong could tell so much information from a simple head titling.He bowed and said smilingly, "Amitabha, I have already arranged a job for you." While saying this, he took out a rein behind.
"……"The white dragon didn't make any response.
"Since you don't shake your head, I think you agreed Amitabha, Good Indeed, Good Indeed."
System prompt that "The prop 'horse 'has found.The quest continues."

norm.苏妲己进宫，纣王当即着了道，话说苏妲己也算是老pua高手了，每天利用自己楚楚可怜:
King Zhou immediately becomes obsessed with her the moment Su Daji presents herself at the court.She can be considered an expert in pua (Pick-Up Artist), who avails herself of her charming and delicate face similar to that of the king’s dream girl and tells him whatever she is doing is for his own good and whoever go against her are the malicious.Over time, the wise and powerful King Zhou completely turns into a fatuous ruler who loses his head over lust.
Qi Yun inadvertently becomes the spokesperson of Jade Column Cave atop Mount South End due to his spying on King Zhou with a mind sense when he was writing an erotic poem to Nüwa.Immortals didn't offensively inquire about the mind sense, since they thought it belonged to Yunzhongzi, who actually has no idea who is the very initiator of the war of the mortal world.
Yunzhongzi, a compassionate and benevolent man, always cares about the mortal world and is good friends with Bi Gan, and consequently, no demon dares to haunt within a hundred miles around Zhao Ge.This time, the fox spirit's coming owes to Nuwa’s authorization.
It is not long after the fox spirit entered Zhao Ge that Yunzhongzi notices the city is haunted.He pays a visit to the city of his own accord and is introduced to the king by Bi Gan.
King Zhou is displeased when he sees him bowing without kneeling down and asks, "Where do you come from?"
Yunzhongzi replies, "I come from cloud water".
"What is cloud water?"
"A mind that is like a white cloud always at ease, and a mind that is like flowing water at will."
King Zhou, being a wise and intelligent ruler, continues asking, "Where will you return when the cloud water dies out?"
The Daoist says, "when clouds are scattered there will be a bright moon in the sky, and when water drys out there will be a pearl."
Hearing this, the king shifts from anger to joy and says, "Great.And I wonder what you want to see me for?"
Yunzhongzi answers, "When I was collecting medical herbs at the peak of a mountain, I saw a sign that the capital was haunted, so I come here to exorcise the evil spirit."
Seeing that Yunzhongzi is immortal-like, King Zhou decides to believe him and hangs the sword given by him in his palace.
Soon, Daji is severely hurt by the sword and almost returns to her original form.King Zhou feels panicked about her sudden illness, and is coaxed to burn the wooden sword by her on the pretext that "the sword frightens me".With the blaze, the Shang Dynasty is doomed to end.
When the twelve immortals of the Chan sect hear about this, they can not help clapping their hands and praising Yunzhongzi in private that he did a great job.Because of him, their sect will by no means be picked on, and in the future they can defend themselves that "they did their part" in preventing the great war.They now also feel ashamed of themselves for doubting his qualification of knowing the inside story about the Creation of the Gods and snooping on King Zhou’s taking the blame.He turns out to be a crafty old devil, though he always lays low.
norm.苏妲己设计害死黄飞虎的妹妹与正妻，黄飞虎在手下四将的撺掇下反商，过五关斩三将投奔:
After his sister and wife are killed by Daji through scheme, Huang Feihu who is persuaded by his four subordinates to rebel against the Shang Dynasty, defects to Xiqi despite all obstacles.
When the Grand Old Master Wen Zhong returns from his suppression of rebellion, he takes over the chaotic court and immediately sends the Chao twins to capture Huang Feihu in Xiqi.
Unfortunately, the Chao twins are no match for the distinguished generals Huang Feihu and his sons whom are assisted by Jiang Ziya, the military advisor.They end up being defeated and induced to capitulate.
Wen Zhong bursts into fury after hearing the news, and then Zhang Guifang volunteers to lead a campaign against Xiqi, starting the first fierce battle.
Seeing the right time coming, Qi Yun tells his master he wants to go down the mountain for experience, and the master gives his consent.Leizhenzi who feels bored at the mountain wants to leave with him together, and Qi Yun agrees, as he believes things may turn out good though this is not the very right time for him to leave.
After arriving in the mortal world, Qi Yun asks Leizhenzi to put away his wings and magic treasures and transform into a normal human form.Now, Qi Yun is facing two paths, to help King Wen of Zhou or King Zhou of Shang in public, and to help Chan sect or Jie sect in secret.He knows that Chan sect is destined to suffer a great loss in the great war, in which King Zhou would be overthrown, but nonentities of Chan sect would also die and then be granted a post of god.What should he do?
norm.苏护听闻纣王要给自己当女婿，竟拒不领旨，还斥责纣王沉迷女色误国，纣王也没打算强取:
Knowing that the king wants to be his son-in-law, Su Hu rejects the demand and accuses the king of harming the country for obsession with women.King Zhou is not going to take his daughter by force, but as a king, he will by no means admit his mistake.Therefore, he does not make any response to Su Hu’s criticism and intends to let things go hang.But no one expected that Su Hu would be such a man who is seemingly tough but actually weak, as he runs back to Jizhou overnight to launch a revolt in case that he will be killed first after he criticizes the king.
King Zhou would have just written an article criticising him for defying his authority and then forgive him, but before the lord ran away, he wrote a poem on a wall："The King has gone against principle of feudal moral conduct.Su Hu of Jizhou will never go back to visit Shang Dynasty."
The poem is...how shall I put it...not written beautifully but pithily and rhythmically, somehow like words from a kid.
Seizing this opportunity, Fei Zhong and You Hun spread widely the poem by Su Hu and accuse him of rebellion which is proved by Su Hu’s troops mustered in Jizhou.King Zhou has no choice but to launch a crusade against him, since the dignity of king can not be challenged.
Later on, Chong Houhu is dispatched to suppress Su Hu, but fails the first time.Then the younger brother of Chong Houhu, Chong Heihu, who is asked by Ji Chang, the Count of the West, to persuade Su Hu to surrender, pretends to help his brother fight against Su Hu.
When in war, Chong Heihu specifically requires to see Su Hu, but is rejected by the haughty son of Su Hu and involves in a battle with him.With the help of Taoist magical arts, Chong Heihu defeats and seizes Su Hu's son in a few rounds, which scares the piss out of Su Hu.At the point, one of Su Hu's generals Zheng Lun （also known as General Hmm of Hmm-ha Two Generals）, takes the initiative to fight and defeats Heihu with more outstanding skills.Then Heihu seizes the opportunity to explain his intentions to Su Hu and hopes him to weigh up the pros and cons, saying that he should not be so impetuous and that sacrificing his daughter would spare the people of Jizhou from being slaughtered in war.Seeing the way out, Su Hu decides to send his daughter in person into the king’s palace as a concubine.
King Zhou, who would like to avoid wars, now feels delighted with the result, giving Su a great number of rewards.Things seem to settle with a happy ending.
But Qi Yun, spying from afar, knows that Su Daji has been replaced by a fox spirit on her way to Zhao Ge, where a turmoil is about to occur.

norm.台下又是一片群情激愤，大师兄满不在乎的样子说道：“不要吵不要吵，我们春阳派出魔头:
People under the stage were indignant again.The eldest brother said carelessly, "don't make noise! Be quiet.It is a tradition for our sect to cultivate demons.Just look at our grand-master, and the elder uncle.Why you still cannot accept it?"
The two unexpected guests did not enraged Zhang Junhong.Instead he was happy and said, "It is ok.What is the decent sects opinion?" the senior from decent sect nodded his head.
"Please finalize your fighting list.Given that the fighting is merciless, both sides need to sign your names on the waiver.If someone got injured, both side should not instigate problems on the excuse of it."
For the decent sects, they chose the Ziyang Cultivator from Kunlun Mount, Hanli Priest from Qixuan Sect, and Nun Qi from Chuanyang Mount.The opponent was the three people from Springsun Sect.Both sides signed the waiver, and then took a deep breath to enter into the formation.
The formation was a loop.After entering into a tiny space, there were three transportation gates in front.Lu Chen, Qiong Ying and Ye Tianhe exchanged looks with each other.
Lu Chen lowered his head.He still looked like the ragamuffin who made mistakes many years ago.
Now the eldest brother has become the leader of the Sect, and he said to Qiong Ying, "At that time, your death pushed Lu Chen left the Sect.I looked for him for many years, but failed.Then it was said that there was a master of demon cultivator in the southern Shu area.The master killed the evil dragon first, and then integrated it into his body, so he cultivated a body of evil dragon.He defeated several leaders in these demon-surrounded areas, so he became one of the four demon leaders.The man is your young brother Lu Chen."
"Elder sister, t thought you died, but i didn't commit anything illegal." Lu bowed his head and didn't dare to speak.
Qiong touched his head gently.She didn't scold him just as she did many years ago when Lu Cheng made mistakes.
"Let's save our words, and get down to business.Let's break the formation first.Each of us takes one gate." The eldest brother interrupted.
"The eldest brother, and elder sister, i also have studied formation in recent years.I think the formation is a little bit strange.It is not like a complete formation, but instead it is a sideline of a particular big formation.You two be careful." Lu Chen reminded.

norm.提示说明：\n1）本游戏是一款文字修真放置类游戏，适用于年满16周岁及以上的用户:
Instructions：
1) This game is a kind of Textual Cultivation Idle Game, which is suitable for players of 16 years old and above
2) This game is on the baseof Chinese cultivation stories, simple and motivvating.The contents have no connections with the real history and events.The gameplay is based on body control to achive the targets by encouraging playes to cultivate characters and pass the instance.There are also strangers' social system based on text.
3) There is a used certification system in the game, regulating users under 18 years old need to follow the below rules：
Part of the gameplays and items in the game need to be paid, users under 8 years old is forbidden to pay; and users above 8 years old but under 16 years old could not recharge money over 50 RMB each time, with the total not exceeding 200 RMB each month.Users above 16 years old but under 18 years old could not recharge money over 100 RMB, with the total not exceeding 400 RMB.
Users under 18 years old could only log in the game for one hour from 20：00-21：00 on every Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

norm.天刚亮整个京城的告示处都张贴了最新的皇榜，还有专门的内侍敲锣打鼓引民众围观。\n:
At the crack of dawn, the newly drafted imperial edict was put up on every billboard across the nation, and there were eunuchs specially beating drums to attract people's attention.
The edicts says that the Emperor showed great concern to the drought which led to the failure of harvest.So the Emperor prayed the heaven for rainy days.The result showed that the drought was caused by Li Ziming.There were ten crimes that he committed.
What's more, the edict records that some guards went to arrest him last night, but he refused to give in.In the end, he was killed in chaos.And he will be decapitated at the street this noon to serve as sacrifice for the heaven.
the incident caused heated discussion among the public.With the lifting of the knife, Li's head was cut down immediately.At the same time, the bright and clear sky turned dark, and thunder and lightning stroke.A few moment later, the rain poured down.The cheer of "bravado"drowned out in the rain.
Three days have passed when Li Ziming woke up in a hidden passage since the incident happened.He worn Liu Ting's flying fish clothes, which suited him very much.He knew what happened without any explanation from Xiaojiu.
What a intricate plot! Li Yuan killed the king of Dongping by blaming him for the drought.
Now there is less than half a month away from the appointed date.

norm.天绝阵，邓华殒命，文殊广法天尊以遁龙桩控住秦天君，剑取首级。\n地烈阵，韩毒龙卒:
In Heaven Extinguishing Battle Formation, Deng Hua is killed.Qin Wan is tied by the Seven-Treasure Golden Lotus of Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun and beheaded with a sword.
In Earth Quaking Battle Formation, Han Dulong killed.Zhao Jiang bound by Ju Liusun with his magical rope falls to the ground and dies.
In Howling-Gales Battle Formation, Fang Bi killed.Cihang Daoren spoils the formation with his Wind-Fixing Pearl and sucks Dong Quan into the Pure Glazed Vase, melting him into blood.
In Frozen-Glacier Battle Formation, Xue E Hu killed.Puxian Zhenzhen destroys the formation and kills Yuan Jiao with his Wugou Sword.
In Golden-Light Battle Formation, Xiao Zhen killed.Guangchengzi uses his Eight Trigrams Immortal Robe to resist golden light, and then hits the forehead of Jinling Shengmu with his Fantian Yin(a huge seal), causing her brains to spurt out.
In Blood-Curdling Battle Formation, Qiao Kun dies distressingly.Taiyi Zhenren guards himself from the black veil with green clouds, and traps Sun Liang who intends to flee away within his Nine-dragon-fire-net and burns him into ashes.
In Plummeting-Soul Battle Formation, Fang Xiang killed.Chijingzi protects his body with auspicious clouds and clad in eight-trigrams coat, wields his Yin Yang Mirror to control Yao Bin and takes his head with his sword.
In Crimson-Water Battle Formation, Cao Bao slain.Master Virtue of the Pure Void stepping on a lotus flower and protected by auspicious clouds overhead, kills Wang Bian who is escaping with his five-fires and plumes-of-seven birds fan.
Whenever there's a monarch killed, Wen Zhong grows so angry that he cannot wait to go to fight on the battlefield himself.Over time, he feels disappointed and sad, sweeping bitterly.
Every time there's a scapegoat dying in the formation, the Chan immortals are joyful and successfully break the formations one after another.They feel glad to see the hope of overcoming their doom.
In the blink of an eye, among the ten formations what remain are only Blazing-Flame and Crimson-Water Battle Formation.

You decide not to take part in this activity as it is said it's dangerous to travel by the route between Baimang mountain and the capital.
After breakfast in the following morning, you arrive at the school as usual and, not surprisingly, find that you are the first to arrive.By the time for classes, Jia Zhongyang and other classmates have yet to arrive.Then you suppose that they may still wander around the mountain.
But two days later, they are still absent.At the moment, you decide to visit the Jia's to inquire about your friend after school.
You get there in less than a quarter of an hour, and standing in the doorway, you have a bad feeling seeing his family dressed in linen cloth and white on the head, mourning.Then you see Jia Zhongwei （Jia Zhongyang's younger brother） coming over, hurrying up to ask "What happened?"
"According to the obituary from Yiluan government office, my brother was murdered at the dusk of the day before yesterday."he replies with grief and gloom.
Hearing this, you come into the house to pay your respects, and then go back home sadly.

Upon fleeing back to Biyou palace miserably, Tongtian Jiaozhu makes up his mind to fight to the end against his brothers, since now his four most treasured swords have been looted, imposing an insult never seen in his whole life on him.he has created another trap called the Ten Thousand Immortal Slaughtering Trap following his Immortal Execution Formation.
Centered on Tongtian Jiaozhu, the formidable formation has numerous traps which would be activated by the collective magic power of the mass sect members.
Traps are as follows：
Tai Chi Trap：guarded by Immortal Dark Cloud and Immortal Qiu Shou, it is set up in line with the Tai Chi battle diagram, with rocks flying about.The guards are armed with swords and Heavens-Mixing Hammers at their waists.
Two-Yi Trap：guarded by Immortal Spiritual Tooth, it would take the advantage of Yin and Yang to unleash the mysterious power of Jie sect and give out thunders to trap formation breakers.
Four-Elephant Trap：guarded by Immortal Golden Light, it could summon fierce demons and devils and erect impregnable walls when talismans are employed.
In addition, the Jiaozhu has a trump card：Six-Soul Streamer.
The streamer is an ancient mysterious treasure.After writing the names and birth hours and dates of six people on strips of cloth attached with the end of the streamer, and casting a spell of enchantment everyday, one could kill the six with a single wave of the steamer in the formation.Tongtian has long written the names of Yuanshi, Daode, Jieyin, Zhunti, Ji Fa and Jiang Shang down the clothes and entrusted them to his disciple Long Ear Dingguangxian.
In fact, knowing that he would not be able to defeat the four saints with this formation, he means to turn the tide with the Six-Soul Streamer under the guise of the formation.But considering that his adversaries might see through him via divination and make relevant preparations, he entrusts the streamer to his little-known disciple for safekeeping, which sets the scene for his later failure.

norm.屠魔大会中间的台子上站了一个黑袍修士，下面的正道修士群情激愤，义愤填膺，嘴里喊着:
There was a cultivator in black robe standing in the middle of the stage.And these decent cultivators under the stage were excited and indignant.Although they shouted "to slay demons to defend justice" or "No compromise", no one dared to walk ahead.
Then a senior in white jumped on the stage.It seemed that he was prestigious among these people.And he said to the cultivator in black, "Moyuan, you are so bold.We these decent sects don't make trouble for you, but how dare you to have a final fight with us at here.Do you think that all of us are afraid of you?"
The cultivator in black said, "Bullshit, you ask me here to have a final fight.But now i am here, you just claim that i make the appointment.Just be straightforward if you are afraid of having a fight." As the cultivator answered back, these people were indignant.
"Hahahahaha" Zhang Junhong from the Star Picking Pavilion burst into laughter and jumped on the stage.
"Please be quiet.The royal court made the appointment for you to have a final fight.The decent Sects and the demon sect have fought for more than a centenary, but no result has produced.Why not all of you go on the stage to have a final fight.If you refuse, you are afraid of being defeated." Zhang Junhong continued to instigate.
"We are afraid to be defeated?"
"No more words, just tell my how to fight?"
Realizing that both sides got hooked, Zhang took out four flags, and activated them into the sky with his celestial energy.These four flags placed themselves into four directions automatically, and turned into a big formation in the sky.
"This is the formation of isolation, which is completely isolated from the outside world.Although you are having a fight, don't make the fight so violent.For each side, please choose three people to represent the sect.The one who picks the eye of the formation is the winner.How about your opinions?" Zhang said.
The cultivator in black robe took off his hoody and said indifferently, "Today, i come alone.I don't need three people.Myself is enough."
Qiong Ying held the eldest brother’s arm and said to him, "He is our third young brother." The eldest brother pressed her hand to calm her down.And he gave her a look which signified he had knew it already.
The eldest brother held Qiong Ying to jump on the stage, and he said to the crowd with a frivolous voice, "Since Lu Chen is the third disciple of the Springsun Sect, we two will team up with Lu to have a fight."

norm.为什么先出洞府玩法？\n\n洞府资源可用来提升灵根等级，升级建筑等级，是游戏核心:
The abode has a number of buildings that are useful for your cultivation journey.

Abode resources can be used to enhance the level of spiritual roots, upgrade the level of the building, is the core gameplay

1、The abode can generate gems, food, wood and iron which can be used to upgrade abode buildings, sect buildings the level of your spiritual root and more.The production of gems, wood and iron require food, so you will have to balance your food gain with your food expenditure.These resources are a core part of the game and will be essential to the rest of your cultivation journey.

2、Servants can be purchased with food using the “summon” button at the top of the abode.Assigning a servant to a building (gem, wood, food or iron) will increase production of that resource.All buildings other than food will consume a certain amount of food every 10 seconds in order to produce that resource.

3、The amount of resources produced by each building is proportional to the number of servants that are currently working in that building.If you hit the cap on the number of servants in the building, you will need to upgrade it in order to add more and increase production.

4、Buildings in the abode will require wood to upgrade, buildings in the sect will require a mixture of wood and iron.

5、There are a number of buffs to your resource production that can be found through Fairchild and Sect activities, explore those activities to find out more!

6、Other buildings in the abode include:The library, which will allow you to increase your alchemy, refinery and enlightenment experience.The furnace, where you can create orbs and pills to increase your stats.The forge, where you can refine new gear and useful items
.The pet hall, where you can manage pets when you unlock them
.The Fengyi Chamber, where you can interact with your cultivation partners
