norm.1、法宝内丹、主材在<color=#4f9a12>门派藏宝阁</color>，<:
1、Trump main materials and Inner Orbs can be obtained from the <color=#4f9a12>Sect Treasure, Exploration, training map （starting from Mt.Buzhou）, Deity Market</color> etc.
\n2、After turning on the automatic infusing essence for 7-star Array, the 7-star Array will take priority for essence infusion.
\n3、You can activate <color=#4f9a12>set effects</color> by refining trumps using <color=#4f9a12>Inner Orbs</color> , but you can also refine trumps without using Inner Orbs.
\n4、When refining, choosing different opening times will give different effects like TaiYin, TaiYang etc.
\n5、The higher attributes trump has, the higher its grade will be.You can increase trump's attributes by leveling it up.
\n6、You need to reach the specified Blacksmith level to be able to refine trumps.If the assisting materials are not enough, the refining success rate will be reduced.
\n7、You can equip <color=#4f9a12>multiple trumps of the same type</color> , and trumps can be dismantled to obtain materials.
\n8、Trumps that has been refined can be fused to replace the Inner Orb effect of the trump, and the fusion has a chance to fail.
\n9、If two different Inner Orbs are put in, the effect of the Inner Orb after fusion will be randomly chosen from the two.
\n10.The Trump Qi will be increased at Mao time, Strength will be increased at Wu time, Health will be increased at You time, and Agility will be increased at Zi time.

3、The Cultivation Times can be obtained by purchasing with Jades or using Deity Fluid item （if obtained from the Login Activity, please use it in the backpack first）.
4、The growth of Immortal Tree is divided into five stages:Germination, Seedling, Bough, Infancy and Maturity.When the Immortal Tree is mature, you can receive the fruit reward once.Afterwards, it could bear fruit again after being cultivated to a certain Growth Value.Immortal Trees can totally bear fruits for 3 times andyou can receive fruit rewards for 3 times.The reward can be checked in Reward Preview.The total Growth Value of Immortal Tree required for bearing fruits are 1000, 3000 and 6000 
5、When the immortal tree is in its Infancy, you can perform Enlightenment under the Immortal Tree for 3 times.Each time, you can get a enlightenment reward randomly.The reward can be checked in Reward Preview.
6、Cultivate the Immortal Tree to the specified Growth Value can you get reward in Immortal Tree Reward interface.
7、All players of all services can receive the All Servers Reward when the number of cultivated mature Immortal Trees reaches the specified level.Your individual cultivation should reach at least Bough to receive the reward 
8、After the activity ends, we will retrieve the unused Cultivation Times with the price of 45 Jades each, and only the Cultivation Times purchased by Jades will be returned.The number of times obtained by using Deity Fluid Item is preferentially consumed for each cultivation.
9、Deity Fluid items can't be used after the activity ends.Please use them during the activity.

norm.在天枢宫已经待了有些日子了。\n大师兄、琼英和陆沉都已经结出元婴，算是摸到了道的:
I have been in Tianshu Palace for some days.
 My eldest martial brother, Qiong Ying and Lu Chen have all upgraded into Nascence period, which can be regarded as touching the door of Tao.
 Eldest martial brother entered the Tao with swordsmanship, reached the phase of Nascence G.8.His Nascence is a sword fetus.Normally the swordsmen are all people who hone themselves.But the eldest martial brother's appearance of being pampered is somehow favored.
 Qiong Ying also entered the Tao with swordsmanship, which is not surprising.No one can hone herself better than her.Now her attainment is Nascence G.6.
 Lu Chen entered the Tao with "dexterity", which is also one of the three thousand paths but a narrow path, which is specializing in alchemy, blacksmith, arrays and spells and even some spagyrics in it.It is the way that using external things to form the Tao rather than cultivation oneself.Therefore, the upgrading of phase is dawdling, just reached Nascence G.1.
 The day of the 10th Fairy Gathering of the Tianshu Palace is coming.Recalling the previous gathering, all immortals came to celebrate with unprecedented grandeur.Chen Tanlang, as the head of the Big Dipper seven liters, has faintly got the power to summon all from the world.
 This year, the gathering is even more extraordinary.The Roche Dynasty sent LV Xilin, the owner of Star Picking TOwer, to confer a great name and recruited Chen Tanlang to be the new owner.While Chen Tanlang unexpectedly refused.Practitioners originally pursue freedom, and the ones in the imperial court were despised by others.
 Emissary Zhang Junhong was not surprised when he received the reply of rejection.He just asked to stay temporarily on Tianshu Island and join the gathering as to fulfill the duty of supervision.The island owner was polite to them and arranged their accommodation and daily living.
 There are continuously some practitioners arrived early who all moved into Tianshu island.
 On the night three days before the gathering was held, accidents occurred on the island.The imperial court envoy Zhang Junhong and the practitioners moved onto island sbefore suddenly launched attack on the practitioners on Tianshu island.
 Many disciples on the island rebelled.Under the combination of inside and outside, most practitioners on Tianshu Island were controlled.The island owner Chen Tanlang, along with a small number of elite disciples, was trapped in Tianshu Palace.
 Zhang Junhong, the messenger of the Star Picking Tower, threatened with all practitioners’ lives on the island, and the island owner finally surrended.In fact, he could continue to resist until the arrival of backup.But he could not watch his disciples and grandchildren die on the spot.
 The day before the gathering, Tianshu Island announced to all over the world that the gathering of this year was cancelled.And the island owner Tanlang took the position of the Elder of Star Picking Tower.

norm.1、法宝内丹、主材在<color=#4f9a12>门派藏宝阁</color>，<:
1、Trump main materials and Inner Orbs can be obtained from the <color=#4f9a12>Sect Treasure, Exploration, training map （starting from Mt.Buzhou）, Deity Market</color> etc.
\n2、After turning on the automatic infusing essence for 7-star Array, the 7-star Array will take priority for essence infusion.
\n3、You can activate <color=#4f9a12>set effects</color> by refining trumps using <color=#4f9a12>Inner Orbs</color> , but you can also refine trumps without using Inner Orbs.
\n4、When refining, choosing different opening times will give different effects like TaiYin, TaiYang etc.
\n5、The higher attributes trump has, the higher its grade will be.You can increase trump's attributes by leveling it up.
\n6、You need to reach the specified Blacksmith level to be able to refine trumps.If the assisting materials are not enough, the refining success rate will be reduced.
\n7、You can equip <color=#4f9a12>multiple trumps of the same type</color> , and trumps can be dismantled to obtain materials.
\n8、Trumps that has been refined can be fused to replace the Inner Orb effect of the trump, and the fusion has a chance to fail.
\n9、If two different Inner Orbs are put in, the effect of the Inner Orb after fusion will be randomly chosen from the two.
\n10.The Trump Qi will be increased at Mao time, Strength will be increased at Wu time, Health will be increased at You time, and Agility will be increased at Zi time.
\n11.Refined trumps （artifacts） could be upgraded with star levels （max of 5 stars） through quenching to obtain stronger attributes.Upgraded trumps equipped in 7-star Array could provide <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color> attribute, <color=#4f9a12>the higher</color> Divine Stamp is, the less DMG will receive in fighting.
\n12.When the total star levels of trumps in the 7-star Array reached some extent, it will unlock connecting <color=#4f9a12>Infinite Star Shining</color> , providing special effects in fighting.
\n13.Quenched trumps could turn back part of Star Soul after clicking dismantle, and you may get double Star Soul through Void Gem or Tianmen Gem.

norm.1.灵童通过与道侣双修时灵气碰撞而诞生（灵童品质和概率与双修道侣品质有关，绿色和:
1.Fairchild is born from the essence crashing of dual-cultivation of partners （quality and chance of the Fairchild are related with partners' quality）.Fairchild could be deployed when in the Spirit Fetus with the max of 3, which would provide stats for character.When the Fairchildren have same quality, and the quality of each stats came out randomly, then the higher qualification of stats is, the bring up stats upper limit would be higher
2.After being deployed, Fairchild will conduct practice by himself, daily learning of external spells could strengthen power, also the Innerorb could improve attainment quickly.
3.Being not able to breaktrough within the age limit, Fairchild would be temporarily sealed and could be unsealed by consuming gems.
4.By using the functions of Innerorb, Fairchild could improve stats value.But orbs with different quality share the usage limit within a big state, please be care of choosing

6.After being given up Fairchild, Fairchild no longer belonged to player and cannot be retrieved.
7.There are still a lot more fun in Fairchild, player could explore by yourself.

norm.奖池选择说明：\n1、活动共需选择天阶1种、地阶2种、玄阶1种、黄阶4种10种奖:
Instruction of Prize Pool Selection：
1、Select 10 prizes in total (1 from Heaven-Class, 2 from Earth-Class, 3 from Mythic-Class, and 4 from Novice-Class) and put them into the Prize Pool.No change is allowed once your selection is made.
2、Once you get the Heaven-Class Prize, you can reset the pool and re-select your prizes.All prizes will be changed.
3、Each type of prize can only be put into the pool for limited times.If the count comes to zero, it can no longer be selected.If the count of every prize of any class is zero, the pool can no longer be reset.
4、If you choose to reset the pool after getting the Heaven-Class prize, all prizes left in the pool will still be counted as consumed.Please decide carefully.
5、The number of draws left in each class indicates the total times you can selection from this class, and if it's larger than one, you can select one prize for multiple times until it's used up.

norm.1、初始选择本轮抽奖奖池，分天、地、玄、黄四档奖励，每档分别选择1、2、3、4种:
1、First, select prize for the pool in this round.Select one, two, three, four types of prizes respectively for Heaven, Earth, Mythic, and Novice Class, and then put them into the pool to start.
2、Tap "DRAW" to consume your ancient runes and draw.Each draw gives you a random prize from the pool.
3、You can purchase more attempts with Jade, or get more by consuming Ancient Runes （use them in your inventory if you obtain them in other campaigns）.
4、Each prized can only be drawn for limited times.If you have obtained it for enough times, it won't be drawn again.
5、Heaven-, Earth-, Mythic-, and Novice-Class prizes can be obtained respectively for 1, 2, 5, 10 times.It takes 60 draws to obtain every prize in a pool.
6、After obtaining the Heaven-Class prize, you can continue with the current pool or change your prizes and reset your pool.If the pool is reset, all prizes will be changed.
7 Each prize can only be placed into the pool for limited times.If the the count is 0, it can no longer be selected.If all items in a class are all used up, the pool can not be reset again.
8、When the event is over, all unused ancient runes will be retrieved at 45 Jades each.Only ancient runes purchased with Jade will be retrieved.Your draws will first consume runes obtained from using items.
9、Ancient runes cannot be used again after the event is over.Please use them during the event.
10.Prize-winning possibilities：
 Heaven-Class：1%
 Earth-CLass：10%
 Mythic-Class：30%
 Novice-Class：59%

norm.仿佛回到了孩时，他总是紧紧攥住你的衣袖，生怕你遗失在人流之中。总是嘴角带笑的看着: It felt as if you were back in your childhood, when he used to look at you with a smile and grip your sleeve so tightly lest you get lost in the crowd.
norm.闭合的折扇有意无意敲打着扶手，慵懒的眼神貌似没有任何焦点。他目前对任何事情都提不: He kept knocking an arm of the chair with his folding fan, his eyes wandering about.He seemed uninterested in anything at the moment.
norm.他眼神冰冷，嘴角没有一丝笑意。从紧握的双拳可以看出，目前他的心情并不愉悦。: His eyes were cold and face unsmiling, with his clenched fists indicating his displeasure.
norm.像一尊平静的布娃娃一样躺在躺椅上，不吃不说，轻眯着眼睛，看不出一丝喜怒。: He was lying on a chaise longue like a quiet doll, neither eating nor saying anything.All his emotions were hidden in his squinted eyes.
norm.把坐在他腿上的你紧紧搂入怀中，力道有些蛮横，恨不得把你融入他的身体。老远能听到一: He held you, sitting on his lap, into his arms in an almost violent way, as if trying to absorb you into his own body.His heart beat was loud enough to be heard even in the distance.
norm.她眼神冷清，白净如雪的脸庞没有一丝笑意。眉关紧锁，冷若冰霜，宛若临凡的雪山仙子。: She had icy eyes and a pale, unsmiling face.Frowning coldly, she looked like a fairy from the snowy mountains.
norm.时间仿佛在这一刻静止，相拥的两人成为刹那天地的焦点。: Time seemed frozen at this moment.The couple embracing each other becomes the center of the whole world.
norm.轻轻的环拥，你可以清晰听到他炙热心脏的有力跳动。: In his gentle arms you could clearly hear his warm heart beating powerfully.
norm.用力将他拥入怀中，你可以清晰感受到他双手驻留在你背后的僵硬和无措。: Holding him firmly in you arms, you could feel his flustered hands behind your back seeking a place to rest.
norm.你的拥抱让他紧皱的眉头有所舒展，但男人的自尊，让他决定与你暂时保持距离。: His frown seemed to have relieved a bit with your hug, but he decided to maintain the distance between you and him out of his pride as a man.
norm.突如其来的拥抱，让他感觉不适。情绪宣泄的出口一刹那被堵塞。: He felt somewhat uneasy because of the sudden hug, His outlet of emotions is suddenly blocked.
norm.你的拥抱，让他紧绷的脸开始有了一丝绽放的微笑。: Your hug added a light smile to his serious look.
norm.他用力回抱，并亲吻了你的头顶。鼻息的热气让你觉得异常温馨。: He responded with a firm embrace and a kiss on the top of your head.His warm breath brought you a homely feeling.
norm.沉默是他对抗你的最佳方式，但忽然的拥抱让他不知所措。: Silence is his best weapon against you, but the sudden hug surprises him.

norm.神魂游历大千，发现上古法宝山河图所化幻境，内有大量无主异宝: The divine soul wandered around the world and found an illusory realm formed by the ancient Trump - the Painting of Mountains and Rivers, inside which there were lots of unclaimed treasure.
norm.执事房是获取前期修炼资源的主要所在: You can find the resource you need in the early phase mainly in the executive room.
norm.灵池等级提升，方能存储更多灵气，灵根可提升等级越高: The Spirit Pool can store more essense at higher levels, which allows you to upgrade your aptitude.
norm.这里就是以后炼丹的地方了，想要变强，丹药必不可少: This is where you refine your orb, which is indispensible if you want to become stronger.
norm.坊市已开，有诸多功法、异宝出售，道友可入内查看一番: The Market is open now.Enter to see what techniques and treasures you can buy there.
norm.天命所趋，劫数已至，请领受: Accept the tribulation brought by your fate.
norm.前往老道所说门派查看有什么机缘: Visit the Guild the Taoist mentioned to see what opportunities are awaiting.
norm.派遣仙仆上阵后，即可开始产出食物: Send your servant on field to start producing food.
norm.天道酬勤，求道者更要把握机缘，修炼过程中的奇遇和世界奇遇大都将汇聚在这里: Fate rewards deligence.Those who seek Tao must seize opportunities, for all amazing experience will be expected here.
norm.天下武功，唯快不破，此招式即是以速度闻名于世: Nothing defeats fastness.This move is known exactly for its speed.
norm.看来是无法善了了，远方又有大批妖魔来援，还须速速斩杀此魔: This is not going to end well.More monsters are coming up, and you must kill this demon fast.
norm.筑基境界，已经达到炼器需求等级，可以炼制法器了: You have reached Base Stage.Now you can start refining.
norm.藏经阁内藏有门派功法和招式，达到条件即可修习: There are techniques and Skills of Guilds, which you can learn after you meet the requirements.
norm.炼丹之地，打造完成后即可开炉炼制: You can start concocting after building the refinement room.
norm.天地灵物，有缘得之，异宝来投，一定是机缘到了: The divine objects only present themseLv.es to those to whom they belong.They must have been brought to you by fate.
norm.修仙之途，炼丹，炼器之术傍身，才能走的更远，达到一品炼器师后，可去器室炼制法器: Skills of concocting and refining bring you further on your way of becoming a deity.You can refine instruments in the Forge after reaching refining G.1.
norm.开始任务后，将会自动循环执行，之后加入新门派还需手动开启一次: It will be executed automatically after the mission starts.After you join a new guild, you need to turn it on manually.
norm.寻幽探宝，斩妖除魔，获取修行资源，即从此处开始: Start from here to search for treasure in uncharted areas and eliminate evil demons to obtain resource for your practice.
norm.任务达标，可领取修行资源，章节任务达标后更有特殊奖励！: Complete missions to obtain resource for you practice.Meet the requirements in every stage for special rewards.
norm.前方有妖魔阻拦，无法绕行，恐怕将有一番征伐，须小心行事: There are monsters ahead in your way and there's no detour.Prepare carefully for conflict.
norm.灵根是修行的基础，孕育五行，演化万千: Aptitude is the basis of your practice.It gives births to the five elements and all other things.
norm.其上有虹光闪现，确是精品，可上手品鉴一番: The iridescent light indicates its fine quality.Try it out.
norm.山不在高，有仙则名，继承前辈遗留小世界，化生自己的随身洞府: Significance comes from value instead of size.Inherit the small world left by your ancester and turn it into your Adobe.
norm.财侣法地，缺一不可，法即招式，登仙途中学过的招式都汇聚在这里: You need wealth, partner, skill, and turf to prevail.All the skills you've learn on your way are here.
norm.这里功法价格不菲，境界越高可修习的功法越多，当然消耗的灵石也越多: The techniques here are expensive.The higher your level is, the more technique you can learn, and of course, the more gem it will cost you.
norm.先行建造书阁，之后，可在此消耗灵石修行炼丹，冶器之技: After building your library, you can spend gem to refine orbs and forge instruments here.
norm.坊市按照资源分门别类，藏经阁专门出售神功秘法，是直接提升实力的最好去处: The Market is sorted by types of resource.The library, where techniques and skills are sold, is the best place you can improve your power.
norm.神魂游历，每隔固定时间，会将无主之物带至储物内，需保持储物空间足够容纳: The Divine Soul will regularly bring unclaimed objects to your bag.Make sure you have enough room for them.
norm.此处还有些悬赏任务，奖励和任务所需时间都不相同，需要酌情选取: There are also some bounty quests here.The reward and payment vary.Choose those that fit you.
norm.派遣至灵石，木材和陨铁的仙仆工作时需要消耗食物，提升后，食物存储上限增加，仙仆工: Servant sent to collect gem, wood, and iron consume food.After raising your maximum food volume, your servants can work for a longer time before returning.
norm.这就是修为满溢的感觉吗，真奇妙，是时候突破境界瓶颈了: Is this how an attainment overflow feels? Amazing.It's time for a state breakthrough.
norm.历练时斩杀妖魔，经历奇遇都将得到修行资源，先收下再说: Both encounters and killing monsters give you resource for practice.Collect whatever you get.
norm.道侣好感度达到100即可邀约，开启双修: When your partner's fondness reaches 100, you can invite him/her to start dual practice.
norm.日后，可在此地一展所学，炼法器，斩妖魔: In the future, this will be where you show what you've learned by forging instruments and killing monsteres.
norm.果然是好宝贝，先装备上，日后有更强法器，可再行替换: It's indeed a treasure.Equip it until you obtain something more powerful.
norm.仙途漫漫，按照任务指引前行，仙路将会更顺畅: There's a long way ahead.Following the guide will make your way easier.
norm.道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。开启第一次修炼！: Tao produces the one.The one produces duality, and duality produces trinity.Trinity eventually forms everything.Start your first practice now!
norm.此处即是历练的始发站，名为百莽山，人迹罕至之地，此去，定要当心: This is the beginning of your journey, Baimang Mountain, which few people have ever come to.Take care on your way.
norm.黄风拂掠窃杯影，齐眉深瞳锁佳人，快进入房间吧，开始双修吧: The wind's blowing outside, and your partner's waiting in the room.Enter the room to start dual practice.
norm.天降大任，必有考验。成功渡劫后，可提升大境界: Great challenge comes before great responsibility.If you survive the tribulation, you can move on to the next state.
norm.提升五行灵根等级，可以增加对应五行属性功法加成，等级越高加成越多: Increasing the level of Five-Element Aptitude can increase the bonus for five-element techniques.The higher the level is, the greater the bonus will be.
norm.书阁已扫洒完毕，可入内开始修习: The library has been cleaned.You can enter and practice now.
norm.神魂初凝，可分出一缕游历险境，代替本尊感悟大千: The Divine Soul has formed its shape.Now you can send it out to explore the world for you.
norm.合理的招式搭配，能更好的克敌制胜: A sensible combination of skills can help you defeat your enemies more easily.

norm.有阴阳两面，阳是生，阴是死，拥有掌控生死之能。: It has two sides:Yang representing life, and Yin representing death.It has the power to control life and death.
norm.混沌青莲的莲茎结合天地间凶煞之气化为弑神枪，可伤圣人。: The stem of he blue lotus of chaos mixed all evil spirits in the world and became the Gold-Slaying Spear, which has the power to hurt immortals.
norm.太上扁拐: The Flat Stick of the Supreme Lord
norm.鸿蒙开辟三年，采一片阳晶芭蕉叶，交予童子扇焰，过得一量劫，沾染融合兜率火所成。: Three year after the primitive world was created, a Palm-Leaf was given to the apprentice to fan the fire.A Kalpa later, the leaf fused with Doushuai's flame and became the fan.
norm.摇晃可令敌人魂不附体，失魂落魄，从而昏倒不醒人事。: When shaken, it stupefies and stuns its enemies, causing them to faint.
norm.以古陨星炼成，外形只是一根簪子，神气内敛。: Made from an ancient fallen star, it seems ordinary just like a normal hairpin.
norm.蕴含日月灵气的宝珠，可祭起攻击敌人，令人防不胜防。: An orb containing the spirit of the sun and moon.Can be used to start a surprise attack.
norm.混沌青莲半成熟莲子所化。灯高有九寸，其形作宝莲盛开，大有海碗，莲心即是灯心。: A nine-inch lantern derived from the half-mature seed of the blue lotus of chaos.It has the shape of a blossoming lotus and the size of a large bowl, with its core as the central part of the flower.
norm.天道规则凝结而成，内含各种无上伟力，可化各种属性攻击。: Made from the concentration of all laws in the universe.It contains strong power that can turn into attack of different elements.
norm.高四五丈有余，光分五彩，可召命天下妖族。: With a height of over 40 feet and iridescent light, it has the power to summon all demons in the world.
norm.上古祖龙的龙角，锋利无比，坚不可摧。: Horn of the elder dragon.Its extremely sharp and can break all defense.
norm.老君以昆仑山下一美玉雕琢而成，后乘水乘丹养成灵气，为玉净瓶，可颠覆阴阳。: Carved from a fine piece of jade by the supreme lord and developed spirit with the nurturing of water and orbs.The clean vase of jade can switch Yin and Yang.
norm.环体洁白无瑕，投掷攻击，百发百中。: A perfectly white jade ring.After thrown out, it never misses its target.
norm.灯内有一团金色火焰，名唤万灵古燚。相传此火有探查万灵之能。: A golden flame named Ancient Flame of Ten-Thousand-Ghosts hides burns in the center of the lantern.It's told the flame can detect any ghost.
norm.玉虚琉璃灯: Glazed Glass Lantern of Void Jade
norm.以吸收了天地五行精气的桃木制作而成，可降服百鬼。: Made from peach wood that absorbed the spirit of 5-elements in the world.Capable of defeating all ghosts.
norm.枪刃有三个尖端，枪缨为紫色火焰，蕴藏着无穷的力量，为斩妖除魔、诛兵屠将的神兵利器: A trident with purple flame as its tessel.It contains infinite power for killing demons and monsters.
norm.此剪乃是两条蛟龙，采天地灵气，受日月精华，起在空中，往来上下，祥云护体，头并头如: The scissors are formed by two dragons that collected spirit of heaven and earth and absorbed essens of the sun and the moon.Flying in the sky along with clouds, their bodies crosses each other's and form the scissors.
norm.此宝装于一个红葫芦内，真形不明，放出白色毫光即现封住对手元神法力，使其无法逃脱。: Contained in a red gourd, the treasue's real shape remains unknown.It can release a stream of white light that seals its opponent's power to escape.

norm.老子之物，坐禅之宝，此宝是一个具有收人收物神力的坐垫，蕴含风与火大道，故名风火蒲: The treasure of Lao Tsu.A sitting cushion with the power of containing both people and items.It's named Wind-Fire Cushion for the power it contains.It can also summon fighters for you.

norm.至金至刚之宝，由黄金打造，坚不可摧，投掷而出能暴击万物，可改变大小。: A treasure of utmost hardness.It's made of gold and impossible to break.Attacks anything critically once thrown out.It's size can be changed freely.
norm.暗藏风火之力，可踏在脚下代步，飞快如风，火速冲天。: It contains the power of wind and fire, and can be used to travel.Its speed compares to wind and flame.

norm.剑内蕴一鸾凤，祭出后可自动追敌。: The sword contains a phoenix inside it, which can pursue its enemy automatically when released.
norm.汲取日之精华辅以千年玄铁炼制而成，其细如针，大小由心。: It was forged with darksteel and absorbed the essense of the sun.It's thin as a needle, and it's size can vary freely.
norm.上古奇物，寄放分魂，滋润壮大之用，最终可炼成元神分身。: An ancient treasure used for storing soul fragment and nurturing it.The soul will eventually develop into a separated body of the original spirit.

norm.琼英走过去，她能感觉到如果李明对自己这些人有恶意，临死前也能将众人抹杀。\n“我:
Qiongying walked up.She sensed that if Li Ming were hostile to them, he could wipe them out before his own death.
 "My original name was Li Ziming," Li Ming started to talk slowly 
 "I was the last emperor of the Li Dynasty, which became the Luo Dynasty you live in now.Back then, there no crisis under the sky, so I abdicated the throne and gave it to Luo Cheng.Now it seems a wise choice.Later I went to wandering around the world along with Yunyao.Since she had practice for a while before, although she had little attainment, her life is still much longer than mine.As I age continuously, she didn't seem to have changed a bit.In the biginning, I hated the cultivation very much.She never tried to persuade me into it, but would only wipe off her tearing everytime she thought of me dying in front of her.The other day, she went secretly to the Soul-Breaking Cliff to search for the Spirit-Condensing Jade in order to extend my life, and then she never came back.I went searching for her as if crazy, but I couldn't even find the entrance of the cliff." Li Ziming went on after some bad coughs.
 "Later, I started cultivation.Thankfully, I had some talent for this.After I started, I learned about the gap of power between us.I kept practicing, and didn't enter the Soul-Breaking Cliff until I reached Severance state.By the cold lake I found her body and the Spirit-Condensing Jade in her hand.It had been too long, and her soul had already vanished.I left her in peace at the bottom of the lake and left alone." 
"Since then, I've been looking for the way to resurrect her.I reopened the Star-Picking Tower and asked all capable men to search for me, and my search led me to the Ghost Cultivation.The Blood-Soul Box detected my desire and lured me to Ghost cultivation, and went on to swallow me.Me body was burned up by it, and only my original spirit survived.Then I met you and restored my mind with your Mind-Clearing Rune.Later you died, and I witness how your sad fellow apprentice resembled me back then.So I found you and tried to help you reshape your body with the Spirit-Condensing Jade, and you really made it.I also sent my primordial spirit back to my body thanks to the thunder triggered by your body reshaping." 
"After that, I deployed this Immortal Slaying Field.There's no way to resurrect Yunyao in the mortal world, and I'm going to try my luck in heaven.I warned you against coming here, yet here you are now." Li Ziming continued.
"Your idea of trigger the tribulation in advance was brilliant, but it was a bit too late.I had taken the elixir that can boost my power and accelerate absorption before.And before the tribulation came, I'd already felt my my ascension coming." Said Li Ziming.

norm.眼看一年期就要满，不空都想放弃了，一个声音传了过来。\n“黄风怪不是让你不要放弃:
As the one-year limit will end soon and Bukong was considering giving up, a voice suddenly came.
 "The Yellow Wind told you not to give up, didn't he?" Bukong looked up and saw a decent man standing in front of him.It was the pig monster he met previously in Gaolaozhuang.The pig monster was just as hands as before, only with his body glowing continuously as if he was to disappear.
"Tianpeng? How could you be here? Did you..." The Sandy Monk started panicking in the water.
 "Juanlian, haven't you seen what these people are after all these years?" The pig monster told the Sandy Monk.
"That's not your business.You are only jealous of my morality and the respect I will receive in the future.You don't work hard, and you forbid others to do so." Yelled the Sandy Monk.
" Juanlian, I see you are far too obssessed.Let me save you from it." Tianpeng raised his right hand, and his rake appeared in his hand.
"With your body like this? Ha-ha-ha." the Sandy Monk laughed.
"In case you don't remember, I'm the Tianpeng emperor, the head of...100 thousand soldiers" Tianpeng said as his body suddenly started to glow blue light.He jumped high and split the Flowing Sand River with only one hit.The Sandy Monk's body was thrown up high and fell heavily like a descarded piece of cloth, and his blood colored the riverbank red.
"Ha-ha-ha, Tianpeng, even with me killed, ha-ha, the Golden XXX wouldn't make it far.Ha-ha-ha.You broke the barrier and offended the lords.You will spend your next life as an animal.Hahahaha!" The Sandy Monk died laughing.
Tianpeng gave Bukong a smile and faded, leaving not another word.
Bukong saluted towards where Tianpeng disappeared, and pulled the White Dragon across the split Flowing Sand River to went on to the west.

norm.从五庄观出来，看过那本仙册，小白龙的话也没有以前多了。\n他是西海龙王的第58个:
Leaving Wuzhuangguan, the white dragon talked much less after reading that book.
He was the 58th son of the Dragon King of the West Ocean, growing up in a unnamed lake.He'd never been in the Dragon Palace.
 His dream since childhood was to become a dragon in the tale, just like his father, flying freely in the sky and bring rain to people.People would only need to praise him when he flies by.
So he kept sharpening his skills, and when he came to age, his father got him a position of rainmaker.It was in a remote place, but he was happy.
 The first day he came to his post, he saw a notice:Due to their disrespect for the Jade Emperor, the nation shall receive no rainfall for three years.The White Dragon put back his rainbag silently, thinking that the the Jade Emperor's rage would vanish soon.Two year had passed, and he never got any reply to his suggestion for raining.In fact, the Jade Emperor had left his rage way behind, but the official would rather stay indifferent than take the risk of making any mistake.All suggestion letters were discarded by them.
 Later, it was heard that a white dragon violated the law and brought rain to the nation.He would face death sentence according to the law.
His mother threatened to suicide for his father's mercy.The death sentence was replaced with other punishment.He would be sent to the immortal world and experience reincarnation for 9 lives.
 "White, a dragon cannot change the world unless he has ultimate power.In that case, you only need to be yourself.Don't blame yourself for being unable to save everyone.Only remember what choice you would make back then if you are really in a position to change the world." 
 Bukong wiped tears again for the sleeping White Dragon.
 Wake up, White Dragon.Time to roll.
 Bukong tapped White Dragon lightly.White Dragon had not come back to himself from his dream.He followed Bukong without a word.

2、Every time of cultivation gives you a Jade Leaf, which can be used to purchase items in the store.

4 There are 5 stages of the immortal tree's growth:sprout, seedling, sapling, pre-maturity, and maturity.There is a reward for cultivating the immortal tree to maturity stage.After receiving the pride, keeping cultivatiing the tree and accumulate growth point to make the tree bear fruit again.The immortal tree can bear fruit and provide reward for 3 times.You can check the reward content in reward preview.It takes 1000, 3000, 6000 points respectively for the tree to bear fruits.
5、Cultivate the immortal tree to pre-maturity stage to start enlightenment under the tree.You have 3 chances of enlightenment, and each time you can receive a random enlightenment reward.You can check the reward content in reward preview.
6、Cultivate the tree and receive enough grouth points to get reward in immortal tree reward.
7、If there are enough players in the server who's cultivated the immortal tree to maturity stage, a server reward will be provided.Players can get the reward with a immortal tree at or above sapling stage.
8、When the event is over, all unused cultivation chances will be retrieved at 45 Jades each.Only chances purchased with Jade will be retrieved.Your cultivation will first consume chances obtained from using items./n9.Deity fluid items cannot be used again after the event is over.Please use them during the event.

norm.柳公子全名柳怀瑜，膝下仅有独女，为了缅怀去世的妻子，女儿随母亲姓琼，单名一个英字:
Mr Liu's full name is Liu Huaiyu.He has only one daughter, and he named his daughter as Qiong Ying in memory of his wife whose surname is also Qiong.Liu runs a well-off family by selling his lyric composition and paintings.
Qiong Ying is very weak since she was born.She took various herbs and medicines before the age of two.
At the age of three, her mother died of illness.But since then, she became healthy.His father's mental health fluctuates widely.Sometime she even needs to take care of her father.
When Qiong was very young, she showed her extraordinary talent in calligraphy and painting.With her father's guidance, she could integrate what she had learned together.However, women are not allowed to take the imperial examination.
Qiong is able to read the Book of Family Names at three years old, recite long articles at four years old, write essays containing three thousand characters at the age of five,and able to compose poems easily.Despite all of these outstanding achievements, she is still not allowed to take the examination.
Her neighbor Mr.Wang has a dumb son.Qiong Ying thought the dumb son is superior to her.
The reason why an eight-year-old girl desires to take the exam lies in that she believed that to pass the exam is her father's lifelong aspiration.If she can fulfill her father's dream, he will recover from the current insanity.
Now as the one-year-held provincial examination is approaching, Qiong Ying disguised herself to be a male scholar.Her appearance, figure and voice are similar to man.She even devised a fake laryngeal protuberance for herself.Even her father who is drunk cannot tell who she is.

norm.掌门大殿：宗门星级是宗门这个大功能的基础，其他玩法功能升级或开启都依赖于宗门星级:
Sect Hall：star level is the basis of the sect, upgrade or open of other gameplay are both rely on the star level, you can redeem sect level-up stone in spiritual realm
Upgrading of sect level could improve character as well as disciple practice speed, prior to upgrade sect level

Disciple Hall：recruiting disciples.You need disciples everywhere in sect zone, sect foreign affairs, sect array, explioiting spiritual vein and settled in adobe.And the main method you get disciples is from the Disciple Hall.Also, you could buy disciple giftpack to get 5-star discples.

Sect Zone：the mainly method of obtaining materials in heaven.After upgraded the sect level, you could upgrade sect zone with Woods and Stones
The higher level of the sect quest and the more disciples dispatched, the more rewards you will get.For example, one disciple dispatched for 1-star quest would get 100 Div.Gems, if dispatched2 disciples you could get 200 Div.Gems.Disciples with buff on sect will obtain 250 Div.Gems.So the quality of disciples and level of zone quest are very important.

Recast Pool：place you could add attributes on dicsiples.Disciples of the sect array would recast here.The spirit fluid consumed for recasting could be get from Destiny Tower.And you can also upgrade the recast pool by usting herbs and minerals

Sect Array：you could allocate disciples on it when you are going through the map or having a fight, with which you could add extra attributes on yourself.You can prior to allocating disciples with array buff.After upgrading, you can unlock more arrays with which you could add more attributes

Foreign Affairs Hall：you don't neeed to complete daily quest manually, but directly apply disciples with extra buff on foreign affairs, and you can just receive rewards after quest completed.

Wanfa Tower：place where you can make your own skills attached with 5-element DMG.Please remember that each Atlas could only be used once, unless you recast the already comprehended one.Please be careful for your choice.

Zhenpai Chamber：you can redeem Divine Fire by comsuming Tima Hourglass produced in Time Realm from Realm-Realm Merchant and refine Zhenpai Trump.The quality of Divine Fire is very important.The higher grade of Divine Fire used to refine, the higher buff on attributes you will get.

Xinhuo Chamber：open after passed through East Pole Islan, where you could transmit to disciples.Transmitting is inheriting the character attributes to disciples according to the percentage of transmitting progress.You can open the extra soul energy for direact disciples by consuming ensoul materials in the Ensoul Chamber.And you can upgrade the disciple sills in the Skill Hall.

Realm of Circles：A periodical mode which opens from Monday to Friday; Sect Treasure - the major way of getting cultivation materials for Secret Treasures.Don't miss it!

norm.1.无极修仙世界迎来仙子花魁大赛，道友们可以选择自己心仪的仙子为其送花，本玩法是:
1.The Infinite Practitioners' World is holding the Fairy Beauty Competition.Players could choose your favorite fairy to send flowers in this cross-server event.
2.There are 3 kinds of flowers could be sent：
You could get 4 pink roses everyday, which would be refreshed at 0：00 everyday and can't be accumulated
You could obtain red roses through Wandering with the most of 2
You could obtain Time Illusory rose by dual-cultivation with the most of 3; meanwhile you could obtain by purchasing with items or Jades
3.It will prior to send flowers obtained by consuming quests when sending them.When the activity ends, we will clear all roses and retrieve unused Time Illusory roses with the price of 45 Jades each for the ones purchased with Jades
4.Every time you send flowers could add up with Attraction value for the fairy as well as Contribution value for yourself, and you would obtain Flower Fluid and rewards of sending flowers
By accumulating Attraction value could contribute to the ranking of fairies, and you could also send flowers to different fairies
Contribution value could be accumulated to redeem contribution rewards, and gain ranking of cross-server contributions
Flower Fluid could be used to redeem items from shop, and will be cleared up when the activity ends, please be aware
Rewards available can be previewed from the reward list.
5.After the activity ends, the top 3 fairies of the Beauty Ranking will obtain certain dual-cultivation buff when being as partners, continuous for 7 days
6.After the activity ends, we would spare an extra day to display the rankings of Beauties and Contributions for you to check and obtain rewards, as well as redeem from shop, while you can't do other operations like sending flowers
7.Beauty Ranking will be updated every minute, but the calculation of rankings are real time calculation, so the rankings in the final minute will be shown after the activity ends.

norm.仙塾悟道说明：\n1.灵童境界达到<炼虚一阶后>开启仙塾悟道功能\n2.悟道时间:
Instructions for Enlightenment in Fairy School：
1.Open the function of Enlightenment of Fairy School after reached <Veinify G.1> 
2.Enlightenment Time：Monday to Friday, rest on Saturday and Sunday 
3.Set different enlightenment types from Monday to Friday, and the added attribute types will also be different 
4.Each Fairchild chooses Deity Emperor Class or Tao Ancestor Class for enlightenment every day （there is only one chance to choose very day and can't be changed） 
5.Fairy School enlightenment attribute will be converted into character attribute according to the Fairchild's quality 
6.Fairchild will get 1 credit for each enlightenment, which will be used for listed on Credit Ranking.The credits will be cleared at 22：00 every Sunday 
7.The Credit Ranking lists the rankings of all enlightenment Fairchild this week （according to the ranking of credits, the same credits are ranked according to the time of achievement） 
8.The Credit Ranking is reset at 22 o'clock every Sunday, and reward of Credit Ranking is issued at 24 o'clock every Saturday （each Fairchild on the list can get a reward） 
9.Enlightenment event follows this enlightenment and will be cleared when enlightenment ends 
10.When the Fairchild inherits：the Fairy School attribute will also be inherited

norm.奖池选择说明：\n1、活动共需选择天阶1种、地阶2种、玄阶3种、黄阶4种，共10:
Instruction of Prize Pool Selection：
1、Select 10 prizes in total (1 from Heaven-Class, 2 from Earth-Class, 3 from Mythic-Class, and 4 from Novice-Class) and put them into the Prize Pool.No change is allowed once your selection is made.
2、Once you get the Heaven-Class Prize, you can reset the pool and re-select your prizes.All prizes will be changed.
3、Each type of prize can only be put into the pool for limited times.If the count comes to zero, it can no longer be selected.If the count of every prize of any class is zero, the pool can no longer be reset.
4、If you choose to reset the pool after getting the Heaven-Class prize, all prizes left in the pool will still be counted as consumed.Please decide carefully.
5、The number of draws left in each class indicates the total times you can selection from this class, and if it's larger than one, you can select one prize for multiple times until it's used up.

norm.1、角色、怪物各出手一次，计算为一回合。\n2、每回合出手的先后顺序，由当前回合:
1、A round is set after your character and your enemy strike once.
2、The strike order in each round is based on Agility.Units with higher Agility strike first.
3、The way that certain effects are triggered is based on the situation of the combat.Ethereal Chant for example：
 Effect：Increases your EVA by X% for 6 rounds each time when you evade enemy attack
 It means that it will take effect in the current round when enemies strike first.
 And when your character strikes first, then it will take effect in the next round.

Periodical Gameplay：available from 0：00 every Monday to 24：00 every Friday, unavailable on Saturday and Sunday
Requirements：Create a guild
Introduction：
1.Corresponding character level, stats, skills, affixes and currencies are active only in the Realm of Circles
2.Tap your avatar from down left to see your character stats and related info
3.Skills you obtained in Realm of Circles can be equipped on your profile page
4.All stats, skills and related data reset when the Realm of Circles becomes available again
Character death and resurrection
1.Your character will be dead when its HP falls to 0 （keep an eye on it）
2.HP recovery：you can recover HP by upgrading, triggering events and buy items from vendors

norm.1.好感度达到100的道侣可以带回洞府进行双修。\n2.根据道侣的体质不同，双修:

norm.1.天赋伴随元神而生，可同时在主世界和元世界中使用多种天赋技能，暴击天赋除外。\:
1.Talent points are generated through the Essence Soul, acquired Talents affect both the Main World and the Essence Soul World, excluding Talents that affect CRI.
2.Some Talents are mutually exclusive, not all Talents can be activated at the same time.
3.Talent Points are obtained when the Essence Soul increases in level.
4.Skills obtained through Talents can still be upgraded even if the Talent has been reset, Talent must be reactivated to equip skill.
5.When activating Talents, the extra cost talent points are not calculated into accumulated consumption.
6.Extra cost occurs when activating Talents on multiple Talent trees.
7.Yuan Qi obtained after using corresponding orbs can be used to cover the extra cost instead of using Talent points.
8.When traveling in the Essence Soul World, there is a low chance to obtain Yuan Qi orbs.

norm.别看贫道一副吊儿郎当的样子，如果认真起来的话，可也是一等一的高手呢。回想起来这一: Don't worry about my casual or even sloppy look.You know, if I take something serious, I can also be a first-class master.Looking back on my cultivation along the way, there were really someone who helped me, and there were so many opportunities.When I was a rambunctious boy, I thought about participating in the apprenticeship trial of the Saga Clan.But I failed the first assessment, so I couldn't get in as wished.But how could I give up such an opportunity? Well, I was so young and I simply cried and rolled, except leaving that place.Then, Master Mo of the Saga Clan saw my persistence, so he interceded for me and asked me if I'm going to take the exam again.The second time, I went all out and won applause from all the halls, later, I was accepted as a disciple of the clan and started cultivation from then on.It's really funny to think about it now.Master Mo was regarded as the first noble person at the beginning of my cultivation.
norm.别人称呼我为风华绝代的美人，而我却一心只想当放情肆意于江湖之间的侠士。我的银剑锐: I don't like them calling me a peerless beauty, indeed, I only want to be an unrestrained, and chivalrous swordswoman.My sword is sharp enough to kill all troublemakers in the world; my words are straightforward, and I can communicate with anyone.I treat my friends sincerely, and I am willing to travel thousands of miles to help my confidant.When I was a child, I witnessed the murder of my parents under the plot of a demon.So in order to eliminate the evil sects, I went through all kinds of difficulties and dangers, and finally joined the Yellowind Valley.This is the gathering place for righteous monks in Guangdong, and it is also a new starting point for me to implement my chivalry.

norm.从桃夭那里回来的时候，已经下雪了……\n漆黑的一片，北风带来的浑身刺痛……\n我:
When I came back from Taoyao, it was already snowing……
It was pitch black, and my body was stinging from the north wind……
I want to go back to Beast Mountain, which is my home……
However, I couldn't stand the cold, so I curled up
under a tree and fell asleep for a while.After regaining consciousness
I found that my body was frozen……
I wanted to open my eyes so bad……
I don't want to be frozen to death in the cold wild……
My body suddenly felt a strong sense of cold.
I suppressed this feeling and slowly opened my eyes.
It was snowing heavily, I slowly got up and struggled hard.
I walked forward step by step, but soon hunger
had me.The strength in the legs gradually disappeared.
"Am I dying here? No, I can't……"
I was about to fall down, but I heard a gentle male voice
"You don't look well, do you need help?"
But still, I fell before I could speak.
I just remember I gradually became unconscious……
