norm.藤蔓精要认我当干女儿，把她的道行传承给我。只是需要我来当巫女，这样她的内丹好继续: The Vine Essence wants to recognize me as a goddaughter and pass on her Taoism to me.It just needs me to be a witch, so that her inner alchemy can continue to survive in my body.So I agreed to her, kneeled three times and kowtowed nine times according to her instructions, and then offered a bowl of Miaojiang custom apprentice wine.The old lady told me that the so-called witches of Miaojiang refer to practitioners who integrate themselves with the wood spirits.Once I complete the apprentice ceremony, I will sign a contract, and from now on I will have the ability to control flowers and trees.I listened to her words and kept nodding.And after the old lady drank the apprenticeship wine I offered her, she died as if withered, and just condensed an inner alchemy and dropped it on the ground.According to her instructions, I planted the inner alchemy in my own navel, and the inner alchemy was Perfect integrated into my belly.From then on, I had the ability to control flowers, seedlings, plants and trees, and was revered as a witch, Gu and Taoist girl by the people of Miaojiang.
norm.外界盛传百花域是女儿国，只有妙龄少女，而没有男儿郎。没错，百花域是一片只有女修，: It is widely rumored that Floral Realm is a country of daughters, with only young girls and no boys.That's right, Floral Realm is a forbidden area where only female cultivators and male cultivators are not allowed to enter.It is filled with all kinds of Ganoderma lucidum and fairy grass that cannot be obtained by the outside world, which is extremely effective in healing the injuries of practitioners.And the disciples of Floral Realm are famous for being good at practicing medicine and treating serious injuries.Whether it's the strange poisonous curse under the heavens, or the end of Yuan Yang after he failed to Ascend, in the Floral Realm, he can find the best healing method for him.But Floral Realm is not so easy to enter, you must get the permission of Baihua Patronus before you can enter Floral Realm to receive treatment.
norm.我不会哭泣，因为眼泪酷似雨滴。所以仇恨只得在我的内心里积攒，日复一日的更升腾猛烈: I won't cry because tears are like raindrops.So the hatred had to accumulate in my heart, day after day it rose more violently, and the sun burned my heart.Damn it, do you know how deep the resentment and hatred are in my heart?
norm.我曾经爱过一个人，那就是银灵子。但他不知好歹，拒绝了我的爱意。就像我爱过我的父亲: I once loved someone, and that was Yin Lingzi.But he didn't know what to do and rejected my love.Like I loved my dad, but he didn't love me at all.I choose to love Houqing, because Houqing will always stick behind me!
norm.我曾是峨眉散仙冰魄师太身边的灵童子，习得一手好乐曲。只是师太跟我说，我前世尚有一: I used to be the soul boy next to Master Bingpo of Emei Sanxian, and I learned good music.It's just that my teacher told me that I still had an unresolved love relationship in my previous life, and I had to go to the world of mortals to Asked and recover my past life memories in order to bring the unresolved relationship to an end.So I took a jade flute that my master gave me, and I used my sword to search for the mortal city, the city, and the square.Every time I walk a distance, I will meet different people, experience the feelings of different people in the world of mortals, and experience the process of getting along with different people.When I walked to the edge of the sky and the blue sea, it seemed that there was a force in the dark calling me here, which made me feel like I belonged here.
norm.我曾是一只萤火虫，在银杏树上出生，也在银杏树上修炼。一群蝼蚁毁伐了我的银杏树，所: I used to be a firefly, born on a ginkgo tree, and also cultivated on a ginkgo tree.A group of ants destroyed my ginkgo tree, so I had to give up Home.You should understand now why I hate you so much, because you look like ants.asshole! Let me trample you to death, and you will be punished instead of those ants!
norm.我都说了，我和雨师不一样，她没脑子，我有。我是主动找到蚩尤，希望效力在他的帐下的: I've said it all, I'm different from Master Yu, she has no brains, but I do.I took the initiative to find Chi You, hoping to work under his account.But Chiyou didn't Dispatch me to fight, but said he would introduce a wife to me first.I was speechless, but I could only accept it, so he married me with Yu Shi as a matchmaker.
norm.我对共工说，你救了我，不知道要怎么感谢你。共工说，事情还没结束呢，那只三足金乌依: I said to Gonggong, you saved me, I don't know how to thank you.Gonggong said that the matter is not over yet, the three- Golden Crow is still flying in the sky.So I lifted up Wangwu Mountain and smashed it against the sun flying in the sky with all my strength.The stupid Golden Crow couldn't dodge and was hit by the giant mountain, but he didn't fall, but was broken into ten small sun pieces, ten small three-legged Golden Crow.
norm.我感知着世间万物的变化和最细微的危险，一有风吹草动，我就遁避，这并不是我胆小懦弱: I perceive the changes of all things in the world and the slightest danger.Whenever there is a turmoil, I will avoid it.This is not because I am timid and cowardly, but because I want to avoid danger.Oh, you said you were going to knock me down and gain my power? Hahaha, then you can try to compete with me first, let me agree with you before talking!
norm.我国人民过春节已经有多少年的历史？: How many years have our people celebrated the Spring Festival?
norm.我建议你抽空找大夫看看脑子？（白眼）: I suggest you take the time to find a doctor to look at your brain? （roll eyes）
norm.我可以背起一座山，亦也可以掀翻一座岛，这便是我作为巨人的力量，但巨人一族从何而来: I can carry a mountain on my back, and I can also overturn an island.This is my strength as a giant, but few people know where the giant family comes from.Pan Gu, who created the world at the beginning of the primordial world, was a giant.It was the giant who created this world, and I am the only descendant of the giant.The giant's misfortune all stemmed from the conspiracy of the Emperor of Heaven.
norm.我可以一直陪伴在素女的身边，但素女却痴痴的要去找那人。我劝她别去，她不信，她哪知: I can always be by Su Nu's side, but Su Nu is obsessively going to find that person.I advised her not to go, but she didn't believe it, she didn't know how dangerous people's hearts are.Her handsome gentleman in disguise is actually the Magically Change of my eldest brother Chi You! The elder brother used an ax to open the chest cavity of the plain girl……What should I do if you ask me? I dare to defy my old man! big! elder brother! ?
norm.我们不知道在幽冥的空虚里过去了多少时光，几千几万年。虽然受到百鬼热捧，但我们只是: We do not know how much time has passed in the nether emptiness, tens of thousands of years.Although we are favored by all ghosts, we are just caged birds and have no freedom.In that abyss forgotten by the gods, we encountered an intruder.At that time, we were amazed, who was so bold as to dare to break into the depths of the nether world? The man claimed that his name was Chi You, a god of Conquest with a copper head and iron arms, loyalty and courage.
norm.我们来不及去管那些小金乌，因为共工得到了消息，兵神蚩尤的魂魄就被镇压在上古战场，: We didn't have time to take care of those Golden Crow, because Gong Gong got the news that the soul of Chiyou of Soldiers, was suppressed on the ancient battlefield, my former Home.So we set off immediately to return to the Heaven, and met Xingtian on the way.It turned out that Xing Tian revealed to us the whereabouts of Chi You's soul.It seems that the God of War and God of War who once shook the Three Realms will be united this time.
norm.我们一群朋友，包括萧凌萱、嫡仙儿、东桥姑娘，都是隐居在下界的散仙，或者是近仙的文: A group of our friends, including Xiao Lingxuan, Di Xian'er, and Miss Dongqiao, are all loose immortals who live in seclusion in the lower realms, or literati who are near immortals.The one I played best with is Hongye, the female Cultivator of Misty Sword Sect.I guess she is the one who spread 《Yushulu》 for everyone to see.In fact, my parents don't want me to be known by so many people.Since our Ye family faded out of the field of monasticism, we have built a house in a deep forest and leafy place by the river to live in seclusion, afraid of being known by the outside world.So I grew up with a group of hermit friends since I was a child, living an unfettered life like a Peripatetic by the cold river.Hongye said, maybe the appearance of me walking by the river will become a glimpse of passers-by.
norm.我是一个被天界遗弃的人，被父亲遗弃的人。我帮他们立下过不世大功，却换来这样的遭遇: I am a person who was abandoned by Heaven, and who was abandoned by my father.I helped them make great achievements in life, but in exchange for this kind of experience.I think you should have experienced the feeling of being deceived by the Emperor of Heaven.
norm.我是最痴情的，从第一次遇见素女，我就离不开素女了。可在素女所编织的梦里，素女喜欢: I am the most infatuated, from the first time I met Su Nu, I couldn't do without Su Nu.But in Su Nu's dream, Su Nu likes other men, not me.But I am willing to accept all of this, for the sake of the plain girl, I am willing.In the beautiful dream she wove for herself, I was just Liuying who accompanied her.
norm.我天生火神，以后岂不是…『斜眼看着你』: I was born with a god of fire, so in the future, I will..."Looking at you sideways"
norm.我现在是小孩，教不了。。: I am a child now and cannot teach..
norm.我也曾是凡间官家的显赫女子，也曾见惯了人间巨宦仪仗、车水马龙的大场景。本来我应该: I was also a prominent woman in a mortal official family, and I was used to seeing the big scenes of giant Mortals and honor guards and heavy traffic.Originally, I was supposed to enjoy wealth and honor in the deep mansion, but that purple fairy grass appeared in my dreams from time to time.Once, the fairy grass turned into a purple-clothed fairy, walked up to me, and talked about the little girl's current and past lives.It turned out that I had such an ordinary legendary experience……It should be a Perfect piece of jasper, but it has not been polished.That's why I thought about being entrusted to be born in the official family of the Mortals, and taste the world.Later, after having this dream hundreds of times, the little girl couldn't bear it any longer, and wanted to follow the scenes in the dream, follow the pictures, and find the place in the dream.
norm.我一直追逐着金乌来到渭河边，我干渴极了，快要渴死了。但是我所承受的刑罚，让我无法: I have been chasing Golden Crow to the Weihe River, I am extremely thirsty, almost dying of thirst.But the punishment I endured made me unable to stop.The Heavenly Emperor wanted to thirst me to death and kill me, the remaining descendants of giants.But there is no unparalleled road, and my friend Gonggong came to me through the Weihe River.
norm.我拥有了极为强大的实力后，为了报复黄帝，便夜闯军营。就在我大闹轩辕营地之时，天神: After I became extremely Strength, in order to avenge the Yellow Emperor, I broke into the barracks at night.Just when I was making a big fuss in the Xuanyuan Camp, the Goddess Nv Wa came to fight.I wasn't afraid of Nv Wa at first, but she held a treasure bottle specially designed to Restrain zombies.Under Nv Wa's obstruction, my revenge plan fell short and was defeated again.
norm.我再一次曝尸在荒野之中，但我体内的犼之魂还在。犼魂将我唤醒了，并告知我已是不死之: I once again exposed my corpse in the wilderness, but the soul of DragonDog in my body is still there.The ghost awakened me and told me that I was immortal.Just want revenge, relying on me alone is not enough, I need companions.The DragonDog spirit drove me to look for the same kind, and the first person I saw was the god of drought.At that time, she was abandoned in the north of Ruo Shui, helplessly resentful, just like me.
norm.我在年纪尚幼时就加入了黄风谷，一切都是家里安排妥当的，水到渠成的。我所发挥的作用: I joined the Yellow Wind Valley when I was still young, and everything was arranged at home, and it happened naturally.The role I play is to let the teacher know that there is such a person as me.As for the Other things, I can't decide……Originally, a self-cultivation life would be spent in a mediocre life, but I didn't expect that, The Sect arranged for me to get acquainted with a brother named Lu.The teachers hope that I will agree to this marriage and facilitate a good talk.I have been docile since I was a child, and I only know how to obey the arrangements of my teachers and dare not do anything against them.Maybe I'm just such a……puppet-like solitary person in essence.
norm.我找大夫给爹爹看过病，大夫说这是因为爹爹在修炼的时候，太过急于求成，所以不小心走: I asked a doctor to see a doctor for my father.The doctor said that it was because my father was too eager for success when he was practicing, so he accidentally lost his temper.Now his meridians are disordered, almost paralyzed, and his life expectancy may not be long.I'm really worried about him……But our Qinglingmen is only a very small Guild, and we can't afford my father's medical expenses.In the past, the kind Ziling Fairy Wang Ning would give us some spiritual herbs, but unfortunately it wasn't enough……So I had to go to the Medicine Valley to gather herbs by myself, and that's when I was attacked by monsters.
norm.我这才知道，我的父亲有多痛恨我，因为我是他的私生女，是他的耻辱和话柄。在天界，庶: Only then did I know how much my father hated me, because I was his illegitimate daughter, his shame and his talk.In the Heaven, being a concubine means low status and being excluded.And my illegitimate daughter is even worse than a concubine.Everyone hates my scorching sun and heart-burning ability, and they will chase me forever in the mortal world.
norm.我知道，虫儿们都在背后窃窃私语的议论着我。哦，银灵子从一只萤火虫，化形成人；只为: I know that the bugs are whispering about me behind my back.Oh, Yin Lingzi transformed from a firefly into a human being; just to see the plain girl playing under the ginkgo tree again, I even lost the task of helping Chi You defend Jizhou.
norm.我只是让你见到我让你认为的样子。: I just let you see me what I want you to think.
norm.我自己对于争斗之术并不感兴趣。我所擅长的，仅仅是炼丹制药，让其他修仙者安心定魂，: I'm not interested in the art of combat myself.What I am good at is just Concoct and medicine, so that Other immortal cultivators can feel at ease and calm their souls, and reduce the pain of the invasion of Inner Demon .Because of my withdrawn personality, I like to study the obscure knowledge of pharmacology.And relieving the suffering of others is something that makes me, who is naturally shy and kind, enjoy it.In order to find the best spiritual herb, another female cultivator, Gongsun Li, and I forcibly ventured into the Falling Demon Valley, which is rumored to be the most dangerous place in the south of the sky.But in order to find medicine, we still set foot in without hesitation.Finally, with the help of a nun named Qingcha, we found the precious elixir.Immediately, I refined the Orb that could resist the invasion of the Inner Demon , successfully Ascend and became a Nascence cultivator, and then continued my life of living in seclusion and collecting herbs.
norm.无头的本将挣脱开镣铐，以双乳作眼、肚脐为口，手执干戈。无尽的怒火驱使着本将，继续: The headless Ben will break free from his shackles, use his breasts as his eyes and his belly button as his mouth, and hold his sword in his hands.Endless anger drove this general to continue to challenge Yellow Emperor, but Yellow Emperor did not dare to fight.So this general started killing all living things in the lower realm.But this still didn't help the matter, the general could neither save Jingwei nor find his head.
norm.吾辈听过很多来求占者来倾诉她们的心声。大概就是别人内心的声音听得太多了，所以吾辈: We have heard many people who come to seek occupation to confide their aspirations.Probably because I listened too much to other people's inner voices, so we started to ignore our own inner voices instead.My generation has become a confidant sister who heals the wounds in others' hearts, but I have forgotten the five disadvantages and three disadvantages designed by the Tendo for us fortune-tellers.As long as people like us who try to understand the Destiny, they will have misfortunes in their lives.And the misfortune that belongs to us is probably doomed to be unable to alleviate the loneliness in our hearts for the rest of our lives.Although my generation is the confidant of all monks, but none of us know my own heart.This kind of mentality of sharing the breeze and the moon, and the high mountains and flowing waters with few bosom friends, no one who has experienced it will understand.So we can only stay in the Destiny Pavilion all our lives, and be the fortune teller who asks about the fate of others.In the end, the only ones who can keep in touch with us are Miss Dongqiao, or Master Yu, who lives in the mortal world but doesn't care about the impermanence of fate.They didn't come to me to ask for their fate, but they became one of the few people who can let me confide in my heart.
norm.昔年，本宫原是冰海里的一只凤凰，遨游在冰面之下，享受着万年的清凉和海水滋润。作为: In the past, Bengong was originally a Phoenix in the ice sea, Roam under the ice surface, enjoying the coolness and the nourishment of the sea water for thousands of years.As the master of the ice sea, the worship of the sea people and the waves of the ice sea are enough to make me intoxicated.Bengong doesn't want to leave the seabed, nor does he have any intention of interfering with the affairs of the human world.It's just that the peaceful days are always difficult to last.That year, before Ascend, Fairy Bingpo used her great Divinity power to freeze Bingyuan Island for a hundred years to vent her anger.It forced us and the rest of our family to give way to the monks of the Northern Night Pole Palace.Since then, the enmity between the sea monster and the Northern Night Pole Palace has been forged.In order to fight against Fairy Bingpo, I want to find another fairy, Mumei, hoping that the guardian queen of the extreme north can follow Master's instructions and join hands with me to punish Beiyeji Palace.
norm.仙长，你好~呜呜呜~我不是故意要哭的，刚才真的有妖兽在追我，差一点点就……把我吃: Fairy, hello~ woo woo woo~ I didn't mean to cry, there was really a monster chasing me just now, and it almost……ate me up.Ah, there was Sister Song Yu of Luo Yunzong who protected me and collected medicine with me before, but now I am the only one left.Woohoo, you ask where my parents went? My father is the prime minister Qingjun of Qinglingmen, and my mother passed away due to dystocia when giving birth to me.So I was very lonely when I was born.The only relative who could accompany me when I was a child was my father Shangxiang Qingjun, but now, even my father is about to pass away, woo woo woo……
norm.仙长，小女子本已一心向道，对儿女私情了无牵挂。不远千里来到洛云宗，其实只是为了避: Immortal head, the little girl has already devoted herself to Taoism, and has no worries about her children's personal affairs.Traveling thousands of miles to Luoyunzong, in fact, is just to avoid the control of the family and to calm down and practice.The little girl has no interest in the disputes in the outside world, she just wants to practice my own way of Taoism, comprehend wisdom, and Wander in the sea of ??learning.But with such a cold personality, even the elders in the Sect think that I am not interesting.So he sent the little girl to manage the Herbal Fields.But that's okay, the little girl was so happy that she stared at those spirit grasses and spirit flowers in a daze, her daily life was collecting and refining medicines.Song Yu, a senior sister from the same school, and Nangong Guan'er, the little girl's old friend, often came to visit the little girl, and living like this was considered comfortable and peaceful.
norm.贤弟，你不知道啊！那个叫旱神的女魃，恨我不肯接受她的爱意，居然迁怒素女。她竟然将: Brother, you don't know! That daughter-in-law called Drought God hated me for not accepting her love, and even turned her anger on Su Nu.She actually turned the bones of Su Nu into a pair of bone qin and gave it to me! Since then, I have become a walking dead, at the mercy of my elder brother Chi You.
norm.小孩有小孩的好处，你不懂。: Children have the benefits of children, you don't understand.
norm.小媚一听说北冥冰岛，便连连点头，看来即使是在气候温暖的乱星海，北冥的名头也很响嘛: As soon as Xiaomei heard about Beiming Iceland, she nodded repeatedly.It seems that even in the warm climate of Chaotic Star Sea, Beiming's name is very famous.Beiming Iceland is actually a small peninsula, surrounded by the sea on three sides and directly inland on one side, only one state away from Frost County.Rather than saying that it is surrounded by sea on three sides, it is more appropriate to say that it is surrounded by ice on three sides.Therefore, people on the island, such as the disciples of the Northern Night Pole Palace, are generally affected by this cold climate, so people in the south seem to be more indifferent.Many people who see them for the first time will have the illusion that they are indifferent and don't like to make friends.In fact, this is not the case.Under the cover of ice and snow, there is a fiery heart.In short, in order to get rid of that indifferent external image, they chose us as foreign affairs disciples to be responsible for external communication.Because our personality is more cheerful, we like to make friends.For example, Mumei, Queen of the Extreme North, who is also in the Beiming area, and Minghe, the fairy of Minghe, are our old friends and old acquaintances!
norm.小男孩望着快速消失在暮色中的孱弱身影，将油纸包快速塞入怀中，悄悄跟了上去。: The little boy looked at the frail figure that quickly disappeared into the twilight, quickly stuffed the oil-paper bag into his arms, and followed quietly.
norm.小女孩几近冻僵的小手感受到了丝丝暖意。眉毛微微一挑，嘴角坏笑上扬。伸入怀中的小手: The little girl's almost frozen hands felt a little bit of warmth.The eyebrows were raised slightly, and the corners of the mouth were raised in a smirk.The little hand that reached into his bosom quickly attacked the boy's armpit.After success, quickly flee the scene.The boy felt an itch, but the girl had already run far away like an elf.Yinling's laughter came along with the wind, "Mother is waiting for me to go back to eat, Xiaonian hurry home."
norm.小女孩随手在地上捡起一截枯枝在手中轻挥，小脚踩在厚厚的积雪上发出吱吱的声响。受惊: The little girl picked up a dead branch on the ground and waved it lightly in her hand, her little feet creaking on the thick snow.The frightened hare came out to look for food and ran into the woods quickly, leaving a series of small footprints.
norm.小女子出生在岚州城墨家，是墨家的长女。父亲墨居仁精通医术，早年以行医行走江湖。他: The little girl was born in the Mo family in Lanzhou City, she is the eldest daughter of the Mo family.His father, Mo Juren, was proficient in medical skills and practiced medicine in his early years.After seeing the Ice Soul Fairy fighting with people in the extreme north, he was shocked by the magic of immortality, so he embarked on the road of cultivating immortality.In the end, his father founded the Jingjiao Club surrounded by everyone, and became one of the famous three tyrants in Lanzhou.As the eldest daughter of the Mo House, the little girl has been fond of spiritual cultivation since she was a child, and she has known Yulingzong's sisters Xiyue and Han Yunzhi since she was a child, but it is a pity that she did not go to practice with them later.Since childhood, it has been widely rumored in the outside world that Luzhu, the eldest daughter of Mo, was born with a beautiful country and a beautiful country; therefore, the little girl has many suitors and is quite flocked by people.I thought that the little girl's life would always be perfect like this, but the accident still happened unexpectedly.
norm.小女子的父亲常给小女子讲述乱星海上各路修士的故事，其中尤以他自己的过往经历显得离: The little girl's father often told the little girl Story about monks from all walks of life in the Chaotic Star Sea, among which his own past experiences seemed bizarre and brilliant.When his father was still young, he used the name Wen Qiang to travel in the Chaotic Star Sea.At that time, he also met a very Strength friend who later became famous.Since the father was unwilling to disclose the name of this friend to the little girl, the little girl could only call him "uncle".When my uncle first came to Luan Xinghai, it was my father who took him to enjoy the scenery and Roam around, and the two became best friends because of this.
norm.小女子的父亲居仁有一天留下一封书信，便渺无音讯地离去了，这下惊蛟会群龙无首，内部: The little girl's father, Ju Ren, left a letter one day, and then left without a word.Now the frightened group has no leader, and the internal voices of breaking up the family have never stopped.The formidable enemy of the Jingjiao Society, Dominating the Villa, is taking advantage of this time to erode our power bit by bit.But fortunately, the little girl's stepmother, Mrs.Yan, is smart and capable.Under her efforts to turn the tide, Jing Jiao will use the most precious Fire Treasure Baoyu from his sect as a reward to attract a wolf monk called "Hundred Refining the Universe" , named Qi Yunxiao.Qi Yunxiao killed Ouyang Feitian, the owner of the domineering villa who wanted to dominate the entire Lanzhou, and took the treasure to thank him.Because there is no strong enemy, our Mohism has ushered in the most prosperous period so far.
norm.小女子的家母是前任妙音门主，但她死于极阴岛修士的杀害。极阴老祖贪恋我的容貌，强娶: The little girl's mother was the former head of the Miaoyin Sect, but she died of being killed by a monk on Jiyin Island.The ancestor of Jiyin was greedy for my appearance, and he couldn't marry me by force, so Dispatch monks to assassinate my family.After the death of my mother, Miaoyinzong became a mess, fighting and attacking each other.I know very well that this is because Senior Sister Jingmei and Senior Sister Zhuo each have intentions for the position of sect master, so they split into two factions to fight internally.But the little girl's thoughts are very simple, no matter which senior sister, as long as she can avenge her mother, the little girl will voluntarily give up her position as the head of the sect.To show her determination, the little girl withdrew from the Miaoyin Sect, and someone else temporarily took the position of sect master.Until the revenge was avenged, the sect master reassignment ceremony was held.After leaving the Sect, the little girl became a casual cultivator with the Title of Fairy Ziling, and became a close sister who often helped others and gave them medicine and pills.
norm.小女子虽然外貌柔弱，但轻视小女子的话，可是会遭来邪毒噬身之苦哦。在小女子的家乡苗: Although the little girl looks weak, but if you look down on the little girl, you will suffer from the evil poison.In Miaojiang, the little girl's hometown, there are evil insects and poisonous snakes crawling everywhere, and scorpions and centipedes are rampant.So the people of Miaojiang used these poisonous substances to form poisonous Gu for cultivation, and the monks in the Han area called me "poison cultivator".But ah, in the huge Han land, people's hearts are sinister, how can the people of Miaojiang protect themselves without using poisonous Gu? Miss Taoyao is the number one poison master in Miaojiang, and is famous for her Dual Practice of voodoo and poison.Even she said to the little girl, "Only poisonous insects and evil Gu are the way for Miaojiang girls to protect their lives and bodies."
norm.小女子想向你倾诉一些话，这是只有我自己一个人的时候，小女子才会思索的话语……从前: The little girl wants to confide some words to you.These are the words that the little girl will think about when I am alone……Once upon a time, a girl was wearing a white gauze, and others praised her for her skin as smooth as jade.Her satiny black hair hung down her shoulders, and her features were exquisite.However, people also said that the girl's face was pale, as if she had lost a layer of blood.People looked at her and felt that she was like a fairy who didn't eat fireworks, like a dream……In the Miaoyin Sect, the disciples were all talking about it , Can this girl really take over the heavy responsibility of the sect master? Under the Sect, there are shrewd and capable senior sisters Jingmei and Zhuo.Will there be a place for this girl who does not Mortals?
norm.小女子原本只是魁星岛附近一个小门派的女修，与师姐颜丽从出生时便相识。二人从小一起: The little girl was originally just a nun from a small Guild near Kuixing Island, and she and her senior sister Yan Li had known each other since birth.The two grew up together, like sisters.We wandered around Kuixing Island at first, occasionally visiting the young master Mei Ning of Taiyang Gate.Under Mei Ning's introduction, we went to Tianxing City to look for celebrities to apprentice.As a result, there was an accident on the way, and our sisters were separated.Later, the little girl practiced in the first generation of Chaos Xinghai, and finally learned that her senior sister Yan Li was imprisoned by Sanyang Daoist of Qingyangmen.So the little girl wanted to rescue Yan Li regardless of the danger, but the news leaked out, and I had to fight fiercely with Master Sanyang.In the end, she finally got rid of Master Sanyang, but Yan Li's body was destroyed in the process.The little girl found the Nurture Soul wood, and wanted to use the resurrection technique to bring her senior sister back to life.But when the spell was cast, a cloud of strange ghost fog appeared out of thin air, engulfing the little girl.
norm.小仙见过道君，我等受道君援手，避过偿岁之灾，当有所报。\n但惯例需与道君切磋比较: Xiaoxian has met Daojun, and I will be rewarded when I receive the help of Daojun to avoid the disaster of repaying the old age.\nBut the practice needs to be compared with the Daojun.
norm.眼看男孩兴致勃勃的就要进入房间之中，你也没有想起那个故事是什么。但是你还是率先打: Seeing that the boy was about to enter the room with great interest, you didn't remember what the Story was.But you interrupted the boy first, "Why don't you give it to your sister as a gift, I don't think this gift is very good." You said so.The boy turns his head and rolls his eyes at you and walks on.You also think that you are just a simple traveler, and there is no way to change other people's minds.The only thing you can do is to manage yourself.\nYou left this place after having dinner with their family in the afternoon.After you left, you remembered this common Story .It was a Story .On the bed, in order for the heroine to witness the beauty of time, the hero kept all kinds of weird things and took them home for the heroine to see.The ending was that the heroine couldn't bear the loneliness and committed suicide.As for what will happen to the boy's sister, it's none of your business, you are just a passerby, that's all.\n"I could have endured the darkness if I hadn't seen the light."
norm.因逃避仇家追杀，自幼随父母过着逃亡的生活。常年居无定所，生死相搏以求活命。: Because of escaping from the pursuit of the enemy, he lived a life of fugitive with his parents since he was a child.Living in no fixed place all year round, life and death fight for survival.
norm.因为本小姐相貌很漂亮，为了不引发过多的关注，所以在外都是女扮男装活动。现在乱星海: Because this lady is very beautiful, in order not to attract too much attention, she is always Event as a man outside.Now the thieves in Luan Xinghai actually want to unite against Star Palace.They formed the Anti-Star Alliance and even ambushed Miss Ben on Nanming Island.Fortunately, there are many high-ranking cultivators in the Star Palace, and a passing male cultivator wiped out the thieves of the Anti-Star Alliance without any effort.That male cultivator's methods dazzled Miss Ben, so Miss Ben invited him to go to Skystar City together.It's a pity, but in the end, the male cultivator couldn't be kept.He borrowed the teleportation from the Star Palace and went to the Alien Sea.
norm.因为轩辕氏的背信弃义，所以两军在阪泉爆发大战。本将单靠一把钢斧，便杀得轩辕氏丢盔: Because of Xuanyuan's treachery, a battle broke out between the two armies in Banquan.With just a single steel axe, this general killed Xuanyuan's family and fled in a panic.Unexpectedly, they actually used tricks to Summon a thick fog to confuse their sight.This general was also lured into the mist, lost in it, and could not use his force without strength.However, our army was divided and surrounded, and finally defeated one by one.
norm.因为域外的人，也有许多心怀不轨，想要偷盗百花弟子的法宝灵药的。百花女修们为了自身: Because there are many people outside the territory who have evil intentions and want to steal the Trump weapon and elixir of disciple Baihua.For their own safety and to preserve this paradise, the Hundred Flowers Sisters will select previous Hundred Flowers Patronus to protect them and the Floral Realm.This lady is the Patronus of Hundred Flowers this term.It may be because she is more ruthless in her actions, so outsiders call her the Hundred Flowers Witch.In fact, Floral Realm was originally created by Shenni Youtan.Since Shenni herself is a naughty little nun who looks only twelve or thirteen years old, she has no intention of hurting others, but just likes to tease those who want to sneak into Baihuayu .A rogue who steals treasures in the Floral Realm.After the Ascend of the gods and nuns, in order to continue to protect the Floral Realm , the post of Baihua Patronus was Setting .
norm.因为灼热，我必须不停的奔跑着，每一步都撕心裂肺般疼痛。而三足金乌就像是在看承受炮: Because of the scorching heat, I had to run non-stop, and every step was piercingly painful.And the three- Golden Crow laughed happily as if he was looking at someone who was being burned.I must touch the Golden Crow's feathers, and this painful punishment will end.For the rest of my life, I have to run all the time, chasing the Golden Crow that I can't reach.
norm.银灵子居然逃回了他心爱的素女旁边，害的冀州城几乎沦陷。孤怒不可遏，只能派遣帐下大: Yin Lingzi actually fled back to his beloved Su Nu, and Jizhou City almost fell as a result.Furious, he had no choice but to Dispatch his general, Yu Shi Feng Bo, to Jizhou for rescue.On the other side, it is unknown what kind of tricks the Yellow Emperor was planning in private.
norm.应龙被咱家用风雨击败后，黄帝老头便又向天帝老头求援。黄帝老头要到一人，是一名女的: After Yinglong was defeated by our family's wind and rain, the old man Yellow Emperor asked the old man Tiandi for help.The old man Yellow Emperor wants to find one person, a woman, and that is the woman who can stop the rain.As a result, the female demon summoned a drought, which made our family's Divinity of wind and rain unable to use.So our side suffered a loss in the battle of Jizhou, and finally lost miserably in the battle of Zhuolu.
norm.幽冥双神，是我姐姐所在冥都的一对舞女。如果你侥幸过了我这一关，可在幽冥双神那里，: The Phantom Twin are a pair of dancers in the capital where my sister lives.If you are lucky enough to pass my level, the Phantom Twin will never let you pass, they will imprison you in the Nether Prison.Let you suffer from suffering and pain for thousands of years.
norm.由于奴家本来学的就是一些招待来宾，取悦墨客的才艺。于是便被护法安排专门负责外事接: Because the slave family originally learned the skills of entertaining guests and pleasing scholars.So he was assigned by the Patronus to be responsible for the reception of foreign affairs.Over the years, the slave family has also been fascinated by it, and has learned many cultivation methods of the Star Picking.This Star Picking is far different from the general Sect sects.Those who can enter this sect are all top monks from all over the world.Therefore, it was purely a Fortuity that the slave family was able to visit the Star Picking by mistake.It's just that what I want to learn the most is the fundamental method of this Guild, the wonderful art of Star Picking.It is said that if you have cultivated to the level of the old man who Star Picking, you can pick up the Star Picking and take the moon, and it is nothing.If my family can pluck the stars from the night sky, it will be so romantic and beautiful!
norm.游戏内有以下属性：\n真气：增加攻击\n根骨：增加防御\n体魄：增加生命上限\n:
The game has the following Stats：
 Qi：Increase ATK
 Strength：Increase DEF
 Health：Increase HP limit
 Agility：Increase Evade
 Mana：Increase CRI
 Savvy：Increase Prac.Speed
 Fortuity：increase the speed of Essence
 5-Element：increase the damage of five elements
 Divine Stamp：reduce the damage received

You can simply think that the damage is equal to the ATK power minus the opponent's DEF power

The Stats can be clicked on the main interface Profile Photo or Bag in the upper left corner - Inner viewing
PS：To view Stats, you need to learn the knowledge of the body, which can be obtained at the second floor of Market- Phenomena Tower or the first floor of Jade Market
norm.有句话，叫做天妒英才，不知道用在妾身的身上是否合适。\n妾身从一出生，就让家人受: There is a saying called "Heaven is jealous of talents", I don't know if it is appropriate to use it on concubines.\nSince the concubine was born, her family has been worried……At that time, she even caused a sensation in the surrounding neighborhood.According to the elders, when he was born, he seemed to hear the whisper of a dragon, and then the room was filled with golden light.The concubine came to this world amidst the golden light and the sound of the dragon's chant.The neighbor, Grandpa Qi, is an experienced craftsman, and he immediately concluded that the concubine possessed an invisible physique called the quality of dragon chanting.It's a pity that the concubine's body was a man's body and gave birth to a daughter's body by mistake.I'm afraid it will not last long.
norm.有人的美食总是能让人心情愉悦，少年很快抛弃了心头的抑郁，专心对付桌上的美食。: Someone's food can always make people feel happy, the boy quickly abandoned his depression and concentrated on dealing with the food on the table.
norm.有人说云就是在天上的雾，亦或者雾就是在地下的云；云雾都是笼罩在三界的一层朦朦胧胧: Some people say that the cloud is the fog in the sky, or the fog is the cloud in the ground; the cloud and fog are a layer of hazy decoration that covers the Three Realms and makes it difficult to see clearly.And Xiaoxian is the exiled immortal who is responsible for weaving clouds and mist for the Mortals.Although he lived in exile in the Mortals, he lived a happy and happy life, with the company of the world of mortals and his home all over the world.Probably because Xiaoxian has traveled too many places, the monks in the Mortals compiled Xiaoxian's deeds into a story from the end of the world, which attracted countless people to search for Xiaoxian's footprints.So Xiaoxian didn't dare to reveal her real name, so they called Xiaoxian Miss Dongqiao.
norm.有一次叶凝烟问起我，为什么我总是一袭红衣打扮？我说这是因为我崇拜缥缈剑宗的大师兄: Once Ye Ningyan asked me, why am I always dressed in red? I say this because I admire Han Yi, the elder brother of Misty Sword Sect.When I was still young, the name of "Xia Ke Xing Han Yi" was already resounding all over the country.Because he often acts chivalrously and kills the unrighteous people in the world, his clothes are always stained with blood.For convenience, he simply wears a red robe forever.I regard Senior Brother Hanyi as a model, and in order to emulate him, I deliberately wore a red dress as well.
norm.于是，大猫变成了我的灵兽。在灵兽山，它是首屈一指的强力灵兽，也是陪伴我的伙伴。云: So, the big cat became my Pet.In Pet Mountain, it is the most powerful Pet and also my companion.Yunzhi also likes this big cat very much, and caresses the soft fur of this big cat all day long.However, An An from Destiny Pavilion is also our good friend, but she predicted from the standpoint of a fortune teller that the HP of a big cat is extremely limited, and it will consume its own life soon.We were very scared when we heard this, and asked An An how to resolve this disaster.An An said that the catastrophe cannot be resolved, but she can ask Tao Yao for help, she has a way to keep the dead big cat by my side.\nJust after An'an finished divination for us, the demonic invasion occurred, and Pet Mountain was attacked by a large number of enemies.As the strongest Pet in Pet Mountain, the big cat is regarded as the primary target of ATK, but even so, it is also desperately covering us from escaping.I was dragged away by Yunzhi, but when I looked back, I saw a sharp tiger-killing spear piercing the big cat's chest……After the war, Pet Mountain was merged into the Imperial Spirit Sect, and I was able to get back the big cat corpse.So I went to find Taoyao according to An'an's words.She is a witch from Miaojiang.With her help, the big cat's soul was called back and lodged in my body.Since then, I have shared a body with the big cat.
norm.于是本公主就在她们的安排下，成功混迹进入魔木崖。这里地势极为险要，易守难攻，实际: So under their arrangement, the princess successfully sneaked into the Demonwood Cliff.The terrain here is extremely dangerous, easy to defend but difficult to attack.In fact, it is a magic circle fortress converted from a military pass.But since this princess has successfully entered, she is a golden flower lurking in the magic wood cliff.Here, the princess also met Yan Shiyu, a Cultivator known as Shiyu Sword.According to her, she sneaked in to find the peerless sword hidden in the magic wood cliff.But according to what this princess knows, the peerless sword has already been transferred away, so Yan Shiyu has no choice but to make friends with Miss Ben, and left sadly.
norm.于是汉地的修士，便用蛇蝎心肠，来形容我们这些貌美心毒的苗疆女子。小女子曾和清茶仙: So the monks in the Han area used the heart of snakes and scorpions to describe us Miaojiang women who are beautiful and venomous.The little girl once traveled with Qingcha Fairy and Li Qingjun to the Tiannan area of ??Han, and all the monks she met along the way were whispering and sneaking behind the little girl's back.It was as if they expected that the little girl would come to Tiannan with malicious intentions, intentionally spreading some kind of plague and miasma poison to Tiannan.But in fact, the purpose of the little girl and her party is to go to the Destiny Pavilion, find the famous divination master An An, and divination for my father, Venerable Wan Du.Unexpectedly, as soon as they arrived outside the Destiny Pavilion, the monks from Tiannan had already set up an ambush.They fired all arrows and blocked the little girl.The two female companions, Qingcha and Qingjun, tried to stop him, but they failed.
norm.于是接下来的事情变开始变得有些荒谬。在京城人人尽传，薛家大小姐不待字闺中等着嫁给: So what happened next became a little ridiculous.It is well known in the capital that Miss Xue did not wait in her boudoir to marry her son-in-law Chenglong Kuai, but instead used the excuse that she wanted to Exploration her past life experience, so she went to Experience to famous mountains and rivers, trying to find the so-called way to become a fairy.Everyone in the capital rumored that the little girl had gone crazy, and my family kept writing to me, urging the little girl to go home.But I have made up my mind, and I will not give up halfway.Along the way, I also met Yan Shiyu, a Cultivator, and learned sword art with her.She heard me talk about the purple fairy grass, so she pointed me to the Jiutian Jiange to find it.
norm.于是我便代替共工被锁在不周山上，每日被铁索贯心。共工则在我的指点下，先去找雨师屏: So instead of Gonggong, I was chained on Buzhou Mountain, and I was impaled by iron chains every day.Under my guidance, Gonggong first went to the Pingyi, and after finding Pingyi's soul, we were able to Summon wind and rain and create fog.Under the thick cloud cover, the gods have no idea of ??our actions.
norm.于是我的游历继续进行着，可惜啊……战争还是没有停止，在一场大战之后，天兰草原大获: So my Experience continued, but unfortunately……the war still didn't stop.After a big battle, the Tianlan Grassland won a complete victory, and the Mulan Grassland became an area under the rule of the Tianlan people.In the easternmost part of the grassland, I met Qin Yutong, who is called the Baihua Witch.As the envoy of Floral Realm, she came to me and begged me to put an end to the senseless killings on the grassland.I assured her that the war was over and that the next thing we could do was at least to quell the hatred.I use my status as a saint to assure the world and announce to the people on the grassland that the war is over and the hatred should not continue.We can no longer continue the hatred to our next generation.Now the people on the grassland should join hands to abandon the millennium disputes and build their own Home together.Beyond the prairie, there is a wider world waiting for us to Exploration.
norm.于是我开始游历整个草原。在天兰草原的东部，是木兰草原。那里同样是木兰人的家园，他: So I started to Experience the whole prairie.In the east of Tianlan Grassland is Mulan Grassland.It is also the Home of the Mulan people, who, like us, are shepherds on the grassland.But, I don't know when the hatred started, blinding everyone's eyes.Since I was young, I have seen everyone's endless disputes.In the Mulan Grassland, I met a cultivator hired by the Mulan people.His name is Ge Tianhao.Unexpectedly, Tianhao looks rude and rude on the outside, but he is a chivalrous person in his heart.I told him, I am tired of seeing bloody killings and hell-on- Mortals scenes.May I ask, we are all citizens of the grasslands, the sons and daughters of Changshengtian, why do we have to fight each other like this, we have to kill each other without leaving any blood in order to be quicker? \n Tianhao was stunned after hearing this, and finally, under the education of the little girl, he abandoned this kind of hatred for no reason.I told him that if I were a saint on the grassland, then my first duty as a saint would be to quell the war between the Tianlan people and the Mulan people.
norm.于是我为了发泄心头恨意，便在凡间制造了大干涸。黄帝却借口此事，把我驱逐到了弱水之: So in order to vent my hatred, I created a great dryness in the mortal world.The Yellow Emperor excused this and expelled me to the north of Ruoshui.People see me as a disaster, and the criticism is endless.Oh, it turns out that human beings are such ruthless creatures just like gods.
norm.于是我在碧海畔奏起了我的《碧海潮生曲》，当曲子和碧海的涛声产生一种共鸣后，如影像: So I played my 《Blue Sea Tide Song》 on the bank of the blue sea.When the song resonated with the sound of the blue sea, the image-like memory flooded into my thoughts.I played the jade flute, but I watched scene after scene of my previous life in meditation with my eyes closed.It turned out that when the teacher picked up a little baby girl at the foot of Mount Emei, she learned from the jade flute in the baby that she was a descendant of the fairy clan, a banished fairy in the mortal world.So she named me Li Xian'er, hoping that when I grow up, I can use my flute to pursue my past memories.The mysteries of the previous life, the reincarnation of the present life, the unfulfilled wish, all the unsolved Story surrounding my jade flute, how many have not been told yet.
norm.于是我主动靠近旱神女魃，取得她的信任，和她成为同伴。同时我为了女魃寻求认同，带她: So I took the initiative to approach the Nvba, to gain her trust and become her companion.At the same time, I sought approval for my daughter-in-law and brought her to this ancient battlefield in the Heaven.Under DragonDog's guidance, I Setting a sacrificial ceremony to turn the female demon into a zombie.DragonDog divided his soul into four, and one of them entered the body of Nv Yao.
norm.于是在亭子里另一位隐士叶凝烟的指点下，本公主来到了百花域，和来此寻找忆梦草的薛思: So under the guidance of Ye Ningyan, another hermit in the pavilion, the princess came to Floral Realm, and met Xue Si who came here to look for Yimengcao.Xue Si said that she was a reincarnated sword fairy and wanted to start her cultivation career again.From then on, the princess and Xue Si began to practice Aerify together.After breaking through the State, the two of us came to the pavilion by the Hanjiang River again.This time, Ye Ningyan and Hanyi were waiting for the princess.It turned out that the war of the Demon Dao's invasion of Guangdong was about to begin, and they were recruiting manpower behind the front, trying to counter the Demon Dao.
norm.于是在一次外出执行任务的过程中，我遇到了执行攻击灵脉任务的怜非花。她是魔焰宗掌门: So in the process of going out to perform a mission, I met Lian Feihua who was on a mission to ATK the Spirit Vein.She is the daughter of the Leader of the Demon Flame Sect.It is said that she can use fire to burn other people's souls, taking pleasure in abusing others, and improving her own Attainment.Lian Feihua recognized me at a glance as the recent active female disciple of Huangfenggu, and ordered the minions to surround me.Lian Feihua wanted to take me away to practice her evil fire Technique, so naturally I wouldn't let her succeed easily, so I vowed to resist to the death.But Lian Feihua is not an idle person, I fought her very hard, and she used the evil fire to trap me, and I couldn't use it for a while.Just when I was about to fall into a desperate situation, I heard a person approaching with a song.I looked up, and it turned out to be Hanyi, a hero known to both righteous and demonic people.He was dressed in red, as if he came here specially to rescue me, and within a few rounds he repelled Lian Feihua.I escaped from the evil fire and was about to thank Han Yi, but he floated away in a red blood coat, leaving me only his back.
norm.与我常一起的，还有叶家的千金小姐叶凝烟，我经常去寒江畔的枫叶亭里，找她们一群散仙: I often go with Ye Ningyan, the daughter of the Ye family, and I often go to the Maple Leaf Pavilion by the Hanjiang River to drink and have fun with a group of Sanxian hermits.Getting to know Ningyan was the greatest Fortuity in my life, and through her, I came into contact with a strange and bizarre world.Whether it is the Dongqiao girl who weaves the clouds, or Xiao Lingxuan who Summon the rain, those exiled immortals who should only exist in legends have now appeared in front of me alive one by one.Sometimes when I come to the Maple Leaf Pavilion, I see such a group of loose immortals gathered together, playing and playing like mortal young women.I even mistakenly think that this is in a dream, and I have to pinch myself fiercely to get rid of it.feel real.
norm.郁垒、神荼，我们是来自幽都的两姊妹，一对魑魅魍魉。千百年来，我们一直在幽冥的万鬼: Yu Lei and Shen Tu, we are two sisters from Youdu, a pair of ghosts and monsters.For thousands of years, we have been dancing to our heart's content in the ghostly haunted land.We scratched our heads and posed, and twisted our hips and waists to our heart's content.All the ghosts were fascinated by us, and we forgot our hatred and resentment.If you dare to come before us, are you not afraid of being dragged into the abyss of temptation?
norm.原来极北女王牧梅实际上也有自己的思量，她知道北夜极宫的虚灵殿中心，有一处空间节点: It turns out that the Queen of the Extreme North, Mumei, actually has her own thinking.She knows that there is a space node in the center of the Void Spirit Hall in the Northern Night Pole Palace, which can help the monks in the transformation stage to quickly Ascend.Mumei actually wants to take the opportunity to occupy this space node and study the shortcut method of Ascend.Bengong was also very jealous of this space node, so he had a dispute with Mumei.The two sisters Yan Shiyu and Xue Si persuaded us to capture the Void Spirit Hall and discuss it again, so we put the quarrel on hold for the time being.How could the minor cultivators of Jigong be able to resist our Strength, even Beiye's junior sister Bai Yaoyi was injured by us.It's just that while we were arguing, Fairy Bingpo was also very slippery, and she didn't hesitate to destroy the Void Spirit Hall by herself, destroying the entrance of that space node.The huge explosion triggered an energy vortex, and Bengong and Mumei couldn't move forward.In the end, they had to give up this crusade against Beiye and wanted to fight again in the future.
norm.原来是那群修士借口小女子到天南是故意散播瘟疫，他们以扫奸锄恶为名，非要要逼小女子: It turned out that the group of monks used the excuse that the little girl went to Tiannan to intentionally spread the plague.They used the name of sweeping up rape and evil, and they insisted on forcing the little girl to leave the poisonous treasures and beasts on her body before they would let her go.Seeing this group of people being so stubborn, the little girl turned her anger into a smile, and pretended that she was willing to keep the poisonous magic Trump on her body, but she wanted to invite fellow Taoists to drink a glass of wine.Those people thought that the little girl was going to invite them to drink poisonous wine, but it was not the case.The little girl took out the nest of poisonous insects on her body, crushed them and flew out countless poisonous insects, stung them one by one on the head, and they immediately scattered and fled.It turns out that Miaojiang people are used to drinking poisonous insects, and the top of their heads will become more and more swollen, and eventually they will lose their minds, as if they were drunk every day.
norm.原来是三阳真人想要让奴家成为他的傀儡，奴家宁死不从，于是他威胁要将奴家囚禁起来。: It turned out that Sanyang Daoist wanted to make Nujia his puppet, and Nujia would rather die than obey, so he threatened to imprison Nujia.The slave family had no choice but to pretend to agree, while contacting their sister Yuanyao.With Yuanyao's help, we designed a trap to assassinate Sanyang Zhenren.As a result, during the operation, Nujia was accidentally destroyed by Sanyang, and his spirit was forced to live in the magic weapon.Yuanyao got the Nurture Soul wood later, and wanted to perform the resurrection technique for the slave family, but was interrupted by a ghost fog in the process.The two of us sisters were involved in the ghost mist, and finally trapped in the dark place in the center of the ghost mist.Here, the two of us became half ghosts, but fortunately, we met Yan Qingyan, the eldest lady of the Ghost Spirit Gate., with her help, the two sisters from the slave family reformed the ghost way.

norm.云萧大哥为了帮妾身根治龙吟之质的疾病，便用颠倒五行阵去换取了一株千年灵药紫桂花，: In order to help my concubine cure the disease of dragon-yin quality, brother Yunxiao exchanged the upside-down five-element array for a plant of purple osmanthus, a thousand-year-old elixir, which became a primer for my concubine's life-saving medicine.So the concubine temporarily got rid of the worry of her life, but brother Yun Xiao was assassinated because he was suspected of having more magic circle treasures.The concubine entrusts another friend, Wen Siyue, a disciple of Miaoyinzong, to use the 《Cloud Note》 left by her elder brother as a reward on her behalf, hoping to recruit knights to avenge her elder brother, and at the same time find her wandering soul.It is rumored that someone said that he saw his eldest brother being rescued by a member of the wolf tribe.It is not debatable whether it is true or not.I hope that the fairy will be willing to find news about the eldest brother for my concubine.Thank you!
norm.再次来到了两界峰，望着眼前熟悉的仙门，之前飞升的情景历历在目，仿佛就在昨日……: Came to 2-World Peak again, looking at the familiar fairy gate in front of me, the scene of the previous Ascend was vivid in my mind, as if it was just yesterday……

norm.在犼魂的指点下，本将冲破了天界，来到了上古战场。这里是炼狱废墟一般的地方，正是本: Under the guidance of the DragonDog, the general broke through the Heaven and came to the ancient battlefield.This is a place like the ruins of purgatory, and it is a good battlefield for this general to flex his muscles.Ben will Dispatch DragonDog to contact Chiyou's former subordinates, Gonggong and Kua Fu, and summon them as well.As long as a group of demon gods can be gathered here and the line of defense is set up, they can let go and wake up Chi You.Then the situation between the enemy and ourselves will be very different.

norm.在冀州战场上，风伯雨师降下大暴雨，故黄帝来请求止雨。于是我的父亲天帝，便让我下凡: On the battlefield of Jizhou, Fengbo Yushi rained a heavy rain, so the Yellow Emperor came to ask to stop the rain.So my father, the Emperor of Heaven, sent me down to quell the rain.Because my ability is to summon drought and make all the wind and rain disappear.Just this time, the gate of Heaven will be closed to me forever.

norm.在母亲红拂师姑的关系下，奴家进入到黄风谷成为了一名青年女修。于是奴家正式开始把自: Under the relationship of his mother, Aunt Hongfu, the slave family entered the Yellow Wind Valley and became a young female cultivator.So the slave family officially began to display their hatred of men.There are a lot of brainless male cultivators in Huangfeng Valley, as long as Nujia winks at them, they will think that Nujia has a heart of love for them, and fall in love with Nujia like a demon.Therefore, the slave family maintained an ambiguous relationship with multiple men at the same time, making them jealous for the sake of the slave family, and even developed to fight with swords and fight with each other with their lives.Every time I saw those men killing each other, the slave family was very excited.The slave family even tricked that idiot Senior Brother Lu into taking Chen Qiaoqian's Base.Later, I heard that the fool failed to grab the pill, and he was killed, which is really interesting.
norm.在女魃召唤出来大干旱之下，雨师风伯的神通无法施展，最终他们二人被黄帝击败，冀州城: Under the great drought Summon by the female demon, Yu Shifeng's Divinity could not be displayed.In the end, the two of them were defeated by the Yellow Emperor, and Jizhou City was reduced to ruins.Gu then left everything behind, went to the land of Zhuolu and fought against the Yellow Emperor.With Gu's presence on the battlefield in person, the morale of the front line was greatly boosted.The Yellow Emperor lost nine of nine battles.
norm.在我的脑海里，总有这么一段似有似无的记忆，好似云海的鸣声，又好似云霄的琴音。在那: In my mind, there is always such a vague memory, like the sound of the sea of ??clouds, and like the sound of the piano in the sky.In such vague impressions, I am a fairy, standing at the end of the sea of ??clouds, looking at the endless Xiandu Xiandian, the golden fence of the Jade Palace, and the swaying Xianjiao……as if all this happened for real Passed, something deliberately kept in my mind to remind me of my identity.But what about my past? norm.在颜丽的介绍下，伦家得知，原来鬼雾的正中央叫做阴冥之地，在这里面，还有许多的阴冥: Under Yan Li's introduction, the Lun family learned that the center of the ghost mist is called the land of the underworld, where there are many ghosts of the underworld.They stared at the Lun family one by one, as if they wanted to devour the Lun family at any time.The Lun family was terrified, because in the land of darkness, All human beings cannot use mana, and only ghost cultivators can use Divinity.When the Lun family was at a loss, Yan Li gave advice to the Lun family, saying that the Lun family was originally a body of jade and phoenix marrow.The characteristic of this physique is that they can transfer the Lun family's mana to the other party through skin-to-skin contact.The Lun family kissed on the lips of a female cultivator Bai Yaoyi who was also involved in the dark place like the Lun family.Bai Yaoyi recovered Mana and pulled the Lun family away from the ghost fog.It was really too dangerous, so the Lun family never dared to leave Taiyang Gate, because the outside world was too dangerous.Even if they had to endure their father's severe accusations inside the door, the Lun family did not dare to leave.
norm.在这个三界内外，吾所知唯一可能撼动天帝权威的，便是已成为征伐之神的兵神蚩尤。可惜: Inside and outside the Three Realms, the only thing I know that can shake the authority of the Emperor of Heaven is Chi You, the Chiyou who has become the God of Conquest .It's a pity that after the Zhuolu War, Chi You's soul has been suppressed on the ancient battlefield.Although the Original has endless tricks, but to awaken Chi You, he needs the help of Other demon gods.
norm.在正面战场上，孤所向披靡，攻无不克战无不胜。于是轩辕氏便派遣大将应龙，去偷袭孤后: On the frontal battlefield, Gu is invincible and invincible.So the Xuanyuan clan Dispatch General Yinglong to attack Jizhou, the base camp behind Gu.As Yinglong arrived, he spit out flames and melted the city, and Jizhou was terrified.But Yin Lingzi, who was in charge of guarding Jizhou, sensed the fear in advance and ran away.Gu Reflection's biggest mistake in using soldiers in his life was picking Yin Lingzi as a general.
norm.咱确实是北夜极宫里的一个异类弟子啦，咱待人很热情，也很话痨啰嗦，一见到新朋友就有: We are indeed a different kind of disciple in Beiyeji Palace.We treat people very enthusiastically, but we are also very talkative.Whenever we meet new friends, we can't finish talking.But this does not mean that we are very happy and have no worries in our hearts.In fact, the Beiye Pole Palace is now facing very great difficulties.We Experience to the south so frequently, on the one hand, we also want to seek help.Recently, Che Laoyao from Wan Yao Valley led a group of demons, joined forces with Xue Feng in the ice sea, and attacked the entire Beiye Pole Palace.In the end, it was the palace lord who detonated the Void Spirit Hall to injure Xuefeng and drive back the demons in the Valley of Ten Thousand Monsters.Now that the Northern Night Polar Palace has been seriously damaged, we would like to invite some powerful monks to become the foreign aid of the Northern Night Polar Palace to protect the safety of the Polar Palace.I don't know if the Immortal Elder intends to become the honorary Patronus of the Northern Night Pole Palace together?
norm.咱只是一个从小就喜欢灵兽的修士，比起什么正道魔道来说，咱只在乎是不是可以让咱养灵: We are just a monk who has liked Pet beasts since we were young.Compared with the orthodox way, we only care about whether we can raise Pet.And Yulingzong is such a good place, everyone raises insects and beasts, and even the Pet raised by others are more powerful.We live happily here, and we don't want to get involved in any dispute between good and evil.At the Tainan Xiaohui, we also sold a Jinzhu talisman pen to a female cultivator who was also obsessed with Pet.Her name was Xiyue.I didn't expect Xiyue to help us a lot when we were about to encounter difficulties later.
norm.早先我在苗疆修行之时，便和程程一道在腊尔山追寻五圣老祖的步伐。我一开始只是希望能: When I was practicing in Miaojiang earlier, I followed the footsteps of the Five Sacred Patriarchs on Mount Laer with Cheng Cheng.At the beginning, I just hoped to make myself a step further in poison art.But I didn't expect the ancestor of the five sages to tell me that I not only have the Talent of using poison, but also the Talent of controlling flowers and plants.Under his guidance, I came to a huge vine forest.After careful inspection, I found out that this is actually an ancient ivy that has grown into a spirit, so a single vine grew into a whole forest of vines, and All the vines are connected.In the middle of the forest, I saw the vine spirit, a wood spirit with the appearance of an old woman.She said that she failed to Ascend, Yuan Yang was exhausted, and now she was looking for a descendant to Inherit her mantle.Seeing me is my Fortuity.
norm.盏茶过后，少年驱马赶至。满目残垣断壁和熊熊燃烧的大火，行凶之人已不知去向。少年紧: After a cup of tea, the young man drove his horse to arrive.There are ruins and blazing fires everywhere, and the perpetrators have disappeared.The young man frowned, raised his hand and waved "Save!".Dozens of people were divided into small teams and began to treat the wounded.I saw a few soldiers carrying the elderly and helping the wounded with broken arms out of the fire.Moans and cries filled the eardrums, a scene of hell.
norm.占卜这种事情，向来都是站在求占者的立场上考虑的。就是说不问对方求占的是多么恶念的: Divination has always been considered from the standpoint of the seeker.That is to say, it is an evil thing not to ask what the other party is asking for divination.As a fortuneteller, we must not refute the other party's position.For example, Ge Tianhao, who used to be a demon, once came to ask for possession.He first asked if he could succeed in forming the alchemy next time, so we can just answer the other party's yes or no.But if the other party adds a sentence, when forming the alchemy, it is necessary to treat others as medicine dregs to improve the chance of alchemy, is it harmful to the sky? Then we would say：Just do what you want, and you don’t have to ask whether it is moral……Our purpose in doing this is actually to prevent ourselves from refuting the other party’s position and causing disaster.The behavior of the monks is beyond the control of the fortuneteller, and the results of good and bad are often derived from good and evil thoughts.As a fortune teller, what we have to do is not to interfere with other people's positions, and to ensure that we do not get involved in disputes.

norm.这片天界的上古战场，在成为战场之前，曾是我的家园。在天界之战爆发之前，盘古遗留的: This ancient battlefield in the Heaven was my Home before it became a battlefield.Before the Battle of the Heaven broke out, the descendants of Pangu lived here.Even the gods privately call this place the Heaven Beyond Heaven, and envy the relaxation and freedom here.This is a paradise that is not controlled and restrained by the emperor of heaven.
norm.这时一个獐头鼠目的瘦小个子献媚策马走至大汉身侧，拱手作揖。“大王，小的有一计。”: At this time, a thin and small man with a deer-headed mouse look flattered and rode up to the side of the big man, bowing his hands."My lord, the little one has a plan." norm.这世间的凡夫俗子，又有谁人得知世间万物的演化规律。亘古以来，世间万事万物之更易，: Ordinary people in this world, who knows the evolution law of all things in the world.Since ancient times, everything in the world has been changed, such as Zhouyi, Yin and Yang, following the law of Hetu and Luoshu.Tens of thousands of years ago, the old man Attainment a great achievement, he overwhelmed the number one cultivator of Tiannan's righteous and demonic ways, and subdued them, so as to give me the land of the extreme west, so that he will be famous in future generations The Thousand Bamboo Sect; I created the Technique in the Thousand Bamboo Sect, and only then did I have the Dayan Jue that countless talented monks in later generations pursued enthusiastically.It's a pity that people in the world are short-sighted.The puppet art that I have devoted my whole life to is the real treasure in the world! No one knows how to appreciate it.It's really the breeze and the bright moon who share the same, the mountains and rivers have few bosom friends.
norm.这一晚你睡得并不怎么舒坦，早上还要被惊吓。原来事情是这样的，早上的你还犯着困，感: You haven't slept very well that night, and you'll be terrified in the morning.It turns out that the thing is like this, you are still sleepy in the morning, and you feel that your face is being poked by someone, and you are so annoyed that you can't push it away with your hands or turn over.You opened your eyes directly to see what's going on, this time it's good, a black ghost-like person is facing you, you thought you really met a ghost, so you jumped up.It wasn't until he calmed down that he remembered that this person was the person he saved yesterday, but his skin was completely destroyed because of the thunder disaster.\nAfter the two of you finished the question and answer like in the script, you learned that her name is Concubine Mu Xue.Because there are no practitioners in the city, and you don’t have a master.I found a deep mountain to Ascend, but I didn't expect to be very unlucky.In the same way, you also informed her of the situation, and she begged you to help her recover her skin after learning about the situation.You also agreed.

norm.之前山门来了一个名叫厉非宇的小药童，说自己只有炼气期的道行，师长安排他在小女子手: A little Medical Assisitant named Li Feiyu came to the Cult Gate before, saying that he only had the Taoism of the Aerify stage, and the teacher arranged for him to work under the little girl's hands.The little girl herself has few desires and pure cultivation.In fact, she hates contacting the opposite sex, but seeing the honest face of the little drug Medical Assisitant, and the teacher insisted on asking the little girl to give him some advice.There is no other way but to let him work hard in the Herbal Fields.The little girl originally thought that little Medical Assisitant was very inconspicuous, but she didn't expect that his ability was really not small, and he actually got a good result in the top ten in the sword test meeting.It feels like he is not an ordinary disciple in the Aerify period, but a master who deliberately pretended to be a disciple and came to the little girl's Herbal Fields to steal the teacher.Alas, there are too many Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon practitioners in the Sect, and it's not just the little Medical Assisitant.Even Nie Ying, the girl from Yellow Wind Valley, is only spending the night in our Sect to cultivate, and even her Strength may surprise the outside world.
norm.之所以我有遁神这个称号，是因为我善于躲避危险。但为了爱我可以不顾危险。我问你，你: The reason why I have the Title of Escaping God is because I am good at avoiding danger.But for love I can ignore danger.I ask you, have you ever loved someone else? norm.只记得，在梦里我已经修炼至大乘，准备渡过飞升雷劫之际，却被一位被称为轮回殿主的大: I just remember that in my dream, I had already cultivated to Mahayana, and when I was about to go through the Ascend disaster, I was Summon to the fairyland by a great man called the master of the reincarnation hall.When I came to the fairy world, I saw that the Lord of the Reincarnation Palace was a handsome man.He asked his beautiful daughter Gan Jiuzhen to take me to Huangquan Daze.In front of me.Only then did I suddenly realize what had happened in my previous life.But after Gan Jiuzhen showed me the experience of the previous life, he said that I was only allowed to see the Destiny in my dreams, and once I woke up, I would forget all about it.So when I woke up, I could only remember the Hall of Reincarnation, Huangquan Daze, and the Six Paths Reincarnation Disk, but I couldn't Memory the scenes in the reincarnation disk at all.So I can only speculate that my previous life probably has something to do with the Hall of Reincarnation and even the fairy Gan Jiuzhen.It's just speculation……
norm.只是血灵大法过于霸道，想要修炼此法，必须要一男一女共同双修才行。而灵根资质对其能: It's just that the Blood Spirit Dafa is too overbearing.If you want to practice this method, you must have a man and a woman to Dual Practice together.And the Aptitude qualification is very important for it to be able to cultivate to several levels.The Hehuan Sect once came over and told the matchmaker that Dong Xuanxuan and this young master should be allowed to Dual Practice together, but Dong Xuanxuan is not someone with Aptitude, so this young master refused.Later, after I heard that the Yan family in Guangdong had a daughter who was born with a heavenly Aptitude, I personally went to the Yan family.Sure enough, hard work pays off, the old man of the Yan family wisely said that he would marry his daughter to me, and he would also lead the entire Yan family into the Ghost Gate.Hmph, in this day and age, there are very few people who are so knowledgeable about current affairs and who are outstanding, so this young master naturally agreed to him immediately.Just wait for the Yan family's daughter to pass through the door, and then they can Dual Practice the blood spirit Dafa together, and wait to dominate the magic way!

norm.<color=#0c5a8b>写在前面的话</color>：\n1、无论哪种化圣:
<color=#0c5a8b>Developer's Note</color>：
1、You will earn <color=#9e4444>all 3 avatar frames and tags</color> regardless of the ascension order you selected;
2、Outland and Time River can be unlocked through <color=#9e4444>all types of ascension</color>;

<color=#0c5a8b>Ascension</color>：
1、Subsage：<color=#9e4444>Finish daily Merit Hall quests</color> and activate all 9 Merit Lotuses （<color=#9e4444>Easiest way that takes longest time</color>）
2、Sursage：<color=#9e4444>Collect materials, reveal the 3 corpses and slay them</color>.（Requires high <color=#9e4444>Realm</color>, as well as passing <color=#9e4444>Outland Yin</color> and <color=#9e4444>Jade Deity G.10</color>.）
3、Marsage：<color=#9e4444>Win the fight to ascend</color>, （no need to collect resources and no Realm required）, but requires a lot to <color=#9e4444>activate Divinity</color>.

<color=#0c5a8b>Ascension Order</color>：
<color=#9e4444>Subsage - Sursage - Marsage</color>.This order <color=#9e4444>is fixed</color>.
1、After becoming the Subsage, you can start the process of <color=#9e4444>ascension to Sursage and Marsage</color>;
2、If you choose to ascend to the Marsage first, then you cannot ascend to <color=#9e4444>Subsage or Sursage</color>;
but you can still <color=#9e4444>finish the related quests and collect the avatar frames</color>.

<color=#0c5a8b>200% Divinity Materials</color>：
If you choose to ascend by <color=#9e4444>default order</color>, it will cost <color=#9e4444>1 material each time you ascend</color>, and the Divinity you have activated will upgrade automatically;
If you choose to ascend to <color=#9e4444>Marsage</color> directly, then you will need <color=#9e4444>2 pieces of material</color> each time you activate a Divinity.

As time went on, Houqing's resentment became more serious.In order to avenge the Yellow Emperor, Houqing dedicated his souls to Hou, becoming one of the four ancestors of zombies! Later, Houqing met Nvba, who was also abandoned in the north bank of the Ruoshui River, and helped her become a zombie.Houqing used his soul to curse all the recently deceased corpses, to help them become zombies after an unjust death.

norm.逐鹿之战后发生了严重的旱灾，太阳像个大火球，烤得大地龟裂，江湖涸干，一片荒凉。夸: After the Battle of Zhulu, a severe drought occurred.The blistering sun scorched the earth into cinders, and the rivers dried up and became desolate.Such irritated Kua Fu, so that he wanted to take off the sun, as he kept chasing the sun and drank all the water from the Yellow River and Wei River along the way, but he still felt unbearably thirsty.Kua Fu decided to drink the water from the great swamp before he could the sun.As soon as he reached the edge of the swamp, he suddenly fell to the ground.Exhausted, Kua Fu looked regretfully at the setting sun, sighed, threw his stick towards the sun, closed his eyes and died.Later, Kua Fu's walking stick turned into a peach forest, where the trees were full of huge fruits.

norm.小女子虽然外貌柔弱，但轻视小女子的话，可是会遭来邪毒噬身之苦哦。在小女子的家乡苗: Although the little girl looks weak, nobody would ignore her as it leads to evil poison.In Miaojiang, the little girl's hometown, evil insects and poisonous snakes are crawling everywhere, and scorpions and centipedes are rampant.So the Miaojiang people used these poisons cultivation, who, called by the Han monks, as poisonous cultivators.But, in the vast Han land, people can be hostile, and Miaojiang people must protect themselves with such poison.Miss Taoyao is a poison master in Miaojiang, and is famous for her cultivation of voodoo.Even Taoyao said to the little girl, "Only the evil poisons are the way to protect the lives in Miaojiang."

norm.其实，本宫与冰魄仙子以及极北女王三人，万年以前也曾是同门师姊妹，皆拜于泠海龙王门: In fact, I, the Ice Soul Fairy and the Queen of the Far North were all sisters in the same discipline thousands of years ago.We all worshiped under the Linghai Dragonlord and learned the techniques of frost.It's just that the Ice Soul Fairy, who wanted to transform into a god and ascend, stole the Ocean Bell, the treasure of my clan.From that day on, I broke up with her, and used the frost power of the Ocean Bell to backfire on the Ice Soul Fairy, causing her to lose a thousand years of cultivation for no reason.From then on, the Ice Soul Fairy had nothing but extreme hate on me.Later, on the day when the Ice Soul Fairy finally achieved enlightenment and ascended to heaven, she used tricks to freeze my sea palace, causing numerous casualties to my clan.In order to take revenge , I came to see the Queen of the Far North, Mu Mei.At the beginning, we three sisters made an oath in front of our master.If we dare to hurt our sisters, we will be punished.Now that the Ice Soul Fairy has broken this oath, I want Mu Mei to fulfill what we swore and destroy her palace.But Mu Mei said that the Ice Soul Fairy has ascended, and the strength of the two of us alone may not be enough.Mu Mei recommended two female sword cultivators, Yan Shiyu and Xue Si.These two female cultivators joined us in the crusade against the Ice Soul Fairy.

3：Different treasure has different luckiness, which could be checked by cliking the exclamation mark in the Treasure Interface.

norm.灵兽-<color=#9e4444>提供大量属性加成</color>\n\n1、:
Pets <color=#9e4444>provide massive Stats bonus</color>

1、Each additional Pet increases Mount's stats by <color=#9e4444>10%</color>;
2、Each time you raise a Pet's level by <color=#9e4444>10</color>, your character will gain <color=#9e4444>5%</color> stats boost, which can be useful in the early and middle stages of the game;
3、<color=#9e4444>Seiryu and Sea Demon</color> are recommended in the early stage, while <color=#9e4444>Divine Deer and Tortoise</color> are for the late stages.
Note：Pets provide large stats bonus, and is quite important for <color=#9e4444>ascension</color>.

Spirit Beast Veins - <color=#9e4444>provides massive attribute bonuses</color>
<color=#0c5a8b>Fiend Hunt</color>
1、Using Fiend Tempter in the <color=#9e4444>Trapping Array</color>, you can trap Fiends with different qualities <color=#9e4444>（Plant Fiend Tempter at Home）</color>
2、The higher the quality, the stronger the fiend will be! The strength of the fiendss can be weakened by <color=#9e4444>upgrading the level of the array</color> （Warm tips：when the strength is not enough and the level of the array is too low, try to trap the fiends at lower level first）
3、The beasts will drop <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】 and 【Fiend Essence】</color>.Failed challenge will grant a small amount of 【Fiend Blood】.
4.Successful challenge of Fiends will also grant a <color=#9e4444>probability of looting 【Gem of Veins】</color>, which is a high-level item to lock the Vein Refining affixes.

<color=#0c5a8b>Beast Veins</color>
1、Every Spirit Beast can have its Veins awakened, tthe higher the quality of the Beast, the more blood veins can be awakened.
2、Spirit Beasts can have their Veins <color=#9e4444>enhanced</color> or <color=#9e4444>quenched</color>.
3、Vein Enhancement
（1） Each blood vein has 2 kinds of basic enhancement attributes, consuming <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】 and 【Fiend Essence】</color> for improvements.
（2） The higher the quality of the Spirit Beast, the higher the upper limit of the enhancement level will be.
<color=#FF0000>G.Heaven：Lv.40 （Tortoise：Lv.50）</color> 
<color=#FF8C00>G.Earth：Lv.30</color> 
<color=#9400D3>G.Mythic：Lv.20</color> 
<color=#0000FF>G.Novice：Lv.10</color> 
4.Vein Quenching
（1） Each Spirit Beast can have up to 4 quenching attributes!
<color=#FF0000>G.Heaven</color>：4 Blood Veins = 4 quenching attributes
<color=#FF8C00>G.Earth</color>：3 Blood Veins = 3 quenching attributes
<color=#9400D3>G.Mythic</color>：2 Blood Veins = 2 quenching attributes
<color=#0000FF>G.Novice</color>：1 Blood Vein = 1 quenching attribute
（2） Consuming <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Essence】</color> allows you to get different attributes through quenching
（3） Quenching <color=#9e4444>20 times</color> consecutively, the next quenching will be guaranteed with a purple quality attribute
（4） When a high quality quenching attribute appears, you can consume <color=#9e4444>【Gem of Veins】</color> to lock it; the locked attribute will not be replaced in the next quenching! （Each quenching retains the last locked selection, carefully check the timely replacement of the selection）
5.Quenching attribute quality probability：
<color=#008000>Green：60.5%</color>
<color=#0000FF>Blue：24%</color>
<color=#9400D3>Purple：10%</color>
<color=#FF8C00>Orange：5%</color>
<color=#FF0000>Red：0.5%</color>

norm.1.灵童通过与道侣双修时灵气碰撞而诞生（灵童品质和概率与双修道侣品质有关，绿色和:
1.Fairchild is born from the essence crashing of dual-cultivation of partners （quality and chance of the Fairchild are related with partner quality: green or blue partner-max G.Mythic fairchild, purple partner-max G.Earth fairchild, orange partner-max G.Heaven Fairchild）.Up to 4 fairchildren could be deployed in the Spirit Fetus to give your character a a stat bonus.For different Fairchildren of the same quality, the quality of their each stats is generated randomly.The higher their stat qualities are, the higher their limit will be.
2.After being deployed, Fairchildren will practice automatically.Daily learning of external spells could strengthen power, and their inner orb could improve attainment quickly.
3 Failure in breaking through in practicing time limit will lead to temporary seal.You can consume gem to unlock the seal.
4.With inner orb, Fairchildren can use orbs to increase their attributes.Orbs of different quality share the usage limit within a big state.Please choose carefully.
5.Within each state there's a limit to the attribute a Fairchild can obtain.If it breaks through onto the next state before fully obtaining its attributes, the left attribute will not be added to the new limit.The substitution function can temporarily restore the lost limit in previous states.
6.DissoLv.ed Fairchildren will be lost forever and could not be retreved.
7.Jade will be returned when a G.Huang Ne-Zha or a Fairchild is substitured by one of higher quality.
8.Explore the game for more interesting facts of Fairchildren.
