norm.1.每个灵兽都可以觉醒血脉，品质越高的灵兽可觉醒血脉个数越多\n2.灵兽有<co:
1.Every Spirit Beast can have its Veins awakened, tthe higher the quality of the Beast, the more blood veins can be awakened.
2.Spirit Beasts can have their Veins <color=#9e4444>enhanced</color> or <color=#9e4444>quenched</color>.
3.Vein Enhancement
（1） Each blood vein has 2 kinds of basic enhancement attributes, consuming <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】 and 【Fiend Essence】</color> for improvements.
（2） The higher the quality of the Spirit Beast, the higher the upper limit of the enhancement level will be.
<color=#FF0000>G.Heaven：Lv.40 （Tortoise：Lv.50）</color> 
<color=#FF8C00>G.Earth：Lv.30</color> 
<color=#9400D3>G.Mythic：Lv.20</color> 
<color=#0000FF>G.Novice：Lv.10</color> 
4.Vein Quenching
（1） Each Spirit Beast can have up to 4 quenching attributes!
<color=#FF0000>G.Heaven</color>：4 Blood Veins = 4 quenching attributes
<color=#FF8C00>G.Earth</color>：3 Blood Veins = 3 quenching attributes
<color=#9400D3>G.Mythic</color>：2 Blood Veins = 2 quenching attributes
<color=#0000FF>G.Novice</color>：1 Blood Vein = 1 quenching attribute
（2） Consuming <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Essence】</color> allows you to get different attributes through quenching
（3） Quenching <color=#9e4444>20 times</color> consecutively, the next quenching will be guaranteed with a purple quality attribute
（4） When a high quality quenching attribute appears, you can consume <color=#9e4444>【Gem of Veins】</color> to lock it; the locked attribute will not be replaced in the next quenching! （Each quenching retains the last locked selection, carefully check the timely replacement of the selection）
5.Quenching attribute quality probability：
<color=#008000>Green：60.5%</color>
<color=#0000FF>Blue：24%</color>
<color=#9400D3>Purple：10%</color>
<color=#FF8C00>Orange：5%</color>
<color=#FF0000>Red：0.5%</color>

norm.1、法宝内丹、主材在<color=#4f9a12>门派藏宝阁</color>，<:
1、Trump main materials and Inner Orbs can be obtained from the <color=#4f9a12>Sect Treasure, Exploration, training map （starting from Mt.Buzhou）, Deity Market</color> etc.
2、After turning on the automatic infusing essence for 7-star Array, the 7-star Array will take priority for essence infusion.
3、You can activate <color=#4f9a12>set effects</color> by refining trumps using <color=#4f9a12>Inner Orbs</color> , but you can also refine trumps without using Inner Orbs.
4、When refining, choosing different opening times will give different effects like TaiYin, TaiYang etc.
5、The higher attributes trump has, the higher its grade will be.You can increase trump's attributes by leveling it up.
6、You need to reach the specified Blacksmith level to be able to refine trumps.If the assisting materials are not enough, the refining success rate will be reduced.
7、You can equip <color=#4f9a12>multiple trumps of the same type</color> , and trumps can be dismantled to obtain materials.
8、Trumps that has been refined can be fused to replace the Inner Orb effect of the trump, and the fusion has a chance to fail.
9、If two different Inner Orbs are put in, the effect of the Inner Orb after fusion will be randomly chosen from the two.
10.The Trump Qi will be increased at Mao time, Strength will be increased at Wu time, Health will be increased at You time, and Agility will be increased at Zi time.
11.Refined trumps （Relics） could be upgraded with star levels （max of 5 stars） through quenching to obtain stronger attributes.Upgraded trumps equipped in 7-star Array could provide <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color> attribute, <color=#4f9a12>the higher</color> Divine Stamp is, the less DMG will receive in fighting 
12.When the total star levels of trumps in the 7-star Array reached some extent, it will unlock connecting <color=#4f9a12>Infinite Star Shining</color> , providing special effects in fighting 
13.Quenched trumps could turn back part of Star Soul after clicking dismantle, and you may get double Star Soul through Void Gem or Tianmen Gem.Jiuzhou Yelan will NOT be returned.

norm.莲动鱼衔半颗星，荷香扶影认前生。: Lotuses move, fish carry half a star; the lotus scent helps trace shadows of a past life.
norm.烈焰缠身逆九霄，混天血刃斩龙袍。: Wrapped in flames, defying the Nine Heavens; the chaotic blood blade slays the Dragon Robe.
norm.春风有信如期至，细雨无声润物生。: The spring breeze arrives as promised; fine rain silently nourishes all life.
norm.青菰裹月浮星汉，赤帜劈波碎玉壶。: Green leaves wrap the moon floating in the galaxy; red banners split the waves, shattering the jade pot.
norm.黑龙腾云噬九天，烈焰焚穹破万渊。: The Black Dragon soars to devour the Nine Heavens; raging flames burn through ten thousand abysses.
norm.青荷欲衔岳色浮，碧叶如唇衔远山。: Green lotuses desire to reflect the floating mountain colors; emerald leaves kiss the distant hills like lips.
norm.仙寰永驻五曜光，此间长乐胜无常。: The Immortal World is eternally lit by five stars; eternal joy here surpasses the impermanence of life.
norm.鹊羽织就星河路，祥云托起相思桥。: Magpie feathers weave the Milky Way road; auspicious clouds hold up the Bridge of Longing.
norm.月阙悬檐聆风语，桂香落影缀云裳。: Listening to the wind at the Moon Palace eaves; osmanthus scent falls upon cloud-like robes.
norm.绛月垂光判阴阳，紫魇凝爪叩心窗。: The crimson moon casts light to judge Yin and Yang; purple magic claws tap on the window of the heart.
norm.金穗垂芒扫云鬓，南瓜抱日缀秋容。: Golden ears of grain sweep the cloud-like hair; pumpkins embrace the sun, adorning the autumn look.
norm.双曜轮转照影久，一念浮沉纪年深。: The Twin Luminaries (Sun & Moon) turn, casting long shadows; a single thought floats through the depths of years.
norm.金乌神弓: Divine Bow of the Golden Crow
norm.上古大能所创造，通体晶莹剔透，散发着柔和的光芒。修炼者只需将心神凝聚于玉盘之上，: Created by ancient Almighty beings... Cultivators need only focus their spirit upon the jade disk to receive guidance and revelation.
norm.相传永生花长在九天之上，只在牛郎织女相会时才会绽放。这种花象征着永恒和不朽。只有: Legend says it grows in the Nine Heavens, blooming only when the Cowherd and Weaver Girl meet. It symbolizes eternity and immortality.
norm.同心佩由两个相连的佩坠组成，象征着永恒的友谊和情感纽带。这对佩坠形状独特，一个是: Composed of two connected pendants, symbolizing eternal friendship. One is Yang, one is Yin, representing the balance of the Universe.
norm.据传是太玄道祖之物，在教导众弟子时，轻摇羽扇可使人悟性临时提升一大截（无法通过寻: Belonged to the Dao Ancestor Tai Xuan. Gently fanning it while teaching disciples can temporarily boost their enlightenment significantly.
norm.翻云覆雨扇，组合使用可号令云雨，代行降雨之事，单独用法力催动也可令云气翻涌，变化: When combined, it commands clouds and rain; used alone, it can stir up surging mists, creating ever-changing illusions.
norm.东海海眼深处历经千年孕育而出，凝聚五行之水（无法通过寻宝获得）: Nurtured for a millennium in the depths of the East Sea Eye, condensing the Essence of Water from the Five Elements.
norm.以法力驱动，可燃尽世间凡物，传说此物可使天仙之下燃为灰烬，天仙之上自爆灵机一换一: Fueled by magic power, it burns all mortal things to ash. Legend says it allows one to trade their life to destroy even a Celestial.
norm.上古朱雀的一缕余晖，足够使此物燃烧千万年而不灭，传说为天外天圣人之物，使用时请保: Contains a wisp of the Ancient Vermilion Bird's afterglow, burning for eternity. Keep it hidden to avoid detection by its original owner.
norm.远古神人采用天外寒玉锻造而成，法力催动之下可凝结护体冰晶。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Forged by ancient gods using Outer Heaven Cold Jade. When activated, it condenses protective ice crystals around the wearer.
norm.上界大能，斩杀啸月天狼后，将其残躯炼化入玉如意内，使得如意呈现出狼首形态，活灵活: An Upper Realm mighty figure refined the body of the Howling Moon Celestial Wolf into this jade, giving it a lifelike wolf head shape.
norm.仙界有名的套装法宝，由九九八十一颗灵珠组合而成，每一颗都拥有千钧之重，祭出之后，: A famous set of artifacts consisting of 81 spiritual beads. Each is heavy as a mountain; when released, they stir the winds and clouds.
norm.高阶制符师必备法宝，可令成符威力增加一倍。（无法通过寻宝获得）: An essential tool for high-rank Talisman Masters. It doubles the power of any talisman drawn with it.
norm.据说炼制时加入了一缕神兽玄武真意，施展之后重逾万钧，以堂皇之势镇压敌人。（无法通: Infused with the intent of the Divine Beast Black Tortoise （Xuanwu） during forging. It suppresses enemies with the majestic force of a falling mountain.
norm.天下武功唯快不破，其上光洁，施展时，有片羽飘落，速如流光。（无法通过寻宝获得）: In martial arts, speed is paramount. The blade is pristine; when used, falling feathers appear, moving as fast as flowing light.
norm.据说可抵御天劫，并存储天劫之力，释放后犹如开天，因此得名。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Said to withstand Heavenly Tribulation and store its power. Releasing it is like splitting the sky, hence its name.
norm.原是一株普通灵芝，沾染仙人功德之力后进化为金灵芝，有起死回生之效。（无法通过寻宝: Originally a common Lingzhi, it evolved into the Golden Lingzhi after being tainted by Immortal Merit. It has the power of resurrection.
norm.历经千年吸收昆仑祖脉之气，成品蕴含丰沛的水属灵韵，寒气慑人。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Having absorbed Qi from the Kunlun Ancestral Vein for a millennium, it contains abundant Water Essence and exudes a chilling aura.
norm.其疾如风，装备后可大幅增强挪移之速。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Fast as the wind. Equipping this cloak greatly increases movement speed.
norm.于火焰之中绽放，内蕴无边火海。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Blooms amidst flames, containing a boundless sea of fire within.
norm.曾伴随一代古佛，因果愿力加身，法不可侵。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Once accompanied an ancient Buddha. Blessed by the power of Karma and wishes, they are impervious to magic.
norm.可藏匿自身修为，驭使后发动幻境，使敌方神识沉浸其中，无法自拔。（无法通过寻宝获得: Can conceal one's cultivation level. When activated, it creates an illusion that traps the enemy's consciousness.
norm.由一条千年巨龙的鳞片炼化而成，蕴含着无尽的力量。拥有真龙印章的人，可以驭龙呼风，: Refined from the scale of a millennial giant dragon. The wielder can command wind and rain; the Dragon Breath carries unmatched destructive power.
norm.由天地之力凝聚而成，能够操控时间与空间的法器。只有在九天神界诞生的才能触发其神奇: An artifact condensed from the power of Heaven and Earth, capable of manipulating time and space.
norm.可以吸纳任何生命的灵魂并注入持有者体内，让其获得无尽的智慧和力量。然而，凝魂钵失: Can absorb the souls of living beings and grant the holder endless wisdom and power. However, it has been lost for many years.
norm.浸润着龙脉之力，能够呼唤龙威，驱散邪气。传世的龙腾剪纸稀缺而珍贵，拥有它的人将被: Soaked in the power of the Dragon Vein, it can summon Dragon Might to dispel evil Qi.
norm.翎羽冠，明晕散彩，灵光缭绕。含天地玄机，植仙道根基。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Radiant with spiritual light. It contains the mysteries of Heaven and Earth, planting the foundation of the Dao.
norm.桃花坠，幽香乍现，花瓣飘摇。含月华灵气，拂人心弦。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A faint fragrance appears with drifting petals. Contains the Essence of the Moon, stirring the heartstrings.
norm.玲珑骰子，灵气飘散，命运转折。承天地造化，卜命定缘。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Spiritual Qi scatters, fate turns. Inherits the creation of Heaven and Earth to divine destiny.
norm.取神兽金乌遗落的羽毛与太阳真火熔炼而成，开弓时有金乌虚影衔火出击。（无法通过寻宝: Smelted from Golden Crow feathers and True Sun Fire. When drawn, a phantom Golden Crow shoots out with the arrow.
norm.仙踪缥缈，缘分难求，持此玉可增强自身气运，好运连连。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Immortal tracks are mist-like and fate is hard to find. Holding this jade enhances one's luck and fortune.
norm.以紫晶为薪柴，丹火为基，燃起的灵火。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A spiritual fire fueled by Amethyst and based on Pill Fire.
norm.药王当年炼药时，用以收取药液的宝瓶，其内尚有当年药物残留。（无法通过寻宝获得）: The bottle used by the Medicine King to collect medicinal liquids; it still contains residue of ancient medicines.
norm.据说是八卦炉的仿制品，但是威能不逊于一般仙人法宝。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Said to be a replica of the Eight Trigrams Furnace, but its power rivals that of average Immortal Artifacts.
norm.相传是古人祭祀神灵，沟通天地所用神物，亦可用于辟邪护身。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Legend says ancients used this divine tool to communicate with Heaven and Earth; it can also be used to ward off evil.
norm.以旷世奇珍铸其本体后，功德金莲投影其中，具有映照他人吉凶祸福之能。（无法通过寻宝: Cast from worldly treasures with a projection of the Merit Golden Lotus inside. It has the ability to reveal the fortune and misfortune of others.
norm.其白如玉，其洁如光，天生仙石，历经漫长岁月雕琢而成。（无法通过寻宝获得）: White as jade, pure as light. A natural Immortal Stone carved by the passage of time.
norm.原是普通火鸦之羽，却因沾染了一丝仙人之血，使其拥有了不俗的御火之力。（无法通过寻: Originally a common fire crow feather, it gained extraordinary fire-controlling power after being stained with a drop of Immortal Blood.
norm.天雷地火勾连，其上形成了阴阳双鱼纹路，持之可观他人命数，俯览阴阳。（无法通过寻宝: Formed by the connection of Sky Thunder and Earth Fire with a Yin-Yang Fish pattern. It allows one to view the destiny of others.
norm.锏身双龙灵气绕，挥动风雷天地跳；一朝掌握傲四方，纵横九州任逍遥。（无法通过寻宝获: Surrounded by Twin Dragon Qi. Wielding it stirs wind and thunder; dominate the Four Directions and roam the Nine Provinces freely.
norm.镜中乾坤万象存，洞察天地无所遁；阴阳逆转驱邪魔，修行路上镇心神。（无法通过寻宝获: Contains the myriad phenomena of the universe; nothing can hide from it. It reverses Yin and Yang to expel demons and stabilizes the mind.
norm.鎏金斗，聚灵真。星辰日月皆掌控，风雷云雾尽随心。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Gathers True Spirit. It controls the stars, sun, and moon, and commands the wind, thunder, and clouds at will.
norm.莲开九瓣映天娇，灵气缭绕万法消。莲心凝翠聚灵力，护身避难百邪退。（无法通过寻宝获: Nine petals open to reflect the sky; spiritual Qi swirls to dispel ten thousand spells. The lotus heart gathers power to protect the body from evil.
norm.传说由轩辕黄帝亲手炼制。此盘蕴含天地至理，可演算万物变化，预知未来。（无法通过寻: Legend says it was refined by the Yellow Emperor. It contains the logic of Heaven and Earth, calculating the changes of all things to predict the future.
norm.内蕴万年玄冰精华，可冻结时空，封印万物。冰系修士梦寐以求的无上法器。（无法通过寻: Contains Essence of Millennial Black Ice. It can freeze time and space and seal all creation. A supreme artifact for Ice Cultivators.
norm.蕴含天地至善之力。凡佩戴者无不逢凶化吉，遇难呈祥。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Contains the Supreme Kindness of Heaven and Earth. Wearers invariably turn misfortune into fortune.
norm.内蕴烈焰之力，双刃形如凤翼。挥舞之际，烈焰滔天。修炼至深者，更可御火凌空，焚山煮: Contains the power of raging flames, shaped like Phoenix wings. Wielding them fills the sky with fire. Masters can burn mountains and boil seas.
norm.内蕴真龙精魄，可御风驭雷，呼风唤雨。龙珠一出，紫光万丈，可破万法、镇压邪祟。（无: Contains the essence of a True Dragon. It commands wind, thunder, and rain. Once released, its purple light suppresses all evil.
norm.冠顶跃动三昧真火，真火可随心而动。佩戴可增强神识，净化心灵，抵御邪祟。（无法通过: Samadhi True Fire dances on top, moving at will. Wearing it strengthens Divine Consciousness, purifies the mind, and resists evil.
norm.凤凰赤羽所制，扇面绘有玄妙符文。可御火飞行，炼化灵气。实为攻防兼备的上乘法宝。（: Made from Phoenix feathers and inscribed with mysterious runes. It allows flight on fire and refines Spiritual Qi.
norm.通体碧绿如玉，挥舞之际，青光闪烁，如灵蛇出洞。既可缠绕制敌，又可化作藤蔓。（无法: Green as jade. When waved, it flashes like a spirit snake. It can bind enemies or transform into vines.
norm.蕴含无穷造化之力，挥动之际，花瓣纷飞，既可迷惑敌人，又可治愈伤势。（无法通过寻宝: Contains infinite power of creation. Its drifting petals can confuse enemies and heal wounds.
norm.金纸朱砂所书，蕴含业火之力。既可净化心灵，又能灼烧妖魔。（无法通过寻宝获得）: Written with cinnabar on gold paper. It contains the power of Karmic Fire, purifying the soul and burning demons.
norm.内蕴真龙之力，可号令风雨，镇压山河。印一落下，可破万法，镇压邪祟。（无法通过寻宝: Contains the power of a True Dragon. It commands wind and rain and suppresses mountains and rivers.
norm.此盘集阴阳二气，可推演天机，演化日月星辰之力。每逢昼夜交替之际威能最盛，可开辟虚: Gathers Yin and Yang Qi to deduce Heavenly Secrets. Its power peaks at the turn of day and night, opening the Void to the Star Realm.
norm.蕴含远古狮王一缕真灵，戴上此面，可化身金狮战体，力可撼山。更可操控炽烈金焰，焚尽: Contains a wisp of the Ancient Lion King's spirit. Wearing it grants the Golden Lion Battle Body with strength to move mountains.
norm.此镜乃为九天星辰所铸。可照破虚妄，显化真实。持镜者可沟通星辰之力，借天地之势。（: Cast from the Starlight of the Nine Heavens. It breaks through falsehoods to reveal the truth, borrowing the power of the Universe.
norm.万年寒玉为骨，瑶池仙梅为面，扇中藏有小天地，内有终年不化的仙梅林，可采集入药，炼: Bone of Millennial Cold Jade, face of Yaochi Immortal Plum. It hides a small world inside with a forest of plums for alchemy.
norm.由上古灵溪底部的千年玄冰玉髓雕琢而成，表面隐现水波状天然纹路，似流淌的溪泉被凝于: Carved from Millennial Black Ice Essence found at the bottom of the Ancient Spirit Creek, featuring natural water ripple patterns.
norm.九幽冥渊深处孕育的「蚀界紫晶」雕琢而成的莲花吊坠，花瓣层叠如真莲绽放，通体萦绕暗: Carved from "World-Eroding Amethyst" from the deep Nether Abyss. Its layers of petals resemble a blooming lotus, emitting a dark purple halo.
norm.一柄以天界瑶池崩塌时残存的「无垢莲心」织就的法幡，中央绣着十二瓣玉莲图腾，莲蕊处: Woven from the 《Stainless Lotus Heart》 remains of the fallen Celestial Yaochi. The center features a twelve-petal Jade Lotus totem.
norm.以九霄玄火淬炼的双生灵器，轮转间罡风破空、赤焰燎天。（无法通过寻宝获得）: A pair of spiritual weapons tempered by Nine Heavens Mystic Fire. They break through space with astral winds and scorch the sky with red flames.
norm.采东海鲛绡织就的赤霞仙绫，挥动时引动四海之力，可缚千军、镇邪祟。（无法通过寻宝获: A red celestial silk woven from East Sea Mermaid Silk. Wielding it stirs the power of the Four Seas, binding armies and suppressing evil.
norm.以祝融神铁锻冶的裂空炎矛，矛刃淬三昧真火，突刺时引动九霄雷火，可破甲胄、焚妖邪。: Forged from Zhu Rong Divine Iron and quenched in Samadhi True Fire. A thrust triggers Nine Heavens Thunder Fire to break armor and burn demons.
norm.锉柄镌刻“天工敕令”四枚太古篆文，握之触感温润似活物，似与掌心经脉隐隐共鸣。（无: The handle is engraved with "Heavenly Craft Edict" in ancient script. It feels warm and alive, resonating with the meridian of the palm.
norm.青铜古币浸染鎏金，外圆内方处嵌着九道轮回齿纹。（无法通过寻宝获得）: An ancient bronze coin soaked in gold, inlaid with nine Samsara gear patterns within its square hole.
norm.玄色幡面绣三千混沌云纹，暗藏周天星辰流沙，幡角坠九枚太初骨铃，摇动时似有洪荒兽吼: A black banner embroidered with Chaos Clouds and Star Sand. Shaking its nine bone bells mimics the roar of desolate beasts.
norm.通体以金龙玉髓淬炼，鞭身九节镶嵌帝王紫檀木，裂空时隐现万民耕作、兵戈征伐虚影。（: Quenched in Gold Dragon Jade Marrow and inlaid with Imperial Rosewood. Cracking the whip reveals illusions of civilization and war.
norm.上古大能所绘，蕴含天道遁术真意，符光一闪，纵是天罗地网亦难困缚。（无法通过寻宝获: Drawn by ancient mighty figures, containing the true intent of the Heavenly Escape Dao. A flash of light allows escape from any trap.
norm.取北冥万年玄冰精髓融合不周山心炼制，曾镇压东海魔渊三千年不损分毫。（无法通过寻宝: Fused from North Sea Millennial Ice Essence and the Heart of Buzhou Mountain. It suppressed the East Sea Demon Abyss for 3,000 years undamaged.
norm.舟身龙骨采自渡劫失败的应龙遗骸，以九天云霞为帆，催动时瑞气千条，瞬息可至九霄青冥: Keel made from the remains of a Yinglong dragon. With sails of Nine Heavens Clouds, it travels instantly beyond the azure sky.
norm.太上老君所炼，灯芯为不灭金精，灯焰含八种天火，焚山煮海，威能无穷。（无法通过寻宝: Refined by the Grand Supreme Elderly Lord. The wick is Indestructible Gold Essence; the flame contains Eight Heavenly Fires with boundless power.
norm.琴身由万年灵木所制，弦乃天蚕丝与凤羽交织，琴音可引百花盛开，灵气汇聚成阵。（无法: Made from Millennial Spirit Wood with strings of Celestial Silk and Phoenix Feathers. Its music makes a hundred flowers bloom.
norm.扇骨为五爪金龙之骨，扇中蕴藏龙魂，乃天帝赐予人皇之宝，象征天命所归。（无法通过寻: Made from the bone of a Five-Clawed Gold Dragon, containing a Dragon Soul. A treasure given by the Celestial Emperor, symbolizing the Mandate of Heaven.
norm.玉佩内含七色霞光，映照人心欲望，佩戴者可吸食情绪修炼，悲喜皆成养料。（无法通过寻: Glows with seven-colored light, reflecting human desires. The wearer cultivates by absorbing emotions; joy and sorrow become nourishment.
norm.青铜镜面青光流转，照彻世间虚妄幻象，妖魔显形无所遁藏，乃修士破障明心之至宝。（无: A bronze mirror flowing with green light. It reveals the true form of demons and leaves them nowhere to hide. Essential for breaking mental obstacles.
norm.伞面金纹密布，展开时金光护体，诸邪退避百毒不侵，是行走阴煞之地的必备法器。（无法: Densely covered in golden patterns. Opening it provides golden light protection, warding off evil and poison. Essential for Yin-filled lands.
norm.采九霄紫气淬炼而成，中自成一方小天地，可纳灵药、镇妖邪，紫光流转间尽显无上道韵。: Refined from Nine Heavens Purple Qi. It contains a small world inside to store elixirs or suppress demons, displaying supreme Daoist rhythm.
norm.汲取万家愿力凝成的琉璃盏，盏中灯火不灭，可照世间温情，护佑一方平安。（无法通过寻: A glass lantern condensed from the wish power of ten thousand homes. The flame never dies, illuminating the warmth of the world and protecting peace.

norm.灵兽-<color=#9e4444>提供大量属性加成</color>\\n\\n:
Spirit Beasts - <color=#9e4444>Provide massive attribute bonuses</color>

1、For each additional Spirit Beast, it increases Mount's attributes by <color=#9e4444>10%</color>, so <color=#9e4444>the more the better</color>.
2、Every <color=#9e4444>10</color> levels a single Spirit Beast is raised, it can increase character attributes by <color=#9e4444>5%</color> of that Spirit Beast (up to <color=#9e4444>80%</color>).
3、Early game recommends <color=#9e4444>Azure Dragon, Fiend Flood Dragon</color>, late game recommends <color=#9e4444>Divine Deer / Black Tortoise</color>
Note：Spirit Beasts account for a large portion of attributes. Very significant for fellow Daoists wishing to <color=#9e4444>ascend early</color>.

Spirit Beast Veins - <color=#9e4444>Provide massive attribute bonuses</color>
<color=#0c5a8b>Fiend Trapping at Home</color>
1.Using Fiend Tempter in the <color=#9e4444>Trapping Array</color>, you can trap Fiends of different qualities <color=#9e4444>（Plant Fiend Tempter at Home）</color>
2.The higher the quality of the Fiend, the stronger it is！ You can <color=#9e4444>upgrade array level to weaken Fiend strength</color> （Warm tip：When strength is insufficient and array level is low, try trapping lower-level Fiends first）
3.Successful challenge will drop two vein cultivation items：<color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】【Fiend Essence】</color> （Failed challenge drops a small amount of 【Fiend Blood】）
4.Successful challenge will also <color=#9e4444>have a chance to drop 【Gem of Veins】</color>, which is an advanced item to lock vein refining affixes

<color=#0c5a8b>Spirit Beast Vein Cultivation</color>
1.Every Spirit Beast can awaken its veins, higher quality beasts can awaken more veins
2.Spirit Beasts have two types of cultivation：<color=#9e4444>Vein Enhancement</color> and <color=#9e4444>Vein Quenching</color>
3.Vein Enhancement
（1） Each vein has 2 basic enhancement attributes, consume <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Blood】【Fiend Essence】</color> to enhance and increase vein attributes
（2） Higher quality Spirit Beasts have a higher enhancement level cap
<color=#FF0000>Heaven Grade Spirit Beast Lv.40 （Black Tortoise Lv.50）</color>
<color=#FF8C00>Earth Grade Spirit Beast Lv.30</color>
<color=#9400D3>Mythic Grade Spirit Beast Lv.20</color>
<color=#0000FF>Novice Grade Spirit Beast Lv.10</color>
4.Vein Quenching
（1） Each Spirit Beast can possess up to 4 quenching attributes！
<color=#FF0000>Heaven Grade Spirit Beast</color> 4 veins = 4 quenching attributes
<color=#FF8C00>Earth Grade Spirit Beast</color> 3 veins = 3 quenching attributes
<color=#9400D3>Mythic Grade Spirit Beast</color> 2 veins = 2 quenching attributes
<color=#0000FF>Novice Grade Spirit Beast</color> 1 vein = 1 quenching attribute
（2） Consume <color=#9e4444>【Fiend Essence】</color> to quench attribute affixes of different qualities
（3） Quenching <color=#9e4444>20 times</color> consecutively guarantees a purple quality attribute on the next quenching
（4） When high-quality quenching attributes appear, you can consume <color=#9e4444>【Gem of Veins】</color> to lock them；locked attributes will not be refreshed during the next quenching！ （Each quenching retains the last locked selection, please check carefully and update selections in time）
5.Quenching attribute quality probability：
<color=#008000>Green Quality：60.5%</color>
<color=#0000FF>Blue Quality：24%</color>
<color=#9400D3>Purple Quality：10%</color>
<color=#FF8C00>Orange Quality：5%</color>
<color=#FF0000>Red Quality：0.5%</color>
norm.1、法宝内丹、主材在<color=#4f9a12>门派藏宝阁</color>，<:
1、Trump main materials and Inner Orbs can be obtained from <color=#4f9a12>Sect Treasure</color>, <color=#4f9a12>Exploration</color>, Training (Map <color=#4f9a12>starting from Mt.Buzhou</color>), <color=#4f9a12>Deity Market</color> etc.
2、After turning on the automatic infusing essence for 7-star Array, essence will be preferentially infused into the 7-star Array
3、Refining trumps by <color=#4f9a12>placing Inner Orbs</color> can grant <color=#4f9a12>set bond</color> effects, and trumps can also be refined without placing Inner Orbs
4、Choosing different furnace opening times during refining will produce different effects such as Taiyin and Taiyang
5、The higher the trump attributes, the higher the trump grade. Upgrading trumps can increase attributes
6、Trump refining requires reaching the specified Blacksmith level. If auxiliary materials are insufficient, the success rate of trump refining will be reduced
7、<color=#4f9a12>Multiple trumps of the same type can be equipped</color>, and trumps can be dismantled to obtain materials
8、Refined trumps can replace previous Inner Orb effects through smelting; trump smelting has a chance to fail
9、If 2 different Inner Orbs are placed, the Inner Orb effect after smelting will be randomly selected from the 2 Inner Orbs
10、Trump Qi is enhanced at Mao hour, Strength increases at Wu hour, Health increases at You hour, and Agility increases at Zi hour
11、Refined trumps (Relics) can increase star levels (max 5 stars) through quenching to gain stronger attribute effects. Star-raised trumps equipped in the 7-star Array can provide <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color> attributes; the higher the <color=#4f9a12>Divine Stamp</color>, the less damage received in combat
12、When the total star levels of trumps in the 7-star Array reach a certain level, the bond <color=#4f9a12>Infinite Star Shining</color> is unlocked, providing special effects in combat
13、For quenched trumps, clicking dismantle will return a portion of Cosmos Star Souls normally. Double Cosmos Star Souls can be obtained through Void Gem and Tianmen Gem. Jiuyou Night Mist will not be returned after dismantling.
